description:
Sobre Aluna

Aluna convierte el acompañamiento emprendedor en resultados medibles.

Nuestra plataforma ayuda a emprendedores a ordenar, fortalecer y hacer crecer sus negocios paso a paso. Al mismo tiempo, permite que universidades, incubadoras, aceleradoras, gobiernos y programas de emprendimiento tengan visibilidad clara sobre el avance de sus participantes, el desarrollo de competencias y el impacto de sus programas.

Nuestro modelo es B2B: las instituciones son nuestros clientes y los emprendedores son los usuarios de nuestra metodología y plataforma, con oportunidades de crecimiento también hacia modelos B2C.

Aluna ya cuenta con un producto desarrollado y actualmente se encuentra en etapa de validación, implementación con instituciones y evolución continua.

Buscamos sumar a un(a) Cofundador(a) de Producto & Growth que quiera asumir ownership sobre la evolución del producto, la experiencia de usuario y las principales palancas de activación, adopción, retención y crecimiento.

El rol

Serás responsable de convertir el aprendizaje de usuarios, clientes, datos y mercado en decisiones concretas de producto.

No buscamos a alguien que simplemente administre un backlog o coordine tareas de desarrollo. Buscamos a una persona capaz de entender profundamente cómo usan Aluna los emprendedores y las instituciones, identificar fricciones y oportunidades, priorizar qué construir y ayudar a que el producto genere cada vez más valor y mejores resultados.

Esto incluye:

Liderar la estrategia y evolución continua del producto.
Analizar el comportamiento de emprendedores, mentores e instituciones dentro de la plataforma.
Identificar fricciones en onboarding, activación, uso, avance y retención.
Diseñar hipótesis y experimentos para mejorar la experiencia y los resultados del usuario.
Definir y monitorear métricas de producto como activación, adopción, engagement, retención, conversión y uso de funcionalidades.
Priorizar el roadmap de producto en función de impacto, datos, necesidades del cliente y estrategia de negocio.
Traducir necesidades de usuarios y clientes en problemas de producto claros y soluciones accionables.
Trabajar de manera cercana con tecnología y desarrollo para definir funcionalidades, flujos y criterios de aceptación.
Colaborar con el área de Metodología y Mentores para asegurar que la lógica pedagógica y de acompañamiento se traduzca correctamente en la experiencia digital.
Colaborar con el área Comercial para incorporar la voz del cliente sin convertir cada solicitud en desarrollo a medida.
Diseñar y mejorar procesos de discovery con usuarios, entrevistas, pruebas de usabilidad y validación de nuevas funcionalidades.
Ayudar a definir la estrategia de crecimiento de producto, incluyendo mecanismos de adopción, referidos, expansión de uso y conversión entre modelos B2B y B2C.
Crear una cultura de decisiones de producto basada en evidencia, datos y aprendizaje continuo.
Construir los sistemas, procesos y métricas que permitan escalar la función de producto conforme Aluna crezca.

A quién buscamos

Buscamos a alguien con experiencia real construyendo, evolucionando o liderando productos digitales, idealmente en contextos B2B, SaaS, EdTech, plataformas o startups early-stage.

Idealmente, tienes:

Experiencia como Product Manager, Product Owner, Head of Product, Growth Product Manager o en roles similares.
Experiencia liderando productos digitales de punta a punta, desde discovery hasta lanzamiento y optimización.
Capacidad para identificar problemas de usuario y convertirlos en hipótesis, prioridades y soluciones.
Experiencia trabajando con métricas de producto, analítica y toma de decisiones basada en datos.
Conocimiento de metodologías como Product Discovery, Design Thinking, Lean Startup, experimentación, Agile o marcos similares.
Experiencia trabajando con equipos de tecnología, diseño y negocio.
Capacidad para priorizar bajo restricciones de tiempo, recursos y equipo.
Experiencia en diseño de onboarding, activación, engagement o retención.
Sensibilidad por usabilidad y experiencia de usuario, aunque no necesariamente seas diseñador(a).
Capacidad para hablar tanto con usuarios finales como con clientes institucionales.
Experiencia en productos B2B2C es especialmente valorada.
Experiencia en EdTech, emprendimiento, programas de formación o plataformas de acompañamiento es un plus, pero no indispensable.
Autonomía, iniciativa y mentalidad de construcción: alguien que no solo propone mejoras, sino que las prueba, mide y ajusta.
Comodidad trabajando en una startup early-stage, donde el producto ya existe pero continúa evolucionando a partir del aprendizaje con clientes y usuarios.

Buscamos a alguien que pueda responder preguntas como:

¿Qué debemos construir después? ¿Qué está frenando a los usuarios? ¿Qué funcionalidades generan valor real? ¿Qué deberíamos dejar de construir? ¿Qué hace que un emprendedor continúe utilizando Aluna después de terminar un programa institucional?

Qué significa Growth en este rol

En Aluna, Growth no significa únicamente marketing o adquisición de usuarios.

Buscamos a alguien que piense en crecimiento desde el producto:

¿Cómo hacemos que más usuarios completen el onboarding?
¿Cómo logramos que lleguen más rápido a su primer resultado?
¿Qué hace que regresen a la plataforma?
¿Qué funcionalidades generan mayor engagement?
¿Qué hace que una institución expanda el uso de Aluna?
¿Cómo convertimos usuarios institucionales en usuarios recurrentes?
¿Cómo conectamos el modelo B2B con oportunidades B2C?
¿Qué mecanismos de producto pueden impulsar referidos, adopción y expansión?

Esquema

Es un rol de Cofundador(a) de Producto & Growth en una startup early-stage, con dedicación inicial de medio tiempo y participación en equity.

Aluna ya cuenta con un producto desarrollado. Este rol no parte de cero: el reto es entender, priorizar, mejorar y escalar lo que ya existe.

Buscamos a alguien que quiera involucrarse como parte del equipo fundador y tomar ownership real de la evolución del producto, la experiencia de usuario y el crecimiento basado en producto.

No es un rol de consultoría externa ni únicamente de gestión de proyectos.

Buscamos a una persona que quiera construir Aluna con nosotros a largo plazo, trabajando de manera cercana con Comercial, Metodología y Mentores, Tecnología y el equipo fundador.

Si has liderado productos digitales, sabes cómo convertir problemas de usuario en decisiones de producto y te interesa construir una plataforma que ayude a miles de emprendedores a desarrollar negocios más sólidos, queremos conocerte.

Description

Amazon Mexico Retail team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our team. As Vendor Specialist, you'll work with different vendors to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for looking after a brand’s product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed monthly reports on performance. You’ll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive category growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

About The Team

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of account management, project or program management or buying experience
 Bachelor's degree
 Experience using Excel and other business analytic tools
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English


Preferred Qualifications


 Experience with software and editing tools (including HTML, Excel and SQL)

description:
Cargill is a family company committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. We sit at the heart of the supply chain, partnering with producers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. By providing customers with life’s essentials, we enable businesses to grow, communities to prosper, and consumers to live well.

This position is in our Food Enterprise where we are committed to serving food manufacturers, food service customers, and retailers with a complete range of innovative ingredients and branded products. Our portfolio includes poultry, beef, egg, alternative protein, salt, oils, starches, sweeteners, cocoa and chocolate.

Job Purpose and Impact

The Category Insights Lead will apply full knowledge to develop a deep and forward-looking understanding of customer, consumer, category and destination-market dynamics across the food value chain, supporting strategic commercial decisions and customer-driven growth priorities for Cargill Food Mexico.

In this role, you will research and analyze complex and varied data sources, including customer and market information, competitive intelligence, consumer and shopper trends, business environment, market dynamics and competition, to identify relevant opportunities for customers and for Cargill.

You will translate market intelligence into actionable insights and recommendations that support innovation, differentiated customer value propositions, portfolio priorities, and Where to Play and How to Win decisions. You will also generate relevant and compelling category-based insights for commercial and cross-functional teams, helping strengthen Cargill’s position as a strategic innovation and growth partner for its customers.

Key Accountabilities


 Apply syndicated, digital and other relevant research tools to assess past, current and future performance of categories and destination markets, including competitive opportunities and risks and commercial effectiveness, to support marketing, innovation, business and customer strategies. 
 Conduct complex quantitative analysis on shopper attitudes, needs and behaviors in the category for insights generation and activation and provide specific actionable recommendations to commercial teams. 
 Triangulate customer, channel, category and destination-market data and intelligence from various sources and tools, applying analysis and analytics to develop actionable recommendations for category growth, portfolio priorities, differentiated value propositions, positioning and pricing strategies. 
 Apply full knowledge of insights tools and methodologies to continuously improve category insights processes and activities. 
 Provide customers and internal commercial teams with advice and recommendations on category and market opportunities, including actionable and tailored insights that connect customer needs and destination-market trends with differentiated value propositions, innovation priorities and relevant Cargill capabilities. 
 Independently handle complex issues with minimal supervision, while escalating only the most complex issues to appropriate staff. 
 Other duties as assigned


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience
 Strong ability to make connections across disparate and complex data and insights, see the full picture and use tailored story telling techniques to influence and enable insights based decision making across diverse commercial teams
 Fluency in English written and oral
 Minimum of four years of related work experience
 Other minimum qualifications may apply


Preferred Qualifications


 Broad knowledge of category research tools, methodologies and suppliers
 Strong understanding of commercial functions, such as marketing and sales and how those connect with category insights activities
 Strong understanding of the market environment and its implications for category insights activities
 Experience performing complex market, customer and consumer research, analyzing and distilling results, providing recommendations and activating insights in a commercial organization

title: Digital Implementation Specialist
description:
📢 ¡Estamos buscando talento! | Digital Implementation Specialist




🌟 Sobre nosotros

Publicis Groupe México es una compañía líder en publicidad, comunicación y marketing que ofrece soluciones creativas y estratégicas en medios, marketing digital y comunicación.

Como parte de Publicis Groupe, conectamos marcas con sus audiencias a través de la creatividad, los datos, los medios y la tecnología, impulsando soluciones innovadoras y experiencias relevantes.

Buscamos un/a Digital Implementation Specialist responsable de asegurar la correcta implementación, activación y seguimiento de campañas digitales, transformando los media plans y lineamientos estratégicos en ejecuciones precisas dentro de las diferentes plataformas.

El rol conecta planeación, activación, materiales, inversión y reporting, garantizando una correcta configuración de las campañas, consistencia en taxonomías y trazabilidad durante todo su ciclo de ejecución.




🎯 ¿Qué harás?

• Implementar y activar campañas digitales de acuerdo con media plans, briefs, objetivos, presupuestos y KPIs.

 • Realizar el setup y configuración de campañas en Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Display & Video 360 (DV360), Campaign Manager 360, YouTube y TikTok Ads Manager.

🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

• Al menos 3 años de experiencia en implementación y operación de campañas de medios digitales.

 • Experiencia práctica en Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager y DV360.

 • Conocimiento de CM360, TikTok Ads Manager y plataformas digitales/programáticas será un plus.

 • Conocimiento de procesos de media planning, buying, trafficking, tracking y reporting.

 • Entendimiento de métricas como Impressions, Reach, CPM, CPC, CTR, CPV, VTR, CPA y Conversions.

 • Manejo avanzado de Excel o Google Sheets.

 • Alta atención al detalle y orientación a QA y data quality.

 • Organización y capacidad para gestionar distintas campañas simultáneamente.

 • Inglés profesional deseable.




🙌 ¿Qué valoramos en ti?

• Pensamiento analítico.

Contamos con un paquete de prestaciones superiores a las de ley:

• 30 días de aguinaldo.

At A Glance

This role is located in Mexico City for a hybrid work environment.

As an Account Services Representative with a focus on our B2B customers, your number one job is to ensure On customers are happy! In this foundational role for On Mexico, you will have the opportunity to support the build of the account services team in the country. You will be responsible for maintaining the lifecycle of an assigned order book utilizing Microsoft Dynamics 365 (ERP), Looker (BI), and Excel. Part of your goal is to help us become the easiest sports retailer in the industry to work with. You will be the first point of contact for B2B order allocation, outbound shipments, and vendor routing guidelines. Your contacts will include account buying teams, On’s Sales team, and On’s Operations team. For each order you handle, you will aim to WOW our key partners and will strive to find customized solutions when errors arise.

You will be based out of our newly formed Mexico City office, working alongside warehouse teams in Mexico City, while interacting with other teams across the globe.

Your Mission


Work efficiently within multiple CRM systems, specifically Microsoft Dynamics 365, Salesforce, and vendor portals
Demonstrate ownership toward supporting our sales team and corresponding accounts
Build relationships with On’s B2B Accounts to enable essential order book actions, reducing direct involvement from the sales team.
Monitor and adjust the order book to ensure accurate, complete, and on-time shipments.
Oversee internal account administration of On’s dealer accounts in Salesforce
Maintain responsibility for daily account management of orders, future orders, and invoicing of orders
Resolve issues promptly as they relate to assigned sales representatives and accounts including returns, damages, and sales order discrepancies
Act as the point of contact for assigned account(s) for all packing, shipping, and routing inquiries, maintaining an in-depth understanding of all compliance standards. 
Communicate daily with our 3rd Party Logistics warehouse regarding orders, returns, and any order discrepancies
Communicate with our dealers via phone and email while providing excellent customer service and accurate information (e.g. inventory levels, pricing, product information, re-orders, and pre-orders) within 24 hours
Other duties as needed


Your Story


2+ years prior experience in a Customer Service, Account Operations, or Account Management role
Understanding of various systems including D365 (or similar ERP), SPS Commerce, and Google Suite preferred
Intermediate Excel skills, PivotTables and LOOKUP skills are a plus
Excellent written and oral communication skills / interpersonal skills with a focus on relationship-building, listening and questioning
Business Fluency in English 


The Team

Being in direct contact with our partners means we are able to consistently surprise them with outstanding service. We see problems as challenges and aim to solve them in the most positive way possible. Communication and enthusiasm are key in Account Services. Dedicated to delivering the WOW, we are a passionate team that supports each other, questions the status quo, and aims to constantly improve the customer experience.

What we offer

We offer a dynamic, challenging, and sportive environment that has been ranked as the ‘fastest-growing sports company’ of its time. With offices across the globe, we are an international team that is hungry to innovate and build something incredible. We foster an active environment where each individual thrives for excellence and can achieve their full potential. This is where your work matters, you’re hands-on, and your team members are amongst the very best in their respective disciplines and fields.

If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity, and want to be part of our growing team, send us your application and join the ONiverse!

description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for an organized, customer-obsessed, and highly motivated individual to join our Support Team in our Mexico City office. This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing team at a growth-stage start-up that works with the world’s top companies to accelerate their sustainability programs. In this role, you will be responsible for providing our customers with consistently high-quality customer support and product education. You will respond to, research, reproduce, and resolve questions and issues related to our customers’ usage of the Watershed platform, while also serving as a customer advocate by providing internal feedback to inform product improvements and new features.

You will:


Assist customers in solving problems related to product features, platform usability, technical issues, product performance, and time-sensitive inquiries. 
Exceed client expectations on response quality, timeliness of responses, and overall customer experience. 
Partner with our growing Support team to refine workflows and playbooks for how Support operates within Watershed and customer journeys — and contribute to standardized resource materials (e.g. knowledge base content, internal playbooks) for you and your fellow team members to leverage. 
Educate customers on usage of our platform and advocate for customer needs internally — with a goal of continually improving the customer experience. 
Be empowered to think independently, creatively, and critically — going above and beyond to deliver the right solution for each individual customer. 
Liaise with team members across the Watershed ecosystem (Engineering, Product, Sales, Customer Success, Sustainability Services, and more) to drive positive outcomes for every customer. 
Explain the technical details of carbon accounting and emissions measurement methodology — and how it applies to an individual customer’s business operations. 


You might be a fit if you:


Have 1-2 years in a B2B/SaaS customer support environment. 
Have a strong sense of customer empathy, always remaining laser-focused on the customer’s needs. 
Have experience using support ticketing software, Notion, and Linear (or similar). 
Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can readily explain complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 
Have strong interpersonal skills, allowing you to function within a team and to build relationships with customers and other stakeholders across Watershed. 
Are organized, systematic, and efficient. You thrive in a high-volume, evolving environment with a proven ability to multi-task, prioritize, and manage time autonomously. 
Are solution-driven and won't rest until you uncover the root cause of an issue. 
Are curious, and enjoy learning new things. You’re excited by the challenge of learning more about the sustainability space. 


Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

description:
En Gamol buscamos Creador/a de Contenido y Community Manager de TikTok para Wingstop México.




Ciudad de México | $10,000 a $12,000 MXN mensuales




Buscamos una persona de tiempo completo. También consideramos contratación por cuenta para llevar el TikTok de Wingstop México.




Si alguien comenta «¿cuál salsa pica de verdad?», ¿cómo le contestarías en un TikTok de 20 segundos? Buscamos a alguien que pueda escribir la idea, ir a sucursal, grabar la prueba y editar una respuesta que la gente quiera ver y compartir.




Tu principal responsabilidad será producir contenido para la cuenta. Trabajarás con nuestro equipo de influencers para publicar 15 TikToks al mes. La mezcla inicial contempla ocho piezas de tendencias, humor o respuestas en video, cuatro grabadas por ti en sucursales y tres colaboraciones con creadores.




Qué harás




• Detectar conversaciones de comida, deportes y cultura pop, y proponer una idea mientras la tendencia siga vigente.
• Grabar en sucursales y eventos de CDMX. Dirigir a quienes participen, aparecer a cuadro o poner voz cuando la historia lo pida.
• Editar video vertical con buen ritmo, subtítulos y audio limpio. Crear piezas con voz en off, animación sencilla y herramientas de IA cuando aporten a la idea.
• Responder con la voz del Tío Wingstop. Saber cuándo un comentario merece un video y cuándo un cliente necesita atención en privado y seguimiento a su pedido.
• Llevar las piezas hasta su aprobación y publicación. Revisar la retención, los compartidos y el crecimiento orgánico para decidir qué repetir o cambiar.




Qué necesitas




• Vivir en Ciudad de México y poder acudir personalmente a grabaciones. Ambos requisitos son indispensables.
• Haber manejado una cuenta grande de TikTok y poder demostrar su tamaño, tus responsabilidades y los resultados obtenidos.
• Haber sostenido un volumen cercano a 15 videos mensuales y poder explicar cuántos produjiste personalmente.
• Saber grabar y editar una pieza de principio a fin. Valoramos experiencia en restaurantes, entretenimiento, deportes o colaboraciones con influencers.




Cómo postularte




Compártenos por LinkedIn tu CV o portafolio y tres TikToks publicados. Cuéntanos qué hiciste tú en cada uno e incluye al menos uno que hayas grabado y editado personalmente. De una cuenta que hayas manejado, indica el periodo, el tamaño de la audiencia, cuántos videos producías al mes y un resultado concreto. Si hubo pauta, acláralo. Confirma también tu disponibilidad para grabar en CDMX.




Las personas finalistas realizarán una prueba práctica breve y pagada.

Overview

Be part of a team that brings the best of Mastercard to our customers.

The Data & Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing the cutting-edge services that help our customers grow. Focused on thinking big and scaling fast around the globe, this team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base. Centred on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include consulting, innovation, data&analytics, marketing services, loyalty solutions, and more.

Also, it involves working with the Marketing team to create sales enablement materials to support the sales team to effectively position our solutions to the right buying center.

The ideal candidate is passionate about delivering data-driven, customer-focused solutions to customers, highly motivated, intellectually curious, solutions-oriented and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. Additionally, the ideal candidate is well known for being highly collaborative with the ability to influence, managing projects to flawless completion, with a high level of accountability.

description:
Acerca de PayJoy




 




PayJoy, una Corporación de Beneficio Público, es una empresa de crédito con una misión clara: ayudar a clientes desatendidos en mercados emergentes a alcanzar la estabilidad y el éxito financiero. Nuestra tecnología patentada de crédito garantizado ofrece una vía de acceso para que nuevos clientes ingresen al sistema crediticio. A través del financiamiento en punto de venta y y las ofertas de tarjetas de PayJoy, los clientes obtienen acceso a una vida moderna y de calidad. El crédito de PayJoy también les permite aprovechar oportunidades como microempresarios y actuar como una forma de seguro. Al aprovechar tecnologías avanzadas como el aprendizaje automático, la ciencia de datos y la inteligencia artificial para la prevención del fraude, hemos prestado servicio a más de 18 millones de clientes hasta 2025, logrando una sólida rentabilidad que impulsa un crecimiento sostenible.




 




 




Acerca del rol




You'll own the technology behind how PayJoy reaches customers in collections, and turn it from something we maintain into something that drives results. That stack includes Customer.io, our data pipelines, external data (EDC) integrations and a growing set of AI vendors.




Your work will be visible and measurable. Better segmentation, smarter automation and clear vendor testing will lift recovery in every market while cutting manual work and cost per contact. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building, testing and seeing their changes move real numbers.




Key Responsibilities







Run Customer.io for collections. Build and monitor workflows, messaging sequences and treatment triggers. Fix configuration issues, data mismatches and workflow failures so campaigns keep performing in every market


Automate what's still manual. Design treatment triggers, escalation logic and contact-sequencing rules. Spot manual processes that can be automated, and document every setup so the team can rely on it


Keep the data flowing. Build and maintain SQL/Python pipelines that feed customer and account data into Customer.io. Watch data quality and fix failures before they hit campaigns, working with our Data Analyst and Engineering


Connect external data. Set up and maintain EDC and third-party data integrations so new sources are validated and ready to use. Keep integration workflows and data dictionaries up to date


Test and scale AI tools. Pilot new collections tools such as conversational AI and smart contact prioritization. Measure each vendor against a control group on recovery, cost and ROI, then double down on what works


























Qualifications


We're hiring for skills and potential. If you meet most of these points, we'd like to hear from you.





1–2 years of experience in a data, CRM, marketing-automation or operations role


Hands-on use of Customer.io or a similar platform (Braze, HubSpot, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Iterable or similar)


Working SQL: you can write queries to pull, join and check data on your own


Experience with workflow-automation tools


Understanding of A/B tests or treatment-vs-control experiments and how to read their results


Care for data quality: you notice when numbers don't add up and dig in


Comfort learning and setting up new tools with little supervision


Clear writing and the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical teams


Advanced English and a bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience




Bonus points


None of these are required. We'll help you learn them.





Python for data pipelines or scripting


API integrations with external data sources or third-party providers


Collections or credit operations experience, especially across LatAm, South Africa or the Philippines (treatment strategies, days-past-due segmentation, agency assignment)


Databricks, Snowflake, Infobip or similar messaging gateways


Customer data platform (CDP) concepts and multi-channel contact strategy


Evaluating AI/ML vendors


Spanish, Portuguese or another language spoken in our markets

50% Vacation premium

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The Company Is Founder Led, Profitable And Growing.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators. They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories, and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As an experienced marketer at Canonical, you’ll lead cross-disciplinary teams of product, partner, or sales professionals in your specific area, from establishing priorities and strategies with senior stakeholders to delivering on integrated campaigns. We are looking for both generalists who want to take ownership of a product portfolio or channel, and for specialists who can help the whole team excel in their domain of expertise.

Location: This is a globally remote role; you can be based in EMEA, APAC, or the Americas, depending on the team’s location.

The role entails

You will take ownership of one of our core marketing tracks and lead both strategy and execution. You’ll ensure campaigns land, launches succeed, and adoption grows, while contributing to the broader go-to-market engine.

You will:


Lead GTM strategy and campaign execution in your functional area
Align with product, sales, content, and partner teams to deliver integrated plans
Shape messaging, positioning, and assets that resonate with customers
Design and run experiments to test your hypothesis
Drive major launches, marketing initiatives, and growth programs
Run reviews and retrospectives to improve performance and impact
Mentor colleagues, strengthen the function, and set high standards for delivery

Strong written and verbal communication in English
Exceptional academic track record from high school and university
Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in software, SaaS, or open source

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Learn more at www.teads.com.

Lead client workshops and deep dives on topics such as viewability, brand safety and campaign performance, translating technical data into clear messages for non-technical audiences.

Contribute to internal team development through consistent knowledge sharing and operational best practice exercises.


What will you bring to the team?

Must-Haves (The Baseline Bar)

description:
Telepatia AI is a healthtech company on a mission to transform healthcare in Latin America and beyond. Born at Stanford and built by doctors for doctors, our platform introduces AI Healthcare Employees that work invisibly inside clinical workflows: transcribing consultations in real time, generating structured medical records, offering evidence-based decision support, and integrating seamlessly with any current health system, all without disrupting the physician's flow.

Already adopted by thousands of doctors and leading hospitals across the region, Telepatia has demonstrated measurable impact: reducing cognitive load, improving patient experience, and increasing adherence to clinical protocols.

Our vision is bold: to turn scarcity into abundance by empowering healthcare professionals with scalable, trustworthy intelligence, and to pursue nothing less than the first Nobel Prize in Medicine for Latin America since 1984 with an AI Doctor.

About The Role

Doctors do not adopt software because a contract was signed. They adopt it because someone was next to them during their first consultations, answered their questions, fixed the small things and showed them the note was better than what they would have typed. That someone is you.

You will spend most of your time in the field, inside hospitals and clinics, making sure doctors learn, trust and love the product. You are the bridge between medical teams, our product and the engineering squads.

Core skills: (i) Empathy and communication with doctors (ii) Adaptability and organization in unstructured environments (iii) Persistence in driving adoption (iv) Energy and ownership.

One requirement: Be patient-centered (and cool). Languages: Spanish (native), English (basic technical comprehension).

What you will do Guide doctors during their first consultations with Telepatia's scribe, on site, specialty by specialty.

Provide hands‑on support (technical and emotional) to make the transition to AI‑assisted documentation smooth.

Monitor adoption metrics: consultations per doctor, drop‑off rate, time to first success; act on them daily.

Collect feedback and communicate insights to product, engineering and the Medicine team.

Assist with patient consent (consentimiento informado) and make sure compliance is in place at every site.

Coordinate with Forward Deployed Engineers for setup and technical troubleshooting.

Train new users on best practices to maximize note accuracy and speed; identify champions who help usage grow organically. What we look for

More than experience, we look for attitude and drive. Recent graduate or early career: nursing, biomedical engineering, health administration, clinical research coordination or hospital operations.

Strong communication skills and empathy with medical professionals; comfortable with busy, skeptical doctors.

Proven ability to work independently in fast‑paced, unstructured environments.

Comfort spending most of your time inside hospitals, interacting with different specialists.

Passion for healthcare, technology and improving doctors' lives.

Grit, ownership and emotional intelligence. Nice to have Hospital operations, digital health or change management experience.

Junior medical representative or clinical research coordinator background.

Experience activating users for a software, fintech or medical‑device company. What we offer Variable: based on doctor activation performance.

Training with the Onboarding team in Colombia, where more than 25 institutions have been activated.

Direct mentorship from the AI Deployment Strategist and the Country Manager.

Career progression into Lead Onboarding Specialist, Customer Success or the Medicine team as Mexico scales.

Every doctor you activate touches thousands of patients. How we work We're always on.

We own what we do and don't wait for anyone.

We move fast and with focus.

We play to win. What this means for you Ask questions. There are no silos; we grow by learning together. Own your work. Don't wait until tomorrow; don't hand over unfinished work. Speak up. Every voice matters, no matter the title. Focus on impact. Prioritize what moves the needle.

Leave things better than you found them. Motivation and alignment: 30 minutes with the People team. Scenario simulation: 45 minutes: doctor onboarding role‑play, with the AI Deployment Strategist. Culture and values: 30 minutes with a founder, Mau or Cata.

Monitorear KPIs de campaña e identificar desviaciones u oportunidades de optimización para escalar al supervisor.

Asegurar la precisión de la información en sistemas, reportes y controles administrativos.

Dar seguimiento a conciliaciones, facturación, documentación y cierres de inversión con proveedores y equipos internos.

Cumplir procesos, tiempos y estándares de calidad, respondiendo con agilidad ante cambios de prioridad.

Licenciatura concluida en Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Comunicación, Administración o carrera afín.

1 a 3 años de experiencia en agencia de medios, publicidad, marketing o áreas relacionadas.

Experiencia en implementación, seguimiento y cierre de campañas.

Manejo intermedio de Excel y PowerPoint; capacidad para trabajar con bases de datos, reportes y presentaciones.

Comprensión de inglés de aproximadamente 80%.

Who is UJV?

Planning and managing a 5-star vacation from scratch requires expertise, cleverness, and a genuine passion for detail. That's what UJV is all about. UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How?


UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide.
We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.
We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.
We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity
and attention to detail.
We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.


Role Mission

At Ultimate Jet Vacations, email is more than a channel, it’s one of our most powerful revenue engines. It’s how we nurture travelers from first click to confirmed booking, and how we keep them coming back.

We’re looking for an Email Marketing Specialist who will own the strategy, execution, and performance of our email programs in HubSpot. You’ll design campaigns and automated journeys that grow our subscriber base, deepen engagement, and consistently drive revenue, with a goal of generating at least USD 5 million annually through email.

This role goes beyond sending campaigns. You’ll be a HubSpot system expert, a data-driven optimizer, and a creative storyteller, turning insights into smarter campaigns and measurable business results.

Responsibilities

Lifecycle & CRM Strategy

You will own and evolve UJV’s CRM ecosystem within HubSpot, building scalable segmentation and lifecycle strategies that move advisors from new leads to highly engaged, high-value partners. You’ll continuously improve audience targeting, engagement scoring, and database health to maximize conversion opportunities.

Email Marketing & Campaign Execution

You will build and execute high-performing email campaigns across nurture flows, co-op campaigns, re-engagement sequences, and conversion-focused initiatives. You understand how to balance strategy with flawless execution, ensuring campaigns are timely, relevant, and aligned with business priorities.

Segmentation & Personalization

You will develop sophisticated segmentation strategies based on advisor behavior, engagement history, booking trends, and destination interests. You know personalization goes beyond “first name” tokens, and you understand how to make every campaign feel intentional and relevant.

Automation & Funnel Development

You will create scalable automated workflows that support long-term growth, including onboarding journeys, nurture sequences, re-engagement campaigns, and conversion funnels. You think beyond one-off sends and build systems that continuously move advisors through the lifecycle.

Performance, Optimization & AI-Powered Growth

You will own email performance reporting and optimization, tracking metrics such as engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution, and campaign ROI. You’re naturally analytical and constantly testing, iterating, and improving. We leverage AI to move faster, and you’ll use AI-powered tools to improve targeting, messaging, efficiency, and performance insights.

Qualifications


High-performance mindset and drive. Our culture is strongly based on results.
Experience in the travel industry (required), ideally luxury travel.
HubSpot Marketing Hub certified, or demonstrably proficient in all aspects of the platform. You must be a system expert.
3+ years of experience in email marketing with a proven track record of success, including:
Significant expansion of email subscriber lists
Continual growth of engagement rates
Campaigns that delivered high conversion rates and significant revenue growth
Detailed reports showing profitability across platforms and campaigns
Experience with email marketing automation tools and workflows.
Strong understanding of email marketing best practices, including segmentation, personalization, and A/B testing.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Impeccable written and verbal communication skills in English.
A creative mindset that produces high-performing, data-driven marketing.

Bonus Points


Experience in luxury travel or high-touch, high-ticket sales environments.
Strong background in inbound marketing methodology.
Experience integrating HubSpot with CRM data for end-to-end revenue attribution.
Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for custom email templates.
Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Tableau or Power BI.


Who You Are

You’re a data-driven email marketing pro who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

You don’t just send emails, you understand the story behind the numbers and use it to make every campaign smarter than the last.

You’re equally comfortable building a complex HubSpot workflow, writing a subject line that earns the open, and presenting performance results to stakeholders.

You’re creative, analytical, and accountable, and you take ownership of your revenue targets as if they were your own.

Why You’ll Love This Role

As Email Marketing Specialist, you’ll have direct ownership of a channel that drives millions in revenue for UJV. You’ll work closely with the Marketing team, designers, content creators, and Sales to shape how we engage travelers across their entire journey.

If you’re excited about combining creativity, data, and HubSpot mastery to deliver measurable results, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

description:
¿Quiénes somos? 




Clivi es la primera startup en México enfocada en mejorar la vida de personas con enfermedades crónicas como diabetes, sobrepeso y obesidad, las principales causas de muerte en México y Latinoamérica.




Somos la empresa de salud digital de mayor crecimiento en México: hemos atendido a más de 17 mil pacientes. Fuimos la primera compañía digital en México en trabajar con los dos titanes del GLP-1 en el mundo. Nuestra misión es simple pero poderosa: llevar salud de calidad a quienes más lo necesitan.




La posición 




No buscamos un perfil. Buscamos solo a alguien extraordinari@.




Te vamos a dar problemas reales del negocio, no tareas. Un funnel que no convierte. Un canal que nadie ha probado, una línea de negocio que lanzar, etc.. Un proceso manual que se come 40 horas a la semana del equipo. Tu trabajo es entender el problema, construir la solución (con código, con IA, con lo que haga falta) y medir si funcionó. Luego el siguiente.




Serás un builder: un mes estarás automatizando el seguimiento de leads con agentes de IA, el siguiente lanzando un experimento de adquisición, el siguiente construyendo el dashboard de automatizado de una nueva línea de negocio que tú mismo@ lanzaste. Trabajarás directamente con los fundadores.




¿Qué harás con nosotros? 




Tomar proyectos de growth de principio a fin: diagnóstico, solución, lanzamiento y medición.
Construir herramientas internas, automatizaciones y agentes de IA que hagan que el equipo se mueva 10x más rápido.
Diseñar y correr experimentos de adquisición, conversión y retención; documentar qué funcionó y qué no.
Conectar datos de marketing, ventas y producto para encontrar dónde se pierde el dinero y dónde está la siguiente palanca para crecer más rápido.
Prototipar en días lo que otras empresas tardan meses en decidir.




¿Qué buscamos? 




Construiste algo real. Una app, un bot, una herramienta, un negocio, un proyecto open source. Algo que otras personas usaron, que generó dinero o que resolvió un problema real. Muéstranos el link, el repo o los números. Este es el requisito más importante.
Sabes programar y usas IA para programar más rápido (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot o lo que uses). Te sientes en casa en la terminal.
Vienes de ingeniería, economía, actuaría, matemáticas, física, computación o ciencias, o aprendiste por tu cuenta y lo puedes demostrar.
Estás al inicio de tu carrera: puedes ser recién egresad@ o tener tus primeros años de experiencia. Lo que importa no es tu CV, es lo que has construido.
Eres autodidacta. Si no sabes algo, lo aprendes este fin de semana.
No aceptas un no por respuesta. Eres hustler, emprendedor@, survivor. Si una puerta se cierra, encuentras la ventana.
Piensas en primeros principios: entiendes el problema antes de saltar a la solución.
Tiene ambición para ganar, y ganas de construir la compañía de salud digital más grande de LATAM. (competir y ganar) 
Te comunicas bien en inglés, oral y escrito.




Suma puntos 




Ganaste hackathons, olimpiadas de matemáticas o programación, o competencias similares.
Ya emprendiste, aunque haya fracasado. Sobre todo si fracasó y sabes por qué.
Tienes seguidores, usuarios o clientes que puedes nombrar.




Esto no es para todos 




Seremos honestos: esto no es un trabajo de 9 a 6. Trabajamos con intensidad de fundador. Hay semanas largas y fines de semana en los que un lanzamiento no puede esperar. Buscamos gente que quiera estar en la oficina porque ahí está la acción, que se obsesione con sus proyectos y que no pueda dormir hasta resolverlos. Si buscas comodidad, este no es tu lugar. Si buscas aprender en 2 años lo que otros aprenden en 10, sí.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?




Equity. La gente extraordinaria debe ser dueña de su empresa. Para parecerlo hay que serlo: tendrás acciones de Clivi.

Viva Talent connects US companies with exceptional Executive Assistants and creates meaningful, career-defining work for talented people across Latin America. We’re opening this role to make candidate generation more consistent as Viva’s hiring needs grow. Lead candidate demand generation: Build and manage a multi-channel strategy to attract candidates, with social media as a core channel.

Start hands-on and grow into leadership: Begin as the sole recruitment marketing contributor, personally developing and running the work. As the function grows, take on people management and lead and new team members.




Requirements




Marketing management: 3+ years in a marketing manager role, including at least 2 years with people management responsibilities.

Use performance data to improve results and connect campaigns to pipeline impact, hires, and post-hire quality. Candidate-generation experience is ideal; customer or user lead generation is transferable (B2C preferred).
End-to-end paid campaigns: Assess campaign needs and audiences, build and create ads, launch campaigns, analyze impact, and optimize results. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok.
Organic social content: Create consistent, original content that attracts candidates and encourages them to learn more or apply.
AI, automation, and systems: Use LLMs, tools such as Zapier or n8n, and vibe-coding tools such as Lovable to improve workflows. CRM experience is relevant. Bring original ideas and make independent creative decisions.
Communication: C1+ English, with clear, confident, concise written and verbal communication.




Nice to have: Recruitment marketing, Talent Acquisition, employer brand, candidate-generation, or B2C experience; staff- or influencer-generated content experience; Google or AEO experience.




Location

Remote, based in Argentina, Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Nicaragua, Colombia, Ecuador, or Mexico.




Benefits




100% remote work, forever.
Competitive compensation with increases every six months and performance bonuses.
Global health insurance, including medical, dental, vision, mental health, and routine care.
Paid holidays, vacation, sick leave, and family care days.
Parental leave and flexible support.
A culture centered around growth, ownership, well-being, and continuous learning.




How we hire




A focused process: application → recruiter screen → skills assessment → hiring-manager interview → final interview. We move quickly and respect your time.

description:
About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

Community Associate | Community

About The Opportunity

As a Community Associate, you'll be the primary point of contact for the Community and act as the “face” of WeWork! You will report to your building each day to support the Community Management team.

Duties

Your work, which will include but not be limited to the duties listed below, will help WeWork to achieve the following:


Build a welcoming and collaborative community environment amongst our members through events and building relationships between members!
Ensure that your building is fully operational and processes are running efficiently.
Drive growth and promotion of WeWork-provided service offerings.
Take direction from the Community Lead and the Community Manager to support the Community Team as necessary.
All of this while illustrating WeWork’s core values and working towards achieving our mission.


Depending on the location you are assigned, you’ll either work with a variety of members from different backgrounds and industries, or focus your efforts on one of our Enterprise clients. Employees supporting our Enterprise locations may have different holidays, technical systems, operational and relationship requirements, and property management responsibilities than employees in our Classic locations.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the following areas: 

Front Desk Management


Cover the front desk during the building’s set business hours and be an on-site point of contact, easily located on the member floor or at Community Bar.
Greet members and guests with a warm and welcoming demeanor.
Ensure all visiting guests are in accordance with WeWork's guest policy by ensuring all guests properly sign-in via Welkio tablet.
Learn the names of members and guests with the goal of building relationships in order to facilitate the sense of Community WeWork is known for.
Anticipate member and guest needs before they arise using relevant information collected about members to enhance and personalize their experience.
Ensure building Specific forms are up to date including pet forms, filming requests, bike room requests, etc.
Keep the front desk clean and organized.
Notify members of any food deliveries and couriers.
Answer any questions from members and guests related to the building including way-finding, policies and procedures, community etiquette, etc.


Events And Membership Engagement


Provide feedback on programming types (based on member makeup) and evaluate events based on attendance, satisfaction, and impact on the appropriate event team.
Consistently celebrate members’ successes and milestones through gifts and notes.
Distribute all necessary info to promote the event including creation and posting of weekly events poster and individual event posters.
Ensure building-specific operational requirements are met for each event (elevators, HVAC, etc).
Input notes into Kube or equivalent system about Members.
Identify and execute opportunities to connect members with each other.
Know and recommend local restaurants, food delivery services, catering options, team outing venues, post office, shipping center, supply store, etc.
Be active on the WeWork member network to engage members.
Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures and communicate, inform, and update members on building issues.
Ensure music levels and activations are appropriate to the daypart and occasion.
Write and send broadcasts relating to building updates.


Building Operations And Management


Receive, process, sort, and organize all mail.
Locate and issue posts via the regional system to members upon request.
Keep the mailroom organized and clean.
“Return to Sender" for unidentified mail and former member mail after 30 days of no-pick up.
Ensure courier parcels have all the correct details for scheduled pick-ups.
Investigate, escalate, and resolve 'lost' packages.
Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures around mail and mailroom.
Track, audit, and organize keys collected and distributed.
Manage keycard stock and request new inventory as needed.
Collect keys and key cards upon move-out.
Review location and how to use each piece of Emergency Equipment.
Provide support for an automated coffee machine for guests and members.


About You

We’d love to hear from you if you meet the qualifications below:


College graduate with a four-year degree preferred, but not required
1+ years of hospitality experience
Customer service and/or sales experience a plus
Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
Outstanding interpersonal and multitasking skills
Demonstrate integrity, dependability, responsibility, accountability, self-awareness, work ethic, and compassion
Passion for entrepreneurial communities
Passion and understanding of WeWork’s mission and values
Proficient in basic computer skills


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

Conduct outbound customer calls personally to encourage repeat transactions, reconnect with inactive customers, and demonstrate effective retention techniques by example.
Develop, implement, and continuously improve standard operating procedures (SOPs), calling workflows, scripts, and training materials to strengthen team performance.
Organise daily outreach activities, manage agent schedules, and allocate campaign assignments to ensure efficient customer engagement.
Design and execute customer retention campaigns, including promotional offers, discount incentives, abandoned transaction follow-ups, and reactivation initiatives.

Conduct regular call evaluations, performance reviews, and individual coaching sessions to identify improvement opportunities and strengthen agents' communication and sales skills.
Analyse customer behaviour, transaction activity, and campaign performance to identify retention opportunities and develop targeted engagement strategies.

Manage escalated customer concerns and collaborate with Marketing, Customer Support, Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to ensure effective issue resolution.
Support recruitment, onboarding, and training initiatives to build and maintain a capable, results-oriented retention team.
Use relevant digital and AI-powered tools to improve research, script development, workflow efficiency, and overall team productivity.
At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in customer retention, outbound sales, contact centre operations, or a similar customer-facing environment.
Demonstrated success in customer conversion, retention, and reactivation, with experience managing performance-driven teams and achieving measurable commercial results.
Proven ability to develop and implement SOPs, outbound calling scripts, operational workflows, and employee training materials.
Strong leadership, coaching, and mentoring skills, with the ability to motivate teams, manage performance, and encourage continuous improvement.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and objection-handling abilities, particularly when engaging customers over the phone.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
Ability to balance direct customer engagement with team supervision and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, alongside practical experience using CRM systems and outbound calling platforms.
Comfortable using AI-powered tools to support research, improve customer communication scripts, and enhance everyday productivity.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high service and performance standards.
Previous experience in fintech, financial services, cryptocurrency, or another regulated industry is a significant advantage.
Basic understanding of cryptocurrency and blockchain technologies, combined with a genuine interest in financial technology, is considered a plus.
Competitive USD Salary: Attractive compensation paid consistently every month, regardless of your location.
Performance-Based Incentives: Additional financial rewards directly linked to individual achievements and overall team performance.
Paid Annual Leave: 10 days of paid vacation per year.
Public Holidays: Paid time off on all U.S. federal holidays.
100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere in Anywhere, provided you have a professional home-working setup.
Leadership and Career Development: Opportunity to lead, develop, and shape a customer retention team while strengthening your management expertise.
High-Growth Industry Exposure: Work within the rapidly evolving global fintech and cryptocurrency sector.
Direct Business Impact: Take ownership of retention initiatives that directly contribute to customer engagement, recovered revenue, and business growth.
Collaborative Culture: Join a supportive, high-trust working environment that values initiative, accountability, and professional development.
AI-Enabled Work Environment: Opportunities to leverage modern AI tools to improve workflows, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
skills: Desarrollo de Reportes con Enfoque Visual: Diseñar, construir y actualizar dashboards en Tableau, Power BI o Looker Studio, aplicando nociones básicas de Data Storytelling para estructurar la información de forma lógica, clara y limpia.

Integración y Extracción de Datos: Apoyar en la conexión, limpieza y validación de fuentes de datos de marketing digital (GA4, Meta, TikTok, Appsflyer, Google Ads, Programmatic, etc.) utilizando consultas de datos básicas para garantizar reportes precisos y consistentes.
Aseguramiento de Calidad (QA de Datos): Realizar revisiones periódicas de los dashboards para asegurar la precisión de las métricas registradas y resolver discrepancias de datos.
Mapeo de KPIs: Apoyar en la estructuración de marcos de medición y modelos de datos, conectando las métricas de rendimiento de campañas con los objetivos de negocio de los clientes.
Soporte en Análisis Operativo: Ayudar en la extracción y preparación de datos para estudios de impacto (Conversion Lift o Test & Learn) e informes periódicos de efectividad de campaña.
Documentación Técnica: Mantener actualizada la documentación de los modelos de reporteo, diccionarios de métricas (metadatos), esquemas de datos y fuentes integradas para cada cuenta.
Seguimiento y Comunicación: Comunicar proactivamente al Manager cualquier inconsistencia en los datos, retrasos operativos o bloqueos técnicos en las conexiones de APIs o plataformas.
Experiencia y precisión en la transformación y validación de datos numéricos para evitar errores en reportes.
Capacidad para priorizar entregas diarias y cumplir con los tiempos de respuesta acordados.
Interés por entender los mecanismos del marketing digital y cómo los datos se convierten en insights.
Manejo funcional o práctico de herramientas de visualización de datos (Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio / Data Studio).
Nociones básicas/intermedias de SQL para la extracción, filtrado y transformación de tablas de datos.
Conocimiento básico o interés en Python (deseable para manipulación de datos con librerías como pandas, automatización o consumo de APIs).
Familiaridad con métricas y estructuras de datos provenientes de plataformas de activación digital (Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Search/Display, Programmatic, GA4, Appsflyer, etc.).
Entendimiento general de los canales de medios pagados (Search, Social, Display, Video, Programmatic) y las palancas que un digital marketer opera para influir en los resultados.
Experiencia en preparación de datos, fórmulas analíticas (Excel/Google Sheets avanzado, lenguaje DAX, campos calculados entre otros) y lógica básica de esquemas de datos (schemas).

Comprensión básica de principios de comunicación visual de datos (jerarquía de información, elección adecuada de gráficos para métricas sencillas, uso correcto del color y maquetación limpia) para presentar la información de manera entendible para el usuario.

title: Customer Success Manager
skills: Customer Onboarding: Manage the onboarding journey for new customers, including sending welcome communications, organizing kickoff calls, identifying customer objectives, mapping organizational structures, and introducing relevant stakeholders to available programs and resources.

Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key contacts across each account, from operational teams to executive decision-makers. Proactively develop stakeholder networks and secure introductions to additional contacts to strengthen account engagement.

Customer Engagement: Maintain consistent communication throughout the year through personalized emails, strategic conversations, and regular account check-ins. Conduct approximately 3–6 meaningful calls per account annually, depending on the customer lifecycle stage.

Success Planning: Develop and present AI-assisted Mutual Success Plans, ensuring alignment between customer objectives and available solutions. Review and update these plans approximately every 90 days to monitor progress and maintain engagement.
Executive Relationship Development: Establish regular communication with economic buyers and senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment on customer priorities, business objectives, and delivered value.

Account Health and Retention: Monitor customer satisfaction, engagement, and account health to identify potential risks early. Develop and implement proactive intervention strategies to address challenges and protect customer relationships.
Renewal Management: Own the end-to-end renewal process, from preparing and presenting renewal business cases to leading commercial discussions, negotiating pricing, and securing contract renewals.
AI and Process Optimization: Use AI-powered tools, prompts, agents, and automations to improve account research, customer communication, success planning, business reviews, and renewal preparation.
At least 3 years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, with direct ownership of renewals across a defined portfolio of accounts.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple customer relationships simultaneously and driving retention through structured engagement strategies.

Confidence engaging senior revenue leaders, including VPs of Sales, Chief Revenue Officers, and Sales Enablement leaders, with the ability to communicate business insights and provide informed recommendations.
Strong executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to build rapport, and a clear, direct, and concise communication style.
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, recurring 90-day engagement cycles, quarterly success plan updates, and renewal timelines.
A self-sufficient and proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced remote environment.
Practical AI proficiency, including experience building and using prompts, AI agents, skills, and automations to improve workflows and productivity.
Experience using HubSpot as a CRM and system of record is required.
Familiarity with Google Workspace and customer success or conversation intelligence platforms such as Sybill, Gong, or Chorus is an advantage.
Willingness to work with AI tools such as Claude and internal customer intelligence platforms, with training provided where necessary.
Native-level written and spoken English proficiency.
Availability to work a full US business day aligned with Central Time.

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Customer Success Manager to manage a portfolio of 30–45 accounts within the B2B SaaS industry. In this fully remote role, you will take ownership of the entire customer journey, from onboarding and relationship development to retention and contract renewals. You will work closely with key stakeholders, including VPs of Sales, Chief Revenue Officers, and other senior decision-makers, to ensure customers achieve measurable value. Your primary focus will be building strong relationships, maintaining account health, and securing long-term customer retention. You will leverage AI-powered tools and automation to streamline workflows, develop tailored success plans, and improve customer engagement. This is an opportunity to join a fast-paced, collaborative, and growth-oriented environment where initiative, adaptability, and execution are highly valued.

Accountabilities


Customer Onboarding: Manage the onboarding journey for new customers, including sending welcome communications, organizing kickoff calls, identifying customer objectives, mapping organizational structures, and introducing relevant stakeholders to available programs and resources.
Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key contacts across each account, from operational teams to executive decision-makers. Proactively develop stakeholder networks and secure introductions to additional contacts to strengthen account engagement.
Customer Engagement: Maintain consistent communication throughout the year through personalized emails, strategic conversations, and regular account check-ins. Conduct approximately 3–6 meaningful calls per account annually, depending on the customer lifecycle stage.
Success Planning: Develop and present AI-assisted Mutual Success Plans, ensuring alignment between customer objectives and available solutions. Review and update these plans approximately every 90 days to monitor progress and maintain engagement.
Executive Relationship Development: Establish regular communication with economic buyers and senior stakeholders, ensuring alignment on customer priorities, business objectives, and delivered value.
Account Health and Retention: Monitor customer satisfaction, engagement, and account health to identify potential risks early. Develop and implement proactive intervention strategies to address challenges and protect customer relationships.
Renewal Management: Own the end-to-end renewal process, from preparing and presenting renewal business cases to leading commercial discussions, negotiating pricing, and securing contract renewals.
AI and Process Optimization: Use AI-powered tools, prompts, agents, and automations to improve account research, customer communication, success planning, business reviews, and renewal preparation.


Requirements


At least 3 years of experience in B2B SaaS Customer Success, with direct ownership of renewals across a defined portfolio of accounts.
Demonstrated experience managing multiple customer relationships simultaneously and driving retention through structured engagement strategies.
Confidence engaging senior revenue leaders, including VPs of Sales, Chief Revenue Officers, and Sales Enablement leaders, with the ability to communicate business insights and provide informed recommendations.
Strong executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to build rapport, and a clear, direct, and concise communication style.
Exceptional organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts, recurring 90-day engagement cycles, quarterly success plan updates, and renewal timelines.
A self-sufficient and proactive mindset, with the ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced remote environment.
Practical AI proficiency, including experience building and using prompts, AI agents, skills, and automations to improve workflows and productivity.
Experience using HubSpot as a CRM and system of record is required.
Familiarity with Google Workspace and customer success or conversation intelligence platforms such as Sybill, Gong, or Chorus is an advantage.
Willingness to work with AI tools such as Claude and internal customer intelligence platforms, with training provided where necessary.
Native-level written and spoken English proficiency.
Availability to work a full US business day aligned with Central Time.

The Client Insights & Delivery (CID) Analyst is a foundational role within the Global Nielsen Campaign Analytics team, focused on delivering actionable recommendations that drive client success and market impact.

As a member of this fast-paced, client-facing team, your primary responsibility is to work directly with media companies and advertisers to understand campaign objectives, advise on study setup, and provide performance analysis. 2-3 years experience in analytics and/or media or marketing planning.
Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills; ability to grasp new concepts easily and present them simply. Advanced level of English (written and verbal) is required.
