description:
Waves Acoustics · Vacante WAC-RH-MKT-2026-01

Dirección fraccional de Marketing y Demand Generation B2B, con IA aplicada

Remoto desde México · Cierre: 26 de noviembre de 2026, 23:59 h (CDMX)




Construye demanda. Demuestra resultados. Usa IA con criterio.




SOBRE WAVES ACOUSTICS

Waves Acoustics es una firma mexicana de ingeniería acústica. Diseñamos y desarrollamos soluciones para espacios y proyectos —aislamiento, acondicionamiento, mediciones, simulación, diagnóstico técnico e implementación— para arquitectos, desarrolladores, hoteles, restaurantes, oficinas corporativas, industria y vivienda.




LA MISIÓN

Construir el sistema de generación de demanda B2B de Waves: conectar audiencia, campañas, contenido, web, Sales y medición para producir oportunidades comerciales, cobros y aprendizaje sobre qué funciona.

Buscamos a una persona responsable de la estrategia y de su ejecución coordinada. No buscamos una agencia completa, un community manager ni a alguien que haga solo todas las tareas del área.




RESPONSABILIDADES

• Definir audiencias, ofertas y mensajes para los segmentos B2B de Waves, y priorizarlos con evidencia.

• Diseñar y ejecutar campañas orgánicas y, con presupuesto acordado, pagadas, que lleven a oportunidades comerciales.

• Conectar web, landings y formularios con el CRM y con Sales: criterios de lead, lead aceptado por Sales (SAL), handoff y seguimiento.

• Impulsar SEO y contenido orientados a demanda, no a volumen de publicaciones.

• Medir y atribuir con honestidad: tablero, cortes periódicos, aprendizajes y decisiones.

• Aplicar IA con criterio en investigación, segmentación, contenido, análisis y automatización, siempre con verificación humana.

• Coordinarte con Diego Garcés (Dirección General) y con Sales, y reportar avances y resultados.

• Coordinar apoyos puntuales, internos o proveedores, cuando el acuerdo lo contemple.




REQUISITOS ESENCIALES

• Experiencia demostrable en generación de demanda B2B: al menos un caso que puedas explicar de campaña a oportunidad y a resultado. Puede estar anonimizado.

• Experiencia práctica en conversión (ofertas, landings, formularios), SEO, CRM y medición.

• Trabajo coordinado con equipos comerciales: criterios de lead, handoff y seguimiento.

• Conocimiento práctico de IA aplicada a Marketing (ver abajo).

• Capacidad para explicar con claridad, por escrito y en conversación, qué hiciste, por qué y qué resultado obtuviste.

• Trabajar desde México, con disponibilidad compatible con una colaboración fraccional por entregables.




IA APLICADA: REQUISITO EXPLÍCITO

Queremos ver usos concretos de IA en investigación, segmentación, contenido, análisis o automatización. En tu solicitud cuéntanos:

• qué problema resolviste;

• qué herramienta o flujo usaste;

• cómo verificaste la salida (revisión humana, fuentes, pruebas);

• qué resultado obtuviste.

Saber escribir prompts o mencionar una herramienta no es suficiente. Tampoco buscamos una marca específica de herramienta.




DESEABLE

• Experiencia en servicios técnicos, ingeniería, arquitectura, construcción o venta consultiva con ciclos largos.

• Experiencia como consultor/a o dirección fraccional con varios clientes.

• Pauta B2B con control de presupuesto y medición por oportunidad, no solo por clic.

• Automatización de marketing y conexión entre herramientas.




NO PEDIMOS

Títulos de una universidad específica, un número arbitrario de años, experiencia previa en acústica, vivir en Monterrey, fotografía ni datos personales que no ayuden a evaluar tu experiencia.




MODALIDAD Y DEDICACIÓN

• Dirección fraccional por servicios y entregables, sujeta a formalización acorde con la operación real.

• Remota desde México, con opción híbrida mediante reuniones previamente acordadas. No necesitas vivir en Monterrey.

• Tú propones tu disponibilidad; acordamos entregables y capacidad. No es jornada completa ni pide exclusividad.

• Colaboración directa con Diego Garcés y coordinación con Sales.




COMPENSACIÓN (LÉELA COMPLETA ANTES DE POSTULARTE)

La etapa inicial no tiene base garantizada.




Qué es UBC: cobro neto sin IVA menos los costos directos correspondientes, asignados y validados. El variable se calcula sobre UBC positiva elegible, atribuible a Marketing y liberada por Finance. Facturar no equivale a cobrar, e influir en una venta no basta para originar comisión.




Etapa 1 · Validación (inicio de la colaboración)

• Base: $0

• Variable: 5% de UBC elegible

• Bono: $100 por lead aceptado por Sales (SAL)

• Bono: $250 por reunión elegible celebrada

• Tope conjunto de ambos bonos: $1,500 MXN al mes

• Si en un mes no hay hitos elegibles ni UBC liquidable, el pago de ese mes puede ser $0.




Etapas posteriores propuestas (no son ascensos automáticos; requieren resultados sostenidos y acuerdo escrito)

• Etapa 2 · Consistencia: $6,000 mensuales + 4% de UBC elegible, sin los bonos de la etapa 1. Referencia de acceso: promedio mensual, en tres meses consecutivos, de $150,000 de UBC atribuible y 12 SAL.

• Etapa 3 · Escala: $10,000 mensuales + 4% de UBC elegible + 0.5% únicamente sobre el excedente mensual de $500,000, sin los bonos de la etapa 1. Referencia de acceso: promedio mensual, en tres meses consecutivos, de $300,000 de UBC atribuible y 18 SAL.




Ejemplos ilustrativos (no son ingresos garantizados)

• Etapa 1 con $130,000 de UBC elegible en el mes: 5% = $6,500; con los bonos en su tope, $8,000.

• Etapa 3 con $520,000 de UBC: $10,000 + $20,800 (4%) + $100 (0.5% de los $20,000 excedentes) = $30,900. No se aplica 4.5% al total.

• Con el bono máximo, las etapas 1 y 2 pagan lo mismo con $450,000 de UBC; por encima de esa cifra, la etapa 2 paga menos. Lo revisamos contigo en la conversación económica.




Las reglas de SAL, reuniones, deduplicación y atribución se formalizan por escrito antes de iniciar. Importes en pesos mexicanos (MXN), antes de impuestos aplicables al acuerdo. Waves cubre la publicidad con presupuesto acordado; la persona no la financia. No se ofrecen acciones, sociedad ni prestaciones.




QUÉ COMPARTIR EN TU SOLICITUD

• Un caso de generación de demanda B2B: audiencia, problema, qué hiciste, inversión si aplica, resultado y cómo lo mediste y atribuiste.

• Un ejemplo de IA aplicada: problema, herramienta o flujo, verificación humana y resultado.

• Tu enfoque para los primeros 90 días.

• Tu disponibilidad propuesta, ciudad y país.

• Opcional: enlaces a tu perfil o CV.

Puedes anonimizar tus casos. No envíes secretos comerciales ni información confidencial de clientes.




PROCESO DE SELECCIÓN

1. Solicitud en el formulario oficial, antes del cierre.

2. Revisión humana de cada solicitud: buscamos un ejemplo pertinente de demanda B2B, una aplicación concreta de IA y disponibilidad y modalidad compatibles. Si falta algo, podemos pedirte una aclaración; una respuesta incompleta no se descarta de forma automática.

3. Conversación inicial.

4. Revisión a fondo de un caso.

5. Conversación final.

6. Decisión: acordar la colaboración por escrito o continuar la búsqueda.

Algunas conversaciones pueden empezar antes del cierre. La recepción sigue abierta hasta la fecha publicada.

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

Partner with product, operations, and regional business teams to design and monitor pilot programs, defining success metrics and producing post-pilot evaluation reports that recommend scale/no-scale decisions.
Synthesize large internal datasets and external sources into clear, actionable insights using SQL, Excel, and visualization tools, enabling timely actions that improve trip completion, driver supply balance, or delivery efficiency.
Prepare concise briefings and presentation materials for senior management and cross-functional steering committees to support priority-setting, resource allocation, and strategic trade-offs.
Track progress on strategic initiatives through dashboards and periodic reviews, flagging risks, identifying root causes for deviations, and proposing corrective actions to meet KPI targets.

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Ser extraordinarios liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.

Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo, creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido, asistiendo a la oficina alrededor de tres días a la semana. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

Growth & Business Development Associate (Remote)

EcoPackables is a fast-growing U.S.-based sustainable packaging company working with some of the world’s leading brands.




We’re looking for a scrappy, entrepreneurial, AI-native growth generalist who’s obsessed with finding creative ways to generate new business.




We want someone who loves experimenting with new B2B marketing strategies, growth hacking, and finding unconventional ways to reach potential customers.




What You’ll Do:

• Develop creative strategies to generate interest and new business opportunities.

• Experiment with B2B outreach channels, including LinkedIn, cold email, cold calling, AI-powered prospecting, and automation.

• Identify potential customers, build relationships, and help turn opportunities into business.

• Research, test, and implement new growth hacks, tools, and customer acquisition strategies.

• Use AI and automation to make prospecting, outreach, and marketing more effective.

• Potentially travel to meet customers, attend trade shows, and develop business relationships (depending on the candidate).

• Work directly with the founder on growth initiatives and other business projects.

• Jump into whatever needs to get done. We’re a small team, and everyone wears multiple hats.




Who We’re Looking For:

• AI-native: You use AI tools daily and constantly experiment with new ways to work smarter.

• Growth-obsessed: You genuinely enjoy discovering new B2B marketing tactics, outreach strategies, and growth hacks.

• Scrappy and resourceful: You don’t wait for instructions. You figure things out and make things happen.

• Entrepreneurial: You think like an owner and take initiative.

• Excellent communicator: Strong written and spoken English, with confidence speaking to potential customers.

• Execution-focused: You’d rather test 10 ideas than spend weeks planning one.

• Comfortable with outreach: You’re willing to pick up the phone, send cold emails, and do whatever it takes to create opportunities.




Previous experience in B2B sales, marketing, or growth is a plus, but we care much more about your ability to execute, learn quickly, and deliver results.




Why Join Us?

You’ll work directly with the founder of a growing U.S. company, have the freedom to experiment with new ideas, and take ownership of meaningful growth initiatives.

There’s significant opportunity to grow with the company.




How to Apply:

Send your resume and a 1–2 minute video covering the following to hiring@ecopackables.com:

Why you’re interested in the role.

You'll manage the day-to-day execution of marketing activities across email, SMS, websites, YouTube, and social media. You'll also play a key role in integrating marketing systems as the company expands into new clinic locations.

You'll work closely with the Head of Growth and other marketing team members to ensure campaigns launch on time, systems stay connected, and marketing operations continue to improve.

If you're someone who spots a repetitive task and immediately thinks about how to automate it, we'd love to meet you!

Key Responsibilities


Marketing Systems & Integrations: Lead the marketing setup and integration process for new clinic locations, including CRM and email platforms, SMS systems, contact lists, booking links, tracking tools, business listings, and website updates. 
Email & SMS Marketing: Build, segment, test, and schedule approximately 6–12 campaigns per week using platforms such as ActiveCampaign, SimpleTexting, and CounselEar. Manage contact lists, tags, and automations while ensuring accuracy and compliance with opt-out preferences. 
YouTube Operations: Support video publishing and channel management, including uploading videos, optimizing titles and descriptions, adding chapters, coordinating with editors, and tracking channel performance. 
Social Media Management: Manage social media calendars across multiple brands, repurpose existing content into posts, reels, and stories, schedule publications, respond to comments, and monitor engagement.

Marketing Automation & AI: Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Zapier, and other automation platforms to streamline repetitive tasks, improve workflows, and increase efficiency. 
Creative & Direct Mail: Create marketing materials using Canva and coordinate direct-mail campaigns through platforms such as Click2Mail. 
Webinars & Virtual Events: Support the execution of online events, including promotional campaigns, registration processes, and speaker coordination. 
Reporting & Process Improvement: Monitor campaign performance, maintain organized workflows, document standard operating procedures (SOPs), and identify opportunities to improve marketing processes. 


What We're Looking For

Must-Haves


3+ years of hands-on marketing operations experience supporting U.S.-based companies, particularly across email, SMS, and website management. 
Proven experience building, launching, and managing email campaigns and automations using platforms such as ActiveCampaign, Klaviyo, HubSpot, or Mailchimp. 
Experience executing SMS marketing campaigns using tools such as SimpleTexting, Attentive, Postscript, or similar platforms. 
Experience setting up, migrating, or integrating marketing systems for a new business, location, or brand, including CRM, email platforms, tracking, and business listings. 
Hands-on experience managing branded social media accounts, including short-form content and scheduling platforms. 
Ability to update and manage WordPress websites, with basic knowledge of HTML and CSS. 
Experience using AI tools and automation platforms to simplify workflows, save time, and improve productivity. 
Excellent written English communication skills and strong attention to detail. 
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Requisitos y Experiencia

Conocimiento práctico de herramientas de diseño y edición de video y audio en smartphone o PC.

Deseable (Puntos Extra)

Conocimientos básicos en fotografía y grabación de video con smartphone.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




Salario: Mínimo

Horario: Flexible (Por proyecto)




Sobre el puesto




El trabajo es remoto y por objetivos, sin un horario fijo. Tu función principal será la edición de video y la grabación de tomas para proyectos con guiones previamente escritos. Las fechas de entrega se pactarán de mutuo acuerdo, lo que te dará total libertad para manejar tus tiempos o incluso combinar este proyecto con otros trabajos o estudios.




¿Qué harás? El objetivo central es posicionar contenido en redes sociales (Instagram, Facebook y TikTok). Trabajarás en dos líneas de contenido:

Videos con IA: Edición de material basado en guiones con personajes de Inteligencia Artificial.
Contenido realista en exteriores: Grabación de tomas fotográficas, videos de apoyo y breves entrevistas en diversas locaciones (restaurantes, museos, parques, plazas comerciales, etc.). Toda grabación se realizará siempre con el permiso previo de los encargados del lugar.

¿Para quién es ideal? La carga de trabajo es ligera y el sueldo sinceramente es modesto (proporcional al tiempo invertido). Por ello, esta oportunidad está pensada principalmente para:

Jóvenes que buscan ganar experiencia y dar sus primeros pasos en el mundo audiovisual.
Personas de cualquier edad que disfruten la creación de contenido y deseen tomarlo como un hobby o un ingreso extra sin presiones.

Description

The Amazon Marketplace Paid Services (AMPS) organization is seeking a Strategic Account Manager to drive business growth for some of the most influential Sellers on the Amazon Mexico Store.

Develop a clear understanding of the Selling on Amazon products and their functionalities, the e-commerce industry and competitive environment.

Analyze data and trends to identify, action and influence long term in order to maximize potential for your assigned portfolio of Sellers.

Lead business strategy development and design long term account plans, collaborating effectively with internal teams and your Sellers to find joint areas of opportunity to drive customer success with Amazon.

Build effective working relationships with your Sellers; be a trusted advisor and a business advocate.

Oversee key strategic activities that are underway for the Seller, follow up, escalate and clear blockers as appropriate across multiple organizations. Advocate as the voice of the customer internally, using data and anecdotes to drive prioritization and deliver value across a larger customer set

Track metrics to record the success of the Sellers in your portfolio. Use these metrics to guide your work and uncover hidden areas of opportunity.

Prepare and deliver business reviews regarding progress and state of health of your Sellers.

 Bachelor's degree
 Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
 3+ years of client or vendor facing roles with a focus in relationship management and negotiation skills experience

 Experience in problem solving and identifying problems using metrics and data

description:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:



Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:



Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a fast growing company from within. 
This role requires exceptional customer-facing communication skills, the ability to quickly understand a customer's business, and comfort explaining technology products to both executives and day-to-day users. In addition to this, you will champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a growth mindset, be inclusive and win as a team) as we scale globally and across new offices. 



This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico.

 

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
Manage the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment
Create launch plans and a roadmap to increase product usage
Track implementation progress, participation, product adoption, and account health
Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara’s technology, and work through challenges with customers and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases
Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to customers of all types
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

2+ years of experience in a senior Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
Bilingual (Spanish and English) is required
Strong spoken and written language skills for working with multiple teams and publishing documentation
This is a demanding position with high internal visibility, that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence 
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Candidate must be based in Monterrey, N.L., or willing to relocate

An ideal candidate also has:

Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Experience facilitating workshops with senior stakeholders and operational teams.
Strong executive presence and ability to influence cross-functional leaders.
Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: Executives, Day-to-day users of our software 
Experience serving a large and complex customer base in B2B SaaS 
Thrives in an unstructured, fast-paced, and change-heavy environment
Experience working with different countries of the LATAM regions preferred, but not required
Experience working in Tech Touch Engagements 
Experience using Customer Success Platforms
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a data-driven, highly organized Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist to join our Marketplace team and report to the Product Manager for Marketplace. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

The Marketplace is where shoppers discover stores, products, and deals inside the Sezzle app. Our team runs a lot of features, and there's almost always something being tested. You'll be the person who knows what's live, who it's live for, and how it's performing.

This is an operations role with a strong product and data lens. You'll launch and track A/B tests, keep an eye on our shopping partners, and turn results into clear recommendations on what we do next. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, design, and partnerships. If you like running a lot of experiments at once and keeping every one of them organized, this role is for you.

The salary range for this role is $2,000 - $2,666 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Experimentation


Set up, QA, and launch A/B tests across Marketplace features. Make sure targeting, variants, and tracking are right before anything goes live.
Monitor running tests, flag issues early, and call results once they reach significance.
Keep a single source of truth for every test: what's live, who sees it, and what we learned.


Partner & Marketplace Operations


Create and manage placements, promotions, coupons, and offers across the Sezzle app.
Set up and manage cashback programs in our internal admin tools.
Onboard new online stores into the marketplace and activate their store domains, so more stores are shoppable in the app.
Keep a clear map of which user and merchant segments see which features, placements, and offers.
Run regular QA audits, work through user-reported issues and broken links, and set up alerts so problems get caught before users notice.


Reporting & Process


Benchmark our shopping experience against competitors and bring new ideas for placements, deals, and offers that get more users shopping.
Document test plans, results, and processes, and find parts of the workflow that can be automated with AI.


Required

What We Look For


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
1 to 3+ years of experience in operations, experimentation, or product analytics.
Highly organized. You can run many tests and workstreams at once without anything slipping.
Clear written and verbal communication in English, with teammates across the business and external partners.
Strong analytical skills. Comfortable with SQL and dashboards, and able to read A/B test results (lift, significance, sample size).
Comfortable in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift.
Detail-oriented with a QA mindset. You catch the targeting mistake before it launches. 
Daily user of Claude or a similar AI tool. You use it to analyze data, write queries, draft docs, and automate repetitive work, and you can walk us through real examples.


Nice to Have


Experience with A/B testing or feature flag tools, such as Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or Firebase.
Experience with affiliate, cashback, or advertising partnerships.
Experience with Jira and Confluence.
Experience with mobile apps and product analytics tools, such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Somos Reckitt

Hogar de las marcas más queridas y confiables de higiene, salud y nutrición.

Únete a nuestra lucha para lograr que el acceso a higene de calidad, bienestar y nutrición sea un derecho y no un privilegio.

Marketing

Nuestro propósito y espíritu de lucha son lo que nos motiva a diseñar y ofrecer comunicaciones diferenciadas a lo largo de todo el recorrido del consumidor, generando crecimiento de categoría y, al mismo tiempo, un impacto positivo en la sociedad.

Con amplios equipos de medios y digitales integrados en toda la organización, medimos tanto nuestro desempeño empresarial como nuestro impacto social. Nuestros equipos globales lideran la estrategia general de marca, la gestión y protección de las marcas, así como el pipeline de innovación, en estrecha colaboración con I+D. Esto permite que nuestros equipos locales de marketing se enfoquen en alcanzar los objetivos regionales en alianza con los equipos de Ventas.

Con una comunidad de marketing de más de 2,500 profesionales, junto con nuestra innovadora Marketing Academy, tendrás amplias oportunidades para desarrollarte, adquirir nuevas habilidades y acelerar tu crecimiento profesional.

Acerca del Rol

En Reckitt, nos apasiona marcar una diferencia en la vida de las personas a través de nuestros reconocidos productos de salud e higiene. Estamos buscando un(a) Analista Junior Global de Insights & Analytics, cuya creatividad y capacidad analítica ayudarán a dar forma al futuro de nuestras marcas.

description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a Product Operations Intern at DiDi, you will support the supply channel mid-platform team in driving high-quality execution of mobility and platform product initiatives across multiple markets; your work will enable faster feature rollouts, improved product reliability, and measurable improvements in user and driver satisfaction metrics. You will join a cross-functional operations team whose mission is to translate product strategy into scalable operational processes, ensuring platform stability and data-driven optimization across fleet, franchise and ride-hailing.

In this role, you'll be...


 Cross-Region Operations Communication & Support
Maintain daily communication with regional operations teams across multiple markets; collect and organize frontline business feedback and requests
Assist in syncing product feature updates and operational strategy changes to regional teams
Follow up on regionally reported issues and coordinate internal resources to drive resolution
 Operations Execution & Support
Help maintain CP/MSP communication channels; collect and organize partner feedback and requests
Assist in monitoring core operational metrics (e.g., driver retention, completion rate); flag anomalies
Assist in drafting SOPs, training materials, and FAQs
 Product Requirement Coordination
Participate in requirement discussions and review meetings; help organize BRDs and meeting minutes
Track post-launch feature adoption and collect user feedback



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Data Science, Economics, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory; current students or recent graduates are encouraged to apply.
Strong analytical ability with experience using Excel, SQL, or similar tools to manipulate data and produce actionable insights in a fast-paced environment.
Basic familiarity with product development lifecycle, A/B testing concepts, and incident management practices relevant to large-scale consumer platforms.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, able to produce concise reports and present findings to cross-functional stakeholders.
Detail-oriented and process-minded, with demonstrated ability to create clear documentation, checklists, and operational runbooks.
Proactive problem-solver with a service mindset, able to prioritize tasks, follow through on deliverables, and escalate appropriately in high-impact situations.
Comfortable working in a multicultural, fast-moving company and adaptable to changing priorities across different mobility products and regional markets.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

title: Gestión de la Comunicación Interna LATAM
description:
Sobre NTT DATA




Haz de este el lugar donde crezcas.

Como líder global en innovación empresarial y tecnológica, trabajamos con las mejores organizaciones a nivel mundial para entregar soluciones que generan un impacto significativo. 

Con más de 190,000 profesionales en más de 70 países, combinamos un profundo conocimiento con una cultura que valora el aprendizaje, la curiosidad y la colaboración. 

Lideramos la transformación y entregamos soluciones seguras, innovadoras y específicas de la industria que impulsan el crecimiento de los negocios. Nuestra gente impulsa todos nuestros logros, piensan en grande para entregar resultados mientras se asegura que cada voz sea escuchada. 




¿Qué buscamos?

• Experiencia sólida en comunicación interna, comunicación corporativa o funciones afines, idealmente con alcance regional o multinacional.

• Experiencia desarrollando y ejecutando estrategias y campañas de comunicación interna alineadas con objetivos de negocio y de la organización.

• Experiencia coordinando iniciativas de engagement y comunicación regional desde su conceptualización hasta la ejecución y medición de resultados.

• Conocimiento en gestión de procesos, flujos y modelos de gobernanza de comunicación interna.

• Experiencia administrando y optimizando canales de comunicación interna y plataformas digitales corporativas.

• Excelentes habilidades de redacción, edición y revisión de contenidos institucionales, guiones, mensajes ejecutivos y otros materiales de comunicación.

• Experiencia en planificación y coordinación de eventos internos regionales y corporativos, como All-Hands y encuentros ejecutivos.

• Capacidad para relacionarse y coordinarse con equipos de diferentes países, manteniendo consistencia de mensajes y adaptación a contextos locales.

• Alta capacidad de organización, gestión de múltiples iniciativas, orientación a resultados y excelentes habilidades de comunicación e influencia.




¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?

• Desarrollar y ejecutar planes estratégicos de comunicación interna alineados con los objetivos de comunicación de IBIOL y de la compañía.

• Gestionar, coordinar y monitorear campañas regionales de comunicación interna, asegurando consistencia de mensajes, cumplimiento de plazos y medición de resultados.

• Liderar la producción y gestión de iniciativas regionales de engagement y comunicación, desde la conceptualización hasta su ejecución.

• Gestionar los procesos, flujos y gobernanza de la comunicación interna, impulsando eficiencia y buenas prácticas en la región.

• Administrar y optimizar los canales de comunicación interna, promoviendo su uso estratégico y efectivo.

• Producir, revisar y aprobar contenidos editoriales, incluyendo textos institucionales, guiones de video y mensajes ejecutivos, garantizando calidad, claridad y alineación de tono.

• Desarrollar y gestionar la comunicación de eventos internos regionales y corporativos, incluyendo la planificación, producción de contenidos y coordinación de canales.

• Mantener una relación cercana y continua con los equipos de comunicación interna de los diferentes países de LATAM, facilitando la coordinación regional.

• Actuar como punto focal regional en comités de gestión de People y Comunicación Interna junto con NTT DATA Inc.




Este rol describe tu punto de partida en NTT DATA. Creemos en las relaciones a largo plazo y en apoyar tu desarrollo. A medida que tus habilidades y ambiciones evolucionen, trabajaremos contigo para identificar futuras oportunidades, proyectos y carreras profesionales dentro de nuestra organización. 




🌟 ¿Por qué NTT DATA?

🤝 Una cultura de colaboración y apoyo

Fomentamos un entorno donde la curiosidad, la innovación, el compromiso y el trabajo en equipo son celebrados. Nuestra filosofía de “People first” es una de las razones principales por las que continuamos siendo reconocidos globalmente. 

🚀 Desarrollo profesional y aprendizaje continuo

Accede a un camino de formación estructurado, recursos de aprendizaje continuos, revisiones de desempeño anuales y un programa de mentoría dedicado — todo diseñado para ayudarte a desarrollarte profesionalmente y asumir nuevos desafíos. 

💻 Equilibrio entre vida laboral y personal apoyado por nuestra política BeFlex 

Como empresa, adoptamos un enfoque BeFlex que empodera a nuestra gente con flexibilidad para gestionar su jornada laboral.

✨ Top Empleador Global 

Estamos orgullosamente certificados como Top Empleador Global, que refleja nuestro compromiso de ser un lugar donde las personas puedan desarrollarse y prosperar. 

🌿 Salud y bienestar primero

Tu bienestar mental importa. Los empleados tienen acceso a psicólogos certificados y talleres de salud mental en línea. 

🌈 Diversidad, Equidad e Inclusión

Estamos comprometidos a crear un lugar de trabajo donde todos puedan prosperar, sin importar género, nacionalidad, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o contexto. La inclusión es parte de quiénes somos y cómo trabajamos. 

#WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique 

Al recibir una entrevista, puedes solicitar adaptaciones para cualquier necesidad de accesibilidad. 

¿Suena interesante? Aplica ahora o comparte con un amigo 🔹




Nuestros Beneficios

Sueldo competitivo, acorde a tu experiencia y conocimientos, en un esquema 100% nómina.

Prestaciones de ley.

Seguro de Gastos Médicos Mayores y Menores.

Seguro Dental y de Vida.

Vales de despensa y Home Office.

Fondo de ahorro.

Plan de carrera con formación continua:

Cursos de inglés.

Formación en gestión y habilidades profesionales.

Formación técnica y certificaciones.




¿Quieres saber más? 

Si te interesa saber más acerca de nuestra oferta ponte en contacto con nosotros a través de mexico.reclutamiento@nttdata.com.

Puedes encontrar más información sobre NTT DATA en https://www.nttdata-bewired.com/




En NTT DATA, todos nuestros procesos de selección y empleo se rigen por principios de equidad e inclusión. Está estrictamente prohibido solicitar certificados médicos de no embarazo, pruebas de Virus de Inmunodeficiencia Humana (VIH) u otros análisis médicos como requisito de ingreso.

Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades en todas nuestras posiciones, incluyendo aspectos como compensación, beneficios, prestaciones, vacaciones, capacitación, educación y programas sociales y recreativos. Seleccionamos y desarrollamos talento únicamente con base en méritos y capacidades, sin distinción de raza, color, género, nacionalidad, religión, edad, orientación sexual, información genética, discapacidad física o mental, embarazo, estado civil o cualquier otra condición protegida por la legislación local.

description:
Who We Are

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Disclaimer: We're currently on the lookout for potential candidates to join our talent pool via this job listing. Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A Day In The Life

A Creative Strategist will be the lead ideator on strategic accounts. They are required to have a robust understanding of paid social creative best practices, their client’s brand, performance goals, historical data, current ecommerce trends, and consumer behavior, to develop winning paid social advertising that impacts their client's growth.

Creative Strategists know how to act fast to capitalize on good results, or on the flip side know what to change if an ad isn’t performing to their goal. This means testing with the intention of moving the needle on key performance metrics — from improving CPA, CTR, or ROAS to driving brand awareness. Creative Strategists pitch new ideas and concepts to clients, write scripts, and follow the execution and review of ads through to production and delivery to clients.

An ideal candidate for the Creative Strategist role is a self-starter who is passionate about maximizing success for their clients through creative strategy, and is eager to take the lead on developing creative concepts that are intentionally produced to generate clear testing results and insights. They have mastered presenting creative reporting to clients and team members through storytelling, and are constantly implementing learnings to enhance future campaign results. Sr. Creative Strategists are zealous about continuously testing various creative concepts to develop a strong understanding of how to not only effectively and efficiently meet client goals, but to surpass them. If creative deliveries are not meeting client expectations, or creative tests are not hitting target goals, Sr. Creative Strategists will be relentless in the pursuit to troubleshoot and problem solve with a growth mindset.

About EyeCarePro

EyeCarePro is a leading digital marketing agency specializing in helping independent optometry and ophthalmology practices across North America grow their businesses.

Through innovative digital marketing strategies, advanced technology, and data-driven solutions, we help eye care professionals attract new patients, increase appointment bookings, improve online visibility, and achieve sustainable business growth.

We're expanding our international team and looking for an experienced, bilingual Marketing Strategist based in Mexico who brings strong digital marketing expertise, commercial awareness, and a passion for helping businesses grow.

Experience in optometry, optical retail, ophthalmology, or healthcare marketing would be particularly valuable.

About The Role

As a Marketing Strategist, you will develop, guide, and continuously optimize digital marketing strategies for a portfolio of independent eye care practices.

This is a strategic position rather than a purely operational marketing role. You'll analyze marketing performance, identify growth opportunities, develop actionable recommendations, and collaborate with specialist teams to deliver measurable business results.

You'll work closely with Client Strategists, SEO Specialists, Paid Media Specialists, Content Writers, Designers, Developers, and Project Managers.

The ideal candidate is an experienced marketing professional who understands how digital marketing drives business growth and can confidently communicate recommendations in both Spanish and English.

Key Responsibilities


 Digital Marketing Strategy & Planning
Develop and maintain comprehensive digital marketing strategies aligned with client business objectives.
Create annual, quarterly, and monthly marketing plans with measurable goals.
Identify growth opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, and performance data.
Recommend improvements to existing marketing initiatives.
Develop strategic marketing roadmaps that support both immediate results and long-term business growth.
Provide clear strategic direction to internal marketing and production teams.
 SEO, Local Search & Online Visibility
Develop and guide SEO and local search strategies to increase qualified organic traffic.
Identify opportunities across technical SEO, on-page optimization, content marketing, and website structure.

description:
¿Qué hace que DHL sea una gran Compañía?

¡Nuestra gente y nuestra cultura, basadas en el respeto y los resultados!

DHL Compañía #1 en servicio de logística global está presente en más de 220 países, lo que la convierte en la empresa más internacional. Con una fuerza laboral superior a 480,000 empleados, brindamos soluciones para un número casi infinito de necesidades logísticas. DHL es parte del grupo postal alemán y líder mundial en logística, DHL Group abarca tres divisiones: DHL Express, DHL Global Forwarding y DHL Supply Chain.

Somos reconocidos como Global Top Employer en 6 regiones y 35 países, incluido México.

Nuestra división, DHL Global Forwarding está enfocada en proveer servicios logísticos de Importación y Exportación (Aérea, Marítima y Terrestre), incluyendo el servicio de Aduana. Nuestro expertise abarca desde operaciones estandarizadas y soluciones multimodales de expedición, hasta proyectos industriales individualizados.

Tenemos una gran oportunidad para ti como Becario en Inteligencia Comercial y Desarrollo de Negocios, ubicado en Ciudad de México.

¿Cuál será tu objetivo principal en esta posición?

Apoyar al equipo comercial de México en la identificación y priorización de nuevos prospectos mediante investigación de mercado, análisis de información y generación de leads con potencial de negocio.

¿Qué harás en esta posición?



Investigar mercados, industrias y empresas para identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.
Analizar información comercial y realizar exploración de datos para generar prospectos de valor.
Mantener actualizadas bases de datos, reportes y herramientas de seguimiento comercial.
Colaborar con equipos de ventas en proyectos de generación de leads y expansión de mercado.
Generar reportes, dashboards y análisis que apoyen la toma de decisiones del área comercial.
Participar en actividades de inteligencia comercial y desarrollo de estrategias de prospección.



¿Qué puedes aportar a la posición?



Inglés Avanzado.
Manejo de Excel avanzado.
Manejo de Microsoft Office.
Deseable conocimiento de Power BI u otras herramientas de visualización. 
Interés por aprender herramientas de inteligencia comercial, CRM y análisis de mercado.
Pensamiento lógico, crítico y orientado a identificar oportunidades.
Ser estudiante de 5° semestre en adelante de la licenciatura en administración, Finanzas, Negocios Internacionales, Ingeniería Industrial, Business Analytics o afín.



¿Por qué deberías unirte a nuestro equipo?

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en una empresa internacional con un entorno multicultural. Podrás explorar nuestras oportunidades de capacitación y desarrollo y convertirte en un experto en Logística.

DHL es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Evaluamos a los postulantes sin distinción de raza, religión, sexo, preferencia sexual, discapacidad, entre otras características.

Para esta posición, DHL Global Forwarding solo empleará a aquellos que estén legalmente autorizados para trabajar en México. Esta no es una posición para la cual se otorgará subsidio de reubicación o patrocinio de visa.

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

Work on the region’s pricing strategy;
Create frameworks to improve decision-making;

Collaborate with different areas like operations, marketing, product, and growth

Work Style: Adaptable and proactive, thriving in ambiguous environments; hands-on approach to experimenting and executing projects.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

The role of a Partner Marketing Manager at Canonical

Canonical is looking for a channel marketing manager who will be responsible for developing our strategic relationships with a set of global partners . Canonical partners with the leading companies in technology across public cloud (Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Oracle…), silicon (ARM, Intel, Qualcomm, Mediatek, Nvidia, Xilinx…), hardware vendors (Dell, HP, HPE, Lenovo). As our business increasingly depends on partners, the scope of our partnership grows every year (GSI, software vendors, IoT…). We are thus looking for an individual, who will not only drive successful marketing activities with our partners but also shape our partner programs.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

This role reports to the Head of Partner Marketing.

Location:This role will be based remotely in the Americas region.

Build joint go-to-market plans with partners, from messaging to pipeline generation

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. We are looking to hire a Customer Success Associate to join our team in Mexico! The CSA is responsible for supporting a large portfolio of nonprofit and corporate customers through structured engagement activities, product adoption support, and routine outreach across key lifecycle milestones. Working within established processes and with close guidance from senior team members, this role focuses on building foundational customer relationships, executing defined engagement activities, and developing core competencies in customer health monitoring and Bonterra's SaaS solutions. description:
About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The problem you are hired to solve

Hilbert's pipeline comes from Executive dinners, advisor firesides at the office, briefings at the customer's offices, side events at conferences. Events and warm introductions produce most of the deals that reach a second meeting.

Today those rooms happen when a founder or a regional sales leader makes them happen. There is no calendar, no owner, no follow-up standard and no count of which room produced which meeting. The Americas pipeline spans the United States, Mexico, Brazil and the Andean markets, and the sellers in each of them are building their own event plans from scratch.

That is this role: own the Americas event programme end to end, decide what goes on it, and measure it on the budget-holder meetings it produces.

What the role is

The Field Marketing Manager owns the strategy and the execution of every in-person and live-audience programme in the Americas. The job has two halves.

The first is the outside calendar: which conferences and industry events Hilbert joins, at what level, and what it does there. You recommend the list with the reasoning, and then you run each one, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.

The second is the programmes Hilbert hosts itself: executive dinners in the hub cities, advisor and investor firesides and podcast recordings at the office, customer roundtables and webinars. You design the format, the audience and the guest list, propose it, and then produce every part of it, including the promotion and the follow-up that turn attendance into meetings.

You plan both halves with the regional sales leaders, run them yourself, and report what each one produced. You are the first field marketer in the Americas. Your counterpart in EMEA runs the same programme there, and you build the shared playbook together.

What the role is not


Not content production. The founders and the product marketing lead decide what Hilbert says publicly and write the materials. You decide where it is said, to whom, and what happens the next morning.
Not paid acquisition. Hilbert runs no paid demand programmes today and this role does not start one.


The impact you will have


Decide the Americas calendar for the year with the regional sales leaders: which outside events to join, which events to host and in which office cities, which accounts in the room, and what each one has to produce. Recommend it with the reasoning and own it once agreed.
Run the executive dinner series in the hub cities, with guest lists drawn from target accounts and late-stage deals, and a follow-up plan agreed with the sellers before the invitations go out.
Own Hilbert's presence at the conferences you chose, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.
Design and produce the office programmes: advisor and investor firesides, live-audience podcast recordings, customer roundtables and webinars. You propose the format and the guest, and then you produce the whole thing, from the invitation to the recording to what is published afterwards.
Run pre-event targeting and post-event follow-up with sellers so that attendance becomes meetings within the week, not the quarter.
Manage vendors, venues, budgets and the partners who co-host with Hilbert.
Promote every programme through the channels Hilbert uses, LinkedIn and the newsletter among them, within the review process the company sets for public content.
Track every programme in the CRM: invited, attended, met, advanced. Report it monthly and change the calendar on what the numbers say.
Write the playbook, so that a dinner in Mexico City runs to the same standard as one in New York, and so that the next region can copy it.


How you are measured


Meetings with budget holders at target accounts that trace to a programme you ran.
Late-stage deals that advanced within thirty days of an event their buyer attended.
Cost per qualified meeting, by format.
Programmes delivered on the date and budget agreed.


What we look for


Four or more years in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company with an enterprise sales motion, with end-to-end ownership of programmes from guest list to follow-up.
Has built an event strategy, not only executed one. Can show a calendar they designed, what they chose to join, what they chose to host, what they turned down, and what each produced.
Has run executive dinners and small, senior rooms and can show which meetings and deals came out of them. Has also run a conference presence with speakers, side events and a meeting schedule.
Has designed and produced an owned format from nothing: a dinner series, a podcast, a fireside or a webinar programme that ran more than once because it worked.
Works as a partner to sellers: plans the room with them, holds them to the follow-up, and is trusted with the account list.
Operationally exact. Vendors, venues, budgets, registration, name badges and the follow-up list are all yours, and you keep every one of them on track.
Writes a clear invitation, a clear brief for a speaker and a clear report for a sales leader.
Fluent in English and Spanish. The Americas programme runs in both.
Comfortable at startup pace, with a programme to build, no agency behind you at first, and a founder's calendar to work around.
Able to travel around 30 percent across the United States and Latin America.


Nice to have: Portuguese; experience with HubSpot; a network among CMOs and growth leaders in retail, grocery, QSR or banking; experience at a company that sold to the same buyers Hilbert sells to; experience building a field programme from nothing.

Your first ninety days


Weeks 1 to 3. Meet every seller in the Americas and read the pipeline. Audit the events run so far and what they produced. Take over the next dinner already on the calendar.
Weeks 4 to 8. Recommend the Americas calendar through the next two quarters: the outside events to join, the programmes to host, and why. Run two programmes end to end, with follow-up tracked in the CRM.
Weeks 9 to 12. Report the first ninety days by format and cost per meeting. Agree the shared playbook with your EMEA counterpart. Tell us which formats to drop.


You will inherit a brand system, a target-account list, an advisor network that opens doors and a track record of dinners that worked. You will not inherit a calendar or a team. Both are deliberate.

At Hilbert, we move fast, work collaboratively, and give people real ownership over their impact. As a fast-growing company, there's no shortage of room to grow — you'll take on new challenges quickly and shape the path as you go.

Apply with your résumé. If your background aligns, you will receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours.
