title: AI Strategic Consultant
description:
AI Strategist Consultant

Role Overview

The AI Strategist Consultant works with clients after they sign, turning their business problems into AI solutions that get built and used. You sit between the client's team and ours. You learn how their business runs, find where AI can save time or money, scope the work, and build early prototypes yourself with tools like Claude, ChatGPT and Claude Code. A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) from our team builds most of the final solution, and you work with them from the first call to launch. You also pay close attention to what the client struggles with outside the current project. Those pain points often lead to the next engagement, so spotting them is a core part of the job. You report to the Head of Operations.




Key Responsibilities

Discovery and Pain Point Identification

Run working sessions with client teams to understand how their business operates today and where time, money or quality is lost.

Spot problems the client has not asked us to solve yet, and write them up clearly with the business case behind each one.

Bring those opportunities to the Head of Operations and the sales team so we can follow up with a proposal.

Rank AI opportunities by business value, effort and risk, and help the client choose what to do first.




AI Strategy and Scoping

Turn each opportunity into a clear scope with goals, success measures, data needs and a delivery plan.

Build AI roadmaps that show the client what to do now, next and later.

Explain what AI can and cannot do today, in plain business language, including where a person should stay in the loop.

Estimate the return on each solution (hours saved, cost reduced, revenue added) before and after we build it.




Prototyping and Delivery

Build quick prototypes and proofs of concept with Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools to test an idea before the team commits to building it.

Work side by side with the FDE on the engagement. You define the problem and the outcome, and the FDE builds the production solution.

Review what the team builds against the original goals, and catch gaps early.

Keep every engagement on schedule and flag risks to the Head of Operations before they become problems.




Adoption and Training

Teach client teams how to use what we deliver, through workshops, walkthroughs and short guides.

Track whether people actually use the solution after launch, and fix what gets in the way.

Collect client feedback and share what you learn with our delivery and engineering teams.




Client Communication

Serve as a trusted advisor for client leadership and day to day teams.

Present findings, roadmaps and results to executives in clear, direct language.

Travel to the US/MX for on-site workshops, kickoffs and client meetings when the engagement calls for it.




Requirements




Experience

2 to 3 years of consulting experience.

Experience running discovery sessions, workshops and interviews with client teams.

A track record of finding business problems and turning them into scoped, funded projects.

Proof that you use AI every day to solve real problems. During the interview process, you will show us a real workflow you built with AI.




Skills

Fluent English and Spanish, written and spoken.

Based in Latin America, and able to travel to the US.

Strong business sense. You understand how companies make and lose money, and you can tie an AI idea to a number.

Comfortable with Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools, and willing to earn certifications on both platforms.

Clear thinking and clear writing. You can explain a complicated idea to a busy executive in a few sentences.

Curious and fast to learn. You keep up with new AI tools and test them on real work.

Self-managed for remote work, able to run client relationships and meet deadlines without close supervision.




Tools

Daily use of Claude, ChatGPT and other AI assistants.

Familiarity with Claude Code, Cursor and automation tools like n8n and Make, enough to build prototypes.

Documentation and planning tools such as Google Workspace, Notion or Linear.

Project and collaboration tools including Plutio, Slack, Zoom and Google Meet.

Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

Role

The Creative Strategist is responsible for connecting marketing performance with creative execution. This person turns research, data, customer psychology, and business priorities into clear creative direction for paid social, landing pages, campaign concepts, and content tests.

This role is not limited to coming up with ideas. The Creative Strategist is responsible for building a structured creative process, identifying winning angles, writing strong creative briefs, analyzing what is working, and helping the team produce ads designed to perform.

This person works directly with the Head Of Marketing and marketing team, and collaborates with media buyers, designers, editors, copywriters, and creators to make sure creative output is aligned with growth objectives.

The role is expected to bring taste, structure, speed, and performance oriented thinking to a growing ecommerce group.




Creative Strategist Responsibilities




❖ Creative Strategy & Research

➢ Research customers, competitors, market trends, ad libraries, reviews, comments, and social platforms to identify strong creative opportunities.

➢ Translate customer motivations, objections, desires, and buying triggers into creative angles, hooks, messages, and offers.

➢ Build a clear understanding of each brand’s positioning and customer psychology.

➢ Stay close to what is working across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and other relevant platforms.




❖ Ad Concepts, Hooks & Creative Briefs

➢ Develop new ad concepts, hooks, scripts, storyboards, UGC directions, landing page ideas, and campaign angles.

➢ Write clear creative briefs that explain the objective, target customer, key message, structure, examples, and success criteria.

➢ Create both quick iterations and bigger creative tests that can help unlock new performance.

➢ Maintain an organized backlog of creative tests, angles, and hypotheses for each brand.




❖ Performance Analysis & Creative Testing

➢ Analyze creative performance with the marketing team to understand what drives clicks, conversions, CPA, ROAS, retention, and scale.

➢ Identify patterns in winning and losing creatives and turn those patterns into new tests.

➢ Help define creative testing roadmaps and prioritize the ideas most likely to improve performance.

➢ Create feedback loops between performance results and future creative production.




❖ Collaboration With Creative Production

➢ Work closely with designers, editors, copywriters, media buyers, creators, and other team members to turn ideas into finished assets.

➢ Give clear, practical, and constructive feedback on creative work.

➢ Make sure creative assets are aligned with the brief, the brand, the customer insight, and the performance goal.

➢ Build repeatable frameworks, references, and standards that help the team produce better creative over time.




❖ Brand, Customer & Market Understanding

➢ Protect each brand’s positioning while still pushing for strong direct response performance.

➢ Use customer language to improve ads, landing pages, hooks, and messages.

➢ Identify new angles based on customer objections, product benefits, competitive gaps, and market shifts.

➢ Help the company build a stronger creative foundation as the group grows.




What This Role Is Not

➢ This role is not a traditional Creative Director role focused only on visual taste or brand aesthetics.

➢ This role is not a graphic designer, video editor, or content creator role, although it works closely with those functions.

➢ This role is not responsible for managing ad spend or making final media buying decisions alone.

➢ This role is not a pure social media management or community management role.

➢ This role is not responsible for defining company strategy on its own.

➢ This role is not about producing random ideas without research, structure, testing, or performance accountability.




The Creative Strategist owns creative research, angles, briefs, testing direction, performance learning, and creative feedback loops. The Head Of Marketing and marketing leadership own final business priorities, budgets, and strategic decisions.




Compensation & Benefits

➢ Compensation package of up to 25k USD including bonus, depending on experience, scope of responsibility, and performance.

➢ Opportunity to play a key role inside a rapidly growing ecommerce group.

➢ Direct exposure to company strategy, performance marketing, creative production, and brand growth.

➢ High ownership over the creation of the group’s creative strategy function.

➢ Clear path toward becoming a key creative and growth leader within a multi brand ecommerce group.

➢ Additional performance bonuses for working ads: when a concept, hook, script, or creative brief becomes a strong performing ad and materially helps improve results, the role can receive extra upside tied to that impact.




Ideal Candidate

➢ Strong creative strategy profile with the ability to connect customer insight, storytelling, and performance data.

➢ Comfortable working directly with a founder led leadership team.

➢ Able to create clear, useful, and execution oriented creative briefs.

➢ Strong understanding of paid social creative, direct response marketing, customer psychology, hooks, angles, offers, and creative testing.

➢ Comfortable analyzing ad performance and translating data into practical creative improvements.

➢ Strong written communication and copywriting ability.

➢ Highly organized, reliable, and comfortable building systems from scratch in a fast moving company.

➢ Able to collaborate with designers, editors, media buyers, copywriters, creators, and marketing operators.

➢ Has strong taste, customer empathy, and performance oriented judgment.

➢ Ambitious and comfortable operating in a fast paced, high growth environment.

➢ Previous experience in ecommerce, DTC brands, performance marketing, paid social, creative strategy, UGC, advertising, copywriting, or growth teams is highly valued.

➢ Fluent written and spoken English, C1 level mandatory.

description:
About the job

Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Manager (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $1,160,000 - $1,510,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $1,160,000 - $1,317,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

description:
About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About The Role

Happyrobot is looking for a highly organized and execution-driven Field Marketing Specialist to join our rapidly growing LATAM Field Marketing team. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing our LATAM conference strategy and initiatives that connect directly with customers and prospects to drive pipeline.

This role will largely be focused on third-party industry trade shows and conferences in LatAm, mainly in Brazil and Mexico. As we build out a robust field marketing engine, you will collaborate with our events team and work closely with our Content and Creative team to ensure our booth experiences and event collateral are top-tier.

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and love the logistics of a great event, we want to hear from you!

What You’ll Do


Manage all trade show and conference deadlines, coordinate booth materials, and oversee shipping/freight logistics.
Organize, prep, and manage on-site schedules for the sales team and attending executives to maximize their time and impact.
Research, evaluate, and recommend the best industry conferences and trade shows across our target verticals.
Secure, handle, and optimize event sponsorships and executive presentation/speaking opportunities.
Ensure seamless lead capture at events and partner with revenue teams to track pipeline impact.


Must Have


Minimum of 2 years of dedicated field marketing and event management expertise.
Hands-on experience working with major trade show vendors and general contractors.
Strong experience using Salesforce for lead capture, list imports, and campaign tracking.
Basic ability to navigate Figma to collaborate efficiently with our creative and design teams on booth graphics and collateral.
Ability to hit the ground running immediately and handle high event volumes.


Nice-to-have


English, Spanish & Portuguese languages Proficiency. 


Why join us?


Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

In relation to the period of conservation of your personal data, these will be eliminated after three months of inactivity in compliance with the GDPR and legislation on the protection of personal data.

If you wish to exercise your rights of access, rectification, deletion, portability or opposition in relation to your personal data, you can do so through security@happyrobot.ai subject to the GDPR.

title: Spanish to English Interpreter
description:
About the job

We’re actively #hiring! Know someone who might be interested?

We are currently hiring Spanish to English Medical Interpreters for a fully remote, full-time Independent Contractor opportunity with i-Call International. The role involves facilitating clear, accurate communication between Spanish-speaking patients and healthcare providers, including doctors, nurses, and other medical professionals.

The selected interpreters will be responsible for accurately interpreting medical terminology, diagnoses, treatments, and healthcare-related information between Spanish and English. The role also involves providing cultural mediation when required, maintaining strict patient confidentiality and professional ethical standards, documenting interpretation services, and staying current with medical terminology and healthcare practices. Candidates will provide both Over-the-Phone Interpretation (OPI) and Video Remote Interpretation (VRI) services.

Candidates must be fluent in Spanish and English, with experience in medical interpretation or translation preferred. Strong knowledge of medical terminology, familiarity with healthcare-related conversations, excellent communication skills, cultural sensitivity, and the ability to work accurately under pressure are essential.

This is a remote position paying $5 per hour, with additional attendance and QA bonuses. Work will follow an hourly shift schedule aligned with the EST time zone, and payments will be made monthly through Payoneer.

Candidates must have a quiet, professional workspace, a minimum 15 Mbps download and upload internet connection, a compulsory USB headset, a PC or laptop with at least a 5th-generation processor and 8GB RAM, LAN/Ethernet connectivity, and an HD webcam.

After accepting the offer, selected candidates will complete a mandatory 80-hour training program over 10 business days. Training is paid at half of the agreed hourly rate, subject to successfully passing the assessment and starting employment. Must be a detail-minded, deadline-oriented self-starter who can work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.


Resumen

The Demand Planner, Brand & Innovation is responsible for working cross functionally with strategic Commercial Teams, such as Marketing, Innovation, and Finance to create and maintain a consensus depletion forecast at the brand and item levels as part of the IBP process, enabling effective operational planning, financial guidance organizational execution signals, and strategic direction at the enterprise level. This role serves as the primary demand planning counterpart to Marketing, bridging brand strategy and execution by translating portfolio decisions, innovation plans, and cannibalization impacts into a coherent demand outlook and generating content for decisions needed in the Portfolio Review process. As a Planner, this role will support the Manager, Brand and Portfolio Demand Planning in additional key activities such as team process definitions and improvements, long range annual planning, and scenario development. This role requires a professional with a strong analytical background, the ability to communicate effectively and collaboratively and a track record of delivering results.

Responsabilidades

Forecasting & Demand Planning


Proactively gather and validate commercial assumptions that are aligned and approved with appropriate insight owners prior to integration into demand plans.
Demonstrate the ability to quantify relationships between business drivers and demand outcomes.
Proficiency in statistical modeling and its application to forecasting.
Expertise in data visualization and business intelligence tools, to drive decision making/consensus across cross functional partners
Digital Competency: Demonstrated experience across use of Data Science and Analyticsknowledge of advanced analytics and ML models and use of predictive and prescriptive analytics.
Own and defend demand volumes, drivers, and Risks & Opportunities (R&Os) at item, brand, and brand-family levels.
Provide content for the Monthly Portfolio Review meeting and process, framing tradeoffs, risks, and opportunities for gap closure to plan


Collaboration And Communication


Foster strong relationships with marketing, operations, and finance teams to integrate relevant data and insights to drive the right forecast enhancements. 
Work closely with counterparts in regional Demand Planning team to ensure overlay of brand insights are appropriately integrated into the consensus forecast.
Lead cross-functional meetings with partners in sales, marketing, and finance to align on commercial insights affecting the depletion forecast.
Demonstrates effective communication that is genuine and authentic, as well as clear, concise, and persuasive in both written and oral communication.
Ability to own, present and drive consensus of overall forecast to multiple levels and functions in the organization


Continuous Improvement


Stay updated and apply relevant industry trends, best practices and emerging technologies in demand planning and supply chain management
Challenge the status quo to improve demand planning processes and tools.
Drive continuous improvement efforts to increase forecast accuracy and operational efficiency

Ciudad de Mexico, Mexico

Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.




The Content Integrity Editor works closely with the fact-checking and copyediting teams within the Content Integrity Group (CIG) to uphold Condé Nast’s editorial standards by ensuring the accuracy, consistency, clarity, and integrity of digital and print content across its English-language publications. Based in the Mexico network hub, this role works under the supervision of senior team members and in coordination with fact-checkers, copy editors, legal affairs editors, and global workflow leadership.




The Content Integrity Editor ensures that published material is thoroughly vetted for factual accuracy and style consistency, aligned with Condé Nast’s editorial and ethical standards, and appropriate for its intended audience. This role requires curiosity, skepticism, attention to detail, and a commitment to journalistic rigor. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable conducting research and verification, and refining copy for readability and consistency.

About the job

HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.

HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.

You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.

You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What You Will Own


Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand
Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention
Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands
Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing
Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently


Support and autonomy

The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.


Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention
Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability
Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists
Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments
Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems
Strong professional English and effective remote leadership


Experience in youth sports, education, fitness, memberships or multi-location services is useful. Evidence of building a profitable business and an effective team matters most.

How To Apply

Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.

Complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners using that email, indicate this in the form.


Culture Index survey
Criteria GAME assessment - English


Benefits

Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Remote work from LATAM, with Toronto-hours collaboration. Opportunity to build and lead a business and the parent marketing team, with equity opportunity subject to agreed terms. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

About the job

UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.

At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.

UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.

Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.

For every child, the right to a future

UNICEF Mexico’s Country Programme Document (CPD) for the period 2026–2031 provides a strategic framework to address emerging challenges and evolving priorities aimed at improving the lives of children across the country. The programme operates through a structure, comprising one Country Office in Mexico City and three Zonal Offices covering the southern, northern, and eastern regions. It is characterized by strong programmatic delivery, complemented by an ambitious national fundraising and brand positioning strategy.

Within this context, UNICEF Mexico prioritizes the strategic use of evidence to inform policy and programme design, the strengthening of partnerships and multistakeholder coalitions, and the delivery of scalable interventions with a particular emphasis on subnational engagement. In parallel, the office is advancing a diversified and sustainable fundraising model anchored in long-term donor engagement, aimed at securing predictable funding for core priorities while further elevating organizational visibility and impact.

How can you make a difference?

The role encompasses both procedural and specialized functions related to ICT systems, including desktop administration, connectivity, and server support. It involves the installation, configuration, and routine maintenance of ICT components, as well as user support and orientation. In addition, the position ensures the efficient management of service requests, maintenance of technical and user documentation, and adherence to organizational standards, thereby contributing to the overall effectiveness, reliability, and performance of digital systems in support of UNICEF’s results for children in Mexico.

General ICT / Office Support

For every Child, you demonstrate...

UNICEF's Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values

 Builds and maintains partnerships

Familiarize yourself with our competency framework and its different levels.

UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status.

UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance.

UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of serious misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable. Appointment, selection and continued engagement are subject to the satisfactory completion of all required checks. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information and consent to enable UNICEF to undertake these checks. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially.

UNICEF appointments are subject to medical clearance. Appointments are conditional on the selected candidates willingness to comply with current or future vaccination requirements, should UNICEF mandate it for personnel. Failure to comply with such requirements, where applicable and without a duly approved medical exemption from the relevant UN authority, will result in the cancellation of the selection or may lead to other administrative measures, including separation from service.

Remarks

As per Article 101, paragraph 3, of the Charter of the United Nations, the paramount consideration in the employment of the staff is the necessity of securing the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity.

UNICEF is committed to fostering an inclusive, representative, and welcoming workforce. For this position, eligible and suitable candidates from underrepresented groups, including persons with disabilities, indigenous peoples, and Afro-descendant communities, are encouraged to apply.

Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF reserves the right to withdraw an offer of appointment, without compensation, if a visa or medical clearance is not obtained, or necessary inoculation requirements are not met, within a reasonable period for any reason.

Humanitarian action is a cross-cutting priority within UNICEF's Strategic Plan. UNICEF is committed to stay and deliver in humanitarian contexts. Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities.

Important: For GS category positions, only candidates who are nationals of the country or that hold a valid work permit or residency status will be considered.

All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. An internal candidate performing at the level of the post in the relevant functional area, or an internal/external candidate in the corresponding Talent Group, may be selected, if suitable for the post, without assessment of other candidates.

description:
About the job

HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.

HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.

You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.

You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What You Will Own


Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand
Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention
Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands
Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing
Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently


Support and autonomy

The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.


Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention
Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability
Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists
Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments
Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems
Strong professional English and effective remote leadership


Experience in youth sports, education, fitness, memberships or multi-location services is useful. Evidence of building a profitable business and an effective team matters most.

How To Apply

Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.

Complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners using that email, indicate this in the form.


Culture Index survey
Criteria GAME assessment - English


Benefits

Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Remote work from LATAM, with Toronto-hours collaboration. Opportunity to build and lead a business and the parent marketing team, with equity opportunity subject to agreed terms. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

description:
About the job

Titre : Partenaire d'affaires RH

Catégorie : Permanent

Localisation : Sud-Ouest de Montréal et téléravail

Salaire : Compétitif




Particularités de l’employeur : Cette entreprise québécoise en croissance évolue dans un environnement international et commercialise des produits auprès de marchés nord-américains et européens. Elle se distingue par sa culture entrepreneuriale, son agilité et sa volonté constante d’innover. L’autonomie, la collaboration et l’impact concret de chacun y sont fortement valorisés, dans un environnement humain, dynamique et orienté vers les résultats.




Avantages : Horaire flexible et culture très humaine - Travail hybride avec un jour en télétravail par semaine - Gym complet sur place et accès à un entraîneur - Espaces de travail lumineux avec terrasse privée - Chalet corporatif à disposition - 6 journées personnelles par année - Assurances santé et soins dentaires dès l’entrée en poste - REER avec contribution de l’employeur - Grande latitude dans les décisions RH et implication stratégique directe avec la direction




Vos responsabilités en quelques mots! Agir comme personne-ressource RH pour les employés et gestionnaires - Concevoir et appliquer des politiques RH internes - Structurer le processus complet de recrutement, d’intégration et de départ - Mettre en place une gestion de la performance et soutenir les gestionnaires - Développer la formation et les parcours professionnels - Collaborer à la gestion de la paie et suivre les aspects administratifs - Administrer BambooHR et assurer la gestion des indicateurs RH - Être vecteur de culture et organiser des initiatives de mobilisation - Gérer la SST, CNESST, invalidités et retours au travail - Préparer des tableaux de bord RH et recommander des améliorations à la direction - Participer activement à l’amélioration continue des pratiques humaines




Vos Atouts pour ce poste! 

• Baccalauréat en ressources humaines ou domaine connexe

• Titre professionnel CRHA

• Minimum 5 ans dans un rôle généraliste ou de conseiller(ère) RH

• Aisance avec BambooHR

• Expérience en environnement entrepreneurial ou en forte croissance

• Capacité à structurer un département RH à partir de zéro

• Solide connaissance des pratiques RH québécoises

• Compétence en gestion de la paie (PowerPay, un atout)

• Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais




Une opportunité idéale pour une personne proactive, structurée et autonome, capable de bâtir et piloter l’ensemble des fonctions RH dans un environnement en croissance. Vous jouerez un rôle crucial au sein d’une équipe de direction engagée, où vos idées auront un impact direct sur la culture et l’expérience employé. Vous prospérerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial, en vous adaptant aux besoins d’une entreprise qui évolue rapidement. En rejoignant cette équipe, vous contribuerez à poser des bases solides pour la fonction RH, à soutenir les gestionnaires dans leurs décisions humaines, et à renforcer la cohésion interne. Rejoignez-nous pour une aventure stimulante et structurante à long terme !

title: Online Data Analyst - Spanish speakers in Mexico
skills: Users can discover trusted businesses and cultural landmarks with confidence
Communities can navigate with accurate, culturally-informed geographic intelligence
Geographic data quality scales across millions of locations and thousands of data variations
Conduct detailed, methodical evaluations of geographic and business data entries using advanced mapping platforms and GIS-standard evaluation tools
Assess spatial data points (coordinates, boundaries, locations) for accuracy and consistency across multiple authoritative sources
Verify business information (names, hours, categories, contact details, service offerings) against primary and secondary sources
Evaluate cultural and regional context—ensuring data reflects how Mexicans actually navigate, describe, and interact with their geographic environment
Compare business, geographic, and cultural data entries across multiple authoritative sources (official registries, local government databases, business directories, street-level verification)
Identify discrepancies where data conflicts across sources (e.g., conflicting addresses, outdated hours, category misclassifications)
Apply critical thinking to determine which source is most reliable and document reasoning transparently

description:
About the job

About the Role

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Mexico's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.




Why This Matters

Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures that:

Users can discover trusted businesses and cultural landmarks with confidence
Communities can navigate with accurate, culturally-informed geographic intelligence
Geographic data quality scales across millions of locations and thousands of data variations

At scale, this is infrastructure work. Every verified data point contributes to how billions of people interact with geographic information globally.




What You'll Do

Core Responsibilities

Structured Quality Audits on Spatial Datasets

Conduct detailed, methodical evaluations of geographic and business data entries using advanced mapping platforms and GIS-standard evaluation tools
Assess spatial data points (coordinates, boundaries, locations) for accuracy and consistency across multiple authoritative sources
Verify business information (names, hours, categories, contact details, service offerings) against primary and secondary sources
Evaluate cultural and regional context—ensuring data reflects how Mexicans actually navigate, describe, and interact with their geographic environment




Cross-Reference Complex Data Against Authoritative Sources

Compare business, geographic, and cultural data entries across multiple authoritative sources (official registries, local government databases, business directories, street-level verification)
Identify discrepancies where data conflicts across sources (e.g., conflicting addresses, outdated hours, category misclassifications)
Apply critical thinking to determine which source is most reliable and document reasoning transparently




Rigorous Framework Application

Apply detailed, multi-dimensional evaluation frameworks with consistency and precision across dozens of geographic, business, and cultural data variations
Understand the intent behind evaluation guidelines and apply them contextually—knowing when to follow rules strictly and when to apply judgment




Work Across Diverse Task Types

Be flexible and adaptable across varied evaluation tasks: Maps (location data, boundaries), News (geo-relevant content accuracy), Audio (transcription and context verification), Relevance (data-to-query matching), and emerging task types
Quickly learn new task specifications and apply them with the same rigor




Provide Structured Feedback for Algorithm Improvement

Articulate clear, actionable feedback that helps refine mapping algorithms and improve geographic intelligence
Explain not just what is wrong, but why it matters for real-world navigation and discovery

Structured onboarding: Access comprehensive evaluation guidelines, detailed reference materials, and practical examples before your first live assessment

description:
About the job

City : Guadalajara State : México (MX-MEX) Country : Mexico (MX) Requisition Number: 48503

Bunge has an exciting opportunity available for Merchandiser. In this role you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities.  Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world.  Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way.  Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world – creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed.

At Bunge, people don’t just come here to work, they come here to grow – solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress.  Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work. Most importantly, in all we do we live our values:


 Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect
 Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient
 Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably


A Day in the Life:

Develop the origination, marketing, and execution of commodities within a designated geographic area and/or assigned customer portfolio. The key objective of this role is to drive sales and market growth, strengthen arbitrage and risk management capabilities, and achieve or exceed profitability targets. This is accomplished through close interaction with customers and suppliers, delivering excellent service and support, and expanding the customer/supplier base with a strong focus on improving margins and overall profitability.

What You'll Be Doing:

Actively participate in the research, analysis, and execution of commodity market strategies for customer trading.

Maintain constant communication with customers and suppliers to address their needs, ensure excellent service, improve logistical efficiency, and increase business margins.

Provide follow-up and guidance to the Merchandiser Trainee programs.

Support and oversee the implementation of origination programs relevant to the area.

Execute and manage the development of a P&L (profit and loss) for the assigned area.

Record sales, operations, and general information in internal databases.

Prepare weekly and monthly profit and loss estimates.

Build operational knowledge in fixed price and margin risk management.

Buy and sell assigned products to/from specific customers, delivering high-quality market analysis and commercial recommendations.

Oversee logistics programs, including load review, rates, and cost tracking.

Develop impactful ideas and strategic projects that contribute significantly to the business

Support the development of new markets and continuous process improvement.

Collaborate closely with other teams to achieve shared goals.

Perform other activities inherent to the department

Skills/Experience

3+ years of experience in the industry, in roles such as Trader or Merchandiser.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Engineering, Business Administration, International Business, or a related field.

Collaborate, effectively communicate with others and take initiative to continually develop themselves.

Pursue opportunities to solve problems and take action while maintaining the ability to manage work, even in times of challenge or change.

Knowledge of international trade

Strong numerical skills

Understanding of the futures market

Experience in pricing and contract management

Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously, with a strong sense of urgency and within tight deadlines

Proactive mindset

Decision-making skills

Excellent communication skills

Intermediate to advanced Excel proficiency

Advanced English proficiency

Valid visa

Outgoing and confident attitude

Customer service orientation

Sales-driven mindset

Attention to detail

Leadership and strategic thinking

At Bunge (NYSE: BG), our purpose is to connect farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed and fuel to the world. As a premier agribusiness solutions provider, our team of :34,000 dedicated employees partner with farmers across the globe to move agricultural commodities from where they’re grown to where they’re needed—in faster, smarter, and more efficient ways. We are a world leader in grain origination, storage, distribution, oilseed processing and refining, offering a broad portfolio of plant-based oils, fats, and proteins. We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. With 200+ years of experience and presence in over 50 countries, we are committed to strengthening global food security, advancing sustainability, and helping communities prosper where we operate. Bunge has its registered office in Geneva, Switzerland and its corporate headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Learn more at Bunge.com.

Every day our people exemplify these values, which represent Bunge at its core:


 We Are One Team – Collaborative, Respectful, Inclusive 
 We Lead The Way – Agile, Empowered, Innovative 
 We Do What’s Right – Safety, Sustainability, With Integrity 


If this sounds like you, join us! We value and invest in people who believe in our purpose and are excited to live it every day – people who are #ProudtoBeBunge

title: Gerente de tienda
description:
About the job

Forma parte de Taiga Floors, empresa familiar con más de cuatro generaciones de experiencia en la industria de la madera.

Buscamos una Gerente de Tienda con experiencia comercial, capacidad de liderazgo y una fuerte orientación a resultados, que sea responsable de la operación diaria en una de nuestras tiendas en Ciudad de México, así como del seguimiento y cierre de las oportunidades comerciales.

 

PERFIL Y REQUISITOS

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en gestión de tiendas y/o equipos comerciales.

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en ventas, preferentemente en pisos, acabados, interiorismo, construcción o sectores relacionados.

• Experiencia en atención, seguimiento y cierre de clientes.

• Experiencia en elaboración y seguimiento de cotizaciones.

• Dominio avanzado de Excel.

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia utilizando CRM.

• Alta capacidad de organización, seguimiento y resolución de problemas.

• Proactividad, iniciativa y capacidad para trabajar bajo presión.

• Excelente comunicación y atención al cliente.

• Orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de objetivos comerciales.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar de lunes a sábado.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES

• Responsable de la operación y resultados comerciales de la tienda.

• Atender, asesorar y dar seguimiento a clientes, tanto presenciales como provenientes de canales digitales.

• Elaborar y enviar cotizaciones de acuerdo con las necesidades de cada cliente.

• Dar seguimiento puntual a prospectos hasta lograr el cierre de la venta.

• Mantener actualizado diariamente el CRM y asegurar el correcto registro de las oportunidades comerciales.

• Coordinar con fábrica, supervisores de obra, instaladores y clientes para garantizar el correcto desarrollo de cada proyecto.

• Dar seguimiento a la postventa, incluyendo cobranza, entrega de materiales e instalación.

• Supervisar y mantener el correcto funcionamiento, imagen y organización de la tienda.

• Elaborar reportes semanales de ventas, prospectos y seguimiento comercial.

• Asegurar el cumplimiento de los procesos y políticas comerciales de la empresa.

• Apoyar y dar seguimiento al trabajo de la Ejecutiva Administrativa y Comercial de la tienda.

• Resolver oportunamente incidencias con clientes y coordinar las acciones necesarias con las diferentes áreas de la empresa.




OFRECEMOS

• Sueldo base de $20,000 MXN mensuales + bonos y comisiones.

• Desarrollo dentro de una empresa familiar con amplia trayectoria en la industria de la madera.

• Un puesto con responsabilidad directa sobre la operación y resultados de la tienda.

 

Si eres una persona comercial, organizada, responsable y orientada a resultados, y buscas un puesto donde puedas tener autonomía y responsabilidad sobre una tienda, queremos conocerte.

 

Envía tu CV y forma parte de Taiga Floors.

title: Asesor comercial
description:
About the job

Forma parte de Taiga Floors, empresa familiar con más de cuatro generaciones de experiencia en la industria de la madera.




Buscamos una Asesor(a) Comercial con experiencia en ventas, excelente capacidad de seguimiento y una fuerte orientación a resultados.




El puesto es presencial en nuestras oficinas de Lomas de Chapultepec, CDMX y está enfocado principalmente en la atención, seguimiento y cierre de prospectos comerciales generados por las campañas de marketing de la empresa.

La asesora será responsable de gestionar de principio a fin sus oportunidades comerciales: desde el primer contacto con el prospecto, identificación de sus necesidades y elaboración de la cotización, hasta el cierre de la venta y seguimiento posterior. Cuando sea necesario, podrá recibir y acompañar a sus clientes en nuestro Showroom, donde contará con el apoyo de la empresa para presentar los productos y avanzar en el proceso de venta.

 

PERFIL Y REQUISITOS

• Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en ventas.

• Experiencia comprobable en atención, seguimiento y cierre de clientes.

• Experiencia en elaboración y seguimiento de cotizaciones.

• Deseable experiencia en pisos, acabados, interiorismo, arquitectura, construcción o sectores relacionados.

• Experiencia utilizando CRM.

• Dominio de Excel.

• Excelente capacidad de organización y seguimiento.

• Proactividad, iniciativa y autonomía.

• Excelente comunicación y atención al cliente.

• Orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de objetivos comerciales.

• Capacidad para gestionar múltiples prospectos simultáneamente.

• Disponibilidad para trabajar de lunes a viernes.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILIDADES

• Atender y dar seguimiento a los prospectos comerciales proporcionados por la empresa.

• Contactar oportunamente a cada prospecto y entender sus necesidades.

• Asesorar al cliente sobre las diferentes opciones de productos y soluciones.

• Elaborar y enviar cotizaciones.

• Dar seguimiento puntual a cada oportunidad hasta lograr el cierre de la venta.

• Recibir y acompañar a clientes en el Showroom cuando sea necesario.

• Mantener actualizado diariamente el CRM y registrar correctamente cada oportunidad.

• Dar seguimiento a cada proyecto desde la venta hasta su entrega e instalación.

• Coordinar con fábrica, supervisores de obra, instaladores y otras áreas involucradas en cada proyecto.

description:
About the job

YouTube isn't a campaign type here. It's a dedicated channel with its own team.


Salary: $3,750 USD/month

Reports to: Director of Growth 




At most agencies, YouTube is a line item inside "Google Ads management." A campaign type. Something the search team turns on when the client asks about video or the Meta team builds it out.

At Taikun, YouTube is its own service line. Its own strategy, its own creative discipline, its own measurement design. We built it that way on purpose, because the channel deserves it and because treating YouTube like Meta is how you burn $50k learning nothing.




That decision is why brands doing $5M to $500M a year hire us for YouTube specifically. We run geo holdouts to prove lift. We publish quarterly research on the channel. We are at the forefront of YouTube tools like CTV Premiere Beta, YouTube Creator Partnerships, and Insights Finder.

We're not looking for someone who wants to learn this. We're looking for someone who already lives it and wants a bigger stage to run on.




About Taikun

We're a fully remote ~30-person performance marketing agency and Google Premier Partner, built for DTC ecommerce. Your work ships under your name, and some of it gets published for the whole industry to read.




What you'll actually do

You'll own YouTube strategy and execution for DTC accounts.

The role:

Build true full-funnel YouTube programs. Awareness through conversion across in-stream, in-feed, Shorts, and Demand Gen, with each stage doing a distinct job instead of 1 campaign pretending to do all of them.
Design sequencing strategies. Story arcs across ad exposures. You know how to architect this and when it's worth the complexity.
Deploy contextual and audience targeting with intent. Placements, topics, custom segments, in-market layers. You match the message to the moment, not just the person.
Design measurement that holds up. Geo holdouts, platform-comparable CPA, attribution triangulation across Triple Whale, Northbeam, and GA4.
Brief creative that converts. Hook first. Emotion first, logic second.
Catch the lies early. Conversion inflation, view-through padding, saturation creep. You'll spot them before the client ever sees a weird number.
Report like a strategist. Weekly reads that separate real CAC from reported CAC, written so a founder actually understands them.
Your findings feed our quarterly YouTube reports and frameworks. Your work builds your reputation, not just ours.




Who this is for
You've run YouTube hands-on for 3+ years as your primary channel, ideally on DTC accounts spending $100k+ a month. Not YouTube as a side quest inside a Google Ads role. YouTube as the job.
You've built sequenced, full-funnel programs before and have opinions about when sequencing earns its complexity and when it doesn't.
You speak incrementality fluently. Holdouts, lift tests, MMM calibration, and why last-click fails to flatter a video channel. Every, single, time.
You have taste. You can watch a cut and know in 6 seconds whether it'll hold attention, and you can explain why.
You write like you talk. Clear, direct, no jargon. Clients hire us for clarity as much as performance.

Bonus points
Demand Gen experience and the scars that come with its reporting quirks
A DTC background, so you can translate for brands shifting spend
SQL, Python, or scripting chops for reporting automation
A public footprint. You've posted, published, or podcasted about this work (not mandatory).




Why this job is different

You've probably been the only person at your company who really understands YouTube. Here, we’re building an entire team around it. A dedicated service line, the sharpest measurement stack in the DTC agency world, direct access to leadership, and a byline on research the industry actually reads. This is where your expertise starts compounding.

 

Competitive salary, benefits, remote flexibility!

description:
About the job

Job Summary

Leverages digital analytics and manages day-to-day operations of the paid Display & Social Media Acquisition plans. Creates and manages campaigns that deliver on key KPIs of sales calls and premium; measuring and evaluating the overall effectiveness of key campaigns.

Essential Job Functions

Leads end to end build-out of paid display and social campaigns (that is DV360, Facebook, etc. ), daily management and optimization of in-market campaigns to deliver against key KPIs, manage ongoing data reporting. Analyzes weekly campaign performance to feed into management reporting and leads audience management and segment creation within technology platforms. Leads daily performance analysis to determine optimization opportunities to implement in-market Display and Social campaigns to deliver effective campaigns in driving efficient leads into the funnel for conversion. Takes ownership of managing monthly digital media budget by partnering closely and providing Finance with budget actuals and forecast. Leads daily management (actualizing, optimizing and planning) of the paid Display & Social media budgets with minimal supervision. Recommends testing of new innovative approaches for display, social media and in-market initiatives to generate quality leads. Partners with analytics team to create dashboards for analysis and optimization. Leads insight/implication development of display and social media creative performance. Manages vendors, including display networks and social websites. Coordinates with cross functional partners to include analytics, creative/content and customer relationship management (CRM) team to execute specific display and social media campaigns as needed.

Physical Actions

Job is performed in-person at a Farmers office or virtually at an approved alternative work location. The physical work environment is indoors and climate-controlled with adequate lighting and ventilation. Normal and customary distractions include background noise produced by office equipment and chatter among people, as well as interruptions. Frequently sits for prolonged periods of time, up to a full shift. Occasionally moves about the workplace including, navigating stairs, ramps, and level or uneven surfaces. Occasionally moves, pushes, pulls, lifts, carries, and/or places objects or materials weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Frequently uses shoulders, arms, hands, and fingers to manipulate equipment, tools, and objects necessary to perform job duties. Frequently performs fine motor tasks such as typing, mousing, or writing, up to a full shift. Rarely performs movements such as bending, stooping, crouching, kneeling, twisting, and reaching overhead or below the knees. Possesses clear vision, with or without correction, to visually read and verify information. Relies on depth perception and peripheral vision to navigate the work environment visually by identifying barriers, changes in terrain and locating objects. Possesses adequate hearing, with or without correction, to communicate with co-workers, respond promptly to auditory signals or alarms, and discern sounds essential for maintaining safety and productivity in the workplace. Jobs in this category require rare, if any, travel.

Physical Environment

This position operates in an open office working environment which will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions.

Education Requirements

High School Diploma or equivalent *Bachelors degree in Marketing or related field.

Experience Requirements

related experience creating and managing paid display and social campaigns, including management of DV360, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube. Demonstrated experience in performance marketing and ability to work across marketing department functions. Track record of successful vendor management.

Special Skill Requirement

Additional Qualification

Demonstrated analytical skills. Ability to synthesize complex data sets into actionable steps/initiatives *Demonstrated time management and priority setting skills. Ability to drive multiple projects to successful completion. Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Strong written communication skills. Ability to build strong customer relationships. Possesses a high degree of initiative.
