About the job




🚀 ALIADO COMERCIAL TPV | MONETIZA TU CARTERA DE CLIENTES

📍 CDMX | Modalidad flexible | 100% comisión




¿Ya tienes una cartera de clientes y quieres generar ingresos adicionales con ella?

Buscamos Aliados Comerciales que ya tengan relaciones comerciales activas con empresas, comercios, profesionistas o negocios y quieran incorporar un servicio de Terminal Punto de Venta (TPV) como complemento a los productos o servicios que actualmente comercializan.

No necesitas empezar desde cero.

Tu cartera ya existe. Tu relación con el cliente ya existe. Ahora puedes agregar una nueva solución a tu oferta y generar ingresos adicionales.

🎯 Objetivo del rol

Desarrollar oportunidades comerciales a través de tu cartera actual de clientes.

El objetivo es identificar clientes que tengan necesidades de cobro con tarjeta y presentarles la posibilidad de incorporar una TPV como una solución adicional a los servicios o productos que ya utilizan.

Tú mantienes la relación con tu cliente y generas la oportunidad.

Nosotros te respaldamos con el producto, proceso y cierre comercial.

💡 ¿Cómo funciona?

La dinámica es sencilla:

Tu cartera → Detectas la necesidad → Presentas la solución TPV → Nosotros desarrollamos la oportunidad → Se concreta el servicio → Tú generas comisión.

La TPV puede convertirse en un producto complementario dentro de la relación comercial que ya tienes con tus clientes.

Por ejemplo:

Si vendes productos médicos → puedes ofrecer TPV a consultorios y clínicas.
Si vendes tecnología → puedes complementar tu oferta con soluciones de cobro.
Si eres consultor empresarial → puedes identificar clientes que necesitan mejorar sus medios de pago.
Si comercializas insumos o equipamiento → puedes agregar una solución de cobro.
Si eres contador o asesor financiero → puedes detectar negocios con necesidades de cobranza y medios de pago.

Profesionales independientes, empresarios, vendedores, consultores y especialistas que ya tengan una cartera comercial activa.

Representantes comerciales.

description:
About the job

Email Marketing Specialist (Klaviyo)

Part-Time — 20hs to start | Remote | Long-Term Contract




About the Role

Our client, a US-based full-service marketing agency and close Klaviyo partner, is looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join its email team as a strategist across multiple ecommerce client accounts. You will own the email and SMS strategy for your accounts and the results that come from it. Dedicated designers and builders handle creative and technical execution, so your focus stays on strategy, performance, and quality.




Key Responsibilities

Own email and SMS strategy for multiple client accounts in Klaviyo, including flows, campaigns, segmentation, A/B testing, and pop-ups
Audit new accounts: revenue attribution (flows vs. campaigns), core flow coverage, campaign cadence, segmentation quality, list growth, deliverability health, integrations, and billing/active profile optimization
Design flow architecture with profile and flow filters, conditional splits, and trigger logic across the full lifecycle (welcome, browse/cart/checkout abandonment, post-purchase, repurchase, winback)
Build segmentation strategies based on purchase and engagement behavior, including RFM-based segments
Diagnose and fix deliverability issues, including authentication/domain setup, inbox placement testing, content adjustments, and list hygiene
Write and review email copy and creative briefs for designers
Act as the final QA checkpoint before flows go live and campaigns are scheduled or sent
Report on performance and explain strategic decisions using revenue and engagement data
Collaborate with the head of email, designers, builders, media buyers, and other marketing teams




Requirements

Hands-on Klaviyo experience as the primary owner of client accounts, not only sending campaigns
Ability to clearly explain how core flows work and relate to each other, including flow filters, profile filters, and conditional splits
Solid understanding of lifecycle marketing and customer progression from first touch to repeat purchase
Practical experience troubleshooting deliverability issues
Experience making and defending decisions with performance and revenue data
Experience managing multiple ecommerce/DTC accounts at the same time
Strong written and spoken English




Nice to have:

Complex multi-channel flow architecture (email + SMS)
Klaviyo integrations, API/custom events, or non-Shopify setups
Deliverability recovery experience on accounts with low scores
BFCM campaign planning and execution
Agency experience
Exposure to hospitality, B2B, or subscription brands
Familiarity with Meta/Google attribution




Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate thinks in Klaviyo naturally. When asked how a flow should be structured or why an account is underperforming, they answer from real experience, not from a script. They are curious and technically minded, enjoy digging into flow logic and deliverability data, and treat the accounts they manage as their own, including owning outcomes when results drop. They communicate clearly and confidently, are comfortable with occasional client conversations, and work well within a structured team where strategy and execution are split across roles.

Detrás de cada experiencia NUBA existe un equipo apasionado que comparte una misma visión: elevar cada detalle para crear algo verdaderamente excepcional.




Hoy buscamos personas que quieran formar parte de esta historia y contribuir con su talento a seguir reinventando el arte de viajar.




The Art of Travel starts with extraordinary people.




Conoce más sobre nosotros en https://nuba.com/




Propósito de nuestro Digital Marketing & Analytics Specialist.




Implementar, medir y optimizar las iniciativas digitales de NUBA Américas para México, Estados Unidos y Paraguay, bajo la dirección de la Digital Marketing Manager. La posición será responsable de la operación técnica de campañas, email marketing, CRM y activos web, así como de revisar la calidad de la medición y aportar información que permita evaluar el desempeño de las iniciativas digitales y el trabajo de las agencias externas.




¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones?




Campañas y pauta digital 




Configurar, monitorear y optimizar campañas en Meta Ads Manager de acuerdo con los objetivos, audiencias y presupuestos aprobados. 
Revisar la configuración y los resultados de campañas gestionadas por agencias externas, identificando discrepancias y oportunidades de mejora. 
Coordinar con Digital Content & Design los formatos y variantes creativas necesarios para las campañas. 
Dar seguimiento a los resultados de pauta y a la calidad de los leads en coordinación con los equipos correspondientes.




Medición y análisis 




Revisar el seguimiento de campañas y conversiones mediante GA4, Google Tag Manager y Meta Events Manager. 
Comprobar el funcionamiento de etiquetas, eventos, conversiones y enlaces con parámetros UTM; documentar incidencias y dar seguimiento a su solución. 
Analizar tráfico web, comportamiento de usuarios, resultados de email marketing, leads y desempeño de campañas. 
Preparar reportes que expliquen los resultados y presenten recomendaciones concretas para la Digital Marketing Manager.
Revisar los reportes y recomendaciones de agencias, contrastándolos con los objetivos y los datos disponibles en las plataformas de NUBA. 




Email marketing y CRM 




Configurar, probar, programar y medir los newsletters desarrollados por Digital Content & Design. 
Administrar segmentaciones, listas, etiquetas y audiencias en las plataformas de email marketing y CRM. 
Mantener organizados los datos, enlaces de campaña y registros necesarios para el seguimiento de resultados. 
Identificar oportunidades de mejora en los envíos, las automatizaciones y los procesos de captación de leads.




Web y SEO 




Gestionar actualizaciones operativas del sitio web y las páginas de campaña, en coordinación con IT o proveedores cuando se requieran cambios técnicos. 
Investigar búsquedas relevantes y colaborar con Digital Content & Design en la definición y optimización de contenidos. 
Revisar elementos de SEO en página y dar seguimiento a la visibilidad e indexación de contenidos mediante Google Search Console. 
Utilizar herramientas de inteligencia artificial para apoyar la investigación, el análisis y los procesos de trabajo, verificando la calidad de sus resultados. 




Competencias 




Pensamiento analítico y capacidad para convertir datos en recomendaciones concretas.
 Conocimiento práctico de Meta Ads Manager, GA4 y Google Tag Manager, incluido el seguimiento de eventos y conversiones. 
Capacidad para identificar problemas de configuración o medición y coordinar su solución.
Organización, atención al detalle y seguimiento de tareas hasta su cierre. 
Comunicación clara para explicar hallazgos técnicos a personas de otras áreas. 
Criterio para evaluar resultados de campañas, recomendaciones de agencias e información generada con herramientas de inteligencia artificial. 




KPIs e indicadores de desarrollo.




Confiabilidad de la medición. Campañas prioritarias con eventos, conversiones, enlaces y seguimiento correctamente configurados y verificados antes de su lanzamiento. 
Calidad del análisis. Reportes que expliquen resultados, identifiquen posibles causas y propongan acciones útiles para la toma de decisiones. 
Mejoras implementadas. Oportunidades detectadas en pauta, email, CRM, SEO o web que se hayan aprobado y probado, junto con los resultados observados. 
Criterio técnico frente a agencias. Capacidad para identificar hallazgos relevantes en configuraciones, medición o reportes externos y plantear una recomendación clara para resolverlos. 
Calidad de la operación digital. Campañas, envíos, segmentaciones y cambios web ejecutados con las verificaciones necesarias, documentación clara y seguimiento de incidencias hasta su resolución. 
Aprendizaje aplicado. Desarrollo de criterio técnico a partir de campañas ejecutadas, problemas resueltos y resultados analizados, con capacidad para asumir gradualmente mayor autonomía.




¿Qué buscamos en ti?




Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Marketing, Mercadotecnia, Administración, Analítica de Datos o una carrera afín.
Experiencia: 2 años de experiencia en Marketing Digital, participando en la ejecución y seguimiento de campañas digitales, email marketing, analítica, CRM o iniciativas relacionadas.
Experiencia práctica en Meta Ads Manager, incluyendo configuración de campañas, segmentación de audiencias, monitoreo de resultados y optimización.
Conocimiento de Google Analytics 4 (GA4) y Google Tag Manager (GTM) para consultar eventos, conversiones y revisar el seguimiento de campañas.
Conocimiento de Meta Pixel y Events Manager, así como capacidad para identificar posibles problemas de medición o tracking.
Experiencia utilizando plataformas de email marketing o CRM para segmentar audiencias, configurar campañas y analizar resultados.
Manejo avanzado de Excel o Google Sheets, con capacidad para analizar información y convertir datos en recomendaciones claras.
Experiencia práctica utilizando herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial (IA) para mejorar procesos de investigación, análisis y ejecución, con criterio para validar la información generada.
Deseable conocimiento de Google Ads, Google Search Console, WordPress, Looker Studio y/o SEO.
Inglés avanzado (requisito indispensable).




¿Qué encontrarás en NUBA?




Más que un empleo, encontrarás la oportunidad de formar parte de una organización donde las personas son quienes hacen posible el arte de viajar.




Serás parte de:




Un equipo apasionado por crear experiencias extraordinarias.
Una cultura basada en la excelencia, la confianza y la innovación.
Un entorno que impulsa el aprendizaje, el crecimiento y el desarrollo profesional.
Una organización que valora las ideas, la colaboración y la iniciativa.
Una empresa comprometida con la sostenibilidad, la diversidad y la inclusión.
Una experiencia laboral diseñada para que cada persona pueda desarrollar su máximo potencial.




Porque, así como cuidamos cada detalle de los viajes que diseñamos, también cuidamos la experiencia de quienes construyen NUBA cada día.




The Art of Travel. The Art of Growing Together.




NUBA promueve una política transparente de atracción, selección y contratación, que garantice igualdad de oportunidades a candidatos, sin hacer ninguna exclusión por motivos de sexo, edad, raza u otra condición no relacionada con el buen desempeño del puesto que se busca cubrir.

title: Ingeniero de Aplicación y Ventas Iluminación
description:
About the job

Ingeniero de ventas para la división de Iluminación.




Descripción de las actividades: 

Atender clientes establecidos y prospectar nuevos clientes para los productos de la Division. Los productos son aluminio anodizado para reflectores, drivers y modulos de potencia para gabinetes LED, drivers para iluminación de emergencia, planchas y perfiles difusores ópticos, herrajes para colganteo de luminarias, gabinetes y cuerpos para ensamblar luminarias, foto-controles, sensores, etc.. Los clientes del Grupo Target buscan soluciones para mejor iluminación comercial, industrial y alumbrado publico. Precisamente esas son las soluciones que ofrecemos tanto en componentes de alta gama como de uso común pero siempre de una muy alta calidad. Los clientes clasifican como fabricantes de luminarias, integradores, ensambladores, especificadores o distribuidores de componentes eléctricos y de iluminación. 




Requisitos indispensables:

-Alto compromiso y responsabilidad en servicio al cliente. Desear tener una carrera corporativa en aplicación y venta de productos de este sector. 

-Carrera de Ingeniería bien sea Industrial, Eléctrica o Mecatrónica, o similar, bien sea concluida o avanzada sin terminar y con comprensión de lo que es la tecnología de iluminación y las ventas de campo.

-El candidato deberá conocer el sector de la iluminación y tener suficiente experiencia para poder dar soporte a la cartera de clientes que tenga asignada y ampliarla mediante prospectación en los territorios asignados. Debe tener familiaridad con las marcas de los componentes y de los clientes fabricantes. Manejar con fluidez el requerimiento de cotizaciones y del ciclo de ventas en general incluyendo la cobranza. Debe tener acilidad para preparar reportes de visita y reportes de campo antes y después de las visitas. 

-Conocimientos en softwares de: Dialux Evo, AutoCAD 2D y 3D

-Vivir cerca de Azcapotzalco

-Contar con -Automóvil propio




Propuesta laboral:




-$16,000.00 netos mensuales 

-Comisiones: del 2% proveniente de las ventas facturadas y cobradas cada mes. 

-Prestaciones: las ordinarias de Ley incl. vacaciones con su prima, reparto de utilidades y aguinaldo. Además, prestaciones discrecionales que incluyen, 4 medios días y día de cumpleaños. 

-Apoyo Trasporte Local: $1,400.00 mensuales para visitas a clientes locales y viáticos para trasporte fuera del perímetro urbano. 

-Herramientas de trabajo proporcionados por la empresa: Computadora, telefonía celular, muestras de productos.

description:
About the job

Theogames was founded in 2018 as a communications agency specializing in games for Brazil and Latin America. If you have any questions, please contact us at people@theogames.biz




Applications at: https://forms.gle/7FQsFa9v2DdhFYPY8







As Head of Community Marketing for SSA (Spanish-speaking Americas), you will provide strategic, high-level oversight of all activities carried out by Theogames’ Community Marketing team across this territory. 




Reporting directly to the agency’s Director of Regional Operations, you will be part of the broader executive management team, working in constant synergy with the Public Relations, Social Media, and Influencer Relations departments to ensure excellence in delivery.

Strategic Leadership

Identify and implement industry best practices and technologies, ensuring optimal quality, innovation, and results from the entire team.
Constantly evaluate, redefine, and refine engagement and growth processes and KPIs, proposing structural adjustments for approval by agency leadership.

Maintain frequent, periodic, high-level contact with all regional clients, ensuring the quality of community and marketing strategies is monitored and adjusted to meet their specific needs and guidelines.

Oversee the development of major strategic partnerships with local organizations, player groups, and other relevant entities to expand the agency's reach and influence within the gaming market.

Ensure the team maintains client relevance within local audiences in an authentic manner aligned with Theogames' values, fostering an inclusive and dynamic environment.
Ensure that insights and feedback from the community are seamlessly integrated into service and product development, both internally and for clients.




Team Leadership and Mentoring

Foster a collaborative, supportive, and high-performance work environment, driving the continuous professional development of leaders and the entire team under your purview.

Deep understanding of gaming industry culture, market dynamics, and trends across Latin America, including Brazil. 
Strong business vision with the ability to identify commercial opportunities and manage direct relationships with strategic clients.
Excellent communication and negotiation skills in Spanish and English.
Comprehensive command of data-driven strategies, analytical methodologies, and advanced community management platforms.




Our work model:




It's a 100% remote position, under a contractor model, in which you would send us monthly invoices in your country’s currency (Ex. Argentina Peso) and paid directly to your local bank account.
15 days of paid time off per calendar year, to use in any order you prefer.
By the end of the year, the agency takes a "recess period" of around 5 days for Christmas + New Year's eve; Local holidays are also respected as paid time off. Of course, sometimes this depends on a case by case basis, since working with global brands may require acting according to their schedule, but it's something we always try to balance and compensate for, so even if something critical needs to be taken care of, you will be able to take the corresponding day off at another moment.

About the job

About Rankbreeze




Rankbreeze helps short-term rental hosts and property managers win more bookings through better data, smarter listing optimization, and tools that make Airbnb performance easier to understand.




We help operators improve the parts of their listing that drive more visibility, more clicks, and more bookings — including rankings, photos, amenities, pricing, descriptions, and A/B testing.

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager to help us grow Rankbreeze’s brand, reach more hosts, and turn our product insights into content, campaigns, and offers that property managers actually care about. Turn lookers into bookers.




About the Role




As a Marketing Manager, you'll own the bridge between what Rankbreeze builds and how the short-term rental market discovers, understands, and adopts it. You'll get access to Rankbreeze's product, customer results, Airbnb data, and short-term rental insights to create marketing that drives trial sign-ups, email growth, website traffic, and customer acquisition.




This is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable writing copy, creating content, filming videos, analyzing funnels, improving website conversion, and testing new marketing ideas.




You'll work closely with the founder, product, customer success, and growth teams to make Rankbreeze the go-to platform for short-term rental operators who want to improve their Airbnb & vacation rental performance.




Our company is based in Canada, but we’re hiring for this role anywhere in the Americas.




What You'll Work On




Growing trial sign-ups, email subscribers, and website traffic with offers that genuinely help hosts win more bookings — across email, social, communities, and paid channels.
Shipping marketing that's actually useful — guides, data studies, lead magnets, and tools that STR managers genuinely want.
Growing the brand and customer base every month through a consistent content cadence and a continuously optimized funnel.
Owning the funnel: diagnose ad campaign performance, run landing-page experiments, and optimize each stage from first visit to trial to paying customer.
Creating content end-to-end: draft emails and social posts that help hosts book more nights, film feature showcases and videos breaking down A/B test winners from Airbnb listings.
Building leverage through affiliates, influencer partnerships, webinars, and community programs that compound reach over time.




What You'll Own & Manage




Product Marketing: Turn features, customer wins, and Airbnb data into clear messaging that helps hosts understand how Rankbreeze helps them get more visibility, more clicks, and more bookings.
Growth Channels & Campaigns: Build and manage campaigns across email, social, paid ads, affiliates, webinars, partnerships, and other channels to grow Rankbreeze's brand and customer base.
Website Conversion & Funnel Optimization: Improve website copy, landing pages, CTAs, and trial sign-up flows by analyzing performance data, identifying bottlenecks, and running tests.
Content & Demand Generation: Create useful, high-converting content such as emails, social posts, videos, blog posts, lead magnets, data studies, and product updates that attract STR hosts and drive trial sign-ups.




What Makes You a Great Fit




You may be a great fit if you:




Can explain complex product topics in simple, compelling language
Understand how to create content that drives sign-ups, not just engagement
Are comfortable being on camera or creating video content
Like testing different hooks, offers, pages, and campaigns
Care about measurable growth
Can analyze marketing performance and turn it into action

What Success Looks Like




Within your first few months, success would look like:




Rankbreeze is consistently reaching more short-term rental hosts every week
Trial sign-ups are growing
Website conversion rates are improving
Email list growth is accelerating
Product launches are organized, clear, and more effective
Rankbreeze has a stronger content engine across email, social, video, and website
Hosts better understand how Rankbreeze helps them improve their Airbnb listings and win more bookings




What We're Looking For




You are both strategic and hands-on. You can think through systems, but you can also write the email, film the video, improve the landing page, and analyze the results.

You have experience with:




Product/SaaS marketing
Content marketing with data
Email marketing
Paid acquisition




Experience in short-term rentals, Airbnb, real estate, hospitality, or property management is a strong bonus, but not required.




Join Rankbreeze Today




Grow with a fast-scaling SaaS company in a high-ownership role where your work actually matters 
Be part of a fully remote global team building something meaningful, shipping fast, and winning together 
You’ll get to work with booking funnel data, customer stories, product insights, and A/B test results that hosts actually care about. Your work will directly help property managers improve their listings, grow their revenue, and make better decisions.




If you’re excited about product marketing, SaaS growth, and helping Airbnb hosts win more bookings, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
About the job

The Global Transportation Pricing & Benchmarking Manager is a hands-on individual contributor responsible for analyzing transportation data to identify pricing, benchmarking, sourcing, and measurable savings opportunities across multiple transportation modes. The role combines advanced transportation pricing analysis with customer-facing solution development and transportation provider negotiations.




This individual owns pricing and benchmarking engagements from analysis through recommendation and commercial execution: understanding current transportation costs, normalizing complex rate structures, establishing meaningful benchmarks, developing sourcing and negotiation strategies, presenting and defending recommendations, and participating in or leading transportation provider negotiations designed to convert identified opportunities into measurable customer results.




The position does not initially require direct personnel management. The Manager title reflects ownership of the pricing and benchmarking function and accountability for customer outcomes.

The position requires broad transportation knowledge, with particular emphasis on domestic and international small parcel, international heavy air freight, and international ocean freight.

Experience with LTL, Truckload, Rail, Intermodal, Drayage, and other transportation modes is also valuable. Candidates do not need to be equally experienced in every mode; demonstrated depth in one or more priority modes and the ability to expand across modes will be considered.




Key Responsibilities include




Transportation Pricing & Benchmarking

Analyze shipment-level, invoice, rate, surcharge, accessorial, service-level, lane, zone, weight, and transportation provider data to establish a complete current-state transportation cost profile.
Validate benchmarking and savings models against actual freight invoice and shipment-level spend so recommendations reflect the true cost of transportation, including base transportation charges, fuel, accessorials, minimums, dimensional weight, duties and taxes where applicable, and other contractual charges.
Develop and maintain transportation pricing benchmarks by mode, lane, geography, service level, weight break, zone, shipment characteristic, and other relevant cost drivers.
Benchmark customer pricing against internal transportation data, historical sourcing events and bids, transportation provider proposals, customer-specific agreements, and appropriate external market intelligence.
Normalize pricing to create meaningful like-for-like comparisons, including base rates, discounts, minimums, fuel, accessorials, dimensional weight, zones, weight breaks, origin/destination charges, and contractual terms.
Develop current-state versus proposed-state cost models and quantify realistic savings opportunities.
Identify pricing trends, anomalies, unfavorable contract provisions, cost drivers, and opportunities for improved transportation pricing or service alignment.
Help develop and maintain reusable nVision Global benchmarking methodologies, databases, tools, and market intelligence capabilities.

 

Small Parcel Pricing

 Analyze domestic and international parcel pricing structures, including zones, service levels, weight breaks, dimensional weight, minimum charges, fuel, residential and delivery-area surcharges, additional handling, oversize charges, international surcharges, and earned/tiered discounts.
Evaluate customer-specific parcel agreements and model alternative pricing structures, provider scenarios, service changes, and negotiation opportunities.
International Heavy Air & Ocean Pricing
Analyze international heavy air pricing including chargeable weight, actual versus dimensional weight, lane pricing, origin/destination charges, fuel/security charges, forwarder pricing, consolidation, and airport-to-airport versus door-to-door structures.
Analyze ocean pricing including FCL/LCL, container types, port pairs, origin/destination charges, drayage, fuel-related charges, detention/demurrage concepts, accessorials, and forwarder/NVOCC pricing structures.

 

Sourcing, Negotiation & Commercial Execution

Develop sourcing strategies, bid packages, pricing scenarios, negotiation targets, and evaluation models for transportation RFPs/RFQs.
Evaluate transportation provider bids and proposals, normalize responses, identify material differences, and determine whether proposed pricing is competitive and commercially sound.
Participate in and, when appropriate, lead transportation provider pricing and contract negotiations.
Translate benchmark findings into specific negotiation positions and defend those positions using data and financial analysis.
Measure negotiated results against baseline and modeled expectations to confirm realized savings and identify follow-up opportunities.




Customer & Sales Support

Translate complex transportation pricing and benchmarking analysis into clear business recommendations for customers and prospects.
Present and defend findings with customer executives, procurement teams, transportation professionals, finance teams, and other stakeholders.
Support nVision Global Sales and Supply Chain Services teams during discovery, solution development, customer presentations, RFPs, sourcing initiatives, and negotiations.
Clearly explain the methodology, assumptions, data, risks, and financial impact supporting each recommendation.
Help convert analytical findings into compelling, credible business cases that demonstrate measurable customer value.




Data Analysis & Reporting

Analyze customer and nVision Global data across orders, shipments, freight invoices, transportation rates, and related supply chain information.
Use advanced Excel, nSight, IMPACT AdHoc Reporting, BI tools, and other analytical technologies to develop models, dashboards, and management-ready reporting.
Maintain high standards for data accuracy, consistency, documentation, assumptions, and analytical methodology.
Work with Operations, Freight Audit & Payment, Supply Chain Services, Sales, IT, and Finance to ensure analyses reflect operational and financial realities.




Qualifications include

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, Finance, Economics, Industrial Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience will be considered.

Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in transportation pricing, rate analysis, benchmarking, procurement, sourcing, freight audit, transportation analytics, or related disciplines. Demonstrated capability is more important than years of experience.

Freight Audit & Invoice Analysis: Experience reviewing and interpreting freight invoices and understanding the relationship between contracted transportation rates, shipment characteristics, invoice charges, and actual transportation spend is strongly preferred. Candidates with freight audit experience should be able to recognize billing discrepancies, rate application issues, accessorial charges, and other cost drivers that may affect benchmarking, sourcing, and negotiation strategies.

Transportation Expertise: Demonstrated experience in Domestic and/or International Small Parcel, International Heavy Air, or International Ocean transportation. Experience across multiple priority modes is strongly preferred.

Analytical Capability: Demonstrated ability to interpret complex transportation rate agreements, analyze shipment-level data, normalize transportation costs, develop financial models, identify savings opportunities, and support recommendations with defensible data.

Customer-Facing / Commercial Capability: Ability to translate complex transportation pricing analysis into clear business recommendations and confidently present and defend findings. More experienced candidates must demonstrate customer-facing consultative experience and the ability to participate in or lead transportation provider pricing negotiations. Experience supporting Sales, customer presentations, sourcing events, and negotiations is strongly preferred.

Technology: Advanced Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, data manipulation, scenario modeling, and financial analysis. Experience with BI/reporting tools and large transportation datasets is strongly preferred.

Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain complex transportation pricing concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.




Candidate Profile

nVision Global is seeking an analytically strong transportation professional who is commercially capable, intellectually curious, and comfortable moving between detailed shipment-level data and executive-level recommendations. The successful candidate must be willing to challenge assumptions, support conclusions with data, and take ownership of recommendations rather than simply produce analysis.

A candidate earlier in their career may succeed in this position if they demonstrate strong transportation pricing knowledge, analytical ability, communication skills, and the potential to grow into customer-facing negotiation responsibilities. A more senior candidate will be expected to bring immediate customer-facing credibility, consultative presentation skills, and the ability to independently support or lead transportation provider negotiations.




Success will be measured by the ability to:

Produce accurate, defensible transportation pricing and benchmarking analyses that identify measurable opportunities.
Build increasingly robust nVision Global benchmarking intelligence and reusable analytical methodologies.
Translate analysis into practical sourcing, pricing, and negotiation strategies.
Present findings clearly and credibly to internal teams, customers, prospects, and transportation providers.
Support or lead negotiations that convert identified opportunities into measurable customer savings and improved commercial terms.
Develop broad multimodal expertise while maintaining deep capability in nVision Global’s priority transportation areas.

About the job

Sales Agent 




Are you ready to embark on a rewarding career as a Sales Agent? At Turkish Airlines, known for its exceptional hospitality, we are seeking bright and enthusiastic individuals to join our welcoming team. As a Sales Agent, you will play a crucial role in providing outstanding passenger services, creating memorable experiences, and ensuring seamless operations at our Sales Office. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy interacting with passengers, and are known for your go-getter attitude, this is the perfect opportunity for you. Join us and become a valued member of our team as we strive to deliver exceptional service and elevate the travel experience for our passengers!







Job Description:




With a warm and friendly demeanor, you will handle Reservation/Booking, Ticket Sales, Information, and Passenger Operations (Check-in, Manifest preparation) services.




Your responsibilities will include calculating fares, arranging routes based on passenger requests, providing schedule and fare information, and ensuring seamless coordination throughout the passenger journey. You'll handle reservation/booking requests with efficiency and issue tickets for both domestic and international flights. Additionally, you'll handle processes such as Endorsement, Rerouting, and the return of tickets.




To support effective management, you'll report and register operational income, cost, financing, and financial statistical information in relevant IT systems like SAP, ERP, and DOP.




Desired Skills & Experience:




Bachelor's degree or at least high school graduation.
Permanent residence permit in the respective country (the company does not provide or assist with work permits).
Minimum of 1 year experience in civil aviation or tourism.
The ability to thrive in high-pressure situations.
Excellent command of English and proficiency in local language(s).
Availability to work in shifts, including overnight shifts.
A team player who can also work independently when needed.
Ability to multitask effectively and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Good knowledge and experience with a major Computer Reservations System (Troya or Quickres experience is a plus).
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Demonstrated a sense of responsibility and the ability to make accurate and effective decisions.




Benefits:




Commuting Allowance
Pass / Ced Ticket Benefits




We strive to bring the far close by making the world move through our wings. We are working with all our strength to offer our guests a unique experience while connecting 340 destinations around the world. We would like to see you among us in our success story to which each member of our family contributes. Now it is time to grow our family with you to achieve greater goals.

description:
About the job

Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.




A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.




Key Responsibilities

Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.




The hourly earnings for this role are 9 USD per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.




TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

title: TypeScript Team Lead
skills: Quality monitoring: Spot-check TypeScript items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues.

Code review: Evaluate AI-generated TypeScript code, type definitions, debugging responses, implementation explanations, frontend/backend snippets, tests, and step-by-step reasoning for correctness, type safety, and clarity.
Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, quality expectations, and TypeScript-specific review standards.

Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around type safety, inference, generics, strict mode, async logic, browser vs Node.js environments, frameworks, testing, edge cases, and rubric interpretation.
Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed.
Documentation: Create and maintain TypeScript project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, calibration tasks, and onboarding materials.

Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and TypeScript-specific review requirements.
Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply TypeScript review guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve.

Risk and security review: Flag unsafe, misleading, insecure, or overconfident code recommendations, especially around type bypassing, unsafe casts, dependency usage, authentication, data handling, and production readiness.
Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for TypeScript AI training projects.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field; equivalent professional software engineering experience may be considered.
Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear technical feedback in English.

3+ years of professional experience in TypeScript development, JavaScript development, frontend engineering, backend development with Node.js, full-stack engineering, code review, software QA, technical mentoring, or related workflows.

Strong understanding of core TypeScript concepts such as static typing, interfaces, type aliases, generics, unions/intersections, narrowing, inference, mapped types, conditional types, utility types, strict mode, module systems, and type-safe API design.
Strong understanding of JavaScript runtime behavior, including promises, async/await, event loop, closures, scope, modules, error handling, and modern ECMAScript features.

Ability to evaluate TypeScript content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as incorrect logic, non-executable code, type errors, unsafe any usage, flawed reasoning, missing edge cases, poor async handling, security risks, hallucinated APIs, or incomplete explanations.

Familiarity with common TypeScript ecosystems and tools such as Node.js, React, Next.js, Express/NestJS, npm/yarn/pnpm, Jest, Vitest, Playwright, ESLint, Prettier, Vite, Webpack, tsconfig, or GitHub workflows is preferred.
Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, engineers, technical writers, coding mentors, or QAs is strongly preferred.
Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, GitHub, and project management systems.
Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, calibration tasks, and other quality documentation.
Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, code content QA, or rubric-based LLM evaluation is a strong plus.
description:

In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a TypeScript Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across TypeScript AI training projects. You will review AI-generated TypeScript code and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards.

You will assess work for code correctness, type safety, reasoning quality, runtime behavior, debugging accuracy, readability, maintainability, performance, security awareness, test coverage, formatting, instruction-following, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong TypeScript expertise, strong English communication skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote technical teams.

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. skills: Collaborate with business stakeholders to analyze finance and controlling requirements across cost center profit center and accounts receivables processes translating them into clear and feasible S4 HANA solution designs that align with client objectives and organizational standards.

Configure S4 HANA Vertexcomponents including cost center accounting and profit center accounting to support accurate planning allocation and reporting that enables timely insight driven financial decision making for the client.

Design and implement S4 HANA Vettex functionalities that streamline invoice processing credit management and payment tracking so that overall cash flow visibility and collection performance are improved.

Optimize end to end apply cash to invoices processes by configuring lockbox payment advice handling and matching logic while ensuring that exception handling and reconciliations are controlled and transparent for finance teams.

Configure and support S4 HANA FI SD integration scenarios ensuring that revenue recognition billing and financial postings are consistent reconciled and compliant with internal policies and external reporting requirements.
Implement and enhance SAP Refx functionality to manage real estate contracts conditions postings and valuations in a way that integrates seamlessly with controlling and general ledger processes.

Utilize Cognizant Gen AI tools to design and deploy intelligent automations predictive insights and guided workflows that reduce manual effort in receivables cash application and customer master maintenance activities.

Develop functional specifications for extensions reports interfaces conversions and forms collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure that delivered solutions meet performance security and usability expectations.

Execute unit testing integration testing and user acceptance support for finance and controlling scenarios documenting results thoroughly and driving timely resolution of defects that impact business operations.

Provide hybrid model consulting support through workshops remote sessions and on site interactions when required ensuring that user queries related to day shift operations are resolved within agreed timelines and quality standards.

Guide user teams through knowledge transfer training materials and day to day issue resolution so that process owners can operate S4 HANA and SAP Refx solutions with confidence and minimal disruption.

Monitor production issues across controlling and receivables areas perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable fixes that enhance stability data accuracy and system performance without requiring travel.

Prepare detailed process documentation configuration workbooks and operational guidelines that capture design decisions standard procedures and controls supporting regulatory compliance and audit readiness.

Partner with cross functional teams spanning finance sales and operations to evaluate change requests estimate effort and recommend pragmatic enhancements that maximize value from existing S4 HANA investments.

Ensure that hybrid work practices support effective collaboration by using digital tools structured communication and clear status reporting to keep stakeholders informed and engaged.

Demonstrate solid experience of six to ten years in S4 HANA finance and controlling with specific exposure to cost center accounting profit center accounting and accounts receivables in complex enterprise environments.
Exhibit proven expertise in configuring and supporting S4 HANA FI SD integration so that end to end order to cash processes and associated financial postings remain consistent and well controlled.
Show practical proficiency in SAP Refx including contract management condition handling and integration to finance to support real estate or leasing intensive business models.
Apply hands on knowledge of applying cash to invoices processes including payment allocation residual management and dispute handling to improve working capital and reduce unapplied cash.
Demonstrate experience in updating customer master data with strong attention to data quality governance rules and alignment with compliance standards such as credit checks and dunning settings.
Utilize Cognizant Gen AI tools or similar enterprise grade AI platforms to build or support use cases that automate repetitive finance tasks and generate actionable insights for decision makers.
Communicate clearly with business and technical audiences documenting requirements designs and test results in concise language suitable for stakeholders in a global hybrid working environment.

About the job

The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. The Role

AspenTech is a market leader, providing software that optimizes process manufacturing – including oil and gas, petroleum, chemicals, pharmaceuticals and other industries that manufacture and produce products from a chemical process. The High Velocity Sales Account Manager will develop an understanding of AspenTech’s value to customers to overachieve sales targets in an assigned, quota-carrying territory. This person will work as a member of a sales team which includes business consulting, customer support and sales operations.

The High Velocity Sales Account Manager role is directly responsible for generating revenue by selling AspenTech’s products using proven sales methodologies taught in an onboarding program. The High Velocity Sales Account Manager role is an opportunity to join an industry-leading team while building a strong foundation of skills centered on our customer’s business goals, needs and value.

Renew and grow

description:
About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we’re a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We’re hiring a Marketing Production Support Lead to serve as the operational anchor of the CRM and Promotional Operations team at a high-growth consumer technology company — functioning similarly to a Site Reliability Engineer for marketing: owning live campaign monitoring, on-call triage, incident command, and root-cause analysis for post-launch errors, while also managing a team of 4+ QA specialists and enforcing the operational standards that keep high-visibility, budget-critical campaigns from going wrong. Your time will be split approximately 50% team leadership and escalation management, and 50% hands-on advanced technical QA — this is not a traditional pre-launch QA role. It requires someone who is highly autonomous, technically rigorous, comfortable holding a distributed team accountable, and decisive under pressure when production issues arise.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Team Leadership & Accountability: Manage daily operations and serve as the primary escalation point for a team of 4+ QA specialists — leading daily stand-ups to assess workloads, reallocate tickets, and manage expedited requests; enforcing strict SLAs, task accountability, and end-of-shift status reporting; and taking decisive management action when expectations are missed.
Production Support & Incident Management: Monitor live production campaigns and act as incident commander for on-call triage and rapid resolution; conduct root-cause analyses on post-launch errors and communicate findings and remediation plans to cross-functional partners and leadership; and serve as the final gatekeeper for urgent, high-visibility, or C-suite-directed campaign requests to mitigate financial risk.
Technical Operations & Advanced QA: Audit, update, and schedule complex digital campaigns across email, push notifications, in-app messaging, and promo code engines; use SQL to verify target audience sizes against promotional logic and validate that large-scale marketing budgets align with business guardrails; and deep-dive into campaign assets to validate HTML/CSS, copy accuracy, and advanced dynamic targeting strategies.
Process Optimization & AI Enablement: Maintain and optimize QA checklists to incorporate new product features and marketing surfaces; analyze error trends to build targeted training documentation; leverage AI and automation tools to accelerate triage and live-campaign monitoring; and champion AI adoption across the team by coaching team members on integrating these tools into daily workflows.




What You Bring

CRM & Production Support Experience: 3+ years in technical operations, production support, or advanced QA within CRM ecosystems — with 3+ years of hands-on technical experience inside enterprise-level ESP/CRM platforms; Braze experience is highly preferred.
People Management: 2+ years of formal or informal people management experience with a proven track record of enforcing accountability, managing performance, and building trust with a distributed team.
Technical Proficiency: Intermediate to advanced SQL proficiency required for audience validation; working knowledge of HTML/CSS for campaign asset validation; strong Google Sheets and/or Excel skills for operational workflows.
Financial & Promotional Guardrail Experience: Direct experience auditing promotional budgets or managing campaigns with high monetary impact — with the judgment and decisiveness to act as the final gatekeeper under time pressure.
Communication & Leadership Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable delivering clear status updates to executive leadership and holding firm on quality standards with execution teams simultaneously.




Bonus Points if:

You have prior experience in the tech sector, high-growth startups, or supporting app-centric digital products.
You have familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies and ticketing systems such as Jira or Asana.




Sign-on Bonus: $500 bonus upon successful completion of the first 90 days of employment




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren’t just joining a company; you’re joining a movement to redefine how the world’s best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You’ve applied, now let’s get to work. Here’s the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.
Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we’ll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick.
Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You’ll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you.
Step 4 Match Interview: You’ll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we’re matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine — it’s the final step for many of our roles!




Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps:

Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We’ve got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you’re 100% ready.
Step 6 Client Interview: You’ll meet the client to discuss how you’ll help them scale and succeed. Bring your metrics and be on your A-game — this is your last chance to make a great first impression!




Join our 100% remote global team today, and grow with GrowthAssistant!




GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Descripción del puesto: La posición requiere una persona con capacidad analítica para investigar, recopilar y analizar información económica, así como dar seguimiento a acontecimientos políticos, regulatorios y geopolíticos con impacto en sectores estratégicos. Será responsable de identificar tendencias y riesgos, analizar datos y fuentes abiertas (OSINT), y elaborar reportes y productos de inteligencia para la toma de decisiones estratégicas. Se requiere excelente capacidad de síntesis, redacción, verificación de fuentes y análisis de información, así como atención al detalle y, deseablemente, experiencia en investigación y manejo de herramientas de análisis de datos.




Funciones principales:

Apoyar en las investigaciones multidisciplinarias atendidas por la Dirección de Inteligencia Estratégica.
Participar en la elaboración de productos de inteligencia, mediante la recopilación, análisis, integración y verificación de información.
Realizar análisis económico de indicadores, mercados, sectores productivos, comercio, inversión, finanzas públicas y tendencias nacionales e internacionales.
Monitorear información política, económica y geopolítica relevante para las investigaciones en curso.
Recopilar, depurar, contrastar y analizar información proveniente de fuentes oficiales, bases de datos especializadas y fuentes abiertas (OSINT).
Identificar tendencias, riesgos, patrones y relaciones entre variables económicas, políticas y sectoriales.
Elaborar reportes coyunturales, notas ejecutivas, fichas de análisis, matrices de riesgo y otros productos de inteligencia.
Mantener actualizadas bases de datos, indicadores y series de información económica utilizadas en las investigaciones.
Verificar la calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de los datos y fuentes empleados en los productos de inteligencia.
Procesar, organizar y analizar grandes volúmenes de información con criterios de rigor, confiabilidad y trazabilidad.




Perfil requerido:

Preferentemente recién egresado de Licenciatura en Economía, pero se atenderán también solicitudes de carrerar como Relaciones Internacionales, Ciencia Política, Finanzas, Administración Pública o áreas afines.
Experiencia: 1 a 2 años de experiencia en análisis económico, investigación, consultoría, inteligencia, análisis de riesgos, asuntos públicos o áreas relacionadas (se tomará en cuenta experiencia desarrollada en pasantías, prácticas profesionales o similares).
Herramientas: Manejo intermedio de Excel; deseable conocimiento de herramientas de análisis y visualización de datos.
Fuentes de información: Manejo de bases de datos económicas y fuentes oficiales nacionales e internacionales.
Competencias: Pensamiento analítico, capacidad de investigación, síntesis de información, atención al detalle y organización.
Redacción: Excelente redacción y ortografía, con capacidad para elaborar documentos ejecutivos y técnicos.
Disponibilidad para trabajo presencial y atención de proyectos con plazos establecidos.

Las personas interesadas deberán enviar su CV en español, así como una carta motivos de máximo dos cuartillas a: 

contacto@vantaraig.com




Con copia a:

ms@vantaraig.com
rz@vantaraig.com




Indicar en el asunto del correo: “Vacante Analista Junior de Economía y Política – Nombre y Apellido”

LionHead Digital is a fast-growing digital marketing agency helping law firms across the United States dominate their markets through advanced SEO, paid ads, and AI-powered strategies.




We're looking for a Marketing Manager who will lead our Paid Media team while taking full ownership of our Google Ads and PPC campaigns—with one clear mission: drive consistent, qualified leads for our clients at controlled costs that produce real, measurable results.




This role is more than managing budgets and clicking buttons. You'll lead the Paid Media team, coach and develop team members, improve processes, and serve as the performance engine behind our clients' paid media success—building smart campaign structures, optimizing relentlessly, and owning every metric from CPL to conversion tracking accuracy. You'll work closely with Client Success, SEO, and Web teams and report directly into fulfillment leadership.




What You'll Do

Own PPC Strategy & Campaign Setup: Take full ownership of paid media once a client is fulfillment-ready—reviewing goals, budgets, and market conditions to build campaign structures aligned with services, locations, and search intent.
Team Leadership & Management: Lead, mentor, and support the Paid Media team to ensure campaigns are executed efficiently and achieve performance goals. Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, provide coaching and feedback, prioritize workloads, remove roadblocks, and foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and high performance.
Account & Asset Validation: Validate access to Google Ads, GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, and landing pages before launch—flagging gaps and coordinating fixes with Development, SEO, or Operations before a single dollar is spent.
Campaign Launch & Optimization: Launch campaigns on approved timelines, monitor performance daily during early phases, and continuously optimize keywords, match types, ad copy, bids, budgets, and negative keyword lists to hit CPL and lead quality targets.

Cross-Team Coordination: Collaborate with Client Success Managers for client context, SEO and Content for keyword alignment, Web and Development for landing page improvements, and Operations for capacity planning and prioritization while ensuring clear communication across teams.
Internal PPC Campaigns: Plan, launch, and optimize LionHead Digital's own Google Ads campaigns for lead generation, recruiting, and brand initiatives—applying the same quality standards used for client campaigns.
Process Adherence & Improvement: Follow and improve documented PPC SOPs, maintain clean account structures and naming conventions, and propose enhancements to campaign frameworks, QA checklists, reporting templates, automation rules, and team workflows.




What Success Looks Like (KPIs)

CPL consistently at or below target across all active accounts.
Lead volume delivered reliably month over month.
Zero broken conversion tracking across client accounts.
Campaigns launched on time with no setup delays.
Reduction in wasted spend through disciplined negative keyword management.
Strong client satisfaction scores related to paid media performance.
Internal PPC campaigns hitting CPL and conversion benchmarks.
Paid Media team consistently meeting quality, productivity, and delivery expectations.




What We're Looking For

3+ years of hands-on Google Ads / PPC management experience (agency experience strongly preferred).
2+ years of experience leading or managing a Marketing, Paid Media, PPC, or Digital Marketing team.
Proven track record managing multiple accounts with measurable, documented results
Deep expertise in campaign structure, bidding strategies, keyword match types, and Quality Score optimization.
Strong command of conversion tracking, GA4, GTM, call tracking, and CRM attribution
Experience managing budgets responsibly and optimizing for spend efficiency.
Ability to analyze performance data, spot trends, and translate insights into clear action plans.
Strong leadership, coaching, communication, and documentation skills—you keep projects, people, and processes organized and accountable.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with SEO, Web, Content, Client Success, and Operations teams.
Up to date on Google Ads platform changes, AI tools, policy updates, and PPC best practices.




Compensation & Perks

Competitive pay range: $40,000 to $52,000 annually, based on experience, with performance-based bonuses tied to CPL targets, lead volume, team performance, and client retention.
Direct reporting line to the Director of Client Services and participation in the agency's leadership team.
Paid time off and holidays for a healthy work-life balance.
Employee of the Month recognition.
Access to premium training, certifications, and industry conferences.
Work-from-home flexibility.
A collaborative, high-performance team that values results, efficiency, leadership, and continuous growth.




Ideal Candidate Profile

Experience & Skills

3+ years managing Google Ads campaigns, preferably in a marketing agency serving multiple clients simultaneously.
2+ years leading, mentoring, or managing a Paid Media, PPC, or Digital Marketing team.
Deep hands-on expertise in Google Ads campaign structure, bidding strategies, match types, ad copy, and Quality Score optimization.
Strong working knowledge of GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, call tracking, and CRM attribution.
Proven ability to manage multiple accounts, hit CPL targets, and scale campaigns profitably
Demonstrated ability to coach team members, improve processes, and drive accountability across a marketing team.
Exceptional attention to detail. You catch tracking gaps, budget pacing issues, and underperforming ad groups before they become problems.
Comfortable working cross-functionally and communicating performance data clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.




Why Join LionHead Digital?




We’re building the most advanced law firm marketing system in the country. At LionHead Digital, you’ll own the fulfillment engine that drives client success and long-term growth. If you’re ready to lead teams, build scalable processes, and make client retention your mission, this role is for you.

About the job

Influencer & Creator Partnerships Coordinator

LumiMeds | Remote | Contract

About the Role

LumiMeds is hiring a hands-on Influencer and Creator Partnerships Coordinator to own the end-to-end execution of our creator program. This is a fully remote contract role that sits at the intersection of relationship management, content operations, and quality control, supporting a growing influencer, UGC, and provider content strategy.




You will manage our full creator roster across influencer, UGC, and licensed provider talent, handling all outreach, negotiation, contracts, and whitelisted creator marketplace management from start to finish.

What You'll Own

All influencer, UGC creator, and provider content creator outreach, from prospecting through first contact
Rate negotiation and deliverable scoping with creators at every tier
Contract coordination, including tracking signatures, deadlines, and compliance with agreed terms
Onboarding and managing creators within our whitelisted creator marketplace
Day-to-day creator communications and relationship maintenance
Quality review of content submissions before they go to approval, flagging anything that does not meet brand or compliance standards
Campaign logistics, coordinating posting schedules, asset collection, and deadline tracking across multiple active creators

What This Role Does Not Own

Creative strategy and scripting (led by our Social Media Manager)
Final content approval (reviewed and approved by Social Media Manager)
Outreach copy approval (submitted for sign-off before sending)
Brand and campaign strategy (set at the leadership level)

This is a role for someone who thrives in execution and takes pride in running an airtight process, not someone looking to own creative direction from day one.

What We're Looking For

2+ years in influencer marketing, talent management, creator partnerships, or a similar role
Comfortable owning outreach and negotiation independently once aligned on parameters
Experience with influencer platforms or whitelisted creator marketplaces (e.g., TikTok Creator Marketplace, Aspire, Grin, Modash, or similar)
Strong communicator with a professional and warm outreach style
Highly organized, able to manage multiple creators and campaigns simultaneously without close supervision
Familiarity with contract basics and deliverable tracking
Understanding of FTC disclosure requirements and platform content policies
Self-directed and reliable working fully remotely as a contractor

Experience in health, wellness, or a regulated industry
Background working with UGC creators or licensed professional talent (MDs, NPs, PAs)
Comfort with basic quality review for branded content

A creative team for visual direction and brand standards

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital.

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

The Junior Creative Strategist role supports business growth by developing foundational creative strategies and translating client objectives into clear, performance-oriented creative solutions. This role builds core capabilities at the intersection of creative thinking and performance marketing, contributing to campaign effectiveness through data-informed creative development.

You are a curious, growth-oriented collaborator who brings energy to brainstorms, asks thoughtful questions, and builds on the thinking of those around you. Your work helps Thrive deliver creative solutions that perform, and your development within this role sets the foundation for deeper strategic ownership as your expertise grows.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: support the development and execution of creative strategies by applying foundational knowledge of performance data, market research, and creative concepts to produce effective solutions.
Client: contribute to client relationships by preparing materials, supporting strategic conversations, and delivering clear, well-researched outputs that reflect client goals.
People: build collaborative relationships through active participation, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth. 
Company: contribute to organizational development by staying informed on industry trends and supporting initiatives that advance Thrive Digital's creative and performance capabilities. 


We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll you’ll learn the company’s mission and values, complete your technical onboarding bootcamp, and onboard to your first account.
In your first 60 days you’ll be contributing to creative briefs, testing plans, and client-facing materials for your assigned accounts, applying feedback from senior strategists as you go.
In your first 90 days you’ll be an active contributor to creative strategy for your accounts - bringing your own research and ideas to briefs, creative recommendations, and client conversations. 


Qualifications


You've worked on paid or performance marketing campaigns (paid social, search, or programmatic) and understand how creative choices affect metrics like CTR, CPA, or ROAS. 
You've translated a creative brief or client goal into a strategic recommendation or creative concept - whether at an agency, in-house, or on your own projects.
You've used research (competitive, market, or audience) or channel performance data to shape or defend a creative decision.
You've prepared client- or stakeholder-facing materials (decks, one-pagers, recaps) that turn data or insight into a clear, compelling story.
You collaborate naturally across disciplines - you've worked with creative, media, or analytics partners to move an idea from concept to execution.
You stay current on industry and creative trends, and look for ways to apply what you learn to your work.



Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About the job

Hey there — yeah, you!




HomeHop is a fast-growing short-term rental management company (think Airbnb & VRBO), and we're on the hunt for a friendly, quick-thinking individual to be the voice our guests hear when they reach out. We started with a handful of properties and now manage 140+ short-term rentals across the Midwest USA… and we're still just getting started!




If you love solving problems, thrive when things move fast, and get a little thrill from checking things off a list — keep reading.




What you'll actually be doing

You'll be our guest's go-to person. Someone messages asking where to park, how the hot tub works, or whether they can check in early? You've got them — warm, fast, and helpful every time. Guest messaging is a big part of this role… but it's not the whole role.




Because we're a startup, no two shifts look the same. One minute you're smoothing over a booking question, the next you're helping the team knock out a random task that keeps the whole machine running. We wear a lot of hats around here, and we're looking for someone who's happy to grab one and jump in.




A taste of the day-to-day:

Chatting with guests across Airbnb, VRBO, and our direct booking channels — keeping it prompt, professional, and genuinely friendly
Handling reservations, questions, and the occasional "help, I locked myself out" moment
Coordinating with cleaning and maintenance crews to keep stays running smoothly
Jumping in on all kinds of team tasks and projects as we grow — flexibility is the name of the game
Keeping notes and records tidy so nothing slips through the cracks
Using critical thinking when problems with guests arise

Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
You'll need to work on American holidays (guests travel most when everyone else is off)
5 days of PTO to start




You'll fit right in if you…

Write like a real, warm human — clear, kind, and typo-free
Stay cool under pressure and can juggle a few things at once
Are tech-savvy and comfortable bouncing between apps and platforms
Have experience with short-term rentals or Airbnb (a big plus!)

Actually like helping people




Why HomeHop?

We're a small, scrappy, supportive team that believes work should be fun — not a corporate snooze-fest. We move fast, we back each other up, we celebrate wins, and there's real room to grow as we do!




Ready to hop in?

Hit apply and tell us a little about yourself. We can't wait to meet you!!
