description:
About the job

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Data Science Lead, LATAM

We're looking for a Data Science Lead to own data science across our two LATAM markets, Mexico and Brazil. Both are fast-growing businesses operating with the speed and autonomy of a startup, backed by the scale and stability of an established group.

We're open to this role being a Lead, Manager or Senior Manager - the mechanics of the role won't change.

It's a hands-on leadership role. You'll lead a small team of data scientists across both markets while remaining an active contributor yourself - building models, shaping technical direction, and setting the standard for how the work gets done.

The two markets sit at different stages of maturity, and the role spans both. In one, you'll be establishing foundations — infrastructure, modelling standards, and a roadmap to bring capability up to the level of our other markets. In the other, you'll be supporting a more mature practice as it advances model architecture and builds a more integrated approach to credit decisioning and portfolio valuation.

How You'll Make An Impact


Own the data science strategy and roadmap for Mexico and Brazil — what we build, in what order, and to what standard.
Remain hands-on, building and shipping models alongside the team.
Establish modelling standards, infrastructure, and delivery practices where they don't yet exist, and raise the bar where they do.
Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data scientists across two markets and a wide range of experience levels.
Partner with credit leadership as a peer — understanding business objectives and translating them into modelling, impact measurement, valuation input, and P&L analysis.
Bring structure and discipline to how the work runs: clear priorities, visible progress, and reliable delivery.
Contribute to methodologies that can be adopted across the wider Tilt data science organisation.


Why You're a Great Fit


You've led a team of Data Scientists before, ideally across different regions.
You're still a builder. You've stayed close to the modelling work and want to keep it that way.
Strong applied machine learning and modelling craft, with a clear view of what good looks like and the ability to raise a team to meet it.
Sufficient understanding of credit and underwriting to contribute meaningfully to credit conversations. Direct experience in lending, credit, or payments is a strong advantage.
Comfortable with ambiguity and pace, with a track record in high-growth or small-company environments.
A strong bias toward delivery, and the judgement to know when to stop exploring and start shipping.
You connect data science to measurable business outcomes and communicate technical ideas clearly to non-technical stakeholders.


Location & Language

Based in Brazil, Mexico, or the US. Fluent English required. Portuguese is an advantage; Spanish is welcome.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get At Tilt


Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

About the job

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.






About the Role:


As a Corporate Program Manager, Founder Initiatives, at JumpCloud, you'll work hand in hand with our CEO, Co-founders and Executive Team to align, action, guide and measure key initiatives across the organization. 




Similar to a Chief of Staff role, your work as a Corporate Program Manager will have a clear impact on the success and growth of JumpCloud, as we continue our trajectory towards iconic technology brand status. You will engage directly with board members, and internal stakeholders and act as a representative of our CEO in your communications and actions. 







What you will be doing:






Manage specific programs within our corporate objectives, managing key metric reporting & insights, and others that span cross functionally and require CEO level visibility.








Manage the company roll up, down and reporting of key objectives - driving alignment and transparency.








Drive our corporate communication cadence of weekly, monthly, quarterly, half and annual highlights. This includes curating content, creating drafts and ensuring consistency of our disciplined communication cadence.








Program lead our monthly extended leadership team Ops Review - setting the agenda, ensuring materials are created on time, and managing follow up items from the review meeting.








Help set up and manage a regular cadence for the CEO to have customer and partner calls, capturing and following up on action items from these meetings.








Facilitate an ongoing CEO outreach to employees through virtual coffee, round table sessions and skip level 1:1s, prompting key topics for discussion, capturing employee sentiments and following up on action items or opportunities identified.








Drive the cross functional preparation for our Board meetings, managing the agenda and materials.












What we are looking for:






Exceptional operational, organizational and communication skills.








Executive level presentation creation and delivery skills








Demonstrated expertise executing on clear and diligent follow-up and communication at the most senior levels, both internally and externally 








A track record of successfully coordinating multiple cross-departmental efforts that achieved meaningful business outcomes across all levels of the organization 








The ability to manage scope, risk, and uncertainty.








Demonstrated ability to streamline operational processes for consistency and efficiency.








Proactive approach to spotting potential issues and solving problems.








Someone who thrives in the pace and culture of a fast moving and rapidly growing SaaS business.















Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role. 




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. 




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO




 




Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. 




 




JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.




 




Scam Notice:




Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.




 




All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"




 




 #BI-Remote




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

Experience taking ownership of workflows, processes, systems, or operational projects and making them clearer or more reliable.
Strong structured thinking: you can break a messy problem into users, inputs, outputs, statuses, handoffs, risks, and decisions.
Practical AI use in real work, improving workflow efficiency and measuring success with KPIs.
Reliable ownership of defined projects, including asking clarifying questions, communicating progress, and escalating early when something is blocked.
Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
Confidence with spreadsheets, structured data, project tools, and documentation tools.

High attention to detail and a habit of checking work before it reaches other people.
Comfortable explaining systems, process changes, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability and curiosity about new tools, especially where they make delivery cleaner or faster.
Experience with creative, content, social, campaign, approval, or asset workflows.

description:
About the job

💸 Up to USD 28,000 salary on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Working with the latest hardware, tech stack and tools

🏋️ Access to benefits (country dependent 🌎 )




Who We Are 




At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.




Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.




Embracing Future-Facing Technology 




Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!




RESPONSIBILITIES 




Storm Ideas partners with some of the world's most recognisable media and entertainment brands. Behind that work are planning processes, approvals, asset handoffs, reporting needs, stakeholder reviews, and internal systems that need to run cleanly.




As a Creative Operations Officer, you will help teams turn messy creative and operational processes into clear workflows, systems, documentation, and handoffs. This is not a generic coordinator role. The focus is reliable delivery: understanding how work really moves, structuring it clearly, building practical Airtable and lightweight workflow solutions, and helping people use them.




You do not need to come from a social media background. You do need to be comfortable learning new domains quickly, asking good questions, and using tools and AI to make your work clearer, faster, and easier to hand over.




What can you expect? 

Organize and manage your own work across briefs, tasks, priorities, and follow-ups, without needing every next step spelled out.
Deliver work cleanly, independently, and on time, with clear status updates.
Map messy processes, identify bottlenecks, and turn ambiguous briefs into clear next steps.
Use AI responsibly to speed up workflow mapping, documentation, QA, data cleanup, and automation support, while checking outputs carefully.
Clean up creative approval workflows so teams know what is planned, what is waiting for review, what is approved, and who owns the next action.
Structure work into sensible fields, statuses, ownership, handoffs, review points, and definitions of done.
Build Airtable bases, views, and interfaces for client teams, with supporting documentation that makes the workflow easy to use.
Improve lightweight systems in tools such as Airtable, spreadsheets, project management platforms, documentation tools, Slack or Teams workflows, and automation platforms.
Create clear documentation, SOPs, interface notes, handover materials, and client-ready explanations.
QA your own work before handoff, checking data, logic, copy, statuses, permissions, assumptions, and user experience.
Present process improvements in clear, non-technical language to internal teams and client stakeholders.
Collaborate with creative, social, client service, analytics, and technical colleagues to ship practical improvements.
Support workflows after launch by gathering feedback, fixing friction points, and improving adoption.




QUALIFICATIONS 




What's important to us: 

Experience taking ownership of workflows, processes, systems, or operational projects and making them clearer or more reliable.
Strong structured thinking: you can break a messy problem into users, inputs, outputs, statuses, handoffs, risks, and decisions.
Practical AI use in real work, improving workflow efficiency and measuring success with KPIs.
Reliable ownership of defined projects, including asking clarifying questions, communicating progress, and escalating early when something is blocked.
Excellent written communication and documentation skills.
Confidence with spreadsheets, structured data, project tools, and documentation tools.
Strong no/low-code and systems aptitude. Airtable experience is highly useful, and this role will suit someone who enjoys turning a rough workflow into a clean working process.
High attention to detail and a habit of checking work before it reaches other people.
Comfortable explaining systems, process changes, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
Adaptability and curiosity about new tools, especially where they make delivery cleaner or faster.




What’s nice to have: 

Experience with creative, content, social, campaign, approval, or asset workflows.
Experience building Airtable bases, interfaces, automations, or similar lightweight project management workflows.
Familiarity with tools such as Asana, Monday.com, Jira, Zapier, ChatGPT/Codex, Claude/Cowork, Slack, Teams, etc.
Basic familiarity with JavaScript, HTML, APIs, or scripting concepts.
Experience with change management- helping teams adopt a new process or tool without creating unnecessary complexity.




What It’s Like to Work Here




Cutting-Edge Tools & Tech

Work with the latest hardware and software so you're always set up to succeed.




Ideas Welcome, Always

We don’t just say we’re open to ideas—we act on them. Your insights can shape how we work across the company.




Fast, Agile, Adaptive

We move like a start-up but with the backing of a larger team. Quick decisions and a responsive culture are the norm.




Incredible Team, Global Reach

Join an international crew of 175+ passionate, talented people. We hire for skill, drive, and authenticity—just be yourself.




APPLICATION




Please include a cover letter with your application. It does not need to be long, but it should give us clear evidence of how you work.




In your cover letter, please briefly cover:




one example of a messy workflow, process, or system you helped make clearer, including what changed and what improved;
your experience with Airtable or similar lightweight project/workflow tools, including what you have built or improved;
one practical example of how you use AI in your work, including how you check or apply the output.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS




First, we will review your CV and cover letter for the requested examples.




If successful, you will receive a task using a provided Airtable base. We will ask you to show how you structure the workflow, build useful views or interfaces, document your decisions, and explain your approach.




If successful, you will be invited to a 60-minute interview. During the meeting, you will walk through your completed task as if presenting to a client, followed by a Q&A with Creative Operations management.




And that’s it!

About the job

Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs - in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. We invite you to join us if you want to be part of a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career and support you to do some of the best work of your life alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do

We're looking for a AI Content Specialist to help shape how Clara shows up across our organic channels and bring our brand to life through relevant, thoughtful, and engaging content.

This is a hands-on role for someone who genuinely loves creating content. You know how to write a strong article, turn an idea into a LinkedIn post, adapt to an executive's tone of voice, script a video, and work with designers to bring a concept to life. You're equally comfortable thinking about the bigger story and obsessing over the small details that make the final piece great.

We think about this role as AI-native. AI isn't a shortcut bolted onto content work, it's part of how the work gets designed and produced in the first place.

You'll work across Clara's main content channels—including our corporate and leadership LinkedIn profiles, blog, website, and video—with occasional support for other social platforms and paid initiatives.

We're looking for someone who is chronically online in the best possible way: curious about what's happening on the internet, attentive to how brands and creators communicate, and constantly spotting formats, conversations, and trends that Clara can participate in without forcing it.

Most importantly, we want someone who takes ownership. You can start with a blank page, develop an idea, write the copy, brief and collaborate with design, gather feedback and approvals, and make sure the final piece actually gets published—and published well.


Create high-quality content across Clara's organic channels, including LinkedIn, blog articles, website content, video scripts, executive communications, and other social media formats using Google Drive for seamless document collaboration. 
Treat AI as core infrastructure for how content gets made, not just a drafting shortcut. Go beyond prompting — build and maintain real automations that connect tools using N8N or custom GPTs to take repetitive work off your plate. 
Write and execute content for Clara's leadership team, adapting to established voices and ensuring each piece feels authentic to the person publishing it. 
Own content projects end-to-end: develop concepts, write copy, coordinate with designers, manage feedback and approvals, and schedule or publish final pieces. 
Identify opportunities for video and spontaneous content around our offices, people, customers, and events, capturing raw content and collaborating with designers on final output. 
Stay close to internet culture and trends relevant to our audience, translating them into meaningful B2B fintech communications. 
Maintain a consistently high editorial bar across all channels, paying strict attention to language, tone, formatting, visual execution, and audio/video quality. 
Collaborate cross-functionally with Events, Design, PR, Growth, and Product Marketing teams using Slack to align priorities and turn company milestones into compelling stories. 


Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves


Native/fluent Spanish and working proficiency in English. 
3+ years of experience in content, social media, editorial, copywriting, or a related creative role, ideally at a startup, fintech, content/social team, or creative agency. 
Strong writing skills with the ability to adapt clear, creative, and persuasive copy across different formats, audiences, and leadership voices. 
Builder mentality with hands-on experience using AI tools to create workflows, automate tasks, and refine content output with strong critical judgment. 
A strong portfolio demonstrating range across social content, articles, campaigns, scripts, or end-to-end executed projects. 
High digital fluency with strong instincts for B2B communication, internet culture, and social media dynamics. 
Proven project ownership with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a hands-on approach to content creation. 
Adaptability to fast-changing environments and a commitment to high-quality execution. 


Nice to haves


Basic proficiency in Portuguese or a desire to learn it. 
Hands-on experience building AI-powered or automated content production workflows using N8N or similar platforms. 
Experience creating content for B2B, SaaS, technology, financial services, or managing executive/leadership communications. 
Independent analytical skills using spreadsheets, SQL, or Python to track content performance and metrics. 
Basic visual editing skills (e.g., Canva, CapCut) for quick adjustments and video concepting. 
A good sense of humor. 


Why join Clara

At Clara, you'll have the autonomy, speed, and support to make meaningful impact — not just on your team, but on how organizations are run across Latin America.

Who we are


We're the leading B2B fintech for spend management in Latin America. 
Certified as one of the world's fastest-growing companies, a Great Place to Work, and a LinkedIn Top Startup. 
Passionate about making Latin America more prosperous and competitive. 
Constantly innovating to build financial infrastructure that enables each of our customers to thrive. 
Product-led, high-talent-density culture — designed for builders who raise the bar. 
Proud of our open, inclusive, and values-driven environment. 


What we believe in


#Clarity. We say things clearly, directly, and proactively. 
#Simplicity. We reduce noise to focus on what really matters. 
#Ownership. We take responsibility and never wait to be told. 
#Pride. We build products and experiences we're proud of. 
#Always Be Changing (ABC). We grow through feedback, risk-taking, and action. 
#Inclusivity. Every voice counts. Everyone contributes to our mission. 


What we offer


Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one 
Multicultural team with daily exposure to Portuguese, Spanish, and English (our corporate language) 
Annual learning budget and internal accelerated development paths 
High-ownership environment: we move fast, learn fast, and raise the bar — together 
Smart, ambitious teammates — low ego, high impact 
Flexible vacation and hybrid work model focused on results 


If you're ready for growth, ownership, and impact — apply now and help us redefine B2B finance in Latin America.

Clara's Hybrid Policy

Claridians in a hybrid mode split their time between working from the office, talking to or visiting customers, or working from home. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for each individual and team.

We don't enforce a minimum number of days for most roles, but you're expected to spend time at the office organically, and be at the office most days during your ramp-up or when required by your leader.

About the job

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY




Our client is a family-owned US food manufacturer. They are now building their own commercial team in Mexico. These are the first field sales positions in the country: two in Mexico City, one in

Monterrey.




THE ROLE




You will own your territory end to end — the accounts, the distributors

and the number.




· Open and grow accounts with restaurant chains, independent operators,

 pizzerias and Italian concepts in your plaza

· Build and manage the distributor network that carries the product,

 including forecast and sell-through by distributor

· Run product demonstrations and side-by-side cook-offs directly with

 chefs, kitchen managers and owners — this is where the sale is won

· Carry and deliver a revenue growth target for your territory

· Report directly into the US organization, working day to day in English




REQUIREMENTS




· Minimum 3 years selling into the foodservice channel — restaurants,

· Valid US visa (indispensable: the role includes travel to the company's

· Comfort in the field and in kitchens, this is not a desk role

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS




· Base salary of USD $36,000 per year (approx. MXN $51,500 per month),

· Variable compensation: volume-based bonus plus a growth bonus

· All Mexican statutory benefits (IMSS, vacaciones, prima vacacional)

 to US leadership




HOW TO APPLY




Apply here with your CV in English. Applications in English only.

About the job

¿Quiénes somos?

En Doctoralia, parte del grupo Docplanner, conectamos a millones de pacientes con profesionales de la salud en toda Latinoamérica. Nuestra misión es hacer que la experiencia de cuidar la salud sea más humana, sencilla y digital, tanto para pacientes como para especialistas.

Tu misión:

Serás el motor de la transformación digital de nuestros especialistas. Tu trabajo no será buscar clientes nuevos: vas a acompañar a los doctores que ya confían en nosotros para que den el siguiente gran paso, que es automatizar sus ingresos con Pagos Doctoralia.

Buscamos un perfil híbrido entre Customer Success y Sales, alguien que sepa escuchar, que entienda las objeciones de los profesionales de la salud y que las convierta en casos de éxito.

¿Qué harás en tu día a día?


Activación estratégica: contactar a especialistas de nuestra cartera para presentarles el valor de nuestra herramienta de pagos.

description:
About the job

About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

About The Role

We are looking for analytically minded and detail-oriented individuals to join the Customer Data Services team in our Mexico City office on a fixed-term basis starting at the beginning of January 2027. This role is open to early-career candidates with up to 2 years of experience who love working with complex data and want to see how it drives real decisions at the world's largest companies.

Watershed is a growth-stage start-up that works with 800+ customers globally, including 100+ of the Fortune 500 and 5 of the top 6 US banks, to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work hands-on with customer business data, transforming it to fit Watershed templates and enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact.

You will


Clean and transform customer business data into Watershed templates to reduce customer friction and drive time-to-value. 
Partner with customers to understand their raw data and recommend best practices for preparing it. 
Communicate data issues clearly to customers, covering impact, options and trade-offs. 
Leverage judgment to assess, advise, and execute on data cleaning best practices. 
Rigorously document decisions to ensure traceability of data manipulations during third-party verifications. 
Synthesize customer experiences and feedback to drive continuous improvement of our work and inform product development. 


You might be a fit if you


Have up to 2 years of experience working with large data files in Excel, whether through internships, co-ops or academic projects. Python or SQL is a plus. 
Thrive on complex, messy data and enjoy the work of making it clean, structured, and trustworthy. 
Are detail obsessed. You double check your work and do not consider something done until you know it is right. 
Have good intuition for how numbers in a spreadsheet map to the real world. You translate abstract problems into concrete data frameworks. 
Have high customer empathy and want to help them achieve their outcomes. 
Are a strong written and verbal communicator in English. You can concisely communicate externally to non-technical audiences. 
Are a low ego team player with a strong sense of ownership. You are driven by team goals and bias for action in order to achieve them. 


Fixed-term details


Minimum commitment of 4 months, with a possible extension of up to 3 additional months. 
Fixed-term employees receive compensation and benefits similar to full-time Watershed employees, including daily lunch delivered in the Watershed office in Mexico City. 
This position requires being in person in our Mexico City office 4 days per week. 


Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

description:
About the job

The Chainalysis Deployment Strategy team helps public and private sector customers investigate financial crimes involving cryptocurrency. We combine technical knowledge with analytical rigor to support complex investigations and build regional capacity for blockchain analysis. In the LATAM and Caribbean region, our team works directly with customers to enable them in the fast-moving world of cryptocurrency investigations. Along the way, we make the world a safer place.

As a Deployment Strategist I, you will support cryptocurrency investigations, conduct research and data analysis, and help deliver training to customers across the LATAM and Caribbean region. You will learn to use Chainalysis tools and data to develop insights on illicit activity trends in crypto, and you will present findings to team members and customers. This is a growth-oriented role for someone eager to build expertise in blockchain analysis while contributing to complex financial crime investigations alongside senior team members.

In This Role, You'll


Support complex cryptocurrency investigations in collaboration with senior team members and cross-functional partners at Chainalysis
Conduct research and data analysis on financial crime cases involving cryptocurrencies, and document your findings in clear reports
Present investigative findings to team members and customers
Assist in reviewing the completeness of investigations and data collection methods to help determine the authenticity and relevance of evidence
Prepare summaries of research and analysis that highlight recommendations, follow-up leads, and potential risks to an investigation
Contribute to the development and delivery of workshops and training materials in English and Spanish
Represent the Chainalysis mission of bringing trust to blockchains with customers and partners in the region


We're Looking For Candidates Who Have


A degree in cybersecurity, criminal justice, intelligence, forensic accounting, data analytics, finance, or a related field
1-3 years of professional experience in financial crime investigations, intelligence analysis, law enforcement, compliance, or a related analytical role
Strong research skills, including experience with open-source intelligence and public or private databases
Interest in or passion for blockchain and cryptocurrency technology
Fluency in Spanish and English
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to manage multiple tasks and work both independently and as part of a team
Based in Mexico City or willing to relocate


Nice To Have Experience


Familiarity with Chainalysis products (Reactor, KYT, or similar tools)
Working proficiency in Spanish
Previous experience supporting or conducting investigations related to dark web markets, counter-terrorism financing, or sanctions evasion
Exposure to cryptocurrency exchanges, DeFi protocols, or blockchain technology in a professional setting
Relevant certifications such as CCFC (Chainalysis Cryptocurrency Fundamentals Certification), CDAF, CRC, CCI, CFE, or CAMS


AI at Chainalysis

AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

description:
About the job

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms


ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.


Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work


High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.


What we offer


Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


About The Role

ElevenLabs builds the tools that let creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, images, and video with AI. Our enterprise customers - agencies, studios, brands, and media companies - are adopting these tools to transform how they produce creative at scale. The gap between having access to the platform and getting real value from it in production is where this role lives.

We are looking for an AI Creative Director to work directly with enterprise customers, helping them deploy ElevenLabs' creative tools into their actual production workflows. This is a hands-on, forward-deployed role. You will sit at the intersection of creative expertise and product knowledge - understanding what our tools can do, showing customers how to use them, and building the workflows and templates that make adoption stick.

You will partner with customers' creative and production teams to understand their current pipelines, identify where AI-powered tools fit, and demonstrate what is possible through hands-on work. You will create reference content, prototype workflows, and produce case studies that show real results. You will also work closely with our product and engineering teams - bringing field insights back to shape the roadmap.

The right person for this role has deep creative production experience and genuine fluency with AI creative tools. You are not just advising customers on what to do - you are in the tools alongside them, building and showing what great looks like.

What You Will Do

About the job

As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:


Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents.
Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close.
Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.
Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers to bring them to life.
Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact.
Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally.
Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives.
Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap.
Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers.
Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes.


Requirements


3+ years of experience working with customers in a technical capacity. Direct enterprise customer experience is preferred.
Experience in product development, delivery, and change management
Commercial instinct: comfort engaging in deal conversations, structuring value propositions, and navigating enterprise sales cycles alongside GTM partners.
Basic proficiency in Python and familiarity with API integration, sufficient to prototype, demo, and communicate credibly with engineering teams.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; particularly the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and structure clear logic in pursuit of optimal solutions.

Es donataria autorizada, cuenta con la acreditación de institucionalidad y transparencia del Cemefi y hoy se prepara para abrir su primer centro de atención y crecer a nivel nacional. Conoce más en vuela.org.

Esta posición reportará a la Gerencia de Marketing, Alianzas e Inversión Social y trabajará de cerca con las áreas de Operaciones y Comunicación. Se busca a una persona que construya relaciones con facilidad, dé seguimiento sin pena, proponga ideas creativas y, sobre todo, tenga un interés genuino por el impacto social.

description:
About the job

About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

How we work:

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About your skills:


Customer Advocacy: You keep our learners, partners, and administrators at the center of your work, identifying and anticipating their needs and pain points. You thoughtfully advocate for customer needs cross-functionally. 
Project Management: You manage multiple work streams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive customer-focused projects, adapting quickly to changes. You identify opportunities to improve processes and initiate lightweight project plans.
Data-driven Storytelling: You analyze quantitative and qualitative data and use your technical platform expertise and critical thinking to identify keen user insights to communicate succinctly and memorably. 
Communication: You are fluent in the English language and can communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing.


About This Role


The Product Specialist team sits at the intersection of Support, Product, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams, translating user signals into structured improvements that enhance platform quality, reduce friction, and enable scalable growth. Product Specialists equip our user-facing teams to provide a seamless user experience on our platform as well as drive user-centric platform enhancements by strategically pinpointing key challenges and opportunities to the right internal stakeholders at the right time.
The Product Specialist team meets the challenge of internal stakeholders’ competing priorities by nimbly adjusting advocacy strategies to compliment current company priorities. As Product Specialists grow in the role, they take on higher-impact projects and partner closely with leaders in Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support. The role and these projects ensure that our users remain at the center of product and process development across our company. 


What You’ll Be Doing


Use Coursera platform expertise to advocate for and create great learner and administrator experiences by influencing roadmaps, driving issue resolution, and building creative technical solutions
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to define and execute workflows for new feature launch operational readiness, representing our team and our learners
Work closely with our Support teams to directly enable users by driving escalation resolution, triaging issues, and updating internal resources

Present data-driven support insights to internal stakeholders to showcase trends and guide internal decision-making
Build strong working relationships with multiple internal cross-functional teams and collaborate to create learners-first solutions


What You’ll Have


3+ years of experience in product operations, customer success, technical support, or client services, working directly with Product and Engineering teams to resolve issues and drive product improvements in a fast-paced SaaS environment
Demonstrated ability to drive projects that benefit clients, customers, or end users, with comfort acting as a project owner who can manage competing stakeholder priorities
Experience with mastering a technical platform and providing technical consultative support
Written and verbal communication skills (English) to communicate complex technical information clearly, succinctly, and professionally 
Experience working independently as an individual contributor, managing multiple high-stakes workstreams and achieving impact


Compensation

At Coursera, we offer competitive, zone-based pay aligned to your location, experience, and role level. Our total rewards package goes beyond salary, with comprehensive health and wellness benefits, bonus and RSU equity programs, and global perks designed to help you grow and thrive wherever you are.

This role is only available for hire in Mexico City.

Coursera offers competitive pay and fair compensation practices across all regions. Job titles may span multiple career levels, and the targeted hiring annual base salary range for this role in Mexico City is MXN 440,000.00 - MXN 550,000.00. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, education, transferable skills, business needs, and location. This range may be adjusted over time and may include eligibility for variable pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

description:
About the job

Description

Are you a UX/UI-minded content strategist who thrives on turning complex information into simple, conversion-driven experiences? Are you energized by the challenge of helping small and medium businesses in Mexico discover the tools they need to grow? Do you want to own the digital front door for one of the fastest-growing seller marketplaces in Latin America?

If this sounds like your kind of challenge, consider joining the Mexico Marketplace team as a Content and Website Manager.

What You Will Do?

This role owns the end-to-end content experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, the primary destination for prospective sellers exploring how to sell on Amazon Mexico. The mission is clear: make it effortless for potential sellers to find, understand, and act on the information they need to start their business on Amazon.

You will combine UX/UI expertise with content strategy and data analysis to continuously improve the site experience. You will track free search sources to understand how sellers discover the site, then optimize every touchpoint from first click to completed registration.

To succeed, you will need to think like a designer, write like a marketer, and measure like an analyst, all while collaborating across a diverse set of internal teams.

Core Responsibilities

UX/UI Strategy and Execution: Own the information architecture, page layouts, and user flows on vender.amazon.com.mx. Ensure every page delivers a clear value proposition, intuitive navigation, and a frictionless path toward seller registration. Conduct usability reviews, propose wireframes, and work with design resources to implement improvements.

Content Management at Scale: Plan, create, publish, and maintain site content including landing pages, educational modules, FAQs, and program explainers. Ensure content is accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with active seller programs and promotions.

Free Search Source Tracking: Monitor organic traffic performance across Google and AI-powered search surfaces. Identify keyword opportunities, track ranking changes, and coordinate content updates to maximize discoverability without paid spend.

Conversion Optimization: Own the visitor-to-registration funnel. Design and run A/B tests on layouts, copy, and CTAs. Analyze drop-off points, recommend improvements backed by data, and report on conversion metrics to leadership.

Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate daily with Program Managers, Product Managers, and Commercial teams. Translate business priorities, new program launches, and policy changes into user-friendly site content within rapid turnaround cycles.

Performance Reporting: Build and maintain dashboards that track organic traffic, conversion rates, content freshness, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights to stakeholders with clear recommendations for next steps.

What We Are Looking For

To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Demonstrate

A strong UX/UI foundation: experience with wireframing, prototyping, user research, and usability testing.

A true hands-on approach to content creation and site management, comfortable rolling up your sleeves in the CMS daily.

The ability to translate complex business and program information into simple, action-oriented content that converts.

A data-driven mindset: comfort defining KPIs, running experiments, interpreting analytics, and presenting results.

Strong internal customer service focus, able to interface at all levels of the organization, from operational teams to senior leadership.

A solutions-oriented approach: comfortable identifying problems and driving appropriate fixes without waiting for direction.

Bias for action, strong work ethic, and desire to achieve excellence in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Enthusiasm for collaborative work and a drive to create a positive, high-performance team culture.

Success in this role requires influential partnership with Program, Product, and Commercial teams to ensure vender.amazon.com.mx delivers the best possible experience for potential sellers in Mexico. If you are passionate about using design thinking and content strategy to change the trajectory of small businesses, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

Own the content strategy and UX/UI experience on vender.amazon.com.mx, ensuring prospective sellers in Mexico can easily discover, understand, and act on the information needed to start selling on Amazon.

Design and maintain site user flows, page layouts, and information architecture. Conduct usability reviews and implement improvements that reduce friction in the seller registration funnel.

Plan, publish, and update site content (landing pages, FAQs, educational modules) in coordination with Program, Product, and Commercial teams. Ensure all content reflects current programs and promotions within 48 to 72 hours of changes.

Track and analyze free search traffic sources. Identify organic keyword opportunities, monitor ranking performance, and optimize content for discoverability across search engines and AI-powered surfaces.

Run A/B tests on layouts, messaging, and CTAs. Measure conversion at each funnel stage, report findings to stakeholders, and implement data-backed improvements.

Partner cross-functionally to translate complex business requirements into clear, conversion-oriented site experiences. Serve as the primary point of contact for all content and UX requests related to the Mexico seller acquisition site.

Maintain performance dashboards covering organic traffic, conversion rates, and page experience scores. Deliver monthly insights with actionable recommendations.

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing organic traffic dashboards, identifying which pages are gaining traction and where drop-offs occur. title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About the job

LealUp es la plataforma de Customer Success con IA para empresas B2B con ingresos recurrentes en Latinoamérica. Lo que en el mercado se llama "posventa" lo resolvemos en un solo lugar: la vista 360 de cada cliente, health score, WhatsApp nativo, renovaciones, cobranza y encuestas NPS. Nuestros agentes de IA preparan QBRs, resumen cuentas, detectan riesgos y activan playbooks.




Creemos que la retención es el motor principal de crecimiento de una empresa B2B. Para la mayoría de las empresas de la región, el principal competidor no es otro software. Es el Excel y el WhatsApp personal de cada ejecutivo.




Buscamos a nuestra primera persona de Customer Success en México.




El rol




Vas a acompañar a nuestros clientes desde la firma hasta la renovación, y a construir cómo se hace Customer Success en LealUp en México. No vas a heredar un playbook de 200 páginas, vas a escribirlo. Y vas a gestionar tu cartera dentro de LealUp, así que tu trabajo diario también va a mejorar el producto.




Lo que vas a hacer en los primeros 12 meses




→ Liderar el onboarding y la implementación de clientes con nuestro proceso de 7 etapas. Que cada cliente vea valor en las primeras semanas, no en meses.

→ Gestionar una cartera de cuentas B2B: adopción, health score, QBRs, renovaciones y oportunidades de expansión.

→ Detectar a tiempo las señales de riesgo y de expansión, y actuar con playbooks antes de que un cliente se vaya en silencio.

→ Ser la voz del cliente dentro del equipo: llevar a producto lo que ves en cada cuenta y participar en las decisiones del roadmap.

→ Adaptar nuestro mensaje, procesos y materiales al mercado mexicano: vocabulario, comités de compra, facturación y formas de trabajar.

→ Trabajar con partners y aliados locales en implementaciones conjuntas.

→ Medir lo que importa: retención, NRR, tiempo hasta el primer valor y adopción.




Lo que buscamos




→ Al menos 3 años en Customer Success, Account Management o implementación, en SaaS B2B o en empresas de servicios con contratos recurrentes.

→ Experiencia gestionando onboarding, renovaciones y conversaciones difíciles con clientes, incluidas las de cobranza y riesgo de baja.

→ Manejo de métricas de posventa: churn, NRR y health score, y saber usarlas para decidir, no solo para reportar.

→ Experiencia con algún CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive o Zoho).

→ Comodidad para usar WhatsApp como canal profesional con clientes.

→ Español excelente, escrito y hablado, e inglés intermedio para leer documentación y herramientas.

→ Residencia en México. Si estás en CDMX o Monterrey, suma, porque habrá reuniones presenciales ocasionales.




Suma, pero no es requisito




Haber trabajado en una startup en etapa temprana, haber implementado una plataforma de Customer Success (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Planhat, Totango u otra), experiencia con IA aplicada al trabajo con clientes, o participar en comunidades de Customer Success en LATAM.




Lo que ofrecemos




→ Trabajo 100% remoto desde México.

→ Trabajo directo con los fundadores, sin capas intermedias.

→ Una silla en la mesa para decidir cómo crece LealUp en México.

→ Influencia real sobre el producto: lo que veas con clientes se construye.

→ Salario competitivo del mercado







El proceso

Conversación con los fundadores, un caso práctico sobre una cuenta real de ejemplo (por ejemplo, un plan de rescate para un cliente en riesgo o la preparación de un QBR), una conversación final y la oferta. De la primera conversación a la oferta, 2 semanas como máximo.

Si te incomoda la ambigüedad, necesitas procesos definidos desde el primer día o prefieres administrar cuentas en lugar de construir cómo se gestionan, este rol no es para ti. Y está bien.

title: CRM Operations & Support Specialist
skills: Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation

Be the users' advocate. You sit in on training sessions and working sessions and watch how people actually use the system. When a button says "Book the IC" on a deal whose IC is already booked, you notice, you understand why the user is confused, and you get it changed.

Own the feedback loop. Our US beta Slack channel gets forty posts a day: bugs, how-do-I questions, data problems, ideas. You triage every one: answer directly when you know the solution and pass on what you can't solve yourself. You keep the Salesflow feedback tracker current and make sure the backend team does not forget backend issues and the frontend team does not forget UI/UX issues.

Fix what you can, hand off what you can't. With AI as your pair, you fix copy, FAQ entries, help content and data corrections directly; small UI changes are within reach for the right person but are not the bar. For anything deeper you write a precise brief: what happened, for whom, how to reproduce it, what you already ruled out.

Own the in-app help: short videos, screenshots, and written walkthroughs, which today are generated automatically, high quality but unmonitored. You are the human who monitors changes, corrects, and adds what is missing.

Test before it ships. Before a release you click through the affected flows as a salesperson would. You keep a living checklist of the paths that matter. You are the last person who touches a feature before a user does.

Keep people unblocked. Login problems, access requests, a lead in the wrong stage, a deal that will not close. You resolve them, you write the how-to so it does not come back, and when the same question arrives three times you propose the change that makes it stop.

Grow with the rollout. As Salesflow expands to new markets and absorbs our marketing systems, the volume and variety of feedback grows with it. You build the process that scales, and you are the first person our new markets meet when they get stuck.

You have systems sense. You look at a user's screen and see the cause behind their specific issue. You ask why something was built the way it was before you decide it is wrong. You can hold a salesperson's workflow and an engineer's constraints in your head at the same time. People who have this usually come from product, implementation or solutions roles, from operations jobs where they were the one who "understood the system", or from an engineering or analytical background. About the job

Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:


Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications
Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation
Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards
Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation


We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Role

Crimson is replacing Salesforce with Salesflow, an AI-native CRM we build in-house. It runs the whole sales journey: lead intake, scheduling, call transcription and coaching, AI-drafted appraisals, contracts and e-signature, and invoicing. It is live for our US sales team today and rolls out to every other market over the coming months.

The build team is four people plus AI. What we lack is the go-between: the person who breathes both sales day-to-day and the UX and can tell, quickly and correctly, whether a salesperson's issue is due to (1) the salesperson needs more guidance and training; the system is fine or (2) the salesperson is in the right; the system flow is broken / there is a bug. Often, issues are a bit of both: the salesperson has not fully understood, and the CRM has not made it obvious.

That is you. You talk to salespeople to understand what blocks them. You talk to Claude and your teammates to find out why. You answer the how-to yourself, you write the bug or design issue so an engineer can act on it without a second conversation, and specify potential alternatives. You are the reason a salesperson in Los Angeles gets an answer in ten minutes even if the developer is across the world and asleep, and the reason the same question is not asked again next week.

This is not a support desk role and it is not a QA role, though it contains both. It is not a developer role either: you will not be asked to write production code. It is the seat from which the whole feedback loop is owned.

Location: Remote from Mexico, Brazil, or Central/South America. You must be available 9:00-18:00 US Eastern.

Reporting to: Head of Data

Employment: Full time

What are the main responsibilities for this role?


Be the users' advocate. You sit in on training sessions and working sessions and watch how people actually use the system. When a button says "Book the IC" on a deal whose IC is already booked, you notice, you understand why the user is confused, and you get it changed.
Own the feedback loop. Our US beta Slack channel gets forty posts a day: bugs, how-do-I questions, data problems, ideas. You triage every one: answer directly when you know the solution and pass on what you can't solve yourself. You keep the Salesflow feedback tracker current and make sure the backend team does not forget backend issues and the frontend team does not forget UI/UX issues.
Fix what you can, hand off what you can't. With AI as your pair, you fix copy, FAQ entries, help content and data corrections directly; small UI changes are within reach for the right person but are not the bar. For anything deeper you write a precise brief: what happened, for whom, how to reproduce it, what you already ruled out.
Own the in-app help: short videos, screenshots, and written walkthroughs, which today are generated automatically, high quality but unmonitored. You are the human who monitors changes, corrects, and adds what is missing.
Test before it ships. Before a release you click through the affected flows as a salesperson would. You keep a living checklist of the paths that matter. You are the last person who touches a feature before a user does.
Keep people unblocked. Login problems, access requests, a lead in the wrong stage, a deal that will not close. You resolve them, you write the how-to so it does not come back, and when the same question arrives three times you propose the change that makes it stop.
Grow with the rollout. As Salesflow expands to new markets and absorbs our marketing systems, the volume and variety of feedback grows with it. You build the process that scales, and you are the first person our new markets meet when they get stuck.


Your first 60 days: by day 30 you own first response in our US beta channel during US hours and the feedback tracker is current. By day 60 you have shipped your first fixes, you run the weekly aging report, and login and access issues come to you and stop there.

What skills and experience are required?


You have systems sense. You look at a user's screen and see the cause behind their specific issue. You ask why something was built the way it was before you decide it is wrong. You can hold a salesperson's workflow and an engineer's constraints in your head at the same time. People who have this usually come from product, implementation or solutions roles, from operations jobs where they were the one who "understood the system", or from an engineering or analytical background. Sales experience helps but is not required; we can teach you how our sales team works in a month. We cannot teach the above.
You are AI-augmented, not AI-dependent. You use Claude, ChatGPT or similar every day to do real work. You ask it critical questions, read its answers skeptically, catch it when it is wrong, and know when a task needs a human developer. If you are uncomfortable working with AI tools, this is not the role for you.
You have delivered things. Experience level matters less than evidence that you finish what you start. That could be a job in operations, support, product, or QA, or something you built yourself. Tell us about it.
You write clearly. Most of this job is written: Slack replies to users, briefs to developers, FAQ entries, AI prompts. Your English is fluent, precise, and clear. Spanish or Portuguese is a bonus for our upcoming markets.
You have drive. Nobody will hand you a ticket queue. You will see the mess, decide what matters, and go.


Strong Plus If You Have


Experience in system design or algorithms
Experience with a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot) as an admin or power user
Experience supporting a software product in production


This is probably not for you if you want a defined queue and a manager who prioritises it for you, if you would rather build things than make other people's things work, or if you prefer to smooth over a broken screen for a user rather than get it fixed.

Why this role

You will have a direct hand in a piece of software that replaces a global company's CRM and defines how it sells for the next decade. You will work daily with the four people who built it. There is no ceiling on what you can pick up: people who thrive in this seat grow into product, engineering or operations leadership as the team scales.

About Sussman Law Firm, PLLC

Sussman Law Firm is a Charlotte-based firm focused on family and immigration law. We value accountability, initiative, and professional growth within a collaborative, high-performance environment. We are not your typical law firm. We are poised for aggressive growth, and we believe great work starts with a strong team.

Our Culture

If you are looking for a role where you will be pushed to grow, supported by a strong team, and make a difference in people’s lives, you will fit right in.

If you are hired, you will be part of a wonderful team of people who work hard to get the job done right the first time and take pride in the work that they do. However, it is our belief that anything really great is worth working hard for and that our greatest growth comes from our biggest challenges. As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.

Bachelor's degree.

Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).

title: AI-First Copy & Community Manager
skills: Write engaging, on-brand social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube and other relevant platforms, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working.
Review and refine social copy for clarity, accuracy and audience fit, adapting each piece to its platform and purpose.

Learn each brand's voice, audience and subject matter deeply enough to judge when AI output fits. Maintain and evolve tone-of-voice guidance, source context and examples that people and agents can use consistently.

Fact-check against supplied sources and proofread everything you deliver, including anything AI touched. Check names, claims, grammar, punctuation, links, accessibility and platform-native formatting; treat rights and brand safety as fixed points.

Pitch social content angles and approaches that improve engagement and visibility. Apply copywriting best practice, using performance signals and feedback to improve attention, reach and the quality of the writing.

Engage communities day to day: respond to comments and join relevant conversations on fan, talent and partner content. Keep replies timely, appropriate and consistent with the brand's personality and engagement approach.

Stay close to culture, fandom, trends and platform developments. Surface timely engagement opportunities that suit the audience, and feed what you learn from conversations back into copy and content ideas.

Use agents for repeatable work such as preparing copy variants, checking against source material and summarising community themes. Review their work critically, make the editorial decisions and keep useful records for clear handovers.
Prioritise deadlines and responsive community work, balance a shared workload with colleagues across time zones, and adapt constructively to feedback and changing priorities.

Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you. Test new capabilities against real briefs, compare the results with your current approach, and update shared methods when they improve quality or reliability.
Excellent written English and a strong editorial ear. Your writing shows precision, range, personality and an ability to adapt tone without losing clarity.
Community judgment: you understand fan behaviour, can write a natural response and recognise when to engage, pause or escalate. You bring a real interest in TV, film and online culture.

Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI agents in work, study or personal projects. You can show how you build context, direct production and checks, reject weak output and improve the result. You have examples beyond asking a chatbot for ideas.

Confidence working with editorial documents, social platforms and AI tools. You may bring a traditional copy background with a developed AI practice, or have built your craft using AI from the start. Either path works here.
Sound fact-checking and accessibility knowledge, with the attention to detail to hold the quality bar at speed. You can explain the choices behind your copy and replies.
A systems mindset and ownership: you spot repeatable work, improve it and follow through. You can demonstrate a reusable method and explain how you help someone else use it successfully.
