description:
About the job

💸 USD 24,000 - USD 28,000 per year, on a full-time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working!

✨ Create sharp copy and meaningful community conversations for globally recognised brands in US TV and entertainment.

🔍 Work with AI agents, reusable skills and editorial context libraries at the centre of your craft.

💻 High-end, fast computer

💡 All the latest software and productivity tools you’ll need




About the Role 




You write copy that sounds right for the brand and gives people a reason to care. You also know how to join a fan conversation: when a thoughtful reply adds something, when humour fits, and when an issue needs escalating. This is a hands-on role owning the relationship between a brand and its community through strong copy and thoughtful engagement.




Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.




AI-first doesn't mean AI-generated. The work itself is craft: finding the right angle, shaping a line and responding with judgment. You direct agents through Codex, using reusable skills and context libraries of brand voice, source material and editorial examples to produce copy variants, edit working documents and run structured checks. You catch the bland line, unsupported claim or reply that misses the mood, and make it better. Your editorial judgment stays in charge of every word.




You'll learn the ground first: what we make and the bar it has to hit. Social copy that earns attention. Community replies that make the brand feel like part of the fandom. Then you'll work from Storm's stack of AI and creative tools, and play a real part in improving how this work gets done.




About Storm Ideas 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Storm brings together entertainment, fandom, creative production, community and technology.




We help major brands build stronger relationships with their audiences, while using AI to improve how that work is created, checked and delivered.




We are a remote-first, fast-moving company with established clients, a growing team, and a strong appetite for better tools, better systems, and better ways of working. AI is central to how we operate — every team, every role, this one included.




What You Will Do

Write engaging, on-brand social copy for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, YouTube and other relevant platforms, with AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working.
Review and refine social copy for clarity, accuracy and audience fit, adapting each piece to its platform and purpose.
Learn each brand's voice, audience and subject matter deeply enough to judge when AI output fits. Maintain and evolve tone-of-voice guidance, source context and examples that people and agents can use consistently.
Fact-check against supplied sources and proofread everything you deliver, including anything AI touched. Check names, claims, grammar, punctuation, links, accessibility and platform-native formatting; treat rights and brand safety as fixed points.
Pitch social content angles and approaches that improve engagement and visibility. Apply copywriting best practice, using performance signals and feedback to improve attention, reach and the quality of the writing.
Engage communities day to day: respond to comments and join relevant conversations on fan, talent and partner content. Keep replies timely, appropriate and consistent with the brand's personality and engagement approach.
Stay close to culture, fandom, trends and platform developments. Surface timely engagement opportunities that suit the audience, and feed what you learn from conversations back into copy and content ideas.
Use agents for repeatable work such as preparing copy variants, checking against source material and summarising community themes. Review their work critically, make the editorial decisions and keep useful records for clear handovers.
Prioritise deadlines and responsive community work, balance a shared workload with colleagues across time zones, and adapt constructively to feedback and changing priorities.
Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you. Test new capabilities against real briefs, compare the results with your current approach, and update shared methods when they improve quality or reliability.




Success means distinctive, accurate copy; timely community responses that fit the conversation; and improvements that reduce avoidable revisions and help teammates deliver consistently. You can show what your methods changed, using examples, feedback and useful measures.




What We Are Looking For

Excellent written English and a strong editorial ear. Your writing shows precision, range, personality and an ability to adapt tone without losing clarity.
Community judgment: you understand fan behaviour, can write a natural response and recognise when to engage, pause or escalate. You bring a real interest in TV, film and online culture.
Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI agents in work, study or personal projects. You can show how you build context, direct production and checks, reject weak output and improve the result. You have examples beyond asking a chatbot for ideas.
Confidence working with editorial documents, social platforms and AI tools. You may bring a traditional copy background with a developed AI practice, or have built your craft using AI from the start. Either path works here.
Sound fact-checking and accessibility knowledge, with the attention to detail to hold the quality bar at speed. You can explain the choices behind your copy and replies.
A systems mindset and ownership: you spot repeatable work, improve it and follow through. You can demonstrate a reusable method and explain how you help someone else use it successfully.
Clear communication, reliable organisation and thoughtful asynchronous handovers. You share work well, respond to feedback and learn new tools with an eye for what improves the result.




What It's Like To Work Here




Modern Tech Stack

You’ll work with a supported AI stack, shared context and reusable skills, backed by our AI Operations team. You’ll build on established tools and methods, contribute improvements, and help colleagues put them into practice.




Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works 

We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.




Team-based

Join an international, remote-first team of 175+ people who value skill, initiative and collaboration. You work closely with copy and account colleagues and contribute to a shared quality bar.




Flexibility

Fully remote-first. You will work 37.5 hours per week within a 9am–5:30pm Pacific Time schedule, Monday–Friday, collaborating with colleagues across time zones.




Recruitment Process




Apply with your CV, a short note explaining your fit for the role, and writing samples or a portfolio. Samples are required; personal projects count. Social copy and community-response examples are especially useful.




Shortlisted applicants complete self-recorded video questions and a short, time-boxed copy and community practical task as one screening stage.




If successful, you'll meet Tania Pardisi, Senior Copy Manager, and Nicola Taghizadeh, Chief Creative Officer, together for an interview. We'll discuss your work, your approach to community relationships and your experience using AI, and answer your questions about the role and team.




Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway if this sounds like how you already work. We are more interested in your operational judgement, reliability, follow-through, and ability to use modern tools well than in a perfect traditional CV.

title: e-Commerce AI Business Enablement Lead
skills: Shape the commercial analytics agenda for the region: sales, market share, pricing, digital shelf, assortment, search performance, retail media, traffic, conversion, availability, Buy Box and profitability.
Turn ambiguous business questions into quantified opportunities, business cases and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with Sales, Category Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Digital to help decisions move from weeks to days.
Bring data to commercial priorities and help teams learn from what the numbers say.
Commercial decisions become faster, better informed and easier to trace to outcomes, with revenue and margin wins the team can celebrate together.
Explore and rethink core commercial processes together with the teams that run them.
Reduce manual work through automation and help the best practices spread across markets.
Guide cross-functional improvement initiatives from diagnosis to adoption, with empathy for how people experience change.
Create playbooks and documentation that help improvements stick.
A more productive organization: hours returned to commercial teams, fewer handoffs and ways of working that scale naturally across countries.
Spot and prioritize promising AI use cases across the business, guided by a clear view of potential value.

Prototype, pilot and scale solutions such as commercial copilots, AI agents, workflow automation, pricing and competitive intelligence, content generation, reporting automation and knowledge assistants.
Care for quality along the way: evaluation, reliability, responsible AI practices and data privacy, including LGPD.
Nurture adoption through enablement, training and honest measurement of real usage.
Stay curious about the frontier and test emerging AI technologies.
AI woven into everyday operations, with adoption and impact everyone can see: less manual work, faster execution and a growing competitive edge.
Shape: the LATAM eCommerce AI enablement roadmap, solution design and prioritization, and regional best practices.
Influence: cross-functional, multi-country initiatives, partnering with stakeholders up to Director level.
Develop others: mentor analysts across the region and help grow the organization's AI fluency.
Recommend: bring investment ideas, vendor options and trade-offs to eCommerce leadership with a clear point of view.
Explore — first 90 days: immerse in the business, listen to teams across markets, map workflows and identify the opportunities with the most potential.
Experiment — by month six: launch the first pilots in one or two markets, test and learn, and measure openly what works and what doesn't.
Scale — by month 12: turn the successful experiments into solutions adopted across the region, and share the learning openly, including from the pilots that didn't make it.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Business or a related quantitative field; an advanced degree (MBA or MS) is a plus.

Around seven years or more of experience across eCommerce, commercial analytics, digital transformation or AI solutions, including meaningful hands-on time designing, testing and deploying AI or automation solutions that made it into everyday use.
Stories of things you've built: solutions people actually adopted, the results they produced and the experiments that taught you the most.

description:
About the job

The Lead, e-Commerce AI Business Enablement guides the artificial intelligence journey of LATAM eCommerce business. It is a senior individual contributor role for a curious builder: someone who turns AI capability into commercial results across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers, and who helps the whole regional organization work smarter along the way.

You'll have real freedom to explore, prototype and test ideas — and the backing to scale the ones that succeed. Some experiments won't work, and that's part of the deal. What matters is learning fast, being honest about results and turning the wins into everyday practice across the region.




Where You'll Make an Impact




Your energy will center on three missions:




Mission 1 | Drive Commercial Growth

Build the insight-to-action engine that accelerates revenue and profitability across Amazon, Mercado Libre and other strategic digital customers.

What you'll do

Shape the commercial analytics agenda for the region: sales, market share, pricing, digital shelf, assortment, search performance, retail media, traffic, conversion, availability, Buy Box and profitability.
Turn ambiguous business questions into quantified opportunities, business cases and executive-ready recommendations.
Partner with Sales, Category Management, Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance and Digital to help decisions move from weeks to days.
Bring data to commercial priorities and help teams learn from what the numbers say.

Success looks like

Commercial decisions become faster, better informed and easier to trace to outcomes, with revenue and margin wins the team can celebrate together.

Mission 2 | Evolve Ways of Working

Champion continuous improvement across the LATAM eCommerce organization: simpler processes, less manual work and good ideas that travel across markets.

What you'll do

Explore and rethink core commercial processes together with the teams that run them.
Reduce manual work through automation and help the best practices spread across markets.
Guide cross-functional improvement initiatives from diagnosis to adoption, with empathy for how people experience change.
Create playbooks and documentation that help improvements stick.

Success looks like

A more productive organization: hours returned to commercial teams, fewer handoffs and ways of working that scale naturally across countries.

Mission 3 | Explore, Test and Scale AI

Take AI from ideas to everyday practice through experimentation: try, test, learn and scale what works.

What you'll do

Spot and prioritize promising AI use cases across the business, guided by a clear view of potential value.
Prototype, pilot and scale solutions such as commercial copilots, AI agents, workflow automation, pricing and competitive intelligence, content generation, reporting automation and knowledge assistants.
Care for quality along the way: evaluation, reliability, responsible AI practices and data privacy, including LGPD.
Nurture adoption through enablement, training and honest measurement of real usage.
Stay curious about the frontier and test emerging AI technologies.

Success looks like

AI woven into everyday operations, with adoption and impact everyone can see: less manual work, faster execution and a growing competitive edge.

How You'll Operate

Shape: the LATAM eCommerce AI enablement roadmap, solution design and prioritization, and regional best practices.
Influence: cross-functional, multi-country initiatives, partnering with stakeholders up to Director level.
Develop others: mentor analysts across the region and help grow the organization's AI fluency.
Recommend: bring investment ideas, vendor options and trade-offs to eCommerce leadership with a clear point of view.

Your First Year: Explore, Experiment, Scale

A natural arc for the first 12 months, which we'll shape together.

Explore — first 90 days: immerse in the business, listen to teams across markets, map workflows and identify the opportunities with the most potential.
Experiment — by month six: launch the first pilots in one or two markets, test and learn, and measure openly what works and what doesn't.
Scale — by month 12: turn the successful experiments into solutions adopted across the region, and share the learning openly, including from the pilots that didn't make it.

What You'll Bring

Experience and skills

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, Business or a related quantitative field; an advanced degree (MBA or MS) is a plus.
Around seven years or more of experience across eCommerce, commercial analytics, digital transformation or AI solutions, including meaningful hands-on time designing, testing and deploying AI or automation solutions that made it into everyday use.
Stories of things you've built: solutions people actually adopted, the results they produced and the experiments that taught you the most.
Strong marketplace fluency: the economics of Amazon and Mercado Libre, including retail media, digital shelf, search, Buy Box dynamics, 1P/3P models and profitability drivers.
Hands-on comfort with SQL and Python, plus working command of LLM APIs and frameworks (prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation), enterprise automation (Power Platform, n8n, Make) and advanced Power BI.
Confident, clear communication with senior stakeholders, in writing and in the room.

Languages

Spanish: native or full professional proficiency.
English: full professional proficiency. English is the working language with regional and global leadership, and parts of the selection process are conducted in English.

Nice to have

Consumer goods, retail or marketplace industry experience at scale.
Experience with AI governance, model evaluation and data privacy in enterprise environments.
Internal copilots or agents you've built that found sustained adoption.
Lean Six Sigma or comparable continuous improvement certification.
Experience scaling solutions across multi-country organizations.




How We Work

We believe the best AI adoption comes from curiosity and experimentation, not mandates. You'll have room to explore, permission to test ideas that might not work and support to scale the ones that do. We move with rigor — we measure what we try and we're honest about results — and we treat every experiment, successful or not, as progress.

About the job

See something that should exist? Build it.

See a better way? Do it.

At Terrific, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.

And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

Terrific is hiring Customer Success Managers in multiple locations to help shape the future of social commerce.

The Role

We are hiring a builder to own and scale the customer lifecycle after the deal is closed. We have strong product potential, but long-term success depends on how customers adopt, engage, and grow with Terrific.

This role exists to turn customers into successful, long-term partners.

What You Will Build

You will help define how customers experience Terrific post-sale.

Your work will directly shape:


How customers onboard and reach first value 
How customers adopt core features and build habits 
How we identify and act on expansion opportunities 
How we reduce churn and increase retention 
How Terrific turns customers into long-term growth partners 



You’ll build the playbooks, lifecycle, and touchpoints that drive retention and expansion.

What You Will Own

You will own the customer lifecycle end-to-end:

Onboarding → Activation → Adoption → Retention → Expansion

Customer Lifecycle Ownership


Own a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise customers 
Lead onboarding and ensure fast time-to-value 
Drive product adoption and ongoing engagement 
Build strong relationships with key stakeholders 



Activation & Adoption


Ensure customers successfully launch and use Terrific 
Identify friction points in onboarding and usage 
Proactively guide customers toward best practices 
Turn product usage into measurable outcomes 



Retention & Expansion


Monitor account health and identify risks early 
Drive renewals and reduce churn 
Identify and execute expansion opportunities 
Partner with Sales on upsells and account growth 



Product & Feedback Loop


Act as the voice of the customer internally 
Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering 
Identify patterns across accounts and surface insights 
Help improve onboarding and product experience 



Systems & Scale


Help build CS playbooks, processes, and lifecycle journeys 
Define what “good” looks like across onboarding and engagement 
Contribute to dashboards, health scoring, and reporting 
Create repeatable processes that scale 



You will have real ownership and autonomy.

Who You Are

You are someone who understands that customer success is about outcomes, not activity.

Requirements


2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or similar roles 
Experience working with SaaS products and customer lifecycles 
Strong ability to manage relationships and drive outcomes

You won’t inherit a fully built customer journey.

You’ll help define how customers succeed with Terrific.

Your work will directly impact retention, expansion, and long-term revenue.

Terrific is a focused, execution-driven company where strong operators have direct impact.

description:
About the job

Hey, Dingus!







Yeah, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!




Dingus and Zazzy does what traditional marketing agencies don’t. We provide limitless creative and strategy services, including graphic design, copywriting, SEO, video, and beyond, for brands that want to expand their presence across digital platforms. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.




The Perfect Candidate for This Role Is




Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and coming up with solutions
A strong communicator who ensures clarity with both internal teams and clients
Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently
Able to communicate in English clearly and efficiently (Minimum Level: Professional)
Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team made up of different personalities
Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful, always finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas, so things run smoothly
Excellent with time management and can handle multiple priorities simultaneously
Happy to talk through ideas, offer feedback, and help teams align with client goals
Experienced in marketing and project management




Purpose of the Role




The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination and client relationship management. It’s the bridge between internal teams and clients. Marketing Coordinators support smooth project execution by managing internal communication and task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard.




Main Objectives




1: Client Collaboration & Project Oversight




Manage client meetings, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
Translate these goals into clear tasks for the team to ensure smooth project execution.
Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.




2: Internal Team Coordination




Work closely with designers, brand & copy strategists, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello,) and ClickUp boards are updated.




3: Communication & Task Management




Review and approve the final deliverables before submission to ensure they meet client goals and expectations.
Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.




4: Resource Planning & Problem Solving




Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring each progresses smoothly without delays or miscommunication.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.




5: Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking




Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows to ensure efficiency and consistent delivery.
Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success




Important Notes

Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional.




If you genuinely love building relationships and keeping things organized, and take pride in making clients feel like they’re in the best hands, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

description:
About the job

About Us



Join us in inspiring everyone to express their unique beauty.

IPSY is the beauty industry’s most powerful platform, uniting brands, creators, and hyper-engaged consumers with unprecedented access to each other through the ultimate beauty membership. Home to sample-size subscription IPSY Original, full-size subscription IPSY Extra, and quarterly, limited-edition collection IPSY Ultimate, we curate beauty for millions of members so they can play, explore, and express their unique beauty every day.

We think self-discovery, self-expression, and confidence are beautiful. Agree? Then join us! Explore careers and learn more about our values, culture, and benefits across all our brands: IPSY Careers.

We're proud to be a remote-first company. Our fully remote team members have the chance to live and work where they want, because we believe work should fit into your life—not the other way around. We offer monthly virtual activities, company-wide offsites, professional development, and learning sessions, to help our team members stay connected, engaged, and impactful while working virtually.

United States Remote: Remote positions which may be performed in any of the states where IPSY has established a Business presence: Arizona, California, Connecticut, Florida, Illinois, Kansas, Massachusetts, Missouri, North Carolina, New York, New Jersey, Nevada, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, and Washington. California Privacy Notice

Beware job scams! IPSY recruiters only use @ipsy.com email addresses. We do not interview via text/message/Teams. We don't ask for software downloads (except Zoom) and we will never ask for sensitive information (like SSN/bank info). Suspect fraud? Report it to law enforcement and recruiting@ipsy.com. 

About the Role:

IPSY is seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Commerce Coordinator (junior merch analyst) to support our online merchandising operations in Mexico. In this role, you will bridge merchandising execution and performance analysis—ensuring accurate product representation, optimizing website content, and digging into eCommerce data to drive actionable campaign and assortment strategies.

If you thrive in a fast-paced eCommerce environment, love turning numbers into revenue-driving decisions, and know your way around retail metrics and Excel, this is the role for you.

This position reports to the Global Merchandising Manager and is remote, but is based (you must reside) in Mexico.

What You’ll Be Doing:


Merchandising & Campaign Asset Optimization: Coordinate banner and promotional asset uploads across eCommerce and Add-ons formats. Translate and update Product Detail Pages (PDPs) for Add-ons, eCommerce, and Glam Bag formats, ensuring assets are accurate, complete, and optimized for search and user experience.
Product Lifecycle & Operations: Monitor product availability to prevent stockouts in coordination with the US merchandising team. Manage Accommodations and PDP workflows in Akeneo, execute bi-weekly Merch Import Requests, and track monthly assortment reviews in Asana.
Performance Analysis & Insights:
Analyze sell-through, inventory turns, SKU/category profitability, and promotional lift to guide markdowns, reorders, and campaign strategies.
Deep-dive into eCommerce KPIs (CVR, AOV, sell-through, margin contribution) to evaluate category performance and monitor ROI on promotional calendars.
Conduct demand forecasting and open-to-buy support to optimize stock levels.
Reporting & Strategy: Deliver monthly qualitative and quantitative performance reports to leadership. Monitor competitor offers, deals, and market trends to flag opportunity areas.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with digital operations, creative, product, and US merchandising teams to ensure timely execution and resolve stock/asset blockers proactively.


What We Are Looking For:


Early Career / Entry-Level Experience: Open to recent graduates in Engineering, Business, Economics, or quantitative fields with up to 2 years of hands-on experience in eCommerce or retail merchandising (experience with platforms/retailers like Amazon, Mercado Libre, Liverpool, Palace, etc., is a major plus).
Core Excel & Data Fluency: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, handling sales and inventory data) with a proven ability to translate analysis into real business impact.
eCommerce & Retail Metric Literacy: Solid understanding of eCommerce campaign dynamics and key retail metrics (Conversion Rate, Average Order Value, Sell-through, Gross Margin).
Operational Precision & Ownership: Exceptional attention to detail, strong time-management skills, and the ability to autonomously drive cross-functional operational workflows in fast-paced environments.
Language Skills: Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) for seamless cross-border team collaboration.


Bonus if You Have:


Experience in the Beauty industry or a passion for cosmetics/skincare.
Experience in Subscription business models or recurring revenue eCommerce.
Experience with PIM/CMS tools like Akeneo or project management tools like Asana.


What We Offer: 


Competitive salary (MXN)
Paid time off & work from home flexibility
Learning & development programs
Free IPSY Original subscription

skills: You build the department, not just the tests. This is the first dedicated CRO hire. You'll shape the strategy, the methodology, and the hypothesis backlog from scratch, not inherit someone else's system.

Brands people know. Work across multiple ecommerce categories, including a major name in the gaming and energy space.

You have real CRO experience and don't need someone walking you through the basics.
You're comfortable making fast, judgement-backed calls rather than waiting weeks for a single test to reach textbook statistical significance.
You're proactive by default: you spot what needs testing next without being told.
You're a strong researcher who can look at a page and know what's holding it back.
You communicate well in English and are confident enough to eventually get on client calls.
You want ownership, not a checklist: you think like someone building a department, not executing a queue of tickets.
You're based in a time zone within two to four hours of Pacific time.
Worked at an agency juggling multiple brands at once rather than a single in-house site.
Got hands-on skills in copywriting, design, or data analysis on top of CRO strategy.
Used AI tools to speed up research, copy, or testing workflows.
description:
About the job

Most agencies say they do conversion optimization. This one actually ships. Landing pages go from brief to live in 48 hours, not a month. Calls on what to test get made with real judgement, not just data, so nobody's sitting around for two weeks waiting on a button colour test to hit significance. If that pace sounds like your kind of work, keep reading.




This agency built its name on creative strategy and media buying for DTC ecommerce brands, and it's good enough at both that clients pay a premium for it. Now CRO is becoming its own department, and they're bringing in someone senior to build and run it.




This is a full-time, remote contractor role. 

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

You build the department, not just the tests. This is the first dedicated CRO hire. You'll shape the strategy, the methodology, and the hypothesis backlog from scratch, not inherit someone else's system.
Unlimited PTO. Take the time you need to do the work well.
Performance bonuses. The agency runs on incentives and every hire is on one.
Real growth path. As the department proves itself and more clients come on, there's a clear path to building out a team under you.
Direct line to the founders. You'll work closely with the founder driving strategy day to day, with a fast route to getting in front of clients once you've earned the trust.
Brands people know. Work across multiple ecommerce categories, including a major name in the gaming and energy space.




WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO

Own CRO strategy and execution across several DTC ecommerce accounts at once.
Build and run the hypothesis backlog and testing methodology from the ground up.
Ship continuous tests across landing pages, PDPs, homepages, and checkout: carousels, buy box changes, new sections, full page builds.
Partner with the media buyer and creative strategist on each account to align messaging and decide what gets built next.
Brief the in-house Replo developer and design resource to bring your ideas to life.
Audit new client PDPs and landing pages during onboarding and set the initial testing roadmap.
Read performance data and make the call on what to test next, backed by both numbers and judgement.
Earn a seat on client calls as you prove you can represent the work and the agency well.




WHO YOU ARE

You have real CRO experience and don't need someone walking you through the basics.
You're comfortable making fast, judgement-backed calls rather than waiting weeks for a single test to reach textbook statistical significance.
You're proactive by default: you spot what needs testing next without being told.
You're a strong researcher who can look at a page and know what's holding it back.
You communicate well in English and are confident enough to eventually get on client calls.
You want ownership, not a checklist: you think like someone building a department, not executing a queue of tickets.
You're based in a time zone within two to four hours of Pacific time.

Bonus if you've:

Worked at an agency juggling multiple brands at once rather than a single in-house site.
Got hands-on skills in copywriting, design, or data analysis on top of CRO strategy.
Used AI tools to speed up research, copy, or testing workflows.

title: Strategy Intern
skills: Exposed to influential leaders and learn how decision-making happens in the highest levels of corporate strategy.

As a Strategy Intern you'll be monitoring the competitive landscape to identify emerging threats and opportunities, exploring new markets and product verticals, and serving as our “eyes on the ground” for Mexico’s evolving macroeconomic environment and regulatory context.
The work is dynamic and evolves with the needs of the business, requiring a proactive and adatable mindset.

You’ll help DiDi’s leadership in China and Mexico understand where to play and how to win, translating local dynamics into clear, data-driven recommendations while being attentive to cultural nuances and strategic implications.
A background in finance or economics, and a curious mind paired with a strong analytical toolkit to match it.
You enjoy digging into data, markets, and regulation to uncover insights, and you can structure complex problems into clear, actionable reports.

You are an intelectual with an interest in finance and the economy, and a collaborative team player who thrives in fast-paced, cross-cultural environments, and you communicate in concise, well-structured written English.
You care about details, whether in a model, a slide, or a short memo, because you understand that precision and clarity are essential when advising senior leaders on high-stakes decisions.
description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

A key unit within the Strategy & Planning (S&P) function, the Fintech Strategy team is small and highly selective. It is made up of highly accomplished professionals with backgrounds in technology, management consulting, and investment banking. It has a central role in helping our top leaders answer their most pressing questions and support their most impactful decisions. Our team partners directly with senior stakeholders based in China, to frame problems, structure thinking, conduct research, and generate insights that drive high-impact decisions across DiDi Fintech in Mexico and, increasingly, the broader LatAm region. Members of this team share an endless sense of curiosity and are able to turn raw data into valuable knowledge and actionable insights. Our team works on strategic initiatives that shape our product roadmap, market positioning, and long-term growth, connecting on-the-ground realities in Mexico with the priorities of our global headquarters in China. The team is focused on the future, delegating the execution of plans to local operational teams while they're already looking forward to what will come after, working several steps ahead, to establish a path forward.

In this role, you'll be...


Exposed to influential leaders and learn how decision-making happens in the highest levels of corporate strategy.
 As a Strategy Intern you'll be monitoring the competitive landscape to identify emerging threats and opportunities, exploring new markets and product verticals, and serving as our “eyes on the ground” for Mexico’s evolving macroeconomic environment and regulatory context.
The work is dynamic and evolves with the needs of the business, requiring a proactive and adatable mindset.
You’ll help DiDi’s leadership in China and Mexico understand where to play and how to win, translating local dynamics into clear, data-driven recommendations while being attentive to cultural nuances and strategic implications.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


A background in finance or economics, and a curious mind paired with a strong analytical toolkit to match it.
You enjoy digging into data, markets, and regulation to uncover insights, and you can structure complex problems into clear, actionable reports.
You are an intelectual with an interest in finance and the economy, and a collaborative team player who thrives in fast-paced, cross-cultural environments, and you communicate in concise, well-structured written English.
You care about details, whether in a model, a slide, or a short memo, because you understand that precision and clarity are essential when advising senior leaders on high-stakes decisions.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

About The Team

The marketing team amplifies Mural’s story to the world through creative, strategic, and measurable programs that drive awareness and engagement. We’re a collaborative group of marketers, storytellers, and relationship builders passionate about connecting with customers and partners in meaningful ways. Together, we shape how the world experiences Mural through events, partnerships, and thought leadership.

YOUR MISSION

Mural is looking for a strategic and collaborative Corporate Marketing Manager to help shape how we bring our brand and company story to market. This role sits at the center of our go to market strategy, partnering across Growth Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership to deliver integrated campaigns that build brand awareness, accelerate pipeline, and strengthen buyer engagement.

You will lead cross-functional marketing initiatives that connect our corporate narrative with business priorities—from webinars and executive programs to strategic campaigns, product launches, industry events, and sales-led growth initiatives. You’ll thrive in this role if you’re equal parts strategist, storyteller and operator: someone who loves building alignment, managing complex projects, and transforming ideas into impactful marketing programs.

Collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to develop programs that support strategic account engagement and pipeline acceleration.
Support Event Marketing on executive experiences, customer events, and account-based initiatives that strengthen relationships with key prospects and customers.
Support Content Marketing on Webinars, Whitepapers and other offerings that generate leads and pipeline
Partner with Product Marketing and GTM leadership to support product launches, strategic announcements, and company initiatives.
Execute integrated corporate marketing campaigns that align brand, product, customer, and revenue objectives.
Ensure consistent messaging and execution across owned, earned, paid, partner, and event channels.
Measure campaign performance and optimize based on business outcomes and insights.

Experience working with Europe or be able to work a 6:00 am to 3:00 pm working shift

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. "The heatmap shows people stop scrolling before the CTA, so the CTA moves above the fold" is. When it is something you can build, you build it.
You narrate the numbers. In two minutes, in plain English: what is working, what is not, and what is next.
You catch problems first. The client never discovers an issue we have not already told them about.
You spot the next win. Not a pitch. Arithmetic out loud with the client's own numbers until the next step is obvious.
Every client in your book got a response within one business hour of reaching out and a real answer or a timeline within a day.
Every client request became a ClickUp task with enough context that nobody had to come back to you to ask what it meant.
You ran the client calls yourself. The CEO was not on them.
You built or fixed automations, workflows or pages yourself instead of leaving them in someone else's queue.
Your pod's daily client updates went out accurate, because you read them before they shipped and corrected the one that was wrong.
No client surprised anyone with a problem, and no client cancelled without the risk being visible weeks earlier.

You get your hands dirty. You are comfortable building things yourself, not just asking someone else to.

You own outcomes. You have handled client relationships and can tell us what you kept, what you lost and why. Haven't owned a client book yet? Tell us honestly, and tell us about the closest thing you've done.
You bring bad news early, with a plan. You do not wait to be asked.

Healthcare or high-ticket cash-pay client experience
GoHighLevel, or a similar CRM and automation platform
Zapier, Make or other automation tools
Meta Ads Manager
Briefing builders, designers or media buyers, and getting the work back right the first time
Junior Client Success Managers start at $1,500 USD per month, plus a share of the pod's monthly bonus pool.
Raises follow responsibility, not tenure. More output and more responsibility earn more. Time served does not.
A 90-day review with the CEO, where we look at the results and set what comes next.
Find where you are strongest. Some people in this seat grow into leading a pod; others move toward strategy, ads or automation. Both are wins.
CSM to Strategist. This is a real step people here have been offered.
Earn more by carrying more. Cover more than one seat in your pod well and you earn more than one seat's share of the bonus.
Learn a niche most marketers never touch. Doctors as clients, four- and five-figure treatments. People who get good at this are rare, and they get paid like it.
Room to build, zero micromanagement. See a better way to run things? Say so and run it.
Reply to clients within 1 business hour, even if it is "got it, looking into it," with a real answer or a timeline within 24. Reply to internal Slack within 10 minutes.
Decisions live on the ClickUp task or in the client channel. Never in DMs.
Monday all-hands, 9:00 to 10:30 AM Eastern.
This is a fully remote position. If you do not have a quiet, productive place to work from home with reliable power and internet, this is not the right role for you.
Going quiet is the one thing that does not work here. Missed a deadline? Tell us. Stuck? Say "I hit a wall." Problems get named the same day, in the open.

No recipe, and the structure keeps moving. We are "building the plane while flying it," and pods, seats and clients change as we grow. The first 2 to 3 weeks are quiet. The people who thrive start digging before anyone asks.
The CEO is direct. Plain feedback, expected back. He loves being challenged and hates silence.

Doctors push back, and quality beats volume. Our clients are smart, busy and spending their own money, so you hold your ground with evidence. A cheap lead who cannot afford a $4,000 treatment is not a win. Compliance is non-negotiable: no guarantees, no definitive claims.
You are the last set of eyes. Errors that should have been caught in QA come out of the pod's bonus pool, just as retention and expansion grow it.
Give a shit. We act like this is our business, because in a way it is.
Better before bigger. Scale is earned by delivering undeniable value.
Sincere candor. Candor is kindness. We speak the hard truth early.
Move fast. Fix it. We ship fast, but we do not move on until it is fixed.
Prove it works. If it has not been tested, it is still just an opinion.
Unimpeachable character. We do not lie, hide or cut corners, especially when it is inconvenient.
Subject line: "I actually read the instructions."
A link to your resume as a PDF, named Lastname.Firstname.JuniorCSM.pdf
Your written answer: "Tell us about a client you lost. What did you see too late, and what would you do differently?"
A 2-minute Loom, camera on: why you want this role, and one real way you used AI in your work this week.

Terms: full-time independent contractor, paid semi-monthly in USD. 20 days of paid time off a year, including six US holidays, approved in advance. Fourteen-day notice, either party. Location flexible, Eastern hours fixed.




How we work




Reply to clients within 1 business hour, even if it is "got it, looking into it," with a real answer or a timeline within 24. Reply to internal Slack within 10 minutes.
Decisions live on the ClickUp task or in the client channel. Never in DMs.
Monday all-hands, 9:00 to 10:30 AM Eastern.




Skunks on the table




Every line is true. If one makes you want to close the tab, that is useful for both of us. If they make you lean in, you are probably who we are looking for.

This is a fully remote position. If you do not have a quiet, productive place to work from home with reliable power and internet, this is not the right role for you.
Going quiet is the one thing that does not work here. Missed a deadline? Tell us. Stuck? Say "I hit a wall." Problems get named the same day, in the open.
No recipe, and the structure keeps moving. We are "building the plane while flying it," and pods, seats and clients change as we grow. The first 2 to 3 weeks are quiet. The people who thrive start digging before anyone asks.
The CEO is direct. Plain feedback, expected back. He loves being challenged and hates silence.
Doctors push back, and quality beats volume. Our clients are smart, busy and spending their own money, so you hold your ground with evidence. A cheap lead who cannot afford a $4,000 treatment is not a win. Compliance is non-negotiable: no guarantees, no definitive claims.
You are the last set of eyes. Errors that should have been caught in QA come out of the pod's bonus pool, just as retention and expansion grow it.




Our values




Give a shit. We act like this is our business, because in a way it is.
Better before bigger. Scale is earned by delivering undeniable value.
Sincere candor. Candor is kindness. We speak the hard truth early.
Move fast. Fix it. We ship fast, but we do not move on until it is fixed.
Prove it works. If it has not been tested, it is still just an opinion.
Unimpeachable character. We do not lie, hide or cut corners, especially when it is inconvenient.




How to apply




Still reading? Good. That is the first test. Here is the second: follow these exactly.

Subject line: "I actually read the instructions."
A link to your resume as a PDF, named Lastname.Firstname.JuniorCSM.pdf
Your written answer: "Tell us about a client you lost. What did you see too late, and what would you do differently?"
A 2-minute Loom, camera on: why you want this role, and one real way you used AI in your work this week.
Send it all to: andrea+csmli@guidepostmarketing.com

We are genuinely excited to meet the person who reads this and thinks, "Finally." If you have a question before you apply, put it in your email and we will answer it. We cannot wait to see what you send.

Who We Are




Rothbard Group, based in Panama, is a boutique cross-border tax and corporate structuring firm that helps successful families and entrepreneurs protect and grow their wealth offshore. 




The firm is grounded in individual sovereignty and free-market economics. Our work uniquely combines the technical depth of traditional law firms and Big 4 practices with the modern client experience of offshore consultancies. 




Our lead tax attorney has built a large and engaged international audience through our popular YouTube channel, giving us a distinctive brand and a steady flow of high-quality inbound interest.







The Opportunity

Your role is to quickly understand what sophisticated clients truly need, build genuine trust, and guide the right prospects to choose Rothbard as their partner. Most sales roles in professional services ask you to sell someone else’s vision. Here you will be representing a firm whose principles you can actually stand behind — and whose clients care deeply about the same things you do.




You get the commercial upside of a sales role, the intellectual interest of complex cross-border work, and the lifestyle freedom that most corporate jobs simply do not offer.

We want someone scrappy, passionate about solving problems, and genuinely curious about what AI can do for how PMs work. You'll own features for ACME end to end, from discovery through launch, and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, customer facing teams, and marketing. Beyond the ACME brand, you will need to understand what Peek and Connect&GO are building, so you can spot chances to extend a feature across brands instead of building it three times. Over time, there's room to take on more, including owning product areas across brands.

Peek is leaning into AI to solve problems, clear bottlenecks, and move faster, so we can deliver more value to the businesses that rely on us. We are looking for someone with product management experience who’s also excited about that shift and wants to help figure out how AI gets used here.

What You'll Do


Own features from discovery through launch. Write specs and PRDs engineering can act on without three rounds of clarifying questions, and think through edge cases before anything ships
Run discovery directly with customers: interviews, calls, feedback loops, not just tickets that land in your queue. Ask why before you write requirements, and be able to name the user problem behind every ticket
Manage a ticket backlog with accuracy. Nothing falls through the cracks
Use analytics tools to monitor usage, find opportunities, and measure what you shipped
Prioritize a roadmap with competing asks, and say no to things that don't move the needle
Use AI to move faster on the parts of the job that used to be slow: turning research into a spec, digging through tickets for patterns, drafting a first-pass PRD you then sharpen, and experiment with new ways of working with Engineering as tools and development practices evolve
Stay plugged into what's possible. Try new tools, bring back what works, help set the norm for how the team uses AI


What We're Looking For


3+ years in product management, owning discovery, requirements, and cross-functional delivery
Strong fundamentals: clear written and verbal communication, detail-oriented, organized, good at tracking and structuring work. Your specs get acted on, your updates are short and complete
Comfortable with technical conversations. You can follow an engineering tradeoff, not just translate requirements
Can prioritize ruthlessly and defend the call when a stakeholder pushes back
Comfortable owning status updates to leadership: what's on track, what's at risk, what you need
User-grounded. You can always name the problem behind a ticket
Curious about where AI takes product work, and want to be part of figuring that out here

description:
About the job

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Merchant Care Analyst I is the foundational tier within our Merchant Care organisation, responsible for delivering efficient and timely responses to merchant inquiries. You will support tickets raised by merchants through any channel, instant messaging, email or web form, as well as requests from internal stakeholders, ensuring queries are addressed promptly and accurately within a specific product scope. The role combines resolving documented issues independently using our established knowledge base with recognising cases of higher complexity and escalating them with clear context to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst. Success in this role means strong communication, a solid understanding of payments, and a genuine sense of urgency in everything you pick up.

What You Will Be Doing


Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system, remaining logged in and active during working hours.
Investigate and respond to merchant inquiries, as well as requests from internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.
Perform initial investigations and refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate, providing full context for a speedy resolution.
Resolve tickets using the existing knowledge base, identify documentation gaps, request new SOPs, and keep documentation up to date.
Maintain a solid understanding of our products, services, and policies to provide accurate information to merchants.
Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimise errors and deliver consistent care.
Categorise issues in the global queue and identify repetitive problems, escalating likely root causes to the wider team.
Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with our Product and Engineering teams.
Participate actively in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups.


About You


2+ years of experience in technical support or operations roles, ideally within Fintech, Banking or Financial Services.
A degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Data or a related field, though equivalent professional experience in other disciplines will be considered.
A comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end payment flow
Strong problem-solving skills, breaking a merchant-reported symptom into checkable components and working through them methodically rather than by trial and error.
Proficient in one or more of the following: API troubleshooting with Postman, log and event analysis with Datadog, data querying with Looker, Snowflake or SQL, and secure environment access tooling such as Guacamole.
Comfortable following SOPs and troubleshooting guides accurately, and knowing which tool applies to which category of task.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to interpret complex technical issues in simple business terms for merchants and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to manage a live workload against SLA countdowns in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high service standards.
Proficiency in using customer service software (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce) and CRM tools.
Proven ability to work independently as well as collaborate effectively across teams, seeking guidance proactively to ensure positive outcomes for merchants.
A genuine appetite for learning new concepts and technologies quickly, approaching all work with urgency, enthusiasm and a growth mindset.


Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Acerca de WPP Media

WPP es la empresa de transformación creativa. Aprovechamos el poder de la creatividad para construir un futuro mejor para nuestra gente, el planeta, nuestros clientes y nuestras comunidades. Para obtener más información, visita wpp.com.

WPP Media es el colectivo global de medios de WPP. En un mundo donde los medios están en todas partes y en todo, reunimos las mejores plataformas, personas y socios para crear oportunidades ilimitadas de crecimiento. Para obtener más información, visita wppmedia.com

En WPP Media, creemos en el poder de nuestra cultura y de nuestra gente. Es lo que nos impulsa a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales tanto a nuestros clientes como entre nosotros. En este puesto, será fundamental adoptar los valores fundamentales compartidos por WPP y WPP Media:


Ser extraordinarios liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.
Crear un ambiente abierto equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y de los clientes mediante el fomento de la confianza.

Herramientas: Es deseable conocimiento en soluciones CTV, DOOH programático, Meta, Amazon y herramientas de medición, reporting y dashboards.
Medios a manejar: Digital y programmatic, principalmente Video, Display, CTV y DOOH. Deseable conocimiento de Social, Audio y ecosistemas como Amazon.


Vida en WPP Media y Beneficios

Nuestra pasión por construir la nueva era de los medios cobra vida gracias a nuestro compromiso con Ser Extraordinarios, invirtiendo en nuestra gente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora. También Lideramos con Optimismo, creyendo firmemente e Impulsando el Crecimiento y Desarrollo de cada persona. Este compromiso permite a nuestro equipo en WPP Media aprovechar la amplia red global de WPP Media y WPP para perseguir sus pasiones, construir conexiones profesionales clave y aprender en la vanguardia del marketing y la publicidad.

Creamos un Entorno Abierto basado en la confianza y el respeto, donde cada persona sienta que pertenece y tenga oportunidades reales de crecer. Esta cultura inclusiva se fomenta a través de diversos grupos de recursos para empleados (ERG) y eventos frecuentes en la oficina para destacar los logros del equipo, compartir liderazgo de pensamiento y celebrar fechas especiales e hitos importantes. Nuestro paquete integral de beneficios refleja este compromiso e incluye seguro médico, de visión y dental, planes grupales de retiro, un generoso programa de tiempo libre pagado, descuentos preferenciales con aliados y días dedicados al bienestar y la salud mental de nuestro equipo.

En WPP Media ofrecemos igualdad de oportunidades y consideramos todas las postulaciones sin discriminación. Creemos que el mejor trabajo surge cuando estamos juntos, potenciando la creatividad, la colaboración y la conexión en un entorno abierto y colaborativo. Por eso, hemos adoptado un modelo de trabajo híbrido, asistiendo a la oficina alrededor de tres días a la semana. Si requieres alguna adaptación o flexibilidad, te invitamos a conversarlo con el equipo de selección durante el proceso de entrevista. Ten en cuenta que, si bien nuestra filosofía es la misma en todo WPP, los beneficios específicos pueden variar según la oficina o el país.

Por favor, consulta nuestro Aviso de Privacidad (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) para obtener más información sobre cómo procesamos la información que nos proporcionas.

description:
About the job

GoHighLevel Marketing Operations Specialist




Location: Latin America - Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Schedule: Part-time initially – approximately 20 hours/week, with potential to expand

Start Date: As soon as possible




About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on GoHighLevel Marketing Operations Specialist to build, manage, and continuously improve the marketing infrastructure for a growing organization.

This is a technical marketing operations role, not a general Virtual Assistant or content-writing position. You will be responsible for turning marketing strategies and campaigns into reliable, functioning systems inside GoHighLevel.

You will work closely with the marketing and digital strategy team, who will provide direction on messaging, campaign strategy, SEO priorities, and lead-scoring strategy. Your responsibility will be to configure, execute, test, troubleshoot, document, and optimize the underlying marketing systems and workflows.

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, technically capable, comfortable working independently, and able to identify potential issues before they affect a live campaign.

Key Responsibilities

GoHighLevel Administration

Administer and maintain GoHighLevel agency and sub-account environments.
Build and maintain workflows, automations, pipelines, tags, triggers, forms, calendars, and email templates.
Configure and maintain CRM structures and marketing processes.
Ensure GoHighLevel systems remain organized, accurate, and scalable.
Manage multiple brands, campaigns, and sub-accounts when required.

CRM & Data Management

Maintain clean and accurate contact databases.
Manage list hygiene, segmentation, tagging, and lifecycle statuses.
Configure lead-routing rules to ensure leads reach the appropriate destination.
Maintain accurate source attribution and campaign tracking.
Identify and correct data inconsistencies, duplicate records, missing fields, and routing issues.
Help establish standardized naming conventions and data structures.

Email Marketing & Automation

Build reusable email campaign templates for newsletters, lead nurturing, webinar promotions, follow-up campaigns, re-engagement campaigns, and other recurring marketing campaigns.
Schedule, test, launch, and monitor email campaigns using content supplied by the marketing team.
Build automated nurture sequences and lifecycle-based communications.
Test email triggers, links, personalization, segmentation, and delivery before campaigns go live.
Monitor campaign performance and identify technical or operational issues.

Webinar Marketing Operations

Configure webinar registration workflows.
Build automated webinar reminder sequences.
Set up attendance and registration tracking.
Create follow-up workflows based on registration, attendance, non-attendance, drop-off, and engagement.
Configure lead routing and segmentation based on webinar activity.
Build reusable webinar campaign templates that can be replicated for future events.
Work with WebinarKit or comparable webinar platforms.

Website & Landing Page Operations

Support the technical administration of GoHighLevel-hosted websites and landing pages.
Configure and maintain website forms.
Ensure form submissions are correctly captured in GoHighLevel.
Configure appropriate tags, source attribution, and lead routing.
Support implementation of metadata, structured schema, tracking codes, UTM parameters, and website analytics.
Identify opportunities to improve website tracking and page performance.

Lead Scoring & MQL Management

Implement lead-scoring and marketing-qualified-lead workflows based on the marketing team's strategy.
Configure MQL thresholds and routing rules.
Set up notifications and automated actions based on lead activity.
Maintain lifecycle stages and qualification criteria.
Monitor lead-scoring performance and help refine workflows based on campaign data.

Integrations & Troubleshooting

Configure and maintain marketing technology integrations.
Work with native integrations, APIs, webhooks, Zapier, Make, or similar automation tools.
Support integrations involving GA4, AWS SES, social platforms, website tracking, email systems, CRM, and marketing platforms.
Investigate data synchronization problems and integration failures.
Troubleshoot email events, including delivery issues and hard-bounce data that may not properly sync into GoHighLevel.
Identify the root cause of technical issues and implement reliable solutions.

Reporting & Analytics

Build and maintain practical marketing dashboards and reports.
Track email performance, campaign results, website traffic, lead sources, MQL activity, lead conversion, webinar performance, and marketing pipeline activity.
Ensure reporting data is accurate and properly attributed.
Help identify gaps in tracking and reporting.
Use performance data to recommend operational improvements.

Documentation & Process Improvement

Document workflows, automations, integrations, naming conventions, and processes.
Create repeatable procedures for campaigns and webinars.
Maintain clear documentation so systems can be easily understood and managed by other team members.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reliability, and scalability.
Establish processes that reduce manual work and prevent recurring errors.

Required Qualifications

Strong, hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL/HighLevel).
Demonstrated experience building and managing workflows, automations, pipelines, tags, triggers, forms, calendars, email campaigns, and sub-accounts.
Experience implementing marketing operations systems rather than simply using GoHighLevel as a basic CRM.
Experience with CRM/database management.
Strong understanding of contact segmentation and lifecycle management.
Experience building email automation and nurture sequences.
Practical experience with webinar marketing workflows.
Working knowledge of website tracking, forms, GA4, UTM parameters, and marketing analytics.
Ability to configure and troubleshoot integrations using Zapier, Make, webhooks, APIs, or similar tools.
Strong attention to detail and testing discipline.
Ability to troubleshoot technical and operational issues independently.
Clear written and spoken English.
Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with WebinarKit or comparable webinar platforms.
Familiarity with AWS SES and email deliverability.
Experience with technical SEO/AEO implementation.
Understanding of metadata and structured schema.
Experience managing multiple GoHighLevel brands or sub-accounts.
Experience migrating or rebuilding marketing operations following a HubSpot-to-GoHighLevel transition.
Experience with dashboarding and reporting tools beyond GoHighLevel.
Background supporting B2B SaaS, consulting, professional services, or event/conference marketing.
Experience with lead scoring and MQL lifecycle management.
Experience working with marketing technology stacks and integrations.




What Success Looks Like

During the first 60–90 days, the successful candidate will help establish a clean, reliable, and scalable GoHighLevel marketing environment.




Success will include:

Clean and dependable data structures.
Proper contact segmentation and tagging.
Reliable lead routing and lifecycle management.
Reusable email campaign and nurture workflows.
Repeatable webinar registration and follow-up workflows.
Properly configured forms and website tracking.
Accurate source attribution.
Functional marketing dashboards.
Improved visibility into email, website, campaign, and MQL performance.
Clear documentation of workflows and processes.
Identification and prioritization of gaps involving GA4, AWS SES, website tracking, and future marketing integrations.




Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys working behind the scenes of marketing systems and is comfortable getting into the technical details.

You should be someone who can take a marketing requirement such as:

"We need to capture webinar registrants, send reminders, identify attendees, route qualified leads, and follow up with people who didn't attend."

—and independently turn that requirement into a fully functioning, tested GoHighLevel workflow.

You should be comfortable asking questions when requirements are unclear, testing your work before launch, troubleshooting when something breaks, and documenting what you've built.

This role is best suited for someone who considers themselves a GoHighLevel Specialist, Marketing Automation Specialist, Marketing Operations Specialist, CRM Automation Specialist, or similar technical marketing professional rather than a general VA or content marketer.

About the job

Overview

CARRERAS PARA SONREIR 

 

En PepsiCo, descubrirás un lugar donde nuestra misión es crear sonrisas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 500 marcas queridas, incluyen Gatorade, Lay's y Quaker y nuestro trabajo llega a millones de personas cada día.

 

En el corazón de nuestra compañía hay un equipo de pensadores y creadores que colaboran para innovar y convertir las ideas en acciones. Impulsados por la innovación y centrados en crear momentos de alegría a través de los alimentos y bebidas, nuestras decisiones se guían por y para el consumidor, creando oportunidades para que nuestros asociados realicen un trabajo significativo y tengan un impacto duradero en las comunidades a las que servimos.

 

Sea cual sea tu función, formarás parte de una comunidad global que valora tus ideas y te empodera para que tengas impacto en tu carrera y en el mundo que te rodea. 

Responsibilities

La oportunidad 

La función principal del rol es garantizar el seguimiento diario al proyecto de vueltas de cartón, buscando la mejora continua a través de la implementación de iniciativas en conjunto con todas las partes involucradas dentro de la cadena E2E (Planta, Bodegas, Transporte y Ventas), de tal forma fomentamos una transformación cultural para concientizarnos al cuidado de cartón, contribuyendo a la estrategia Pep+ poniendo la sostenibilidad en el centro de todo lo que hacemos, mejorando consecuentemente los resultados del negocio dejando un impacto ambiental positivo.

Tu impacto 

Como Productivity Sr Supervisor tus responsabilidades constarían de… 


Definición de estrategia y Governance anual con base a las oportunidades YAGO analizadas previamente y los desafíos para el año actual.
Calcular corte de indicadores de forma semanal y validar con el equipo de planta los resultados, resolver discrepancias en caso de que exista alguna. Y compartir al equipo de liderazgo el scorecard, bright spots y hot spots.
Asegurar continuidad en el monitoreo diario de merma, dando visibilidad de las oportunidades a través de Power Bi, logrando enfocar esfuerzos priorizando los Cedis de mayor oportunidad basándonos en datos cuantitativos, haciendo usos de recursos digitales. 
Liderar las sesiones semanales con todo el equipo extendido, donde se revisan resultados, se generan compromisos y se da seguimiento a planes de acción, documentando la ejecución de mejoras.
Proporcionar información y análisis a las personas claves para detectar oportunidades de forma oportuna, definir métricas clave del proyecto.
Participar en los mapeos y workshops con plantas y proveedores para identificar necesidades, atacar causas raíz de los problemas y generar planes de acción sostenibles.
Avanzar de manera acelerada en las iniciativas clave, que facilite la entrega de resultados.
Documentación de los diferentes procesos estándar del proyecto de cartón: proceso de retorno, proceso de selección, mapeo de cartón a nivel cadena.
Impartir onboarding de cartón a los nuevos integrantes de productividad y personas que se integren al proyecto de cartón. Alineando a todas las partes involucradas para la comprensión del proyecto.
Buscar nuevas herramientas que faciliten el uso de la información y data analysis, como Power BI, Good Software manager, Planner, Power Apps.
Seguimiento semanal con equipo de R&D y Calidad Central para revisión a desviaciones de receta.
Seguimiento mensual con Contraloría a desviaciones de proceso estándar.
Conoce e implementa la metodología de Lean Sigma para la mejora continua de procesos.
Generación de contenido visual y difusión de campaña de cuidado de cartón #Cartonizate
Replica de buenas prácticas a lo largo de la cadena.
