title: Creador de Contenido para Redes Sociales
description:
About the job

Sobre nosotros

Symmetry es una app de salud y fitness con más de 3 millones de descargas: número uno de fitness en España, top 10 en varios mercados más y más de 200 millones de visualizaciones al mes en nuestros canales de Marketing. Estamos sumando creadores en México para seguir creciendo en la región.




Qué vas a crear

Piezas para redes sociales, con el carrusel como formato principal: varias tarjetas con imagen y texto, pensadas para retener la atención y para que la gente las guarde. Tú te encargas de la pieza completa, desde el concepto y el gancho inicial hasta la última tarjeta.




Tu semana de trabajo

Arrancas revisando qué está funcionando en fitness y bienestar dentro de redes: qué formatos se repiten, qué ganchos retienen y qué está saturado. 

Con eso armas propuestas y las llevas al Head of Content. Una vez validadas, produces siguiendo la línea editorial del equipo, registras tu trabajo en las herramientas internas y ajustas con el feedback de la revisión semanal.




Qué necesitas

Criterio para redes: distingues un gancho que funciona de uno que no y sabes explicar por qué. Manejo de formato vertical y de las herramientas para producirlo; con tu celular y computadora es suficiente. Escritura corta y precisa, porque el copy es la mitad de un buen carrusel. Capacidad de recibir feedback y aplicarlo rápido. Interés real por el fitness, la salud o el bienestar.




Suma puntos

Cuentas o piezas propias que podamos ver, sin importar el tamaño de la audiencia. Experiencia produciendo contenido orgánico con calendario y volumen sostenido. Conocer la escena de creadores de fitness y bienestar en México.




Cómo trabajamos

Trabajo remoto al cien por ciento y horario flexible: lo que cuenta es el contenido que sale, no el horario en que lo produces. Reportas directo al Head of Content, con metas definidas cada semana y una sesión de revisión para iterar sobre lo publicado.




Compensación y formato

Compensación competitiva, acorde a experiencia y dedicación. Posición remota desde México. Si el encaje funciona, existe camino de crecimiento dentro del equipo de contenido.




Tu candidatura

Mándanos trabajo que ya tengas publicado: tu TikTok, Instagram, carruseles, videos, lo que sea. Si todavía no tienes nada publicado, mándanos tres cuentas que te parezcan bien hechas y dinos exactamente qué hacen bien.

About the job

Job Description

Marketing Analyst | EF Language Abroad

What if your next role actually changed lives, including your own?

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that learning a language abroad is one of the most transformative experiences a person can have. And we need passionate, driven people to help make that happen. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Marketing Analyst to join our team in Polanco, Mexico. This is your chance to grow your career in a global company, work alongside an energetic and ambitious team, and help shape the way young people discover life changing experiences abroad.

You'll be at the heart of our digital presence: creating content, managing campaigns, and turning data into insights that drive real results. No two days look the same, just creative work, real impact, and a team that's genuinely rooting for you from day one.

Your Main Responsibilities

Digital Marketing


 Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, and other digital channels. 
 Manage the brand's social media channels, including content scheduling, posting, and community engagement. 
 Monitor campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations. 


Content Creation


 Develop engaging content for social media, email marketing, blogs, and other digital platforms. 
 Support the creation and localization of global marketing materials for the local market. 
 Review and ensure all content is aligned with brand guidelines and tone of voice. 


Analytics and Reporting


 Track and report on key marketing KPIs, providing regular performance updates to the team. 
 Use data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. 
 Support A/B testing and other optimization initiatives. 


Collaboration


 Work closely with the sales team to align marketing efforts with business goals. 
 Collaborate with global marketing teams to adapt and localize campaigns. 
 Support the planning and execution of events and promotional actions. 


Requirements


 Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field. 
 Previous experience in digital marketing or content creation. 
 Proficiency in English. Additional languages are a plus. 
 Hands on experience with social media management tools, CRM, and analytics platforms. 
 Strong eye for design and familiarity with tools like Canva, Adobe, or equivalent. 
 Data driven mindset with strong analytical and communication skills. 
 Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast paced international environment. 


Why You Will Love Working with Us

More than just a job, we offer a career, and the benefits grow with you.

From Day One, All EF Team Members Enjoy


 Benefits by local law 
 Corporate benefits discounts 
 Staff referral bonus (500 USD) 
 EF Hello App 
 Access to the Mental Health App "Foundation" 


As a Marketing Analyst, You Also Unlock


 Global Mobile Office 
 National KO recognition 
 EF Summer Helper Nomination: 1 week as a group helper abroad 
 Famtrip Nomination: travel to the USA 


As you grow through our career ladder, even more doors open. Depending on your level, you may also unlock:


 Intercontinental Famtrip nominations 
 Free language courses and international training nominations 
 Hub Office visits with training and networking opportunities 
 Leadership development programs and international kickoffs 


 Benefits vary by career level and are subject to local labor laws and business eligibility criteria. 

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

At EF Language Abroad, we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we've helped millions of students discover new places, embrace diverse cultures, and gain fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to our mission of opening the world through education, harnessing the power of language learning to deepen the connection between people across the globe.

We offer immersive short-term and long-term language courses and programs across different languages in the countries where they’re spoken. Through blending classroom-based lessons with interactive exercises and real-world practice, our courses bring you to the heart of the language. Together, our global staff help students from around the world develop the language skills they need to achieve their dreams.

EF is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All positions are subject to a criminal background and/or reference checks, as applicable.

description:
About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT 

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity 

The Global Procurement Control System Support Associate Manager serves as the primary business liaison between the Global Procurement Control organization and IT teams, supporting critical procurement and control systems that enable global business operations. This role is responsible for ensuring the stability, effectiveness, and continuous improvement of key business applications, while driving automation, process enhancements, and digital transformation initiatives.

The position supports day-to-day business operations, system administration, user support, project execution, and controls-related activities. The role will partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Procurement, Planning, Control, and IT to identify solutions, improve processes, and deliver strategic system implementations.

Your Impact 

Serve as the functional liaison between business users and IT teams for Global Procurement and Control applications, including CCDS, T-Forms, QuickBase, CMS, Business Objects, Selectica, and Ariba CLM.

Administer, maintain, and support critical procurement and control systems to ensure ongoing operational effectiveness.

Manage user access, permissions, licensing, and system governance across supported platforms.

Lead issue resolution efforts by coordinating with business stakeholders, IT teams, and external vendors.

Identify and implement automation opportunities, process improvements, and system enhancements that drive efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Support system upgrades, testing, user acceptance activities, implementations, and post-deployment stabilization efforts.

Partner with cross-functional teams to execute strategic projects and digital transformation initiatives across Global Procurement.

Develop and maintain process documentation, training materials, and user guides.

Create and enhance dashboards, metrics, and reporting solutions to improve business visibility and decision-making.

Support controls-related activities, including system access management, cyclical application controls, master data maintenance, and accounting close support processes.

Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For? 

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

Experience supporting business applications, systems administration, process improvement, or IT business partnership functions.

Experience working with ERP systems, such as SAP, and business applications in a corporate environment.

Experience participating in system implementations, testing, automation, or digital transformation initiatives.

Technical Skills

Strong knowledge of business systems, applications, and reporting tools.

Experience Supporting Enterprise Applications Is Preferred.

Understanding of IT support processes, system governance, access controls, and application lifecycle management.

Experience leveraging AI and technology solutions to improve business processes, reporting, and analysis.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess risks and develop practical solutions.

Leadership and Professional Skills

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for business audiences and business requirements for technical teams.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.

Proven ability to influence stakeholders and collaborate effectively across functions and organizational levels.

Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to drive initiatives from concept through implementation.

Results-oriented mindset with demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, solve complex problems, and implement sustainable process improvements.

If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us: 


Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs. 
Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning. 
Development programs according to Leadership skills. 
Specialized training according to the role. 
Learning experiences with internal and external providers. 
We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others. 
Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life. 
A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle. 
And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others. 


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

title: Analista Mapeo y Diseño de Procesos
description:
About the job

Objetivo del puesto:

Mapear y diseñar los procesos que impulsen la integración de cada vertical del ecosistema al modelo operativo físico y Omnicanal, a través de la implementación de metodologías y herramientas probadas de mejora continua por medio del rediseño de la forma de trabajo con el fin de enriquecer la experiencia de Andrea y mejorar alcances, costos y gastos.




Responsabilidades:




Mapeo a análisis de procesos

•Mapear, entender y comunicar los procesos “as-is”, a través de diferentes niveles y herramientas de documentación (Procedimientos, Instructivos, Diagramas de flujo, Matrices RACI, Pareto, Ishikawa, AMEF, etc.) a fin de comprobar las hipótesis de mejora, eficiencia y escalabilidad en los flujos de la integración de las diferentes verticales.

•Analizar, evaluar y asegurar la eficiencia e impacto de las iniciativas y procesos de integración de cada vertical vs la estrategia de formato, a través del uso de herramientas lean y six sigma para identificar oportunidades y riesgos en los procesos (pilotos, Prueba de proporciones, 5 porqués, Matrices de causa raíz, etc.) para identificar cuellos de botella y/o puntos de fricción en el flujo E2E y definir requerimientos, puntos de control y medición.

•Proponer cambios en los procesos existentes de acuerdo con los puntos identificados para simplificar la ejecución en tiendas 

•Diseñar soluciones de supervisión efectivas para mejorar las oportunidades encontradas en comunicación y visitas a tiendas

•Coordinar con las áreas correspondientes los flujos de atención y solución de problemas para tiendas y kioscos .




Definición de estrategia

•Diseñar el flujo de proceso (to-be), planteando las hipótesis a comprobar y los kpi´s a impactar, utilizando Eventos Kaizen, Matrices de viabilidad y factibilidad, Marco ágil (ej. Designthinking, SCRUM), etc., para implementar las mejoras en los procesos y lograr las eficiencias comprometidas con el negocio para la integración de verticales en un ecosistema funcional y escalable.

•Diseñar herramientas que ayuden al personal de tienda a comprender y ejecutar los servicios y beneficios de cada vertical, así como el valor agregado que ofrecen a la experiencia del cliente con el fin de lograr una aceleración en el impulso de las verticales 

•Analizar los resultados de buenas practicas, promociones y concursos para determinar mejores prácticas a replicar 

•Alinear rutinas operativas de verticales en la operación para evitar procesos duplicados e instrucciones confusas 

•Construir el plan de capacitación de cada vertical para asegurar que los asociados se familiaricen y adopten los productos de las verticales.




Implementación e integración (Líder de proyecto)

•Gestionar y asegurar la implementación de mejoras a través de la medición de indicadores de desempeño de ecosistema y establecer a los responsables de los mismos, vigilando la eficiencia del proceso, ajustes de proceso, seguimiento a roll out con la finalidad de “ajustar” el flujo en caso de ser necesario para lograr la adopción y correcta ejecución del mismo.

•A través de la data y "caminar el proceso", identificar las oportunidades de refinamiento y eficiencia, mejora de la experiencia del cliente y reducción del costtoserv. Proponiendo soluciones operativas y tecnológicas cuantificando los beneficios de las mismas.

•Impulsar y apoyar la integración de las verticales en nuevo modelo operativo de kiosco 2.0 

•Implementar las mejoras propuestas en conjunto con las áreas involucradas para definir un modelo escalable 

•Dar seguimiento a la implementación de pruebas piloto, pruebas de concepto y centro de excelencia en tienda para la adecuación de rutinas operativas; así como analizar los resultados de cada una

•Consolidar la información clave para bajar a la operación los cambios en rutinas, programas vigentes y alcance a resultados 

•Establecer y comunicar objetivo y alcance de cada proyecto, coordinar la participación e involucramiento de las áreas y stakeholders desde su definición hasta la implementación de mejoras.




Buscamos:

Escolaridad: Ingeniería Industrial, Administración Industrial o afín a manejo de procesos.

considerando Información Financiera, Data y Análisis para generar estrategias.

Experiencia de al menos 3 años en gestión, diseño de procesos y proyectos de mejora en áreas comerciales y/o retail.

Deseable Certificación como PMO para coordinar equipos multidisciplinarios.

Excel avanzado, Power BI para el manejo de bases de datos, liderazgo, comunicación asertiva, planeación y organización.

Idioma: inglés intermedio




“En Walmart de México y Centroamérica estamos comprometidos con una cultura de pertenencia, por lo que buscamos incorporar el mejor talento basándonos en competencias, habilidades y potencial; no discriminamos por ningún motivo, incluyendo género, edad, origen étnico, apariencia física, estado civil, condiciones de salud por VIH o cualquier enfermedad, situación socioeconómica, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género por ello durante el proceso de atracción y selección no solicitaremos información personal, fotografías o análisis clínicos de ningún tipo. Los datos personales del candidato o candidata no son relevantes durante el proceso de entrevista ni para la selección final. En Walmart de México y Centroamérica nos comprometemos con nuestros/as asociados/as para que encuentren día a día en el trabajo un ambiente de respeto, libre de discriminación y acoso sexual.”

About CUBBO




We are CUBBO, a venture-backed fulfillment company operating in Mexico and Brazil.




We support brands by connecting their entire order journey—from purchase to delivery—through technology and operations.




Our platform serves hundreds of merchants, processes high monthly volumes, and delivers with speed and consistency.




We work from Mexico City, where our team builds tools and logistics capabilities for modern commerce.

To empower brands to gain freedom, becoming the platform present in every transaction of modern commerce.




We're not just here to compete; we're here to dominate and redefine the future of modern commerce. If you're a AAA player, CUBBO offers you an unparalleled platform to be a part of this industry-defining transformation.

We help modern commerce reduce friction and deliver better shopping experiences. Our platform connects the entire order journey—from purchase to delivery—through seamless technology, operations, and logistics.




Job Location




Mexico City (Headquarters)




Hybrid work model: 4 days on-site, 1 day remote




Yes, we are not remote only.




The Role




As an Account Executive at CUBBO, you'll be a critical force in revolutionizing modern commerce fulfillment across Latin America. HQ at Mexico City, you'll be part of the strategic development and execution of B2B sales initiatives, working closely with the Co-Founder and our elite growth team. Account Executives are a key player to maintain CUBBO's 100% YoY growth rhythm. Your role goes beyond transactional sales; it's about crafting consultative solutions that empower businesses to dominate the space. By fostering strong relationships and leveraging data insights, you'll not only be opening new doors but also setting the stage for DTC to become the leading model in modern commerce. If you're a proactive, resilient, and adaptable sales leader, this is your chance to be part of an industry-defining transformation while scaling a startup into a market leader.

- Meet and exceed sales quota from new customers

- Hunt for new opportunities

- Develop and execute B2B sales strategies with a Growth Mindset

- Manage complex negotiations with senior-level executives

- Build rapport and establish long term relationships with customers

- Employ consultative selling techniques to craft solutions

- Analyze sales data to adapt and optimize strategies

- WIN




Skills & Qualifications




- Adaptability: Embrace change as the only constant in our dynamic marketplace.

- Resilience: Face challenges head-on and rebound stronger from setbacks.

- Empathy: Go beyond listening; deeply understand customer needs.

- Communication Skills: Articulate ideas and solutions with clarity and precision.

- Networking Ability: Build genuine connections that translate into lasting relationships.

- Navigating Chaotic Environments: Thrive in complexity of the corporate world of our Customers, bringing order and strategy to every situation.

- Trust-Building: Establish trust as your currency




Hard Skills




- Negotiation: Close deals that are win-win and build lasting partnerships.

- Tech-Savvy: Master our tech stack to demonstrate real solutions.

- Data Analysis: Turn raw data into actionable strategies.

- CRM Mastery: Own our CRM system like it’s your second language, Manage your sales pipeline like a pro, always knowing what’s next.




Nice to Have




- Industry Knowledge: Eat, sleep, and breathe modern commerce (not logistics)

- Consultative Selling: Be a problem-solver first and a seller second.

- Account Management: Treat every account as a long-term partnership, not a transaction.

- Opening New Doors: Have an eye for opportunities and the courage to pursue them.

Customer First: At CUBBO, the customer is our North Star. We operate on the principle that the best decision for our customers is the best decision for us.




Trust: You place trust in your fellow Cubbeños, recognizing that internal teamwork is essential for our collective success.




Empowerment: At CUBBO, waiting for instructions is not an option. You're a catalyst for empowering others to take initiative and make impactful decisions.




Growth Mindset: You're always asking questions, hungry to improve. If you're not embarrassed by what you were doing six months ago, you're not growing fast enough.




Speed: Ideas alone don't win markets; swift and effective execution does. We act quickly, adapt promptly, and turn plans into results.




Candor: Transparency and constructive feedback are the bedrocks of our culture. We value honest insights aimed at personal and professional growth.




Why Join CUBBO?




Be Part of a Revolution




Join us in setting groundbreaking industry standards and changing the face of ecommerce in Latin America. We're revolutionizing the entire region through innovation.




Work with the Best




Accelerate your career growth exponentially at CUBBO. A year here equates to a decade of experience elsewhere. If you're a high-performer eager to join a cadre of like-minded champions, your search ends here.




Built to Last, Built to Win




We're not just surviving; we're thriving. Our sound financial health allows us to focus on what really matters—winning the market and ensuring an unparalleled customer experience.




Are you ready to win?

description:
About the job

Customer Success Specialist 

Schedule: 40 hours/week, Monday–Friday

Reports to: Business Unit Manager

About the role

We’re looking for a Customer Success Specialist to build strong, long-term relationships with Cleenora’s clients and help turn great service into long-term loyalty.

This person will become the main relationship owner for our clients. While Sales and Dispatch manage specific parts of the booking and service, the Customer Success Specialist gets to know the client, understands their preferences, follows their experience over time, and makes sure they feel valued and taken care of.

The goal is simple: keep clients happy, keep them coming back, and turn more one-time clients into recurring clients.

What you'll do

Client Success & Relationship Building

Build a personal relationship with a portfolio of Cleenora clients.
Regularly call clients to check in, gather feedback, and make sure they are happy with their service.
Become the person who knows the client's history, preferences, expectations, and relationship with Cleenora.
Keep client notes and preferences updated so the entire team has the information they need.
Track important client milestones and create opportunities to recognize and appreciate loyal clients.
Coordinate thank-you gestures, gifts, and other client appreciation initiatives.

Client Experience Check

Quickly review the next day's appointments to make sure everything looks in order.
Confirm the right cleaner is assigned and that known cleaner preferences are being respected.
Make sure important client requests, expectations, and property information are documented.
Flag anything that looks incorrect or incomplete to Dispatch and make sure it is addressed.
This role does not replace Dispatch or assign cleaners; it provides an additional client-experience check.

Retention & Customer Success

Monitor clients for signs that they may be unhappy or at risk of leaving.
Follow up with clients after their first cleaning and after important service interactions.
Help recover clients who are unhappy or considering cancelling.
Keep track of recurring clients and their relationship with Cleenora.
Identify opportunities to increase frequency, add services, or introduce relevant add-ons.
Help turn one-time clients into recurring clients through personal follow-up and relationship building.
Maintain a list of clients who need follow-up and make sure no relationship falls through the cracks.

Reviews & Referrals

Ask happy clients for Google and other online reviews at the right moment.
Encourage satisfied clients to recommend Cleenora to friends, family, and others.
Help increase positive reviews, referrals, and client engagement through genuine conversations.

What this role is NOT

This is not a dispatcher or dispatch supervisor position.

You will not be responsible for:

Assigning cleaners
Managing the dispatch team
Managing cleaner performance
Handling every operational question from clients
Managing the daily schedule
Quoting new clients

Instead, you will notice problems, communicate with the appropriate team, follow up, and make sure the client's experience is taken care of.

What we're looking for

Excellent spoken and written English.
Warm, confident, and natural on the phone.
Comfortable having genuine conversations with clients — this is a phone-heavy relationship role, not just a texting position.
Highly organized and excellent at following up.
Strong attention to detail.
Naturally proactive and attentive to what clients need.
Comfortable using CRM, booking systems, and spreadsheets.
Able to communicate across Sales, Dispatch, and Operations without needing to manage those teams.
Previous experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Relations, Hospitality, or Customer Service is a plus.
Spanish is a plus.

Success in this role looks like

Clients know who their Customer Success Specialist is and feel comfortable reaching out to them.
Client preferences and important history are consistently documented.
Problems are identified before they become bigger client issues.
Happy clients are regularly recognized and encouraged to leave reviews and referrals.
More one-time clients become recurring clients.
Fewer recurring clients leave.
Clients stay with Cleenora longer and increase their value over time.
The client experience feels personal, consistent, and organized — even as Cleenora grows.

About the job

Growth Marketing Lead — Buyer Acquisition (US & Canada Market)

Company: KasaFinder




Location: Remote (Based in Mexico or Argentina)




Role Type: Full-time | Early-Stage Core Team

About KasaFinder




This is a full-time position. Not meant to be a side-project or another client for your agency.




At KasaFinder, we are bridging the "trust gap" in Latin American real estate. We empower North American buyers (US & Canada) with the transparency, safety metrics, and neighborhood intelligence they need to confidently invest in top Latam destinations.

We are building a data-driven marketplace and an automated growth engine. We are looking for a sharp, hands-on Growth Marketing Lead to own our buyer acquisition strategy and scale our ecosystem from day one.

The Role




As our first Growth Marketing Lead, you will sit in the driver's seat of our top-of-funnel strategy. You won't just manage campaigns—you will build the acquisition framework across SEO, Paid Search, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AIO).

Your mission is clear: Drive qualified North American buyers to KasaFinder and maximize buyer-to-seller interactions.

You will work directly with the founders to test channels rapidly, optimize unit economics, and transform high-intent traffic into qualified leads.

Key Responsibilities

SEO & Content Strategy: Develop and execute an organic strategy tailored to US/Canadian buyer search intent (e.g., cross-border real estate, expat relocation, and Latam investment guides).
Performance Marketing: Launch, manage, and scale high-ROI Google Ads, Search, and Native Advertising campaigns targeting high-intent buyers.
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Continuously test and refine landing pages, user journeys, and inquiry funnels to boost visitor-to-lead conversion rates.
Next-Gen Search (GEO/AIO): Monitor, analyze, and optimize KasaFinder’s presence across AI search engines and LLMs (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Search Generative Experience).
Analytics & Attribution: Set up, track, and analyze buyer journeys using GA4, GTM, Search Console, and Microsoft Clarity to ensure clean attribution.
Funnel Integration: Work with our leadership team to sync marketing channels with our CRM ecosystem (Pipedrive) to ensure zero lead leakage.
Reporting & Velocity: Deliver data-driven insights and clear, actionable campaign reviews directly to executive leadership.

Key Success Metrics (KPIs)

Qualified Buyer-to-Seller Interactions (Primary Metric)
Cost Per Qualified Lead / Interaction (CPL / CPI)
Visitor-to-Interaction Conversion Rate (%)
Growth of High-Intent Organic & Paid Traffic
Buyer Retention & Re-engagement Rate

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience in Growth Marketing, Demand Gen, or Performance Marketing within PropTech, High-Ticket Marketplaces, or B2C SaaS.
Proven track record of acquiring and converting US/Canadian consumers.
Deep technical expertise with Google Ads, GA4, GTM, SEMrush/Ahrefs, and CRO tools.
Data-obsessed mindset: You know how to read the data, spot friction points, and iterate quickly.
Full professional fluency in English (both written and spoken) is required.
Self-starter mentality: You thrive in early-stage, fast-moving environments with high autonomy.
Must be based in Mexico or Argentina.

Strong Plus: Previous experience in Real Estate, Cross-Border Investments, FinTech, or Marketplace startups.

What We Offer

Direct leadership access: Work side-by-side with KasaFinder’s founders and shape the growth trajectory of the company.
High impact: Be a core member of an early-stage startup with the opportunity to build and lead the future marketing team.
Flexibility: 100% remote culture with a fast-paced, collaborative team atmosphere.
Competitive package: Attractive base salary + performance bonuses tied directly to growth milestones.

title: Business Development Representative | SaaS, FinTech & Tecnología | Prospección Outbound & Eventos
description:
About the job

Para nuestro cliente, una empresa internacional de tecnología especializada en comunicaciones en la nube, soluciones de contact center y automatización de interacciones con clientes, estamos en búsqueda de un/a Business Development Representative (BDR) – Outbound B2B para integrarse a su equipo comercial en México.




Esta posición es ideal para una persona con mentalidad hunter, experiencia en prospección outbound y capacidad para generar nuevas oportunidades comerciales en sectores B2B, especialmente dentro de tecnología, SaaS, fintech, contact center, CPaaS o soluciones de comunicación empresarial.




La persona seleccionada será responsable de identificar y contactar empresas objetivo, abrir conversaciones con tomadores de decisión, calificar oportunidades y agendar reuniones comerciales para el equipo, manteniendo una gestión ordenada y precisa del pipeline en CRM.

LO QUE BUSCAMOS EN NUESTRO/A CANDIDATO/A IDEAL:

1. A partir de 2+ años de experiencia en roles de prospección comercial, generación de leads outbound o desarrollo de ventas B2B. 

2. Experiencia deseable en sectores como tecnología B2B, SaaS, Fintech, contact center, CPaaS, cloud communications, soluciones digitales o servicios tecnológicos para empresas. 

3. Experiencia previa como Representante Comercial, Ejecutivo Comercial, SDR, BDR, Sales Development, Lead Generation o posiciones similares.

4. Mentalidad hunter y fuerte orientación a resultados, con comodidad para hacer contacto en frío, buscar nuevos prospectos y abrir puertas con tomadores de decisión. 

5. Capacidad para identificar empresas objetivo, entender el perfil de cliente ideal y calificar oportunidades comerciales de manera estructurada. 

6. Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar soluciones tecnológicas de forma clara, consultiva y profesional. 

7. Experiencia trabajando con CRM, registrando actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de oportunidades de manera ordenada y constante. 

8. Perfil organizado, proactivo, coachable y con actitud madura para representar a la empresa en primeras conversaciones comerciales y eventos de la industria. 

9. Inglés intermedio, suficiente para comunicarse con equipo internacional y entender información comercial del producto. 

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES DEL PUESTO:

1) Realizar prospección outbound a empresas objetivo definidas por la compañía. 

2) Contactar a prospectos a través de canales como LinkedIn, email, llamadas y otros medios comerciales. 

3) Representar a la empresa de manera profesional en eventos, conferencias y espacios de networking de la industria, realizando prospección activa y no solo atención pasiva de contactos.

4) Identificar y abrir conversaciones con los tomadores de decisión adecuados dentro de cada empresa. 

5) Calificar oportunidades comerciales, entendiendo las necesidades del prospecto, el fit con la solución y el potencial de negocio. 

6) Mantener información clara, completa y actualizada en el CRM sobre actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de cada cuenta. 

7) Dar seguimiento constante a prospectos y oportunidades en etapa inicial del proceso comercial. 

8) Proponer nuevas empresas objetivo cuando identifique oportunidades relevantes dentro del mercado. 




¿POR QUÉ UNIRTE A ESTE EQUIPO?

· Se ofrece una compensación altamente competitiva, de acuerdo con tu experiencia y perfil, junto con un atractivo esquema de bonos basado en resultados, porque las contribuciones sólidas deben ser realmente recompensadas.

· En este rol tendrás la posibilidad de participar directamente en la expansión comercial de la compañía en México, trabajando con un producto tecnológico de alto valor y con un equipo internacional orientado a resultados, aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional.

· Además, es una posición ideal si buscas desarrollar una carrera comercial en tecnología B2B, fortalecer tus habilidades de prospección outbound, aprender sobre soluciones complejas y tener exposición real a clientes, eventos de la industria y procesos comerciales consultivos.

· La empresa ofrece un entorno dinámico, flexible y de baja burocracia, donde se valora la responsabilidad, la iniciativa, la transparencia, la capacidad de aprendizaje y la ejecución constante.




TRES CLAVES PARA EL ÉXITO EN ESTA POSICIÓN

1) Mentalidad hunter y fuerte capacidad de prospección outbound

2) Disciplina comercial y excelente manejo de CRM

title: Event Marketing Manager | FinTech, Crypto & Strategic B2B Events
description:
About the job

For our client, an international technology company that is strengthening its commercial and marketing presence in Mexico and LATAM, we are looking for a proactive and highly organized Event Marketing Manager.




We are looking for a proactive, hands-on and highly organized Event Marketing Manager who can take ownership of event activities in Mexico, from identifying the right opportunities and managing local vendors to lead capture, CRM follow-up and post-event performance analysis.

This is not a purely operational event-planning role.




The main goal of this role is to make events a measurable commercial channel by supporting brand awareness, generating qualified leads, contributing to SQL and pipeline creation, and connecting event participation with clear business outcomes.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR IN OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

· We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of event execution in Mexico and manage multiple details, vendors, deadlines, and internal stakeholders at the same time.

· The ideal candidate should have solid experience organizing corporate, B2B marketing events and should understand that events are not only about logistis, but also about brand visibility, lead generation, CRM follow-up, and business impact.

 

EXPERIENCE IN THE FOLLOWING SECTORS WOULD BE HIGHLY VALUABLE:

B2B technology; Crypto, SaaS; FinTech; banking technology; telecom; CPaaS; cloud communications; contact center technology; enterprise software; digital B2B services; corporate event agencies serving technology or business clients. 

1. Experience in event management, event marketing, field marketing, corporate events, B2B events. 

2. Previous experience organizing business-focused events such as conferences, trade shows, expos, sponsored events, business lunches, executive dinners, roundtables, or partner events. 

3. Strong experience coordinating local vendors, including venues, production teams, booth builders, printing suppliers, merchandise providers, catering providers, and logistics partners. 

4. Ability to manage event timelines, budgets, materials, approvals, deadlines, and several event-related workstreams simultaneously. 

5. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through. 

6. Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. 

7. Ability to work independently, anticipate risks, and proactively follow up on open tasks. 

8. Fluent Spanish for local coordination with vendors, venues, and partners in Mexico + Strong business English for communication with the direct manager and international teams. 

9. Based in Mexico, ideally in Mexico City or nearby. 

10. Availability to travel when required for events.

 

MAIN JOB FUNCTIONS

1. Develop and regularly update the annual event calendar for Mexico and LATAM prioritizing activities based on ICP fit, brand relevance, and commercial potential. 

2. Identify and evaluate relevant conferences, summits, trade shows, business events, executive dinners, roundtables, sponsorships, and co-hosted event opportunities. 

3. Coordinate the company’s participation in events from end to end, including planning, budgeting, logistics, vendor management, booth or brand zone preparation, materials, merchandise, and onsite execution. 

4. Manage local vendors and partners in Mexico, including booth builders, production teams, venues, catering providers, printing suppliers, merchandising providers, logistics partners, and event agencies. 

5. Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, PR, and regional teams to ensure that each event is aligned with commercial priorities, target accounts, product messaging, and marketing goals. 

6. Support lead generation during events by helping the Sales team collect, organize, and qualify leads through badge scanning, forms, meetings, demos, networking activities, and other lead capture methods. 

7. Ensure proper synchronization of event leads with the company’s CRM, such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems, including accurate tagging, data quality, lead ownership, and follow-up visibility. 

8. Coordinate post-event follow-up activities together with Sales, Content, and Product Marketing teams, including email campaigns, social media coverage, PR materials, presentations, and nurture flows. 

9. Support the organization of smaller high-value event formats, such as executive dinners, business lunches, partner events, roundtables, and co-branded activities. 

10. Track event performance and prepare post-event reports, analyzing KPIs such as MQLs, SQLs, CPL, conversion rate, meetings generated, pipeline contribution, ARR potential, branded traffic, media mentions, and overall ROI. 

 

Why Join This Team?

1. This is a great opportunity to join an international B2B technology company expanding in Mexico and LATAM, with a highly attractive compensation package, a mostly remote work format, and the opportunity to travel for key events and conferences.

2. You will take real ownership of event marketing activities in Mexico, working on high-impact initiatives that go beyond logistics and directly support brand visibility, qualified lead generation, pipeline contribution, and business growth.

3. The role offers strong exposure to cloud communications, CPaaS, contact center solutions, and customer engagement technologies, while collaborating with international Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and regional teams.

4. You will join a supportive, collaborative, and non-toxic environment where responsibility, initiative, learning, and ownership are valued. You will also receive guidance from an experienced manager and regional event team, while having the freedom to bring ideas, improve processes, test new event formats, and help build a stronger event marketing function in Mexico.

 

Three Keys to Success in This Position

 

 Ownership, responsibility, and strong execution discipline

 Strong local execution and vendor management in Mexico

 Business-oriented event marketing mindset

 

If you are proactive, highly organized, and excited about building impactful B2B event marketing activities in Mexico, we would be very happy to meet you. Please send your CV to this email cv@tk-recruitment.com we would love to learn more about you.

Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.

You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.
description:
About the job
This job is sourced from a job board. Learn More

Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like


Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.


You are a fit if


You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.


You are not a fit if


"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.


Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like


Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.


You are a fit if


You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.


You are not a fit if


"That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
You want to be told what to do this week.
You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.


Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

About the job

Location: Remote

Language: Native or fluent Spanish

Market: Latin America & Spanish-speaking clients

About Oxford Management Consultancy

Oxford Management Consultancy is a Dubai-based business consultancy helping entrepreneurs, investors, and companies establish and operate businesses in the UAE.

Our services include:

UAE company formation
Free Zone and Mainland setup
Corporate bank account assistance
Corporate Tax and VAT
Accounting and bookkeeping
PRO and residency services
Business compliance
Ongoing corporate support

We are expanding our Spanish-speaking market and are looking for a confident Spanish-speaking Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to generate qualified meetings for our consulting team.

Your Role

Your primary responsibility is not to close the sale.

Your job is to start conversations, understand whether there is a genuine business opportunity, create interest in the UAE, and schedule qualified meetings with our consultants.

You will contact:

Business owners
Entrepreneurs and founders
Accountants and accounting firms
Lawyers and corporate law firms
Tax consultants
Company formation consultants
Immigration/business consultants
Wealth and financial advisers
International business professionals

Our initial focus will include markets such as Argentina, Mexico, Colombia and other Spanish-speaking countries.

Responsibilities

You will:

Make outbound calls in Spanish
Introduce Oxford Management Consultancy professionally
Explain our UAE business services at a high level
Identify prospects interested in establishing or expanding into the UAE
Identify potential referral and strategic partners
Ask qualification questions
Handle initial objections professionally
Follow up with interested prospects
Schedule qualified meetings for our consulting/sales team
Maintain accurate notes and call outcomes
Follow provided scripts while keeping conversations natural
Provide feedback on lead quality and common objections
Work closely with our lead-generation and outreach team

What We Are Looking For

You should have:

Native or near-native Spanish
Strong spoken communication skills
Previous cold-calling, appointment-setting, SDR, telesales or outbound sales experience
Confidence speaking with business owners and professionals
Ability to sound professional rather than reading mechanically from a script
Good objection-handling skills
Strong follow-up discipline
Comfortable working with daily calling targets
Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment

English proficiency sufficient for communicating with our internal team is required.

Experience in any of the following is highly desirable:

B2B sales
Company formation
Corporate services
Banking or financial services
Accounting or taxation
Legal services
Immigration
Real estate
Professional services
International business

What We Provide

We will provide:

Prospect lists
Calling scripts and talking points
Information about OMC services
Objection-handling guidance
Training on UAE company formation and services
Lead qualification criteria
Support from our Dubai consulting team

You are not expected to be a UAE tax or company-formation expert on day one. We will train you on the services you need to discuss.

What Counts as a Qualified Meeting?

We are interested in quality, not simply calendar bookings.

A qualified meeting generally means:

The prospect is a relevant decision-maker
There is genuine interest in UAE business setup, corporate services, banking, tax/accounting, or partnership opportunities
The prospect understands why the meeting is being scheduled
The meeting is confirmed with our consulting team

Compensation

Base salary + performance incentives for qualified meetings and successful conversions.

Compensation will depend on experience and location.

This is intended to be a long-term position for strong performers.

How to Apply

Your location
Your level of Spanish
Your level of English
Your previous cold-calling / appointment-setting experience
What industries you have called for
Approximate number of outbound calls you are comfortable making per day
Your expected monthly compensation
A 30–60 second voice or video introduction in Spanish

description:
About the job

Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Our Supply Team is growing, and we want you to be part of it! As a Market Associate, you will play a crucial role in the retention, growth, and optimization of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts in your assigned territory. You will focus on building strong relationships with these hosts, helping them optimize their listings, improve pricing strategies, and enhance their overall success on Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make

As a Market Associate, you will be responsible for the retention and growth of small and medium hosts in an assigned territory. You will establish and nurture business relationships with emerging professional host accounts by suggesting and supporting strategic initiatives that drive their success on Airbnb. These initiatives will include supply optimization, pricing optimization, host recruitment, and platform education. In addition, as these Hosts successfully grow on the platform, it will be imperative that you help them maintain best-in-class hospitality standards for an excellent guest experience. Beyond one-to-one account management responsibilities, you’ll also support Market Managers on your team to deliver one-to-many education programs, such as webinars and scaled e-mail communication. Ultimately, this team will be responsible for helping long-tail Hosts thrive on Airbnb.

A Typical Day


Manage a book of business consisting of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts, ensuring their retention, growth, and optimization on Airbnb.
Conduct one-on-one optimization and onboarding conversations, providing strategic recommendations on pricing, availability, and listing quality.
Secure availability over high compression dates, ensuring hosts maximize their revenue potential.
Educate hosts on product updates and policy changes, while channeling their feedback to internal teams.
Respond to host inquiries and provide timely, high-quality support to improve their experience on the platform.
Analyze performance data to identify trends and take action on opportunities that drive increased bookings and host success.
Develop long-lasting relationships with hosts, ensuring they receive ongoing support tailored to their needs.


Your Expertise


3+ years of experience in new sales, account management, or partner support.
2+ years of hospitality/travel industry experience (nice to have).
Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts effectively.
Proven experience working a book of business, driving engagement and growth through proactive account management.
Highly goal-driven, with a strong bias for action and persistence in the face of challenges.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively via phone, email, and in-person.
Proficiency in CRM tools, particularly working with leads and opportunities (Salesforce experience is a plus).
Fluency in English and Spanish.


Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is monthly, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Mexico Monthly Pay Range

$43,500—$48,333 MXN

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

 Design and Implement Solutions: Design, develop, test, and implement SAP-based supply chain solutions, focusing on successful project delivery and effective integration with clients' existing systems.

Collaborate with IT, Operations, Supply Chain, and business teams to resolve issues and prevent recurring incidents.

Support SAP releases, HRSP updates, instance refreshes, and regression testing.

Design and execute UT, SIT, and UAT test cases, including positive and negative scenarios.

Identify opportunities to improve solutions and make the support process more efficient.

Strong experience with SAP Ariba and Procure to Pay (P2P) processes.

Hands-on experience with Ariba Buying and Invoicing.

Experience with Ariba Invoice Management, Catalogs, APC, and master data integrations.

Experience troubleshooting SAP Ariba integrations and interfaces.

Knowledge of CIG (Cloud Integration Gateway) and/or CPI (Cloud Platform Integration).

Experience with incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.

Ability to work effectively with both functional and technical teams.

Experience creating functional specifications and test cases.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

description:
About the job

About Finances Demystified

Finances Demystified runs Women in Wealth, a year-long financial education program for members in the United States. Members learn options strategies, long-term investing, financial health, legacy planning, and the mindset work that holds it all together. Our members are mostly women building wealth for the first time in their families.




About the role

Client Success Managers keep members moving through the program. After our onboarding team welcomes a new member, you connect with her early in her first month and stay with her through the year. You are not doing it alone. You work alongside our customer support, tech support, and education teams.




Your job is to make sure nobody gets lost. You keep track of who is active, who has gone inactive, and who has stopped responding, and you reach out before a quiet stretch turns into someone giving up. When a member is discouraged or behind, you are the one who gets her moving again. When a question falls outside your lane, you route it to the right person on the team.

This is a full-time role, and most of your day is spent on member calls over Google Meet.

This is not a financial advice role. You will not analyze trades or tell anyone what to do with their money. But the people who do this job best genuinely love the subject.




What you will do

Run your first call with each new member and set expectations for the year
Hold regular check-in calls with your members
Track who is active, inactive, or unresponsive
Reach out early when a member goes quiet
Keep members connected to the community and live sessions
Route financial, technical, and billing questions to the right team




What this role is not

We want to be direct about this, because it matters.

You will not give trading advice or recommend stocks, funds, or investments
You will not answer technical investing questions
You will not give tax, legal, or personalized financial advice
You will not coach one on one outside scheduled calls
You will not act as a therapist or counselor. You refer members to appropriate support instead




What we are looking for

Warmth that holds a line. You can be encouraging and still tell someone they are behind and need to catch up. Those are not opposites, and the role needs both.

Organization across a caseload. You have kept track of a large group of people before and you can describe how you did it.

Noticing before reacting. The value of this role is catching a problem before anyone raises it. If you have done that, we want to hear about it.

Clean handoffs. When something falls outside your scope, you pass it on quickly and clearly rather than trying to solve it yourself.

Fluency without the urge to advise. You do not need a finance career, but you should be fascinated by money. You read about it, you take care of your own finances, and you enjoy learning how investing works. That helps you connect with members and route their questions to the right person faster.

Comfort on camera. Member calls happen in English on Google Meet, often with people who are frustrated, behind, or ready to quit.

A real connection with who our members are. You understand what it means to build wealth without a family blueprint for it.




Requirements

Deep familiarity with American culture and experience working with US clients
Fluent spoken English
Fully remote. Where you live today does not matter
Reliable internet and a quiet space for calls
Available during US business hours for member calls
Experience in client success, account management, coaching, community, or a similar relationship-driven role
Preferred: a background in finance or a strong personal interest in it. That could be work in financial services, financial education, banking, accounting, or insurance, or your own investing. No credentials required




Compensation

$36,000 to $48,000 USD per year ($3,000 to $4,000 per month), depending on experience. Full-time, independent contractor.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn. Shortlisted applicants will receive a short written application, in English, as the next step.

✓ Inducción para que arranques con el pie derecho.

title: Customer Support Specialist
skills: Remote (Latin America-based)
Compensation: 2,000 - 2,800 USD/month, depending on experience
Full-time contractor role, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST or CST
Tech Stack: Zendesk, Discord, Google Play and Apple AppStore; familiarity with AI-forward products is a plus
Own the support queue. Resolve inbound tickets in Zendesk on account access, subscriptions, billing, and product questions — accurately, in our voice, same-day.
Run our member community. Moderate and engage our Discord community. Keep it healthy, answer questions in public, surface what needs escalating.
Respond to App Store and Google Play reviews. Including the unhappy ones, in a way that reflects well on the brand.
Handle billing disputes. Draft and submit Stripe dispute evidence using our existing templates and tooling.
Triage and route. Separate billing from product from technical, gather clean context, and escalate to Engineering or Product with enough detail to act on.
Spot patterns and flag them. As you build product knowledge, help improve the macros, help-center content, and automations that cut down repeat tickets.
Pitch in on ops projects. We're a small team. Some weeks you'll pick up work outside the support queue — reporting, data cleanup, campaign QA, whatever's needed.
1–3 years in customer support, community management, or customer-facing operations — ideally at a consumer app, SaaS, or subscription business
No degree required. We care what you can do, not where you studied.
Demonstrated experience handling meaningful ticket volume — you can tell us your numbers
Proficiency with a helpdesk platform (Zendesk preferred; Intercom, Front, or Help Scout translate fine)
Comfort with subscription billing mechanics — App Store, Google Play, and Stripe: refunds, chargebacks, plan changes, failed payments
Community platform experience, ideally Discord (roles, moderation, channel management)
Working comfort with spreadsheets, dashboards, and basic reporting
Fluent with AI tools as an accelerant — we expect you to use them well and know when not to

Exceptional written English. You can be warm, clear, and brief in the same four-sentence reply, and you write the way people actually talk. This is the single most important qualification for this role.
Judgment in gray areas. Refunds, exceptions, edge cases. You can hold a boundary kindly and know when to bend one.
Composure in public. Answering a 1-star review or a frustrated community post without getting defensive is a skill, and you have it.
Reliability. You do what you said you'd do, you flag blockers early, and nobody has to chase you for status.
Resourcefulness. You can figure it out. When something's new, you dig before you escalate. And when you do ask, you come with what you've already tried.

Volume tolerance. Hundreds of tickets a week doesn't rattle you, and you know how to triage when the backlog is deep. Plus - you’re setting up automations so you’re not answering the same questions more than five times.
Experience supporting a mobile-first consumer subscription app
History of building support infrastructure — macros, triggers, help center articles, auto-tagging, AI agent tuning
Familiarity with Customer.io, PostHog, RevenueCat, or Linear
Genuine interest in personal development, coaching, or wellness — you'll be talking to people who care a great deal about this
A habit of automating your own repetitive work without being asked
Compensation: 2,000 - 2,800 USD/month, depending on experience.
Full-time contractor arrangement.
Flexible paid time off and U.S. holidays.
Equipment support may be available if needed.

At Near, we connect top talent in Latin America with exciting remote opportunities at U.S.-based companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.

About the Company

Our client is an AI-powered personal growth and mentoring company focused on helping people make better decisions, gain clarity, and create meaningful change. Unlike traditional AI coaching apps, our client combines structured coaching frameworks, psychometric assessments, and behavior-change science to drive measurable progress rather than simply providing conversational support. Since launching in Q4 2025, the company has grown rapidly to tens of thousands of users globally.

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Support & Operations Coordinator to own our customer-facing experience end to end. People come to our client’s app when they're trying to change something real, and when they write to us they're usually in the middle of it. Our job is to meet them there. Support here is human, grounded, and realistic.

This is an execution role: you're in the ticket queue, talking to real people, learning the product and our voice. As you get settled and show you can operate at a high level, you'll take on more surfaces, more independence, and eventually a real hand in how this function gets built. You'll thrive here if you genuinely enjoy talking to customers, take pride in doing it well, and are curious about the operations work behind the scenes.

You should also expect to flex. We're a small team, and some weeks you'll pick up projects outside the support queue — reporting, data cleanup, campaign QA, process work.
