description:
About the job

E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager — TikTok Shop & Social Commerce

https://docs.google.com/document/d/15jwx8ef5lVFGH8VYS8LljPTq6vrZY_aQ6JMxIqgrqQA/edit?usp=sharing




Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required

Salary: $2000 to $2200 USD/month based on experience + profit sharing bonuses based on performance.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small, close-knit team where everyone wears many hats, supports each other, and jumps in wherever needed.




The Role

We are looking for an E-Commerce Growth Marketing Manager to turn TopFoxx’s digital marketing and e-commerce channels into scalable, profitable growth engines.

TikTok Shop is a major focus, but this is not a TikTok-only position. You will work across TikTok Shop, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Instagram, creative strategy, paid media, website conversion, and broader e-commerce marketing. We need someone who understands how these pieces connect and can execute, analyze, and drive results.




You should be able to receive a problem like “TikTok Shop isn’t performing. Figure out what’s happening.” and independently investigate the data, identify the problems, develop a strategy, implement solutions, monitor results, and improve. The same applies to “Meta ROAS dropped” or “Traffic is high but conversion is low.”




You do not need to be an expert in everything. You need to be curious, capable, hands-on, and willing to figure things out. This is not a role where you simply report performance and wait for direction. We are looking for someone who owns growth.




What Success Looks Like

Grow TopFoxx's revenue, conversion, and profitability across digital marketing and e-commerce while making TikTok Shop a major growth engine.

Understand → Identify → Strategize → Execute → Measure → Optimize → Scale

We want someone who connects what customers see, where they come from, what creators produce, how products are presented, what makes someone buy, and whether that sale actually made money.

TikTok Shop is a major part of this role. We currently receive about 2,000 affiliate videos a month from roughly 650 creators, and only 1–2% drive sales. Our Affiliate & Creator Marketing Manager is responsible for growing that creator engine to 5,000+ active creators posting monthly and increasing the percentage of affiliate videos generating sales. Your job is to make sure creator activity, paid media, organic content, product presentation, and e-commerce strategy translate into profitable business results.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)

1) TikTok Shop Growth (Primary Focus)

Analyze GMV, revenue, sales, conversion, traffic, product performance, and creator-generated revenue to identify what is working and where opportunities exist.
Develop and execute strategies to increase daily sales and GMV. Test products, content, offers, campaigns, positioning, and channel strategies.
Follow TikTok Shop updates, trends, tools, features, and best practices. Identify underused opportunities and be first to test them.
Monitor results, improve conversion and product presentation, and work with the Affiliate & Creator Marketing Manager to determine what should be scaled.
Build repeatable processes that make TikTok Shop growth more scalable.




2) Paid Media & Digital Marketing

You should be comfortable managing, analyzing, and improving paid performance, not simply reviewing reports.

Manage and/or oversee paid campaigns across Meta and TikTok aligned with revenue and profitability goals.
Analyze ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, conversion rate, AOV, and revenue contribution. Identify whether problems come from targeting, creative, offer, product, landing page, or conversion.
Recommend budget changes and determine which campaigns or audiences should be scaled, reduced, paused, or restructured.
Develop creative tests across hooks, messaging, offers, formats, products, and concepts. Identify organic or creator content that can be repurposed for paid.
Connect paid media with TikTok Shop, e-commerce, organic content, and creator performance.




3) E-Commerce Growth & Conversion Optimization

Review the customer journey from ad/content → product page → checkout → purchase and identify where customers drop off.
Analyze product-level traffic, conversion, add-to-cart rate, AOV, and sales. Identify underperforming products, pages, offers, campaigns, and customer objections.
Review Shopify product pages and landing pages, including images, videos, headlines, descriptions, pricing, CTAs, and messaging. Ensure advertising and product-page messaging are aligned.
Develop conversion-focused landing page tests. Evaluate TikTok Shop product presentation and Amazon product creative/content.
Use customer questions, reviews, comments, objections, and behavior to identify opportunities and test improvements to presentation, messaging, creative, and offers.




4) Creative Strategy & Content Performance

We want a marketer who understands why creative works and how it drives business results, not simply someone who reports views and engagement.

Analyze TikTok, Instagram, Meta, creator, and paid creative to understand what captures attention and contributes to conversions.
Develop hooks, angles, concepts, messaging, and creative testing strategies based on audience behavior and business performance.
Turn customer pain points, product benefits, reviews, objections, and questions into content opportunities.
Develop TikTok and Instagram content strategies and identify winning creator content that can be replicated, expanded, or scaled.
Create content briefs and provide actionable creative direction to creators and internal teams.
Connect organic, creator, paid, and e-commerce performance to build repeatable creative frameworks.




5) Creative Execution

We want a marketer who can execute, not just strategize. You do not need to be an expert designer or professional video editor, but you should have enough hands-on ability to make or modify content when needed.

You may be expected to:

Make simple edits to images, graphics, and marketing assets.
Edit short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram, and other social channels.
Add or modify text, captions, hooks, CTAs, and other creative elements.
Adapt creative for different platforms, formats, or campaigns.
Create basic social and marketing assets when needed.

Experience with Photoshop, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, or similar tools is valuable.




6) Data, KPIs & Performance

You should be comfortable tracking:

Revenue, GMV, orders, traffic, AOV, and conversion rate
Product-level conversion and add-to-cart rate
CTR, CPC, CPA, CAC, and ROAS
Creator-generated revenue, retention, and engagement
Contribution margin and overall profitability




The goal is not simply to report numbers. You should be able to answer: What is happening? Why? What should we change? What happened after we changed it? Most importantly, did we make money?




You should understand that reported ROI is not profit and account for commissions, referral fees, advertising spend, discounts, shipping, product costs, and other expenses when evaluating profitability.




7) Testing, Growth & Cross-Channel Marketing

Understand how TikTok Shop, paid media, organic content, creators, Shopify, Amazon, Meta, and other channels work together.

Continuously test content angles, hooks, offers, product positioning, creative formats, landing pages, audiences, campaigns, and other growth levers.

title: Experto de Categoría - Joyería de oro y plata
skills: Pricing de la categoría: definir precio de venta, rangos de oferta y hasta dónde baja una pieza, siempre con fuente y racional documentado —precio spot de oro y plata, tipo de cambio, ley y gramaje, y comparables de mercado para las piezas que valen más que su metal.
Desarrollar las colecciones de Oro Dondé: definir qué piezas las integran, a qué precio y cómo se presentan, a partir de lo que se mueve en la red y en los canales digitales.
Aportar el criterio de valor que sustenta las ofertas de préstamo sobre oro y plata, en coordinación con valuación.
Activar la categoría en todos los canales: qué se empuja, cuándo, en qué canal y con qué argumento.
Colaborar estrechamente con la red de sucursales: resolver la duda difícil, dar criterio en las piezas que escalan y formar a quienes las reciben.

Definir los lineamientos digitales de la categoría: matriz de datos y atributos obligatorios (metal, ley, peso, tipo de pieza, piedras, hechura, contrastes, estado) y el estándar de cómo se describe y se fotografía cada pieza —contrastes, cierres, engastes, peso en báscula, marcas de uso reales.
Dejar la categoría lista para comercio agéntico: nomenclatura, atributos y contenido consistentes para que un agente entienda y venda la pieza, y corregir lo que la IA propone mal.
Curar el inventario: qué empujar, qué reprecificar, qué se estancó, qué vale más como pieza que como metal y qué no volver a tomar.
Leer el pulso del mercado: el precio del metal, qué tipo de pieza se mueve, cuál se estanca y por qué, qué estilos y marcas ganan y pierden tracción.
Ser la referencia de la categoría: el criterio final cuando algo no cuadra. Decir “no” a una pieza también es parte del trabajo.
Identificar pieza por pieza: metal y ley (10k, 14k, 18k, 22k; plata .925, .950, .999), peso, tipo de pieza, hechura, contrastes y marcas de fabricante, piedras y engaste, estado.
Verificar la ley con piedra de toque y ácidos, densidad, imán y XRF cuando aplica, y leer los resultados con criterio.

Detectar lo que no es lo que parece: chapa, gold filled y vermeil vendidos como oro sólido; alpaca o plata alemana como plata; piezas huecas o rellenas, soldaduras de baja ley, contrastes falsos, piedras sintéticas o simulantes.
Separar el valor de fundición del valor de pieza: cuándo una joya vale por gramos y ley, y cuándo vale más por firma, diseño, época o piedras.
Saber qué se resuelve en taller, qué escala a valuación formal o a gemología y qué no se toma.
Perfil joyero: experiencia en joyería, taller u orfebrería, marca o retail de joyería. Los años importan menos que lo que sabes.
Criterio de producto: saber armar una colección que se vende, no solo valuar piezas sueltas.
Pasión por la categoría. Sigues el precio del metal, el diseño, las marcas y el mercado de segunda mano.
Criterio y honestidad para poner un precio, defenderlo y rechazar una pieza cuando no cuadra.

Piso analítico: Excel sólido, disciplina para documentar el sustento de cada precio y capacidad de explicar con números qué funciona y qué no. No buscamos un analista ni un perfil de e-commerce: eso ya está cubierto.
Capacidad de trabajar con áreas distintas —sucursales, valuación, capacitacion, digital—

description:
About the job

La joyería de oro y plata es una de las categorías más grandes del ecosistema Dondé. Buscamos a quien la haga crecer: definir el criterio de precio, oferta y presentación de cada pieza, desarrollar las colecciones de Oro Dondé —nuestra marca de joyería sustentable— y llevarlo a una red de 378 sucursales en 31 estados de la república y a todos los canales digitales.

Trabajarás desde el equipo de ecosistema digital, junto a valuadores y gemólogos con décadas de experiencia, como la referencia de la categoría: quien sabe qué tiene enfrente, qué vale y por qué.




Qué vas a hacer

Pricing de la categoría: definir precio de venta, rangos de oferta y hasta dónde baja una pieza, siempre con fuente y racional documentado —precio spot de oro y plata, tipo de cambio, ley y gramaje, y comparables de mercado para las piezas que valen más que su metal.
Desarrollar las colecciones de Oro Dondé: definir qué piezas las integran, a qué precio y cómo se presentan, a partir de lo que se mueve en la red y en los canales digitales.
Aportar el criterio de valor que sustenta las ofertas de préstamo sobre oro y plata, en coordinación con valuación.
Activar la categoría en todos los canales: qué se empuja, cuándo, en qué canal y con qué argumento.
Colaborar estrechamente con la red de sucursales: resolver la duda difícil, dar criterio en las piezas que escalan y formar a quienes las reciben.
Definir los lineamientos digitales de la categoría: matriz de datos y atributos obligatorios (metal, ley, peso, tipo de pieza, piedras, hechura, contrastes, estado) y el estándar de cómo se describe y se fotografía cada pieza —contrastes, cierres, engastes, peso en báscula, marcas de uso reales.
Dejar la categoría lista para comercio agéntico: nomenclatura, atributos y contenido consistentes para que un agente entienda y venda la pieza, y corregir lo que la IA propone mal.
Curar el inventario: qué empujar, qué reprecificar, qué se estancó, qué vale más como pieza que como metal y qué no volver a tomar.
Leer el pulso del mercado: el precio del metal, qué tipo de pieza se mueve, cuál se estanca y por qué, qué estilos y marcas ganan y pierden tracción.
Ser la referencia de la categoría: el criterio final cuando algo no cuadra. Decir “no” a una pieza también es parte del trabajo.




Lo que tienes que saber

Identificar pieza por pieza: metal y ley (10k, 14k, 18k, 22k; plata .925, .950, .999), peso, tipo de pieza, hechura, contrastes y marcas de fabricante, piedras y engaste, estado.
Verificar la ley con piedra de toque y ácidos, densidad, imán y XRF cuando aplica, y leer los resultados con criterio.
Detectar lo que no es lo que parece: chapa, gold filled y vermeil vendidos como oro sólido; alpaca o plata alemana como plata; piezas huecas o rellenas, soldaduras de baja ley, contrastes falsos, piedras sintéticas o simulantes.
Separar el valor de fundición del valor de pieza: cuándo una joya vale por gramos y ley, y cuándo vale más por firma, diseño, época o piedras.
Saber qué se resuelve en taller, qué escala a valuación formal o a gemología y qué no se toma.




Qué buscamos

Perfil joyero: experiencia en joyería, taller u orfebrería, marca o retail de joyería. Los años importan menos que lo que sabes.
Criterio de producto: saber armar una colección que se vende, no solo valuar piezas sueltas.
Pasión por la categoría. Sigues el precio del metal, el diseño, las marcas y el mercado de segunda mano.
Criterio y honestidad para poner un precio, defenderlo y rechazar una pieza cuando no cuadra.
Piso analítico: Excel sólido, disciplina para documentar el sustento de cada precio y capacidad de explicar con números qué funciona y qué no. No buscamos un analista ni un perfil de e-commerce: eso ya está cubierto.
Capacidad de trabajar con áreas distintas —sucursales, valuación, capacitacion, digital—
Suman: certificación en valuación de joyería o gemología, inglés para fuentes internacionales.




Qué ofrecemos

Esquema híbrido (3 días oficina / 2 home office) · Vales de despensa · Seguro de vida · Prestaciones de ley.




Quiénes somos

Fundación Rafael Dondé, IAP — desde 1919, más de un siglo despertando el potencial que transforma vidas. Somos una institución de asistencia privada autofinanciada: operamos Empeños Dondé, Banco Dondé y Tienda Dondé, y sus resultados financian íntegramente nuestra obra social. A través de nuestros Módulos Educativos hemos beneficiado a cerca de un millón de niñas, niños y jóvenes en México.Tienda Dondé es el brazo de economía circular de ese ecosistema: cada pieza que se vende bien se traduce en obra social.

description:
About the job

En Tagma Full Agency buscamos incorporar a una persona con experiencia en BTL, eventos, activaciones y experiencias de marca que quiera participar activamente en la generación y desarrollo de nuevas oportunidades de negocio.




Buscamos una combinación particular: alguien con actitud comercial y orientación a resultados, pero que también conozca la lógica operativa del sector para conversar con clientes, interpretar un brief, construir una propuesta y coordinar información con proveedores y especialistas.




Para esta posición es indispensable contar con experiencia profesional directa en BTL, eventos, activaciones, experiencias de marca, producción o disciplinas estrechamente relacionadas.




No buscamos necesariamente una trayectoria extensa ni un perfil de alta jerarquía. Nos interesa una persona con buenos fundamentos, iniciativa, criterio, capacidad de aprendizaje y potencial para crecer junto con la agencia.




¿Qué harás?

Identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades mediante prospección directa, referencias, contactos existentes y leads generados por Tagma.
Participar en reuniones con prospectos y clientes, comprender necesidades y dar seguimiento a briefs y solicitudes.
Colaborar en propuestas para eventos, activaciones, montajes, ambientaciones y otras experiencias de marca.
Solicitar y dar seguimiento a cotizaciones de proveedores junto con el equipo interno y especialistas de producción.
Acompañar cada oportunidad desde su detección hasta el cierre comercial.
Contribuir al desarrollo de relaciones de largo plazo y nuevas oportunidades en cuentas existentes.




La posición tiene un foco comercial. No esperamos que produzcas directamente los proyectos, pero sí que comprendas sus componentes y puedas conversar productivamente con quienes estarán a cargo de su implementación.




¿Qué buscamos?

Más que un número determinado de años, nos interesa la pertinencia de tu trayectoria y el potencial que puedas aportar.




Valoraremos especialmente experiencia en desarrollo o atención de clientes, prospección, propuestas, cotizaciones, coordinación de proveedores y procesos comerciales dentro de BTL, eventos, activaciones, experiencias de marca o servicios relacionados.




La experiencia comercial en otros sectores puede ser valiosa, pero para esta búsqueda necesitamos que esté acompañada por experiencia directa en este tipo de proyectos o servicios.




También valoraremos tu comunicación, organización, seguimiento, iniciativa, criterio y forma profesional de relacionarte con clientes, proveedores y equipo. PowerPoint, Excel, CRM y un nivel funcional de inglés serán considerados de manera integral.




¿Cómo es trabajar con nosotros?

Tagma es una agencia de comunicación, marketing y contenidos con un equipo compacto y multidisciplinario. Este rol tendrá interacción cercana con Dirección, gestión de proyectos, equipo creativo y partners especializados.




Nos interesa alguien que valore un entorno con espacio para involucrarse, aprender, proponer y construir, donde la excelencia, el enfoque a soluciones, la actitud de servicio, la integridad y la adaptabilidad forman parte de nuestra manera de trabajar.




La posición está orientada a personas en Ciudad de México y su área metropolitana, con disponibilidad para reuniones, visitas, eventos y otras actividades presenciales cuando el trabajo lo requiera.




Consideramos inicialmente una modalidad híbrida y un esquema de dedicación parcial, con compensación fija más un componente variable vinculado a resultados.




Si tienes experiencia en este sector y te interesa desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de negocio desde una perspectiva cercana al cliente y a la operación, nos interesa conocerte.




Postúlate a través de LinkedIn adjuntando tu CV actualizado.

Local situational analysis and customer insight — understand local customer needs, barriers, journey and competitive context to ground the engagement strategy (engagement-focused, not brand re-strategizing).

description:
About the job

Are you looking to join a forward-thinking sales organization with strong earning potential?

Do you want to join an organization where your performance is recognized and rewarded?

If your answers are "yes", this is the opportunity you are looking for.

PLEASE BE AWARE THAT THIS IS A TEMPORARY ONE-YEAR ROLE.

In this role, you’ll be at the heart of building high‑value, senior‑level audiences for a global portfolio of market‑leading B2B conferences. You’ll work across cutting‑edge sectors including energy, sustainability, automotive, supply chain and pharmaceuticals, connecting industry leaders and shaping the conversations that matter most.

This is a commercial, relationship‑led role where your success is defined by the caliber of VIP delegates you engage, the trusted relationships you build, and the exceptional on‑site experiences you help deliver—playing an active role in curating powerful peer‑to‑peer connections and meaningful industry networking.

About The Role

As an Audience Relations Executive at Reuters Events, you will:


Build and execute targeted outreach plans to secure C-level and senior decision-makers for assigned events.
Work with sales leadership and producers to build a focused target account list per campaign, using LinkedIn, competitor/event research, and industry news.
Source, qualify, and manage senior delegate prospects from first touch through confirmed registration/attendance.
Run high-quality outreach through calls, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and pitch meetings with messaging tailored to each vertical.
Re-engage past delegates and "speaker friendlies" from previous events to drive repeat attendance and referrals.
Partner with internal teams to ensure the right audience composition is achieved (e.g., end-user/vendor mix, seniority mix, functional priorities).
Curate and broker relationships with industry associations, networks, and relevant communities to expand reach and unlock warm introductions.
Share market feedback on who is engaging, what they care about, and which segments are underrepresented.
Help ensure a valuable on-site experience by supporting 121 informal meetings introductions between relevant senior delegates and sponsor attendees.
Capture post-event feedback to strengthen retention, improve targeting, and refine future outreach.
Maintain accurate CRM records (Salesforce preferred): outreach activity, statuses, notes, and follow-ups.


About You

To be a Audience Relations Executive, you will likely have:


1+ years outbound B2B acquisition experience (events/conferences, media, communities, or similar).
Proven ability to engage C-level executives and senior decision-makers with credible, concise outreach.
Strong outbound prospecting across LinkedIn, email, phone, and referrals.
Excellent organization and follow-through across multiple concurrent campaigns.
Partnership/community development mindset—comfortable building relationships that convert into attendance.
CRM discipline and data hygiene (Salesforce strongly preferred).
Event industry experience preferred; understanding of audience composition and delegate acquisition is a plus.


To apply, please upload your updated resume in English. 

Location: CDMX

What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

description:
About the job

Location: Tijuana or Mexico City

 Language: Fluent English and Spanish required

 OTE: $60,000–$80,000+ USD

 Base: $30,000–$40,000 USD




The Opportunity

We’re looking for an experienced salesperson to help build Univision’s new self-service advertising business in the United States.




This is a new-business role. You will not inherit an established book of accounts. You will build one.

Your focus will be identifying advertisers and agencies in key US markets, opening new relationships, pitching Univision’s advertising solutions and managing opportunities through to closed campaign.

Initially, the role will be heavily focused on outbound prospecting. Over time, you will also work opportunities referred by Univision’s existing sales teams, inbound advertiser interest and repeat customers.




You will work closely with both Univision and DanAds and become an extension of Univision’s commercial organization.




What You’ll Do
Build a pipeline of US advertisers and agencies through outbound prospecting, networking and referrals
Run discovery calls, sales meetings and platform demonstrations
Sell Univision advertising solutions to SMB and mid-market advertisers
Manage the full sales cycle from first contact through to campaign launch
Develop first-time advertisers into repeat customers
Build agency relationships that can generate multiple advertiser opportunities
Work alongside Univision’s local US sales teams
Identify larger opportunities that should be escalated into Univision’s enterprise sales organization




Who We’re Looking For

We care more about proven sales ability than the perfect CV.




We’re particularly interested in candidates who already understand the US market, have experience selling to advertisers or agencies, and are comfortable building business through proactive outbound sales.




Required
Fluent English and Spanish
3+ years of sales or business development experience
Strong experience in outbound / new-business sales
Confident speaking with business owners, marketers and agency decision-makers
Experience managing the full sales cycle
Self-motivated and comfortable building a territory from scratch
Able to work US business hours




Highly Desirable
Digital advertising, media, adtech or marketing services experience
Experience selling into the US market
Experience working with US advertisers or agencies
Existing relationships in Los Angeles, Dallas or other major US Hispanic markets
Knowledge of the US Hispanic advertising market
Experience selling video, digital media or audience-based advertising




Location

We are hiring in both Tijuana and Mexico City.

For Tijuana-based candidates, experience or relationships in Southern California and Los Angeles would be particularly valuable.

For Mexico City candidates, we are especially interested in people with strong advertising, agency or US-market experience.




About the Role

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a major US advertising territory, work directly with Univision’s commercial organization and help build a new sales channel from the beginning.




DanAds will provide ongoing sales management, coaching and support, while Univision will provide product, audience and commercial training.




This is a contractor position and does not include employer-sponsored health insurance, retirement contributions or other traditional employee benefits.

About the job

Company Overview

Our client builds an all-in-one booking and park-management platform for outdoor hospitality. Campground, RV park, and glamping operators use it to manage reservations, availability, rates, payments, guest messaging, and reporting in one place. It also runs a traveler-facing marketplace that brings operators more bookings.

Many customers are small and mid-sized businesses whose busiest days depend on the software running smoothly. They choose this platform for its ease of use and for the real, hands-on support behind it.

Your Role

This role exists to keep customers successful long after onboarding ends.

You'll be the go-to contact for a portfolio of parks. You'll answer questions, solve problems, and help operators use more of the platform as their business grows. Success in this role means customers feel supported, use the product confidently, and stay with the platform year after year.

You’ll:


Serve as the main point of contact for a portfolio of active customers
Answer product questions and troubleshoot issues with bookings, rates, payments, and availability
Run check-ins and training sessions to help customers adopt features they aren't using yet
Help operators adjust their setup as seasons, rates, or site inventory change
Stay calm and responsive during peak-season rushes, when every booking counts

Turn recurring questions into guides, FAQs, and simple help documentation

Experience in a customer-facing role, such as customer success, account management, support, or onboarding, ideally in SaaS
Comfort learning software in depth and explaining it to non-technical users
Excellent spoken and written English communication
Strong troubleshooting skills and a calm, solutions-first attitude
A tech-savvy, process-oriented mindset
Strong organization and follow-through across multiple accounts
A patient, supportive approach with customers of all technical comfort levels


Bonus Points:


Experience with hospitality, reservations, booking, or payments software

Experience supporting small-business owners

Remote role with schedule overlap for customer calls and team collaboration

title: Product Management Intern
skills: Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.

Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.

Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.
Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.

Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.
description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with a wide range of flexible payment options designed to give customers more choice, accessibility, and a smarter overall experience. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a curious, driven, and thoughtful Product Intern to join our Payments & Fees team. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

If you want to truly understand how fintech works, there's no better place to start than payments — and no better seat than product. The Payments & Fees team sits at the intersection of technology, data, and business, working with payment processors, payment method providers, and cross-functional partners across the company. As a product intern here, you won't be watching from the sidelines. You'll be in the room (or the channel) where decisions get made, picking up context fast and contributing to a team that moves quickly and takes its craft seriously.

You'll support the product manager across a high-throughput environment: helping keep the backlog organized, digging into data to understand payment flows, and working alongside an efficient and technically sharp engineering team, as well as Design and Data teams. Product management is one of those rare roles where no two days look the same — you're constantly context-switching between technical conversations, business problems, and user needs, and that's exactly what makes it exciting.

What You'll Do:

Ticket Management & Product Support


Assist the product manager in drafting, organizing, and tracking tickets for changes and improvements to the payments service. Help ensure work is well-documented, properly prioritized, and moving through the backlog. Follow up on status and surface blockers when needed.


Context Gathering & Stakeholder Support


Help the product manager stay on top of inputs from multiple stakeholders by gathering background context, summarizing key information, and preparing materials ahead of provider meetings. Respond to routine internal questions by pulling the right information from available resources.


Payment Workflow Analysis


Learn and apply SQL to query payment data and support the creation and maintenance of dashboards that track payment performance, processing failures, and operational health. Help flag anomalies in payment flows and assist in assembling data for reviews and investigations.


Documentation & Process Tracking


Maintain clear internal documentation for payment flows, fee structures, and operational processes. Help keep cross-functional teams aligned with concise, well-structured written updates.


Agile Meetings


Participate in agile meetings and collaborate with engineering, operations, compliance, and support teams. One of the most valuable things a product manager does is serve as a bridge between tech and the business — translating technical challenges into clear language and business needs into actionable requirements. You'll get hands-on experience doing exactly that.


What We Look For:


Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Economics, Finance, or a related field
A genuine interest in payments, fintech, and how complex financial systems work under the hood
Natural curiosity and a logical mindset — you enjoy working through problems, aren't afraid to ask questions, and get satisfaction from figuring things out
Strong attention to detail — you notice when something's off and follow through until it's resolved
Comfort working with data and a willingness to learn SQL; prior experience is a plus but not required
Effective written and verbal communication — you can summarize a complex topic clearly and ask the right questions to fill in gaps
Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, fintech, data analysis, or startups is a plus — but we hire for potential, not just pedigree.
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards — many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You're not bound by convention — your success and much of the fun lies in developing new ways to do things.
You need action — speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust — you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit — you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results — you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Product Intern is $800 USD Gross as an independent contractor.

Responder correos de clientes con un tono cercano, profesional y resolutivo.

 Atender mensajes directos, comentarios y menciones en redes sociales a través de Meta Business Suite (Instagram y Facebook).

 Identificar preguntas recurrentes y sugerir mejoras en plantillas de respuesta, FAQs y procesos internos.

 Detectar oportunidades para convertir consultas en ventas y aportar activamente al crecimiento del negocio.

 Reportar métricas semanales de atención (volumen, tiempos de respuesta, casos críticos).







¿Qué buscamos en ti?




Mínimo 2 años de experiencia en customer service para e-commerce.

 Experiencia comprobable trabajando con Shopify (requisito excluyente).

 Experiencia gestionando contracargos y disputas en Shopify Payments y PayPal.

 Manejo fluido de Meta Business Suite para atender comunidades activas en Instagram y Facebook.

 Español nativo con excelente redacción, ortografía y capacidad para adaptar el tono según el canal.

 Actitud proactiva: si ves algo que se puede mejorar, lo propones. No esperas instrucciones para todo.

 Orientación al detalle y capacidad de trabajo autónomo (este rol es 100% remoto y necesitas gestionarte solo/a).

 Empatía real con el cliente y paciencia para casos difíciles.

 Conexión a internet estable y equipo propio (computador funcional).

Modalidad: 100% remoto. Puedes trabajar desde cualquier ubicación siempre que cumplas con el horario del puesto.

 Horario: Lunes a viernes, de 13:00 a 19:00 hrs hora de México (CDMX). Equivalencias: 16:00 a 22:00 hrs hora de Chile (GMT-3) / 21:00 a 03:00 hrs hora de España (CEST).




 Compensación: USD 300 mensuales fijos + comisiones por ventas (sin techo).

 Fecha de inicio: Aproximadamente primera semana de octubre.

 Ambiente colaborativo, con espacio real para proponer ideas y crecer dentro de la empresa.

 Formar parte de un equipo internacional en una marca en expansión.







¿Cómo postular?

Aplica directamente aquí en LinkedIn con tu CV actualizado.

Revisamos cada postulación con atención. Si tu perfil encaja, nos contactaremos contigo en un plazo máximo de 5 días hábiles para coordinar una primera entrevista.




¡Esperamos conocerte pronto!

title: Creator Incubation Manager (Electronics Category) - TikTok Shop
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Incubation Manager (Electronics Category) to join our team. You will be responsible for nurturing and elevating high-potential e-commerce creators, helping them master content creation techniques to drive their GMV growth. Rather than general creator recruitment, your core focus will be matching the right creators with curated category product assortments, co-creating high-impact content to achieve explosive sales growth. Additionally, you will provide hands-on training for agency and individual livestream hosts, guiding them on livestream tools, scripts, and post-session data reviews. A key part of your role will be translating data into actionable strategies and successfully persuading creators to adopt them for continuous performance improvement.

Responsibilities:
- Empower and incubate high-potential e-commerce creators by guiding them on e-commerce content production techniques, increasing their posting frequency and content quality, and ultimately driving their GMV growth.
- Deeply understand curated product assortments within focus categories and identify the most suitable creators for them. Co-create compelling content with these creators to achieve massive sales breakthroughs that outpace the broader market.
- Provide comprehensive training and guidance for agency hosts and individual livestreamers. Help them master livestreaming tools, refine and optimize their on-camera scripts (talk tracks), and encourage higher streaming frequency to maximize the ROI of each session.
- Conduct in-depth post-livestream data reviews with creators. Leverage data analysis to formulate highly actionable strategies, successfully persuade hosts/creators to adopt these recommendations, and track execution to ensure improved results.
- Ensure creators maintain high-quality content standards and adhere to platform guidelines to build a healthy and sustainable e-commerce ecosystem.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the distinct ability to translate data into actionable plans and successfully persuade creators/hosts to execute them.
- Deep understanding of e-commerce content (short video & livestreaming) and the ability to co-create content strategies that perfectly match specific product assortments.
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to deeply coach, train, and build trust with creators and agency hosts.

Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in e-commerce operations, creator incubation, or livestreaming management.
- Proven track record of delivering comprehensive livestream training, optimizing livestream scripts, and driving measurable GMV growth for creators or brands.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

adCasa Partner Network opera con una arquitectura distinta. No dependemos de cookies de navegador. Registramos tus referidos directamente en nuestra base de datos. Si tu prospecto compra su suscripción dentro de un año, tú cobras.

Los programadores tienen VS Code. Los especialistas en marketing tienen 40 pestañas abiertas en el navegador y herramientas desconectadas.




adCasa es un AI Marketing OS diseñado para resolver esto. Reemplazamos hojas de cálculo caóticas y herramientas aisladas con un solo espacio de trabajo. Estrategia humana. Velocidad de máquina.

Sin entrevistas, sin tarifas y sin tiempos de espera.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

description:
About the job

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role purpose

The Periodic Review Due Diligence Specialist is responsible for conducting AML periodic reviews and AML event driven reviews of merchants and sub merchants to ensure customer information, ownership structures, business activity, transaction profiles and supporting documentation remain accurate, current and compliant with internal standards and applicable regulatory requirements.

The role supports Checkout.com’s ongoing monitoring framework by assessing whether a merchant’s existing risk rating and due diligence level remain appropriate, and taking the appropriate action through case management, escalation and stakeholder engagement.

The role is also expected to embody Checkout.com’s Operating Principles in how work is performed: putting the customer first through high-quality review outcomes and clear communication, acting with ownership and urgency, maintaining a high bar for accuracy and evidence, collaborating as one team across stakeholders, and continuously improving review quality, process discipline and operational effectiveness.

Key Roles And Responsibilities


Conduct end-to-end AML periodic reviews and AML event driven reviews of merchants and sub merchants in line with internal procedures, policy requirements and review timelines.
Review merchant information including ownership structure, business activity, line of business, processing activity, regional exposure and supporting documentation to ensure and confirm that the customer profile remains accurate and complete.
Assess whether the merchant’s risk rating and due diligence level remain appropriate based on current information and review findings.
Complete required review actions within the relevant internal systems and tools, including Salesforce and Fircosoft Compliance Link.
Manage periodic review cases from assignment through closure, ensuring statuses, sub-statuses, notes, evidence and outcomes are accurately maintained.
Raise and manage Requests for Information (RFIs) with merchants, account managers or internal stakeholders where documents or clarifications are required.
Perform enhanced due diligence reviews where required for higher-risk merchants, including analysis of risk triggers, supporting documentation and rationale for final decisions.
Escalate cases appropriately where review findings, risk indicators or policy triggers require secondary review or approval.
Maintain clear, accurate and audit-ready case commentary, review notes and evidencing to support decisions taken.
Immediately escalate unusual or suspicious activity in line with internal reporting obligations.
Support quality, control and continuous improvement initiatives by highlighting process gaps, tool issues, documentation weaknesses and operational inefficiencies and suggesting solutions.
Contribute to consistent decision-making, knowledge sharing and strong operational discipline across the periodic review team.


Individual profile

The ideal individual is a detail-oriented and risk-aware specialist with strong AML and customer due diligence knowledge, sound judgement, and the ability to manage a high volume of cases while maintaining quality and discipline. They should be comfortable analysing customer information, identifying discrepancies, following structured procedures and documenting decisions.

They should also be able to communicate clearly with both internal and external stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and escalate issues promptly where risk, policy or operational thresholds are met.

Skills


1-2 years' relevant experience.
Strong understanding of AML, KYC, KYB, CDD and EDD principles.
Ability to review and interpret corporate documents, ownership structures and merchant information.
Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, red flags and material changes in risk profile.
Ability to make structured, evidence-based decisions in line with policy and procedural requirements.
Strong written communication skills for case notes, RFIs, internal escalations and stakeholder updates.
Good stakeholder management and follow-up discipline.
Ability to manage workload effectively across multiple live cases and deadlines.
Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
Good judgement in identifying when to escalate or seek secondary review.
Ability to work with case management and due diligence tools.
Comfortable using internal platforms and review-supporting tools as required.
Ability to work within controlled processes while remaining adaptable to system and procedural changes.


Core competencies


Risk awareness and sound judgement
Analytical thinking
Investigative mindset
Attention to detail
Decision quality
Accountability and ownership
Organisational and time management skills
Clear written and verbal communication
Collaboration and teamwork
Resilience under workload pressure
Process discipline and compliance mindset
Continuous improvement orientation


Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.



What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you! 



Who we are: 

Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments in higher education. We’ve since scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world. 



Today we support more than 5,300 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.



With over 1,400 global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.

 





Job Description



The Opportunity



We are seeking a motivated and hardworking Payment Operations Associate, Payins to manage and streamline the payment process at Flywire. In this role, you will optimize fund movement and reconciliation across global accounts to optimize current partner relationships and identify areas for improvement. This individual will support the Payment Operations, Payouts, and Customer Support Teams.



Key responsibilities:



Identify and match incoming payments to customer bookings.



Reconcile accounting entries across global accounts and multiple currencies.



Investigate and resolve unmatched or misapplied payments by working with internal teams and payment partners.



Troubleshooting bank and partner reporting issues to ensure accurate and timely identification of incoming funds



Identify recurring payment issues and recommend process improvements to reduce manual work and reconciliation breaks.





Qualifications



Here's what we're looking for:



Undergraduate degree with 1-2 years of corporate work experience in the payments / banking industry



Expertise in payments identification and reconciliation



Experience working with bank and partner reporting is a plus



Experience with payment processing and investigations is a plus



Exceptional attention to detail, sense of urgency for deadlines, and strong organizational skills



Fast learner with the ability to work independently, troubleshoot issues and drive tasks to completion in a fast-paced environment



Great communication and collaboration skills; a true team player



Fluent English, written and spoken (additional languages are an advantage)



A positive, can-do attitude; demonstrated willingness and eagerness to learn



Passion for problem solving and helping customers



Excellent analytical and computer skills including proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets 



Experience using applications such as Slack, Zendesk, Jira, and/or Looker is a plus 



 



Additional Information



What We Offer:



Competitive compensation



Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)



Competitive time off, including Digital Disconnect and FlyBetter Days to volunteer in a cause you believe in.



Flying Start - Our immersive Global Induction Program (Meet our Execs & Global Teams)



Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media



Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates



Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact



Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)





Additional Information



Submit today and get started!



We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, other Flymates, the department VP, and participate in a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for questions.



Flywire is an equal opportunity employer and follows a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender identity, national origin, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, genetic disposition or carrier status, veteran status, or any other category protected under applicable national, federal, state or local law.

About the job

Community Manager – Mexico

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Brand: Infinix

Function: Marketing / User Operations

Position: Community Manager




Job Overview

We are looking for a proactive and creative Community Manager to support the growth and daily operations of Infinix’s user community in Mexico.

This role will be responsible for growing and activating our online communities, managing KOC/KOS creator programs, developing engaging local content, supporting offline activations, and strengthening the connection between the Infinix brand and local users.

The ideal candidate understands Mexican social media culture, enjoys interacting with users and creators, and is comfortable managing both daily community operations and project-based campaigns.




Key Responsibilities

1. Community Growth & Operations

Manage and grow Infinix Mexico’s user communities across platforms such as Facebook Groups, WhatsApp, TikTok, Instagram and other relevant channels.
Develop initiatives to continuously recruit new community members and improve user activation and retention.
Maintain daily interaction with community members, including comments, discussions, polls, challenges and user-generated content.
Identify highly engaged users and develop them into core community members, brand advocates or Fan Hosts.
Monitor community sentiment, feedback and user needs, and regularly provide VOC (Voice of Customer) insights to internal teams.
Maintain a healthy, active and positive community environment.

2. KOC & Creator Management

Recruit and manage local KOCs (Key Opinion Customers), micro-creators and brand advocates.
Build and maintain an updated creator database, including creator profiles, content performance and activity status.
Develop creator segmentation and tiering systems based on content quality, activity and performance.
Provide KOCs with campaign briefs, product information, content inspiration and execution guidance.
Follow up on creator content delivery and ensure content meets campaign and brand requirements.
Identify high-potential KOCs and support their development into stronger creators or KOL-level partners.

3. KOS Program Support

Support the development and daily operation of Infinix Mexico’s KOS (Key Opinion Sales) program.
Work closely with Retail and Sales teams to recruit and activate store promoters or retail staff as content creators.
Provide simple content training, shooting guidelines, scripts and creative references for KOS participants.
Track KOS content output, follower growth, engagement and overall performance.
Support incentive programs, monthly rankings, recognition programs and creator challenges.
Help connect online content creation with offline retail traffic and sales conversion.

4. Campaigns & Offline Activations

Support local community campaigns, product launches, gaming activations, campus activities and offline user events.
Design online-to-offline engagement mechanisms to attract community members and creators.
Coordinate participant recruitment, event communication and post-event follow-up.
Support merchandise, prizes and incentive distribution when required.
Collaborate with internal Marketing, Retail, Sales and agency partners to ensure smooth execution.

5. Data Tracking & Reporting

Track key community and creator KPIs, including: community member growth, active users and engagement rate, KOC/KOS recruitment, content output, campaign participation.
Prepare weekly community reports.
Identify challenges and propose actionable solutions based on performance data.

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Business or a related field.
3+ years of experience in community management, social media, influencer marketing, creator operations or digital marketing.
Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp.
Good knowledge of Mexican social media trends, internet culture and local consumer behavior.
Experience managing influencers, KOCs, creators or online communities is highly preferred.
Experience in smartphones, consumer electronics, gaming, youth culture or lifestyle brands is a plus.
Strong communication, organization and project management skills.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and multicultural environment.

About the job

About The Team

We are a friendly and diverse group of individuals located in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico with varying levels of experience in the reinsurance industry. We support North America Property and Casualty Reinsurance teams and units in delivering on their core mandates. We are part of a global team called Reinsurance Business Operations, and we collaborate closely with our colleagues all over the world.

About The Role

Provide our team of Facultative Underwriters with support for all non–client facing activities, including but not limited to:


Data entry of Submission risk clearance
Policy tracking and client follow-ups for missing documents
Provide administrative support regarding records management and processes for the business relationships in his/her area of responsibility
Assists in the planning and reporting process including data gathering and data entry
Enforces and maintains guidelines throughout all facultative risks including archiving and storage planning


Additionally, this role requires someone who feels comfortable working with data, identifying inconsistencies, and organizing information in a clear and reliable way. A big part of the job is handling information flows, spotting gaps, and ensuring accuracy across systems and documents — so an analytical mindset and ease with structured tasks are essential.

About You


Excellent written and verbal communication skills necessary (English and Spanish)
Strong attention to detail
Demonstrates a positive attitude, proactive thinking and effectiveness as a team player
Applies accurate logic and common sense in decision making
Strong customer focus and service orientation
Ability to adapt quickly to changes in tasks and priorities
Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively
Ability to support underwriters in different locations
Demonstrates willingness to seek new knowledge and tasks, questions current processes while suggesting improvements
Comfortable working with data, spotting inconsistencies, and maintaining organized and accurate information across multiple systems.


About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. Hi! We're Yalo

We're on a mission to revolutionize how businesses sell with intelligent AI agents. Born in Latin America and driven by its spirit of innovation, we're now transforming how enterprises around the globe engage their customers and grow.

We're entering our Agentic Era: we no longer just deploy conversational commerce — we put AI agents inside some of the world's largest enterprises, working alongside their commercial teams. Someone has to own whether those agents actually change the business.

That is this role.

The mission

Turn strategic customer relationships into measurable business impact and sustainable growth — operating at the intersection of strategy, consulting, customer success, commercial growth and AI.

This is not a traditional CSM role. No ticket queues. No adoption calls for the sake of adoption. You walk into an ambiguous business problem, structure it, use data to understand it, build the recommendation, prototype the AI solution, align senior stakeholders — and turn it into production and measurable results.

+45% net revenue growth across your existing portfolio

You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone an engineer takes seriously — and someone a customer's team learns from.

Structured problem solving — You bring clarity to ambiguity and think in hypotheses.

title: Analyst, P2P Customer Care
description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.




Your New Role

This position exists to support the Procure to Pay (PTP) workstream of Warner Bros. Discovery WBD. This person will have overall responsibility for performing PTP functions involved in maintaining PTP processes, ensuring Sox compliance, maintaining a robust controls environment providing updates/reporting of overall Procure to Pay Operations.

Your Role Accountabilities
• Deliver world class / proactive customer service to internal and external stakeholders while adhering to company policies and procedures
• Support PTP processes to ensure operational success (i.e. vendor creation is timely, invoices match to PO’s correctly, invoices route to the appropriate coders, etc.)
• Review PCard statement submissions for compliance
• Monitor and reconcile aging PTP activity, including interfacing applications
• Support integration and onboarding of new acquisitions into Warner Bros. Discovery processes and systems
• Support PTP system changes, improvements and new company codes created with testing as required and support new business projects, acquisitions and integrations where needed
• Serve as a subject matter expert in PTP processes & technologies (SAP SRM, Ariba, PeopleSoft, Oracle, OpenText VIM, SAP ECC) for non-content spend.

Qualifications & Experience
• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance or related field is preferred
• Experience in Peoplesoft Financials and SAP is preferred
• Experience in the Media Industry and/or Media Sales is preferred
• A working knowledge of Microsoft Office products (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint)
• Should have a complete understanding of the PTP process
• Strong listening, verbal and written communication skills
• Ability to work independently, creatively and efficiently
• Proven track record in meeting deadlines

The Nice to Haves
• Exclusive Warner Bros. Discovery events and advance screenings
• Paid time off every year to volunteer for eligible employees
• Access to well-being tools, resources, and freebies
• Access to in-house learning and development resources
• Part of the Warner Bros. Discovery family of powerhouse brands




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

description:
About the job

SOBRE EL ROL




Fertilidad Integral es la red de clínicas de fertilidad y ginecología de mayor crecimiento en México, con presencia en Ciudad de México, Guadalajara y Metepec, y alianzas médicas en Puerto Vallarta y Michoacán.




El Growth Automation Analyst lidera la ejecución técnica del stack de automatización: levanta requerimientos junto al Growth Automation Specialist con Experiencia del Paciente, Ventas, Marketing y Producto, los traduce en soluciones técnicas sobre el stack digital, incluyendo HubSpot y ATOM, y orquesta su implementación: ejecutando lo que tiene sentido ejecutar directamente, delegando al partner externo o al área de Data y/o Tech lo que no. No es un rol puramente técnico ni puramente de negocio: es el puente entre los dos.




Es parte del área de Growth y trabaja de forma transversal con el equipo de Ventas, Experiencia del Paciente, el equipo de Paid Media y el área de Datos.




RESPONSABILIDADES

Participa activamente e implementa proyectos de automatización, mejora de flujos, implementación de IA, entre otros, para mejorar la operación de los equipos.




Orquestación y gestión de stakeholders

Actuar como punto de coordinación entre el equipo interno (Growth, Ventas, Experiencia del Paciente), el partner de agencia y las áreas de Datos y Tech: clarificar responsabilidades, gestionar prioridades del backlog y garantizar que los proyectos lleguen a producción.
Recibir pedidos de distintas áreas, evaluar su viabilidad y prioridad, y traducirlos en requerimientos accionables para quien corresponda ejecutar.




Funciones

Coordina con las áreas Comerciales y de Marketing e implementa en el CRM y herramientas de comunicación nuestras campañas de reactivación de deals no convertidos, con mensajes pertinentes de promociones, financiamiento, etc.
Propone, coordina e implementa flujos de lead nurturing, con una serie de toques y mensajes educativos con el objetivo de dar acompañamiento e impulsar la conversión de nuestros deals.
Revisa, mantiene y propone mejoras sobre los flujos y automatizaciones actuales.
Analiza, revisa y presenta resultados de negocio de las campañas ejecutadas por el equipo.
Propone y coordina actualizaciones a los manuales operativos del CRM y otros sistemas pertinentes para asegurar el correcto uso y entendimiento de las plataformas por parte de los usuarios.
Impulsa la mejora continua mediante experimentación (AB testing), definiendo hipótesis y criterios de éxito. Evaluar oportunidades de incorporar IA y nuevas herramientas que incrementen la eficiencia y el impacto del negocio.




Reporte y mejora continua

Proponer mejoras continuas con hipótesis claras y criterios de éxito definidos antes de implementar.







PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

1–3 años de experiencia en roles de CRM, marketing automation, revenue operations o chatbot/conversational marketing, de preferencia en empresas con ciclos de venta consultivos.
Dominio de HubSpot (workflows, pipelines, propiedades, reportes). Conocimiento de ATOM, Manychat o herramientas similares de WhatsApp automation es un plus diferenciador.
Capacidad de leer el negocio y traducirlo a lógica técnica: entiende automatizaciones, APIs y middlewares como Zapier, sin necesidad de ser desarrollador.
Perfil proactivo con autonomía para operar en un equipo pequeño donde no todos los procesos están definidos. Cómodo con la ambigüedad: puede estructurar un pedido poco definido y convertirlo en un plan ejecutable.
