About the job

Join a team that puts people at the center of everything.




At TLNT, we believe that recruitment is more than just filling roles — it’s about connecting humans with humans. We’re a people-first organization partnering with top U.S. companies to help them grow by attracting exceptional talent, and we know that the right content can open the right doors.




This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career with a leading US-based company—fully remote.




You’ll join a woman-owned, small-batch natural skincare brand handmade in Florida — tallow, goat milk and castor-oil-based products sold direct-to-consumer through Shopify, plus one physical storefront. The brand already runs an active, growing TikTok Shop affiliate program alongside a strong organic presence on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.




This is a role for someone who can take ownership of the channel — not simply coordinate creators. It’s an individual contributor position, and the expectation is real ownership of outcomes, not only task execution.




You won’t be starting from zero. Per-platform affiliate infrastructure and commission structures already exist, and there are 100+ affiliates in the program today. But the program has outgrown what’s currently being managed, and this hire is expected to build the systems, relationships and judgment needed to run it at scale.




What You'll Do

Recruit and onboard TikTok affiliates and UGC creators — including filtering serious applicants from spam and low-quality inbound.
Build and maintain creator relationships: proactively reach out to new creators who’d be a strong fit, while managing and growing the existing 100+ affiliate network.
Manage product seeding and outreach.
Develop affiliate campaigns, incentives and commission strategies — evolving and running the structures that already exist across platforms, not building them from scratch.
Secure high-quality UGC that can also be used in paid advertising, through affiliate follow-up and account management, making sure agreed content actually gets posted. This role does not create the content itself.
Track creator performance and grow the channel based on results.
Establish the systems and processes needed to scale: the per-platform affiliate structures exist, but the workflows to triage and manage 100+ (and growing) affiliate relationships day to day still need to be built.
Handle day-to-day affiliate communication — answering questions on commissions, products and program requirements over email and DM.




What You Bring

Proven experience in affiliate or influencer marketing. This one is required, no exceptions.
Fluent, confident English communication skills, and comfort negotiating and building relationships with U.S.-based creators.
Strong familiarity with the TikTok platform and the creator/affiliate ecosystem.
An outgoing, personable communication style — you’ll be the primary point of contact for dozens of creators every day.




Nice to Have

Experience with Shopify or a similar e-commerce platform.
Personal engagement with beauty, skincare or wellness content and communities.




Salary & Perks

Competitive Pay: We hire top talent and compensate accordingly.
This is a full-time, long-term engagement with room to grow.
An individual contributor role with real ownership of the channel.
The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with TLNT.
100% remote — work from wherever you do your best thinking.
Additional perks.




Ready to apply?

We’d love to hear your story. The next step is a short application where you can share more about your background and upload your resume in English. Take your time — we read every response carefully.

title: Event Marketing Manager | B2B & Corporate Events
description:
About the job

For our client, an international technology company that is strengthening its commercial and marketing presence in Mexico and LATAM, we are looking for Event Marketing Manager | B2B Tech Events in Mexico.




We are looking for a proactive, hands-on and highly organized Event Marketing Manager who can take ownership of event activities in Mexico, from identifying the right opportunities and managing local vendors to lead capture, CRM follow-up and post-event performance analysis.

This is not a purely operational event-planning role.




The main goal of this role is to make events a measurable commercial channel by supporting brand awareness, generating qualified leads, contributing to SQL and pipeline creation, and connecting event participation with clear business outcomes.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR IN OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE

· We are looking for a proactive, responsible, and highly organized professional who can take ownership of event execution in Mexico and manage multiple details, vendors, deadlines, and internal stakeholders at the same time.

· The ideal candidate should have solid experience organizing corporate, B2B marketing events and should understand that events are not only about logistis, but also about brand visibility, lead generation, CRM follow-up, and business impact.

 

EXPERIENCE IN THE FOLLOWING SECTORS WOULD BE HIGHLY VALUABLE:

B2B technology; SaaS; FinTech / PayTech; banking technology; telecom; CPaaS; cloud communications; contact center technology; enterprise software; digital B2B services; corporate event agencies serving technology or business clients. 

 

1. Experience in event management, event marketing, field marketing, corporate events, B2B events. 

2. Previous experience organizing business-focused events such as conferences, trade shows, expos, sponsored events, business lunches, executive dinners, roundtables, or partner events. 

3. Strong experience coordinating local vendors, including venues, production teams, booth builders, printing suppliers, merchandise providers, catering providers, and logistics partners. 

4. Ability to manage event timelines, budgets, materials, approvals, deadlines, and several event-related workstreams simultaneously. 

5. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through. 

6. Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills. 

7. Ability to work independently, anticipate risks, and proactively follow up on open tasks. 

8. Fluent Spanish for local coordination with vendors, venues, and partners in Mexico + Strong business English for communication with the direct manager and international teams. 

9. Based in Mexico, ideally in Mexico City or nearby. 

10. Availability to travel when required for events.

 

MAIN JOB FUNCTIONS

1. Develop and regularly update the annual event calendar for Mexico and LATAM prioritizing activities based on ICP fit, brand relevance, and commercial potential. 

2. Identify and evaluate relevant conferences, summits, trade shows, business events, executive dinners, roundtables, sponsorships, and co-hosted event opportunities. 

3. Coordinate the company’s participation in events from end to end, including planning, budgeting, logistics, vendor management, booth or brand zone preparation, materials, merchandise, and onsite execution. 

4. Manage local vendors and partners in Mexico, including booth builders, production teams, venues, catering providers, printing suppliers, merchandising providers, logistics partners, and event agencies. 

5. Work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, PR, and regional teams to ensure that each event is aligned with commercial priorities, target accounts, product messaging, and marketing goals. 

6. Support lead generation during events by helping the Sales team collect, organize, and qualify leads through badge scanning, forms, meetings, demos, networking activities, and other lead capture methods. 

7. Ensure proper synchronization of event leads with the company’s CRM, such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar systems, including accurate tagging, data quality, lead ownership, and follow-up visibility. 

8. Coordinate post-event follow-up activities together with Sales, Content, and Product Marketing teams, including email campaigns, social media coverage, PR materials, presentations, and nurture flows. 

9. Support the organization of smaller high-value event formats, such as executive dinners, business lunches, partner events, roundtables, and co-branded activities. 

10. Track event performance and prepare post-event reports, analyzing KPIs such as MQLs, SQLs, CPL, conversion rate, meetings generated, pipeline contribution, ARR potential, branded traffic, media mentions, and overall ROI. 

 

Why Join This Team?

1. This is a great opportunity to join an international B2B technology company expanding in Mexico and LATAM, with a highly attractive compensation package, a mostly remote work format, and the opportunity to travel for key events and conferences.

2. You will take real ownership of event marketing activities in Mexico, working on high-impact initiatives that go beyond logistics and directly support brand visibility, qualified lead generation, pipeline contribution, and business growth.

3. The role offers strong exposure to cloud communications, CPaaS, contact center solutions, and customer engagement technologies, while collaborating with international Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Content, and regional teams.

4. You will join a supportive, collaborative, and non-toxic environment where responsibility, initiative, learning, and ownership are valued. You will also receive guidance from an experienced manager and regional event team, while having the freedom to bring ideas, improve processes, test new event formats, and help build a stronger event marketing function in Mexico.

 

Three Keys to Success in This Position

 

 Ownership, responsibility, and strong execution discipline

 Strong local execution and vendor management in Mexico

 Business-oriented event marketing mindset

 

If you are proactive, highly organized, and excited about building impactful B2B event marketing activities in Mexico, we would be very happy to meet you. Please send your CV to this email cv@tk-recruitment.com we would love to learn more about you.

description:
About the job

About Alpen Labs

Alpen Labs builds infrastructure for financial markets on Bitcoin.

Alpen Finance, currently an internal project name, is our vision for a Bitcoin-native, neobank-like experience: a best-in-class way for users to hold and use BTC and stablecoins while accessing financial services such as credit, earning interest, spending, and so on.

Alpen is the platform that makes this possible directly on Bitcoin, giving users access to modern financial services without requiring them to trust centralized intermediaries. Alpen uses zero-knowledge technology and programmable Layer 2 infrastructure to achieve this.

Our team includes engineers and researchers from organizations such as Blockstream Research, zkSync, Palantir, and Nethermind, as well as contributors to major open-source cryptography and blockchain projects.

The Role

We are hiring a Consumer Marketing Lead to build the marketing function for Alpen Finance from the ground up.

The product is prelaunch, with no established acquisition playbook or proven channel mix. You will develop the marketing approach needed to take it from its initial unveiling through launch and its first meaningful base of customers, then continue to scale what works.

The immediate focus is consumer acquisition: identifying the right prospective customers, translating the product’s positioning into effective marketing, testing channels and campaigns, and building qualified demand before launch.

This is a highly hands-on, commercially oriented role requiring broad marketing fundamentals and strong judgment. You will work closely with leadership, product, and engineering while personally driving both strategy and execution.

What You’ll Do

Build the marketing foundation


Develop a focused consumer marketing strategy for Alpen Finance.
Turn the product vision into clear marketing priorities, campaigns, and operating plans.
Establish the measurement and feedback loops needed to understand what is working.
Create a practical roadmap from prelaunch audience development through launch and postlaunch growth.
Define and advocate for the marketing investment needed to execute the strategy.


Own consumer acquisition


Identify and prioritize the audiences most likely to become valuable early customers.
Find effective ways to reach them in a market where conventional paid advertising may be constrained.
Test channels such as content, community, referrals, partnerships, creators, events, and selective paid media.
Build and operate acquisition programs and prelaunch campaigns.
Turn promising experiments into repeatable acquisition programs.


Prepare and execute the launch


Own the consumer-facing marketing plan for the product’s unveiling and launch.
Coordinate the campaigns, content, channel activity, and customer communications needed for launch.
Build interest before the product is live while setting accurate expectations.
Establish a sustained marketing cadence beyond the initial announcement.


Find and validate product-market fit


Test hypotheses about the customers, use cases, and problems where Alpen Finance can create the most value.
Use customer conversations, acquisition experiments, and product behavior to identify genuine demand and product pull.
Distinguish meaningful PMF signals from attention or low-intent signups.
Bring customer and market evidence into decisions about positioning, product priorities, launch markets, and go-to-market strategy.


Connect acquisition to product usage


Shape the customer journey from awareness and waitlist participation through onboarding, borrowing, card use, and referral.
Work with product and engineering to connect the marketing promise with the product experience.
Understand where customers engage, convert, retain, or drop out.
Evaluate acquisition activity based on customer quality, behavior, and economics, not reach alone.


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial, commercially- minded, hands-on consumer fintech marketer who can build an early-stage marketing operation, acquire a product’s first meaningful customers, and scale what works.

Core Capabilities


3+ years of relevant marketing experience, with meaningful ownership of GTM, customer acquisition, and growth.
Consumer fintech: Experience marketing a consumer fintech, lending, payments, cards, wallet, brokerage, or similarly trust-sensitive financial product.
Zero-to-one consumer marketing: You have helped take a consumer product from prelaunch or very early stage through launch and meaningful adoption, and understand how marketing changes once real customers and acquisition data exist.
Consumer acquisition: You have directly owned acquisition strategy and execution and can identify, test, and scale effective channels.
PMF and commercial judgment: You have owned metrics such as CAC, conversion, activation, retention, referral, or payback and can use them to make decisions about where to invest.
Marketing fundamentals: You can connect customer understanding, positioning, messaging, content, channels, and measurement.
Hands-on execution: You can turn strategy into campaigns, assets, experiments, and operating work.
Customer and market judgment: You can form useful hypotheses from incomplete information, test them, and adjust based on evidence.
Cross-functional ownership: You can move work forward across product, engineering, leadership, and other stakeholders.


We care more about demonstrated work, ownership, and judgment than a particular title or career path.

Valuable Experience


Crypto or Bitcoin products with unconventional customer behavior or acquisition channels.
Community, creator, referral, partnership, content-led, or product-led acquisition.
Marketing products that require customers to understand risk and place meaningful trust in the company.


Why Alpen Labs


Build from zero: Create the consumer marketing function and acquisition approach from the beginning.
Meaningful ownership: Shape how a new Bitcoin financial application reaches its first customers.
Market challenge: Solve acquisition problems for a product that does not fit neatly into conventional consumer-finance categories.
Technical ambition: Work alongside leading engineers and researchers building new infrastructure for Bitcoin-native finance.

title: Account Executive - Distribution Solutions
description:
About the job




Sobre CUBBO







Somos CUBBO, una empresa respaldada por venture capital que construye la infraestructura del ecommerce — combinando tecnología y logística para que las marcas escalen el comercio moderno.




Apoyamos a las marcas conectando todo su proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología y operaciones.




Nuestra plataforma atiende a cientos de marcas y procesa +1M de pedidos mensuales, entregando con velocidad y consistencia.




Trabajamos desde la Ciudad de México, donde nuestro equipo construye herramientas y capacidades logísticas para el comercio moderno.







Nuestra Visión







Empoderar a las marcas para que ganen libertad, convirtiéndonos en la plataforma presente en cada transacción del comercio moderno.







No estamos aquí solo para competir; estamos aquí para dominar y redefinir el futuro del comercio moderno. Si eres un jugador AAA, CUBBO te ofrece una plataforma sin igual para ser parte de esta transformación.







Nuestra Misión







Ayudamos al comercio moderno a reducir fricción y entregar mejores experiencias de compra. Nuestra plataforma conecta todo el proceso de pedidos —desde la compra hasta la entrega— a través de tecnología, operaciones y logística.







Ubicación







Ciudad de México (Headquarters)




Modelo híbrido: 4 días presencial, 1 día remoto




Sí, no somos 100% remotos.







El Rol




Como Account Executive para Distribution Solutions, no serás simplemente un vendedor; serás el arquitecto que diseña cómo las marcas más importantes de México y el mundo escalan sus operaciones. Tu misión es transformar la complejidad logística en una ventaja competitiva, posicionando a Cubbo como la columna vertebral tecnológica y operativa de las marcas de consumo moderno.




Serás el dueño del ciclo de ventas de principio a fin, identificando oportunidades estratégicas donde nuestras soluciones de distribución e infraestructura puedan desbloquear un crecimiento sin precedentes para nuestros clientes. Tu impacto se medirá en la eficiencia de miles de pedidos y en la consolidación de Cubbo como el líder indiscutible del ecosistema e-commerce en la región.




Buscamos a un closer nato, alguien que se sienta cómodo navegando conversaciones complejas y que comparta nuestra obsesión por redefinir el comercio moderno. Si te apasiona la tecnología, la logística y ganar en un entorno de hiper-crecimiento, este es tu lugar.







Responsabilidades Clave




**Estrategia de Ventas y Prospección**

• Identificar y calificar clientes potenciales de alto valor (marcas regionales y globales) que requieran infraestructura avanzada de distribución.

• Construir y gestionar un pipeline robusto de oportunidades para asegurar el cumplimiento de metas mensuales y trimestrales.

• Desarrollar estrategias de prospección personalizadas que resalten la propuesta de valor única de Cubbo en tecnología y logística.




**Consultoría y Cierre de Negocios**

• Liderar presentaciones y demostraciones técnicas, articulando cómo nuestra infraestructura resuelve problemas críticos de la cadena de suministro.

• Negociar términos comerciales complejos y cerrar acuerdos multianuales que aseguren el crecimiento a largo plazo de la compañía.

• Colaborar con los equipos de Operaciones y Producto para asegurar que las soluciones propuestas sean viables y escalables.




**Gestión de Relaciones y Mercado**

• Actuar como un asesor estratégico para los tomadores de decisiones (C-level), entendiendo profundamente sus necesidades de negocio.

• Analizar tendencias de mercado y competencia para adaptar nuestro discurso de ventas y mantener nuestra ventaja competitiva.

• Mantener una higiene rigurosa del CRM para proporcionar visibilidad precisa sobre el pronóstico de ventas y el comportamiento del mercado.







Habilidades y Competencias




• Mentalidad de Ownership: dueño de sus números y de la experiencia del cliente.

• Resiliencia y persistencia para navegar ciclos de venta largos y entornos startup de alta velocidad.

• Habilidades de comunicación excepcionales y capacidad de persuasión a nivel directivo.

• Orientación absoluta a resultados (Quota Crusher).







Hard Skills




• Experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B de ciclo complejo (Logística, SaaS, o Supply Chain).

• Dominio de metodologías de venta consultiva.

• Manejo avanzado de herramientas CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot o similares) para la gestión de pipeline.

• Capacidad de análisis financiero para construir Business Cases y calcular el ROI para clientes potenciales.

• Inglés profesional fluido (capacidad para negociar con marcas internacionales).







Deseable




• Red de contactos establecida en el sector de Retail o E-commerce en México.

• Experiencia previa en startups de logística, tecnología de rápido crecimiento o retail.

• Conocimiento profundo del ecosistema de e-commerce (marketplaces, plataformas de última milla, etc.).

• Pasión por los retos técnicos y la innovación en procesos comerciales.







Nuestros Valores







Customer First: En CUBBO, el cliente es nuestra estrella norte. Operamos bajo el principio de que la mejor decisión para nuestros clientes es la mejor decisión para nosotros.







Confianza: Confías en tus compañeros Cubbeños, reconociendo que el trabajo en equipo es esencial para nuestro éxito colectivo.







Empoderamiento: En CUBBO, esperar instrucciones no es opción. Eres un catalizador que empodera a otros a tomar la iniciativa y tomar decisiones de impacto.







Growth Mindset: Siempre estás haciendo preguntas, con hambre de mejorar. Si no te da pena lo que hacías hace seis meses, no estás creciendo lo suficientemente rápido.







Velocidad: Las ideas solas no ganan mercados; la ejecución rápida y efectiva sí. Actuamos rápido, nos adaptamos y convertimos planes en resultados.







Candor: La transparencia y el feedback constructivo son la base de nuestra cultura. Valoramos la honestidad orientada al crecimiento personal y profesional.







¿Por qué unirte a CUBBO?







Sé parte de una revolución







Únete a nosotros para establecer estándares disruptivos en la industria y cambiar la cara del ecommerce en Latinoamérica. Estamos revolucionando la región entera a través de la innovación.







Trabaja con los mejores







Acelera tu crecimiento profesional exponencialmente en CUBBO. Un año aquí equivale a una década de experiencia en otro lugar. Si eres un high-performer que busca un equipo de campeones, tu búsqueda termina aquí.







Construido para durar, construido para ganar







No solo sobrevivimos; estamos creciendo. Nuestra salud financiera nos permite enfocarnos en lo que realmente importa: ganar el mercado y asegurar una experiencia al cliente sin igual.




Salario




• MXN 55000 bruto mensual

• Crecimiento profesional: oportunidades aceleradas de aprendizaje y desarrollo en una empresa de rápido crecimiento

• Excelente ambiente laboral: trabaja con un equipo inspirador y divertido en una cultura que valora la colaboración, el crecimiento y la mentalidad customer-first

• Estar en la primera fila transformando toda la industria del Comercio Moderno

• Seguro médico

• 20 días de vacaciones desde el día 1

• Servicio / Comedor en la oficina

You'll join an Australian technology company using AI to create meaningful social and economic impact.

● Work with emerging AI technology in education and employability.

● Build relationships with universities, education organisations and workforce partners.

We're looking for someone who wants to grow with us and help create an outstanding experience for every Getmee customer and learner in Mexico.

description:
About the job

What You'll Own

Campaign Execution

•Build and launch campaigns across email, landing pages, forms, and scheduled social, in HubSpot today and in Odoo and Mailchimp as the stack moves.

•Load and publish content: landing pages, blog posts, gated assets, images, and email templates. Format it, proof it, test it across clients and devices, ship it.

Tagging and Attribution

•Apply the campaign taxonomy consistently: campaign codes, UTM parameters, source and medium, and campaign membership on the contact record.

•Keep the chain intact from campaign to content to form to CRM record, so attribution reporting holds up when someone questions it.

•Maintain data hygiene: deduplication, required fields, list hygiene, suppression and unsubscribe handling, and bounce management.

•Test tracking before launch and raise breaks before the campaign sends rather than after the report looks wrong.

Reporting and Optimization

•Produce weekly and monthly performance reporting: sends, engagement, conversion, form fills, and campaign contribution to pipeline.

•Keep dashboards current so leadership does not have to request a refresh to see where things stand.

•Bring observations alongside the numbers. What is working, what is not, and what is worth testing next.

•Recommend and implement improvements to subject lines, send timing, form design, landing page structure, and list targeting based on what the data actually shows.

How We Work

Claude is part of the daily toolkit across the Revenue Marketing function. You will use it to draft and vary campaign copy, QA lists, summarize performance, and automate the repetitive parts of campaign setup. Practical fluency with AI tools is a requirement for this role. If your first instinct on a repetitive task is to find a way to stop doing it by hand, you will do well here.

The team is small, distributed, and asynchronous. Written communication carries most of the weight, and people are trusted to run their own work between check-ins.

What We Are Looking For

Required

•Three or more years in marketing operations, campaign operations, or marketing automation for a B2B company.

•Hands-on ownership of at least one marketing automation platform, such as HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, or Odoo. Real depth in one counts for more than passing exposure to several.

•Evidence that you learn platforms fast. Be ready to describe a stack you picked up on the job and what you shipped in your first month on it.

•Working knowledge of CRM structure: contacts, companies, campaigns, campaign membership, and lifecycle stages.

•Disciplined campaign tagging and UTM practice, and an understanding of the reporting that depends on it.

•Practical fluency with AI tools in daily work. Claude preferred.

•Professional written English and at least four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time.

•Care with detail. Careless work in this seat breaks quietly and is expensive to find later.

Preferred

•HubSpot experience, which is where the near-term work sits.

•Odoo experience, which is where the stack is going.

•WordPress content publishing.

•Experience supporting more than one business or brand at the same time.

•Having been through a marketing platform migration before, on either side of it.

description:
About the job

Hey there — yeah, you!




HomeHop is a fast-growing short-term rental management company (think Airbnb & VRBO), and we're on the hunt for a friendly, quick-thinking individual to be the voice our guests hear when they reach out. We started with a handful of properties and now manage 140+ short-term rentals across the Midwest USA… and we're still just getting started!




If you love solving problems, thrive when things move fast, and get a little thrill from checking things off a list — keep reading.




What you'll actually be doing

You'll be our guest's go-to person. Someone messages asking where to park, how the hot tub works, or whether they can check in early? You've got them — warm, fast, and helpful every time. Guest messaging is a big part of this role… but it's not the whole role.




Because we're a startup, no two shifts look the same. One minute you're smoothing over a booking question, the next you're helping the team knock out a random task that keeps the whole machine running. We wear a lot of hats around here, and we're looking for someone who's happy to grab one and jump in.




A taste of the day-to-day:

Chatting with guests across Airbnb, VRBO, and our direct booking channels — keeping it prompt, professional, and genuinely friendly
Handling reservations, questions, and the occasional "help, I locked myself out" moment
Coordinating with cleaning and maintenance crews to keep stays running smoothly
Jumping in on all kinds of team tasks and projects as we grow — flexibility is the name of the game
Keeping notes and records tidy so nothing slips through the cracks
Using critical thinking when problems with guests arise




The schedule:

Friday, Saturday, Sunday, Monday 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST
You'll need to work on American holidays (guests travel most when everyone else is off)
5 days of PTO to start




You'll fit right in if you…

Write like a real, warm human — clear, kind, and typo-free
Stay cool under pressure and can juggle a few things at once
Are tech-savvy and comfortable bouncing between apps and platforms
Have experience with short-term rentals or Airbnb (a big plus!)
Are based in Mexico and ready to work fully remote
Actually like helping people




Why HomeHop?

We're a small, scrappy, supportive team that believes work should be fun — not a corporate snooze-fest. We move fast, we back each other up, we celebrate wins, and there's real room to grow as we do!




Ready to hop in?

Hit apply and tell us a little about yourself. We can't wait to meet you!!

description:
About the job

Business Development Representative | SaaS, FinTech & Tecnología | Prospección Outbound & Eventos 

Para nuestro cliente, una empresa internacional de tecnología especializada en comunicaciones en la nube, soluciones de contact center y automatización de interacciones con clientes, estamos en búsqueda de un/a Business Development Representative (BDR) – Outbound B2B para integrarse a su equipo comercial en México.




Esta posición es ideal para una persona con mentalidad hunter, experiencia en prospección outbound y capacidad para generar nuevas oportunidades comerciales en sectores B2B, especialmente dentro de tecnología, SaaS, fintech, contact center, CPaaS o soluciones de comunicación empresarial.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de identificar y contactar empresas objetivo, abrir conversaciones con tomadores de decisión, calificar oportunidades y agendar reuniones comerciales para el equipo, manteniendo una gestión ordenada y precisa del pipeline en CRM.




LO QUE BUSCAMOS EN NUESTRO/A CANDIDATO/A IDEAL:

1. A partir de 2+ años de experiencia en roles de prospección comercial, generación de leads outbound o desarrollo de ventas B2B. 

2. Experiencia deseable en sectores como tecnología B2B, SaaS, Fintech, contact center, CPaaS, cloud communications, soluciones digitales o servicios tecnológicos para empresas. 

3. Experiencia previa como Representante Comercial, Ejecutivo Comercial, SDR, BDR, Sales Development, Lead Generation o posiciones similares.

4. Mentalidad hunter y fuerte orientación a resultados, con comodidad para hacer contacto en frío, buscar nuevos prospectos y abrir puertas con tomadores de decisión. 

5. Capacidad para identificar empresas objetivo, entender el perfil de cliente ideal y calificar oportunidades comerciales de manera estructurada. 

6. Buenas habilidades de comunicación para explicar soluciones tecnológicas de forma clara, consultiva y profesional. 

7. Experiencia trabajando con CRM, registrando actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de oportunidades de manera ordenada y constante. 

8. Perfil organizado, proactivo, coachable y con actitud madura para representar a la empresa en primeras conversaciones comerciales y eventos de la industria. 

9. Inglés intermedio, suficiente para comunicarse con equipo internacional y entender información comercial del producto. 




FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES DEL PUESTO:

1) Realizar prospección outbound a empresas objetivo definidas por la compañía. 

2) Contactar a prospectos a través de canales como LinkedIn, email, llamadas y otros medios comerciales. 

3) Representar a la empresa de manera profesional en eventos, conferencias y espacios de networking de la industria, realizando prospección activa y no solo atención pasiva de contactos.

4) Identificar y abrir conversaciones con los tomadores de decisión adecuados dentro de cada empresa. 

5) Calificar oportunidades comerciales, entendiendo las necesidades del prospecto, el fit con la solución y el potencial de negocio. 

6) Mantener información clara, completa y actualizada en el CRM sobre actividades, conversaciones, próximos pasos y avance de cada cuenta. 

7) Dar seguimiento constante a prospectos y oportunidades en etapa inicial del proceso comercial. 

8) Proponer nuevas empresas objetivo cuando identifique oportunidades relevantes dentro del mercado. 




¿POR QUÉ UNIRTE A ESTE EQUIPO?

· Se ofrece una compensación altamente competitiva, de acuerdo con tu experiencia y perfil, junto con un atractivo esquema de bonos basado en resultados, porque las contribuciones sólidas deben ser realmente recompensadas.

· En este rol tendrás la posibilidad de participar directamente en la expansión comercial de la compañía en México, trabajando con un producto tecnológico de alto valor y con un equipo internacional orientado a resultados, aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional.

· Además, es una posición ideal si buscas desarrollar una carrera comercial en tecnología B2B, fortalecer tus habilidades de prospección outbound, aprender sobre soluciones complejas y tener exposición real a clientes, eventos de la industria y procesos comerciales consultivos.

· La empresa ofrece un entorno dinámico, flexible y de baja burocracia, donde se valora la responsabilidad, la iniciativa, la transparencia, la capacidad de aprendizaje y la ejecución constante.




TRES CLAVES PARA EL ÉXITO EN ESTA POSICIÓN

1) Mentalidad hunter y fuerte capacidad de prospección outbound

2) Disciplina comercial y excelente manejo de CRM

3) Coachability, profesionalismo y confianza para representar a la empresa

Si te identificas con este rol y te motiva la oportunidad de generar nuevas conversaciones comerciales, abrir puertas con empresas objetivo y contribuir al crecimiento de una compañía internacional de tecnología en México y LATAM, nos encantará conocerte: cv@tk-recruitment.com

Adapt quickly to changing priorities, client feedback, and evolving business needs.




Qualifications:

3+ years of experience in email and SMS marketing, preferably within e-commerce or DTC brands.
Strong hands-on experience with Klaviyo.
Experience with at least one SMS platform such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar.
Proven ability to drive revenue growth through retention marketing strategies.
Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

AI-native mindset with the ability to leverage modern tools and workflows to improve efficiency and output.

Familiarity with Shopify.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Chargeback Operations Analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Chargeback Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to card and ACH disputes filed against Sezzle. Working closely with our fraud/risk team and our customer disputes team, you will navigate issues on a case by case basis to determine the best course of action to help our customers get unstuck. Analysts will also make recommendations to our Chargeback Manager on how to improve and scale our processes. We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Monday through Friday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm CST.

Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

What You'll Do:


Investigate disputed credit card, debit card, and ACH transactions and take suitable action to resolve those disputes within the allowed timeframes.
Work cross functionally with relevant departments (fraud, disputes) to determine next steps on a case to case basis. 
Investigate individual transactions using internal policies and review methodologies to identify patterns or trends.
Understand our systems and tools; investigate account patterns through data analysis. 
Collaborate with analysts, operations specialists, data scientists and engineering to improve our loss prevention mechanisms, processes and tools. 
Learn and maintain strong domain knowledge of the world of fraud including prevention techniques and technologies. 
Maintain or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for timely resolution of queued cases to minimize potential losses. 
Handle escalations from internal and external stakeholders in a professional and efficient manner.


What We Look For:


Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution 
Minimum 1 year of experience in processing chargebacks or investigating and resolving fraud incidents 
Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment 
Attention to detail and ability to multitask 
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills 
Strong business judgment and communication skills 
Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training 
Able to work through holidays 


Preferred Qualifications


2+ years of experience in processing chargebacks or fraud claims or live transactions against fraudulent activity in e-commerce, banking, fintech or financial institutions is a plus
Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer 


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: Loyalty Manager
description:
About the job

Bullfinch Recruitment are proud to be partnering with a high-growth social gaming business, delivering innovative, scalable products to a global player base, who are looking for a Loyalty Manager to join their team.




What you'll do: 

● Proactive Outreach: Drive revenue and retention by conducting regular outbound calls to

your portfolio of top-tier players, identifying opportunities to deepen engagement and present

tailored offers that convert.

● Relationship Management: Act as the primary advocate and concierge for your players,

building the trust and rapport that makes every sales conversation feel natural rather than

transactional.

● Bespoke Offer Creation: Use your knowledge of player preferences and play patterns to

design and pitch unique, tailored rewards and incentives, treating every offer as a sales

opportunity to increase player value and loyalty.

● Needs-Based Selling: Proactively identify what each player needs, whether that's

reassurance, a specific reward, or a resolution and address it directly, turning every interaction

into a chance to strengthen the relationship and drive results.

● Query Resolution: Draw on strong customer service instincts to act as the subject matter

expert for player inquiries regarding rewards, loyalty programs, and account benefits, resolving

issues swiftly so trust stays intact and the door stays open for the next offer.

● Player Requests: Monitor and facilitate withdrawal requests for your players, ensuring a

smooth, prioritized experience that reinforces confidence in the relationship.

● Player Advocacy: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure player feedback is heard and

their needs are met across all touchpoints feeding insights back into future offer strategy.

What we're looking for

● Sales Mindset: A natural at spotting opportunities in conversation and confidently guiding

players toward offers that genuinely benefit them, comfortable with outbound calling as a core

part of the role.

● Customer Service Background: Prior experience in a CS or player-facing support roles, with

a demonstrated ability to attend to player needs, resolve issues empathetically, and turn

problems into positive outcomes.

● Interpersonal Excellence: Fluent in English, able to communicate with confidence, empathy,

and persuasion over the phone and via written channels.

● Accountability: You take pride in owning a problem and an opportunity from start to finish.

Reliable, and you follow through on every promise made to a player.

● Discretion & Judgment: Ability to make informed decisions on custom rewards and player

requests within company guidelines, balancing player satisfaction with commercial impact.

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng

Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables

Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)

La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Communications, the Corporate Communications Channels Specialist is primarily responsible for the creation and distribution of internal and external communications to team members, customers and other external stakeholders. At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

title: Analista de cartera y datos
description:
About the job

Analista de cartera y datos

100% remoto (México) · $22,000 a $25,000 MXN mensuales, por honorarios · Proyecto a 3 meses con revisión.




Somos una startup de cobranza para originadores de crédito en México. Lanzamos y operamos equipos de agentes de inteligencia artificial que negocian con deudores por mensajería y por teléfono. El cliente entrega su cartera y nosotros operamos la gestión completa: contacto, negociación, acuerdos y seguimiento.




Estamos firmando nuestros primeros clientes, serías de los primerxs en arrancar este proyecto con nosotros. Reportas directo a un cofundador, y los procesos de análisis que uses los primeros meses son los que va a heredar el equipo cuando crezca: los vas a escribir tú.




QUÉ VAS A HACER




Aproximadamente la mitad del tiempo es operación diaria: correr el reporte, perseguir datos que faltan, responderle al cliente. La otra mitad es análisis. Si la parte operativa no te interesa, este puesto no es para ti.




INDISPENSABLE




• SQL: joins, agregaciones, funciones de ventana.

• Python (pandas), de preferencia, o R.

• Excel al nivel de tablas dinámicas y búsquedas (XLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH), sin romper el archivo.

• Conceptos generales de crédito y cobranza: días de mora y buckets de atraso, saldo insoluto, quita o descuento, reestructura, tabla de amortización, castigo, promise taken/kept, roll rate.

• Datos reales y sucios. Sabes dejar rastro de qué le hiciste al dato y por qué.

• Presentar. Puedes tomar un análisis y convertirlo en cinco láminas que un director entienda sin que tú estés presente.




CONDICIONES




• 1 a 2 años de experiencia en cartera, riesgo, crédito o cobranza de un banco, SOFOM o despacho de cobranza; o en análisis de datos en general.

• Tres meses de proyecto, con revisión al cierre. Si funciona de los dos lados, pasa a posición permanente en nómina.

• Nos vemos en persona en Pachuca o CDMX de vez en cuando.

• Reportas al VP Comercial y de Operaciones, cofundador.




CÓMO APLICAR




Manda a hr2@nojucollect.ai (en asunto: nombre de la posición | tu nombre):




1. Tu CV.

2. Un ejemplo de análisis de datos que hayas hecho. Puede estar incompleto.

3. Dos o tres párrafos sobre algún proyecto que hiciste: (a) cuál era la pregunta que tenías que contestar; (b) qué encontraste mal en los datos y qué decidiste tirar o corregir y cómo lo hiciste; (c) qué te salió mal o qué harías distinto.

4. Tu disponibilidad de arranque.




#Cobranza #AnálisisDeDatos #SQL #Python #Fintech #México #Cartera

description:
About the job

Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead
About Flowerburst

We are the fastest growing and most disruptive business in publishing since Amazon. 




Flowerburst starts movements — ideas that burst into life radiantly. Publishing is broken: more than 80 percent of Americans feel they have a book in them, and only about 1 percent ever publish it. After taking 2-3 years to go to market, nine out of ten traditionally published titles fail to turn a profit. Why? There are three middle men between the author and end customer, and there simply isn’t enough margin for any party to invest in marketing. 




Success on self-publishing platforms like Amazon KDP is even more elusive – they leave authors marketing blind and without cashflow: Amazon KDP doesn't show authors who their customers are and where they came from, and pay 60+ days after a sale is made. The result is centuries of gatekeeping in which the best ideas rarely reach the people who need them, dying on shelves in the back of bookstores, undiscovered. We are building the company that fixes this: an AI publishing platform fused with social, direct-to-consumer commerce. The AI platform allows anyone, anywhere to compile their idea in book form - helping the author exactly where they need it. Social commerce allows authors to place books in the heart of culture – social media feeds – to get discovered, even by audiences who typically don’t read books. Anyone, anywhere can write a book and get it to the masses. The end goal is a literary revolution.




The flywheel is already turning and validation has been immediate. In under 12 months since prototype launch, we’ve grown to $7.5M ARR (GMV run rate), and we are one of the top book sellers on social commerce platforms like TikTok Shop; we operate our own publishing imprints, and a creator/affiliate program of hundreds of active creators. Over the next quarter, we’re releasing our own titles (we publish at the speed of movements, not years), and within the next year, we’re opening up our platform so any author – regardless of station in life – can put their idea on paper and bring it to people who are eager to hear it.




The team is scrappy, ambitious, fast-moving, and highly entrepreneurial.




About the Role

We are hiring a Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead to own and scale one of the most important parts of Flowerburst’s growth engine: our TikTok Shop affiliate and VIP Special Ops creator program.




This is not ordinary affiliate management.




Flowerburst has access to a large catalog of top-selling books and uses performance data to identify products with viral TikTok Shop potential before the broader market fully catches on. When we find those products, we bring them to selected creators with a compelling offer: higher commissions, product insights, performance analysis, content hooks, sample support, GMV Max support, and a real partnership designed to help them grow their GMV.




The goal is to help creators win. When creators consistently post around the right products, the upside can be substantial for both the creator and Flowerburst.




You will manage relationships with top TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators, convert them into active VIP partners, and help them produce more videos that sell books. You will be responsible for turning creator interest into posting commitments, repeat content, GMV growth, and long-term creator partnerships.




This is a creator-facing growth role for someone who is organized, persuasive, commercially minded, and excited to help build a repeatable creator revenue engine.




What You’ll Do

You will manage Flowerburst’s VIP creator pipeline from outreach to activation.




This includes identifying promising creators, sending personalized outreach, following up, tracking next steps, coordinating samples, sharing product briefs, asking for posting commitments, monitoring creator activity, and reporting what is working.




You will help build creator launch pods around new book releases and high-potential VIP products. For each campaign, you will help match the right creators with the right products, share content angles, track sample delivery and first posts, and encourage creators to post multiple videos rather than just one.




You will build relationships with creators so they see Flowerburst as one of their best affiliate partners. You will give them useful product insights, help them understand why certain books may resonate with their audiences, and make them feel like part of an insider program.




You will also help build the operating system behind the program: clean tracking, weekly reporting, repeatable follow-up workflows, creator briefs, and simple SOPs.




Responsibilities
Manage a pipeline of TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators
Invite high-potential creators into Flowerburst’s VIP Special Ops Program
Send warm, persuasive, personalized outreach and follow-up messages
Clearly explain the creator opportunity and why selected products may help creators grow GMV
Track creator status, next steps, samples, posting commitments, and performance
Coordinate with internal operations on creator samples
Help creators understand which books to post and what angles may work
Build and manage creator launch pods for new book releases and VIP products
Ask creators for specific posting commitments
Track first post date, number of videos posted, repeat posting, and GMV
Re-engage creators who have sampled from Flowerburst in the past
Report weekly on creator pipeline, activity, and performance
Identify which creators, products, and content angles deserve more investment
Improve outreach, follow-up, campaign briefs, and creator management workflows




What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will learn Flowerburst’s products, creator program, and TikTok Shop affiliate workflow. You will understand the VIP Special Ops pitch deeply enough to explain it clearly to creators. You will clean up the creator tracker, follow up with warm creator leads, make sure every creator has a clear status and next action, help launch active creator pods, and establish weekly reporting.




You will also build a repeatable workflow for creator outreach, onboarding, follow-up, and campaign management. You will increase the number of VIP creators actively posting, track sample-to-post and post-to-GMV performance, help creators post multiple videos per campaign, own creator follow-up with minimal founder involvement, and create reusable creator briefs and campaign templates.




In your first 60 days, you will own the VIP creator program day-to-day, manage multiple creator launch pods, improve creator activation and repeat posting rates, and give leadership clear reporting on what is working.




In your first 90 days, you will help turn Flowerburst’s creator program into a predictable launch channel for new books and high-potential VIP products.




You Might Be a Fit If
You write excellent English
You communicate in a tone that is warm, casual, direct, and professional
You are highly organized and detail-oriented
You follow up consistently without needing reminders
You are comfortable managing many conversations at once
You have experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, account management, sales development, customer success, ecommerce, or partnerships
You are comfortable using spreadsheets, Airtable, Notion, HubSpot, or similar tools
You can work independently and take ownership
You are comfortable asking people for commitments and following up when they do not deliver
You can understand performance data and translate it into simple, compelling creator-facing communication
You are interested in TikTok, creators, social commerce, books, media, or ecommerce




Bonus Points
Experience with TikTok Shop
Experience with influencer or affiliate programs
Experience working with U.S.-based creators
Experience in ecommerce or social commerce
Experience managing launch campaigns
Experience creating creator briefs or campaign briefs
Familiarity with BookTok, publishing, books, or media
Experience in a fast-moving startup environment
Experience with Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center, affiliate platforms, or creator CRM tools




Location and Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

We are equally interested in candidates based in South Africa, LATAM, and the Philippines.

You must be able to communicate with U.S.-based TikTok creators and affiliates during meaningful U.S. business-hour overlap, especially Eastern and Pacific afternoons.




Compensation

Expected base compensation:

$2,500–$3,500/month USD
Up to $4,000/month USD for an exceptional candidate




There is also significant performance bonus potential for measurable GMV growth.




This role has meaningful upside for the right person. If you help Flowerburst activate strong creators, increase repeat posting, and materially grow GMV from managed creator relationships, we want you to share in that success.




The bonus structure will be finalized after baseline performance and attribution are clear, but it will be tied to outcomes such as creator activation, videos posted, repeat posting, and incremental GMV from managed creators.




What We’re Looking For

We are not looking for a generic virtual assistant.




We are looking for someone who feels like a high-performing account manager, creator partnerships operator, or affiliate growth manager. You should be proactive, commercially minded, organized, and excellent in written communication.




The goal is not just to send messages. The goal is to turn creator relationships into videos, repeat posting, GMV, and long-term creator partnerships.




The right person should be excited about the opportunity Flowerburst can offer creators. We are bringing creators data-backed product opportunities, improved economics, performance support, and a real chance to grow their GMV.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

About the job

Job Description

The candidate must also be able to present the status of an implementation to senior stakeholders, both internally and externally. The individual will manage multiple complex deals/projects concurrently that may have competing priorities, resources, and timelines - and must be able to support broader program management of large clients as well as internal key initiatives. This includes providing consultation to clients on product capabilities, method of payment/currency requirements, gathering and documenting requirements, and analysis and expertise with various formats (JSON, SWIFT MT, ISO XML, NACHA, EDI X12, flat files, etc.).

Ultimately this role is responsible for ensuring client business requirements are translated properly and satisfied throughout the implementation of payment solutions and delivery against the mandated agreements. description:
About the job

Hey, Dingus!




Yeah, you heard that right.




Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a Brand Operator to join our growing team! You’re probably thinking, “Wtf is a Brand Operator?” Keep reading. 👀




Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.




Purpose of the Role




The Brand Operator combines client relationship ownership with hands-on marketing production. You are the client’s main point of contact and one of the people actually making the work happen. This role exists because most agencies force clients to choose between “someone who understands your brand” and “someone who can execute.” We don’t think that tradeoff should exist, and neither will you.




About You




Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
Multifaceted, someone who steps up to the challenge
Proactive, always thinking about the needs of a client before they are
Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
Professional level of English (written and spoken)
Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful — you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
A background in marketing is essential
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better




The Skill Requirements




You need real, hands-on proficiency in at least 3–4 of the following:




Short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok, etc)
Social media strategy, content creation, and scheduling
Newsletter writing and editing
Brand strategy and positioning
Copywriting (web, ads, email, social)
Design fundamentals (Canva, Figma, or similar)
Basic analytics and reporting (knowing what a number means, not just where to find it)




Coordination skills alone will not meet the bar for this role. We already know you can manage a project. We need to know what you can build.




Main Objectives




1. Client Relationship Ownership

Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, understanding their goals well enough to make calls without needing a meeting first
Run regular check-ins, reviews, and strategy conversations that actually move the account forward, not just status updates
Translate client goals into a point of view, not just a task list




2. Hands-On Production

Personally execute against your core skills (video, social, newsletter, copy, brand, design, wherever you excel)
Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up ideation, drafting, and iteration. We want to see how you think with AI as a collaborator, not just how fast you can type a prompt
Maintain a quality bar on your own output before it goes to review, not after




3. Internal Collaboration

Work with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other Operators to fill gaps outside your core skills
Keep project tools (ClickUp and similar) current and accurate without needing to be chased
Give and receive direct feedback — we skip the sandwich method here




4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Help shape brand and marketing strategy for your accounts, not just execute against someone else’s plan
Continuously look for workflow improvements, especially ones involving AI, that let you do more without more hours
Manage multiple accounts without letting them quietly rot




Important Notes

Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional.




Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now! Let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

title: Change Order and Pricing Analyst
description:
About the job

Job Description

In this role, your responsibilities will be:

Change Orders

Perform initial review of incoming Change Requests to determine process flow and how to handle change.

Recognize the type of change entered and determine the level of action and how to proceed with items before sending them to the factory for processing.

Work with internal stakeholders to determine and quote the cost and lead-time impact of the requested changes.

Communicate with Emerson Impact Partners to resolve issues, notify them of the cost and lead-time impacts, and provide guidance on how to proceed with their change request including how the fees will be assessed.

Verify that the appropriate department has made the appropriate changes, and the updates have been documented in the FLEX portal, to assign the request to the next department to ensure the correct flow of the procedure.

Follow up the process and status of the change within each department involved in the process.

Ensure new line has been entered correctly by the Impact partner to proceed with the changes

Manages the ticker-orders dashboard to ensure correct process flow of change requests.

Pricing

Update pricing and commissions in Oracle and FF2 as needed.

Investigate and resolve pricing errors and disputes.

Ensure orders have been entered correctly per quotes provided.

Cancel orders that were entered with incorrect pricing and let the Entry User know they need to re-enter it correctly.

Have the authority to contact corrective billing to resolve pricing adjustments.

Order Entry

Enter and commit the orders that Impact Partners have transmitted in Rep Hold: fix unit and old price, tag, currency, deal and quantity errors, remove obsolete codes, enter no-charge orders, configure and set actuators and valves, change shipping information, entering change and expedites fees.

Override and source the items from the correct prime ship as needed.

Adjust and update the correct price on orders to match the quote already provided.

Route emergency and service orders

Error Correction

Ensure communication between the Impact Partner and the production support, error correction and DevOps teams so orders can be successfully transmitted from FF2 to Oracle.

Recognize the different errors and take action to correct and successfully transmit orders to the Oracle system, using tools and knowledge of FF2, XML files and Oracle.

Continuous Improvement

Identify and initiate continuous improvement efforts

Who You Are

You are a proactive and resilient professional who thrives in dynamic environments and embraces challenges with confidence. You enjoy solving problems, are naturally curious, and can move forward effectively even when direction or information may not be fully defined. You are highly collaborative, work well across multiple teams and stakeholders, and maintain a positive attitude when faced with obstacles or setbacks. Your strong communication skills and customer-focused mindset enable you to build effective working relationships across the organization and with external partners.

For this role, you will need:

Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 applications.

Ability to quickly learn and utilize internal systems, tools, and business processes.

Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.

Ability to follow structured processes while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Foundational ability to learn and apply product knowledge.

Confidence in managing ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.

English proficiency equivalent to a TOEIC score of 700 or higher.

Ability to interact effectively with a broad range of stakeholders, including customers, project management teams, order management teams, customer service representatives, manufacturing sites, support teams, and global business partners.

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

Experience working in customer-facing, operations, order management, supply chain, sales support, or project coordination environment.

Exposure to enterprise systems, business applications, or technical support platforms. Demonstrated ability to collaborate with multiple internal and external stakeholders to achieve business objectives.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a continuous improvement mindset.

Proven ability to remain effective and make sound decisions in situations involving uncertainty or changing requirements.

Experience supporting cross-functional teams within a global organization.

Self-motivated, results-oriented, and driven to continuously learn and develop new skills.

Job Competencies

Manages Ambiguity

Collaborates

Manages Conflict

Decision Quality

Persuades

Our Offer To You:

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing and know that to do your best you must have flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work-life balance and offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

At Emerson, we are committed to fostering a culture where every employee is valued and respected for their unique experiences and perspectives. We believe a diverse and inclusive work environment contributes to the rich exchange of ideas and diversity of thoughts, that inspires innovation and brings the best solutions to our customers.

This philosophy is fundamental to living our company’s values and our responsibility to leave the world in a better place. Learn more about our Culture & Values and about Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Emerson.

Our training programs and initiatives focus on end-to-end development, from onboarding through senior leadership. We provide a wide range of development opportunities, including face-to-face and virtual training, mentorship and coaching, project management, and on-the-job training.

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation

If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com .

description:
About the job

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies, helping businesses build high-performing remote teams without limiting talent by geography. We value ownership, clear communication, and people who care about getting the details right, while providing structured onboarding and support for professionals working remotely.




About the Role

As a Customer Operations Coordinator, you’ll support the day-to-day operations of a New York-based business, making sure sales orders, pricing, costs, and customer information are processed accurately and efficiently. You’ll start with a strong focus on back-end operational work, then take on more direct customer communication as you learn the business and demonstrate proficiency.

This is a role for someone who thinks rather than simply processes. When a number, price, margin, or order does not make sense, you’ll be expected to investigate it, double-check the information, and confidently raise questions before moving forward.




Responsibilities

Enter and review sales orders accurately, ensuring customer, product, pricing, and order information is complete before processing.
Validate customer pricing against price sheets, product costs, freight charges, warehouse costs, and other relevant information.
Identify pricing, cost, margin, and order discrepancies before they create downstream operational or customer issues.
Perform basic business calculations involving percentages, costs, margins, multiplication, and division to verify order accuracy.
Investigate information that appears incorrect or inconsistent rather than processing it without question.
Escalate discrepancies and proactively communicate with the appropriate team members to reach a resolution.
Maintain a high level of accuracy while efficiently handling significant volumes of order and operational data.
Support customer inquiries professionally through email as your knowledge of the business grows.
Gradually handle occasional inbound and outbound customer calls once you are comfortable with the company’s products and processes.
Learn the company’s logistics, order management, pricing, and operational workflows well enough to recognize when something does not look right.




Requirements

Must-Have:

Previous customer service, customer-facing, or operational support experience.
Advanced English proficiency across speaking, writing, and reading.
Strong numerical skills and confidence working with percentages, costs, margins, multiplication, division, and basic business calculations.
Excellent accuracy and attention to detail when comparing orders, prices, costs, spreadsheets, and other business data.
Ability to recognize unusual or incorrect figures and investigate them before proceeding.
Professional written communication skills and confidence asking questions or raising concerns when information is unclear.




Nice to Have:

Experience in accounting, banking, finance, order processing, or another numbers- and data-intensive environment.
Experience entering or reviewing high volumes of sales orders or transactional information.
Previous exposure to logistics, warehousing, freight, or supply chain operations.
Experience working with spreadsheets, order management platforms, ERP systems, or similar business software.
Previous experience communicating with U.S.-based customers or teams.
