About the job

💸 USD 18,000 to USD 22,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.




Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.




The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote. Your normal workday will start at 9:30am Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

About the job

Marketing and AI Automation Manager

Type: Full-Time, Long-Term, Remote 

Location: Remote, LATAM-Based Candidates Only

Work Hours: 8am-5pm PST 

Compensation: $10-13/hr, depending on experience, work samples, and strength of relevant experience




ABOUT CASCADEFFECTS

CascadEffects is a fractional operations, industry recruitment, and virtual assistant (VA) service company that partners with growing businesses to build out their teams, systems, and go-to-market execution. This search is being run on behalf of a U.S.-based tax services and tax resolution client. CascadEffects handles sourcing, screening, and initial interviews before presenting finalists directly to the client. Please submit all application materials through CascadEffects as instructed.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is not a basic social media Virtual Assistant (VA) or admin role, and it is not narrow execution-only. You will report directly to the client's CEO as their sole marketing hire, with full ownership of strategy and execution, not just task completion. As the business grows, this role may expand to lead additional marketing hires.




We need someone who can manage CRM workflows, email campaigns, SMS follow-ups, funnels, landing pages, paid media, content, social media, reporting, and AI-supported marketing tasks, and who is comfortable being handed a goal rather than a fully scoped task list. We prefer a candidate who has worked in a similar tax, tax resolution, accounting, financial services, legal, or professional services marketing environment, because the content must be accurate, credible, and responsible.




Our ideal candidate has 5+ consecutive years of recent digital marketing experience and can work independently with minimal training.




A major initial focus will be helping market the client's tax resolution brand, currently a downloadable guide paired with a reformatted IRS transcript analysis, sold as a lower-cost alternative for people who cannot afford full-service tax resolution. It has little to no social media presence today. The client is also actively exploring evolving into a full AI-powered, self-service tool rather than a static download, and this role will be involved in shaping how the product is positioned and marketed as it evolves, not only in producing content for the current version.




CRM CONTEXT

The client's CRM (Zoho) has existing workflows and dashboards that have not been actively maintained or optimized in some time. A key first responsibility will be a full audit to identify what is working, what is broken, and what needs to be rebuilt.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

CRM & Automation:

Audit and rebuild CRM workflows and lead-nurture sequences as needed
Create automated follow-up campaigns based on lead source, interest, or status
Own segmentation, tagging, lists, pipeline stages, and campaign tracking
Monitor automations and troubleshoot issues
Document processes and create simple SOPs




Email & SMS Marketing:

Write, build, schedule, and track email campaigns
Create nurture and reactivation campaigns for leads and past clients, including recovering prospects who dropped out mid-consultation
Draft SMS follow-up, reminder, and reactivation messages
Coordinate email, SMS, and CRM follow-up
Track opens, clicks, replies, appointments, and conversions




Paid Media:

Take ownership of existing paid campaigns (currently Meta Ads, managed by an outside contractor being transitioned out) and identify what to keep, cut, or test
Test and evaluate new channels and platforms as opportunities arise
Manage budget pacing against a clear return threshold, scaling what performs and cutting what doesn't




Funnels & Landing Pages:

Own landing page performance, from structure through conversion optimization
Create or support lead magnets such as guides, checklists, webinars, assessments, or calculators
Improve headlines, calls to action, page structure, and conversion flow
Identify where leads are dropping off in the funnel and fix it




Social Media & Content:

Build our social media presence and content calendar from the ground up
Research common taxpayer questions, fears, objections, and misconceptions
Write posts, captions, carousels, FAQs, and short-form video scripts
Create or coordinate basic branded graphics and short-form videos
Repurpose long-form content into social media, emails, and lead magnets
Schedule and publish content consistently




AI & Reporting:

Use AI tools to support content, campaigns, research, email variations, video scripts, funnel planning, and SOPs
Review, edit, fact-check, and improve AI-generated content before it goes live
Maintain a simple marketing scorecard
Provide weekly updates on work completed, results, obstacles, and next steps

About the job

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with safety. It’s the constant that empowers people to confidently move forward. It can fill a flight or sell out a stadium It can care for a patient or graduate a class. As a global leader in public safety and enterprise security, we create and connect the technologies that help to keep people safe where they live, learn, work and play. Our integrated technology ecosystem unifies critical communications, video security and access control, and command center software, enabling collaboration in more powerful ways. At Motorola Solutions, we’re ushering in a new era in public safety and security. Bring your passion, potential and talents to a career that matters.

Job Description

The Channel Operations Support Analyst plays a key role in the Worldwide Video Sales Operations Team, helping the sales team get their job done. In this role, you will assist in day to day back office activities including but not limited to account setups/modifications, contracts, account data gathering, coordinating people and information to troubleshoot issues that arise, opportunity management and order tracking. Currently, the department is undergoing a strategic shift toward a Triage model, moving from traditional case management to real-time, high-responsiveness support. Manage the ongoing documentation of case management and troubleshooting processes.


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Interact daily with departments including Order Management, Finance, IT, and Customer Success to resolve blockers.

Act as a reliable team player to juggle multiple requests and provide heavy administrative support.

Communication & Language


Strong Written & Reading Skills: Essential for daily management of professional email correspondence and Slack communications with internal stakeholders. 
Clear Spoken English: Must be comfortable and understandable during daily internal video calls and team briefings.


Operational Flexibility & Accessibility 


While the role currently focuses on case management, we are transitioning toward an Omni-Channel Triage model. This will eventually require the candidate to be highly available and online to handle live incoming phone calls and real-time support requests.
A commitment to high responsiveness and the ability to maintain a consistent online presence. 


Technical Skills

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Motive is seeking a driven Account Executive to help build and expand our sales organization in our newest regional market — México. As one of the founding members of this team, you will play a pivotal role in accelerating growth, building customer relationships from the ground up, and shaping how Motive delivers value in the region.

You will leverage Motive’s strong product positioning and proven global success to identify new opportunities, close business, and bring measurable impact to our customers’ operations. This is an ideal role for a high-performing Sales Development Representative (SDR) or Business Development Representative (BDR) who has mastered the art of prospecting and is ready to take the next step into a full-cycle closing role. We are looking for individuals who thrive in fast-moving environments, love building markets, and want to grow within a world-class organization.

This is a hybrid position based in México City, with occasional travel required for client meetings.

What You’ll Do


Own the full sales cycle – from prospecting and pipeline generation to closing and onboarding new customers. 
Develop new business by building strong relationships with key prospects and stakeholders. 
Consistently exceed sales targets, driving growth across Small & Medium Business accounts in priority verticals such as transportation, logistics, construction, and field services. 
Collaborate with sales leadership to localize playbooks, refine go-to-market strategies, and strengthen our commercial footprint in México. 
Conduct needs-based discovery and deliver compelling presentations that translate Motive’s value into tangible business outcomes. 
Negotiate and close deals with professionalism and precision, ensuring a win-win outcome for customers and the company. 
Work cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales Operations, and Marketing to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term success. 
Stay ahead of market trends, leveraging insights to enhance your consultative approach and strengthen your competitive positioning. 


What We’re Looking For


Demonstrated success as an SDR/BDR with strong outbound and closing exposure, or 1+ years of experience in full-cycle B2B sales (ideally within SaaS or technology). 
Proven ability to manage a high-velocity pipeline, maintain a rigorous daily activity cadence, and consistently exceed quota. 
Understanding of 1–2 month sales cycles with deal values typically in the mid-five-figure (USD) range. 
A true hunter mentality – resourceful, resilient, and passionate about winning new logos. 
Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills across all organizational levels. 
Comfort working in fast-paced, high-growth settings, with strong prioritization and self-management skills. 
Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesloft, Gong, Slack, and other modern sales tools. 
Experience selling into transportation, logistics, oil & gas, construction, or compliance and safety industries is a strong plus. 
Must currently reside in México and be fluent in Spanish and English.

At Motive, we’re on a mission to transform the physical economy with cutting-edge technology and data-driven insights. You’ll join a global sales team that values ownership, continuous learning, and teamwork. description:
About the job

There are DTC brands that treat TikTok Shop as a side channel, and others that see it for what it actually is: the single highest-leverage lever in the business. This is the second kind. A family puzzle and games company that's found real traction on paid social in a category most competitors still run through wholesale, and is now betting that a small group of the right creators can take it to a category-defining scale.




Right now, TikTok Shop and creator and affiliate relationships are being managed reactively, alongside everything else. The goal with this hire is to change that: find, sign, train, and run the handful of creators who actually move the needle, and turn that into a repeatable engine feeding both TikTok Shop and Meta.




The math is simple, and the opportunity is real. One or two strong creators are already driving outsized results. The plan is to get to 50 of them, fed with great scripts, trained, motivated, and incentivized to keep posting, producing 1,000+ high-quality videos a month between them. That volume, repurposed into Meta ads, is the single biggest unlock this company has in front of it right now.




If you've run a large TikTok Shop from the inside, you know what separates a creator who posts once and disappears from one who becomes a real growth partner, and you're relentless about finding and developing the latter. This is the most important hire this company is making right now.




This is a fully remote, full-time role.




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Own the entire creator and affiliate function. Full autonomy over sourcing, negotiating, onboarding, and roster management. This is a build-from-scratch seat, not a maintenance role.
Be the reason the flywheel works. Great scripts and a strong media buying team only matter if creators are actually posting consistently. You're the connective tissue that makes the whole model scale.

Work with a proven playbook, not a hypothesis. The one or two creators already driving results prove the model works. Your job is to find the next 48, not invent the concept from zero.
A role built around shared upside. The structure is designed so your success and the program's GMV growth move together.




WHAT YOU'RE GETTING INTO

This role has two connected mandates. The primary one is building and running the creator and affiliate engine behind TikTok Shop, growing from a couple of proven creators to a roster of 50 who are consistently posting high-quality, high-performing content. The second is driving organic social output, high-volume content and video aimed purely at impressions and brand exposure, independent of the GMV-driving creator program.

Drive organic social output across brand channels as a separate lever from the creator and GMV program, pushing high volume of content purely for reach and impressions at effectively zero media cost




WHO YOU ARE

You've managed a large TikTok Shop, ideally one that did $5 million to $10 million+ in GMV, and you know the mechanics, the algorithm, and the creator ecosystem from the inside, not from a course

About the job

About Cape.io

At Cape.io, we're not just keeping pace with the advertising industry. We're accelerating it. We are a global technology company on a mission to eliminate the friction between creative and media. Cape.io is the first Intelligent Campaign Automation platform to unify the entire campaign lifecycle. By embedding AI and automated compliance from creative inception to activation, we empower brands to launch high-impact, compliant campaigns with unprecedented speed and intelligence. Our platform is trusted by the world's top agencies and advertisers to control and distribute advertising content in over 100 countries. With over 230 employees across 21 offices—from London to the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific—we are fundamentally changing the way advertising works.




What you'll do

Own and streamline the end-to-end publishing setup across platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, CM360, DV360, Snapchat and more - from reference campaigns to scalable automation.
Translate campaign requirements into robust Cape.io configurations, ensuring accurate mappings, naming conventions, asset structures and platform-specific compliance.
Test, validate and optimize publishing flows, identifying edge cases and improving reliability, performance and scalability across markets and formats.

What you'll bring

Agency background: Proven experience working in an agency environment - comfortable with high-stakes, fast-moving settings where you're juggling multiple clients and information streams at once.
Coding experience: Hands-on coding ability is required, as this role involves working directly with code for advanced setups (JSON, JavaScript or similar). Comfort reading/writing scripts or structured logic is a must.
Language Skills: Fluency in English and Spanish with strong communication skills for both internal collaboration and client-facing interactions.
Strong understanding of digital advertising ecosystems (Meta, Google Marketing Platform, social and display channels) and how campaign structures translate into technical setups, or a strong willingness to learn.
A detail-driven mindset with the ability to manage complex, highly configurable systems without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Experience with campaign operations, feed structures, automation logic or technical implementations in an ad tech or martech environment.
A proactive, solution-oriented attitude: comfortable testing, troubleshooting and working closely with clients to make sophisticated workflows feel simple.




About the Creative Automation solution

The challenge: Creative bottlenecks and manual Ad Ops are burning out teams and killing campaign performance. The endless cycle of revisions and trafficking keeps brands from scaling what works.

Our solution: Our team is solving this. We've built the all-in-one platform to produce, personalize, and launch high-performing ads for every channel—from social and display to video and DOOH. We unify creative and media workflows, enabling brands to go from a single master creative to unlimited, on-brand variations in minutes, not weeks.

Your impact: As part of this team, you will be at the heart of our mission to unleash creativity. You'll be empowering our clients to outperform the competition by building, selling, or supporting the tools that turn data into high-impact, personalized ads at scale.




Our DNA: How we work

Our values aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles that guide our decisions, actions, and interactions every day.

Move smart: Hesitation kills momentum. We combine speed with intelligence, turning complex challenges into automated solutions. Every experiment teaches us, every failure makes us stronger.
Define tomorrow: We're not here to meet expectations; we're here to reset them. Our mission demands unprecedented quality, security, and scale. We push the boundaries of what's possible.
Be better together: Success multiplies when shared. We step up, dig in, and make things better for each other. Through open collaboration and fierce support, we turn individual potential into collective achievement.
Change what’s possible: Creativity drives humanity forward. Our technology exists to amplify it, protect it, and let it soar. We remove barriers between great minds and great work.

About the job

About Holafly

At Holafly, we’re transforming the way travellers stay connected around the world through eSIM technology.

Since 2018, we’ve helped millions of travellers access mobile data seamlessly across 200+ destinations, becoming one of the fastest-growing companies in the travel connectivity space.

We are a global, fast-paced, and ambitious company with a team passionate about travel, technology, and innovation.

About The Position

Holafly is looking for a proactive and highly organized Partnerships Operations & Activation Specialist to join our growing Travel Partnerships team.

This role will play an important part in supporting the day-to-day operations of the Partnerships team, helping ensure a smooth onboarding and activation experience for partners across global markets.

The position combines operational support, partner onboarding, activation, partner communication, and light commercial responsibilities. The ideal candidate will help partners successfully launch, stay engaged, and become active revenue-generating accounts, while also supporting the internal Partnerships team with operational execution, inbound partner management, and outbound activation follow-up.

We are looking for someone with strong communication skills, attention to detail, a proactive mindset, and a commercial mentality focused on helping partners grow and succeed.

This is a global role, remotely based in LATAM, supporting partners across multiple regions and markets.

Manage inbound partner requests and onboarding processes

Support the Partnerships team with operational and administrative tasks related to partner management

Our passion for providing easy and convenient connectivity to travellers around the world drives everything we do.

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

About the job

About Nu

Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 140 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services.

Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns.

Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Most Influential Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks.

Visit our Institutional Page

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To


Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don't have the data, it's your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
Support your team in making data-based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
Learning how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available;Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well-prepared and highly qualified team;
Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.


What are we looking for?


Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;
Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers' experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
Profiles that add value to Nubank's culture.

description:
About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Media Orchestrator who will:


End-to-End Campaign Delivery & Coordination Manage campaign workflows from brief interpretation to post-campaign analysis while leading status calls, managing timelines, and keeping deliverables aligned across teams. 
DCO Tech Build & Configuration Configure, build, and maintain dynamic creative decision trees in DCO platforms to ensure audience, message, creative, and media rules execute accurately against strategy. 
Troubleshooting & Performance Reporting Identify and resolve technical, campaign, or creative issues promptly, while creating performance reports to extract actionable creative insights for optimization. 
New Business & Market Enablement Support pitches and market adoption by creating compelling case studies, workshop materials, and pitch collateral that highlight HVCS capabilities and success stories. 
Workflow Optimization & AI Innovation Leverage AI tools (such as WPP Open) and emerging DCO technologies to streamline production processes, reduce manual effort, and drive continuous workflow improvement. 


Skills And Experience


2+ years' experience in Ad Operations, Digital Activation, Campaign Management or DCO platforms such as: Flashtalking/Innovid, Smartly, Celtra, etc. 
Advanced level of English (this will be assessed during the interview process) 
Bachelor’s degree 
Proven understanding of digital media channels and campaign delivery fundamentals, with hands-on experience using ad-serving and trafficking platforms. 
Comfortable working with campaign data, building performance reports, and applying strong analytical skills to solve delivery challenges. 
Highly organized with sharp attention to detail, strong process management skills, and clear verbal and written communication. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

About the job

About Us

Platzi is the largest technology school in the Hispanic world with over 5 million students and 4,000 companies trusting us to deliver effective online education. Our mission is to make Latin America a technology superpower. We do it by training companies and individuals in areas such as AI, Cybersecurity, English, Programming and Leadership.

As an industry leader, our presence is highlighted by our massive and fanatic community, extensive press coverage and a daily stream of success stories from students. We operate mostly remote, with key offices in Bogotá, Medellín and Mexico City.

Summary

As a Project Manager, you will lead the design and execution of high-impact educational projects with external partners such as companies, foundations, and governments. You will be responsible for aligning each initiative with Platzi’s strategic goals, creating customized learning programs that meet partner needs, and ensuring successful implementation while maintaining Platzi’s methodology and educational essence.

Requirements

What you'll do


Define the scope, deliverables, and objectives of each project, aligning expectations with internal and external stakeholders
Build detailed work plans, including timelines, milestones, and required resources for seamless execution
Lead implementation efforts across multidisciplinary teams, ensuring projects meet their intended goals on time and within budget
Continuously monitor key performance indicators , and produce progress and outcome reports
Maintain clear and consistent communication with client organizations—government entities, NGOs, corporate partners—and ensure high satisfaction
Identify opportunities to optimize and scale impact, adapting execution strategies as needed
Capture feedback and insights from partners to drive continuous improvement
Represent Platzi’s values and methodology while securing long-term partnerships and impact

3+ years of experience in Project Management, ideally in collaboration with external entities such as NGOs, companies, or government bodies
Proven track record managing complex projects with measurable impact, across multiple stakeholders
Strong command of project management methodologies (PMI, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent)
Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills
Effective communication and negotiation capabilities, with experience in stakeholder engagement
Comfortable managing cross-functional teams and adapting to evolving project scopes
Experience working with KPIs, reporting tools, and data-driven project evaluation
Fluent in Spanish and English, capable of managing bilingual communications and documentation
Passionate about education, innovation, and social impact through learning

With Platzi's help, you will have 100% of the necessary work tools such as a laptop, smartphone, desk, ergonomic chair, monitor, and other accessories.

📗 Books

We provide you with all the books you need to grow professionally on Kindle, and we give you the Kindle too 😉.

🐣 Maternity/Paternity Leave

At Platzi, we believe in gender equity and the importance of parents in the upbringing and care of their children. We make this a reality for new mothers and fathers through extended maternity and paternity leave.

💸 Option Pool

All members of the Platzi Team have the opportunity to own a part of Platzi and have company shares.

🌴 Vacation

You have 15 days of vacation per year regardless of the country you are in, starting from the moment you join the team.

💆‍♂️ Online Therapy

We care about your emotional health by covering the first four online therapy sessions with specialized companies.

🌐 Team Syncs

Although we are in different parts of the world, Platzi teams meet in person during the year to exchange ideas, build, and strengthen bonds.

🏖️ Villa Platzi

Every year, the entire team gathers somewhere in the world for a week to meet face-to-face, get to know each other, have interesting discussions, and plan ambitious projects.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.900 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research


Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight
Analyze qualitative and quantitative user data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities across your product portfolio within Earn and rewards
Bring a genuine Gen Z consumer perspective to how we frame problems, develop messaging, and evaluate product experiences
Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation and sharpen the inputs that shape growth strategy and marketing plans


Strategy & Execution


Own product marketing for your assigned products, both new and existing, supporting the full lifecycle: Discover & Validate, Shape & Plan, Launch & Learn, Optimize & Scale
Translate overall Earn and rewards category strategy into product-specific positioning and messaging, grounded in behavioral data and user research
Develop and execute GTM plans across in-app surfaces, lifecycle messaging, and marketing channels
Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities
Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving
Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift 
Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams


Qualifications

Required


1–2 years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.
Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation
Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly


Nice to Have


Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs
Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

description:
About the job

Somos una empresa liderada por personas, empoderada por la tecnología, omnicanal, dedicada a ayudar a la gente a ahorrar dinero y vivir mejor.



En 2009, Walmart de México y Walmart Centroamérica iniciamos una nueva etapa de crecimiento y nos convertimos en un gran equipo. A partir de 2010, somos Walmart de México y Centroamérica, una de las cadenas comerciales más importantes de la región. Nuestra estrategia omnicanal está centrada en nuestros clientes y en mejorar su experiencia de compra.



Estamos presentes en 6 países: México, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua y Costa Rica.



Contamos con 4,079 tiendas en la región, de las cuales 3,154 están en México y 925 en Centroamérica. Actualmente 6 millones de clientes compran en nuestras tiendas y clubes cada día en México y Centroamérica.



Continuamos ofreciendo a nuestros clientes los productos que necesitan a precios bajos, a través de nuestro portafolio con diversos formatos que tienen propuestas de valor únicas. Al mismo tiempo, aceleramos nuestra estrategia de digitalización. Todo ello, con el fin de servir mejor a todos nuestros clientes y socios en sus diferentes misiones de compra, en todos nuestros canales.





Descripción del empleo



Desarrollar, implementar y optimizar productos publicitarios físicos (offline) dentro del ecosistema de Walmart Connect, identificando nuevas oportunidades de monetización en tiendas y estacionamientos, mediante la creación de formatos atractivos para anunciantes, la construcción de casos de negocio y la coordinación con equipos internos y externos para su correcta ejecución y comercialización.



Principales responsabilidades: 



Desarrollo de Productos Publicitarios



Diseñar y desarrollar nuevos productos publicitarios dentro de tiendas y espacios exteriores, principalmente en estacionamientos.



Identificar tendencias del mercado y oportunidades de innovación en medios de publicidad exterior (Out of Home - OOH).



Evaluar qué formatos publicitarios resultan atractivos para marcas y anunciantes.



Construir propuestas de valor que permitan incrementar la comercialización de los medios disponibles.



Análisis y Estrategia de Negocio



Elaborar business cases financieros para evaluar la viabilidad y rentabilidad de nuevos productos.



Analizar el desempeño de los medios publicitarios a lo largo del año.



Identificar oportunidades de optimización y crecimiento de ingresos.



Diseñar estrategias para mejorar el rendimiento y ocupación de los espacios publicitarios.



Proponer nuevos paquetes comerciales y estrategias de monetización.



Gestión de Stakeholders



Trabajar de manera cercana con equipos internos como ventas, planning, AdOps, Connect, operaciones, trade marketing, marketing.



Coordinar aprobaciones, validaciones e implementaciones de nuevos formatos y proyectos.



Facilitar y destrabar iniciativas mediante una gestión efectiva de stakeholders.



Relación con Proveedores y Agencias



Gestionar proveedores especializados en desarrollo e implementación de medios publicitarios.



Coordinar agencias de diseño y desarrollo de producto.



Negociar costos, cotizaciones y condiciones comerciales con proveedores externos.



Supervisar la correcta implementación de los productos desarrollados.



Capacitación y Habilitación Comercial



Capacitar a los equipos comerciales y KAMs sobre nuevos productos publicitarios.



Realizar presentaciones ejecutivas explicando beneficios, funcionamiento y propuesta de valor de cada producto.



Generar materiales y argumentos comerciales para impulsar la venta de los medios.



En Walmart estamos trabajando por contar con mayor accesibilidad, en caso de que necesites algún ajuste razonable por favor compártelo con el equipo de Reclutamiento.





Requisitos



Calificaciones Preferidas



Experiencia y conocimiento en Medios OOH, Retail Media, Marketing



Conocimientos técnicos en Office, plataformas de IA, metodologías Agile, Conocimientos en agencias de implementación y producción, Manejo de P&L.



Inglés avanzado.

Viajar

Viajes internacionales hacia y desde múltiples instalaciones o lugares de trabajo que requieran pernoctaciones prolongadas.

En Walmart de México y Centroamérica estamos comprometidos con una cultura de pertenencia, por lo que buscamos incorporar el mejor talento basándonos en competencias, habilidades y potencial; no discriminamos por ningún motivo, incluyendo género, edad, origen étnico, apariencia física, estado civil, condiciones de salud por VIH o cualquier enfermedad, situación socioeconómica, discapacidad, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género por ello durante el proceso de atracción y selección no solicitaremos información personal, fotografías o análisis clínicos de ningún tipo. En Walmart de México y Centroamérica nos comprometemos con nuestros/as asociados/as para que encuentren día a día en el trabajo un ambiente de respeto, libre de discriminación y acoso sexual.”

title: Tracking Specialist (GTM) | Remote for Marketing Agency for Education
skills: Own tag management & deployment — deploy, configure, and maintain pixels, tags, and scripts in Google Tag Manager (native templates and Custom HTML); build and maintain data layers with the Web Services team; manage GTM container structure, triggers, and variables across a multi-client environment; implement server-side tagging where it improves measurement accuracy and durability

Own conversion tracking & platform integration — connect website activity to paid ad platforms (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat) using both browser pixels and Conversion APIs (CAPI); configure standard and custom events (leads, applications, inquiries) for accurate reporting and platform optimization; configure and maintain event tracking and key events in GA4 from ad click through form submission and CRM entry; partner with Paid Media and Web Services so every campaign and landing page launches with tracking implemented and verified

Own QA, debugging & data integrity — audit and debug broken tags, dropped events, and data discrepancies across client websites; troubleshoot mismatches between ad platforms, GA4, and CRM to root cause; run routine tag health audits across the portfolio; verify events in platform Events Managers and GA4 DebugView before any campaign goes live

Own data privacy compliance — manage cookie consent banners and consent mode configuration across client sites; keep tracking implementations aligned with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations; monitor platform and browser changes that affect tracking durability and recommend adjustments

Support documentation & cross-team enablement — maintain tagging plans, naming conventions, and QA checklists; translate business requirements from account and client teams into functional tracking solutions; document technical setups so internal teams can interpret and rely on the data
3+ years of hands-on tracking or web analytics experience in a marketing or agency environment
Intermediate experience with GTM containers, trigger and variable creation, data layer implementation, and server-side tagging

Practical experience planning, deploying, and troubleshooting conversion tracking across major ad platforms, with working knowledge of pixel and Conversion API (CAPI) configuration for Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, and LinkedIn
Hands-on GA4 experience, including event configuration, key events, and DebugView

Comfort with HTML, CSS selectors, and basic JavaScript for tag troubleshooting and custom script implementation, and skilled use of GTM Preview mode and browser developer tools (inspect element, network tab)
Understanding of data privacy requirements (GDPR, CCPA) and consent management platforms, and of how tracking decisions affect Paid Media performance KPIs

An analytical, solution-driven mindset with a growth orientation, and strong communication skills that turn technical tracking concepts into clear narratives for non-technical audiences — education marketing experience (traditional or online) is especially valued
Interest in using AI or LLM tools to streamline tag management audits, automate data layer validation, or troubleshoot complex tracking discrepancies across ad platforms
Familiarity using AI-driven insights to assist server-side tag configuration, optimize conversion modeling in privacy-first environments, or generate technical documentation for tracking setups
An AI-forward mindset — curiosity about emerging AI trends in marketing technology and a willingness to experiment with new tools that could improve tracking efficiency or data analysis
Remote role with the flexibility that comes with a distributed, async-friendly team
Competitive compensation based on experience and location
A pivotal, high-visibility seat on a scaling Data & Analytics team, with real ownership over the tracking infrastructure every campaign and report depends on
The chance to build the measurement backbone for an agency whose partners are education and nonprofit organizations working to build a better world
A culture built around finding a better way, playing as a team of A-players, and treating results as the engine rather than the goal
Direct impact: the tags and tracking decisions you make show up directly in whether partners can trust their own data
1️⃣ Application Review (resume + a few questions)
2️⃣ Screening Call with Atomic HR

Más allá de un CV perfecto, buscamos una persona que realmente disfrute las ventas y el hunting.

Disfrutas prospectar, abrir puertas y generar conversaciones desde cero.

Postúlate y ayúdanos a seguir transformando la experiencia de la salud en México.

About Us:




Billions of plastic straws, cups and lids are disposed of every day. At Nothing, we are committed to making a positive change by offering a range of innovative plastic-free paper products. Our mission is to help businesses transition to sustainable alternatives, without compromising on quality or convenience.




Say Goodbye to Soggy Straws and Plastic Lids.




Hate paper straws? Us too.

About the job

Somos una empresa omnicanal impulsada por las personas y habilitada por la tecnología, dedicada a ayudar a las personas a ahorrar dinero y vivir mejor.



En 2009, Walmart de México y Walmart Centroamérica iniciaron una nueva etapa de crecimiento al convertirse en un solo equipo. Desde 2010, operamos como Walmart de México y Centroamérica, una de las organizaciones de retail más importantes de la región. Nuestra estrategia omnicanal está centrada en nuestros clientes y enfocada en mejorar continuamente su experiencia de compra.



Tenemos presencia en seis países: México, Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua y Costa Rica.



Operamos 4,079 tiendas en toda la región, de las cuales 3,154 se encuentran en México y 925 en Centroamérica. Actualmente, más de 6 millones de clientes realizan compras diariamente en nuestras tiendas y clubes a lo largo de México y Centroamérica.



Continuamos ofreciendo a nuestros clientes los productos que necesitan a precios bajos todos los días mediante un portafolio diverso de formatos de negocio, cada uno con una propuesta de valor única. Al mismo tiempo, seguimos acelerando nuestra estrategia de transformación digital para servir mejor a nuestros clientes y socios en todos los canales y en cada etapa de su experiencia de compra.





Descripción del empleo



En Walmart Connect, buscamos un(a) Client Success & Planner que contribuya al éxito de nuestros clientes mediante la planeación, ejecución y optimización de campañas publicitarias dentro de nuestro ecosistema retail media.



Esta posición será responsable de colaborar con equipos comerciales, clientes y socios estratégicos para desarrollar planes de medios efectivos, coordinar campañas end-to-end y generar análisis que permitan maximizar el retorno de inversión y el crecimiento de las marcas dentro de Walmart.



Buscamos una persona analítica, orientada al cliente y apasionada por el marketing digital, la publicidad y la toma de decisiones basada en datos.

Planeación de Campañas y Estrategia Comercial



Diseñar propuestas y planes de medios alineados con los objetivos comerciales y de marketing de los clientes.

description:
About the job

Wonolo (Work Now Locally) is disrupting the $140BN temporary staffing industry. Founded in 2014, Wonolo's mission is to help people find consistent work. Through our two-sided tech marketplace, we connect hundreds of businesses in need of front-line workers with 2 million underemployed workers in local markets across the United States, within minutes. Wonolo has raised over $200M in funding which will continue to help us empower the in-demand workforce by democratizing access to flexible work, opportunities to learn new skills, a living wage, and comprehensive portable benefits and perks.




We are looking for a Growth Marketing Associate to work with Wonolo’s Marketing team. You will be employed by a third-party legal entity authorized to do business in the location in which you reside and you will provide contractual services to Wonolo’s Marketing team. We're building the B2C acquisition and activation machine that brings workers to Wonolo, helps them succeed on their first job, and keeps them coming back. You'll be the technical builder behind that machine, working alongside the team that leads funnel and lifecycle strategy, translating defined priorities into automations, AI-powered flows, and campaigns that run at scale.




You operate autonomously, with market data as your primary input for deciding where to focus and what to activate. You'll partner closely with the Business Operations team when you need qualitative context on specific customers or market conditions that the data doesn't capture. You'll use that context to prioritize where to activate, what campaign response fits the moment, and how your work contributes to revenue attainment across markets.




The right person thinks like a marketer and builds with low-code and AI tools. You're execution-oriented, detail-driven, and motivated by seeing your work directly move supply-side metrics. Are you excited about working with a close-knit team at a mission-driven, US-based technology company? If this is who you are or you can and desperately want to be, please read on!




We welcome qualified candidates located anywhere in Latin America #LI-Remote.




Who you are:




Campaign Execution

Monitor market health data across active markets independently and activate the right campaign response: new customer launching, customer ramping, low fill rate, supply churn, geographic supply gaps, and similar demand factors
Own campaign prioritization and execution end-to-end: pulling the right audience, selecting the right channel and message, turning campaigns on, and tracking performance through to outcome
Partner with the Business Operations team to gather qualitative intel on specific customers or market conditions that analytical data doesn't capture, and use it to sharpen decisions you're already making
Work from established playbooks while flagging when market conditions call for something outside the standard response
Report campaign performance back to the team with a clear read on what worked and what to adjust




Campaign Automation & Activation

Use your campaign execution work as the foundation for everything you build, leveraging what you learn from running campaigns to inform what you turn into scalable systems.
Map the worker journey from acquisition through activation to understand where friction lives, then build automations and AI-powered flows that remove it
Translate funnel strategy into systems: triggered campaigns, onboarding sequences, re-engagement flows, and the logic that runs them
Build tooling to test and iterate on activation and retention campaigns across markets so the team can move fast without manual effort
Build high-leverage automations that enable fast campaign activation across organic and paid channels, including social, job boards, answer engine optimization, and search




AI-Native Workflows

Identify marketing workflows that are still manual and rebuild them to be AI-native, focusing on where AI can improve speed, personalization, or conversion outcomes
Build AI agent workflows that support acquisition, content, and competitive intelligence, covering prompts, data sources, structured outputs, and the human checkpoints that need to stay in the loop
Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent output quality and tie results back to marketing KPIs
Stay current on new AI tools and revisit existing workflows to incorporate improvements as the technology moves




Who you are:




2 to 3+ years in growth marketing, lifecycle marketing, technical marketing, or a role where you owned both strategy and build
You've shipped internal tools that teams fully adopted and used to inflect marketing KPIs
You understand user behavior in a B2C funnel: what good activation looks like, where drop-off happens, and how to design around it
Experience with marketing automation platforms (Iterable, Smartly, or similar); you know how to build and optimize triggered campaigns, not just run them
You can build autonomously using low-code and AI tools; you don't need an engineering ticket to ship
Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), including prompt design, structured outputs, and evaluation loops
Experience building with tools like Zapier, Clay, Framer, or Lovable




If you have read up to this point, we hope you are excited about this opportunity to work at Wonolo! Even if your experience does not check every bullet point, we still highly encourage you to apply. The best hires do not always check off every box of a job description.




Nice to haves:




Experience in a marketplace or gig economy product with a two-sided user base
Background in worker acquisition, supply-side growth, or B2C lifecycle marketing
Familiarity with paid acquisition channels and how to automate decisioning across them




Benefits and perks:




The opportunity for growth in a mission-driven and well-funded start-up
Company laptop
Paid time off, Holiday pay, and Unpaid time off
Access to no-cost on-demand mental health support, including counselling, mindfulness and meditation, and well-being courses
Ability to work from anywhere in Colombia, El Salvador, Costa Rica, or Guatemala (no more commutes!)
Team outings, happy hours, company off-sites, and more!




Important Notice Regarding Fraudulent Recruiting




Disclaimer: We only communicate with candidates through official @wonolo.com email addresses.




Employment scammers may impersonate legitimate recruiters, employers, or recruitment firms, using email, text messages, messaging apps (including, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, etc.), or fake social media accounts to contact you. They may advertise roles that do not exist, claim to represent Wonolo, or use our name and branding without authorization.




Wonolo is aware that individuals posing as recruiters have communicated with job seekers about positions with Wonolo that do not exist. We have received reports that the content and method of communication has varied, but messages may contain requests for payment (e.g., fees for equipment or training) and/or for sensitive personal information.




Wonolo will never ask a candidate for employment for payment or financial information. All open positions are posted in country specific employment portals available at https://info.wonolo.com/careers/. All legitimate job postings on third-party employment sites will direct candidates to complete an application directly through the Wonolo careers page.




Candidates with additional questions or concerns regarding any recruiting communications or Wonolo’s recruiting process in general should email recruiting@wonolo.com.




About Wonolo:




Wonolo is a two-sided job marketplace that serves over 2 million front-line workers, providing them access to flexible and consistent job opportunities across the United States within minutes, at companies such as Peloton, Coca-Cola, Neiman Marcus, Papa John's, and thousands more.




We are a remote-first company with 200+ full-time employees, and quickly scaling our team within the United States, Canada, and Latin America. We are well-funded and backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital, and Leeds Illuminate, among others.




Learn more about us:

Wonolo raises $140M to continue supporting over 1 million laborers and front-line workers

Wonolo is one of Glassdoor's best tech companies to work for in 2021

Why G2 Venture Partners Invested in Wonolo

Yong Kim (CEO) on why he's passionate about empowering the in-demand workforce




Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Equity, and Belonging

Wonolo welcomes you as you and celebrates our collective diversity. We work to serve the underserved, and we are built on the strength of our entire community. We know that diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make for the best teams, and help to drive high performance. We strive to ensure that our team represents different cultures, perspectives, and backgrounds, as these empower our team to come together to make the best decisions and the biggest impact.




Wonolo is an equal-opportunity employer. We work to ensure all people feel supported, empowered, and connected at work. A big part of this effort is through our support for members and allies of Employee Resource Groups. Individuals seeking to work at or with Wonolo are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under all applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.




Wonolo does not accept agency or consulting resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our job postings, email alias, Wonolo employees or any other organization location. Wonolo is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we're a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We're hiring a Marketing Production Support Lead for a leading on-demand consumer marketplace that reaches millions of customers — leading a team of QA specialists across email, push, in-app, and promo campaigns, and acting as the escalation point for CRM campaign execution and quality.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Team Leadership: Host daily stand-ups to manage team workload and re-assign tickets as needed.
Campaign Accountability: Own the preparation and execution of CRM campaign tactics by a team of GAs — promotions, in-app banners, emails, and customer lists.
QA Oversight: Support and internally QA a team conducting quality assurance across all email marketing deliverables (templates, popups, campaigns, flows, and SMS), checking technical setups before launch for strategy alignment, deliverability, and targeting.
Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with cross-functional teams on marketing campaign execution, and maintain campaign documentation including tickets, overviews, calendars, and status documents.
Quality Tracking: Flag SLA violations and QA misses to leadership, record areas where operators frequently miss, and consolidate and track QA misses to identify frequent problem areas.
Strategic Review: Review campaigns from a strategic perspective and provide guidance, and respond to operators promptly via Slack, email, and Jira tickets.
Reporting: Report on self-serve processes monthly, quarterly, and annually, and triage errors and expedited requests across email, push, in-app, and promo.
Training & Auditing: Create and improve training material for new operators alongside the manager, and conduct random audit QA cases to ensure ongoing quality.




What You Bring

CRM QA Experience: 3+ years of experience in QA-specific tasks for CRM (Braze preferred, but not mandatory).
ESP Experience: 3+ years of experience with an ESP (email service provider) platform.
Leadership: 2+ years in a leadership role with a clear ability to hit KPIs while fostering a motivating work environment.
Tools: Proficiency with Jira, Slack, Google Suite, and CRM systems (email, push, in-app, promo codes); intermediate HTML and SQL; intermediate Google Sheets.
Campaign & Budget Experience: Experience reviewing, updating, and scheduling digital campaigns (copy, code, creative review) and managing promo budgets to meet business goals.
Attention to Detail: Exceptionally high attention to detail — thorough, consistent double-checking, and a strong focus on following guidelines and testing everything works properly.
Communication: Highly proficient written and spoken English, with extremely clear communication and direction to team members.




Bonus Points if:

You have experience in the tech industry.
You have experience working with an app-centric client.




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren't just joining a company; you're joining a movement to redefine how the world's best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You've applied, now let's get to work. Here's the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.
Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we'll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick.
Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You'll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you.
Step 4 Match Interview: You'll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we're matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine — it's the final step for many of our roles!




Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps:

Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We've got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you're 100% ready.
Step 6 Client Interview: You'll meet the client to discuss how you'll help them scale and succeed. Bring your metrics and be on your A-game — this is your last chance to make a great first impression!







Join our 100% remote global team today, and grow with GrowthAssistant!




GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.
