About the job

This position is based on-site in Mexico City, CDMX. Remote work is not available.

Submitted resumes must be in English to be considered.

About Landing

We are a nationwide hospitality platform where fully-furnished apartments meet hotel quality and consistency. Guests access a curated selection of thousands of high-quality apartments available for any length of stay in hundreds of cities nationwide.

By blending the best of hospitality and everyday comfort, every unit is designed with all the amenities of home, backed by 24/7 local support. For a week-long getaway or an extended adventure, we deliver a familiar and frictionless guest experience that's perfect for any travel occasion, for work or pleasure.

For property owners, we offer a fast path to new revenue and higher occupancy in just weeks by tapping into our nationwide demand for furnished, hospitality-grade housing. We provide a turnkey solution that covers the entire unit experience, from furnishings to guest turnover and everything in between, with zero operational lift from partners. We handle it all so partners can unlock value faster.

About The Role

Short stays are one of the biggest levers we have on occupancy, and every apartment that takes a stay under 30 nights needs a permit, a license, or a confirmed exemption first. Your job is to get those approvals done and get the apartments on sale.

This is a closing job, not a research job. Cities go quiet, property managers miss deadlines, and applications stall for weeks if nobody pushes. You are the person who pushes. The job is measured on one thing: apartments switched on for short-term stays each week.

Advanced English. You will be on the phone with U.S. government offices every day

Willingness to use AI tools daily to cut research and application time — plus the judgment to verify what they tell you before you act on it

description:
About the job

About Friendzy

Friendzy is a recruiting platform that automates hiring from outreach to retention, using AI agents to streamline tracking, scheduling, and screening. Our agents integrate directly with Indeed, LinkedIn, Salesforce, ADP, and the other systems our clients already use. Companies using Friendzy have made 40,000+ hires. We serve sales and field organizations across HVAC, solar, roofing, pest control, insurance, windows, home services, transportation, MCA, and EPC, alongside enterprise, private equity, and founder-led teams.




POSITION OVERVIEW

We are hiring remote Candidate Screeners to qualify candidates by phone for our client campaigns. You will work leads we provide, using our dialer and approved scripts, run live qualification calls, and stay on the line while each qualified candidate completes the client's application, so the confirmation is in hand before the call ends.




This is a high-volume, phone-first role. You will speak with candidates all day. The screeners who do well here are consistent, organized, and comfortable holding the same standard call after call.

Fully remote.




A TYPICAL DAY

You'll work a full day on the phone: 180 to 200 dials, 40 to 55 real conversations, and 10 to 12 candidates you personally walk through the client's application and confirm before the call ends. Every one of those confirmations is $7 on top of your retainer. Leads, dialer, and script are all provided, so your only job is the conversation.




SCHEDULE

We have two openings:

Weekday: Monday through Friday, 9am to 5pm Eastern Time
Weekend-inclusive: Wednesday through Sunday, 9am to 5pm Eastern Time. Saturday and Sunday are required.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Conduct live phone qualification calls with candidates using company-provided leads, dialer, and scripts

• Screen against campaign-specific requirements, including experience thresholds, licensing, work history, and any disqualifying criteria

• Ask every required screening question clearly and record the candidate's exact answers • Flag uncertain or borderline responses for review rather than resolving them yourself

• Stay on the line while qualified candidates complete the client's application, and record the confirmation number before ending the call

• Document each call fully: date, time, responses, and disposition

• Honor opt-out, do-not-call, and wrong-number requests immediately and report them the same business day

• Maintain accurate records of call attempts, screening responses, and confirmation status

• Tell your lead when a script question or screening criterion isn't working in practice




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Fluent, clear spoken and written English with a neutral phone presence

• 1+ years in phone-based recruiting, candidate screening, call center work, sales development, or comparable high-volume calling

• Available for the full schedule of the opening you're applying for

• Able to follow a script precisely while noticing when an answer needs a flag

• Comfortable with dialers, CRM or ATS tools, and spreadsheets; quick to learn new systems

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet workspace, working computer, and a quality headset




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience screening for transportation, CDL, field sales, or trades roles

• Experience walking candidates through applications or forms by phone

• Prior experience with Auto Dialing System

• Background in a remote or distributed contractor role

• Familiarity with recruiting compliance and consent requirements




TOOLS YOU'LL USE

PhoneBurner for both dialing and CRM, plus Slack. If you haven't used it before, we'll train you on it.




COMPENSATION

• Monthly Retainer: $1,000 USD, paid for each month you meet the minimum output standard below. Prorated for a partial first or final month.

• Per confirmed candidate: $7 each, uncapped

• Daily target: 10 to 12 confirmed candidates

• Realistic monthly earnings at target: $2,470 to $2,764, retainer included

• Payment: Last day of each month via Wise. If that date falls on a weekend, payment is processed the following business day. Candidates confirmed through the 25th are paid that month; later confirmations roll to the following month.

• Independent contractor engagement, non-exclusive




HOW PAY WORKS

• Interested: the candidate says yes on the phone. Not paid.

• Submitted: the application is completed. Not paid.

• Confirmed: a confirmation number is issued and logged. Paid $7.




Pay is earned only at confirmed. Duplicates and candidates whose answers can't be verified are not compensable.




PERFORMANCE STANDARD

We maintain a minimum output standard of 8 confirmed candidates per day on average, measured monthly. Your first month, the standard is 6. The engagement continues while that standard is met.




ONBOARDING

Three days of onboarding: learning the scripts, getting set up in PhoneBurner, and listening to live calls before you take your own. Onboarding days are paid with your first full month once you've completed 30 days on the team.




WHAT WE OFFER

• Fully remote

• Company-provided leads, dialer, scripts, and systems. No sourcing on your own

• Uncapped earnings that scale with your output

• Hands-on experience with a modern AI recruiting stack

• A team that measures results, not hours logged

• A clear path to lead screener and campaign lead roles as the team grows

description:
About the job

🚀 ¿Por qué trabajar en Xepelin?
Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network, se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura.

Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos?
🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro

✨ Creemos e inspiramos

🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños

🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo

🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar

🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia

🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología

¿Qué estamos buscando?
En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol
Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades


Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng





¿Qué necesitas para brillar?


Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables





Requisitos


2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

description:
About the job

Mánager de Contenido y Redes — SoyIvanInversor (remoto, tiempo completo)

Invedx con SoyIvanInversor como principal canal de distribución de Ivan Prats sobre cripto, mercados e inversión, en español.

El formato principal son directos de mercado varias veces por semana. De cada directo sale todo lo demás: clips, hilos, posts, comunidad.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Convertir cada directo en crecimiento.

Después de cada emisión:

- Eliges los 5–8 momentos que de verdad paran el scroll y escribes el hook y el copy de cada uno.

- Recortas, editas y publicas desde las cuentas del canal en YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels y X, a ritmo de 2–3 clips al día. Los clips de un directo salen en menos de 24 horas: en cripto, lo de hoy caduca mañana.

- Escribes el hilo de X de cada directo y publicas avisos de cada transmisión.

- Respondes comentarios en la primera hora, limpias spam e impostores y clasificas los DMs.

- Cada viernes entregas un reporte simple: clip, plataforma, views, retención, seguidores ganados, highlights de la comunidad (comentarios) y propones dos cambios para la semana siguiente.

Tu objetivo no es publicar clips, sino analizar rendimiento y buscar crecimiento, publicar sin resultados no sirve.

REQUISITOS

- Experiencia manejando redes sociales con enfoque a crecimiento.

- Experiencia editando (ya sea con programas como Premiere y After effects, o con IA).

- Entiendes cripto y mercados lo suficiente para saber qué momento de un directo importa hoy y cuál no importará mañana.

- Sabes leer e interpretar datos de las plataformas sociales; retención, CTR, seguidores por clip, y propones adaptaciones en base a los datos.

- Autonomía real en remoto, no esperas a que te digan qué hacer, eres proactivo/a.

CONDICIONES

- Tiempo completo, 100 % remoto (Latam o España), contrato como freelance/autónomo.

- Base de USD 1.500–2.500 al mes según lo que demuestres, más bono por resultados de crecimiento.

inland Expansion is growing its North American outbound team, and we're looking for an experienced Business Development Representative (BDR) to generate qualified opportunities across the US and Canadian market.

We are specifically looking for someone who is genuinely experienced in cold calling - picking up the phone, reaching completely cold prospects, creating conversations, handling objections and generating qualified meetings.




This is not an inbound sales or customer service position.




You do not necessarily need a B2B background. If you have a strong track record in B2C outbound sales, telesales, appointment setting or another high-performance cold-calling environment, we want to hear from you.

 • Qualify prospects and generate qualified meetings

 • Handle objections confidently and naturally

 • Follow up consistently with prospects

 • Maintain accurate activity, notes and follow-ups in our CRM

 • Work closely with inland's campaign and growth teams




What we're looking for

• Minimum 2 years of genuine outbound cold-calling experience

 • B2B outbound, B2C outbound, telesales, appointment setting and cold sales backgrounds are all welcome

 • Excellent spoken English and strong phone presence

 • Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day

 • Strong objection-handling skills

 • Confident, resilient and comfortable with rejection

 • Able to communicate naturally rather than simply reading from a script

 • Strong follow-up and CRM discipline

 • Available to work North American business hours

 

What we offer

 • 100% remote

 • Competitive base compensation

 • Performance-based commission

 • Work with international B2B technology companies

 • Training and development in enterprise technology sales

 • International and ambitious team

 • Opportunity to grow with Inland as we expand our North American business




If you're someone who genuinely knows how to pick up the phone, turn a cold call into a conversation and consistently create opportunities, we'd like to hear from you.




Please apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will complete a live cold-calling simulation as part of the interview process.

About the job

About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Become the Heart of Our Community; Empowering Life's Work

Our Community team isn't just a part of the business—it is the driving force behind our members' success. We are dedicated to enabling every member to create their life's work, and as a Community Lead, you will be leading that effort.

In this role, you are responsible for ensuring your building meets our global standards for hospitality and operating excellence. Whether supporting a diverse member base or a key Enterprise client, you will serve as a trusted and reliable leader focused on member satisfaction, operational excellence, and business performance.

Hospitality & Member Engagement

Deliver elevated hospitality by anticipating member and guest needs, offering personalized support, and ensuring a positive experience throughout all stages of the member journey.
Act as the primary point of resolution for member feedback, leveraging NPS data to identify trends, solve complex escalations with empathy and accountability, and implement proactive service improvements.
Support the Community Team in execution of a curated community event strategy that fosters professional networking and member connections, directly impacting member retention and satisfaction metrics.
Support the Community desk schedule as needed, ensuring there is consistent coverage during business hours. 


Building Operations


Serve as the on-site Lead owning the operation excellence and standards of your building, identifying and implementing improvements that enhance the space on a daily basis.
Ensure timely resolution, clear communication, and consistent execution on all service requests, monthly move-in/ move-out processes, and maintenance work orders, partnering with internal and external stakeholders. 
Partner with our Security team to be the on-site representative for all safety and security protocols and ensure the building remains compliant with global health and safety standards.
Manage the location’s controllable operating costs, while delivering a premium experience for our members


Revenue Growth And Sales Support


Partner with the Leasing team to lead high-impact tours for prospective members, sharing benefits tailored to their unique business needs to capture new revenue and drive building occupancy.
Drive building financial success by proactively pursuing revenue growth opportunities, such as ancillary service sales and membership upgrades.
Collaborate with members to pinpoint renewal and expansion possibilities through the use of data-informed analytics


About You

We’d love to hear from you if you meet the qualifications below:


Bachelor’s Degree In Hospitality or Tourism
Proficient in English 
Preferred 3+ years of professional experience and proven track record of success in hospitality, multi unit retail or related experience.
A proactive problem-solver with an entrepreneurial mindset who embraces change and is committed to continuous professional growth.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a natural ability to build rapport with diverse stakeholders ranging from entrepreneurs to Enterprise executives.
Experience utilizing data (such as Qualtrics or CRM tools like Salesforce) to inform decision-making and drive member satisfaction.
Embraces challenges in a fast-paced environment. Strategic thinker and problem solver with an entrepreneurial mindset. 
Exhibit a high degree of accountability and a strong work ethic, while maintaining compassion and self-awareness in all professional interactions.


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

title: Martech & Analytics Specialist
description:
About the job

DARE TO BE A PART OF THE CHALLENGE! COME AND JOIN OUR TEAM TOGETHER WE CAN MAKE THE DIFFERENCE!

Did you know that Accenture is leading the digital transformation in the World?

Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Our main purpose is to collaborate with our clients, so they can become high-performance businesses. Accenture is present in more than 200 offices, 120 cities, 56 countries and approximately 743,000 employees worldwide.

Offer



Career development according to your profile and interests.

Work in one of the best companies and feel proud.

Access to an innovative methodology and tools.

Direct contact with experts worldwide.

Use of work schemes and cutting-edge technologies.

Constant training.

Work environment based on teamwork and collaboration.

Participation in International Projects



We are seeking a new talent to join the commerce team, where you will have the opportunity to collaborate on projects with a global presence and a strong commitment to innovation, data-driven decision-making, and customer-centric solutions.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for supporting the design, implementation, validation, and optimization of digital analytics solutions. You will work closely with business, marketing, data, and technology teams to translate business needs into measurable requirements, technical specifications, and actionable insights.

You will contribute to the implementation and evolution of Adobe Analytics and Adobe Customer Journey Analytics, ensuring that data collection, dimensions, metrics, events, dashboards, and reports are aligned with business objectives and measurement strategies.

You are expected to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, take ownership of assigned deliverables, identify data quality issues, and provide technical recommendations that improve the reliability and usability of analytics solutions.

Key responsibilities include:



Gather and translate business requirements into analytics measurement plans and technical specifications.

Support the implementation and configuration of Adobe Analytics, including variables, events, classifications, processing rules, and report suites.

Develop and maintain Adobe Customer Journey Analytics components, including connections, data views, calculated metrics, filters, workspaces, and dashboards.

Validate data collection and troubleshoot tracking, ingestion, attribution, and reporting issues.

Analyze customer behavior across digital channels and identify insights that support business and marketing decisions.

Collaborate with development, tagging, data, marketing, and business teams to ensure consistent and accurate data collection.

Support the definition of KPIs, measurement frameworks, and reporting standards.

Identify opportunities to improve data quality, analytics processes, reporting capabilities, and platform adoption.

Document implementations, configurations, data definitions, validation results, and technical recommendations.

Develop knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform and understand how datasets, schemas, identities, and customer profiles support Customer Journey Analytics use cases.



Preferred Skills And Experience



Intermediate or advanced knowledge of Adobe Analytics.

Technical knowledge of Adobe Customer Journey Analytics is highly recommended.

Experience with analytics implementation, data validation, debugging, reporting, or dashboard development.

Understanding of digital measurement concepts, customer journeys, KPIs, attribution, segmentation, and data quality.

Knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform is preferred; candidates must be willing to develop technical proficiency in AEP.

Knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK, Adobe Tags, data layers, or similar data collection technologies is a plus.

Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

Ability to collaborate with business and technical stakeholders in multidisciplinary and global environments.



Accenture does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or for any other reason covered by local law.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol
Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades


Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng





¿Qué necesitas para brillar?


Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables





Requisitos


2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. 





Nuestros Beneficios:

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres.

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin.

Es posible que utilicemos herramientas de inteligencia artificial (IA) para apoyar partes del proceso de contratación, como la revisión de aplicaciones, el análisis de CVs o la evaluación de respuestas. Estas herramientas asisten a nuestro equipo de reclutamiento, pero no reemplazan al criterio humano. Las decisiones finales de contratación son tomadas, en última instancia, por personas. title: VFX & Generative AI Artist
description:
About the job

Buscamos un/a Artista de VFX e IA Generativa para integrarse al equipo interno de CAPONETO. Será un perfil práctico, creativo y resolutivo, capaz de editar contenido audiovisual, realizar composiciones y efectos visuales de complejidad media, corregir color e incorporar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a los procesos de creación y postproducción.




No buscamos necesariamente un especialista senior en efectos visuales, sino una persona versátil, con buen ojo, criterio audiovisual y curiosidad tecnológica, que pueda ejecutar piezas con autonomía y encontrar soluciones eficientes para distintos tipos de proyectos.




Responsabilidades

•⁠ ⁠Editar y terminar piezas audiovisuales para contenido digital, branded content, campañas, presentaciones, cine y televisión.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar compositing, limpieza de imagen, reemplazo de pantallas, integración de fondos, rotoscopia, tracking, chroma key y otros efectos visuales.

•⁠ ⁠Crear, modificar y extender imágenes y videos mediante herramientas de IA generativa.

•⁠ ⁠Desarrollar pruebas visuales, concept videos, animatics, previos y propuestas de estilo.

•⁠ ⁠Integrar material generado con IA dentro de piezas filmadas o editadas de manera tradicional.

•⁠ ⁠Mantener la continuidad visual de personajes, espacios, iluminación, movimiento y estilo en las imágenes generadas.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar corrección de color y looks básicos para unificar y terminar las piezas.

•⁠ ⁠Adaptar contenidos a diferentes duraciones, formatos y relaciones de aspecto.

•⁠ ⁠Preparar versiones y archivos finales conforme a las especificaciones de cada proyecto.

•⁠ ⁠Trabajar en coordinación con productores, directores, editores, diseñadores y el área de postproducción.

•⁠ ⁠Recibir notas creativas y técnicas, interpretarlas y ejecutar los ajustes correspondientes.

•⁠ ⁠Investigar nuevas herramientas y proponer formas concretas de incorporarlas a los procesos de CAPONETO.

•⁠ ⁠Organizar correctamente proyectos, archivos, versiones y materiales de trabajo.




Conocimientos técnicos

•⁠ ⁠Manejo sólido de Adobe Premiere Pro.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimientos intermedios de After Effects para compositing, tracking, rotoscopia, keying y motion graphics.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de DaVinci Resolve para corrección de color y terminación.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia con herramientas de generación y edición de video e imagen mediante inteligencia artificial.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para trabajar con prompts, imágenes de referencia, image-to-video, video-to-video, inpainting, outpainting y extensión generativa.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento de formatos, códecs, resoluciones, frame rates y espacios de color.

•⁠ ⁠Nociones de flujos de proxies, conformado, exportación y entrega.

•⁠ ⁠Deseable: conocimientos de Photoshop, Illustrator, Blender, Cinema 4D, Nuke o herramientas similares.




Perfil

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia comprobable en edición, postproducción, VFX o creación de contenido audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Reel o portafolio que muestre trabajos de edición, compositing, color y/o contenido generado con IA.

•⁠ ⁠Buen ojo para la composición, el ritmo, la iluminación, el color y la integración de imágenes.

•⁠ ⁠Interés genuino por experimentar con nuevas herramientas y procesos.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para resolver problemas técnicos y visuales con los recursos disponibles.

•⁠ ⁠Persona organizada, autónoma, detallista y responsable.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para trabajar en varios proyectos y responder a tiempos de entrega ajustados.

•⁠ ⁠Buena disposición para recibir feedback y trabajar en equipo.

•⁠ ⁠Español fluido e inglés suficiente para utilizar herramientas, investigar procesos y comprender documentación técnica.




Buscamos a alguien que combine sensibilidad audiovisual con habilidad técnica; que disfrute editar, probar, componer y resolver. Alguien que entienda la IA como una herramienta más dentro del proceso creativo y que pueda convertir una idea o referencia en una pieza terminada, coherente y lista para entregar.

title: Coordinador/a de Postprodución
description:
About the job

Buscamos un/a Coordinador/a de Postproducción para supervisar y dar seguimiento integral a los procesos de postproducción de proyectos audiovisuales de CAPONETO CONTENT. 




El perfil ideal combina conocimientos técnicos con capacidad de organización, comunicación y resolución de problemas. Será el vínculo entre productores, editores, coloristas, artistas de VFX, diseñadores, estudios de sonido y proveedores externos, asegurando que cada proyecto avance en tiempo, presupuesto y conforme a sus especificaciones técnicas y creativas.




RESPONSABILIDADES:

•⁠ ⁠Diseñar, organizar y dar seguimiento a los flujos de trabajo de postproducción, desde la recepción y respaldo del material hasta la entrega final.

•⁠ ⁠Elaborar calendarios, rutas críticas y planes de entregas para proyectos simultáneos.

•⁠ ⁠Supervisar procesos de ingesta, respaldo, organización, sincronización, generación de proxies, edición offline, conformado, color, VFX, mezcla y masterización.

•⁠ ⁠Verificar formatos, códecs, resoluciones, frame rates, relaciones de aspecto, espacios de color y especificaciones de audio.

•⁠ ⁠Preparar y revisar masters, versiones, subtítulos, materiales gráficos y entregables para plataformas, networks, festivales, salas y redes sociales.

•⁠ ⁠Realizar controles de calidad técnicos y de contenido antes de cada entrega.

•⁠ ⁠Llevar un registro claro de versiones, cambios, aprobaciones y pendientes.

•⁠ ⁠Administrar materiales en servidores, discos, plataformas de revisión y sistemas de almacenamiento en la nube.

•⁠ ⁠Detectar riesgos técnicos, retrasos o cuellos de botella y proponer soluciones de manera anticipada.




CONOCIMIENTOS TÉCNICOS

•⁠ ⁠Dominio de formatos, códecs, contenedores, resoluciones y estándares de entrega audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento práctico de flujos de edición offline y online, proxies, relink, conformado y masterización.

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia con procesos de corrección de color, VFX, motion graphics, mezcla de sonido y subtitulaje.

•⁠ ⁠Manejo de Adobe Premiere Pro y conocimiento de DaVinci Resolve y After Effects.

•⁠ ⁠Familiaridad con plataformas de revisión y colaboración como Frame.io o similares.

•⁠ ⁠Conocimiento de almacenamiento, respaldos, transferencia de archivos y organización de media.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para interpretar y aplicar especificaciones técnicas de plataformas, televisoras y distribuidores.

•⁠ ⁠Deseable: conocimiento de flujos de trabajo para cine, HDR, DCP, IMF y materiales de distribución internacional.




PERFIL

•⁠ ⁠Experiencia comprobable coordinando postproducción audiovisual.

•⁠ ⁠Español e inglés profesional, tanto oral como escrito.

•⁠ ⁠Extremadamente organizado/a y cuidadoso/a con los detalles.

•⁠ ⁠Perfil técnico, práctico y orientado a soluciones.

•⁠ ⁠Facilidad para manejar varios proyectos, proveedores y fechas de entrega simultáneamente.

•⁠ ⁠Excelentes habilidades interpersonales y de comunicación.

•⁠ ⁠Capacidad para traducir necesidades creativas en procesos y requerimientos técnicos claros.

•⁠ ⁠Buen criterio para priorizar y trabajar bajo presión.

•⁠ ⁠Actitud colaborativa, flexible y responsable.

•⁠ ⁠Interés por mantenerse actualizado/a en herramientas, tecnologías y estándares de la industria.




Buscamos a alguien que no solo dé seguimiento a los procesos de postproducción, sino que comprenda técnicamente cada etapa del proceso, detecte riesgos antes de que se conviertan en problemas y ayude a construir una operación de postproducción cada vez más eficiente, ordenada y confiable.

You will be responsible for managing system configurations, troubleshooting technical issues, monitoring integrations and synchronizations, and working directly with the TRACK provider when technical support is required.

The ideal candidate is highly technical, resourceful, and able to independently investigate problems, identify root causes, and drive issues through to resolution.

About the job

About The Role And Team

Uber Eats is looking for a motivated and strategic Associate Enterprise Partner Manager to join our Grocery & Retail (G&R) team. In this role, you will help shape the success of some of our most important merchant partners by connecting their business goals with the scale and capabilities of Uber. You'll collaborate across teams and play a key role in improving how millions of people access grocery and retail services every day.

Success in this role comes from combining strong analytical thinking with relationship-building skills. More than traditional account management, you'll work through complex business challenges, use data to uncover opportunities, and partner closely with teams across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations, and Legal to drive growth. If you enjoy solving problems, learning continuously, and collaborating with others to create meaningful impact, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do


Build and grow long-term partnerships by understanding the goals and priorities of strategic grocery and retail partners.
Collaborate across Product, Operations, Legal, and other teams to remove roadblocks and create value for partners.
Analyze data, develop business models, and generate actionable insights to measure and accelerate growth initiatives.
Support and drive strategic projects across multiple teams, contributing wherever needed to achieve shared goals.
Communicate effectively with senior business leaders and technical stakeholders, building alignment and influencing decisions through collaboration.
Manage partnership pipelines and account plans with strong organization and attention to detail while maintaining a strategic, long-term perspective.


What You'll Need

Basic Qualifications


At least 3 years of professional experience in client-facing roles such as Account Manager, Sales Manager, Customer Success Manager, or similar positions
Experience managing enterprise or mid-market accounts.
Experience analyzing complex data sets and tracking business goals or OKRs.
Experience negotiating contracts and managing strategic partnerships.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in the Grocery, CPG, or Retail industries.
Experience using data to influence business decisions; SQL or advanced Google Sheets skills are a plus.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and delivering partner solutions that create measurable business impact.
Ability to adapt and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
Strong commercial acumen and experience navigating complex partner relationships.


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Job Description

Are you looking for a role that will use your problem solving skills, technical interests and client communication skills to their full potential? If so, this might be the perfect role for you.

Thomson Reuters are looking for a Software Implementation Specialist to work with global clients and lead the implementation of ONESOURCE Pagero - our e-invoicing compliance software - with their systems. This is the perfect role for a well-organised, collaborative and analytical person that wants to grow their career within the software implementation space and collaborate with a varied book of clients. You'll use your knowledge of coding, excellent communication skills and problem solving skills to tackle client configuration issues and ensure a the highest level of service to our clients.

Key Responsibilities

As an Implementation Specialist with Thomson Reuters, you will:


Act as a specialist in large, cross-functional software implementation team that specialises in e-invoicing solutions.
Work directly with global clients to Understand their ONESOURCE Pagero implementation requirements. You'll run product demonstrations, deliver end-user and super-user training whilst configuring the software to meet their requirements.
Use your analytical, project management and problem solving skills to test client software implementations.
Troubleshoot issues and ensure that project plans are running to the required timelines and within budget.
Resolve customer support issues by working with clients directly and collaborating with internal teams (such as product, sales and support) on a range of pre-sales software demos, and prospectively scoping client needs.
Design, develop, and document project deliverables according to timelines and budgets.


Required Qualifications

You’re a fit for the role of Implementation Specialist if your background includes:


An interest in software and how it is implemented and configured at a range of global institutions.
An understanding of basic coding with the desire to learn and develop your skills within a software setting.
An analytical mindset. You may have gained this through your academic studies or wider interest in coding, economics or project management.
A collaborative attitude, able to work closely with colleagues at various levels of seniority and communicate sometimes complex solutions to international clients.
Excellent communication skills in both English and Spanish, able to deliver the highest level of customer service to our clients.
Demonstrated ability to successfully manage complex scenarios in fast-paced environments, prioritizing competing demands and delivering high-quality results under tight deadlines.


Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with Europe or be able to work a 6:00 am to 3:00 pm working shift

What’s in it For You?


Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.


About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: Lifecycle Marketer




About the Company:

Our client is a US fintech company that provides individuals outside the United States with a US dollar account, international money transfer capabilities, and a card for direct USD spending, all within a single app. Their primary markets are in Latin America, serving freelancers, digital nomads, savers seeking inflation protection, and crypto users who want to manage stablecoins within their banking app. The company is currently in a hypergrowth phase and is seeking individuals eager to contribute to building and innovation.




Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Lifecycle Marketer to manage all user communications throughout their entire journey, from initial sign-up to activation, ongoing engagement, reactivation, and retention. This role requires a hands-on approach, where the individual will not only strategize but also execute by designing flows, writing copy, implementing campaigns in various tools, and continuously measuring and optimizing performance. A data-first mindset is crucial, with a focus on defining, measuring, and iterating on every campaign and message using key metrics. The ideal candidate will be adept at analyzing user funnels, identifying drop-off points, and proactively implementing solutions.

The role is structured around three core pillars: Lifecycle Strategy & Communications, CRM & Omnichannel Marketing, and Testing, Optimization & Analytics. This includes owning lifecycle programs for all user segments, developing customer journey strategies, mapping user journeys, identifying optimization opportunities through segmentation and personalization, and driving cross-sell initiatives. The role also involves designing and optimizing programs across various channels like email, SMS, push notifications, WhatsApp, and in-app messaging, while ensuring channel health and prioritizing trigger- and behavior-based automation. A significant part of the role includes measuring performance using tools like Mixpanel, running A/B tests, reporting on lifecycle impact, leveraging AI for content generation and data analysis, and collaborating with Product and Design teams.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Own the lifecycle programs across all user segments.

• Develop and execute customer journey strategies for acquisition, engagement, retention, and reactivation.

• Map user journeys, identify key moments and drop-off points, and design communication to advance users.

• Identify opportunities to improve lifecycle performance through segmentation, automation, personalization, and testing.

• Drive cross-sell across USD account, card, and stablecoin wallet features.

• Design and optimize lifecycle programs across email, SMS, push, WhatsApp, and in-app channels.

• Build scalable segmentation, personalization, and automation strategies.

• Build, launch, and optimize automated lifecycle campaigns end-to-end.

• Prioritize trigger- and behavior-based automation over blast campaigns.

• Protect channel health, including email deliverability, opt-ins, message frequency, and fatigue.

• Measure performance in Mixpanel, define events, build funnels, analyze cohorts, churn, and LTV.

• Run experiments and A/B tests on copy, timing, channel, and segment.

• Report on lifecycle impact on activation, retention, and engagement with clear metrics.

• Utilize AI tools for content generation, task automation, and data analysis.

• Partner with Product and Design to align in-app communication with roadmap launches.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Demonstrated ownership mentality, taking problems to completion.

• Blend of strategic thinking and operational execution capabilities.

• Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making abilities, comfortable analyzing funnels, cohorts, churn, and LTV, with the ability to query data independently.

• Ability to write effective copy that drives conversions, understanding that lifecycle communication serves both marketing and product functions.

• Daily experience working with AI and automation tools.

• High drive and initiative, with a focus on building and innovation.

• Fluent communication in both Spanish and English.




Preferred Skills:

• Previous experience in fintech, crypto, or Web3.

• Based in Argentina or LATAM.

• Experience in a high-growth startup environment.




Personality:

• Takes ownership and sees tasks through to completion.

• Combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

• Data-first approach to decision-making.

• Creative and driven to build.




Software & Tools:

• Analytics: Mixpanel

• Messaging & CRM: OneSignal, WhatsApp, email

• Product: in-app stories / in-app messaging, email, SMS

• Design: Figma

• AI: Claude and other AI tools

• Automation: end-to-end lifecycle flows and automations




Schedule:

Full-time




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet.

We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together. We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About Bridge Operations And The Team

As Stripe's user base and global footprint grow dramatically, especially as crypto and stablecoins fundamentally change the way money is transferred, Stripe acquired Bridge to leverage its stablecoin infrastructure for global payments. Stablecoins facilitate faster, cheaper, and more efficient transactions than traditional methods, which creates unique compliance challenges.

The Bridge Operations strategy provides operational leverage and expands Stripe's portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs in this rapidly evolving space. This role will be part of the KYC and KYB Team within the Risk Ops organization in Bridge Operations that is accountable for performing KYC and KYB reviews during onboarding and periodic review.

What you'll do

We're looking for someone who is passionate about fighting risks and solving the puzzle of investigations, is naturally curious, and is comfortable operating in ambiguity and finding creative solutions. You will be responsible for spearheading the organization's KYC and KYB compliance efforts within the Mexican market.

The right candidate for this role will have experience in KYC and KYB compliance, preferably within the fintech or e-commerce space.

Responsibilities


Conduct thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) reviews during the onboarding of new users, ensuring the authenticity and accuracy of all customer documentation in compliance with Mexico's regulatory requirements.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of KYC, KYB, and anti-money laundering (AML) regulations specific to the Mexico financial services industry, and apply this knowledge to your daily analyses.
Exercise sound judgment to evaluate complex customer information, make informed decisions on the legitimacy of documentation provided, and determine the appropriate risk profile for each customer.
Handle high-complexity KYC and KYB-related assignments and tasks with a sense of urgency, while promptly resolving incoming requests from internal teams, financial partners, and other external parties.
Adhere closely to process documentation and draft clear, concise investigative summaries and analyses, including the preparation of regulatory reports for submission to the relevant authorities.
Actively participate in building a new team and operational culture focused on robust KYC and compliance practices within the organization.
Leverage your expertise in KYC, KYB, and AML to identify and escalate any suspicious customer activity or high-risk profiles to the compliance team for further investigation and action.
Collaborate cross-functionally with teams such as compliance and fraud to share information and insights that contribute to the overall risk management and mitigation efforts within the Mexican market.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Bilingual in English: Excellent conversational, written, and reading skills.
Professional experience: 2+ years of experience in risk or any type of customer-facing roles within a fast-paced environment.
Resilience and adaptability: Proven ability to thrive in evolving environments, remain composed under pressure, and confidently navigate ambiguity.
Structured mindset: A logical, disciplined approach to problem-solving with a relentless focus on accuracy and attention to detail.
Proactive problem-solver: A self-starter capable of working independently to analyze complex data and make sound, defensible investigative decisions.
Process improvement: The ability to identify operational gaps and proactively implement solutions to enhance workflow efficiency.
Effective communication: Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills to clearly articulate findings and recommendations to internal teams and financial partners.
In-office presence: Full availability to work 100% on-site at our office in Reforma, CDMX.



Preferred Qualifications


Startup and tech background: Experience navigating the unique pace and scale of a technology-driven company.
Industry expertise: Deep knowledge of the payments landscape and the fintech industry.
Specialized domain knowledge: A technical background in KYC, KYB, Risk, or Financial Crimes (FC).
Operational agility: Prior experience working within a queue.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

description:
About the job

Rockstar is recruiting for a marketplace management firm that handles e-commerce operations for brands across major retail channels. They specialize in catalog management, content, retail operations, and advertising on platforms like Amazon, Walmart, and Target Plus. Their AI Agentic Commerce practice builds proprietary tooling for optimized performance.


About the Company



The company manages the marketplace business for brands that can't afford to get it wrong. They handle catalog, content, retail operations, and advertising across Amazon (Seller Central and Vendor Central), Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, and other emerging channels, and they run an AI Agentic Commerce practice building their own tooling for this work.

Their clients span consumer packaged goods, cosmetics, skincare, apparel, footwear, and handbags. They hire them to operate their channel, not to advise from a distance.


The Role



Advertising Analysts run the accounts. This is the seat where the work actually happens.

Analysts own the day-to-day management of advertising for a set of client brands across Amazon, Walmart Marketplace, and Target Plus — building campaigns, managing bids and budgets, adjusting targeting, watching pacing, and finding the changes that move performance. Their manager sets the strategy and the media plan; they make it real in the platform, and they are the first person to know when something isn't working.

This is an individual contributor role, but it isn't a heads-down one. Analysts work directly with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness — inventory, catalog, promotions, detail page quality — and with the Design Team on creative for Sponsored Brands, video, and display. Advertising in these channels doesn't perform in isolation, and analysts who understand that make better recommendations than analysts who only look at ad reports.

Analysts also do a meaningful amount of thinking, not just executing. They run account audits, dig into search term and placement data to find waste and opportunity, build the analysis behind quarterly and annual business reviews, and prepare the decks their manager presents to client leadership. Where they see a better answer than the plan calls for, the company wants to hear it.

The company expects analysts to use AI in their work. The team uses AI for report analysis, bulk file preparation, keyword and search term work, audit drafting, and internal tooling. They don't need to be an engineer, but they should be comfortable working with AI tools and interested in using them to get through the mechanical parts of the job faster so they can spend more time on the parts that require judgment.

This role is a path to account and strategy ownership. The analysts who do it well are the people the company promotes.


What You'll Own


Campaign management and optimization: Build, launch, and manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, Sponsored Display, and Amazon DSP campaigns, plus their Walmart Connect and Target Roundel equivalents. Manage bids, budgets, negatives, placement modifiers, and dayparting against agreed targets. Keep pacing on plan and flag risk before it becomes a shortfall.
Keyword, targeting, and audience work: Research and build keyword and product targeting sets, mine search term reports for new opportunity and wasted spend, and maintain clean negative structures. Support audience building and testing in DSP.
Analysis: Pull and interrogate the data yourself — search term, placement, product-level, and business reports — and turn it into a recommendation rather than a summary. Understand why a number moved, not just that it did.
Account audits: Perform structured audits on new and existing accounts: campaign architecture, targeting overlap, budget allocation, wasted spend, missed placements, and gaps between what the account is doing and what the strategy calls for. Write up findings clearly enough that someone else can act on them.
Client reporting and business reviews: Build the reporting that keeps clients informed, and prepare the analysis and decks for quarterly and annual business reviews. Your work goes in front of client leadership, so it needs to be accurate, clear, and defensible.
AI-assisted workflows: Use AI tools to speed up analysis, bulk file work, keyword processing, and documentation. Contribute to improving how the team works rather than just following the process you were handed.
Collaboration: Partner with the Strategy & Implementation Team on retail readiness and the Design Team on creative. Raise the constraints — inventory, catalog, pricing, page quality — that advertising can't fix on its own.

What You Bring



Required

2+ years hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing Amazon advertising campaigns
Amazon Ads certification in Sponsored Ads and Amazon DSP (both required; verified)
Experience with Amazon DSP campaign management, not just Sponsored Ads
Genuinely analytical: comfortable in large data sets, can build your own analysis in Excel or Sheets, and check your own math
Intellectual curiosity: want to know why something happened, and keep pulling the thread after the immediate question is answered
Strong written and verbal communication: can explain a performance change in plain language and write findings a client can read
Proficiency working with AI tools and AI-assisted workflows
Detail discipline: bulk uploads, naming conventions, and negatives done right the first time


Preferred

Walmart Sponsored Ads and Walmart DSP certification
Meta and TikTok ads experience, with certifications
Target Roundel experience
SQL, Looker Studio / Google Data Studio, or Amazon Marketing Cloud exposure
Agency or multi-brand experience across categories
Advanced Excel; Python or scripting a plus
Familiarity with retail fundamentals: Buy Box, inventory health, catalog integrity, promotions, subscriptions

Who Does Well Here



The work is cyclical and the peaks are demanding — Q4 and Prime Day compress a quarter of decisions into a few weeks. The analysts who do well here treat a bad week as something to diagnose rather than defend, and would rather find the problem themselves than be told about it.

The company also looks for ownership (escalate early and don't lose things), intellectual honesty (would rather be corrected than confidently wrong), care about accuracy, and a habit of fixing a manual process the third time you run it.


What Success Looks Like


30 days: Managing daily optimizations on your accounts with light supervision, and you know each brand's structure, targets, and constraints.
90 days: Running your accounts independently, delivering audits and reporting your manager doesn't have to rewrite, and surfacing recommendations rather than waiting for direction.
12 months: Your accounts show measurable improvement you can explain, you're trusted in front of clients, and you've improved at least one thing about how the team works.

How to Stand Out



Come ready to walk through one account you improved — what you found, what you changed, and how you knew it worked.

Te incomoda tratar con directores de alto nivel o entrar a una junta tensa.

description:
About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly

Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand — we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.




As we scale across Mexico and the U.S., we're investing in AI and data infrastructure as a core business capability — connecting the systems that run the business, automating repetitive work, and building intelligence systems that help our teams make faster, better decisions.




We're splitting what was originally a single "AI + Consumer Intelligence" hire into two focused roles. This posting is for the technical / operational half: the person who architects and builds Sarelly's automation and AI agent capability across the business. A separate Consumer Intelligence Lead will own the consumer questions, taxonomy, insight validation and translation into Product, Brand and Growth decisions. This role will partner closely with them to build the data collection, infrastructure and AI workflows that make that intelligence possible.




The Opportunity

This is not a traditional IT, data engineering, or "prompt engineer" role.

You'll architect the data and intelligence infrastructure behind Sarelly's decision-making: connecting internal business data with selected external market, consumer and competitive signals, and building systems that can turn that data into reliable, traceable intelligence




You'll be Sarelly's internal AI Champion: the person who knows what's actually possible with today's AI tools, pushes back when it isn't, and educates the rest of the organization so people stop guessing. You'll also be hands-on — designing and shipping the automations, integrations and agents that remove manual work across Operations, Logistics, HR and beyond.




Your mission: build the data, automation and AI infrastructure that makes Sarelly smarter and more efficient — connecting fragmented systems, eliminating repetitive work, and transforming internal and external data into reliable intelligence teams can act on.




You'll report into the COO's org and work directly with department heads (Supply Chain, Finance, Sales and Marketing) to find, prioritize and build these projects.




Key ResponsibilitiesBe Sarelly's AI Champion
Act as Sarelly's internal expert on what AI can and can't realistically do, helping teams identify and prioritize high-value use cases.
Build a culture where teams bring business problems, not tool requests.
Create practical standards, reusable workflows and training so teams can safely use and build with AI while critical systems remain governed.
Own and maintain a prioritized roadmap of AI, automation and data opportunities based on business impact, feasibility and effort.




Build Sarelly's Connected Data Foundation
Ex Unify Sarelly's Inventory & Systems Data. Day One problem: Sarelly's inventory currently lives across disconnected systems — Shopify (website + offline stores in Mexico), two separate 3PL systems (MX and US), and Amazon (US and MX) — none of which talk to each other today.
Design and build the integration layer that connects these systems into a single source of truth for inventory.
Identify the next systems that should be integrated as the business grows.




Build Sarelly's Intelligence Infrastructure

Partner with the Consumer Intelligence Lead to build the technical foundation of Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Hub.
Design data collection pipelines across selected public and first-party sources, including social platforms, retailers, competitors, creators/influencers, customer feedback, commerce and CRM.
Build systems capable of continuously transforming large volumes of unstructured data into structured, searchable intelligence using Sarelly-defined taxonomies.
Ensure AI-generated outputs retain links to underlying source evidence, expose confidence and coverage gaps, and can be reviewed or corrected by human experts.
Design the architecture so Sarelly owns its data and can connect it securely to Claude, ChatGPT or future AI models and agents without rebuilding the underlying system.
Over time, extend this infrastructure beyond Consumer Intelligence to broader Business Intelligence, connecting commercial performance, retail, market/category forecasts and competitive intelligence to support leadership and country GM decision-making




Build Automations, Agents & Internal Tools
Map manual, repetitive or disconnected processes across the organization and determine where automation, integration or AI can create meaningful business value.
Own these automations end-to-end: build, test, deploy, monitor, and fix when they break.
Design and deploy Slack-based agents that give the team fast answers on things like regulatory questions and order status/tracking.
Identify other repeated, answerable questions across the org that an agent could handle reliably.




Build Business Intelligence & Forecasting Capabilities
Help build a more robust demand planning and forecasting model.
Organize the underlying data correctly so forecasting is reliable, not ad hoc.
Automate recurring planning routines that are currently manual.
Connect internal performance data with relevant external market, category and competitive signals to improve forecasting and business decisions.
Partner with Finance, Sales and country GMs to identify recurring decisions that can be supported by better data, predictive models or AI-assisted analysis.
Build dashboards, alerts or AI-assisted decision tools where they create measurable value — not dashboards for the sake of reporting.




What you bring 
Proven experience shipping AI-powered automations, integrations, data products or internal tools in a live business environment — not just prototypes or experiments.
Hands-on experience connecting systems through APIs and building data pipelines across structured and unstructured internal and external sources.
Strong hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents beyond prompting, including orchestration, function calling, RAG, tool use, structured outputs or similar production workflows.
Strong understanding of AI quality and evaluation, including source traceability, confidence, human validation, error monitoring and failure modes.
Ability to design maintainable, model-agnostic systems, so critical data and workflows are not locked into a single AI model or vendor.
Strong technical judgment: you know when to use generative AI, deterministic automation, traditional analytics, predictive models or a simpler process solution.
Ability to translate messy business problems into practical technical solutions, prioritize based on business impact, and explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working directly with business teams to define requirements, build solutions, drive adoption and continuously improve them.

Workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Make or Retool.

Building production Slack, chat-based agents or other internal AI tools

Ships working automations, not proposals.

Can work independently across multiple departments without losing focus.
Wants to build a capability — internal AI/automation — that doesn't fully exist at Sarelly yet.

You'll have direct visibility into Supply Chain, Retail, Logistics, Customer Service and HR, and the mandate to fix real operational problems with real tools, fast.
