description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

We ensure that teams across Product Support Operations and Risk Operations have the knowledge they need to master our products, provide gold standard support, and safeguard both Stripe and our users. We aspire to elevate the way our learners perceive us, positioning ourselves as a critical resource on their journey to growth through quality training that resonates with, and empowers, every individual.

What you’ll do

As a Training Program Manager within the Technical Enablement team, your role will be to develop training initiatives that enhance the capabilities of our Operations teams, specifically Product Support and Risk Operations. Our team takes pride in refining the Stripe experience for both our users and our global network of support specialists. By owning the strategic direction and execution of training programs, you'll play a crucial role in equipping operations associated with the knowledge and skills necessary for exceptional service delivery.

Responsibilities


Design learning curricula to help deliver the vision and strategy for the Stripe Operations training program
Convert business requirements into comprehensive training curricula and supportive content, tailored to the needs of our teams
Ensure the application of adult learning principles and systematic instructional design to create effective learning solutions, including online, classroom, virtual, and blended learning modalities
Design assessment methodologies aligned with leading accreditation frameworks and practices
Partner with business leaders across Operations to develop relevant training programs in accordance with the strategy you set out
Analyze metric data to evaluate high-priority topics that would benefit from the development of new training modules and measure training impact post-launch
Efficiently partner with cross-functional stakeholders on high-priority projects and initiatives, adapting swiftly to emerging needs and dedicating focused effort to ensure success
Proactively assess and respond to training demands in cases where there may be significant ambiguity or unknowns
Harmonize our training efforts across our Stripe Delivery Centers



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


3+ years of experience in driving training or enablement programs with prior instructional design or training exposure
Experience designing and developing training materials and content to include online/e-learning modules, instructor-led materials, job aids, online tutorials, multimedia products (video, graphic, audio), and other training materials
Experience using data collection, research, and analysis to evaluate project outcomes and improve individual and organizational performance
Ability to manage multiple stakeholders with varying priorities and drive creative solutions and commitment to a shared goal



Preferred Qualifications


Experience leveraging learning management systems and/or other content delivery platforms
An inquisitive approach to learning about new technologies, with a keen sense in identifying user and agent issues
The ability to distill complex information into clear, concise deliverables
Experience in identifying recurring issues faced by customers and specialists, and developing scalable training solutions
Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience giving presentations



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

About the job

Customer Success Specialist




Acerca de Aldea

Aldea es una plataforma para la gestión y administración de centros educativos. Hoy ayudamos a más de 400 centros (kínderes, guarderías, primarias, centros de terapia, idiomas y deporte) a optimizar su comunicación, administración y procesos pedagógicos.

Nuestra misión es simplificar la operación de los centros educativos, reduciendo su carga administrativa y mejorando la comunicación con padres de familia, para que directores y maestros puedan enfocarse en lo más importante: la educación de los niños.




➡️ ¿Te apasiona esta visión?

¡Genial! Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo y creemos que esta oportunidad puede ser lo que estás buscando. Únete a una empresa 100% mexicana con presencia local y un producto diseñado para las necesidades de miles de centros en Latinoamérica.

Identify, document, track, and retest defects, working with development teams through investigation and resolution.
Use SQL to validate application data, investigate discrepancies, and confirm data integrity.
Review requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios, gaps, and potential risks.

description:
About the job

Creative Content Strategist | YouTube & Long-Form Video

Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week




About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative Creative Content Strategist to take ownership of the strategy and creative direction behind a growing YouTube channel focused on business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and education.




This is a behind-the-scenes creative role. You will be responsible for continuously researching new ideas, developing original video concepts, creating stories and narratives, writing scripts, building storyboards, researching filming locations, and helping shape what each video should look and feel like before the founders step in front of the camera.

The ideal candidate understands YouTube content, storytelling, business, and digital marketing and knows how to turn business expertise into compelling content that people actually want to watch.




Key Responsibilities

Own the creative strategy and content planning for the YouTube channel.
Research and develop new, original video ideas on an ongoing basis.
Study successful YouTube channels and identify formats, storytelling approaches, hooks, and concepts that can be adapted to the brand.
Develop compelling video concepts around business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and real-world business stories.
Create storylines and narratives that make educational content engaging and entertaining.
Write and structure scripts for long-form YouTube videos.
Develop storyboards and detailed creative directions for each video.
Determine the hook, structure, pacing, key talking points, and overall narrative of each piece.
Interview or collaborate with the founders to extract stories, experiences, insights, and expertise that can become strong content.
Research interesting entrepreneurs, businesses, trends, case studies, and potential collaboration opportunities.
Identify and reach out to potential entrepreneurs or business owners for collaborations and guest appearances.
Research visually interesting filming locations in Miami, including hotels, venues, high-rise spaces, businesses, and other unique environments.
Provide creative direction for filming setups, locations, environments, and overall visual presentation.
Prepare the founders with everything they need before filming so they can execute the content efficiently.
Collaborate with the long-form video editor and clearly communicate the intended creative direction.
Help establish a repeatable YouTube content production system and maintain an organized content pipeline.
Develop approximately one long-form YouTube video per week, with additional shorter long-form content as needed.




Content Focus:

The content will primarily revolve around:

Business and entrepreneurship
Digital marketing
Business growth and strategy
Educational content
Entrepreneurial stories and interviews
Case studies and business lessons
Personal branding and founder-led content
Interesting business trends and real-world stories

The goal is to create content that educates, entertains, and builds authority, rather than feeling like traditional advertising.




What We're Looking For

Strong understanding of YouTube content strategy and storytelling.
Demonstrated experience creating or developing long-form YouTube content.
Excellent creative instincts and the ability to consistently generate fresh, original ideas.
Strong scripting and storytelling skills.
Ability to think visually and imagine how a video should look before it is filmed.
Understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, narrative structure, and audience psychology.
Strong research skills and curiosity about business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and financial topics.
Basic understanding of digital marketing and business concepts.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with founders.
Organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of the creative process.
Ability to research and identify interesting filming locations and environments.
Comfortable researching and reaching out to entrepreneurs for potential collaborations.
Experience with B2B content marketing, educational content, consulting, podcasting, or founder-led content is a plus.
A portfolio of YouTube videos or relevant long-form content is required.




Important Role Clarification

Video editing is NOT the primary responsibility of this position.




A dedicated video editor will handle the editing. Your responsibility is to define what should be created and how it should be created—from the initial idea and research through the story, script, storyboard, filming plan, and creative direction.

You will essentially act as the creative director and strategic brain behind the YouTube channel.

You do not need to live in Miami. However, you should be comfortable researching Miami locations remotely using tools such as Google Maps, venue websites, and other online resources.




Experience

We are open to candidates across different experience levels.

A highly experienced YouTube strategist is welcome, but we are equally interested in junior or mid-level candidates who demonstrate exceptional creative thinking, strong storytelling ability, and a genuine understanding of what makes YouTube content compelling.

Your portfolio and creative instincts matter more than a specific number of years of experience.




Schedule

Part-Time
Approximately 20 hours/week to start
Flexible remote schedule
Opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities as the content operation grows

About the job

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring the person who will own paid acquisition for our DTC channel as it moves from a controlled, governed starting point toward meaningful scale. This is fundamentally an economics role before it is a media-buying role: the person we hire will operate inside clear contribution and measurement guardrails, and will be trusted to leave budget unspent when the numbers don't support deploying it.

Recruiting this role does not itself authorize increased ad spend—spend scales in steps, gated by sustained contribution performance, not by hire date. If you're energized by proving out an account methodically and scaling only what's actually working, this role is built for you.




ABOUT US

Ecotero LLC operates five private-label brands led by DECOLURE in premium bedding and home textiles. Amazon is the mature channel at $18M+ annually across roughly 703 SKUs. TikTok Shop does roughly $4.5M and is growing. DTC on Shopify is early.

We are a 27-person distributed team. The analytical infrastructure here is unusual for a business this size: SKU-level COGS across the full catalogue, daily API pipelines into PostgreSQL, competitor tracking, and AI operational agents that produce weekly audit drafts, anomaly flags and performance reports for your review.




SCOPE OF THIS ROLE

This role reports directly to the Head of DTC. You'll own the ad accounts and day-to-day media decisions, but spend authorization is governed separately and is not automatically unlocked by this hire—increases are tied to sustained, measured contribution performance.

You'll work closely with the Lifecycle and Retention Manager, whose cohort and LTV reporting sets your CAC ceiling, and with the Paid Social Creative Producer, who supplies and iterates on creative based on your test results.




You do not own landing page development or on-site conversion optimization directly, though you'll partner closely with whoever does to make sure traffic and landing experience are aligned.

As the channel matures, this role's scope is expected to grow into a broader acquisition function with additional specialists; today, it's a hands-on, individually owned seat.




WHAT YOU OWN

Meta and Google as core paid channels, expanding to Pinterest, YouTube, or others as they qualify on the numbers.
Account structure, campaign architecture, audience strategy, bid strategy, and day-to-day budget pacing.
The daily discipline of deciding where the next marginal dollar goes, including the discipline to leave it unspent when the account doesn't support it.
Operating within a defined spend gate tied to sustained contribution or blended MER performance — spend scales in governed steps as performance clears agreed thresholds, not on a fixed schedule.
Blended MER and contribution economics after COGS, fulfillment, returns, and media cost, not platform-reported ROAS alone.
Applying a realistic haircut to platform-reported return metrics before planning against them.
CAC ceilings set from the lifecycle team's cohort and LTV data, not from a platform dashboard metric.
A structured creative testing calendar in partnership with the Creative Producer — every test has a stated hypothesis, a minimum sample size, and a kill criterion set before launch.
Winner scaling and fatigue monitoring: tracking frequency, CPM drift, and knowing when a winning ad is done.
Incrementality testing, geo holdouts or spend-down tests on a regular cadence, and understanding how much of reported non-brand conversion is actually incremental versus cannibalized branded search.
Working with the CRO/merchandising owner to ensure traffic and landing pages are matched, even though you don't own the page itself.
Clear, regular reporting on account performance, test results, and the reasoning behind every scale-up or pull-back decision.




REQUIRED EVIDENCE

Required:

You have personally held a blended MER or contribution target on an account with $100,000 or more in monthly governed spend, sustained over a period of at least six months, and can name the brand, the dates, and the results.
You can describe a specific time you reduced or stopped spend on something that looked good on the dashboard, the threshold you used, who disagreed, and what happened afterward.
You can do the arithmetic: given margin, AOV, and cost structure, you can derive break-even MER and a maximum sustainable CAC without hesitation.
You understand the limitations of platform-reported ROAS and can explain what you actually plan against instead.
You have run or closely partnered on incrementality testing, geo holdouts, spend-down tests, or branded search cannibalization checks, and can speak to what you learned.
You can provide a reference or verifiable artifact for your results; claims will be checked before a final offer.
You're comfortable operating inside a governed spend gate rather than pushing to scale spend as fast as possible.
You can commit to substantial same-day overlap with US Eastern hours — pacing and budget decisions happen daily.




Preferred:

Experience in bedding, home goods, or textiles.
Agency-side and brand-side experience.
Direct experience partnering with an in-house or contracted creative producer on a structured test calendar.
Experience managing paid media across more than one brand simultaneously.
Familiarity with server-side tracking, CAPI, or first-party data approaches in a post-iOS14 environment.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first 30 days:

Full account audit complete.
A clear point of view on account health.
A documented test calendar in motion.




In the first 90 days:

Every spend and scale decision is explainable in contribution terms.
Incrementality testing is underway.
Reporting is decision-grade.




As the spend gate clears in governed steps:

Sustained MER performance at each new spend level.
A clean track record of test hypotheses and kill criteria.
A working rhythm with lifecycle and creative that keeps CAC disciplined as volume grows.




WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience.
Fully remote position. Work from anywhere.
Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager.
Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry.
A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.
Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new marketplaces and channels.
Employee discounts on Decolure products.

About AI Rudder




AI Rudder is a conversational AI company on a mission to transform how businesses communicate with their customers — across voice and digital channels that feel genuinely human.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Singapore, we're building technologies that bridge languages, enhance understanding, and enable meaningful human–machine communication at scale.

Today, we serve 500+ enterprise clients globally processing 50 million calls daily and having delivered more than 8 billion calls to date.

Most recently, we have raised $50M in a Series B fundraising from leading global investors including Tiger Global, Peak XV Partners, and Cathay Innovation.




How We Work




AI-first: AI isn't a tool we reach for. It's the default we start from. Every team, every workflow: AI-first.

Global Collaboration: We operate globally and work as one team. Distance is a logistics problem, not a cultural one. We build the habits that make distributed teams actually work.

Communication Principle: Simple, Trust, Transparent. We remove unnecessary complexity so people can focus on what matters most.




What We Offer




Learning & Development: Continuous learning through real projects, knowledge-sharing sessions, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.

Performance Recognition: Regular performance reviews, feedback, and opportunities for career progression.

Global Exposure: Collaborate with international teams, global rotations, and work with global enterprise customers.

Meaningful Impact: Build AI solutions that create real value for businesses around the world.

Ownership & Autonomy: Freedom to take initiative and drive outcomes.

Team Engagement: Team Building, Local & Global Gatherings & Local Events Celebration.




AI Rudder is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants.




Responsibilities：




Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Lead business and technical discovery, understand customer architecture and requirements, and design scalable end-to-end solutions.
Architecture & Integrations: Define solution architecture, APIs, integrations, data flows, and deployment approaches in collaboration with customer technical teams.
POC & Technical Validation: Design and manage POCs, define success criteria, and address technical requirements and objections.
Enterprise Deal Leadership: Own the technical side of complex sales cycles, working closely with Sales to remove blockers and drive deals to technical closure.
Enterprise Readiness: Work with IT, Security, Architecture, and Infrastructure teams on requirements such as data residency, security, scalability, high availability, and deployment models.
Commercial Partnership: Balance customer needs with technical feasibility, implementation complexity, cost, scope, and the overall likelihood of winning the deal.




Qualifications：




Technical Expertise (Must-Have): Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, system architecture, and cloud environments. Able to lead technical conversations independently.

Enterprise Pre-Sales Experience: Experience in Solutions Engineering, Solution Consulting, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role supporting complex enterprise deals.

API & Integration Knowledge: Understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, JSON, system-to-system integrations, and data flows.

Enterprise Architecture: Familiarity with SaaS architecture, AWS/Azure/GCP, multi-tenant and single-tenant environments, private networks, scalability, and high availability.

POC & Enterprise Experience: Experience managing POCs or technical validations and working with enterprise IT, Security, Architecture, and Infrastructure teams.

AI Knowledge: Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, AI agents/workflows, model selection, and enterprise AI integrations. Deep ML expertise is not required.

Commercial Mindset: Ability to understand how technical decisions impact deal size, implementation complexity, cost, scope, and revenue.

Communication: Strong English communication skills, with the ability to communicate with both technical and business stakeholders.

description:
About the job

Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.

This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data - combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day-to-day - you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.

If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.

At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On


Leading the full creative cycle - research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels - briefing and reviewing content to keep it on-brand, culturally relevant, and platform-optimised
Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief - identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis - and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge



You’re Probably a Match If


You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy - and you've worked hands-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
You have strong creative instinct - you know what makes a hook scroll-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators - coaching them to produce performance-driven work
You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality



Meet the team

We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high-impact marketing across Latin America - combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. Mexico is a key focus for us right now, and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition.

How We Hire

We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that all interviews are conducted virtually.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

Xepelin está transformando las finanzas empresariales en Latinoamérica con una suite de productos que automatizan la gestión financiera y facilitan el acceso a liquidez. Con el objetivo de convertirse en el CFO digital de todo negocio, ha desarrollado tecnología financiera que impacta en todo el ecosistema empresarial. Gracias a la data obtenida por la interacción de +1M de empresas dentro de su network, se construye un sistema de inteligencia de negocios que da visibilidad de indicadores financieros y evaluaciones de riesgo de la red con la que se colabora, ayudando a que la toma de decisiones sea más rápida y segura.

Nuestros principios ¿Cómo operamos?
🎯 Ponemos a nuestros clientes en el centro

✨ Creemos e inspiramos

🧑‍💼 Actuamos como dueños

🏅 Lideramos con el ejemplo

🏆 Nos desafiamos para ganar

🧠 Tomamos riesgos con inteligencia

🤖 Usamos el poder de la tecnología

¿Qué estamos buscando?
En Xepelin estamos buscando personas creativas y visionarias que piensen fuera de la caja para sumarse a nuestro equipo. Si te apasiona resolver desafíos interesantes de alto impacto y quieres ser parte de un entorno dinámico que está transformando la industria financiera, ¡Esta oportunidad es para ti!

Si te motiva el desafío de construir soluciones innovadoras en un entorno de rápido cambio, queremos conocerte.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol
Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades


Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng





¿Qué necesitas para brillar?


Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables





Requisitos


2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin.

title: SEO Content Optimizer

Content
Content Director

The SEO Content Optimizer leverages Green Marketing’s custom GPT models to produce and refine channel‑specific content: blogs, service and location pages, FAQs, Google Business Profile posts, brand development content, and social captions.

You’ll format, fact‑check, interlink, and polish AI outputs to meet our SEO, accessibility, and brand standards. This is an AI‑first, optimization role; ideal for someone with basic content writing and on‑page SEO knowledge who enjoys turning AI drafts into publication‑ready assets.
AI‑Enabled Content Production

Use Green Marketing’s custom GPT models to draft channel‑specific content (blogs, service and location pages, FAQs, landing pages, Google Business Profile posts, social captions, email snippets), then refine outputs to meet brand and SEO standards.
On‑Page Structure & SEO

Organize content with clear heading hierarchy (H1–H3), scannable paragraphs, bullet/numbered lists, tables when useful, and SEO elements including title tags, meta descriptions, URL slugs, and alt text, where applicable.
Image/Media Selection & Optimization
Source appropriate visuals from approved stock libraries or client assets; ensure image & content relevancy, alt text, and quality.
Internal Linking & Taxonomy

Implement and maintain interlinking across blogs, service pages, and location pages to support topical clusters (e.g., lawn care, landscaping, irrigation, hardscaping) and guide users toward pillar pages.
Editing & Quality Assurance

Audit AI output for accuracy, clarity, originality, brand voice, readability, and local relevance (services, service areas, seasonality). Resolve inconsistencies, remove fluff, and ensure compliance with checklists and tone guides.
Client Voice & Brand Fidelity

Tailor content to each client’s tone, offers, certifications, and service territories; accurately reflect nuances of the lawn & landscape niche (seasonal tasks, regional considerations, safety and licensing notes).
SOP Adherence & Improvement
Follow Green Marketing’s standard operating procedures and checklists consistently; document gaps and propose updates to prompts, templates, and knowledge base to improve throughput and quality.
Documentation & Asset Management
Maintain organized records of prompts, drafts, publishing statuses, image sources/attributions, and final URLs; keep content calendars and task boards up to date.
Basic understanding of on‑page SEO (title/meta, headings, internal links, alt text, URL slugs).
Basic understanding of AI tools (prompting, refining outputs, responsible use).
Communication skills: clear writing, concise edits, and professional client‑facing notes.
Strong attention to detail: consistency, grammar, brand voice, and checklist discipline.
Ability to follow SOPs and hit deadlines across multiple client accounts.
Comfortable using spreadsheets/task boards (content calendars, status tracking).
This is a fully remote position. Team members must maintain a professional, distraction‑free workspace and reliable connectivity to collaborate and deliver work on schedule.
Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), Monday–Friday.
Be available for stand‑ups, reviews, and client‑related meetings during these hours (observing ET, including Daylight Saving shifts).
Timeliness: 100% on‑time delivery; 0 overdue tasks per month.
SOP Adherence: ≥ 98% checklist compliance across formatting, metadata, interlinking, accessibility, and publishing steps.
Quality / Error Rate: ≤ 2 minor issues per 10 assets; 0 critical errors (e.g., incorrect client details, broken links, image licensing issues).
First‑Pass Approval: ≥ 90% “ready to publish” on initial submission.
Interlinking Coverage: 100% of eligible assets include required internal links per content brief/topic cluster.
Accessibility Completeness: Alt text on 100% of images; correct heading order on 100% of pages.
Revision Efficiency: Average 1.5 revision cycles per asset before final approval.
Throughput: Meets monthly cadence defined in the content plan (blogs, service/location pages, GBP posts, social captions).
Communication SLAs: Responds to team/client comments within working hours on the same business day.

About the job

Job Title:

SEO Content Optimizer

Department:

Content

Reports To:

Content Director

Job Purpose:

The SEO Content Optimizer leverages Green Marketing’s custom GPT models to produce and refine channel‑specific content: blogs, service and location pages, FAQs, Google Business Profile posts, brand development content, and social captions.
You’ll format, fact‑check, interlink, and polish AI outputs to meet our SEO, accessibility, and brand standards. This is an AI‑first, optimization role; ideal for someone with basic content writing and on‑page SEO knowledge who enjoys turning AI drafts into publication‑ready assets.




Key Responsibilities:

AI‑Enabled Content Production
Use Green Marketing’s custom GPT models to draft channel‑specific content (blogs, service and location pages, FAQs, landing pages, Google Business Profile posts, social captions, email snippets), then refine outputs to meet brand and SEO standards.




On‑Page Structure & SEO
Organize content with clear heading hierarchy (H1–H3), scannable paragraphs, bullet/numbered lists, tables when useful, and SEO elements including title tags, meta descriptions, URL slugs, and alt text, where applicable.




Image/Media Selection & Optimization
Source appropriate visuals from approved stock libraries or client assets; ensure image & content relevancy, alt text, and quality.




Internal Linking & Taxonomy
Implement and maintain interlinking across blogs, service pages, and location pages to support topical clusters (e.g., lawn care, landscaping, irrigation, hardscaping) and guide users toward pillar pages.




Editing & Quality Assurance
Audit AI output for accuracy, clarity, originality, brand voice, readability, and local relevance (services, service areas, seasonality). Resolve inconsistencies, remove fluff, and ensure compliance with checklists and tone guides.




Client Voice & Brand Fidelity
Tailor content to each client’s tone, offers, certifications, and service territories; accurately reflect nuances of the lawn & landscape niche (seasonal tasks, regional considerations, safety and licensing notes).




SOP Adherence & Improvement
Follow Green Marketing’s standard operating procedures and checklists consistently; document gaps and propose updates to prompts, templates, and knowledge base to improve throughput and quality.




Documentation & Asset Management
Maintain organized records of prompts, drafts, publishing statuses, image sources/attributions, and final URLs; keep content calendars and task boards up to date.




Qualifications and Skills:

Basic understanding of on‑page SEO (title/meta, headings, internal links, alt text, URL slugs).




Basic understanding of AI tools (prompting, refining outputs, responsible use).




Communication skills: clear writing, concise edits, and professional client‑facing notes.




Strong attention to detail: consistency, grammar, brand voice, and checklist discipline.




Ability to follow SOPs and hit deadlines across multiple client accounts.




Comfortable using spreadsheets/task boards (content calendars, status tracking).




Remote Work and Equipment Requirements:

This is a fully remote position. Team members must maintain a professional, distraction‑free workspace and reliable connectivity to collaborate and deliver work on schedule.

Working Hours:

Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), Monday–Friday.




Be available for stand‑ups, reviews, and client‑related meetings during these hours (observing ET, including Daylight Saving shifts).




Performance Metrics and KPIs:

Timeliness: 100% on‑time delivery; 0 overdue tasks per month.




SOP Adherence: ≥ 98% checklist compliance across formatting, metadata, interlinking, accessibility, and publishing steps.




Quality / Error Rate: ≤ 2 minor issues per 10 assets; 0 critical errors (e.g., incorrect client details, broken links, image licensing issues).




First‑Pass Approval: ≥ 90% “ready to publish” on initial submission.




Interlinking Coverage: 100% of eligible assets include required internal links per content brief/topic cluster.




Accessibility Completeness: Alt text on 100% of images; correct heading order on 100% of pages.




Revision Efficiency: Average 1.5 revision cycles per asset before final approval.




Throughput: Meets monthly cadence defined in the content plan (blogs, service/location pages, GBP posts, social captions).




Communication SLAs: Responds to team/client comments within working hours on the same business day.

Compensation and Benefits:

Base Salary: $1,200 per month (USD).




PTO: Generous paid time off, including mental health days.




Additional details on holidays and accruals provided at offer stage.

title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Ventas B2B
description:
About the job

Ciudad de México (Híbrido/Remoto)

Full-time | Entry Level

$15,000 MXN mensuales de sueldo base + comisiones sin tope




Sobre Good Traffic




Good Traffic es la empresa detrás de los autos de rideshare con vehicle wraps, la plataforma de publicidad exterior construida sobre la red de rideshare mundial. Convertimos vehículos normales en espectaculares en movimiento — combinando car wrapping con tecnología de geolocalización y medición de impresiones para darle a las marcas más grandes del mundo un nuevo tipo de inventario de medios: branding premium en movimiento. Somos un equipo pequeño y ágil, y cada persona que se une tiene un impacto real en qué tan rápido crecemos.




Empieza tu carrera en ventas B2B con Good Traffic.




Como SDR serás el primer punto de contacto entre nuestra marca y los anunciantes que podrían beneficiarse de nuestro formato de vehículos wrapeados. No necesitas años de experiencia — solo hustle, curiosidad y ganas de aprender rápido. Vas a trabajar de cerca con nuestro equipo de ventas y marketing para encontrar a los prospectos correctos, iniciar conversaciones y agendar reuniones que se conviertan en relaciones reales con clientes.




Tu rol en el equipo




● Prospección 100% outbound hacia anunciantes potenciales que tú mismo identifiques.

● Entender las necesidades de los anunciantes potenciales e identificar cómo nuestro formato encaja con sus objetivos de marketing.

● Mantener un seguimiento cercano de tu propia actividad y números de pipeline.

● Planear, gestionar y organizar tu prospección y seguimientos en el CRM.

● Asegurarte de que cada lead e interacción quede correctamente registrado.

● Mapear y prospectar nuevas oportunidades de negocio en marcas de CPG, retail, enterprise, etc.




¿Qué vas a hacer?




● Identificar y prospectar activamente nuevos clientes potenciales mediante investigación, mapeo de mercado y herramientas de ventas.

● Contactar prospectos por llamadas, email y LinkedIn — aprendiendo a tener conversaciones reales sobre sus necesidades de marketing.

● Generar conversaciones con equipos de marketing, brand managers, agencias y otros tomadores de decisión.

● Desarrollar buenos hábitos para generar leads de calidad y mantener tu base de datos actualizada.

● Usar criterios de calificación claros para que solo avancen los leads con verdadero potencial. 

● Trabajar de cerca con el equipo de ventas para transferir leads calificados con contexto detallado de cada prospecto.

● Agendar reuniones calificadas para el equipo de ventas con prospectos que muestren interés real.

● Aprender a usar nuestro CRM y herramientas de ventas, manteniendo la información de leads y contactos precisa y actualizada.

● Familiarizarte con el producto de Branded Cars, nuestra metodología de medición de impresiones y nuestros casos de éxito, para poder explicarlos con confianza.

● Mantenerte al día sobre tendencias en publicidad Out-of-Home y el espacio de rideshare/movilidad.




¿A quién buscamos?




● Entre 0 y 2 años de experiencia profesional. Prácticas profesionales, proyectos universitarios o experiencia comercial también cuentan.

● Interés en construir una carrera en ventas, desarrollo de negocio o tecnología/publicidad.

● Muy buenas habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita.

● Persona proactiva y cómoda iniciando conversaciones.

● No te intimidan las llamadas en frío ni el rechazo.

● Organizado/a y capaz de manejar múltiples conversaciones y seguimientos al mismo tiempo.

● Te motivan los objetivos y te sientes cómodo/a midiendo tus propios resultados.

● Aprendes herramientas y procesos nuevos rápidamente.

● Español nativo o fluido.

● Inglés avanzado, con capacidad de mantener conversaciones profesionales.

● Licenciatura terminada o en curso es un plus, pero no obligatoria. Valoramos más tu capacidad, actitud y potencial que una carrera universitaria específica.




Es un plus si...




● Tienes experiencia previa en ventas, prospección, customer service, partnerships o business development.

● Has utilizado un CRM como HubSpot o Salesforce.

● Conoces LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Lusha u otras herramientas de prospección.

● Te interesa la publicidad, tecnología, medios, movilidad o AdTech.

● Has participado en organizaciones estudiantiles, emprendimientos, deportes competitivos o actividades donde hayas tenido que convencer, liderar o comunicarte con otras personas.




¿Por qué te va a encantar trabajar aquí?




● Compensación con upside real: $15,000 MXN mensuales de sueldo base + comisiones sin tope y bonos. Tu desempeño comercial impacta directamente lo que puedes ganar.

● Un camino claro de crecimiento: SDR → Senior SDR → Account Executive → Team Lead, y eventualmente mayores responsabilidades dentro del equipo comercial conforme Good Traffic siga creciendo. 

● Mentoría directa de nuestro equipo comercial y liderazgo — aprendizaje práctico en outbound sales, prospecting, cold calling, calificación de leads, gestión de CRM y pipeline, ventas B2B, y cómo venderle a grandes marcas y agencias.

● Impacto desde el principio: somos un equipo ágil y en crecimiento, así que tu trabajo no va a desaparecer dentro de una organización enorme. Las reuniones y oportunidades que generes se convierten directamente en nuevas campañas y crecimiento para Good Traffic.

● Exposición a algunas de las marcas, agencias y equipos de marketing más importantes del mundo mientras construimos una nueva categoría de publicidad exterior.




¿Te interesa empezar o acelerar tu carrera en ventas B2B con Good Traffic?




Aplica directamente por LinkedIn o envía correo a oscar@goodtraffic.com. No necesitas cumplir con el 100% de los requisitos. Queremos conocer personas con potencial, energía y ganas de aprender.

title: GTM Strategy Analyst
skills: Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión

Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis

Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento

De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos

Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng
Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables
2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti.

Únete a nosotros, ¡crezcamos juntos!

Misión del rol
Ser el cerebro analítico detrás de la estrategia de crecimiento de Xepelin México: definir dónde, cómo y a qué costo adquirimos clientes y convertir ese análisis en decisiones que el negocio ejecuta. El problema central es de los buenos: ¿dónde está el siguiente peso de crecimiento rentable? ¿Más Outbound, mejor pricing, otro segmento, un canal nuevo? Es un problema de asignación de capital, y tú eres quien lo modela, lo recomienda y lo acompaña hasta el resultado.

Principales responsabilidades


Estrategia de crecimiento y asignación de recursos: definir, junto al liderazgo del negocio, la estrategia de adquisición de la compañía — qué canales (Outbound, Inbound, Brokers, Digital), qué segmentos (SMB/Mid/Corp) y qué economics justifican cada inversión
Owner analítico del funnel completo: NQL→SQL→Enrolamiento→Aprobación→Activación→Retención. Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis
Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case
Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen
Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento
De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth
Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. No reportas métricas: cuentas la historia del negocio, propones la decisión y das seguimiento a los compromisos
Experimentación y gobierno de datos: priorizar hipótesis, diseñar tests, instrumentar tracking, productizar ganadores (playbook + métricas); definir eventos, taxonomías y QA de tracking con Analytics/Eng





¿Qué necesitas para brillar?


Pensamiento estructurado: descompones problemas ambiguos en árboles de hipótesis, priorizas el análisis que mueve la decisión y comunicas con claridad ejecutiva (escrita y verbal)
Estratega operador(a): la recomendación no te basta; bajas la idea a dashboard, playbook y piloto en días, no semanas
Data chops: SQL intermedio-avanzado, manejo de BigQuery/Looker o equivalentes; familiaridad con causalidad/experimentos y métricas de funnel
AI driven: experto en Claude/Chat GPT/Gemini/otros, con casos de uso claros y con impacto
Track record de impacto en KPIs: has movido números concretos — enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn — y puedes contar el cómo, no solo el cuánto
Obsesión por el cliente: research continuo, entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done, y capacidad de transformar insights en ofertas y mensajes accionables
Influencia cross-functional: te mueves con Revenue, Growth, Riesgo, Producto y Finanzas con la misma comodidad, sin autoridad formal
Owner mindset: foco en impacto económico (CAC, payback, margen, LTV), no en entregables





Requisitos


2+ años en consultoría estratégica o roles GTM/Strategy/Growth/RevOps analíticos, ideal con foco en adquisición B2B (fintech, SaaS, pagos o lending es plus)
Experiencia probada gestionando funnel completo y mejorando KPIs (enrolamientos, aprobación, activación, churn)
SQL (intermedio a avanzado) y Excel/Sheets avanzado
La posición es para CDMX. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. 





Nuestros Beneficios:

🌴 Xepelin Balance

Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Por cada año que cumplas en Xepelin, te damos un día extra de vacaciones.

Balance days: 10 días libres adicionales al año, para disfrutar como quieras.

Beneficios Flexibles: Puntos flexibles en tu moneda local al mes para gastar en lo que quieras.

🚀 Xepelin Performance & Career

Plataformas de capacitación: Convenios con las mejores plataformas, como Udemy y Google Cloud Skill Boost.

Kit de Bienvenida: todo lo que necesitas para comenzar tu viaje en Xepelin 😊

🤝 Xepelin Cares

Cobertura de salud: contamos con convenios de salud con proveedores de calidad o reembolsos según el país donde te encuentres.

Post Natal: te damos una semana extra de licencia post natal. ¡Nos interesa que estés con tu familia y seres queridos!

Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin.

About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

The Marketing Digital Analyst role will support the ongoing management of the Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform operations for PepsiCo Foods North America (PFNA). This includes acting as primary Point of Contact for Brand Teams, other Internal Stakeholders and External Stakeholders including agency partners. It will also support the management of web content updates to PFNA websites via the Drupal Content Management System (CMS) and provision of basic analytics using Google Analytics.

Your Impact

Support operational set-up and implementation of the Digital Asset Management system within PepsiCo, partnering with and delivering this service to D3 and PFNA brand teams

Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?


Bachelor’s degree in marketing, digital marketing, data analytics, or a related field. 
2+ years of experience in marketing technology, ideally with experience in Digital Asset Management systems or in a cybrarian capacity
Fluency in English is required

description:
About the job

Title: Customer Success Manager

Location: Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico

Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our Customer Success Manager will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Customer Success Organization acting as the go-to resource for our valued customers.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for ensuring successful product adoption and retention of key customers in the business. Specifically, you will:


Build custom Mutual Success Plans to align our Salesloft strategy to the customer’s business objectives.
Effectively guide customers in how to prioritize next steps on a Mutual Success Plan, managing multiple points of contact with each customer.
Partner with internal teams on tasks and projects that impact the broader team.
Review trends in customer data and proactively identify focus areas. 
Create impactful QBRs and prioritize data based on insight and the "so what" for each customer.
Identify unusual trends in the data and anticipate key follow-up questions from a customer.
Provide strategic guidance to customers around sales and sales engagement best practices for their use case. Champion industry best practices and challenge customers on their approach. 
Lead customer-facing webinars and internal trainings around industry insights and recommendations. 
Lead phone calls and on-site meetings with stakeholders (including C-Level), navigating both positive and more difficult conversations with ease.


In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to build long-term, trusted relationships with key executives and influencers. You will own, drive, and affect change for your customers by having an obsessive focus on their outcomes. Daily you’ll focus on driving customer adoption through strategy calls and customized business reviews at the executive level. The goal is to be the ultimate storyteller in showcasing the compelling impact on your customers' business made possible by their use of Salesloft. Remember, you are the quarterback of the customer experience and you will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking an experienced customer-facing professional who will engage, retain, and drive our customers' understanding of Salesloft product offerings working strategically with sales, cs, and leadership (both internally and with the customer). You will be measured on the retention, expansion, and happiness index of a book of business (Salesloft’s customers).

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Customer Success Manager is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Salesloft’s Customer Success team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming account management professionals.

The Customer Success team consists of 30 some team members who develop and maintain a deep understanding of the customer’s business drives, goals, and steer activities to align with these initiatives. They act as a liaison between internal teams to ensure customer needs are being met, partner with sales to define and achieve customers’ success criteria, and demonstrate ROI and ensure customers renew the Salesloft Product Suite. We strive to ensure customer satisfaction through inspiring, educating/training, driving adoption, managing stakeholders, and influencing the customer.

THE SKILL SET:


3+ years of experience in a Customer Success role
1+ years of experience using the Salesforce CRM. Must have an intermediate to expert knowledge of Salesforce CRM components such as leads, activities, contacts, opportunities, and reporting. (Salesforce Admin Certification is a plus!) 
Previous experience in a SaaS/Technology company or fast-growing start-up preferred 
Superb listening skills and the proven ability to dig deeper to uncover the customer’s true objectives
High level of empathy - it’s important for our CSMs to be a good person to peers and customers
You are a clear, confident, and compelling communicator — in writing, in conversation, and in front of an audience
You are extremely perceptive and highly emotionally intelligent, making you agile in adapting your executive presence and approach to any audience and personality
You are an expert project manager who ruthlessly prioritizes, manages stakeholder expectations, and ensures all key objectives and timelines are met
You are resourceful, scrappy, and creative — if a playbook doesn't exist yet, you go figure it out and build it for the whole team to use
You are confident in technical conversations — hearing “API” doesn't make you run and hide


WITHIN ONE MONTH, YOU’LL:


Attend Salesloft’s New Hire Orientation, where you will learn our Salesloft story and understand what makes our “Lofters” unique 
Join our 3-week Sales Bootcamp, where you will learn our software and all the skills necessary to set you up for success, allowing you to make an impact in the market quickly
Begin 1:1’s with your manager, understand your 30-60-90 day plan, meet & shadow current members of the Salesloft team, and delve into your territory 
Set your OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) with your manager and develop an action plan to achieve them
Meet key partners in Account Management, Finance, Marketing, Executives, etc. - they will be key relationships for you throughout your deal cycle
Become demo certified


WITHIN THREE MONTHS, YOU’LL:


Begin working with customers
Be Salesloft admin-certified
Be enrolled in our Salesloft PM certification program
Be a product expert and feel comfortable walking a customer through all aspects of the Salesloft platform
Have proficiency in both the Salesloft product capabilities as well as modern sales engagement best practices


WITHIN SIX MONTHS, YOU’LL:


Be running with your customer success plans to encourage adoption & process optimization
Be able to show quantifiable ROI to customers in the form of success stories
Have a greater ability to understand deep technical aspects of a product and educate customers and peers using simplified explanations


WITHIN TWELVE MONTHS, YOU’LL:


Set an example for new CSMs, and assist in training, onboarding, and motivating new Lofters
Be a proven self-starter and able to come up to speed on complex, difficult concepts with minimal assistance
Have a thorough understanding of the challenges an organization faces when implementing a new technology and how to help them manage change

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role


The Restaurant Experience Product Operations team is responsible for improving how restaurant partners interact with DiDi Food’s products, platforms, processes, and operational tools throughout their journey on the platform.
Our team serves as a bridge between local business needs and Product and Technology teams, translating restaurant pain points, operational challenges, and market opportunities into clear product requirements and actionable solutions.
We work in a highly cross-functional environment, collaborating with Product Managers, Research and Development, Commercial teams, Customer Service, Communications, Finance, Legal, and other regional and global stakeholders.
Our projects cover different stages of the product lifecycle, including user research, opportunity identification, business requirement definition, pilot design, market validation, product launches, communication, training, adoption, and performance monitoring.
This internship offers direct exposure to strategic and operational projects with visible business impact. The intern will contribute to initiatives designed to improve restaurant experience, product usability, operational efficiency, and adoption of DiDi Food solutions.
The role provides a strong learning opportunity for someone interested in Product Operations, Product Management, data analysis, and project execution, with the possibility of developing ownership, stakeholder management, structured problem-solving, and executive communication skills.



In this role, you'll be...


Supporting end-to-end product operations projects, including research, requirement gathering, pilots, launches, training, and post-launch follow-up.
Developing clear communication and training materials for internal teams and restaurant partners.
Coordinating with multiple stakeholders to define responsibilities, track deliverables, identify blockers, and ensure timely project execution.
Analyzing operational and product data using SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards, and other analytical tools.
Translating data and feedback into actionable insights, recommendations, and improvement opportunities.
Supporting user interviews, surveys, competitor research, and feedback collection to better understand restaurant needs.
Monitoring project performance and preparing reports, trackers, presentations, and executive updates.
Helping maintain alignment between Product teams and local business stakeholders throughout the product development cycle.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

You are currently pursuing a degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.

You have strong communication, organization, and analytical skills, and you feel comfortable working with different stakeholders in a fast-paced and multicultural environment. You are proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities while maintaining clear follow-up.

You have knowledge of SQL and experience analyzing data through spreadsheets or visualization tools. You can communicate complex information in a simple and structured way, have an interest in product management and operations, and are comfortable delivering presentations or training materials.

Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will regularly collaborate with international teams.

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

Salesforce Implementation Consultant: Sales Cloud & Marketing Cloud Account Engagement




LATAM

Welcome to 10Pearls! 

We believe in harnessing the power of technology for social good through our core values: Innovate, modernize and accelerate.

 

Description

We are seeking a Salesforce Implementation Consultant to join our growing Salesforce practice. This is a hands-on, client-facing role responsible for implementing and supporting Salesforce solutions, with an initial focus on Sales Cloud and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, formerly Pardot. The ideal candidate combines strong Salesforce administrative skills with excellent communication and consulting abilities. This person should be comfortable leading client conversations, understanding business processes, translating requirements into practical Salesforce solutions, configuring those solutions, testing them, documenting decisions, and training end users.

Responsibilities

Lead client discovery sessions, gather business requirements, and translate sales and marketing processes into practical Salesforce solutions.
Configure Salesforce Sales Cloud, including Leads, Accounts, Contacts, Opportunities, Activities, security, automation, Outlook Integration, reports, dashboards, and forecasting.
Configure Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, including Salesforce connectivity, field mappings, forms/form handlers, lists, segmentation, email templates, sending/tracker domains, and basic automation.
Support data migration and validation activities, including field mapping, contact imports, unsubscribe/opt-out handling, testing, and reconciliation.
Develop implementation documentation, facilitate UAT and launch readiness, and conduct administrator and end-user training.
Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly while collaborating with clients, project managers, developers, architects, and other internal teams.

Requirements

3+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration, consulting, or implementation experience, with strong working knowledge of Sales Cloud.
Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement (Pardot) or a comparable Salesforce-connected marketing automation platform.
Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration, including data models, fields, page layouts, permissions, validation rules, Flow, reports, dashboards, and data management.
Proven ability to gather requirements, facilitate client conversations, and translate business needs into scalable Salesforce configurations and recommendations.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and training skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong organizational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently manage priorities, identify risks, and deliver quality work within project timelines.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

Salesforce Certified Administrator.
Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant and/or Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist/Consultant.
Previous experience working for a Salesforce consulting partner, digital agency, or professional services organization and supporting implementations from discovery through go-live.

What We're Looking For

Success in this role requires more than knowing where Salesforce settings are located. We are looking for someone who can listen to a client describe a business problem, ask the right follow-up questions, recommend a sensible solution, configure it correctly, and confidently explain the result to the client. The strongest candidates will be comfortable moving between client meetings and hands-on Salesforce configuration and will take ownership of their work from discovery through testing, training, and launch.
