description:
About the job

About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Where we Work

Udemy is a global company headquartered in San Francisco, with additional U.S. offices in Denver and Austin, and international hubs in Australia, India, Ireland, Mexico, and Türkiye.

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About Your Skills


Customer Advocacy: You keep our learners, partners, and administrators at the center of your work, identifying and anticipating their needs and pain points. You thoughtfully advocate for customer needs cross-functionally. 
Project Management: You manage multiple workstreams and cross-functional stakeholders to drive customer-focused projects, adapting quickly to changes. You identify opportunities to improve processes and initiate lightweight project plans. 
Data-driven Storytelling: You analyze quantitative and qualitative data and use your technical platform expertise and critical thinking to identify keen user insights to communicate succinctly and memorably. 
Communication (English): You are fluent in the English language and can communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, both verbally and in writing 


About This Role


The Product Specialist team sits at the intersection of Support, Product, Engineering, and Customer-facing teams, translating user signals into structured improvements that enhance platform quality, reduce friction, and enable scalable growth. Product Specialists equip our user-facing teams to provide a seamless user experience on our platform as well as drive user-centric platform enhancements by strategically pinpointing key challenges and opportunities to the right internal stakeholders at the right time. 
The Product Specialist team meets the challenge of internal stakeholders’ competing priorities by nimbly adjusting advocacy strategies to compliment current company priorities. As Product Specialists grow in the role, they take on higher-impact projects and partner closely with leaders in Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support. The role and these projects ensure that our users remain at the center of product and process development across our company. 


What You’ll Be Doing


Use Coursera platform expertise to advocate for and create great learner and administrator experiences by influencing roadmaps, driving issue resolution, and building creative technical solutions 
Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to define and execute workflows for new feature launch operational readiness, representing our team and our learners 
Work closely with our Support teams to directly enable users by driving escalation resolution, triaging issues, and updating internal resources 
Own projects that improve our operational processes and internal tools & resources to improve our effectiveness and efficiency 
Present data-driven support insights to internal stakeholders to showcase trends and guide internal decision-making 
Build strong working relationships with multiple internal cross-functional teams and collaborate to create learners-first solutions 


What You’ll Have


3+ years of experience in customer success, technical support, or client services, working with technical teams 
Demonstrated ability to drive projects that benefit clients, customers, or end users 
Experience with mastering a technical platform and providing technical consultative support 
Written and verbal communication skills (English) to communicate technical information clearly, succinctly, and professionally 


At Udemy, we strive to be transparent around compensation. Actual compensation for this role is based on several factors, including but not limited to job-related skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition to a base salary, this role is also eligible for equity.

Hiring Compensation Range

$440,000—$550,000 MXN

Why work here?

You’ll grow here.

Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.

AI is real here.

We use it in the way we learn and the way we work. You’ll have the space and tools to experiment, apply, and get better at using AI in practical ways.

You’ll own your work.

We trust people to lead, make decisions, and follow through. You don’t need to wait for permission or layers of approval to have an impact.

You’ll Build With Others.

We collaborate openly and shape ideas together. Everyone has a voice, and good thinking is welcomed from any direction.

You’ll see your impact.

What you build helps people grow their skills, change their careers, or find a path forward. You’ve got the experience, why not use it to help others gain theirs?

Bring your curiosity. We’ll bring the platform and the support. Let’s LEARN together. 

Our Benefits Start With U

Our benefits start with you and were built to provide you and your family with the protection and care you need, making it easy to access the right coverage when you need it most. Benefits vary by region, and we encourage applicants to review our Australia Benefits, India Benefits, Ireland Benefits, Mexico Benefits, Turkiye Benefits & US Benefits, pages to get an understanding of some of the benefits we offer. For details on region-specific benefits, please refer to the information provided during the hiring process.

Benefits outlined are provided as a general overview and may vary depending on the location, role, and employment classification. All benefits are subject to change at the discretion of the organization and in accordance with applicable laws and policies.

At Udemy, we value diversity and inclusion and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, age, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, medical condition, or disability. We understand that not everyone will match each of the qualifications. However, we also realize that everyone has unique experiences that can add value to our company. Even if you think your background might not perfectly align, we'd love to hear from you! 

To protect against recruitment fraud, Coursera + Udemy recruiters only communicate via official coursera.org/udemy.com email addresses and never through personal accounts. We do not accept resumes via email or social media; please submit all applications directly through our careers page. If you encounter suspicious recruitment activity, please report it via our Fraudulent Activity Submission Form.

About the job

🇲🇽 USD 18,000 to USD 22,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Mexico!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




The standard hours for this role are 3pm-12am PT, Monday to Friday. 




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.

The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within Mexico. Your normal workday will start at 3pm Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

About the job

Estamos buscando Analista de Resurtido y Demanda para puntos de venta físicos en una empresa de expansión que comercializa productos cosméticos y de belleza. 




Te encargarás de asegurar la disponibilidad óptima de productos en las tiendas, evitando quiebres de stock y sobreinventario. En tu día a día analizarás datos de ventas, históricos de demanda y tendencias de consumo, y elaborarás planes de resurtido alineados con los objetivos comerciales. Trabajarás de forma estrecha con los equipos de ventas, logística y trade marketing para coordinar pedidos, lanzamientos y promociones en tienda.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe is investing in building out its Global Professional Services team to actively engage all customers from Fortune 100s to startups to help accelerate their adoption of Stripe capabilities. The team is responsible for ensuring that our customers deploy quickly with high quality integrations. It then partners closely with front line developers and technical leaders to ensure our customers continue to derive strategic value from Stripe and grow with us as our respective product portfolio expands. In addition, as we master the craft of deployment services, help build the asset and strategy that will enable us to scale through our partner ecosystem.

The Stripe Accelerate is a 3-month offering that unlocks access to a team of Stripe experts to help the user through every step of the implementation. This is included as part of Stripe solution, at no extra cost to our users. Accelerate Onboarding Managers provide prescriptive guidance and planning for the user’s onboarding journey. Onboarding Specialists provide product workshops, best practices, regular check-ins, and technical Q&A. This offering is targeted at Startup and SMB users.

A Few Key Features Of Accelerate Include


Specialized experts: Accelerate experts provide experience helping customers integrate Stripe technology in thousands of projects.
Project management consists of a kick off call, regular check-ins, email Q&A to help unblock your team.
Product workshops and training for fraud and dashboard



What you’ll do

The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for providing technical guidance to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe. They proactively address technical queries, troubleshoot issues, and provide solutions to ensure a seamless onboarding process. They work closely with users to understand their needs, offer guidance on best practices, and anticipate and address any potential technical challenges. The Onboarding Specialist collaborates with cross-functional teams, escalates issues as needed, and maintains accurate records of user interactions. Their goal is to provide exceptional customer service and ensure that users have a positive and successful onboarding experience with Stripe.

Responsibilities


Proactively providing technical guidance and support to users during their onboarding journey with Stripe.
Deliver pre-built technical workshops and kick off calls to users.
Provide light touch project management for ongoing Stripe implementations and timely escalate any delays with planned go-live dates.
Troubleshooting technical issues and providing timely solutions to ensure a smooth onboarding process.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to address user queries and concerns.
Maintaining accurate records of user interactions, issues, and resolutions.
Anticipating and addressing potential technical challenges during the onboarding process. Proactively propose improvements.
Offering guidance on best practices, product features, and account setup to ensure user success.
Continuously updating knowledge of Stripe's products, features, and updates.
Escalating complex technical issues to appropriate teams for resolution.
Providing exceptional customer service to ensure a positive onboarding experience for users.
Contributing to the improvement of onboarding processes and documentation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Advanced English proficiency- fluent in written and spoken.
2+ years of implementation consulting in API technologies or other complex technical environments.
Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
Strong technical understanding of APIs and experience with SaaS solutions.
Comfortable talking about technical concepts, and explaining how Stripe works, both from a product features and API architecture perspective.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with an ability to effectively engage and influence various stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience working with financial systems, online payments, or e-commerce platforms.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
Experience delivering live technical training to users.
Comfortable with various code-level debugging & writing of code.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

About the job

Paystand is the world's leading blockchain-enabled B2B payments network, transforming commercial finance into a software-driven, zero-fee, and open ecosystem. Recognized as a CNBC/Statista 2026 World's Top Fintech company, Paystand delivers over a decade of on-chain payments experience to middle and large enterprises.

Paystand's network services more than one million payors that have moved $20+ billion in volume. With its acquisitions of Yaydoo, Teampay and Bitwage, Paystand's full-stack platform includes agentic AI, its USDb stablecoin, and AR/AP solutions on one tightly integrated network. Its non-profit arm, Paystand.org, advances the mission to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain technology.

What We Do

We built the financial system we always thought should exist: zero fees, zero friction, just your money, faster. Blockchain automates receivables and payables, cuts time-to-cash, and turns every transaction into revenue instead of cost.

Why We Do It

The current system takes a cut from the people who build, create, and grow — and calls it the cost of doing business. We don't buy that. Every fee we eliminate compounds into growth. We're here to decentralize finance and hand the power back to the businesses driving the real economy — extended further through Paystand.org's work to democratize finance through Bitcoin and blockchain.

How We Do It

We don't wait for permission or for the industry to catch up — we build the future of finance ourselves, on-chain, in the open. Small moves now, monumental results later.

Join Us

We're not looking for people who want a job in fintech. We're looking for people who want to build what comes after it. Paystand is where you help lead a financial revolution instead of just reading about one. We stand on change. Come stand with us.

Role at a Glance

As an Account Executive, this role owns the full sales cycle for Paystand's CFO stack, engaging CFOs, VPs of Finance, Controllers, and Treasury leaders at mid-size and enterprise companies. The role is responsible for creating and closing high-quality revenue opportunities by diagnosing finance pain, quantifying ROI, positioning automation value, and navigating complex buying processes.

Audacious Ambition: We dream big and embrace discomfort. We assume risks, make on-time mistakes and learn how to methodically accomplish our goals.

description:
About the job

1.) Introduction

Job Title: Organic Investor & Brand Growth Specialist
Work Hours/Schedule: Part-Time to start (around 20 hours per week) with a clear path to full-time. Flexible schedule, no fixed shift required, with a couple of hours of daily overlap with EST for calls and check-ins
Location: Fully Remote (open to Latin America, South Africa, and the Philippines)
Structure: Project-based ramp up. You start with a defined project and clear outcomes, then take on more scope as you prove results




2.) Overview

If you can turn a founder's raw thinking into content that makes serious investors reach out, this seat was built for you.




This is a small, founder-led U.S. based real estate investment firm operating on a private equity model. They raise capital from experienced professionals, senior executives, and business owners who partner with them on deals, typically wiring somewhere between fifty thousand and two hundred fifty thousand dollars per investment. The business is lean, transparent, and allergic to corporate theater. The founder says exactly what he means, expects the same in return, and measures work by whether it moves the number.




Right now the founder is doing most of this himself. He is writing the content, running the podcast, doing the outreach, and nurturing the pipeline. This role exists to take that entire engine off his plate and then make it better. You will own organic content across LinkedIn, YouTube, and podcasts, build the lead magnets and follow up sequences that warm prospective investors, and track what is actually converting so you can do more of it. The end goal is simple and easy to measure: more qualified investor calls booked.




3.) Key Responsibilities

Create and manage organic content across LinkedIn, YouTube, podcasts, and other social channels
Transform raw founder ideas into engaging written and video content designed to attract prospective investors
Refine content hooks, messaging, and structure to increase audience trust and inbound interest
Build and manage simple organic lead funnels, including lead magnets, automated messaging, and follow up sequences
Nurture prospective investors and move them from initial interest toward qualified booked calls
Track performance data to identify high converting content, optimize outreach efforts, and drive booked calls
Repurpose top performing content across multiple platforms to maximize reach and audience consistency
Own and continuously improve the brand growth process, proactively identifying new ways to generate qualified investor calls and contribute directly to revenue




4.) Must-Have Requirements

Proven experience managing organic content strategy and brand growth across major social platforms
Demonstrated ability to translate complex concepts into clear, engaging written and video content
Experience building organic lead funnels and nurture sequences that move prospects toward booked calls
Strong messaging skills with an understanding of content positioning and audience engagement
Ability to evaluate content performance data and proactively adapt strategy based on results
Strong ownership mindset, able to design their own workload around a stated outcome rather than waiting for instructions
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Availability for part-time hours with a couple of hours of daily overlap with EST




5.) Nice-to-Have Requirements

Prior experience creating content tailored specifically to investor acquisition or finance audiences
Familiarity with video and podcast content editing workflows for multi-platform distribution
Track record of researching content trends and competitor strategies to unlock new growth opportunities
Comfort using AI tools to speed up repurposing and content production
Experience documenting processes and building SOPs others can follow




6.) Why Join Us

Most content roles bury you three layers below the person making decisions. This one puts you directly next to the founder, working on the single thing that grows the business. There is no committee, no brand deck to get approved, and no waiting two weeks for feedback. You bring an idea, you ship it, you see what it did.




The upside here is real. This is a lean team where every result is visible, which means the person who drives investor calls does not go unnoticed. The founder has been clear that he wants to grow this person, hand them more responsibility, and open up performance based upside for someone who genuinely moves the needle. You start with a defined project and a clear outcome, and the scope expands as fast as you can prove yourself. If you want a seat where your work is measured by results instead of hours logged, and where doing well actually changes your trajectory, this is it.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Fraud Operations Analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. As part of optimizing the online shopping experience, Sezzle constantly monitors users and transactions for abusive or fraudulent behavior. Our Fraud Operations team reviews suspicious activity flagged by Sezzle’s fraud detection system or escalated from Customer Support agents. Fraud Operations Analysts will block users deemed fraudulent or risky, and clear false positive flags from our automated systems and support agents. We monitor for new trends in fraudulent behavior and continuously evolve our policies and procedures to stay one step ahead. Monday to Friday, 3:00 PM to 11:30 PM - Central Time

Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills

Preferred Qualifications


Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus
Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus
Experience in using database query language (e.g. SQL, etc), and data processing and analytics tools such as Python / R / SAS is a plus
Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

About The Job

The YouTube Partner Program engages millions of content creators — a group that’s growing quickly, and will grow even faster in the coming years. The Scaled Partnerships team focuses on driving partner and product success at scale by acquiring, managing, and growing partners. The team spans acquisitions and partnerships to drive outcomes across all partner types and all verticals. The Partnerships team is responsible for managing creators and companies that have reached a certain threshold for strategic importance. Fast-paced, dynamic and proactive, our team goal is to responsibly grow creators and media companies at scale through enriching 1:1 and 1:many engagement, product activations, opportunities, and virtual and in-person workshops.

As a Strategic Partner Manager (SPM), you will manage a portfolio of YouTube creators identified as strategic to our business objectives. You will drive product adoption and optimization across YouTube’s platform priorities while also assessing creators’ needs and goals, crafting a plan to grow their channel, and delivering insights and strategy to enable their success on YouTube. You will deliver against partner performance metrics and core program Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to drive maximum impact.

In this role, you grow in a fast-paced environment, and you are building a working understanding of YouTube internal processes, products, and teams. You support your team in deepening relationships with key partners and creators, helping them optimize and adopt features, enabling YouTube to be successful. You are developing your skills in relationship-building, negotiation, project management, and collaboration, focusing on tasks that contribute to your team's and organization's goals.

Responsibilities


Establish scaled strategic relationships with partners through different engagement types.
Drive product adoption, optimization across YouTube priorities and support creators in their content, monetization and viewership goals.
Ensure your partner portfolio complies with YouTube’s Community Guidelines and M10N policies and support them in navigating YouTube’s support and operations teams.

description:
About the job

[Quora is a privately held, "remote-first" company. This position can be performed remotely from multiple countries around the world. Please visit careers.quora.com/eligible-countries for details regarding employment eligibility by country.]

About Quora

Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms:



Quora: a global knowledge sharing platform with over 300M monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others.
Poe: a platform providing millions of global users with one place to chat, explore and build with a wide variety of AI language models (bots), including GPT-5.6-Sol, Claude-Opus-5, Claude-Fable-5, Claude-Sonnet-5, Kimi-K3, and thousands of others. As AI capabilities rapidly advance, Poe provides a single platform to instantly integrate and utilize these new models.



Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world.

This role will be working on our Quora product.

About The Team And Role

The Data Team is highly empowered at Quora, helping navigate complexity and influencing product and company strategy directly. Quora's outsized commitment to data is visible in everything we do, from our sophisticated experimentation processes to the backgrounds of our leaders. With this emphasis on data and empirics, we aim to balance rigor and pragmatism, searching for scrappy solutions in pursuit of our mission. In joining Quora's strong data team, you'll both benefit from and help advance our culture of rational decision making.

As a member of our team, you'll work closely with product managers, product designers, engineers, and other cross-functional partners to devise appropriate measurements and metrics, design randomized controlled experiments, build visualizations, and tackle hard, open-ended problems that uncover usage patterns and opportunities across Quora. Quora has a wide range of rich data, giving you ample room for exploration and creativity.

Data scientists at Quora work across multiple domains, including user growth, content quality, monetization, personalization, marketplace dynamics, and long-term company strategy. Example projects include modeling long-term growth, improving the relevance and personalization of the homepage feed, analyzing drivers of user engagement and question-asking behavior, optimizing marketplace efficiency, and evaluating the effectiveness of monetization initiatives.

Responsibilities



Own well-scoped, impactful problem spaces across product and business domains — from framing the question, to conducting the analysis, to working with cross-functional partners to implement solutions
Design and evaluate experiments to measure the impact of product and strategic changes
Analyze data from across the product to uncover root causes of metric movements
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to inform product decisions with data
Contribute to tools, methodologies, and frameworks that help make the data team and the company as a whole smarter about data



Minimum Requirements



Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “coordination hours" (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time)
2+ years work experience in an analytical or quantitative role, including 1+ as a Data Scientist or similar title
Demonstrated ability to independently drive data analyses that inform product or business decisions
Proficiency with statistical techniques (e.g. regression, hypothesis testing, causal inference) and their practical application
Effective communication skills, including the ability to translate business needs into analytical questions and to explain technical results to cross-functional partners
Experience using a procedural programming language (e.g. Python, R) for data manipulation, modeling, and analysis; comfort working in a production codebase
Strong judgment that blends quantitative rigor with product intuition and common sense



Preferred Requirements



Experience evaluating experiments or recommender systems in offline analysis and online experiments
Experience with large data sets and distributed computing tools (e.g. Presto/Trino)
Active Quora user with curiosity about the product



At Quora, we value diversity and inclusivity and welcome individuals from all backgrounds, including marginalized or underrepresented groups in tech, to apply for our job openings. We encourage all candidates who share a passion for growing the world’s knowledge, even those who may not strictly meet all the preferred requirements, to apply, as we know that a diverse range of perspectives can have a significant impact on our products and our culture.

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

As a User Operations Intern, you will support the Growth Ops team in driving user growth and engagement. We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

Growth

De acuerdo con las necesidades de crecimiento del negocio, desarrollar recursos de telecomunicaciones y voz en otros países de Latinoamérica.

Contar con una red de contactos o recursos locales en México relacionados con operadores de telecomunicaciones, SIP Trunk, VoIP, Cloud Communications o proveedores de líneas de voz.

Conocer el mercado mexicano de Telecom y sus principales proveedores de servicios de comunicación, con capacidad para identificar y desarrollar proveedores de manera independiente.

Fuertes habilidades de negociación comercial y gestión de proveedores, con capacidad para gestionar de forma autónoma todo el proceso, desde la identificación de recursos hasta la negociación y puesta en marcha de la colaboración.

Sólidas habilidades de gestión y ejecución de proyectos, con capacidad para coordinar múltiples áreas, incluyendo Tecnología, Producto, Legal y Finanzas.




Español fluido e inglés suficiente para la comunicación comercial.




Conocimientos básicos de conceptos de telecomunicaciones como SIP, DID, SIP Trunk, VoIP, PSTN y API, y capacidad para comunicarse eficazmente con equipos técnicos.

Requisitos deseables

Experiencia previa en empresas de telecomunicaciones o Cloud Communications como Pentafon AI solutions, Nubacom, sisvox, OMIA/Averix, BITS, Inceptia, Tonali Coice AI entre otras




Experiencia en proyectos relacionados con AI Voice, AI Call Center, Contact Center, llamadas automatizadas o agentes/bots de voz.

Contar con clientes o contactos/proveedores en sectores como Fintech, pagos, banca, cobranza o Call Center.

Contar con recursos y proveedores de líneas para llamadas salientes a gran escala.

Contar con recursos locales en México de DID, SIP Trunk y Voice Termination.

Se valorará experiencia o recursos de Telecom en otros países de Latinoamérica.




Experiencia construyendo desde cero (0 a 1) una red de proveedores o una estructura de recursos/líneas de telecomunicaciones.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we're a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We're hiring a Web Conversion Tracking Specialist to own web conversion tracking operations for a leading on-demand delivery marketplace operating at national scale. This is a hands-on MarTech execution role: you'll implement, configure, QA and maintain tags, triggers and variables in Google Tag Manager across the company's web properties, validate conversion events across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, CM360 and SA360, and chase down the discrepancies between ad-platform data, internal reporting and CAPI implementations that quietly distort measurement. You'll run your own ticket queue end to end — clarifying requirements with stakeholders, building, QA'ing, documenting and following up — while auditing existing configurations for redundant or misconfigured tags and helping hold the line on tagging governance and privacy-compliant consent signals. The role is initially covering a leave, but the team needs this help long term and is approved to keep the position for someone who demonstrates they can take on the core work with autonomy.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

GTM Implementation: Implement, configure, QA and maintain web conversion tags, triggers and variables in Google Tag Manager across the client's web properties.
Cross-Platform Conversion Setup: Set up and validate conversion events across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, Campaign Manager 360 and Search Ads 360.
Troubleshooting & Discrepancy Investigation: Diagnose broken, misfiring, or over/under-reporting conversion signals and investigate gaps between ad-platform data, internal reporting and CAPI implementations.
Tracking Requests: Execute tagging requests for new campaigns, business verticals, funnels and ad placements, translating stakeholder requirements into accurate implementations.
Audits & Cleanup: Audit existing GTM configurations and cross-channel event mappings, identifying redundant, outdated or incorrectly configured tags and triggers.
Ticket Ownership: Own assigned MarTech tickets end to end — requirements clarification, implementation, QA, stakeholder follow-up and documentation of outcomes.
Tagging Governance: Review, approve and publish configurations created by internal stakeholders or agency partners, keeping governance standards intact.
Documentation & Compliance: Maintain accurate documentation of web/CAPI events, triggers, implementation details, QA results and root-cause resolutions, while ensuring applicable GDPR/CCPA consent signals are honored.




What You Bring

Google Tag Manager Depth: 2+ years hands-on with GTM — building and managing tags, triggers and variables, plus testing, QA and troubleshooting.
Paid Media Conversion Tracking: Experience configuring and validating conversion events across Google Ads and other major paid platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, CM360 and/or SA360.
Tracking Fundamentals: Strong grasp of pixels, event mapping, data layers, client-side tagging, and server-side/CAPI concepts.
Technical QA & Root-Cause Analysis: The ability to find the actual cause of a tracking discrepancy or misfiring event rather than patching the symptom.
Performance Marketing Context: Background in performance marketing, ad operations, marketing technology or a closely related environment, with the ability to run a request queue and complete well-defined implementations with limited oversight.
Documentation & Communication: Clear written documentation of implementations, QA findings and resolutions, plus the instinct to ask clarifying questions and surface blockers early.




Bonus Points if:

You've worked in Campaign Manager 360 and Search Ads 360, including Floodlight conversion tracking
You have experience with Segment or another CDP supporting web or advertising event flows
You're familiar with catalog-based advertising and its conversion/event requirements
You've handled consent management and privacy-compliant tagging under GDPR and CCPA
You've supported e-commerce, marketplace, or high-volume performance marketing environments
You understand cross-channel conversion architecture spanning browser-side pixels and server-side/CAPI integrations




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren't just joining a company; you're joining a movement to redefine how the world's best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything — and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You've applied, now let's get to work. Here's the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.
Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we'll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick.
Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You'll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you.
Step 4 Match Interview: You'll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we're matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine — it's the final step for many of our roles!




Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps:

Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We've got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you're 100% ready.
Step 6 Client Interview: You'll meet the client to discuss how you'll help them scale and succeed. Bring your metrics and be on your A-game — this is your last chance to make a great first impression!




Join our 100% remote global team today, and grow with GrowthAssistant!




GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

description:
About the job

Business Development & Sales Executive — Mexico

Department: Business Development / Sales

 Location: Mexico

 Work model: Remote

 Employment type: Full-time — Individual Contributor

 Reports directly to: Head of Marketing — Mexico




 Travel: Occasional travel to the United States may be required

About the Role

Trademarkia Mexico is looking for a results-driven Business Development & Sales Executive with a strong focus on customer acquisition and revenue generation.

This person will own the full commercial cycle, from the initial contact with Marketing-generated leads through qualification, follow-up, sales meetings, closing and payment.

In addition to managing inbound opportunities, the role will be responsible for generating new business through outbound prospecting, lead reactivation, referrals, partnerships and new acquisition channels.

We are looking for someone with a hunter + closer mindset who can build trust, understand customer needs, handle objections and consistently move opportunities toward a commercial decision.

The position will work directly with the Head of Marketing — Mexico and will have direct responsibility for contributing to Trademarkia Mexico's revenue growth.

Primary Objective

Turn commercial opportunities into customers and revenue through:

Disciplined lead management.
Consistent follow-up.
Consultative sales meetings.
Sales closing.
Outbound prospecting.
Lead reactivation.
Development of new acquisition channels.
Accurate pipeline management.

Success in this position will ultimately be measured by the ability to generate consistent and predictable revenue.

Key Responsibilities1. Lead Management

Own and manage leads generated through Trademarkia Mexico's Marketing initiatives.

Responsibilities include:

Contacting leads coming from digital campaigns, the website, social media, referrals and additional acquisition channels.
Following the response-time standards and follow-up cadences established in the Mexico Lead Management SOP.
Using WhatsApp Business, phone calls, email and video calls to communicate with prospects.
Personalizing communication according to each prospect's needs and context.
Properly qualifying each opportunity.
Understanding customer needs, urgency, purchase intent and ability to move forward.
Maintaining consistent follow-up until a commercial outcome is reached.
Recovering leads that stop responding.
Executing the established no-show recovery process.
Ensuring every active opportunity has a defined next step.
Accurately documenting calls, messages, meetings, objections and next actions in the CRM.

The expectation is simple: no commercially viable lead should be left without follow-up.

2. Sales Meetings

The executive will conduct approximately 30-minute consultative sales meetings with prospective customers.

During these conversations, the executive should:

Understand the prospect's situation and needs.
Identify key questions and objections.
Clearly explain Trademarkia, its services and the customer journey.
Communicate benefits and next steps in a simple and transparent way.
Build trust throughout the decision-making process.
Handle commercial objections related to pricing, timing, process and trust.
Identify buying signals.
Move the conversation toward a clear next action.
Ask for the sale when appropriate.
Provide payment instructions or links when the customer is ready.
Follow up immediately after the meeting.

Questions requiring specialized legal advice must be escalated to the appropriate legal team.

The executive must not guarantee legal outcomes or provide unauthorized legal advice.

3. Follow-Up & Closing

The position will be responsible for moving each qualified opportunity toward a final commercial decision.

Responsibilities include:

Following up after calls and meetings.
Addressing commercial questions.
Providing relevant information and materials.
Sharing payment links or payment instructions.
Identifying and removing barriers to purchase.
Handling objections.
Asking for the sale at the appropriate moment.
Reactivating stalled opportunities.
Maintaining a clearly defined next step for every opportunity.
Confirming payment before recognizing an opportunity as closed revenue.

The goal is not simply to have sales conversations. The goal is to convert opportunities into paying customers.

4. Outbound Prospecting & New Business Development

The role should not depend exclusively on Marketing-generated leads.

The executive will also:

Identify potential companies and prospects.
Build prospect lists.
Conduct outbound outreach.
Prospect through LinkedIn, email, calls, WhatsApp, networking and referrals.
Generate new sales conversations.
Develop strategic partnerships.
Identify associations, agencies, firms and communities that could generate opportunities.
Develop referral opportunities.
Identify new market segments.
Propose new customer acquisition channels.
Test commercial initiatives.
Measure the revenue generated through those initiatives.
5. Pipeline Management

The executive will own the accuracy and health of the sales pipeline.

Responsibilities include:

Keeping the CRM updated.
Correctly categorizing opportunities.
Recording estimated opportunity value.
Maintaining expected close dates.
Recording next actions.
Prioritizing high-intent opportunities.
Preventing opportunities from becoming stagnant.
Identifying pipeline risks.
Reporting progress and opportunities to the Head of Marketing — Mexico.
Analyzing lost opportunities.
Identifying reactivation opportunities.
6. Collaboration with Marketing

Because the position reports directly to the Head of Marketing — Mexico, Sales and Marketing will work closely together.

The executive will:

Provide feedback on lead quality.
Identify the campaigns producing the strongest opportunities.
Share common prospect questions and objections.
Identify the messages that produce better sales conversations.
Document loss reasons.
Identify promising customer segments.
Contribute insights for landing pages and commercial materials.
Identify reactivation opportunities.
Propose new acquisition initiatives.
Help improve the complete Marketing → Sales → Revenue funnel.
Performance Metrics

Although variable compensation will be based exclusively on revenue, operational performance will also be monitored through metrics such as:

Lead response time.
Contact rate.
Meetings booked.
Meeting show rate.
No-show recovery.
Lead-to-meeting conversion.
Meeting-to-sale conversion.
Close rate.
Pipeline generated.
Average sales cycle.
Outbound prospecting activity.
Self-generated opportunities.
Lead Management SOP compliance.
CRM accuracy.
Revenue generated.

These metrics help evaluate and optimize sales performance but do not directly determine the monthly performance bonus.

title: Creator Partnerships & Talent Manager
skills: Remote
Full-time
Location: Colombia or Mexico
Base Salary: $2,000–$2,500 USD/month ($24,000–$30,000 USD/year)
Commission: Performance-based and uncapped
Fluent English required (C1/C2 level)
Must be available to work significant overlap with U.S. business hours
Creator Recruitment & Representation: Identify, evaluate, recruit, and onboard creators with strong audience quality, content, engagement, professionalism, and commercial potential.
Brand Partnership Development: Identify and build relationships with brands seeking creator talent and proactively generate paid opportunities that connect the right creators with the right brands.

Outbound Business Development: Research relevant brands and decision-makers, conduct targeted outreach, pitch creators and partnership concepts, and consistently build a pipeline of potential brand deals.
Creator Positioning: Help creators strengthen their commercial positioning through media kits, rate cards, audience profiles, partnership packages, and other brand-facing materials.
Partnership Strategy: Identify brands, categories, campaigns, and opportunities that align with each creator's audience, niche, content, and goals.
Deal Negotiation: Negotiate rates, deliverables, timelines, usage rights, exclusivity, licensing, whitelisting, and other commercial terms.
Talent Management: Serve as the primary business contact for represented creators and help them navigate opportunities, negotiations, partnerships, and long-term monetization.
Partnership Management: Serve as the bridge between creators and brand partners, managing communication from initial introduction and negotiation through campaign execution, payment, and renewal.
Revenue Growth: Grow monthly brand-deal revenue across the creator portfolio and turn one-off sponsorships into recurring brand relationships.
Division Development: Help build the processes, systems, relationships, and infrastructure required to scale Nouvel Age Media's creator partnerships business.
Build the Creator Roster: Recruit a curated portfolio of creators with genuine commercial potential rather than focusing solely on follower count or roster size.
Build the Brand Network: Develop a growing network of brands and decision-makers actively investing in creators, influencers, sponsorships, and social partnerships.
Generate Partnership Pipeline: Consistently create new brand-deal opportunities through outbound prospecting, relationships, referrals, inbound opportunities, networking, and other channels.
Own Creator Monetization: Be accountable for generating brand partnership revenue across the creators you represent.
Prospect Strategically: Research brands and decision-makers that align with individual creators and develop relevant outreach that earns conversations.
Pitch Talent: Confidently communicate why a creator, audience, or campaign concept is relevant to a prospective brand and translate that fit into a commercial opportunity.
Match Creators & Brands: Understand both sides of the partnership well enough to identify opportunities that make strategic and commercial sense for the creator and brand.
Manage the Partnership Pipeline: Maintain visibility into prospects, conversations, pitches, proposals, negotiations, expected deal values, close dates, and partnership status.
Negotiate & Close: Own commercial conversations and negotiate partnership terms that protect creator value while maintaining healthy economics for Nouvel Age Media.
Manage Creator Relationships: Build strong, trusted relationships with represented creators and maintain clear communication around opportunities, expectations, timelines, and performance.
Manage Brand Relationships: Deliver a professional experience for brand partners before, during, and after each campaign.
Drive Repeat Business: Turn successful one-time partnerships into recurring campaigns, ambassador relationships, sponsorships, and longer-term brand deals.
Expand Existing Relationships: Identify opportunities to connect additional creators from our roster with existing brand partners.
Coordinate Partnership Execution: Ensure briefs, contracts, content deadlines, approvals, deliverables, usage requirements, and other partnership obligations stay organized and on schedule.
Support Collections: Coordinate with Nouvel Age Media's internal team to ensure partnerships are properly invoiced and payments are tracked.
Track Performance: Maintain accurate reporting around creator revenue, partnership pipeline, deal value, close rates, renewals, and creator monetization.
Build the Playbook: Establish repeatable systems for creator sourcing, onboarding, brand prospecting, pitching, negotiation, partnership management, renewals, and reporting.
Scale the Portfolio: Build the systems and relationships necessary to eventually manage 20+ active, revenue-generating creators.
3+ years of experience in creator partnerships, talent management, creator representation, sponsorship sales, influencer marketing, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience personally originating and closing paid creator, influencer, talent, or sponsorship partnerships.
Proven ability to generate business through outbound prospecting, relationship development, pitching, and negotiation.
Experience working directly with creators, talent, brands, and partnership decision-makers.
Experience securing paid creator partnerships with brands, particularly U.S.-based brands, strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of creator pricing, sponsorship structures, deliverables, usage rights, exclusivity, licensing, whitelisting, and partnership negotiations.

About the job

Creator Partnerships & Talent Manager




Summary

Remote
Full-time
Location: Colombia or Mexico
Base Salary: $2,000–$2,500 USD/month ($24,000–$30,000 USD/year)
Commission: Performance-based and uncapped
Fluent English required (C1/C2 level)
Must be available to work significant overlap with U.S. business hours







Overview

Can you spot a creator with commercial potential and then turn that potential into actual brand revenue? Nouvel Age Media is looking for a Creator Partnerships & Talent Manager to help us build and grow our creator representation and brand partnerships division from the ground up.




This is not a traditional influencer marketing role where you're handed a campaign brief and asked to find creators for a brand. You'll be responsible for building both sides of our creator partnerships network: talent and brands.




On the talent side, you'll identify and recruit creators with strong commercial potential, build relationships with them, understand their audiences and goals, and position them for relevant paid opportunities.




On the brand side, you'll identify companies that are actively investing in creator partnerships, build relationships with the right decision-makers, pitch our talent, and turn those conversations into paid brand deals.




Nouvel Age Media will sit at the center—connecting the right creators with the right brands while managing the commercial relationship, negotiations, communication, and partnership process.

That means we aren't looking for someone who only knows how to coordinate influencer campaigns.




We need someone commercially sharp who understands creator representation, can build relationships on both sides of the market, is comfortable prospecting and pitching brands, can negotiate confidently, and knows how to turn relationships into revenue.




You'll initially focus on building a curated roster of high-potential creators and generating consistent partnership opportunities for them, with the goal of eventually managing 20+ revenue-generating creators.







Here's What You'll Dive Into

Creator Recruitment & Representation: Identify, evaluate, recruit, and onboard creators with strong audience quality, content, engagement, professionalism, and commercial potential.
Brand Partnership Development: Identify and build relationships with brands seeking creator talent and proactively generate paid opportunities that connect the right creators with the right brands.
Outbound Business Development: Research relevant brands and decision-makers, conduct targeted outreach, pitch creators and partnership concepts, and consistently build a pipeline of potential brand deals.
Creator Positioning: Help creators strengthen their commercial positioning through media kits, rate cards, audience profiles, partnership packages, and other brand-facing materials.
Partnership Strategy: Identify brands, categories, campaigns, and opportunities that align with each creator's audience, niche, content, and goals.
Deal Negotiation: Negotiate rates, deliverables, timelines, usage rights, exclusivity, licensing, whitelisting, and other commercial terms.
Talent Management: Serve as the primary business contact for represented creators and help them navigate opportunities, negotiations, partnerships, and long-term monetization.
Partnership Management: Serve as the bridge between creators and brand partners, managing communication from initial introduction and negotiation through campaign execution, payment, and renewal.
Revenue Growth: Grow monthly brand-deal revenue across the creator portfolio and turn one-off sponsorships into recurring brand relationships.
Division Development: Help build the processes, systems, relationships, and infrastructure required to scale Nouvel Age Media's creator partnerships business.







Accountabilities

Build the Creator Roster: Recruit a curated portfolio of creators with genuine commercial potential rather than focusing solely on follower count or roster size.
Build the Brand Network: Develop a growing network of brands and decision-makers actively investing in creators, influencers, sponsorships, and social partnerships.
Generate Partnership Pipeline: Consistently create new brand-deal opportunities through outbound prospecting, relationships, referrals, inbound opportunities, networking, and other channels.
Own Creator Monetization: Be accountable for generating brand partnership revenue across the creators you represent.
Prospect Strategically: Research brands and decision-makers that align with individual creators and develop relevant outreach that earns conversations.
Pitch Talent: Confidently communicate why a creator, audience, or campaign concept is relevant to a prospective brand and translate that fit into a commercial opportunity.
Match Creators & Brands: Understand both sides of the partnership well enough to identify opportunities that make strategic and commercial sense for the creator and brand.
Manage the Partnership Pipeline: Maintain visibility into prospects, conversations, pitches, proposals, negotiations, expected deal values, close dates, and partnership status.
Negotiate & Close: Own commercial conversations and negotiate partnership terms that protect creator value while maintaining healthy economics for Nouvel Age Media.
Manage Creator Relationships: Build strong, trusted relationships with represented creators and maintain clear communication around opportunities, expectations, timelines, and performance.
Manage Brand Relationships: Deliver a professional experience for brand partners before, during, and after each campaign.
Drive Repeat Business: Turn successful one-time partnerships into recurring campaigns, ambassador relationships, sponsorships, and longer-term brand deals.
Expand Existing Relationships: Identify opportunities to connect additional creators from our roster with existing brand partners.
Coordinate Partnership Execution: Ensure briefs, contracts, content deadlines, approvals, deliverables, usage requirements, and other partnership obligations stay organized and on schedule.
Support Collections: Coordinate with Nouvel Age Media's internal team to ensure partnerships are properly invoiced and payments are tracked.
Track Performance: Maintain accurate reporting around creator revenue, partnership pipeline, deal value, close rates, renewals, and creator monetization.
Build the Playbook: Establish repeatable systems for creator sourcing, onboarding, brand prospecting, pitching, negotiation, partnership management, renewals, and reporting.
Scale the Portfolio: Build the systems and relationships necessary to eventually manage 20+ active, revenue-generating creators.







Requirements

3+ years of experience in creator partnerships, talent management, creator representation, sponsorship sales, influencer marketing, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience personally originating and closing paid creator, influencer, talent, or sponsorship partnerships.
Proven ability to generate business through outbound prospecting, relationship development, pitching, and negotiation.
Experience working directly with creators, talent, brands, and partnership decision-makers.
Experience securing paid creator partnerships with brands, particularly U.S.-based brands, strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of creator pricing, sponsorship structures, deliverables, usage rights, exclusivity, licensing, whitelisting, and partnership negotiations.
Ability to evaluate creators beyond follower count and identify audience quality, brand alignment, professionalism, and commercial potential.
Strong sales instincts and confidence initiating conversations with prospective brand partners.
Strong negotiation and closing skills.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Comfortable communicating, pitching, and negotiating directly with creators and brands, including U.S.-based partners.
Strong organization and follow-through across multiple creators, prospects, negotiations, and active partnerships.
Comfortable maintaining accurate pipeline and partnership information within a CRM or similar system.
Self-directed and comfortable working in a remote environment.
Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial role where you'll help build systems rather than simply follow an established creator-management playbook.
Comfortable working in a role where performance is measured against clear partnership and revenue expectations.







Nice-to-Haves

Experience representing creators and securing brand partnerships on their behalf.

title: Channel Sales Manager
description:
About the job

Impulsar el rendimiento del sell-through de EZVIZ en el mercado mexicano mediante el desarrollo y la gestión de cuentas clave de retail, la optimización de la ejecución en tienda y la aceleración de la rotación de inventario desde el punto de venta hasta el consumidor final, alcanzando al mismo tiempo los objetivos de sell-out, participación en anaquel (shelf share) y rentabilidad en todo el portafolio de productos de EZVIZ (CCTV, Smart Home, Smart Lock y dispositivos IoT relacionados).




Responsabilidades Clave:




• Desarrollar y gestionar relaciones de sell-through con cuentas clave de retail y los principales canales comerciales a nivel nacional.

• Ejecutar planes de sell-through en tienda, incluyendo la colocación de material POP/POS, estándares de exhibición en anaquel y activaciones promocionales para maximizar la visibilidad del producto.

• Monitorear datos de sell-out, niveles de stock y disponibilidad en anaquel con los socios comerciales; resolver proactivamente brechas, desabastos (stockouts) y producto de lenta rotación (dead stock).

• Construir y mantener relaciones sólidas con compradores de retail, gerentes de categoría y equipos de operaciones en tienda para asegurar apoyo promocional y espacio en anaquel.

• Impulsar campañas de sell-through en retail y promociones comerciales; realizar el seguimiento del ROI y reportar los resultados a la dirección.

• Coordinar con distribuidores y equipos de logística para garantizar el reabastecimiento oportuno de productos y un flujo constante de inventario hacia los socios comerciales.

• Elaborar pronósticos (forecasts) de sell-through, reportes de desempeño semanales/mensuales y planes de visitas al territorio.

• Apoyar en la capacitación de producto para el personal de retail y socios del canal con el fin de mejorar el conocimiento de la marca y del producto.

• Viajar extensamente por el territorio para visitar cuentas clave de retail y asegurar los estándares de ejecución en campo.

• Colaborar con los equipos de Marketing, Ventas en oficinas centrales (HQ) y distribuidores para alinearse en promociones, lanzamientos de productos y objetivos de sell-through.




Experiencia Requerida:

• Más de 3 años de experiencia en sell-through, trade marketing o gestión de canales de retail dentro de las industrias de CCTV, Smart Home, electrónica de consumo, redes o seguridad.

• Trayectoria comprobada en el impulso del desempeño de sell-out en cuentas clave de retail.

• Amplia experiencia en la gestión de las principales cadenas de retail y canales comerciales en México.

• Sólidas habilidades de negociación, gestión de cuentas y presentación.

• Competencia en el análisis y reporte de datos de sell-out (por ejemplo: tasas de sell-through, rotación de inventario, participación en anaquel).

• De preferencia, experiencia en la gestión de portafolios completos de productos.




Perfil Preferido:




• Residencia actual en México.

• Relaciones establecidas con las principales cadenas de retail que operan en México (por ejemplo: Home Depot, Costco, Liverpool, Soriana, OXXO, Elektra, Sanborns, Chedraui, etc.).

• Profundo conocimiento del panorama del retail mexicano, los canales comerciales y el comportamiento del consumidor.

• Familiaridad con las dinámicas del mercado regional en los diferentes estados de México.

• De preferencia, experiencia previa trabajando con fabricantes y marcas internacionales.




Competencias:




• Mentalidad comercial

• Excelencia en la ejecución de retail

• Toma de decisiones basada en datos

• Comunicación y gestión de partes interesadas (stakeholders)

• Planeación y priorización

• Orientación a resultados

• Trabajo en equipo y colaboración multifuncional




Disponibilidad para Viajar:




De 70 a 80% de viaje por todo México (cobertura nacional).




Criterios de Selección Importantes.




Se dará prioridad a los candidatos que ya estén establecidos en México, cuenten con una red activa en el sector de retail y tengan la capacidad de ejecutar de manera inmediata tras su incorporación.

2.) Overview

If you can turn a founder's raw thinking into content that makes serious investors reach out, this seat was built for you.




This is a small, founder-led U.S. based real estate investment firm operating on a private equity model. They raise capital from experienced professionals, senior executives, and business owners who partner with them on deals, typically wiring somewhere between fifty thousand and two hundred fifty thousand dollars per investment. The business is lean, transparent, and allergic to corporate theater. The founder says exactly what he means, expects the same in return, and measures work by whether it moves the number.




Right now the founder is doing most of this himself. He is writing the content, running the podcast, doing the outreach, and nurturing the pipeline. This role exists to take that entire engine off his plate and then make it better. You will own organic content across LinkedIn, YouTube, and podcasts, build the lead magnets and follow up sequences that warm prospective investors, and track what is actually converting so you can do more of it. The end goal is simple and easy to measure: more qualified investor calls booked.




3.) Key Responsibilities

Create and manage organic content across LinkedIn, YouTube, podcasts, and other social channels
Transform raw founder ideas into engaging written and video content designed to attract prospective investors
Refine content hooks, messaging, and structure to increase audience trust and inbound interest
Build and manage simple organic lead funnels, including lead magnets, automated messaging, and follow up sequences
Nurture prospective investors and move them from initial interest toward qualified booked calls
Track performance data to identify high converting content, optimize outreach efforts, and drive booked calls
Repurpose top performing content across multiple platforms to maximize reach and audience consistency
Own and continuously improve the brand growth process, proactively identifying new ways to generate qualified investor calls and contribute directly to revenue




4.) Must-Have Requirements

Proven experience managing organic content strategy and brand growth across major social platforms
Demonstrated ability to translate complex concepts into clear, engaging written and video content
Experience building organic lead funnels and nurture sequences that move prospects toward booked calls
Strong messaging skills with an understanding of content positioning and audience engagement
