Strong ownership mindset, able to design their own workload around a stated outcome rather than waiting for instructions

Track record of researching content trends and competitor strategies to unlock new growth opportunities
Comfort using AI tools to speed up repurposing and content production

6.) Why Join Us

Most content roles bury you three layers below the person making decisions. This one puts you directly next to the founder, working on the single thing that grows the business. There is no committee, no brand deck to get approved, and no waiting two weeks for feedback. You bring an idea, you ship it, you see what it did.




The upside here is real. This is a lean team where every result is visible, which means the person who drives investor calls does not go unnoticed. The founder has been clear that he wants to grow this person, hand them more responsibility, and open up performance based upside for someone who genuinely moves the needle. You start with a defined project and a clear outcome, and the scope expands as fast as you can prove yourself. If you want a seat where your work is measured by results instead of hours logged, and where doing well actually changes your trajectory, this is it.

About the job

About Us

At Pencil, we are building the AI Operating System for marketing - the only enterprise platform that aggregates every leading AI model, enforces enterprise-grade governance, and turns creative production savings into media growth. Our work moves brands like Diageo, L’Oréal and Unilever from creative brief to live, on-brand, performance-tested campaigns in minutes - across every market, channel and language - without sacrificing legal, IT or brand control.

Your mission

Bring the craft of advertising together with the speed of GenAI. You build and operate agentic and nodal creative workflows - connecting insight, concept, copy, imagery and video into scalable systems - so our creative teams and clients can move from idea to finished advertising faster, without losing quality or strategic grounding.

You work day-to-day under the direction of Art Directors and Creative Directors, bringing deep hands-on fluency in GenAI tools and workflows to their briefs. You're not setting creative vision - you're the person in the room who knows how to make the technology deliver on it.

This track is for people who go deep on the systems side - building, scaling, and governing the agents, workflows, and creative infrastructure that creative teams and clients rely on. Creative sensibility still matters (they need to understand what "good creative output" means to build for it), but the growth path is technical leadership and architecture, not creative direction.

Key Responsibilities

Discovery & Requirements


Meet with clients, creative teams, and stakeholders to understand workflows, challenges, and operational requirements
Facilitate workflow audits and capability assessments
Identify where GenAI, agents, or automation can meaningfully improve quality, efficiency, or scale
Translate operational challenges into technical implementation plans


Agent, Workflow & System Architecture


Design and build production-grade prompts, workflows, agents, and creative systems
Develop repeatable, scalable frameworks that support multiple brands, markets, and channels
Own workflow governance, quality control, and reliability of deployed systems
Establish technical standards and best practices for how agents and workflows are built and maintained


Enablement & Technical Adoption


Lead training, workshops, and office hours to help teams adopt new systems
Own technical documentation, playbooks, and guides for internal and client use
Support change management as new tools and workflows roll out
Act as the technical authority on GenAI capabilities, limitations, and constraints


Platform Evaluation & Technical Innovation


Evaluate emerging AI models, platforms, and tooling for technical fit and scalability
Stress-test new capabilities and provide structured, technical feedback to Product and Engineering
Identify architectural improvements to existing agents, workflows, and systems
Represent the technical roadmap for creative technology internally


What We’re Looking For


2-3 years’ experience in advertising creative development
Experience with GenAI tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Gemini etc.
Experience with GenAI techniques such as model selection & prompting
Any experience using GenAI to deliver real-world advertising creative
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud
Good personal communication and management skills

description:
About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT 

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity 

Join PepsiCo's North America Beverage Contract Operations team and play a key role in ensuring billing accuracy, financial integrity, and exceptional customer service across our beverage network. As a Supply Chain Operations Analyst, you will investigate and resolve post-shipment billing discrepancies, manage operational requests, and collaborate with multiple stakeholders to ensure accurate transactions, timely resolutions, and a seamless customer experience. This role offers a unique opportunity to develop expertise in supply chain operations, invoicing processes, SAP migration initiatives, and data-driven decision making while supporting one of PepsiCo's largest businesses.

Your Impact 


Investigate and resolve post-shipment billing discrepancies raised by bottlers and franchise partners, validating quantities, shipments, inventory records, and delivery information.
Ensure accurate processing of credits, debits, returns, and invoice adjustments while protecting PepsiCo's financial accuracy and compliance.
Manage requests received through the SPA mailbox, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving inquiries within established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Coordinate with Inventory, Finance, Customer Service, and Operations teams to gather information, resolve issues, and communicate updates to stakeholders.
Support Reverse Logistics activities, including product returns, documentation management, and coordination with distribution centers and inventory teams.
Process sample orders requested by Marketing and other business partners, ensuring accurate execution and timely delivery.
Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reporting accuracy, and customer experience.
Utilize Excel, Power BI, and business systems to analyze data, support reporting activities, and drive process improvements.
Contribute to ongoing business transformation initiatives, including report migrations and process enhancements as part of the SAP transition.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For? 


Advanced English required, both written and verbal.
6 months to 1 year of experience in Supply Chain Operations, Order Management, Billing, Inventory, or related operational environments.
Intermediate Excel skills, including formulas, filters, pivot tables, charts, conditional formatting, and data cleansing.
Working knowledge of Power BI, including reporting and dashboard analysis.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Logistics, or a related field.


If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements. 

What can you expect from us: 


Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs. 
Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning. 
Development programs according to Leadership skills. 
Specialized training according to the role. 
Learning experiences with internal and external providers. 
We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others. 
Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life. 
A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle. 
And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others.

description:
About the job

Eagle Property Capital (EPC) is a real estate investment firm specializing in the ownership, acquisition, management, and disposition of multifamily apartment properties across the Southern United States. The firm focuses on creating and enhancing value in Class B and C multifamily assets through repositioning, renovation, leasing strategies, and recapitalization. 

Role Description 

The Junior Investment Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in Mexico City. This role supports the investment team in underwriting new multifamily acquisition opportunities, preparing financial models, and conducting market and asset-level research for properties across EPC’s target markets. The analyst will assist in preparing investment memoranda and presentations, gathering and analyzing operating data, and supporting due diligence activities, including review of financial statements, rent rolls, and property inspections. Day-to-day responsibilities include monitoring portfolio performance, updating internal databases and reports, and coordinating with asset management and property management teams on business plan execution. The role also involves assisting in investor reporting, maintaining accurate documentation, and contributing to process improvements and analysis that support informed investment decisions.

Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong financial analysis and modeling skills, including proficiency in Excel and familiarity with real estate valuation concepts (DCF, IRR, NPV, sensitivity analysis).
Candidates should possess research and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret market data, demographic trends, and property-level operating metrics to support investment decisions.
Candidates should possess written and verbal communication skills to prepare clear investment memos, presentations, and reports for internal stakeholders and investors.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable planning decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate professionally during escalation situations.
Results-oriented with strong ownership mindset, urgency, and attention to detail.
Flexible worker, operates well working both independently and in a team environment.
Automotive OEM or Tier 1 customer experience (e.g., BMW, DTNA, Toyota, Ford, Harley-Davidson, BRP, Polaris).

Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.
Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles (kanban, PFEP, pull systems, standard work).
Experience with foreign supplier coordination, import logistics, or customs compliance basics.

About the job

Company Description

Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the change to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch!

Job Description

The Supply Chain Planner — Customer & Procurement manages material flow across the North American supply chain on behalf of Bosch customers, plant operations, and internal logistics. Depending on business needs and team structure, this role may be assigned to one or both of the following tracks: Passthrough (Customer) Planning or Procurement (Raw Material) Planning. Planners are expected to develop competency in both areas over time, enabling organizational flexibility as business requirements evolve.

Assignment Note: Individual planners will be designated to a primary track based on team structure and business need. This JD covers both tracks to support role mobility and cross-training across the planning organization.

Track A: Customer & Passthrough Planning

Procure finished goods from global Bosch supplying plants → Manage warehouse inbound → Fulfill OEM/Tier 1 customer demand

A1. Inbound Planning & Procurement from Bosch Supplying Plants


Generate and manage purchase orders and delivery schedules to global Bosch supplying plants based on customer demand and inventory targets.
Maintain 24+ months of rolling demand visibility in SAP and/or Kinaxis Maestro to support long-range capacity planning at supplying plants.
Coordinate with supplying plants on allocation priorities, capacity constraints, shortages, engineering changes, and EOP transitions.
Monitor inbound order confirmations and proactively escalate mismatches between confirmed and required quantities.
Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.


A2. Warehouse Coordination (Summerville, SC & Laredo, TX)


Coordinate inbound receipts, inventory positioning, and stock availability across North American warehouse locations.
Monitor and resolve blocked stock, MRP exceptions, and inventory discrepancies with warehouse operations teams.
Manage goods-in-transit (GIT) visibility and ensure timely clearance of open inbound deliveries.
Support warehouse operations through accurate ASN transmission, delivery scheduling, and outbound shipment prioritization.
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory in partnership with warehouse teams; develop disposition strategies.


A3. Customer Management & Order Fulfillment


Manage customer-facing planning for OEM and Tier 1 accounts across automotive, powersports, and commercial vehicle segments.
Process and validate customer EDI releases; ensure accurate system intake and timely order fulfillment.
Transmit and validate Advance Shipping Notifications (ASNs) through customer portals per customer-specific requirements.
Schedule outbound shipments and monitor deliveries through final customer destination.
Proactively communicate supply risks to customers with recovery timelines and viable alternatives.
Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.


Track B: Procurement & Raw Material Planning

Translate production demand into supplier orders → Ensure uninterrupted material supply → Protect manufacturing continuity

B1. MRP-Driven Procurement Planning


Execute and manage MRP runs in SAP to generate planned orders and purchase requisitions based on production demand.
Convert MRP requirements into purchase orders or scheduling agreements aligned with supplier lead times and production schedules.
Maintain planning master data: MRP type, lot sizes, lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MRP controller assignments.
Monitor and action MRP exception messages (expedite, defer, cancel) to keep supply plans aligned with evolving demand.
Maintain data governance standards in SAP for assigned material portfolio, including parameter integrity and proper controller assignment.


B2. Supplier Coordination & Order Management


Manage purchase orders and scheduling agreements with external suppliers, ensuring on-time delivery to plant locations.
Communicate demand requirements, changes, and escalations to suppliers in a clear and timely manner.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively address shortages, late deliveries, and quality holds.
Coordinate with Purchasing and Supplier Quality on corrective actions, capacity constraints, and alternate source qualification.
Support new supplier onboarding and system configuration in ERP.


B3. Production Supply & Shortage Management


Monitor stock levels at point-of-use and receiving locations to ensure uninterrupted production supply.
Manage critical shortage situations with structured recovery plans communicated to plant operations and management.
Participate in shortage review meetings with structured updates on open issues and resolution timelines.
Coordinate expedited shipments when necessary; ensure premium freight is justified, approved, and documented.
Track goods-in-transit and ensure timely customs clearance for imported materials.


Applies to Both Tracks

Inventory Management & Optimization


Maintain inventory levels (DIO) in alignment with working capital and service level objectives.
Perform ABC/XYZ material classification and define inventory strategies based on criticality, demand volatility, and margin.
Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; recommend and execute disposition strategies.
Support safety stock reviews and planning parameter optimization on a defined cadence.
Manage inventory risk through product lifecycle transitions: new launches, engineering changes, and end-of-production.


Performance Monitoring & Reporting

Analyze forecast vs. actual deviations to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Prepare structured input for weekly shortage reviews, monthly business reviews (MBR), and customer/plant scorecards.
Develop root cause analysis and corrective action documentation for supply disruptions and service failures.
Use SAP, Kinaxis Maestro, and Power BI to maintain real-time planning and performance visibility.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Quality, and Purchasing to align supply plans with business priorities.
Manage premium freight requests through the iStar approval process; ensure spend is justified, documented, and minimized.
Contribute demand and supply input to the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.
Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities across planning processes, system usage, and cross-functional workflows.


Qualifications

Required - All Planners


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in supply chain planning, materials management, or procurement within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Hands-on SAP ERP experience at the transaction level (planning, purchasing, or inventory management context).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and planning scenario modeling (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, etc.).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable planning decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate professionally during escalation situations.
Results-oriented with strong ownership mindset, urgency, and attention to detail.
Flexible worker, operates well working both independently and in a team environment.


Preferred - Track A (Passthrough / Customer Planning)


Automotive OEM or Tier 1 customer experience (e.g., BMW, DTNA, Toyota, Ford, Harley-Davidson, BRP, Polaris).
Experience managing EDI releases, ASN transmission, and customer portal compliance.
Familiarity with managing internal plant-to-plant supplier relationships within a global manufacturing organization.
Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.


Preferred - Track B (Procurement / Raw Material Planning)


Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles (kanban, PFEP, pull systems, standard work).
Experience with foreign supplier coordination, import logistics, or customs compliance basics.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Sales Process Coordinator to support our sales operations team in executing repetitive and high-volume sales processes with accuracy and speed. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who thrives in structured environments and is eager to learn about sales operations in a high-growth tech company. You’ll be responsible for ensuring accuracy in data entry, validation of basic contract requirements, and supporting internal teams with operational requests.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:



You’re reliable, detail-oriented, and value consistency and accuracy. 
You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You’re excited to build a career in operations and want to learn how a fast-growing company runs. 
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You enjoy solving problems and following clear processes. 
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best. 
You thrive in a team environment and take pride in helping others succeed.



In this role, you will:



Perform data entry and validation tasks for sales requests and documentation.
Support ticket intake, triage, and process routing.
Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure required documentation is complete.
Ensure contract and system data is updated correctly in Salesforce and related tools.
Maintain accurate records for audit and compliance purposes.
Escalate process exceptions or errors as needed.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team).



Minimum requirements for the role:



Less than 1 year of experience in a support, operations, or administrative role.
High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
Effective communication skills in both English and Spanish.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, repetitive task environment.
Basic experience using tools like Google Sheets or Excel.
Interest in learning Salesforce or other CRM systems.



An ideal candidate also has:



Experience working with cross-functional teams or in a remote setting.
Prior experience with ticketing tools such as Zendesk.



Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

About the job

Certu Systems builds an end-to-end supply chain solution, augmented throughout with AI that is in production and load-bearing — not a lab project. One of our deployments processes 2.17M+ orders a year and has documented $22M+ in annual savings. Behind it is a team of world-class engineers, data scientists, and business domain experts, founded by Dr. Kim out of Carnegie Mellon.




We are hiring one exceptional person to sit at the centre of everything we do for customers, from the first discovery call to the thousandth day of live operations. This is a wide-brief, high-ownership role with no fixed edges.




We hire for raw ability, work ethic, and judgement — not pedigree. No specific degree, supply chain background, or minimum years of work experience required. Recent graduates are genuinely welcome, and we pay top of market for the right person regardless of tenure. What we do require is listed below.




What you'll do




Discovery. Sit with dispatchers, warehouse managers, transport planners, and C-suite. Understand how their business really runs, and translate it into requirements engineers can build against.
Pilot. Scope, configure, and run pilots end to end — and be honest with both the customer and us about what the results actually show.
Rollout. Own go-lives: data migration, integrations, configuration, training, cutover, and the unglamorous work of getting a sceptical night shift to trust a new system.
Daily operations. Stay with your accounts after launch. Triage issues, work incidents, chase root causes with engineering, and be the customer's trusted point of contact for as long as they're live.
Continuous improvement. You'll be closer to real usage than anyone in the company. Turn that into evidence engineering and leadership can act on — what's working, what's breaking, what needs to change — and drive the fixes through.




Who we're looking for




Exceptional reasoning ability — you can structure a messy, ambiguous problem without being handed a framework
Extreme ownership — when something is broken and it's nobody's job, it becomes yours
Communication that holds under pressure, from engineers to customers and executives
Technical fluency: comfortable with data, and systems thinking
Resilience and pace — live incidents, real deadlines, occasional travel to customer sites
Intellectual honesty — to raise your hand when you don't understand, and to obsessively devote time and energy to learning until you do
Professional Spanish and English




What we offer




Top-tier compensation, benchmarked to the best in the market and set by capability rather than seniority. Direct exposure to the executive team and every major customer from week one. Real scope to define a function and grow into leading it.




This role is demanding — broad remit, fast pace, and intense periods around go-lives. This may very well be the most difficult but rewarding challenge that you'll take up in your life.




Apply




Send a CV.
Send one page on a hard problem you owned end to end, and what you did when it went wrong.




We read every one.




Certu Systems is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate every applicant on ability and potential alone.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The global ABP Team acts as a critical platform that enables and improves efficiencies and effectiveness across Stripe by providing high-value, high-impact administrative support to leadership. The global ABP Team is a recognized and valued team that is integral to how Stripe operates. A crucial part of the global ABP Team is our Administrative Coordinator team—a centralized group of highly motivated and skilled individuals who offer core administrative support to Stripe leaders.

What you’ll do

As the Administrative Coordinator program and team grow, you'll find ways to successfully build processes and systems for scale, manage hiring practices that maintain the Stripe talent bar, and manage individual contributors across multiple regions. Additionally, you'll build relationships with key stakeholders and leaders across the organization that enable and support the work of the Administrative Coordinators and the larger global ABP Team. You'll report to and partner closely with the ABP Program Manager and support operational efforts, programming, and processes for the global ABP Program, including operating cadence, rhythm of business, and documentation.

Responsibilities


Manage and lead a team of Administrative Coordinators
Maintain an understanding of team workload and bandwidth
Develop and maintain adherence to the scope of the program and ensure individuals are set up for success
Maintain an understanding of team and individual performance and quality of support
Develop and maintain program documentation and guidelines
Provide regular and frequent feedback and coaching to individual team members
Address program escalations, feedback, and concerns
Develop strong executive, peer, and stakeholder relationships, maintaining effective communication channels and influencing without authority
Manage the headcount and capacity planning process in partnership with the ABP Program Manager
Manage the onboarding and training (and associated logistics) for new Administrative Coordinators
Serve as an expert on Stripe- and ABP-related policies and guidelines (e.g., travel and expenses) and enforce with the team—provide guidance and expectations around administrative best practices, tools, and processes
Identify and solve large-scale, ambiguous, and complex problems with company- and org-wide impact and drive org-wide strategic improvements
Drive key changes to programs to achieve future-state objectives, including processes, documentation, measurement, etc.
Draft and distribute comms across the ABP Team and to key stakeholders
Ideate and implement process improvements for the global ABP Program
Drive efficiency through simplification, automation, and continuous improvement of systems, processes, and ways of working
Contribute to strategic planning and roadmapping for the global ABP Program
Support existing tools, processes, templates, playbooks, and knowledge management efforts
Exhibit excellent judgment on sensitive and cross-functional issues, building collaboration between leaders, sub-teams, and the larger organization



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Experience managing stakeholders and influencing critical client relationships
Experience in headcount planning and hiring practices
Experience in project and program management
Experience as an Administrative or Executive Assistant or deep knowledge of the administrative support role



Preferred Qualifications


Experience managing or leading individuals or a small team
Experience in managing global programs
Experience mentoring, growing, and developing individual contributors
Experience managing bandwidth and balancing workloads of multiple individuals



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Job Description

Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern

About Sezzle

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on.

As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made.

What You'll Do

Answer questions with data


 Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
 Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
 Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks.
 Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them


Design and measure experiments


 Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches
 Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
 Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process


Bridge marketing and engineering


 Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on
 Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
 QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them
 Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them


Automate and improve how we work


 Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it
 Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use
 Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them


What We Look For

Skills & Competencies


 Basic working knowledge of SQL.
 Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code.
 More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
 You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
 Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
 A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


 Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field
 Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus
 Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus
 Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus
 Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


About You


 You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
 You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
 You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
 You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
 You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
 You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.


What Makes Working At Sezzle Awesome

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Our Marketing Growth team runs the consumer programs that reach millions of shoppers — subscriptions, giveaways, surveys, and lifecycle campaigns across email, push, in-app, and landing pages. This role sits where marketing meets data, engineering and product. You'll write the queries that tell us whether a program actually worked, design the tests that answer questions we'd otherwise be guessing at, and translate between the marketing team and the engineers who build the surfaces we run on.

As a Marketing Growth Analytics & Operations Intern, you will play a critical role in measuring and improving the programs that drive our consumer business. A core focus will be writing the queries and building the reporting that tell us whether a program worked, and designing the tests that answer the questions we would otherwise be guessing at. In addition to analysis, you will work closely with Product and Engineering to translate marketing needs into clear requirements and to identify what we would need built to make new programs possible. This role is well suited to someone with a technical background who is drawn to the business and product side of the work, and who wants exposure to how marketing decisions actually get made.

What You'll Do:

Answer questions with data


Write your own SQL to pull campaign, cohort, and subscription performance.
Track the metrics that drive the business: DAU, NTM, LTV, CAC
Compare performance across time periods and segments, and flag the shifts that matter before anyone asks.
Take ownership of the dashboards behind our decisions, and use AI to find the answers hiding in them


Design and measure experiments


Help design A/B tests across channels — audience splits, variants, and success metrics defined before anything launches
Write the post-test analysis: what worked, what didn't, what we do differently next time
Own consumer surveys from request to results: define and query the audience, launch, monitor completion, report back what we learned, and optimize the process


Bridge marketing and engineering


Turn marketing needs into specs and tickets an engineer can act on 
Investigate when something breaks — trace an issue through dashboards and logs back to its source
QA new product features and surfaces, and help decide how marketing should be using them
Spot underused channels and product surfaces, and propose how marketing could leverage them


Automate And Improve How We Work


Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to build leverage into your own work — recurring reports, first-pass analyses, triage. If a task comes back every week, we'd rather you automate it
Build automations and templates the rest of the team can use
Own recurring operational queues and look for the pattern behind repeat problems instead of just clearing them


What We Look For:

Skills & Competencies


Basic working knowledge of SQL.
Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, or HTML/CSS, and enough comfort reading code. 
More interested in the business and product side than in engineering for its own sake. You want to know why the number moved, not only how the system works
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
You get the most out of AI. Claude, ChatGPT, or similar are already part of how you work — research, summaries, first-pass analyses — and you're constantly exploring what else they can handle
Comfort working in agile, matrixed teams with multiple inputs and quick turnarounds
A strong bias for action


Educational & Professional Experience


Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in engineering, computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related technical field
Exposure to BI tools (Redash/SIA, Looker, Tableau, or similar) is a plus
Prior experience with a CRM platform like Braze is a plus
Any experience with product management, experiment design, or A/B testing is a plus
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.

If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

About the job

About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

Community Associate | Community

About The Opportunity

As a Community Associate, you'll be the primary point of contact for the Community and act as the “face” of WeWork! You will report to your building each day to support the Community Management team.

Duties

Your work, which will include but not be limited to the duties listed below, will help WeWork to achieve the following:


Build a welcoming and collaborative community environment amongst our members through events and building relationships between members!
Ensure that your building is fully operational and processes are running efficiently.
Drive growth and promotion of WeWork-provided service offerings.
Take direction from the Community Lead and the Community Manager to support the Community Team as necessary.
All of this while illustrating WeWork’s core values and working towards achieving our mission.


Depending on the location you are assigned, you’ll either work with a variety of members from different backgrounds and industries, or focus your efforts on one of our Enterprise clients. Employees supporting our Enterprise locations may have different holidays, technical systems, operational and relationship requirements, and property management responsibilities than employees in our Classic locations.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for the following areas: 

Front Desk Management


Cover the front desk during the building’s set business hours and be an on-site point of contact, easily located on the member floor or at Community Bar.
Greet members and guests with a warm and welcoming demeanor.
Ensure all visiting guests are in accordance with WeWork's guest policy by ensuring all guests properly sign-in via Welkio tablet.
Learn the names of members and guests with the goal of building relationships in order to facilitate the sense of Community WeWork is known for.
Anticipate member and guest needs before they arise using relevant information collected about members to enhance and personalize their experience.
Ensure building Specific forms are up to date including pet forms, filming requests, bike room requests, etc.
Keep the front desk clean and organized.
Notify members of any food deliveries and couriers.
Answer any questions from members and guests related to the building including way-finding, policies and procedures, community etiquette, etc.


Events And Membership Engagement


Provide feedback on programming types (based on member makeup) and evaluate events based on attendance, satisfaction, and impact on the appropriate event team.
Consistently celebrate members’ successes and milestones through gifts and notes.
Distribute all necessary info to promote the event including creation and posting of weekly events poster and individual event posters.
Ensure building-specific operational requirements are met for each event (elevators, HVAC, etc).
Input notes into Kube or equivalent system about Members.
Identify and execute opportunities to connect members with each other.
Know and recommend local restaurants, food delivery services, catering options, team outing venues, post office, shipping center, supply store, etc.
Be active on the WeWork member network to engage members.
Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures and communicate, inform, and update members on building issues.
Ensure music levels and activations are appropriate to the daypart and occasion.
Write and send broadcasts relating to building updates.


Building Operations And Management


Receive, process, sort, and organize all mail.
Locate and issue posts via the regional system to members upon request.
Keep the mailroom organized and clean.
“Return to Sender" for unidentified mail and former member mail after 30 days of no-pick up.

Investigate, escalate, and resolve 'lost' packages.
Know and explain WeWork policies and procedures around mail and mailroom.
Track, audit, and organize keys collected and distributed.
Manage keycard stock and request new inventory as needed.
Collect keys and key cards upon move-out.
Review location and how to use each piece of Emergency Equipment.
Provide support for an automated coffee machine for guests and members.


About You

Bachelors Degree in Tourism, Hospitality or related
Proficient in English
1+ years of hospitality experience
Customer service and/or sales experience a plus
Must have strong verbal and written communication skills
Outstanding interpersonal and multitasking skills
Demonstrate integrity, dependability, responsibility, accountability, self-awareness, work ethic, and compassion
Passion for entrepreneurial communities
Passion and understanding of WeWork’s mission and values
Proficient in basic computer skills


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. description:
About the job

Somos Reckitt

Hogar de las marcas más queridas y confiables de higiene, salud y nutrición. Nuestro propósito define nuestra razón de existir: proteger, curar y nutrir en una búsqueda implacable por un mundo limpio y sano. Somos un equipo global unido por este propósito. Únete a nuestra lucha para lograr que el acceso a higene de calidad, bienestar y nutrición sea un derecho y no un privilegio.

Marketing

Marketing está en el corazón de Reckitt. Nos enorgullece nuestra forma única de impulsar el crecimiento de algunas de las marcas de salud, higiene y nutrición más queridas y confiables del mundo.

Nuestro propósito y espíritu de lucha son lo que nos motivan a diseñar y ofrecer comunicaciones diferenciadas a lo largo de todo el recorrido del consumidor, permitiéndonos generar crecimiento en nuestras categorías y, al mismo tiempo, un impacto positivo en la sociedad.

Con amplios equipos de medios y marketing digital integrados en toda la organización, medimos tanto nuestro impacto en el negocio como nuestro impacto social. Nuestros equipos globales lideran la estrategia general de marca, la gestión y protección de las marcas, así como la cartera de innovación, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con el área de Investigación y Desarrollo (I+D).

Esto permite que nuestros equipos locales de marketing se enfoquen en alcanzar los objetivos regionales en conjunto con los equipos de Ventas. Gracias a la escala de nuestra comunidad global de más de 2,500 profesionales de marketing, y al respaldo de nuestra innovadora Marketing Academy, tendrás amplias oportunidades para desarrollarte profesionalmente, adquirir nuevas habilidades y avanzar en tu carrera.

Sobre el puesto

La principal responsabilidad del Especialista de Marketing Médico es apoyar al área de Profesional Marketing y al equipo de Ventas Médicas mediante la propuesta, coordinación e implementación de los programas de Educación Médica Continua (CME, por sus siglas en inglés: Eventos médicos, round tables, lectura tours, participación en congresos, reuniones AdHoc con médicos, farmacias, clientes, garantizando una implementación impecable, el cumplimiento regulatorio y el logro de los objetivos comerciales.

Tus responsabilidades


Implementar actividades de Educación Médica Continua (CME), coordinando de manera efectiva a todas las áreas de profesional marketing, marketing, procurement, medical affairs, regulatorio, stakeholders externos.
Gestionar integralmente los procesos administrativos de compra para cada proyecto, incluyendo elaboración de briefs, procesos de licitación, presentación de propuestas, contratos, órdenes de compra, documentación de cumplimiento y cierre administrativo de eventos.
Administrar el presupuesto coordinando cierres mensuales, proyecciones financieras y seguimiento semanal para garantizar una ejecución alineada al plan.

About the job

Type: Full Time | Remote

Base Salary: $30,000 – $32,000 yearly USD (DOE)




Before You Apply

We review every application closely. If you don’t meet all three of the following, please don’t apply:

3+ years of digital marketing experience in a client-facing role (agency preferred).
Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and leading client communication.
Strong organization, project management, and time management skills.
Fluent English proficiency, both written and verbal




Who We Are

LionHead Digital is a boutique agency exclusively serving criminal defense, personal injury, and family law firms across the U.S.

We don’t do vanity metrics — we deliver verified lead reporting, measurable results, and the kind of transparency that keeps clients for years. Nine years in, we’re building the most advanced law firm marketing system in the country.




The Role

As a Client Success Manager, you’ll be the primary point of contact between our internal team and our clients.

You’ll own client relationships end-to-end, managing communication, timelines, deliverables, and performance. This role requires someone who can balance client success, project management, and marketing insight while ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

You’re a confident communicator who can lead client conversations and build trust

Proactively manage expectations around timelines, deliverables, and performance.

Client Retention & Relationship Management

Maintain a 98% client retention rate YOY
Build strong, long-term client relationships
Gather feedback and identify opportunities to improve processes and experience

Reporting & Analysis

Run and review monthly reports (SEO, PPC, ROI)
Present data-driven insights (cost per lead, channel performance, etc.)
Share key highlights, wins, and opportunities with clients

Project Management

Manage tasks and workflows in ClickUp
Assign and track deliverables across internal teams
Ensure projects stay on track and meet deadlines

Collaboration

Partner with SEO, Dev, Design, and leadership teams
Align on strategy and execution
Coordinate deliverables and feedback across stakeholders

Onboarding & Offboarding

Lead onboarding for new clients, including kickoff calls and setup.
Ensure proper access to tools (Google Analytics, GSC, etc.).
Manage offboarding, including communication and feedback.







How We Measure Success

Client retention rate (target: 98%+).
Client satisfaction and relationship strength.
On-time delivery of projects and campaigns.
Clear, proactive communication.
Quality and accuracy of reporting.
Ability to manage multiple accounts effectively.







Who You Are

Required Experience

3+ years in digital marketing (client-facing role preferred)
Experience managing multiple client accounts
Basic understanding of SEO and digital marketing metrics

Fluent English — written and spoken




Skills & Traits

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Excellent organization and project management abilities.
Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively.
Calm, solutions-oriented problem solver.
High attention to detail and accountability.
Ability to work independently and lead initiatives.
Experience creating SOPs or improving processes.
Leadership mindset and team collaboration skills.







How We Work

Our core values aren't posters on a wall — they guide every decision we make.

Never Settle — We chase mastery, not perfection. Always hungry, always improving.
We Give a Damn — We show up, care deeply, and own outcomes for clients and teammates.
Courageous Communication — Truth early, respect always. We don't hide problems or avoid tough conversations.
Obsessed with Outcomes — Client results are our only scoreboard. When they grow, we grow.




Why Join LionHead Digital?




We’re building the most advanced law firm marketing system in the country. At LionHead Digital, you’ll own the fulfillment engine that drives client success and long-term growth. If you’re ready to lead teams, build scalable processes, and make client retention your mission, this role is for you.




👉 Apply today to join a results-driven agency where your leadership directly impacts our clients and our future.

title: Analista, Atencion a Cliente
description:
About the job

Empresa:

eHubs es una empresa especializada en desarrollar y operar una red de inmuebles de hiper proximidad, permitiendo que las marcas se acerquen físicamente a sus clientes.

Rol:

Gestionar y desarrollar las cuentas clave de la compañía, trabajando de manera coordinada con el equipo directivo para consolidar y fortalecer las relaciones comerciales con los clientes. Será el principal punto de contacto en el día a día, responsable de dar seguimiento a las cuentas existentes y a las oportunidades en pipeline, asegurando el cierre de nuevos negocios, la renovación de contratos y el crecimiento de las cuentas mediante una atención cercana, estratégica y orientada a resultados.

Principales Funciones:

1. Gestión de oportunidades

Dar seguimiento a las oportunidades comerciales hasta su cierre, incluyendo propuestas, visitas a sitio, negociaciones y formalización de contratos.

Elaborar propuestas comerciales y cotizaciones alineadas a los objetivos.

Coordinar el proceso de cierre con clientes y áreas internas involucradas.

2. Renovación y desarrollo de cuentas

Gestionar oportunamente las renovaciones de contratos.

Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento mediante nuevos espacios, ubicaciones o servicios.

Fortalecer la relación con los clientes para impulsar su fidelización y generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

3. Coordinación y atención al cliente

Ser el enlace principal entre el cliente y las áreas internas para asegurar una atención oportuna.

Coordinar con Operaciones, Legal, Finanzas, Mantenimiento y proveedores la correcta ejecución de los compromisos adquiridos.

4. Administración y seguimiento comercial

Mantener actualizado el CRM y dar seguimiento a las distintas etapas de cada oportunidad.

Supervisar el avance de contratos, órdenes de compra, facturación y cobranza en coordinación con las áreas correspondientes.

5. Reportes y control de resultados

Presentar el estatus de las cuentas y del pipeline comercial.

Elaborar reportes e indicadores de desempeño para la Dirección y seguimiento de KPIs.

Requisitos:

- Licenciatura concluida

- 1+ años trabajando en servicio a cliente B2B.

- (Deseable) Experiencia en Real Estate Comercial (retail, industrial o logístico) y/o en arrendamientos comerciales y negociación de contratos.

Otros:

- Manejo de CRM, Excel y elaboración de propuestas y presentaciones comerciales.

- Disponibilidad para realizar visitas y recorridos con clientes en la Ciudad de México y su área metropolitana (auto propio idealmente).

About the job

Certu Systems builds an end-to-end supply chain solution, augmented throughout with AI that is in production and load-bearing — not a lab project. One of our deployments processes 2.17M+ orders a year and has documented $22M+ in annual savings. Behind it is a team of world-class engineers, data scientists, and business domain experts, founded by Dr. Kim out of Carnegie Mellon.




We are hiring one exceptional person to sit at the centre of everything we do for customers, from the first discovery call to the thousandth day of live operations. This is a wide-brief, high-ownership role with no fixed edges.




We hire for raw ability, work ethic, and judgement — not pedigree. No specific degree, supply chain background, or minimum years of work experience required. Recent graduates are genuinely welcome, and we pay top of market for the right person regardless of tenure. What we do require is listed below.




What you'll do




Discovery. Sit with dispatchers, warehouse managers, transport planners, and C-suite. Understand how their business really runs, and translate it into requirements engineers can build against.
Pilot. Scope, configure, and run pilots end to end — and be honest with both the customer and us about what the results actually show.
Rollout. Own go-lives: data migration, integrations, configuration, training, cutover, and the unglamorous work of getting a sceptical night shift to trust a new system.
Daily operations. Stay with your accounts after launch. Triage issues, work incidents, chase root causes with engineering, and be the customer's trusted point of contact for as long as they're live.
Continuous improvement. You'll be closer to real usage than anyone in the company. Turn that into evidence engineering and leadership can act on — what's working, what's breaking, what needs to change — and drive the fixes through.




Who we're looking for




Exceptional reasoning ability — you can structure a messy, ambiguous problem without being handed a framework
Extreme ownership — when something is broken and it's nobody's job, it becomes yours
Communication that holds under pressure, from engineers to customers and executives
Technical fluency: comfortable with data, and systems thinking
Resilience and pace — live incidents, real deadlines, occasional travel to customer sites
Intellectual honesty — to raise your hand when you don't understand, and to obsessively devote time and energy to learning until you do
Professional Spanish and English




What we offer




Top-tier compensation, benchmarked to the best in the market and set by capability rather than seniority. Direct exposure to the executive team and every major customer from week one. Real scope to define a function and grow into leading it.




This role is demanding — broad remit, fast pace, and intense periods around go-lives. This may very well be the most difficult but rewarding challenge that you'll take up in your life.




Apply




Send a CV.
Send one page on a hard problem you owned end to end, and what you did when it went wrong.

About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

Being customer obsessed and data driven is what drives this role. We’re looking for individuals who can empathize with users, and work towards making their everyday lives easier. If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, and organized, but also excited to roll up your sleeves and get your hands dirty, you’d fit right in. The role will require rotational working hours to ensure smooth operational running of the 24/7/365 real-time set up, and collaboration with a global team. This role directly powers a critical live customer-facing product safety product, which forms the foundation for multiple other safety features. You would be the expert at risk identification, for all our customers using our safety products. You would also work closely with the Research & Development teams, to power our in-house Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence models, by generating high quality training datasets. This requires an understanding of data requirements, data definitions, edge-cases, tooling and review processes. In addition to that, you would also work closely with the Product team to run proof of concepts and experiments, which guide the direction of our Safety product suite, particularly in the areas of risk identification, mitigation, and reduction. You would also contribute toward analyzing data to improve the user experience for our customers. You’ll work a regular five‑day schedule, including day, evening and/or overnight and weekend shifts as part of a rotation. Overnight (11pm - 7am for example) shifts include enhanced compensation where applicable.

What You'll Do


Review and analyze live videos captured by Motive's dashcam for risk identification, based on the known risk factors combined with the contextual knowledge which would vary from case to case.
Adhere to the established guidelines and protocols for annotation to ensure consistency and reliability of data.
Ensure timely delivery of accurate data as per SLAs.
Consistently strive to enhance the annotation procedures and play a role in shaping the team's best practices through active participation.
Exhibit flexibility and adaptability in taking on new responsibilities beyond the scope of the defined job description, showcasing a proactive and versatile approach to work.


What We're Looking For


Preferably, a Bachelors in Computer Science, IT, Management or related field.
Detail oriented and organized, with a growth mindset.
Thinks, designs and executes keeping customers at the center of the solution.
Interested in learning about the annotation landscape and application of AI/ML in the trucking industry.
Ability to work collaboratively, in a 24/7/365 set up, with strong context in between them.
The position requires working day, evening and overnight shifts and weekends, while maintaining a standard five-day work week overall.
Good communication skills, oral and written.
Ability to work on multiple projects and tools, and switch context in between them.

About the job

We are seeking a highly organized Property Onboarding & Operations Coordinator to oversee the successful transition of new properties from signed management agreement through operational readiness while providing ongoing administrative support to the Property Management team.




This role serves as the central coordinator between property owners, Property Managers, residents, insurance providers, HOAs, and internal departments to ensure every property is onboarded accurately, efficiently, and with exceptional client service. In addition to managing the onboarding process, this position supports lease administration, resident communications, operational reporting, and process improvement initiatives.




The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, process-driven, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced property management environment.




Key Responsibilities




Property & Client Onboarding
Manage the complete onboarding process for newly acquired properties from signed management agreement through operational handoff.
Serve as the primary point of contact for owners during the onboarding process.
Collect, review, and verify all required onboarding documentation, including:
W-9s
ACH forms
Government-issued IDs
Trust documents
Articles of Incorporation/Organization
Property-specific documentation
Follow up with owners until all required documentation has been received and verified.
Maintain accurate digital records within AppFolio, OneDrive, and internal systems.
Complete onboarding checklists and ensure all milestones are met within established timelines.
Prepare and distribute internal onboarding announcements containing property details, owner information, occupancy status, and supporting documentation.




Property Research & Due Diligence
Research Homeowners Associations (HOAs) and obtain governing documents, rental restrictions, and community guidelines.
Coordinate directly with HOA management companies and community association managers to obtain required information.
Research and document utility providers for every property.
Maintain permanent property records for future operational reference.
Verify all required property information prior to operational handoff.




Insurance & Compliance Coordination
Coordinate property insurance verification with owners and insurance agents.
Review insurance declaration pages to ensure compliance with company requirements, including:
Dwelling coverage
Liability limits
Additional insured requirements
Coordinate policy updates when coverage requirements are not met.
Schedule and track required Four-Point Inspections and other compliance-related inspections.




Property Transition Coordination
Manage all activities between contract execution and property activation.
Collect gate codes, access information, keys, lockbox details, utility information, and vendor preferences.
Coordinate occupied property transitions by obtaining:
Existing lease agreements
Security deposit documentation
Complete tenant information
Ensure Property Managers receive complete onboarding packages prior to kickoff meetings.
Participate in client kickoff meetings, providing onboarding support and answering process-related questions.
Assist owners with portal setup and coordinate collection of onboarding fees.
Deliver a seamless and professional onboarding experience for every new client.




Resident & Lease Administration
Coordinate resident move-in documentation and onboarding requirements.
Respond to resident onboarding questions and assist with portal communications.
Maintain organized lease files and resident records.
Monitor lease expiration dates and renewal timelines.
Conduct market rent research to support renewal recommendations.
Prepare lease renewal agreements and update lease information in AppFolio.
Coordinate lease renewal and non-renewal communications.
Track renewal performance and maintain compliance with company procedures.




Property Management Operations Support
Maintain accurate property, owner, and resident records across company systems.
Support rent collection and related administrative processes.
Prepare operational reports for Property Managers and leadership.
Assist Property Managers by taking ownership of recurring administrative and process-driven tasks.
Monitor onboarding progress and proactively resolve outstanding items.
Identify opportunities to improve workflows, documentation, and operational efficiency.
Contribute to creating a positive experience for property owners, residents, and internal teams.




QualificationsRequired
2+ years of experience in Property Management, Assistant Property Management, Property Administration, or Property Onboarding.
Experience using AppFolio or another property management software.
Experience managing multiple projects while meeting deadlines.
Strong document management and organizational skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
High attention to detail and ability to work independently.
Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
Preferred
Experience coordinating property onboarding or new client implementations.
Experience reviewing insurance documentation.
Familiarity with HOA documentation and community associations.
Knowledge of residential leasing processes and lease administration.
Experience supporting remote property management teams. 




Additional information
Full-time, 40 hours per week
Salary: $12-$15 depending on experience.




BetterWho is proud to partner with PM University (PMU) to support ongoing learning in the Property Management industry. If you're interested in expanding your knowledge through certification, you can explore PMU's programs here: https://pmuniversity.com/course/the-skills-us-property-management-companies-actually-look-for-in-remote-team-members
