About the job

This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.

She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.

The next step is to speak to Jack.

Job Title

TikTok Shop – CAP Program Coordinator

Salary

Not Disclosed

Company Description

456 Growth Media is an official TikTok Partner and leading performance commerce agency driving over $20M in monthly GMV. Sitting at the intersection of talent and data, they represent top-performing social sellers across beauty, wellness, and lifestyle categories, focusing on measurable sales impact rather than traditional talent management.

Job Description

You will manage creator relationships for high-volume TikTok Shop campaigns, overseeing 50+ influencers and hundreds of content pieces monthly. By coordinating CAP programs, tracking GMV performance, and facilitating brand-creator communication, you’ll ensure flawless execution of affiliate strategies. This role is pivotal in scaling a roster that generates millions in monthly social-commerce revenue.

Location

Remote, Mexico / LatAm

Why this role is remarkable


Join an official TikTok Partner driving $20M+ in monthly GMV, placing you at the forefront of the global social commerce revolution.
Move beyond traditional talent management into high-performance commerce, working with creators who deliver real, measurable sales impact at scale.
Enjoy the flexibility of a fully remote role within LatAm while collaborating directly with founders to scale a rapidly expanding creator roster.


What You Will Do


Manage daily communication and campaign logistics for 50+ social sellers, ensuring creators hit deadlines and maximize their affiliate earnings.
Coordinate the end-to-end Creator Affiliate Program (CAP) workflow, including offer intake, product seeding, and tracking video output across high-volume campaigns.
Analyze performance metrics and GMV trends to provide weekly reports and flag high-potential creators for priority brand partnerships.


The ideal candidate


Has 1–2+ years of experience in influencer marketing, talent coordination, or TikTok Shop operations, preferably within a high-volume performance environment.
Possesses exceptional written English skills and professional communication habits, capable of managing hundreds of creator interactions via email and WhatsApp.
Demonstrates proficiency in Google Sheets, CRM tools like Salesforce, and project management software such as Monday.com or Lark to track complex workflows.


Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

description:
About the job

About You:

Are you interested in launching or growing your career in digital marketing? The WITHIN team is expanding, and we’re looking for a Digital Media Buyer Trainee to support our efforts across multiple marketing channels. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop expertise in key areas of digital marketing, including Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatic, Email Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Influencer Marketing, and Retail Media.

As part of a fast-growing company, you’ll collaborate with internal teams and clients to drive performance-driven marketing strategies. This role is perfect for individuals who are analytical, creative, and eager to learn in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment.

What You’ll Learn:

This role will expose you to various marketing channels, helping you develop a strong foundation in performance marketing. Depending on the projects you work on, you may gain experience and training in:

Paid Social: Learn how to create and manage paid social campaigns on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn, focusing on targeting, budgeting, and performance analysis to drive engagement and conversions.
Paid Search: Understand how to create and optimize paid search campaigns on platforms like Google Ads and Bing, including keyword research, ad copywriting, and bidding strategies to maximize return on investment (ROI).
Programmatic: Gain insight into programmatic advertising, including working with demand-side platforms (DSPs) to buy display, video, and native ads at scale, optimizing for reach, engagement, and conversions.
Email Marketing: Learn how to craft compelling email campaigns, segment audiences, and optimize performance through testing and automation.
Affiliate Marketing: Understand how brands collaborate with partners to drive traffic and conversions through commission-based strategies.
Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Gain insights into optimizing website content and structure to improve search engine rankings and organic visibility.
Influencer Marketing: Explore how brands collaborate with influencers to build awareness, drive engagement, and generate conversions.
Retail Media: Discover how brands advertise on e-commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, etc.) to increase product visibility and sales.




Some duties will include and are definitely not limited to:

Work with a diverse portfolio of clients to support their marketing efforts.
Communicate with clients via email and meetings, ensuring alignment on strategy and performance goals.
Collaborate with multiple internal teams to design and execute marketing strategies.
Produce meaningful marketing KPI dashboards and deliver performance reports with actionable insights.
Support A/B testing, consumer research, and data-driven decision-making to enhance campaign performance.
Assist in implementing best practices and proprietary technology to optimize marketing strategies.
Provide creative and copy recommendations.




Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Interest in pursuing a career in performance-driven digital marketing.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel (e.g., conditional statements, pivot tables, VLOOKUPs).
Full professional proficiency (written and spoken) in English.

Our interview process includes, but is not limited to, the following:

Cognitive Aptitude and Typing Test
Logic assessment on Basic data analytics & problem-solving assessment

2-Month Paid Development & Probation Program

This role begins with a 2-month program designed to provide hands-on training and professional working experience, as well as serve as the standard employment probationary period. During this probationary period, you will be closely supervised by our staff and continuously assessed by to determine if you are competent and trustworthy enough to be a full Digital Media Buyer for WITHIN. Upon successful completion of this program, you will be staffed on a team to begin working on client accounts on an independent full-time basis immediately!

Note: Employment types may vary by country due to local labor laws, HR will clarify before employees start.




We offer a competitive salary and benefits based on ability level, including:

Base salary - 25k MXN monthly
Unlimited vacation policy
Health insurance coverage
Food stipend
Internet/phone stipend
Dog friendly office
Professional Development Program
This is a fully in-office role based in Mexico City, Mexico. Candidates must be available to work on-site five days a week.
This is an entry level position. Training and development will be provided.

Note. Please submit your resume in English.




About WITHIN

WITHIN is the world's first Performance Branding company, partnering with some of the biggest brands in the world to drive business growth through innovative marketing strategies. Our integrated operating model collapses the traditional marketing silos between creative and media, performance and brand, and across media channels. With a full suite of offerings including media, creative, SEO, Lifecycle, Retail Media, Affiliate and Influencer, we’re able to work with our brand partners in an integrated fashion, allowing us to align marketing strategies back to core business objectives. Client teams at WITHIN are trained on how to always act as a trusted business partner, acting as a fiduciary to client needs above our own.

Teams at WITHIN have the ability to work with iconic brands such as The North Face, Timberland, Ben and Jerry's and Jose Cuervo. Everyone at WITHIN wants to grow and be challenged. It’s a collaborative place made up of small, closely knit and versatile teams that are fast and adaptive to solve problems and build systems.

Check out some of our work!

We weave AI into everything we do, using the latest tech across all teams to innovate, work smarter, and make better decisions. Whether it’s in creative, operations, or anything else, AI helps us level up and do things at a whole new scale. We expect our people to use AI in their daily work, fully embracing it as a critical tool to help us succeed.

Join Our Network!

Stay connected with us and be the first to know about new opportunities, industry insights, and updates.

Follow us on:

LinkedIn
WhatsApp Community
Instagram
Tik Tok

Bogotá: WeWork Av. Carrera 19 #100-45 Usaquén, Piso (Floor) 10, Bogotá, Distrito Capital de Bogotá 110111, Colombia
Mexico City: Av. Insurgentes Sur 1082, Piso (Floor) 2, Oficina 2008, Ciudad de México, CDMX 03100, México

As part of our initial application review process, we may use an AI-assisted tool to help compare skills and job titles from your resume with the requirements of the role. This tool evaluates information based on contextual relevance and is used only to support our manual review process. It is not used to make hiring decisions.

If you are a resident of New York City and would like to request an alternative evaluation process or a reasonable accommodation, please contact us at 315-533-2388.

title: Growth Digital Marketing Manager
description:
About the job

Growth Digital Marketing Manager | Polanco, CDMX




Estamos en búsqueda de un Growth Digital Marketing Manager para liderar estrategias de adquisición digital enfocadas en Atracción de Talento, conectando performance marketing, datos y tecnología para generar candidatos de calidad y convertirlos en contrataciones.

Buscamos un perfil estratégico, analítico y hands-on, con experiencia en Growth, Performance Marketing y Paid Media, capaz de transformar las necesidades de Reclutamiento en campañas, audiencias y funnels efectivos.




Principales responsabilidades

• Diseñar campañas de atracción de talento en Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn y otros canales.

• Traducir las necesidades de Reclutamiento en audiencias, campañas, mensajes y funnels específicos por vacante, cliente o plaza.

• Administrar y optimizar el presupuesto de pauta.

• Monitorear diariamente el performance y redistribuir la inversión hacia las campañas con mejor conversión.

• Diseñar estrategias diferenciadas para vacantes masivas, especializadas y de difícil cobertura.

• Trabajar de la mano con Talent Acquisition para identificar cuellos de botella en el funnel: leads, calidad, contactabilidad, entrevistas y conversión.

• Implementar A/B Testing de creativos, copies, audiencias, landing pages y formularios.

• Coordinar con diseño y contenido la producción de materiales para campañas.

• Crear dashboards del funnel completo de adquisición.

• Integrar campañas con ATS, CRM, WhatsApp, bots y automatizaciones.

• Analizar las fuentes que realmente generan contrataciones, no solamente leads.

• Construir históricos para identificar qué canal, campaña y audiencia funciona mejor para cada tipo de posición.




Requisitos




• Experiencia en Growth, Performance Marketing o Paid Media.

• Experiencia gestionando campañas y presupuestos de pauta digital.

• Dominio de métricas, funnels de conversión y optimización de campañas.

• Experiencia en A/B Testing y experimentación.

• Capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.

• Experiencia con CRM, ATS, automatización o herramientas de adquisición digital.

• Deseable experiencia trabajando con equipos de Talent Acquisition o Recruiting.




Ofrecemos




• Salario competitivo, acorde con experiencia y perfil.

• Prestaciones de ley.

title: Team Lead, Agency Growth Sales, SpLATAM - Mexico
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
At TikTok, our Global Business Solutions (GBS) team plays a key role in generating revenue by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding new clients, driving ad campaigns, and more. As the TikTok community grows at an unprecedented speed around the world, our GBS team leads groundbreaking projects that are changing the landscape of the advertising industry in real time.

About the team:
TikTok's Agency Sales team is at the forefront of connecting agencies of all sizes with TikTok's creative ecosystem — helping them unlock performance, build compelling narratives for their clients, and grow sustainably on the platform. Our team operates at the intersection of business strategy, product expertise, and client partnership.

The LATAM Agency team is a high-growth, high-impact environment where no two days are the same. We move fast, think big, and win together.

About the role:
We are looking for an experienced Team Lead to head our Agency Sales function across Latin America. This is a player-coach role: you will manage and mentor a team of Agency Partner Managers while also owning strategic relationships with our most critical agency partners in the region.

You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, developing the agency ecosystem, and representing TikTok as the go-to performance and brand-building platform for agencies across Brazil & SpLATAM markets including Mexico, Colombia, Argentina. You will be a key voice in shaping regional strategy, go-to-market motions, and long-term agency enablement programs.

This role requires an experience leader with deep knowledge of the LATAM agency landscape, a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, and the ability to inspire and develop high-performing teams in a hyper-growth environment.

In-Office Policy - We are currently working in the office 4x a week in Polanco and will be moving to full-time, 5 days in-office by September 2026.

*Please submit your resume in English in order to be considered*

Responsibilities:
1) Team Leadership & People Development
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of Agency Partner Managers across region, fostering a high-performance culture rooted in accountability, creativity, and commercial rigor.
- Set clear team objectives, track performance against KPIs, and provide structured feedback and development plans to support individual growth.
- Recruit, onboard, and retain top commercial talent as the team scales.
- Serve as a role model for consultative selling, strategic account management, and cross-functional collaboration.

2) Revenue & Business Growth
- Own and drive the team's revenue targets across the SMB agency segment in LATAM, with accountability for both top-line growth and portfolio health metrics.
- Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic agency partnerships — including independent agencies, regional networks, and in-market holding company affiliates.
- Architect and execute scaled engagement models that allow the team to grow agency revenue efficiently across a large and diverse book of business.
- Build and manage a robust pipeline of new agency acquisition opportunities, translating market trends into actionable growth strategies.

3) Agency Partnerships & Enablement
- Build deep, strategic relationships with C-level and high-level stakeholders at top agencies 
- Lead executive business reviews (QBRs) and joint business planning sessions with key agency partners to align on growth roadmaps and investment strategies.
- Develop and oversee structured agency education and certification programs, ensuring partners are fluent in TikTok product solutions, creative best practices, and full-funnel strategies.
- Champion TikTok's value proposition externally, representing the platform at industry events, agency summits, and partner forums across the region.

4) Strategy & Cross-Functional Influence
- Serve as the primary voice-of-the-market for LATAM agency insights, providing structured feedback to Product, Marketing, and Operations to shape platform priorities and scaled solutions.
- Partner closely with cross-functional teams including Global Sales Excellence, Marketing, Trust & Safety, and Ops to design and execute regional go-to-market initiatives.
- Develop data-driven strategic narratives and market analysis to inform leadership decisions and regional investment priorities.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Years of experience in digital advertising, media sales, or agency partnerships, with at least 3 years in a team leadership or management role.
- Deep, firsthand knowledge of the LATAM agency ecosystem — including the leading independent agencies, regional holding company structures, and the key decision-makers shaping client investment across major markets.
- Demonstrated track record of exceeding revenue targets and growing complex, multi-stakeholder agency relationships in a fast-paced commercial environment.
- Proven ability to coach and develop commercial talent, with experience building and scaling high-performing sales teams.
- High written and oral proficiency in Spanish and English is required due to frequent communications with stakeholders based in Spanish-speaking markets".
- Strong command of the digital advertising ecosystem — including performance marketing, programmatic, social, and full-funnel planning — with the ability to credibly advise high-level agency leaders.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience at a social media, digital platform, or ad tech company, ideally working directly with or within agencies at a leadership level.
- Familiarity with TikTok's advertising solutions, including TikTok for Business, Shop Ads, and performance-based products.
- Knowledge of auction-based and programmatic ad products, and experience translating product complexity into commercial narratives for agency audiences.
- Experience designing and leading scaled agency enablement programs such as certification tracks, partner academies, or structured QBR frameworks.
- Strong executive presence with the ability to engage C-suite stakeholders both externally (agency partners) and internally (TikTok leadership).
- Passion for TikTok's mission and a genuine curiosity about creator culture, short-form content trends, and the evolving role of social commerce in LATAM.
- Entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable building from the ground up, iterating quickly, and driving clarity in ambiguous, high-growth environments.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. title: Creator Manager - TikTok Shop
description:
About the job

Responsibilities
Team Intro
The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build an commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a passionate and strategic Creator Manager to join our team. You will be responsible for discovering, incubating, and educating e-commerce creators, with a focus on helping vertical creators improve their sales performance. You will collaborate closely with industry teams to match high-potential creators with quality content formats, including short videos and live streaming. Additionally, you will support major campaigns, marketing initiatives, and creator education efforts by providing relevant content and guidance. A key part of your role will be working with the content moderation team to educate creators on platform policies and ensure compliance. 

Responsibilities: 
- Identify, onboard, and incubate e-commerce creators within specific verticals to drive sales growth. 
- Develop and implement strategies to scale creator success, leveraging data insights to guide decision-making. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Category, Marketing, Campaign operations) to match creators with suitable content opportunities and promotional activities. 
- Provide ongoing education and support to creators, helping them optimize content strategy, understand platform rules, and improve performance. 
- Work with the content moderation team to ensure creators adhere to platform guidelines and policies.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable plans. 
- Service-oriented mindset, patience, and excellent communication skills to support and educate creators. 
- Fast learner who can quickly absorb information and effectively teach others. 
- Team player with a strong sense of responsibility and a positive, can-do attitude. 
- Proficient in data analysis and comfortable using metrics to drive decisions. 
 
Preferred Qualifications:
- 3+ years of experience in operations or partner management
- Able to establish contact, build up trust with creators, and provide complete support on platform training, creator engagement activities.

About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.


TikTok Accommodation
TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. You are a passionate business builder at heart. You get energized by tackling complex, challenging, often ambiguous problems and driving real impact across a business. description:

Title means nothing. Heart, execution, and fun are everything. This is true for leaders and junior hires alike. This description provides some general guidelines to help you understand the role, but what's most important is a desire to get out of bed each morning to go and create something great.




Just remember, this description is designed to inform, not to limit. We need heart, execution, and fun beyond the confines of any description.




///




INFLUENCER MARKETING COORDINATOR - CAMPAIGN EXECUTION




The Influencer Marketing Coordinator (Campaign Execution) is the driving force behind seamless campaign execution. You'll ensure influencer campaigns across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, and podcasts run smoothly, on time, and with precision. From coordinating deliverables to managing contracts, deadlines, and troubleshooting challenges, you thrive in the details and take pride in flawless execution.




At The Outloud Group, it's not just about checking boxes, it's about delivering top-tier campaigns that leave brands and creators excited to work with us again. You'll work closely with internal teams, influencers, and clients to keep campaigns moving forward, problem-solve on the fly, and ensure every element meets the highest standards.




A day in this role might look like: following up on outstanding contracts, reviewing a creator's content preview against brand guidelines, updating your tracker on posting confirmations, and closing out billing details on a campaign that just went live. If that kind of structured, checklist-driven momentum sounds satisfying rather than tedious, keep reading.







WHAT YOU’LL DO

Manage campaign execution from start to finish, ensuring timelines, budgets, and deliverables stay on track
Manage the full contract lifecycle -- drafting, sending, tracking redlines, and confirming signatures across brand and creator agreements
Maintain a consistent follow-up routine on outstanding contracts, content previews, and posting confirmations
Coordinate with influencers, clients, and internal teams to ensure smooth communication and seamless execution
Review influencer content through multi-stage approval cycles, ensuring accuracy, brand alignment, and compliance with campaign guidelines
Troubleshoot and resolve executional challenges as they arise, keeping campaigns running smoothly
Maintain meticulous records of campaign progress, approvals, and contract status
Prepare end-of-month reporting to support accurate and timely client invoicing
Identify and implement process improvements to make execution more efficient







REQUIREMENTS

Here's my background and what I've done before joining The Outloud Group team:

6+ months of hands-on experience coordinating influencer or creator campaigns, prior exposure to influencer marketing specifically is strongly preferred over general operations/PM backgrounds

Strong organizational skills, capable of managing multiple projects and deadlines efficiently

description:
About the job

Who We Are

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About The Role

How do you build a world-class sales organization?

By creating a best-in-class Sales Development team. We are actively looking for driven, high-potential professionals to join our Mexico Sales Development organization to help us transform one of the most important industries on the planet.

Whether your strength lies in rapid inbound lead conversion, strategic outbound prospecting, or a mix of both, we are building a versatile team to fuel Motive's rapid expansion. As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will be the front-line voice of Motive—navigating organizations, identifying client challenges, and setting qualified discovery meetings for our Account Executive team.

During the interview process, we evaluate each candidate's unique strengths, communication style, and sales instincts to place you in the SDR path (Inbound, Outbound, or Hybrid) where you will thrive and make the biggest impact.

What You'll Do

Depending on your specific role focus within the team, your day-to-day will involve a combination of the following:


Drive Qualified Pipeline: Engage prospective clients to identify operational challenges, qualify business fit against our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), and book high-value meetings for Account Executives. 
Inbound Lead Execution: Act as the first point of contact for warm prospects, converting incoming inquiries, trial requests, and content downloads into qualified pipeline through rapid speed-to-lead. 
Outbound Prospecting: Execute targeted, multi-channel outreach campaigns (phone, email, social) to engage net-new accounts and decision-makers in key markets. 
Serve as the Voice of Motive: Deliver an exceptional initial customer experience, educating prospects on how Motive connects physical operations, enhances fleet safety, and automates freight. 
Opportunity Management: Diligently track interactions in Salesforce, manage follow-up cadences, and re-engage stalled or missed opportunities to maximize conversion. 


What We're Looking For

We are seeking adaptable, ambitious candidates who bring a strong foundation for sales success:


Bilingual Proficiency: Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal). 
Core Sales Instincts: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a natural ability to connect, listen actively, and articulate value quickly. 
Drive & Resilience: High energy, strong work ethic, and the grit to handle rejection while staying focused on target goals. 
Agility & Curiosity: Quick learner who thrives in a fast-paced environment—whether responding rapidly to inbound interest or strategically researching outbound accounts. 
Coachability: Low ego, open to constructive feedback, and passionate about continuous personal and career development. 
Preferred Experience: Previous SDR, cold calling, customer-facing, or Salesforce experience is a plus (though strong potential and attitude come first). 
Education: Bachelor’s Degree required. 


Work Environment

This is a hybrid role based out of our Mexico City office (2–3 days in-office per week). Candidates must reside in or be willing to commute to the Mexico City area.

Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

UK Candidate Privacy Notice here.

title: Founding Sales Lead
description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: Founding Sales Lead




About the Company:

Our client pushes brand creative across a creator network, analyzes performance data, and identifies winning content to be used as ads before paid spend is allocated. They aim to eliminate the guesswork in ad creative selection for DTC brands.




Job Description:

This role is responsible for building and scaling the top of the sales funnel. Currently, growth relies on relationships and founder-led selling, which is not scalable. The successful candidate will own the pipeline development process, transforming a smaller base of clients into a larger one by establishing a scalable sales process. This is a foundational role where the individual will be responsible for creating the sales playbook, messaging, and channel strategy.

The market is large and the category is emerging, with a product that is proven to work and can be demonstrated with data. The role offers the opportunity to significantly impact the company's early growth and sales infrastructure.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Execute multi-channel outbound sales activities (email, LinkedIn, phone) targeting DTC and ecommerce brands.

• Minimize inbound lead response time to ensure the company is the fastest to engage with potential buyers.

• Leverage existing networks (investors, partners, past clients) to generate warm leads and secure meetings.

• Conduct thorough research on target brands' existing creative strategies to personalize outreach.

• Ensure clean and detailed notes are passed to the next stage of the sales process for effective follow-up.

• Maintain CRM data integrity, ensuring all activities are accurately recorded.

• Provide market feedback on objections, effective messaging, and list performance to inform strategy.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 1-3 years of experience in a sales development or account executive role.

• Experience selling to marketing, ecommerce, or agency buyers is preferred.

• Demonstrated passion for sales.

• Ability to manage and maintain over 100 live accounts simultaneously.

• Capacity to receive feedback and adapt behavior quickly.

• Interest in consumer brands and short-form video content.




Preferred Skills:

• Prior experience selling agency or marketing services.

• Experience building sales lists and running outreach sequences independently.

• Existing network within the DTC, ecommerce, or performance marketing sectors.




Personality:

• Proactive and self-starting attitude.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

• Adaptable and eager to learn.

• Results-oriented and driven.




Software & Tools:

• CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)

• Sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft)

• LinkedIn Sales Navigator




Schedule:

Full-time

Remote or In-office in Williamsburg




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

description:
About the job

Client Relations Coordinator 

Symphonic is a fully independent music distribution and marketing company based in Tampa, Florida, with a global team supporting independent artists and labels worldwide.




We’re passionate about music, but even more passionate about the people behind it. We’re looking for curious, driven, and collaborative individuals who want to build, learn, and grow with us. We believe diverse perspectives make better teams, better products, and better outcomes, and we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone belongs.




Sounds like you? Let's talk.




In a Nutshell // 

The Client Relations Coordinator for Symphonic is the liaison between Symphonic customers, partners, and other departments within the organization. The role consists of assisting clients and Symphonic internal departments with common support issues, technical support, errors regarding releases, accounting-related questions, phone support, and other queries that arise from day-to-day interactions. 

 

Compensation //

$19,538 monthly gross




What you will do // 

Engage in day-to-day discussions for both Spanish and English requests, including managing difficult or emotional customer situations, responding promptly to customer needs, soliciting customer feedback to improve service, responding to service requests, and consistently meeting commitments.
Thoroughly understand every service offering of Symphonic Distribution for improved support performance.
Suggest solutions to clients - show and enable clients to learn the system properly.
Assist with one-off requests or tasks as assigned by the management of the Client Relations department.
As needed, and with the support of Technology, reach out to clients to request redeliveries of audio and releases on an as-needed basis.
Develop a full understanding of Style Guides for iTunes / Apple Music and Spotify for content review and best practices.
Educate clients on the Apple and Spotify style guide and its contents. 
Help Maintain Symphonic’s public-facing knowledge base
Review past Spanish help desk articles and follow up with clients on past issues to improve customer satisfaction. (Check bad reviews and ensure each article has relevant and proper linking)
Assist the Client Relations team in translating articles from English to Spanish
Create new Spanish articles as issues arise.
Update existing Spanish articles for better optimization, adding and updating keywords and tags.
Review competitor help desks for comparisons (CD Baby, Label Engine, Beatport, etc.)
Provide feedback and suggestions for constant refinement of the Client Relations processes through available tools (HubSpot, SMS, Zendesk)
Clean and maintain Client Database by updating client details, requesting information updates when necessary, such as artist pics, logos, addresses, emails, etc
Assist the Content Team as needed with the loading and/or updating of clients’ catalogs and content approvals as needed.
Assist the Mexico team with client relations needs when needed.




What you need to have // 

1 year of experience in a customer service capacity
Working knowledge and experience with email marketing platforms, HTML, Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, and/or equivalent Google Apps
Ability to speak, write, and read English and Spanish fluently 
High School Diploma or GED




What will set you apart // 

2 years of experience in a customer service capacity 
Experience resolving system issues or investigating customer service inquiries




Additional Insights //

This role will report to the Client Relations Manager 
This role may receive occasional direction from the Head of the Region 



About Symphonic //

Symphonic is a leading independent music distribution and marketing company founded in 2006 by music producer Jorge Brea in Tampa, Florida. With a “by artists, for artists” ethos, Symphonic provides a powerful platform for global distribution, content management, royalty collection, marketing, and label services tailored to independent creators.




Proudly minority-owned and fully independent, Symphonic combines advanced technology with a hands-on approach that keeps artists and labels connected and supported at every stage. With a global presence across the U.S., Latin America, Brazil, Canada, the Caribbean, Europe, Africa, and Asia, Symphonic is committed to both technological innovation and meaningful engagement within the music communities it serves.

About the job

Objetivo del puesto 

Liderar la evolución del equipo hacia un modelo 360, integrando bajo una sola dirección la planeación offline y digital. La posición será responsable de articular una visión completa de medios, conducir al equipo durante la transición, elevar las capacidades de gerencias y planners, y representar ante el cliente una propuesta estratégica consistente y accionable. 

Responsabilidades clave 

• Definir y liderar la estrategia integral de medios para la cuenta, conectando objetivos de negocio, audiencias, canales y métricas. 

• Integrar la planeación offline y digital bajo una metodología común, evitando silos y asegurando consistencia entre recomendación estratégica y ejecución. 

• Liderar a las gerencias y planners del equipo, estableciendo prioridades, estándares de calidad, responsabilidades y mecanismos de seguimiento. 

• Mantener una relación consultiva con el cliente, presentar recomendaciones, responder preguntas técnicas y facilitar decisiones. 

• Validar planes de awareness con una visión cross-media que considere medios tradicionales y ecosistemas de Meta, TikTok y Google. 

• Impulsar el upskilling del equipo en la disciplina donde cada integrante tenga menor dominio. 

• Coordinar la transición del equipo y asegurar continuidad operativa durante el cambio de estructura. 

• Participar en la evaluación técnica de talento y construir planes de respaldo para posiciones críticas. 

Requisitos 

• Experiencia sólida liderando cuentas o equipos de planeación de medios 360. 

• Dominio estratégico de medios offline y digitales, con capacidad para cuestionar, validar y conectar recomendaciones de ambas disciplinas. 

• Experiencia en desarrollo de campañas de awareness y construcción de planes cross-media. 

• Conocimiento funcional de Meta, TikTok y Google aplicado a planeación, no limitado a performance. 

• Experiencia en manejo de cliente y presentación de recomendaciones a nivel ejecutivo. 

• Capacidad comprobable de liderazgo, gestión del cambio y desarrollo de talento. 

• Pensamiento estratégico, criterio comercial, comunicación clara y organización. 

• Disponibilidad para participar en procesos de entrevista o validación con cliente. 

Deseables / diferenciadores 

• Experiencia en industria automotriz, movilidad o categorías con redes de distribución complejas. 

• Experiencia transformando equipos especializados en estructuras integradas 360. 

• Familiaridad con herramientas de investigación, medición de audiencias, planeación y reporting cross-media. 

• Inglés profesional para materiales, plataformas o interacción regional. 

Indicadores de éxito sugeridos 

• Integración efectiva de la planeación offline y digital en una sola narrativa de cuenta. 

• Calidad, claridad y viabilidad de las recomendaciones presentadas al cliente. 

• Cobertura oportuna de posiciones y continuidad del servicio durante la transición. 

• Evolución observable de capacidades 360 en gerencias y planners.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
About the job

To apply, you will only have to fill a short form on our website that will take you less than 5 minutes.




Job Title: B2B Marketing & Event Manager




About the Company:

Our client is looking for a proactive, highly organized, and strategic B2B Marketing & Event Manager to own and scale their marketing engine.




Job Description:

In this role, you will lead the operational and execution side of our digital marketing channels (social media, email campaigns, PR/backlinks) and serve as the main operational powerhouse behind our In-Person Trade Shows & Industry Events.

This is a full-time, long-term remote position working during US Business Hours (EST preferred).




Responsibilities of the role:

• End-to-End Trade Show & Event Logistics: Own the event calendar (6+ national trade shows/year), managing registrations, vendor booth graphics, collateral, sponsorship details, and team schedules.

• Pre- & Post-Event Campaigns: Execute pre-show teaser campaigns (social + email) to book on-site meetings, and manage post-show lead upload, segmented follow-up sequences, and ROI tracking.

• On-Site Virtual Support: Provide real-time remote marketing support during live events (daily social posts, rapid lead entry into CRM, and recap summaries).

• Social Media & Content Operations: Maintain a 30–60 day rolling content calendar across LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube.

• Create and schedule engaging B2B content following brand guidelines and established approval workflows.

• Monitor industry-specific Facebook groups and communities, engaging in value-first discussions using approved playbooks.

• Email Marketing & Lead Nurturing: Build, segment, and send email campaigns and automated nurture sequences for inbound leads and trade show contacts.

• Monitor key metrics (Open Rates, CTR, Conversions) and optimize copy/segmentation accordingly.

• Public Relations & Backlink Management: Draft and distribute press releases announcing major company updates, event participation, and strategic partnerships.

• Manage backlink hygiene: proactively engage with digital publications and industry media outlets to secure backlink placements back to our domain.

• Collaboration & Reporting: Coordinate with external specialists (SEO, Web Conversion, Outbound Sales) to ensure cross-channel alignment.

• Maintain a weekly marketing performance dashboard tracking reach, engagement, event ROI, and pipeline generated.

• Track Google Ads lead handoffs, performance metrics, and cost-per-lead (CPL) to ensure paid traffic aligns with overarching marketing goals.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 3+ years of B2B digital marketing experience (experience in home services, technical services, or outsourcing industries is a strong plus).

• Proven track record managing trade show logistics and event marketing from planning to post-event lead distribution.

• Native or Near-Native C2 English (written and spoken).

• Strong adherence to approval workflows and process governance.




Preferred Skills:

• Basic familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Business Profile.




Personality:

• High-energy, proactive mindset—you flag opportunities before they become problems.




Software & Tools:

• Hands-on experience with Social Management tools (Zoho Social, Hootsuite, Meta Business Suite) and CRMs (Pipedrive, Zoho CRM, or HubSpot).

• Proficiency with Canva and AI assistance tools (Claude, ChatGPT) for efficient content drafting.




Schedule:

US Business Hours (EST)

Full-time (40 hours/week)




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

title: Aux. Servicio a Cliente, eHubs
description:
About the job

Empresa:

eHubs es una empresa especializada en desarrollar y operar una red de inmuebles de hiper proximidad, permitiendo que las marcas se acerquen físicamente a sus clientes.

Rol:

Gestionar y desarrollar las cuentas clave de la compañía, trabajando de manera coordinada con el equipo directivo para consolidar y fortalecer las relaciones comerciales con los clientes. Será el principal punto de contacto en el día a día, responsable de dar seguimiento a las cuentas existentes y a las oportunidades en pipeline, asegurando el cierre de nuevos negocios, la renovación de contratos y el crecimiento de las cuentas mediante una atención cercana, estratégica y orientada a resultados.

Principales Funciones:

1. Gestión de oportunidades

Dar seguimiento a las oportunidades comerciales hasta su cierre, incluyendo propuestas, visitas a sitio, negociaciones y formalización de contratos.

Elaborar propuestas comerciales y cotizaciones alineadas a los objetivos.

Coordinar el proceso de cierre con clientes y áreas internas involucradas.

2. Renovación y desarrollo de cuentas

Gestionar oportunamente las renovaciones de contratos.

Identificar oportunidades de crecimiento mediante nuevos espacios, ubicaciones o servicios.

Fortalecer la relación con los clientes para impulsar su fidelización y generar nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

3. Coordinación y atención al cliente

Ser el enlace principal entre el cliente y las áreas internas para asegurar una atención oportuna.

Coordinar con Operaciones, Legal, Finanzas, Mantenimiento y proveedores la correcta ejecución de los compromisos adquiridos.

4. Administración y seguimiento comercial

Mantener actualizado el CRM y dar seguimiento a las distintas etapas de cada oportunidad.

Supervisar el avance de contratos, órdenes de compra, facturación y cobranza en coordinación con las áreas correspondientes.

5. Reportes y control de resultados

Presentar el estatus de las cuentas y del pipeline comercial.

Elaborar reportes e indicadores de desempeño para la Dirección y seguimiento de KPIs.

Requisitos:

- Licenciatura concluida

- 2+ años trabajando en servicio a cliente B2B.

- (Deseable) Experiencia en Real Estate Comercial (retail, industrial o logístico) y/o en arrendamientos comerciales y negociación de contratos.

Otros:

- Manejo de CRM, Excel y elaboración de propuestas y presentaciones comerciales.

- Disponibilidad para realizar visitas y recorridos con clientes en la Ciudad de México y su área metropolitana (auto propio idealmente).

About the job

Altamira Trade AG is seeking experienced professionals interested in building a long-term career in the metals and minerals trading industry.




We are offering one position within our Trader Development Programme-Mexico, a structured two-year training and development initiative based in Bolivia. The programme is designed to prepare future traders for opportunities across Altamira's global trading platform, including Mexico and other international markets.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in commodities traffic, operations, logistics, or contract administration.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

• Willingness to relocate to Bolivia for the duration of the programme.

CV screening.
Written assessment.
Technical and commercial interviews.
Final assessment in Mexico city,Mexico.




Programme Structure

Phase 1

Participants will join the Altamira Bolivia traffic desk, gaining hands-on experience in contract administration, logistics, and operational execution.




Phase 2

Participants will progressively assume commercial responsibilities, manage customer and supplier relationships, and contribute to business development activities, including regular travel to mining regions across Bolivia.




Upon successful completion of the programme, participants will be considered for trader opportunities within Altamira's global trading network, including Mexico and other locations where business needs and opportunities exist.




How to Apply

Applications will be accepted until 15 October 2026.

Trader Development Programme-Mexico Application

Altamira Trade AG is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants.

About the job

Un cliente no cancela porque encontró algo mejor.




Cancela porque dejó de usar lo que compró, y nadie se dio cuenta a tiempo.




En Nortrez implementamos monday.com, HubSpot y otras plataformas para empresas mid-market y corporativas en México. El go-live no es el final del proyecto: es el momento en que empieza el trabajo de verdad. Que la gente lo use, que el proceso se sostenga cuando nadie está viendo, y que a los 11 meses el cliente renueve porque le está sirviendo, no porque le dio flojera cambiar.




Busco a una persona que se haga dueña de eso.




𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿 𝗦𝘂𝗰𝗰𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗿

Híbrido, CDMX · $20,000 – $30,000 MXN brutos mensuales, según experiencia demostrada




𝗤𝘂é 𝘃𝗮𝘀 𝗮 𝗵𝗮𝗰𝗲𝗿

→ Acompañar al cliente después del go-live: adopción, capacitación, resolución de fricciones reales.

→ Mirar los datos de uso y detectar quién dejó de entrar antes de que se convierta en una cancelación.

→ Correr sesiones de seguimiento con los dueños del proceso del lado del cliente, no solo con quien firmó.

→ Detectar dónde el cliente tiene otro dolor que podemos resolver, y avisarlo a tiempo.

→ Ser la voz del cliente hacia adentro, incluso cuando lo que tienes que decir no es cómodo.




𝗤𝘂é 𝗻𝗲𝗰𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘁𝗼 𝗾𝘂𝗲 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗴𝗮𝘀

→ Haber sido dueño de un número: retención, renovación, adopción, NPS. Algo medible que dependiera de ti.

→ Capacidad de tener la conversación incómoda a tiempo. El silencio con un cliente en riesgo es la forma más caraque existe de ser amable.

“Creo que deberíamos probar este canal, con esta oferta, esta landing page y este presupuesto. Vamos a medirlo durante X tiempo y decidir con datos si escalamos, modificamos o descartamos el experimento.”

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
About the job

Customer Service Representative




Sobre nosotros




Global Advance (global-advance.de) es una agencia alemana de marketing digital. Diseñamos campañas basadas en datos para marcas ambiciosas: generación de leads B2B, gestión de redes sociales y comunidades, contenido orientado a SEO, email marketing, branding y dashboards de análisis. Para acompañar aún mejor a nuestros clientes, ampliamos nuestro equipo con un/a Customer Service Representative (Representante de Atención al Cliente).




Tu misión




Serás el primer punto de contacto de nuestros clientes: resolverás sus dudas, coordinarás las respuestas con el equipo y te asegurarás de que cada cliente se sienta bien atendido — con rapidez, claridad y empatía.




Tus responsabilidades




- Atender las consultas de nuestros clientes por correo electrónico, chat y teléfono.

- Registrar, priorizar y hacer el seguimiento de cada solicitud en nuestro sistema de tickets/CRM hasta su resolución.

- Acompañar el onboarding de los nuevos clientes: primeros pasos, documentación y preguntas frecuentes.

- Coordinarte con los equipos de campañas, contenido y análisis para ofrecer respuestas precisas.

- Mantener actualizadas las plantillas de respuesta y la base de conocimientos (FAQ).

- Recoger el feedback de los clientes y trasladarlo internamente para mejorar nuestros procesos.




Lo que buscamos




- Comunicación escrita clara, ortografía impecable y un tono cercano y profesional.

- Clara orientación al cliente: paciencia, empatía y capacidad de resolución.

- Organización y autonomía para gestionar varias conversaciones en paralelo.

- Manejo básico de herramientas digitales (correo electrónico, hojas de cálculo); la experiencia con un CRM o helpdesk es un plus.

- No exigimos experiencia previa ni una titulación específica: te formamos nosotros. «Junior» se refiere al nivel del puesto, no a tu edad.




Valorable (no excluyente)




- Una primera experiencia en atención al cliente, soporte o ventas.

- Conocimientos básicos de marketing digital o redes sociales.

- Experiencia con herramientas como HubSpot, Zendesk o Freshdesk.




Qué ofrecemos




- Trabajo 100 % remoto, con el equipo técnico a cargo de la empresa.

- Una cultura de trabajo basada en la confianza y la autonomía.

- Formación inicial estructurada y acompañamiento continuo por parte del equipo.

- Posibilidades reales de desarrollo hacia la gestión de cuentas o el marketing.

- Un equipo internacional con jerarquías planas y comunicación directa.




Nuestro proceso de selección




Consta de cuatro pasos: primero revisamos tu perfil, después mantenemos una breve videollamada, a continuación te proponemos un pequeño caso práctico de atención al cliente y, por último, tomamos la decisión final. La postulación es gratuita en todas sus fases. Respondemos a todas las candidaturas.




## Igualdad de oportunidades




En Global Advance valoramos la diversidad. Todas las decisiones de contratación se basan exclusivamente en la cualificación y la idoneidad para el puesto, sin distinción de origen étnico, nacionalidad, género, identidad de género, orientación sexual, religión o creencias, discapacidad o edad, de conformidad con la Ley General alemana de Igualdad de Trato (AGG).




Protección de datos




Tus datos de candidatura se tratarán de forma confidencial, conforme al RGPD y exclusivamente para este proceso de selección.

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!



About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America's most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn't, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we've built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they're proud of - together.

The Role

Joining the Performance Department (performance marketing) as our Project Lead, you'll be responsible for providing stability within your team by supporting your direct manager through mentoring, training, and developing team members. You will also apply expert-level strategic thinking to promote sustainable project growth, ensuring long-term success in performance marketing initiatives.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Making expert-level project contributions, autonomously leading projects of varying complexity to a high standard of quality, with a focus on testing and creative problem solving, maintaining client success where applicable and reasonable while supporting others around you and teaching others to do the same.
Client: Exemplifying Thrive's standards for client success through strong day-to-day communication, agile and proactive problem solving, project management, and anticipating client needs.
People: Accountable for training and developing team members to be world-class performance marketers with Thrive's standards of quality and impact to aid in the growth of company performance expertise.
Company: Understands and takes action to be a key influencer and innovator in helping Thrive improve our products and services, and enhancing team member contributions while aligning individual contributions with the wider team or program objectives.


We're committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you'll familiarize yourself with Thrive's mission, values, and processes, complete your technical onboarding bootcamp, and onboard onto your team, emphasizing on building relationships.
In your first 60 days you'll put your learning, skills, and experiences into action by supporting on assigned client accounts, preparing and leading client calls, and helping your Strategist manage projects end-to-end.
In your first 90 days you'll have become integrated into the team, becoming an efficient contributor and trusted partner to your assigned clients and team members. You're starting to train others on the work we do. 


Qualifications


You have executed, maintained, and scaled performance marketing accounts of $100k-200k USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time including Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others.
You have experience directly collaborating with and supporting team members to achieve project & team goals. You have coached, mentored, or trained people before, helping them reach their career development goals.
You have advanced analytical skills and experience using data visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools. You have built your own dashboards before, or automated some manual reporting to make it more efficient. 
You've managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, lead gen, etc), and have been responsible for leading projects end-to-end, including delegation to more junior team members.
You have successfully managed and grown client relationships via weekly touchpoint meetings and asynchronous communication, and were able to make strategic recommendations that helped grow their business in the form of quarterly planning meetings or similar.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

At Thrive Digital, we may use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process. All applications and hiring decisions are made by a human member of our team. If you have questions, please contact Michelle Nowacki (Associate Director, Talent Acquisition) at careers@thrivedigital.com.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

description:
About the job

This is an opportunity to work with an Ashoka Fellow 

Ashoka Fellows are leading social entrepreneurs that have been taken through a rigorous selection process, testing the quality of their ideas and character, to become part of the Ashoka Fellowship and Network. Ashoka Fellows take on the challenges of building innovative system change ideas to make and spread social impact in a world wrought with challenges. They refuse to let the ‘impossible’ stand in their way to creating a better world.

This is an unpaid, volunteer opportunity

About The Affiliated Organization

Hecho por Nosotros (HxN) is a non-governmental organization (NGO) with consultative status at the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC), dedicated to driving systemic change. We believe in harnessing the power of the creative economy to transform society and create a more sustainable future. Our mission is to provide access and resources for the next generation to experience the interconnectedness between individuals, the world, nature, and business, while fostering systemic change within the framework of the creative economy. The creative economy and the creative industries offer powerful tools that can serve as catalysts for societal transformation when aligned with our deepest human values. According to the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development's (UNCTAD) Program on Creative Economy, the creative economy encompasses a broad concept centered around the trade of creative goods and services that sustain the activities of creative industries (UNCTAD, 2022). In this context, creative industries are defined by the Department for Digital, Culture, Media, and Sport of the UK Government (DCMS) as those originating from individual creativity, talent, and skill. Building upon these principles, the creative industries have the potential to generate wealth and employment through the creation and exploitation of intellectual property. At Hecho por Nosotros, we collaborate with various stakeholders, including micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs), artisans, designers, online sellers, marketing experts, big brands, economic corporations, media, and more. We acknowledge the close ties between the creative economy and the world of arts, inspiring us with audacious and creative designs. However, we recognize that the current business models often perpetuate human exploitation, modern slavery, and have a significant environmental impact. In fact, it is the second most polluting industry globally. With this in mind, we are seizing one of the greatest opportunities for impact – transforming the contemporary creative industry towards a more sustainable and ethical one.

Adriana Marina, Ashoka Fellow and founder of Hecho por Nosotros (Made By Us), along with the social enterprise Animaná, have been leading the charge in advocating for change. Together, we collaborate with over 80 organizations, including Ashoka, Globalizer, C&A Foundation, Ikea Entrepreneurship, Fabric of Change, UN, UNESCO, Ashoka, UNIDO, UNECE, IDB Network, the European Union, as well as local governments and universities in Latin America, Africa (with a focus on Ghana and Nigeria), and international organizations that champion a sustainable and ethical world. As a platform, we provide tools and opportunities to encourage companies to integrate sustainability principles, develop local value chains, and celebrate the history of raw materials. We analyze the impacts of globalization processes and empower consumers to make informed decisions. We firmly believe that young professionals and students are the future agents of change. Through our network, we aim to connect entrepreneurs, academics, craftsmen, students, citizens, NGOs, INGOs, countries, multilateral organizations, producers, cooperatives, and more. Our goal is to bring these stakeholders together to share information and perspectives, addressing the challenges and opportunities of building a sustainable creative industry. By collaborating in this manner, we can shift the paradigm of the creative industry and collectively work towards a more sustainable world. We focus on the regional context and collaborate with local agents to develop sustainable value chains, promote local natural fibers, and support communities. This bottom-up and geographical approach is crucial for inclusive collaboration and co-creating realistic and impactful solutions. In line with our commitment to transparency and traceability, we are incorporating principles of blockchain and decentralized finance into our tools. We strive to leverage digital and technological innovations to benefit sustainable grassroots initiatives. Now is your chance to join forces with Animaná and Hecho por Nosotros! Together, we can drive positive change and create a more sustainable and equitable future for the creative economy."

For more information, please visit www.hechoxnosotros.org

The Opportunity

PepsiCo strategy includes focused efforts to digitalize the company and build capabilities across the company. These capabilities are: Innovate/Market, Plan, Make, Sell and Deliver. Inside the Plan capability, one of the main enablers is Mosaic.

Mosaic is a global, integrated, and predictive planning tool aligned to the FP&A module of PepsiCo’s Global Template that is currently operating in certain OUs (Europe, AMESA, APAC, North America and LATAM) and will be rolled-out across all sectors. About the job

About the Company:

Our client is a growing fashion brand based in the U.S. that operates its e-commerce business primarily through Shopify. They are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented, and reliable Shopify Specialist to take full ownership of the store's day-to-day operations and ensure a seamless, premium shopping experience for their customers.




Job Description:

We are seeking a Shopify Specialist to manage, maintain, and optimize our client's Shopify store. This role involves correcting existing issues, preventing new errors, uploading products, managing inventory, fixing pricing and discount discrepancies, and ensuring the store is always campaign-ready. You will work closely with the Operations Director and report directly to her. This is initially a part-time position of approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential to transition to full-time based on performance and business needs after a 3-month trial period.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Manage the day-to-day operations of the Shopify store, including product uploads, image corrections, and inventory updates.

• Identify and fix pricing errors, discount miscalculations, and product status issues (e.g., products incorrectly marked as "sold out").

• Ensure all product listings are accurate, visually appealing, and aligned with the brand's fashion identity.

• Proactively audit the store to catch and resolve issues before they impact marketing campaigns or sales.

• Coordinate with the marketing team to ensure the store is fully prepared for new product launches and promotional campaigns.

• Make theme customizations using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as needed.

• Integrate and maintain third-party apps (e.g., Klaviyo for email marketing, review apps, etc.).

• Document all changes, issues, and resolutions clearly for internal reference.

• Provide proactive recommendations to improve the store's user experience, conversion rate, and operational efficiency.

• Work directly with leadership and follow internal processes for store management and quality control.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Advanced English proficiency, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience managing Shopify stores.

• Deep understanding of Shopify's backend, including product management, collections, discounts, and inventory settings.

• Experience working with fashion, apparel, or lifestyle DTC brands.

• Strong knowledge of Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

• Experience with Shopify Online Store 2.0, metafields, and custom sections.

• Exceptional attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and solving problems.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment and take full ownership of store operations.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing business environment.

• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.




Preferred Skills:

• Previous experience working directly with fashion brands or in the apparel e-commerce space.

• Experience with Klaviyo, Google Analytics, and other e-commerce marketing tools.

• Familiarity with SEO best practices for Shopify stores.

• Experience with project management tools (e.g., Asana, Trello, or Notion).

• Background in visual merchandising or product presentation for fashion.




Personality:

• Detail-oriented, organized, and self-motivated professional who takes pride in delivering flawless work.

• Proactive problem-solver who doesn't wait for issues to escalate before taking action.

• Reliable and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership over the store's performance.

• Collaborative and communicative, comfortable providing updates and recommendations to leadership.

• Calm under pressure and able to manage urgent store issues with efficiency and professionalism.




Software & Tools:

• Shopify (required)

• Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript (required)

• Klaviyo (preferred)

• Google Analytics (preferred)

• GoHighLevel or other CRM tools (nice to have)




Schedule:

Part-time: approximately 20 hours per week.

Potential to transition to full-time based on performance and business needs after a 3-month trial period.

Schedule to be determined collaboratively, with availability required during U.S. business hours for coordination with the team.

Flexible approach to holidays and PTO based on the candidate's location and local needs.




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics. With our One UPS advantage and comprehensive service portfolio, including Polar Speed's in-network pharmacies, we are optimally positioned to keep our clients competitive in an increasingly complex market.

The Customer Relations Specialist is responsible for handling and processing UPS customers' complaints about package delivery problems (i.e., missing and damaged items) and service failures (i.e., missed deliveries). The Customer Relations Specialist utilizes customer information databases to build customers' complaint profiles, summarizes and highlights customers' issues, and determines UPS location responsibility (e.g., District Managers, Operations Centers, etc.) for resolving customers' issues. This position interacts with UPS corporate departments (i.e., Public Relations, Legal, and Security) to ensure departments are notified of customers' issues and develop reports for Customer Relations and UPS senior management, summarizing customers' issues and resolutions. He/She acts diplomatically to handle calls from VIPs and diffuses and stabilizes calls from frustrated customers. This position processes correspondence from attorneys and states' attorneys general to ensure requests, demands, and inquiries are processed correctly within established deadlines.

Permanente

About the job

At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

About The Sales Executive (Nearshore) Role...

The Business Development Executive will be focused on closing new business. You will plan and prioritize business development activities to achieve company revenue goals and sales targets for defined regions. You will develop and implement innovative commercial strategies to maximize results and support business growth. Ideally, you will leverage existing industry contacts to increase SiteMinder’s client base and brand coverage in the assigned territory.

Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.
