description:
About the job

Company Overview

atomic✳HR is a recruiting startup. We help talented people across Latin America land remote roles with fast-growing startups and marketing agencies in the US and Canada, and we help those companies hire people they'd never have found on their own. We're small, fully remote, and we treat hiring like a growth problem: we test the way we write to candidates and where we post roles, and we use AI tools to move faster. This role sits on our own internal team.

Your Role

This is lead generation pointed at people instead of customers. You'll work across many different roles and industries, and every search starts with two questions: who is this person, and what would actually make them reply? If you've done lead gen or marketing, it's the same muscle you already have. You research an audience and write messages that convert, except here a conversion is a great candidate writing back.

A lot of what you'll source for is marketing and creative work: creative strategists, paid media, performance, growth, and data roles. So if you come from a marketing or agency world, you already understand the people you're reaching and what they care about. You figure out where the right people are, write the outreach, post the role so the right people see it, and improve based on what actually gets responses. Some recruiters treat this as the boring first step of hiring. We think it's the most interesting part, and it's most of this job. No recruiting experience needed. You'll be mentored while you learn the talent side, and you'll have real tools, including a dedicated sourcing platform and AI, to do it at scale.

You'll:


Research each new role to understand who the ideal candidate is and where to find them
Write and personalize outreach, then test subject lines and openers to lift reply rates
Post and promote roles so the right people actually apply
Review incoming applicants and shortlist the ones worth talking to
Keep your pipeline organized and follow up so no good candidate goes cold
Use AI and sourcing tools to work through a large volume without losing the personal touch
Track what's working, and change your approach when the numbers say so


You Bring


Curiosity and a real drive to keep learning, since every role is a new puzzle
Strong written English, and the ability to write to a stranger like a human rather than a template
Resourcefulness: handed a new tool and no script, you'd rather figure it out than wait to be told
Organization and follow-through, so pipelines stay clean and nothing slips
A competitive streak and self-motivation, because a lot of this is chasing a number you want to hit
Comfort with basic metrics, and the instinct to test something and adjust
A concrete example of a time you used a tool, a tactic, or automation to work smarter or hit a goal


Bonus Points


A background in lead generation, marketing, growth, sales, business development, or customer success
Experience at a marketing or creative agency, since many of the people you'll reach are creative, paid media, performance, growth, and data professionals
Hands-on time with a CRM like HubSpot or Salesforce, or with outreach and prospecting tools
You already use AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) in your day-to-day work
A language beyond English and Spanish

Fully remote from anywhere in Latin America, part-time to start at roughly 20 to 30 hours a week with room to grow, on hours that overlap US time zones

description:
About the job

Job Description

Sales Development Representative (SDR) – NetSuite

Resumen del Rol

El Sales Development Representative (SDR) es responsable de identificar, prospectar y desarrollar cuentas alineadas con el Perfil de Cliente Ideal (ICP) de NetSuite, generando conversaciones de valor que permitan identificar desafíos, iniciativas estratégicas y posibles oportunidades de transformación de negocio.

Como primer punto de contacto con potenciales clientes, el SDR ejecuta estrategias multicanal de prospección, diseña planes de contacto efectivos y agenda reuniones calificadas con tomadores de decisión. Su principal objetivo es generar Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) de alta calidad mediante un entendimiento profundo de los retos y necesidades del cliente, facilitando una transición exitosa al equipo de ventas para la posterior calificación de oportunidades.

Dependiendo de la función asignada, el SDR puede desempeñarse en modelos Inbound, donde su foco será recibir marketing qualified leads, calificarlos y desarrollar la cuenta con agilidad ("Farmer"), o Outbound, con un enfoque proactivo de apertura de mercado y generación de nuevas conversaciones ("Hunter").

Perfil curioso, con ganas de potenciar sus habilidades con nuevas herramientas de tecnología ( Inteligencia artificial). Preferible nivel de inglés conversacional.

Perfil del Candidato

Experiencia


 Preferible experiencia en prospección comercial, generación de demanda, desarrollo de negocios o ventas consultivas, preferentemente en tecnología, software o soluciones SaaS. 
 Preferible experiencia en prospección outbound y/o gestión de leads inbound. 
 Familiaridad con herramientas CRM y plataformas de prospección digital. 



Competencias Clave


 Mentalidad Hunter para roles Outbound y Farmer para roles Inbound. 
 Excelente capacidad de investigación y mapeo de cuentas. 
 Habilidades de descubrimiento y escucha activa. 
 Comunicación efectiva y capacidad para generar confianza con ejecutivos y tomadores de decisión. 
 Disciplina, organización y consistencia en la ejecución diaria. 
 Orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de métricas. 
 Curiosidad intelectual y aprendizaje continuo. 
 Capacidad para adoptar y aprovechar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial en su proceso comercial. 



Indicadores de Desempeño (KPIs)


 Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) generados. 
 Oportunidades creadas a partir de SQLs transferidos. 
 Reuniones calificadas agendadas. 
 Conversión de prospectos a SQL. 
 Conversión de SQL a oportunidad. 
 Cumplimiento de actividades de prospección y planes de contacto. 
 Calidad de la información y documentación registrada en CRM. 



Lo que distingue a un SDR exitoso en NetSuite

Un SDR exitoso no se limita a generar reuniones; comprende profundamente el negocio del prospecto, identifica y documenta sus principales desafíos y construye el contexto necesario para que el equipo de ventas pueda desarrollar una conversación consultiva y convertir esa necesidad en una oportunidad real de negocio.

Responsibilities

Responsabilidades Principales

About the job

Offshore SDR / Lead Generation Specialist (Recruitment) – Remote




Fully remote, full-time, US hours




A specialist recruitment firm is looking for a sales development rep to build and run its outbound engine. You'd work directly with the founder, with real ownership from week one. You will ideally have a SAAS, ERP or Tech background. But we are open to all sorts.




The role is centered on prospecting, list building and outreach campaigns that generate qualified conversations for the founder, with some marketing and candidate delivery support around it. If you're relentless about pipeline, write clean and persuasive outreach, and like seeing your work turn into booked meetings, this is built for you.




What you'd actually do




Build and clean targeted prospect lists of hiring managers and decision-makers
Research target accounts and prepare briefing notes so every outreach touch is relevant
Set up and run multi-channel outbound campaigns (email, LinkedIn) in Smartlead and our CRM
Write and test outreach sequences, subject lines and follow-ups to improve reply and meeting-booked rates
Qualify inbound and outbound leads against our ideal client profile
Book discovery calls onto the founder's calendar and hand off with full context
Track all activity and keep the CRM and pipeline data clean and current
Support marketing and candidate delivery when needed: newsletters, social posts and shortlists




You will not be closing deals or negotiating fees. That stays with the founder. Your job is to fill the top of funnel, keep the pipeline full of qualified conversations, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.




Who this suits




You've run SDR, lead gen or sales development for a company.
Your written English is genuinely excellent. This is non-negotiable, you'll be writing outreach that lands in a stranger's inbox
You know how to build a prospect list, sequence outreach and read reply-rate data
You're comfortable with outreach tools and CRMs, or you learn them fast
You like systems, lists and knowing exactly where every lead is up to
Recruitment industry exposure is a plus, not a requirement




Practical bits




Fully remote, you can be based anywhere, but you must work US business hours

Structured six-month ramp-up with training across outbound, tools and the recruitment business

Modern stack (Claude, Smartlead, and modern outreach and CRM tools), and you'll learn to use it properly

Results-focused: booked meetings and pipeline generated, not hours-logged




How to apply




Send your resume and a short note telling us why this role fits. Applicants that send a video are more likely to be selected for interview.

About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned DTC eyewear brand known for innovative, problem-solving sunglasses and bold product design. Our slogan, “sunglasses with a solution,” reflects our focus on function, style, and constant improvement. We’ve built a global customer base and a highly engaged social community of over 250,000 followers, driven by founder-led storytelling, product innovation, and performance-driven content.

The Role

Success in this role isn't determined by how many influencers you recruit, it's measured by your ability to build strong relationships, activate creators, generate consistent content, and drive profitable revenue.

If you're naturally proactive, enjoy building relationships, think strategically, and know how to motivate people, we want to hear from you.




This role requires someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, builds themselves to be the expert in their field and enjoys improving systems while delivering measurable business results.

 Brindar una atención integral y estratégica a los clientes, gestionando con empatía sus necesidades, incidencias y puntos de fricción para asegurar su satisfacción y confianza. • Adaptabilidad

About the job

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

This position is responsible for driving the execution of strategic franchise initiatives across Latin America, leading efforts to bring WBD’s iconic IPs to life in locally relevant and culturally resonant ways. The role combines project leadership and strategic support with hands-on management of local social media deployment, partnering closely with external vendors and cross-functional teams to ensure content is localized, impactful, and aligned with Global Franchise priorities.

Acting as a connector across teams and markets, the role plays a key part in amplifying WBD’s storytelling, fostering deeper fan engagement, and identifying opportunities to expand reach and impact across LATAM. How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

You'll thrive here if...

AI native or highly competent with AI tools. This is a must.

description:
About the job

Hey, Dingus!




Yeah, you heard that right.




Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a Brand Operator to join our growing team! You’re probably thinking, “Wtf is a Brand Operator?” Keep reading. 👀




Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency, but here’s the thing most agencies won’t tell you: having a website isn’t a strategy. Neither is posting on Instagram three times a week. A blog without a traffic plan is a diary. A newsletter nobody opens is a chore. Every tactic we run exists to answer one question: how does this move someone from ”never heard of you” to “shut up and take my money”? That’s the job. Blogs feed SEO. SEO feeds traffic. Traffic feeds the funnel. The funnel feeds revenue. If a tactic doesn’t connect to that chain, we don’t run it just to look busy. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription, minus the shit that doesn’t get anyone anywhere.




Purpose of the Role




The Brand Operator combines client relationship ownership with hands-on marketing production. You are the client’s main point of contact and one of the people actually making the work happen. This role exists because most agencies force clients to choose between “someone who understands your brand” and “someone who can execute.” We don’t think that tradeoff should exist, and neither will you.




About You




Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
Multifaceted, someone who steps up to the challenge
Proactive, always thinking about the needs of a client before they are
Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
Professional level of English (written and spoken)
Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful — you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
A background in marketing is essential
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, specifically) as part of your daily workflow as a way to move faster and think better




The Skill Requirements




You need real, hands-on proficiency in at least 3–4 of the following:




Short-form video editing (Reels, TikTok, etc)
Social media strategy, content creation, and scheduling
Newsletter writing and editing
Brand strategy and positioning
Copywriting (web, ads, email, social)
Design fundamentals (Canva, Figma, or similar)
Basic analytics and reporting (knowing what a number means, not just where to find it)




Coordination skills alone will not meet the bar for this role. We already know you can manage a project. We need to know what you can build.




Main Objectives




1. Client Relationship Ownership

Serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, understanding their goals well enough to make calls without needing a meeting first
Run regular check-ins, reviews, and strategy conversations that actually move the account forward, not just status updates
Translate client goals into a point of view, not just a task list




2. Hands-On Production

Personally execute against your core skills (video, social, newsletter, copy, brand, design, wherever you excel)
Use AI tools, especially Claude, to speed up ideation, drafting, and iteration. We want to see how you think with AI as a collaborator, not just how fast you can type a prompt
Maintain a quality bar on your own output before it goes to review, not after




3. Internal Collaboration

Work with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other Operators to fill gaps outside your core skills
Keep project tools (ClickUp and similar) current and accurate without needing to be chased
Give and receive direct feedback — we skip the sandwich method here




4. Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

Help shape brand and marketing strategy for your accounts, not just execute against someone else’s plan
Continuously look for workflow improvements, especially ones involving AI, that let you do more without more hours
Manage multiple accounts without letting them quietly rot




Important Notes

Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.
The minimum level of written & spoken English required for this role is professional.

description:
About the job

Location: Mexico City

Reports to: CEO

Scope: SARELLY Mexico, with potential broader regional responsibilities over time




MISSION

Make SARELLY the strongest and most innovative beauty brand online in Mexico.

The Online Sales Director will lead SARELLY’s entire digital commercial ecosystem — from DTC and marketplaces to social commerce and the e-commerce performance of our retail partners.

This is not a channel-management role. It is a growth leadership role.

You will be responsible for defining where the next wave of digital growth will come from, building the strategy to capture it, and mobilizing Commercial, Marketing, Content, Community, Operations and Data around it.

Because digital is often where new consumer behaviors, products and commercial models emerge first, this role is also designed as a potential stepping stone toward broader Mexico General Management responsibilities.




ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is a fast-growing, entertainment-native beauty brand born in Mexico, building the next generation of beauty for a global audience.

Founded by creator and entrepreneur Anna Sarelly, SARELLY sits at the intersection of beauty, entertainment, community and commerce. We don't just launch products — we create cultural moments around them, combining product innovation, creator-led storytelling and a highly engaged community.

Since launching beauty in 2023, SARELLY has rapidly expanded from DTC into social commerce, marketplaces and physical retail. Today, the brand is present at leading beauty retailers including Sephora and Ulta in Mexico and is entering its next phase of international growth, including a major U.S. retail expansion.

Digital has been part of SARELLY's DNA from day one. Our products have become best sellers on platforms including TikTok Shop, while our entertainment and creator ecosystem gives us a unique ability to turn cultural relevance into commercial performance.

As we enter our next stage, we want to build one of the most innovative digital commerce engines in beauty in Mexico — and are looking for a leader who can help us define what that looks like.




1. OWN THE ONLINE BUSINESS

Own the strategy, commercial performance and P&L across SARELLY’s digital channels in Mexico:

SARELLY.com
Mercado Libre
Amazon
TikTok Shop
Emerging marketplaces and social-commerce channels
E-commerce business of key retail partners, including Sephora and Ulta

Build one integrated digital commercial strategy while defining the distinct role, consumer mission and economics of each channel.

Own revenue, profitability, traffic, conversion, AOV, repeat purchase, assortment and promotional strategy.

Set ambitious annual and quarterly targets and translate them into clear commercial plans and priorities.




2. CREATE THE NEXT GROWTH ENGINES

Don't just execute an existing playbook — create the next one.

Continuously identify, test and scale new opportunities across:

Platforms and emerging channels
Commercial models
Assortments, bundles and exclusives
Launch and promotional mechanics
Affiliate and creator-commerce programs
Live-shopping formats
CRM and retention initiatives
Partnerships and technology

Stay ahead of shifts in consumer behavior, platform capabilities and commerce innovation, turning successful experiments into scalable and profitable businesses.




3. MAKE SARELLY A DIGITAL COMMERCE CASE STUDY

Our ambition is for SARELLY to become a reference for how the next generation of beauty brands wins online.

The question should constantly be:

“What can SARELLY do online that other beauty brands are not doing yet?”

Partner closely with Marketing, Content, Community and Creator teams to develop commercial ideas that are culturally relevant, entertaining and native to each platform.

Use SARELLY’s entertainment and community ecosystem as a competitive advantage, connecting content, creators and commerce rather than treating e-commerce as simply the final transactional step of a marketing funnel.

Build ideas and capabilities in Mexico that can ultimately inspire SARELLY's approach in other markets.




4. TURN SOCIAL COMMERCE INTO A CORE CAPABILITY

Make TikTok Shop and emerging social-commerce channels major engines for both revenue and customer acquisition.

Define and continuously optimize the right combination of:

Organic content
Affiliate creators
Paid amplification
Live commerce
Product seeding
Promotions
Exclusive drops
Hero-SKU strategies

Work hand in hand with Marketing and Community so commercial insights influence content decisions — and content insights translate into commercial opportunities.

Build a repeatable social-commerce model that can scale with the brand.




5. WIN ON MARKETPLACES

Build differentiated strategies for Mercado Libre and Amazon, recognizing them as strategic businesses rather than secondary distribution channels.

Own and optimize:

Assortment and pricing architecture
Product pages and digital content
Search visibility
Retail media
Promotions
Ratings and reviews
Inventory availability
Conversion
Marketplace-specific launches and activations

Understand the different consumer missions and economics of each marketplace and adapt SARELLY’s approach accordingly.

Develop strong relationships with platform teams and position SARELLY as a priority and innovative beauty partner.




6. WIN ON OUR RETAILERS' DIGITAL SHELVES

Make SARELLY as powerful online within our retail partners as it is in their physical stores.

Partner with the Wholesale team to lead the digital growth agenda at retailers such as Sephora and Ulta, bringing dedicated e-commerce expertise while Wholesale remains the owner of the overall retailer relationship.

Drive excellence across:

Digital assortment and availability
Product pages and content
Search and discoverability
Ratings and reviews
Retail media
Digital launches and promotions
CRM opportunities
Retailer-specific activations

Develop joint digital growth plans with strategic retailers and make their e-commerce businesses meaningful growth engines for SARELLY.




7. CONNECT MARKETING, CULTURE AND COMMERCE

Act as a key commercial partner to the Mexico Marketing team, translating consumer, content and platform signals into growth opportunities.

Bring proactive ideas, not just briefs:

“We are seeing this behavior on TikTok — what should we launch around it?”

“This product is accelerating on Mercado Libre — how do we amplify it?”

“This creator mechanic is converting — how do we scale it?”

“This retailer has an untapped digital opportunity — what can we propose?”

Constantly connect what consumers are watching, talking about and searching for with what they ultimately buy.




8. BUILD THE OPERATING MODEL TO SCALE

Create the data, dashboards and commercial rituals required to make faster and better decisions.

Build a clear view across channels of:

Net sales and growth
Gross and contribution margin
Traffic and conversion
AOV
CAC / ROAS where relevant
New vs. repeat customers
Sell-through
Inventory and OOS
Search performance
Affiliate performance
Content-to-commerce conversion
Retail media performance

Build a culture that goes beyond reporting what happened to understanding why it happened, what we learned and what we should do next.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 12–24 months:

SARELLY has built a significantly larger, more diversified and more profitable online business.

TikTok Shop, Mercado Libre and Amazon have become major growth engines, while SARELLY.com has evolved into an increasingly sophisticated platform for acquisition, conversion and retention.

SARELLY is consistently one of the strongest-performing beauty brands online within its strategic retail partners.

The company has developed distinctive capabilities around entertainment-driven, creator-driven and social commerce, with successful ideas continuously tested, measured and scaled.

Most importantly, platforms, retailers and the beauty industry increasingly recognize SARELLY as a case study for how the next generation of beauty brands wins online in Mexico.




THE PROFILE

We are looking for a builder, not a channel administrator.

Someone commercially ambitious, digitally native and highly analytical — but equally capable of generating ideas, taking calculated risks and challenging how things have traditionally been done.

Ideally, this person has:

Significant e-commerce and marketplace experience in Mexico
Proven ownership of meaningful online revenue and P&L
Strong experience with Amazon and/or Mercado Libre
Hands-on understanding of TikTok Shop, social commerce or creator-led commerce
Experience working with major retailers' e-commerce businesses
Strong commercial and analytical capabilities
Solid understanding of digital marketing and retail media
Experience managing teams and external partners
The ability to influence and operate cross-functionally across Marketing, Content, Operations and Finance
An entrepreneurial mindset and appetite to build, experiment and move fast

Beauty experience is valuable, but digital commercial excellence, leadership potential and entrepreneurial mindset matter more than category pedigree.




LEADERSHIP EXPECTATION

This role is designed for someone with the ambition and potential to grow beyond e-commerce.

Digital is often where SARELLY sees consumer trends first, tests new ideas first and learns fastest. That makes this position a unique vantage point into the broader Mexico business.

For the right leader, the scope could progressively evolve from:

Online Sales Director

→ broader Commercial leadership

→ potential General Manager Mexico

To make that progression possible, we expect this person to think beyond their immediate channels from day one — developing a strong understanding of the consumer, brand, wholesale, physical retail, operations, profitability and overall performance of SARELLY Mexico.

The ultimate expectation is not simply to run online sales.

It is to help build the future commercial model of SARELLY.

description:
About the job

About PostPilot

PostPilot helps ecommerce and consumer brands turn direct mail into a modern performance marketing channel.




Our platform makes it easy for brands to send individually personalized postcards to customers and prospects, combining the targeting and measurability of digital marketing with the attention and trust of physical mail.




At a time when customers are overwhelmed by digital ads, inboxes are crowded, and online channels keep getting more expensive, direct mail gives brands a different way to reach people and drive growth.




We're a fast-growing team working with leading brands across ecommerce, retail, health and wellness, apparel, beauty, home, and more. Our team is practical, creative, and focused on helping customers launch campaigns that actually perform.




About The Role

We're looking for a Graphic Designer to help customers bring direct mail campaigns to life.




This is a hands-on, customer-facing design role focused on postcard campaigns for ecommerce and consumer brands. You'll design postcard campaigns for a wide range of brands, adapt customer assets into effective direct mail creative, help improve offers and CTAs, prepare files for print, and work with customers and internal teams to get campaigns launched quickly and cleanly.




This is a high-volume creative environment, but not a repetitive one. You'll work across many different brands, industries, offers, and campaign types, often with several projects moving at once. The role is best for someone who enjoys variety, clear deadlines, practical iteration, and the rhythm of getting good work out the door consistently.




Customer conversations are part of the role. You should be comfortable joining customer calls to clarify briefs, discuss creative feedback, explain design decisions, and help align on campaign direction. This is not a sales role, but it is a customer-facing creative role.




The right person is not just a strong visual designer. You're also comfortable thinking through the marketing goal behind a campaign, communicating with customers, working across many projects at once, and using AI tools thoughtfully to move faster without giving up taste, judgment, or attention to detail.




This is a full-time remote position. The role requires availability during US business hours.




What You'll Do

Design postcard campaigns for PostPilot customers across a wide range of industries and brand styles.
Turn customer-provided assets, copy, offers, and briefs into polished, print-ready direct mail creative.
Advise customers and internal account teams on creative direction, messaging, offers, CTAs, layout, and campaign strategy.
Join customer calls to clarify campaign goals, discuss creative direction, review feedback, explain design decisions, and help customers move toward a strong final campaign.
Review designs for direct mail and print readiness, including hierarchy, legibility, bleed, trim, safe areas, mail panel constraints, QR codes, URLs, offer clarity, and front/back consistency.
Communicate with customers and internal teams to answer design-related questions, clarify briefs, collect missing assets, and resolve feedback.
Manage a steady queue of design requests while meeting draft deadlines and keeping work organized.
Use AI tools in your daily workflow to speed up ideation, versioning, copy refinement, research, organization, and QA while maintaining strong creative judgment.




About You

You're a strong designer who understands that great marketing creative has to look good, communicate clearly, and drive action.




You can move quickly without being sloppy. You know how to adapt to different brand styles. You can take imperfect customer inputs and turn them into something clear, polished, and effective. You are comfortable asking good questions, explaining your thinking, and working through feedback from customers and teammates.




You do not need to know everything about direct mail on day one. We do expect strong design fundamentals, good marketing instincts, clear communication, comfort with AI tools, and a willingness to learn the details of print, production, and campaign strategy.




Must Have

Strong visual design skills and a portfolio showing polished, commercially useful work.
Fluency in Adobe Creative Suite.
Experience designing for marketing, advertising, ecommerce, DTC brands, or other performance-driven creative.
Strong layout, typography, hierarchy, and brand adaptation skills.
Ability to design across multiple industries and brand styles without making everything feel the same.
Comfort working with customer-provided assets, imperfect briefs, and fast-moving feedback.
Comfort communicating directly with customers, including joining calls to discuss creative direction, feedback, and campaign goals.
Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize clearly, and consistently hit draft deadlines.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, offers, URLs, codes, formatting, and production requirements.
AI-native working style, with experience using AI tools to improve speed, creativity, communication, or quality in daily work.
Based in the Americas and available to work US business hours.




Nice To Have

Print design or direct mail design experience.
Ecommerce or lifecycle marketing experience.
Customer-facing design, creative strategy, customer success, or support experience.




What Makes Someone Successful In This Role

You think about the business goal behind the design, not just the look of the card.
You can make customers creative better without overcomplicating it.
You communicate clearly and keep work moving.
You care about details that affect print quality, campaign clarity, and customer experience.
You are comfortable balancing creativity with speed, process, and practical constraints.
You enjoy working across many different brands and campaigns.

title: Project Coordinator — Construction Operations & Client Proposals
description:
About the job

PROJECT COORDINATOR — HOME REMODELING & REPAIR OPERATIONS




Company: Constractiva

Location: Remote — Mexico (must work Pacific Time hours, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PT)

Type: Full-time, independent contractor

Compensation: $2,000 – $2,500 USD per month, depending on experience

Reports to: Founder & CEO




———




THE SHORT VERSION




I'm a licensed contractor in Los Angeles specializing in home remodeling, repairs, and residential work orders. I'm looking for one person to own our project pipeline from the moment a client asks for something to the moment the work is scheduled and paid for.




Most of what we do is fast-moving: a bathroom remodel, a kitchen refresh, a repair work order, a punch list at a rental property. We handle a high volume of small-to-mid-size jobs, which means the pipeline is always full and always moving. That's why this role exists.




This is not a data entry job. You will decide what moves forward and what stalls. You'll write proposals that win work, chase the ones that go quiet, and make sure nothing sits untouched in a queue for a week. If you are the kind of person who cannot stand seeing an open item with no next step, this job will feel like it was written for you.




You'll also be one of the first users of a proposal platform we built ourselves — AI-assisted, photo-driven, designed to give clients pricing they can actually understand. Your job is to use it well and tell us how to make it better.




———




WHO WE ARE




Constractiva is a California-licensed General B contractor focused on home remodeling, residential repairs, and work orders across Los Angeles — bathrooms, kitchens, flooring, drywall, paint, and the steady stream of repair requests that come with managing residential property. We run real job sites and we build our own technology: a proposal platform that turns site photos and structured questions into transparent, itemized client pricing.




We are small, we move fast, and the person in this role will have more ownership in six months than most people get in three years somewhere larger.




———




WHAT YOU'LL OWN




THE PIPELINE (this is the core of the job)




You own the funnel and its conversion rate:




• New requests — respond same day, gather what's needed, get them moving

• Quotes — build proposals in our platform, send them out fast, make them clear

• Follow-up — when a quote goes quiet, you chase it. Day 3, day 7, day 14. You don't wait to be asked

• Approved work — coordinate with our field team to get it scheduled without gaps

• Invoicing — bill promptly and accurately when work completes

• Collections (first pass) — track what's outstanding and follow up until it's paid




You'll be measured on real numbers: how fast requests become quotes, what percentage of quotes get approved, how quickly approved work gets scheduled, and how fast we get paid.




PROPOSAL CREATION




• Use our AI-assisted platform to build itemized, transparent proposals from site photos and job details

• Ask the right follow-up questions — good proposals come from good inputs, and that's on you

• Review AI-generated output for accuracy before it reaches a client. You are the last set of eyes

• Communicate directly with clients about scope, options, and pricing




WORKING WITH OUR FIELD TEAM




Our maintenance coordinator is on job sites all day — recruiting, supervising, running crews. He cannot be in the admin system. That's you. You're his counterpart: he handles the ground, you handle everything else, and you sync daily so nothing falls between you.




PRODUCT FEEDBACK




You'll be in our platform every day. We want to know what's slow, what's confusing, what's missing. A few hours a week documenting that is part of the job, and it genuinely shapes what we build next.




———




WHO I'M LOOKING FOR




REQUIRED




• Residential construction or property maintenance background — you've worked for a remodeling contractor, a handyman or repair company, a property management maintenance team, a home warranty company, or in construction admin. You understand what a scope of work involves and roughly what things cost

• Fully bilingual, English and Spanish, written and spoken. You'll write client-facing proposals in English and talk to subcontractors in Spanish

• Genuinely comfortable with software — you learn new platforms quickly and don't need hand-holding

• Strong organizational discipline: you track dozens of open items without losing any

• Willing and able to follow up persistently. Some clients need to be pushed. That has to be okay with you

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet work environment, and availability during Pacific Time business hours




WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT




• Experience with Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Buildertrend, AppFolio, or similar field service and property software

• Any experience writing or assembling repair and remodeling estimates or proposals

• Background in inside sales, client service, dispatch, or collections

• Familiarity with US residential construction and repair terminology, trades, and materials




WHAT WON'T WORK HERE




• Needing a fully defined process before you'll act

• Discomfort with follow-up or with clients who push back

• Treating this as an order-taking role — you're expected to drive the pipeline, not just record it




———




WHAT WE'RE OFFERING




REAL OWNERSHIP. You'll run our entire project pipeline. Not a slice of it — all of it.




REAL TECHNOLOGY. You'll work daily in a platform we're actively building, and your input will change it.




REAL GROWTH. As Constractiva grows, this role grows. The person who owns this well is the person we build the next layer of the team around.




COMPENSATION




• $2,000 – $2,500 USD per month, based on experience

• Performance fee tied to pipeline conversion and collections results

• Long-term, stable full-time engagement — we are hiring for years, not months




———




HOW TO APPLY




Send your CV and answers to these four questions. Please skip the standard cover letter — I'll read the answers.




1. Describe a remodeling project or repair job you helped coordinate. What was your specific role, and what went wrong?




2. A client received a quote nine days ago and hasn't responded. Walk me through exactly what you do.




3. Look at the photo of the damaged bathroom included in this posting. What questions would you need answered before you could price the repair?




4. What software have you used for work that frustrated you? Be specific about what was wrong and how you'd fix it.




Email: [savas@zumahousing.com]

Subject line: Project Coordinator — [Your Name]




I read every application personally.

Job Title: Business Development & Sales Representative (Architecture & Design Firm)

Our client is seeking an experienced sales professional with a background in architecture, renovations, construction, or real estate development. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying potential clients, generating new business opportunities, nurturing leads, and closing sales for their architecture and design services. This is a part-time remote position with a competitive commission structure, making it an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a performance-based environment.

• Qualify leads and manage the sales pipeline from initial contact through closing.

• Conduct discovery calls and present the firm's architecture and design services.

• Prepare proposals and coordinate with the design team as needed.

• Follow up consistently with prospects to move opportunities through the sales process.

• Meet or exceed monthly sales and revenue goals.

• Maintain accurate records of leads, client interactions, and sales activities in the CRM.

Preferred Skills:

• Existing network within the architecture, construction, or real estate industry.

• Experience selling professional services or high-value projects.

Personality:

• Enjoys networking, building long-term client relationships, and turning opportunities into successful projects.




Software & Tools:

• CRM software

• Microsoft Office or Google Workspace




Schedule:

Part-Time

Flexible, with availability during U.S. East Coast business hours preferred.




Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

• Full-time remote opportunity.

description:
About the job

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Merchant Care Analyst I is the foundational tier within our Merchant Care organisation, responsible for delivering efficient and timely responses to merchant inquiries. You will support tickets raised by merchants through any channel, instant messaging, email or web form, as well as requests from internal stakeholders, ensuring queries are addressed promptly and accurately within a specific product scope. The role combines resolving documented issues independently using our established knowledge base with recognising cases of higher complexity and escalating them with clear context to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst. Success in this role means strong communication, a solid understanding of payments, and a genuine sense of urgency in everything you pick up.

What You Will Be Doing


Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system, remaining logged in and active during working hours.
Investigate and respond to merchant inquiries, as well as requests from internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.
Perform initial investigations and refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate, providing full context for a speedy resolution.
Resolve tickets using the existing knowledge base, identify documentation gaps, request new SOPs, and keep documentation up to date.
Maintain a solid understanding of our products, services, and policies to provide accurate information to merchants.
Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimise errors and deliver consistent care.
Categorise issues in the global queue and identify repetitive problems, escalating likely root causes to the wider team.
Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with our Product and Engineering teams.
Participate actively in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups.


About You


2+ years of experience in technical support or operations roles, ideally within Fintech, Banking or Financial Services.
A degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Data or a related field, though equivalent professional experience in other disciplines will be considered.
A comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end payment flow
Strong problem-solving skills, breaking a merchant-reported symptom into checkable components and working through them methodically rather than by trial and error.
Proficient in one or more of the following: API troubleshooting with Postman, log and event analysis with Datadog, data querying with Looker, Snowflake or SQL, and secure environment access tooling such as Guacamole.
Comfortable following SOPs and troubleshooting guides accurately, and knowing which tool applies to which category of task.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to interpret complex technical issues in simple business terms for merchants and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to manage a live workload against SLA countdowns in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high service standards.
Proficiency in using customer service software (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce) and CRM tools.
Proven ability to work independently as well as collaborate effectively across teams, seeking guidance proactively to ensure positive outcomes for merchants.
A genuine appetite for learning new concepts and technologies quickly, approaching all work with urgency, enthusiasm and a growth mindset.


Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

description:
About the job

🇵🇭 USD 8,000 to USD 10,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in the Philippines!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




The standard working hours for this role are Tuesday to Saturday, approximately 6:00am–3:00pm or 7:00am–4:00pm Philippine Time, depending on US daylight saving time. These hours correspond to Monday to Friday, 3:00pm–12:00 midnight Pacific Time.




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 

We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.




The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within the Philippines.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

About the job

La mayoría de los proyectos de software que fracasan no fracasan por el software.




Fracasan porque nadie se sentó a entender el proceso antes de configurar la herramienta.




En Nortrez implementamos monday.com, Fin, HubSpot y otras plataformas para empresas mid-market y corporativas en México. El trabajo real no es armar tableros: es entrar a una operación desordenada, entender cómo funciona de verdad —no cómo dice el organigrama que funciona— y rediseñarla para que se sostenga sin nosotros.




Busco a una persona que haga exactamente eso.

→ Diseñar y construir la solución en monday.com y stack adyacente: automatizaciones, integraciones, APIs.

→ Capacitar usuarios y pelear por la adopción real, no por el go-live.

description:
About the job

BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF

The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished.

How will you contribute to our magical experience?

The Assistant, Social Media of ESPN Mexico will join the team to maintain our prestige on social networks and will provide our fans with the best consumer experience in sports. This role will be responsible for creating posts (videos, images or text) on our social media channels, generating original and creative content and amplifying the best of our content as a brand in these Social Media platforms: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X. Whether in the office or on-site coverage, the Assistant Social Media will implement our strategy on each social network.

An Assistant of Social Media can contribute by creating or curating relevant, high-quality content that aligns with the brand’s goals, messaging, and audience interests, ensuring the business stays visible and relevant in the digital space.

By consistently creating engaging content and managing the brand’s social presence, a social media assistant can help grow the business’s online following and extend its reach to potential new customers.

The Assistant, Digital ESPN Social Media will be responsible for: 


Implement our social media strategies across the entire brand and propose new ideas to increase our engagement.
Content management across multiple social media platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X.
Content creation of video, photos, memes and original content to increase the accounts and engage the fans.
Publish organic content and sales content (paid campaigns).
Live posting of the most important sports events; sometimes the coverage will be on site.
Effective monitoring and content curation.
Identify insights and social media trends.
Collaborate with another teams, especially editorial, DVC and marketing.


What we need from you to be part of this story:


Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or related fields. Qualifications on social media networks are a plus.
Knowledge of social media networks: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X. Ideal experience in social media environment. Knowledge of sports and social media trends. Activate and grow an engaged community.
Basic knowledge in photo and video editing software (Photoshop/CupCut).
Impeccable spelling and writing skills.
Effective monitoring, content curation, teamwork and work under pressure.
Extensive knowledge of sports.
Availability to work evening shifts and weekends, and travel as required.
Upper intermediate level of English.


Additional Information

At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create the memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. We are a team of storytellers and hire under equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability and gender identity. We foster a corporate culture of belonging and inclusiveness, which empowers our staff and company to thrive. At Disney, everyone has the opportunity to speak up and participate, grow and share ideas.

“You can design and create, and build the most wonderful place in the world. But it takes people to make the dream a reality.” Walt Disney

title: Marketing Automation & Lead Gen Specialist (GHL Expert)  - CS0812
description:
About the job

📌Job Description: Growth Marketing Specialist - CS0812

📍 Location: Remote - Must work Eastern Time hours

📄 Contract Type: Full-Time

💰 Compensation: $1,800 USD per month

🕒 Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM EST




About the Client:

A technology-forward financial services firm focused on credit education and dispute tracking. They use cutting-edge tools to streamline the credit repair journey for both B2B and B2C clients — and they're looking for a high-ownership professional to build, optimize, and scale their internal automation ecosystem.




About the Role:

We're looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Specialist to own our lead generation engine end to end, from paid ads and outbound prospecting through funnel building, CRM/automation execution, and channel partner development. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who can take ownership of multiple channels with minimal oversight.

This role replaces work currently split across outside contractors. You'll be taking direct, full-time ownership of functions we've been running through agency partners, so this is a build-and-own position, not a support seat.




Key Responsibilities

- Set up, launch, and manage Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns: targeting, creative rotation, budget management, and ongoing optimization.

- Build and optimize marketing funnels (landing pages, opt-ins, nurture sequences) designed to convert traffic into qualified leads.

- Serve as our Go High Level (GHL) expert, building workflows, automations, pipelines, and campaigns within the platform.

- Manage and execute LinkedIn marketing, organic and/or paid strategies to grow visibility and generate inbound interest.

- Work within Apollo for outbound prospecting, list building, and sequence management.

- Develop and manage channel partner strategy, including outreach, relationship tracking, and reporting on partner-sourced pipeline.

- Oversee our SMS/texting outreach campaign, working with our outside vendor to manage cadence, messaging, and performance.

- Monitor campaign performance across channels and report on key metrics (CPL, conversion rates, funnel drop-off, partner attribution, etc.).

- Continuously test and refine ad creative, targeting, and funnel copy to improve performance.




Required Skills & Expertise

- 3+ years of hands-on experience in performance/growth marketing, ideally combining paid ads, funnels, and CRM/automation (5+ years preferred)

- Proven expertise with Meta Ads Manager, able to set up and run campaigns independently with no ramp-up time

- Strong funnel-building skills, comfortable designing and launching landing pages and nurture flows

- Go High Level mastery, this is a must-have, not a nice-to-have

- Working knowledge of Apollo for outbound prospecting and sequencing

- LinkedIn marketing experience, organic content strategy and/or LinkedIn ads

- Experience developing or managing partner/referral programs is a strong plus

- Ability to work full-time Eastern hours

- Self-directed, comfortable owning multiple channels end to end with minimal hand-holding.

Our recruitment process is designed to ensure the right fit for you and our team. Here's what to expect:

- Complete the application form: https://airtable.com/appOWPxckxVIjvMdu/pagy70vUZTFTvcYsD/form

- Screening interview with our recruitment team

- Interview with the client

- Final decision – some candidates may have a second client interview before an offer is made

- We're looking forward to learning more about you! 🎨

description:
About the job

Reports to: Creative Director Anna Sarelly (Showrunner)

Works closely with: CMO, Brand Social, Creative Studio, external production partners

Location: Mexico City

Type: Full-time

Experience: 3+ years




THE ROLE

SARELLY is a cultural-first beauty brand born in Mexico and built for the next generation of Latinas. We’re now building Entertainment into a core pillar of the brand.

At the center is Drama en la Chamba, our original entertainment franchise, with ambitions to expand across episodic storytelling, YouTube, social content and future original IP.

We are looking for an Entertainment Studio Producer to turn our Founder & Showrunner’s creative vision into a consistently produced, distributed and growing entertainment engine.

You will own the day-to-day machinery behind SARELLY Entertainment: taking ideas from concept through production, post-production and distribution, while building the systems required to deliver consistently.

You will also turn every hero production into a broader stream of platform-native storytelling that keeps audiences engaged between episodes and seasons.

The goal is simple: enable the Showrunner to focus on vision, storytelling, characters and creative direction—not production management, editing workflows or publishing logistics.

This is neither a traditional TV producer nor social media role. We need someone who understands both sides of modern entertainment: producing a show and programming it for a YouTube-first, digital-native audience.




ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is a fast-growing beauty brand born in Mexico, founded by creator Anna Sarelly and beauty executive Rémi Martini.

Since launching beauty in 2023, SARELLY has rapidly expanded across DTC and leading retailers in Mexico and the U.S. In 2026, the brand was named Breakthrough Brand of the Year at The Business of Beauty Global Awards and is launching nationwide at Target.

Our ambition is to build one of the most culturally relevant beauty brands to emerge from Latin America.




WHAT YOU’LL DO01 — RUN ENTERTAINMENT PRODUCTION

Own end-to-end production for Drama en la Chamba and future original formats.

You will:

Own the Entertainment production calendar and priorities
Translate the Showrunner’s vision into production plans, briefs, timelines and deliverables
Coordinate scripts, pre-production, shoots, post-production and final delivery
Manage production companies, agencies, editors, freelancers and other partners
Own budgets and production economics, including cost per episode or format
Manage schedules, resources, feedback rounds and approvals
Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget and at the expected creative standard
Identify production risks early and recommend solutions
Build clear production workflows and approval processes
Assess capacity and recommend external or internal resources as the vertical grows
Prepare decisions, consolidate feedback and independently resolve day-to-day execution issues within established creative direction




A major measure of success is Showrunner leverage: Anna should spend significantly more time on vision, story, characters and major creative decisions—and less on production management and execution.




This is a hands-on role. You should be senior enough to build the operating model and manage partners, while comfortable getting into the details required to make the work happen.




02 — BUILD THE CONTENT MULTIPLICATION ENGINE

Build a repeatable system that transforms every hero production into a broader stream of content that extends the story and grows the audience.




Formats may include:

Trailers, teasers and recaps
Character edits and spotlights
Behind-the-scenes and cast reactions
Best moments and plot-twist edits
Shorts and platform-native cutdowns
Extended scenes and community-driven content

You will define how derivative content is planned, produced and delivered with editors, freelancers and production partners.




AI should be integral to how you work. Use AI-powered creative and editing tools to identify high-potential moments, accelerate repurposing and increase the speed and volume of content without compromising quality. Continuously test emerging tools and integrate the best into the Studio workflow.




03 — OWN ENTERTAINMENT PROGRAMMING & YOUTUBE

Own and develop SARELLY’s Entertainment YouTube channel as the dedicated home of SARELLY Entertainment.

You will:

Build and manage the Entertainment editorial calendar
Define programming cadence around episodes, seasons and key moments
Package and sequence hero and derivative content for YouTube
Oversee publishing and channel development
Optimize titles, thumbnails, formats, runtime and release cadence
Analyze watch time, completion, returning viewership and other audience signals
Use performance learnings to inform programming and production
Recommend how Entertainment extends across TikTok and Instagram
Partner with Brand Social to integrate Entertainment into SARELLY’s broader social calendar




This role owns the Entertainment programming stream and SARELLY Entertainment YouTube channel, not SARELLY’s overall social media calendar.




THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You are first and foremost a producer and operator who understands YouTube-native entertainment.




You know how to take a creative vision and build the people, process, budget and production rhythm required to deliver it consistently.




You have personally worked on content produced for YouTube and understand how format, cadence, packaging, audience behavior and iteration differ from traditional production.




Your background may come from YouTube-first entertainment, creator-led media, serialized digital content, digital publishing or a modern entertainment studio.




Traditional production experience alone is not enough. Social media expertise alone is not enough. We want someone who has actually made entertainment for digital audiences and turned creative ambition into a repeatable production operation.




WHAT MATTERS MOST

The strongest candidates will have:

Produced recurring or serialized YouTube content on a consistent publishing schedule
Experience with seasons, episodes and recurring formats—not only campaigns
Strong end-to-end production experience from development through final delivery
An AI-native mindset, constantly experimenting with tools to increase creative possibilities, speed and output
Experience owning production budgets and economics
Managed production companies, agencies, editors, freelancers and other partners
Built production workflows or systems where none existed
Strong understanding of YouTube programming and performance metrics, including packaging, cadence, retention and viewership
Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram ecosystems
Experience turning episodic content into short-form and platform-native formats
Strong editorial judgment and storytelling instincts
The judgment to protect a creative founder’s vision without needing to be the author of it
Excellent project-management skills and confidence making day-to-day decisions independently
Strong understanding of Latino audiences, culture and entertainment
Professional proficiency in Spanish and English




HOW WE’LL MEASURE SUCCESS
Production excellence: Projects are consistently delivered on time, on budget and at the expected creative standard.
Showrunner leverage: Anna focuses on creative vision and major decisions rather than production execution.
YouTube growth: SARELLY builds a distinctive, consistently programmed Entertainment destination with growing watch time, returning viewership and engagement.
Content multiplication: Every hero production generates a strong stream of derivative, platform-native storytelling.
Audience development: Audience behavior and performance data increasingly inform programming and production.
Operational excellence: Workflows become clearer, faster and less dependent on individuals.
Production economics: Clear visibility into costs and resource requirements by episode and format.
Entertainment scalability: A repeatable engine supports Drama en la Chamba and future original IP.




HOW YOU’LL WORK WITH THE REST OF SARELLY

Founder & CCO / Showrunner — Anna Sarelly

Owns creative vision, storytelling universe, characters and creative direction.




CMO / Entertainment Strategy & Growth

Owns Entertainment’s broader brand and business growth strategy, including GTM, distribution partnerships, collaborations, retail integrations and commercialization.




Entertainment Studio Producer — You

Owns the production engine, post-production, Entertainment programming and YouTube channel.




Brand Social Manager

Owns overall social strategy, master calendar and brand channels. Entertainment programming is integrated into this calendar.




Creative Studio / Associate Art Director

Protects SARELLY’s overall visual identity and brand creative standards.




WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT OWN

This role does not own SARELLY’s overall social strategy, master social calendar, day-to-day brand/product content, global creative direction, product-launch GTM, commercial partnerships, distribution negotiations or retail activation strategy.




Your primary accountability is clear:

Build and run the Entertainment production and YouTube programming engine that turns SARELLY’s creative vision into scalable original entertainment.
