description:
About the job

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique:

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. 




How You'll Make an Impact:

As a leader within the Customer Onboarding Team, you will cultivate a highly effective, close-knit, and collaborative team that consistently delivers exceptional support. By ensuring seamless and successful onboarding experiences, your leadership directly translates into immediate value realization and long-term retention for our customers.




In this role, you will champion our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission, guiding your team to move from a pure training function to a strategic business partnership. You will lead a group of Caring Rebels who model Hospitality Before Efficiency, empowering clients to use our platform to deliver an experience of Unreasonable Hospitality. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust-building, and are ready to make a significant impact by guiding, mentoring, and setting the standard for a deeply personalized customer journey, we look forward to having you lead the way!




Our Customer Onboarding Team:

Our Onboarding team is where Hospitality Hearts meet Smart Solutions. We are a fully remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals, focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can spend more time on our "human magic": building and strengthening relationships, and ensuring our customers feel confident and supported from day one. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust-building, and delivering deeply personalized hospitality moments instead of repetitive operational tasks, you and your team will feel right at home here.




What You Bring to the Team:

• Embody the Caring Rebel Mindset: 

Cultivate, mentor, motivate, and empower a world-class team of Onboarding Coaches to care for our customers and their properties just as they would for a guest in a hotel.




• Standardize the Repeatable, Personalize the Meaningful:

 Drive the adoption of AI and modern tooling across your team to eliminate administrative drag, freeing them up to focus on strategic onboarding guidance, deep product adoption, and human magic.




• Lead Performance & Growth:

 Own the preparation, execution, and follow-up for 1-on-1s, check-ins, and performance reviews. Identify, communicate, and facilitate learning and career-growth opportunities for each member of your team.




• Strategic Portfolio Management:

 Monitor a segment of Cloudbeds customers with associated retention goals, analyzing utilization and customer data independently to discover insights and improve the onboarding experience.




• Escalation & Advocacy:

 Serve as a confident, knowledgeable, and patient escalation point for complex technical or operational inquiries from clients, third-party stakeholders, and key decision-makers.




• Cross-Functional Collaboration:

 Partner with Sales, Product, and Support to convert onboarding feedback into systemic operational improvements, shortening delivery timeframes and ensuring Cloudbeds' value is realized early.




• Thought Leadership:

 Provide leadership in hospitality training, ensuring full client context is maintained throughout the journey, and that all new knowledge is captured, searchable, and reusable.




• Commercial Mindset:

 Partner with Sales to define success, demonstrate ROI, drive customer retention, promote product value, and identify upsell opportunities.




• Data-Driven Success:

 Design, implement, and track quantitative and qualitative metrics to measure the success of projects, people, and processes, including driving best practices around customer outreach for reviews.




What Sets You Up for Success:

• Show Strong AI Smarts: 

Exceptional technical aptitude and learning agility. You work seamlessly with AI, pick up new software quickly, and feel comfortable adapting to evolving technology to unlock more time for personalized relationships.




• Demonstrate Your Hospitality Heart:

 Over 2 years of direct leadership experience within a hospitality property (e.g., Front Desk Manager, Revenue Manager, Concierge) or at least 3 years of relevant Hospitality SaaS industry experience in a customer-facing leadership/matrix role. (Prior experience as a Senior or Key Account Onboarding Coach within Cloudbeds is a major plus).




• Empathy & Relationship Champion: 

High emotional intelligence with a proven ability to build trust, resolve competing priorities under pressure, and create relationships across all levels of an organization (internally and externally).




• Agile Leadership:

 Ability to manage people, processes, and accounts effectively in an agile system and matrix reporting environment, while overseeing comprehensive learning and development plans for your team.




• Clear Communicator: 

Ability to clearly, concisely, and confidently synthesize technical and business concepts in both written and verbal contexts.




• Operational Excellence: 

Highly accountable, data-driven, and detail-oriented with background experience in modern operating systems (CRMs like Salesforce, OTAs, PMS backgrounds, etc.).




• Inclusive Outlook: 

Comfortable leading and working alongside people from diverse cultures and backgrounds.




Recommended Skills to Stand Out:

1. Fluency or working knowledge of Spanish, Portuguese, English, Thai, or Tagalog.

2. Project Management or Change Management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile, Prosci).

3. Hospitality degree preferred.




What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. 




Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

At Ruvixx, we are building a smarter digital engine. We are a team that values data, strategic experimentation, and clear, measurable results. We are seeking a mid-level Digital Marketing Specialist to lead our Digital pod. In this critical role, you will own the architecture and management of our entire digital growth engine—spanning web, paid search/social (Google/LinkedIn), content syndication, and lead capture.

Core Requirements

Performance & Attribution Expert: You are highly confident in GA4 (events, explorations), GTM, and Looker Studio. You understand attribution modeling and B2B funnel analysis.
Paid Media Strategist: You have hands-on experience running and scaling campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads for B2B audiences.
Web & CRO Advocate: You have a strong grasp of A/B testing, landing page optimization, and UX principles.
B2B Tech Marketer: You have a working knowledge of B2B SEO principles and marketing automation platforms (Marketo or Salesforce).
A Data Storyteller: You can translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and leadership.

How to Apply

Ruvixx is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. If you are passionate about building data-driven growth engines and meet the criteria above, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every single box.

Whether for technology-focused roles or diverse non-technical industries, we are committed to empowering businesses with the best talent around the globe.




Business Development Representative (BDR) 

Full-Time EST Working Hours | Mastery of English | $2,500+On-Target Earnings 

● Base: $1,500 USD/month | OTE: $2,500 USD/month, paid in USD 




About the Client

Our Client builds ERP software purpose-built for wholesale bakeries, bakery distributors, and large professional retail bakeries, helping them manage orders, production, inventory, and payments in one place. We're growing fast and hiring our first dedicated BDR to help us scale into the North American market. 




The Role 

You'll own the top of the funnel. That means calling wholesale bakery owners and operators across the US, qualifying them, and booking discovery calls for our Account Executive , every day, with discipline and consistency. 

You won't be building the playbook from scratch. We're providing proven call scripts, fully built email sequences, and structured onboarding so you can focus on what actually matters: execution and relationships. What we need from you is the energy, accountability, and people skills to run those plays well and improve on them over time. 




What You'll Do 

● Run daily outbound cold calls and email sequences to wholesale bakery owners, operators, and distributors across the US 

● Use Apollo for prospecting, sequencing, and contact management; HubSpot as your CRM for logging all activity and outcomes 

● Qualify prospects by confirming decision-maker, business scale, and product fit 

● Book qualified discovery calls directly on your Account Executive's calendar 

● Hit weekly targets across dials, live connects, qualified conversations, and meetings booked 

● Join weekly check-ins with Account Executives and Head of Sales 




What We're Looking For 

● English fluency:written and spoken; all prospecting is with US-based business owners. This is a firm requirement. 

● Real cold calling experience, you know what high-volume outreach feels like and you don't shy away from the phone 

● 2–3 years in an SDR, BDR, or sales-adjacent role, ideally in SaaS, software, or tech. Experience selling and booking meetings for B2B software is a must

● Available 9am–5pm EST, Monday–Friday, please be clear-eyed about what this means for your time zone before applying 

● Reliable internet and a quiet, professional space for calls 







This Role Is a Strong Fit If You... 

● Genuinely enjoy cold outreach and find rhythm in high-activity work 

● Are looking for USD compensation with real upside, not a vague bonus structure 

● Want a company that does the enablement work upfront instead of leaving you to figure it out alone 

● You’re looking to build a career in sales and are excited about the opportunity to further refine your skills in a professional environment 




What We Offer 

● Base: $1,500 USD/month | OTE: $2,500+ USD/month, paid in USD 

● Fully remote from anywhere

● Complete sales enablement from day one: scripts, sequences, and structured training 

● Direct mentorship from company leadership 

● Clear growth path as the team scales, this is the first BDR role and we're building around it

About the job

A little bit about us:




We are Belvo, an open finance API platform with the bold vision of democratizing access to financial services in Latin America. We enable any financial innovator to access and interpret financial data, as well as initiate payments from their end-users accounts. We’re turning the messy complexities of the Latin American financial ecosystem into a modern set of tools to access and interpret data and move money in a seamless and secure way.

We’re a highly-technical, passionate, and driven team. We are more than 90 people and our team currently represents 20 nationalities. We have offices in São Paulo and Mexico City – while a large portion of us work remotely.

We are tackling a very stimulating problem: connecting fintech innovators with legacy financial infrastructure. We strive to go beyond the limits of what is possible today and to do so in an elegant and developer-first way.

Since starting our adventure in May 2019, we have raised $71m from the leading VC investors globally.

You can read more about our company here and about our team and culture here. Also, head to our blog for more news about what we’re building and how we work.




About the team:

We work in cross-functional, autonomous teams. We follow continuous delivery best practices executed on top of a modern technology stack. 
Our products are built for developers, by developers. Technological excellence is at the heart of what we do. 
We are pragmatic and customer-focused. We strive to find the right set of trade-offs in order to validate our hypothesis as early as possible, iterating on our products based on customer feedback.

Job Title: Digital Marketing Strategist / Account Manager




About the Company:

Our client is a dynamic, fast-paced digital marketing and sales firm rooted in strong values and a faith-inspired mission. They are a community of creative thinkers, proactive problem-solvers, and growth-minded professionals working to drive real impact through innovation and collaboration.




Job Description:

As a Digital Marketing Strategist / Account Manager, you will play a critical role in managing client relationships, owning account management responsibilities, planning strategic marketing initiatives, and guiding internal teams to deliver exceptional results. You will collaborate directly with clients, support cross-functional teams, and partner with Executive Leadership to determine the best paths forward.




Responsibilities of the role:

• Work 1-on-1 with clients to develop comprehensive marketing plans.

• Understand client goals, translate them into actionable strategies, and ensure deliverables align with expectations.

• Report progress to internal teams and help ensure tasks stay on track.

• Serve as the main point of contact for assigned clients, building strong, trusted relationships.

• Lead regular client check-ins, status updates, and strategy conversations.

• Ensure client needs, expectations, deadlines, and priorities are clearly communicated to the internal team.

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve client results, strengthen relationships, and add value.

• Support client retention by maintaining consistent communication, accountability, and a high level of service.

• Escalate client concerns, blockers, or strategic needs to leadership when appropriate.

• Coordinate with creative, content, web, paid media, and leadership teams to keep projects moving forward.

• Monitor project timelines, deliverables, and client requests to ensure work is completed accurately and on time.

• Prepare meeting agendas, recap notes, next steps, and follow-ups after client calls.

• Help manage client feedback, approvals, and scope conversations with clarity and professionalism.

• Keep internal teams aligned on priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

• Help ensure client communications are timely, professional, and organized.

• Track project status and flag potential risks, delays, or changes in scope.

• Support and oversee email campaigns, including setup, optimization, and reporting.

• Conduct data analysis and prepare performance reports for clients and leadership.

• Assist in sales enablement efforts through strategic planning, tool setup, and content alignment.

• Provide direction or oversight on SEO, social media management, paid digital spend, and general web technologies.

• Help connect marketing performance insights to strategic client recommendations.

• Have a solid understanding of how the CRM works and how information is organized.

• Manage HubSpot to support the sales, marketing, and customer service teams.

• Set up and monitor basic automated tasks and simple processes in the CRM.

• Keep the database clean, organized, and up to date.

• Create easy-to-understand reports and dashboards to show overall progress.

• Troubleshoot common HubSpot issues and help team members use the platform effectively.




Required Experience and Qualifications:

• 2+ years of experience in digital strategy, marketing management, account management, client services, or a CRM-focused role.

• Strong understanding of marketing databases, CRMs, and workflow architecture; HubSpot experience strongly preferred.

• Experience managing client relationships, expectations, timelines, and deliverables.

• Ability to translate complex data and client needs into clear, actionable plans.

• Strong communication and presentation skills for client-facing interactions.

• Familiarity with key digital marketing functions, including email, SEO, paid media, social, and web strategy.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients, priorities, and moving pieces.

• Ability to confidently navigate new tools, technologies, and client environments.




Preferred Skills:

• Strong HubSpot experience is highly beneficial and preferred.

About the job

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. You are a passionate business builder at heart. You get energized by tackling complex, challenging, often ambiguous problems and driving real impact across a business. About the job

Social Media Community Manager

Location: Remote – Latin America

Schedule: Full-Time | 40 hours/week

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM ET

Compensation: $6-$8 per hour

Language: Fluent English & Spanish required




About the Role

We are looking for a highly proactive, bilingual Social Media Community Manager to help a growing U.S.-based business stay connected with its online community, respond to prospective clients, and convert conversations into appointments.




This is not a traditional content-focused social media role. The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people, whether through DMs, comments, WhatsApp, or phone calls, and knows how to turn conversations into meaningful business opportunities.




Key Responsibilities:

Monitor and respond to DMs, comments, messages, and inquiries across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
Engage authentically with followers and contacts through comments, greetings, friend requests, and other relationship-building activities.
Represent the business owner’s warm, friendly, and relationship-focused brand voice in online conversations.

Schedule qualified appointments directly on the calendar.
Re-engage older leads and contacts who may have fallen through the cracks.
Maintain organized records of conversations, follow-ups, and appointments.
Proactively identify missed messages, neglected leads, and opportunities requiring follow-up.
Suggest ways to improve communication, follow-up, and engagement processes.

Fluent or near-native Spanish and strong professional English.
2+ years of experience in social media/community engagement or managing customer conversations through social platforms.
Comfortable communicating with potential clients
Strong relationship-building and conversational skills.
Highly organized and able to manage multiple conversations and follow-ups simultaneously.

Able to communicate naturally and warmly with a predominantly Hispanic/Latino audience.

Experience supporting real estate professionals or other relationship-driven service businesses.
Experience reactivating old leads or working from an existing CRM/database.
Experience with Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Messenger, and WhatsApp.
Experience creating or maintaining chatbots and automated messaging workflows.
Familiarity with AI tools for customer communication and productivity.
Basic social media content creation or short-form video editing skills.




Who Will Thrive in This Role?

You may be a great fit if you have worked as a Community Manager, Social Media Engagement Specialist, or Customer Engagement Specialist and your experience crosses both digital communication.




We are especially interested in people who see an unanswered message, neglected lead, or missed opportunity and take initiative to do something about it.

Comfortable working independently through ambiguity and proactively identifying problems and opportunities
Creative, curious, and resourceful, with a focus on developing practical, scalable solutions
Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with Marketing Analytics and nontechnical stakeholders


At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

This role will have access to sensitive and/or confidential employee or customer personally identifiable information (PII) and/or Company financial information, and therefore will be subject to background checks upon receiving a conditional offer of employment. 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Nice to Have


Experience using integration tools like Zapier, Make (Integromat), or Webhooks to connect HubSpot with third-party tools.

100% Remote Position within LATAM.

title: Key Account Executive
description:
About the job

AVENTA busca incorporar a un Key Account Executive para desarrollar cuentas clave y generar

oportunidades de grandes proyectos en los segmentos de hotelería, desarrolladores inmobiliarios, despachos de arquitectura, constructoras y project managers.

La persona será responsable de abrir relaciones comerciales, detectar proyectos desde etapas

tempranas, posicionar a AVENTA como asesor y proveedor estratégico, y acompañar las

oportunidades durante ciclos de venta consultivos y de largo plazo.

AVENTA se encuentra en un proceso de transformación y crecimiento. Por ello, buscamos un

perfil con iniciativa, criterio comercial y capacidad para trabajar en un entorno donde algunos

procesos todavía están en construcción. La persona deberá identificar áreas de mejora,

proponer soluciones y ayudar a profesionalizar la operación comercial.

La posición puede tener como base:

● Ciudad de México y zona metropolitana.

● Región del Bajío, preferentemente en San Miguel de Allende, Querétaro, Celaya o ciudades

cercanas a la planta de AVENTA.

Se requiere disponibilidad para viajar, visitar cuentas, despachos, obras y proyectos, así como

acudir periódicamente a la planta en San Miguel de Allende.




Responsabilidades principales

● Prospectar y desarrollar cuentas estratégicas de grandes proyectos.

● Construir relaciones con propietarios, desarrolladores, arquitectos, diseñadores,

constructoras, operadores hoteleros, compras y otros participantes de decisión.

● Investigar cuentas y detectar proyectos desde las etapas de planeación, diseño y

especificación.

● Coordinarse con las áreas técnica, cotizaciones, operaciones, marketing, producción e

instalación para desarrollar propuestas viables.

● Dar seguimiento a oportunidades con ciclos de venta largos y múltiples participantes.

● Elaborar planes de cuenta, mapas de relaciones y estrategias de entrada.

● Mantener actualizado HubSpot con contactos, actividades, proyectos, etapas, montos,

probabilidades y siguientes acciones.




Perfil que buscamos

● Experiencia mínima de cinco años en ventas B2B, cuentas clave, especificación o

desarrollo de negocios.

● Experiencia comercial en construcción, arquitectura, desarrollos inmobiliarios, hotelería,

acabados, materiales, productos premium o sectores relacionados.

● Evidencia de haber generado proyectos nuevos, no solamente administrado cuentas

existentes.

● Excelente comunicación, presentación ejecutiva y capacidad de generar confianza.

● Disponibilidad para viajar y visitar clientes, despachos, obras y proyectos.




Experiencia deseable

● Relación vigente con despachos de arquitectura, desarrolladores, constructoras, cadenas

hoteleras o project managers.

● Experiencia en productos arquitectónicos premium o soluciones técnicas para construcción.

About the job

COORDINADOR(A) DE OBRA CIVIL Y ESTRUCTURA

Especialidad: estructuras de concreto y cimentación profunda




En BYGGO Gerencia de Proyectos creemos que los buenos resultados comienzan con las personas.

Buscamos integrar a un(a) Ingeniero(a) Civil con experiencia específica en estructuras de concreto y cimentaciones profundas, que quiera aportar sus conocimientos, asumir un nuevo reto y continuar desarrollándose profesionalmente.




📍 INFORMACIÓN DEL PROYECTO




🌎 Ubicación: Zona Metropolitana de Guadalajara.

📅 Duración inicial: 3 meses.




Existe la posibilidad de continuar en la empresa al concluir el proyecto, de acuerdo con el desempeño, las aptitudes y los conocimientos demostrados, así como con las vacantes disponibles en ese momento.




🔹 ¿QUÉ HARÁS EN ESTA POSICIÓN?

• Coordinar y supervisar la ejecución de la cimentación profunda y la estructura de concreto del proyecto.

• Verificar los procesos de excavación, preparación, perforación, armado, colado y ejecución de los elementos de cimentación.

• Supervisar la correcta ejecución de pilas, pilotes, dados, contratrabes, losas de cimentación y demás elementos contemplados en el proyecto estructural.

• Coordinar la ejecución de columnas, muros, trabes, losas y demás elementos de concreto reforzado.

• Revisar planos estructurales, detalles constructivos, especificaciones técnicas y procedimientos de obra.

• Verificar armados, cimbras, apuntalamientos, recubrimientos, niveles, ejes y tolerancias antes de cada colado.

• Supervisar la recepción, colocación, vibrado, curado y control de calidad del concreto.

• Dar seguimiento a pruebas de laboratorio, muestreos, revenimientos y resultados de resistencia.

• Coordinar contratistas, proveedores y frentes de trabajo relacionados con la obra civil y estructural.

• Monitorear avances, calidad, programa y cumplimiento técnico.

• Identificar riesgos, desviaciones y problemas constructivos, proponiendo soluciones oportunas.

• Elaborar reportes de avance, registrar pendientes y mantener comunicación constante con la gerencia de proyecto, el cliente y el equipo de obra.




🔹 ¿QUÉ PERFIL BUSCAMOS?

• Ingeniería Civil concluida; este requisito es indispensable.

• Experiencia comprobable en supervisión y coordinación de estructuras de concreto.

• Experiencia específica en cimentaciones profundas.

• Conocimiento sólido de procesos constructivos, acero de refuerzo, cimbras, concreto y control de calidad.

• Capacidad para interpretar planos estructurales, especificaciones, memorias y detalles constructivos.

• Experiencia en proyectos de edificación.

• Manejo de AutoCAD, MS Project y paquetería Office.

• Capacidad para coordinar equipos y contratistas en campo.

• Liderazgo, organización, comunicación y enfoque en la solución de problemas.

• Residencia actual en la Zona Metropolitana de Guadalajara.




🔹 ¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?

💰 Sueldo: $30,000.00 MXN libres mensuales.

🚀 Posición presencial e incorporación inmediata.

🤝 Ambiente profesional, cercano y colaborativo.

📈 Posibilidades de crecimiento acordes con tus aptitudes, conocimientos y resultados.

🏗️ Oportunidad de participar en un proyecto relevante y contribuir directamente al crecimiento de BYGGO.




⚠️ INFORMACIÓN IMPORTANTE

Esta posición es presencial y no contempla apoyo de reubicación, viáticos ni modalidad remota.

Agradecemos postularse únicamente si actualmente resides en la Zona Metropolitana de Guadalajara.

Si cuentas con experiencia sólida en estructuras de concreto y cimentación profunda, y quieres formar parte de una empresa que valora tanto los resultados como a las personas que los hacen posibles, nos encantará conocerte.

description:
About the job

🚀 We’re Hiring: HubSpot Solutions Architect (Technical Lead)




Most HubSpot agencies do standard implementations. We do the heavy lifting. We don't just set up pipelines; we engineer complex migrations, architect multi-system custom integrations, and build hyper-personalized data experiences.




As our HubSpot Solutions Architect, you will be the technical mastermind behind our most complex client projects. You will act as the translator between business requirements and technical realities—scoping bespoke solutions, mapping data architectures, and leading the technical delivery from kick-off to deployment. You won’t just be a consultant; you’ll be the technical authority guiding our developers and clients to success.




What You’ll Be Doing




System Architecture & Documentation: Design robust HubSpot architectures for enterprise clients and produce clear technical schematics, process maps, and data flow diagrams using tools like Lucidchart, Miro, or Visio.
Complex Integrations: Architect custom connections between HubSpot, ERPs, and legacy systems using enterprise-grade middleware (Workato, Zapier, Make) alongside custom API strategies.
Migrations & Dual-Syncs: Lead technical strategies for large data migrations and design complex, ongoing dual-sync environments between HubSpot and other platforms, such as Salesforce and NetSuite.
Data Governance & Hygiene: Establish firm rules and scalable standards for system compliance, data integrity, and ongoing platform cleanliness across all client Hubs.
Technical Scoping & Pre-Sales: Partner with the sales team to audit prospective client tech stacks, scope out technical requirements, and build proof-of-concept solutions.
Project Leadership: Act as the ultimate technical safety net for the delivery team, ensuring that what we architect is exactly what gets built and deployed.




What You Bring to the Table




Proven Experience: 3+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience architecting and configuring complex solutions within the HubSpot ecosystem.
Technical Comprehension: A solid working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, SQL, and JavaScript. You don't need to write the code, but you must know how, when, and why developers will use them for custom integrations, Data Hub workflows, and serverless functions.
Deep HubSpot Expertise: You know the ecosystem inside and out, including Sales, Marketing, Service, CMS, and Operations Hub.
Client-Facing Confidence: You are highly comfortable leading technical workshops, challenging assumptions, and explaining complex backend concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Agency Agility: You thrive in a fast-paced, multi-client environment and know how to manage competing technical priorities effectively.
Certifications: You hold advanced HubSpot certifications (Solutions Architecture, Data Integration, etc.).

Join an official TikTok Partner driving $20M+ in monthly GMV, placing you at the forefront of the global social commerce revolution.

Demonstrates proficiency in Google Sheets, CRM tools like Salesforce, and project management software such as Monday.com or Lark to track complex workflows.


Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?


Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

About the job

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible. 

You will improve value and service to your customers and improve supply chain efficiency. In addition, you will use internal and customer data to optimize plans and to support joint initiatives with strategic customers.

How You Will Contribute

You will:


Be the single point of contact for your customer portfolio
Manage escalations for complaints and disputes, and handle and resolve issues to ensure maximum customer satisfaction
Help achieve business and commercial objectives by achieving customer service targets, supporting the improvement agenda (internal process and external customer) and developing collaborative relationships cross-functionally and with customers
Work with the order fulfilment team to report on KPIs, including root-cause analysis and improvement initiatives
Use customer data to monitor on-shelf availability, depot-to-store service, stock holding and promotional sales. Use this information to drive decision making internally and with the customer in ways that maximize service levels and sales



What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:


Experience in CS&L and with customers
Experience in fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods company
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
SAP knowledge and expertise in MS Office
Customer orientation, strong influencing and communication skills
Strong focus on delivering productivities, service and KPIs
Team player, accountable, proactive thinking, flexibility



Objective

Lead logistics and customer service collaboration at an advanced and comprehensive level for Grupo Walmart across the Cheese and Crackers categories. The role seeks to maximize supply chain efficiency, optimize commercial value, and drive customer satisfaction through data analysis, replenishment tracking, and the development of high-impact collaborative plans.

Responsibilities

Relationship Management & Strategic Collaboration:

Serve as the single point of contact for the Walmart portfolio.

Design and actively participate in the construction of the AVP (Annual Value Plan) and collaborative plans in partnership with the customer's CPFRs.

Build and maintain strong collaborative relationships at a cross-functional level (internal teams and Walmart's commercial/supply teams).

Operational Tracking & Replenishment Analysis:

Conduct consistent, weekly tracking of replenishments, inventory levels, and performance through Walmart's specific portals.

Monitor and analyze key metrics such as On-Shelf Availability, DC-to-store service, days of stock, and promotional sales to make decisions that maximize sales and service levels.

Work hand-in-hand with the Order Fulfillment team for KPI reporting, root-cause analysis, and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives.

Issue Management & Continuous Improvement:

Map and resolve escalations, disputes, or operational complaints to ensure compliance with service targets and the business's commercial objectives.

Requirements

Experience in Customer Service & Logistics (CS&L) within the FMCG / CPG industry.

Solid, prior experience with Grupo Walmart: Deep knowledge of their replenishment processes, portals, and key logistics metrics.

Advanced proficiency in SAP and MS Office Suite (especially Excel for data analysis).

No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez México has been in the country since 1927 and currently employs 6,000 wonderful people. Our diverse portfolio includes iconic and mouth-watering global brands such as Trident, Oreo, Philadelphia, and local jewels like Clorets and Bubbaloo. We are leaders in the making of cream cheese, powdered beverages and confections—in fact, we make seven out of every 10 chewing gums consumed by Mexicans. Our growth is supported by our cutting-edge manufacturing facilities, such as our Puebla Plant and Nuevo León HUB, which are the largest gums, candies and biscuits factories in the world in terms of volume. You can buy are products in 900,000 places in Mexico. Responsabilidades

• Planear, configurar y optimizar campañas de generación de leads en Meta Ads y TikTok Ads.

• Administrar el presupuesto diario y reasignarlo según el costo por lead y por cita agendada.

• Configurar y mantener la infraestructura de medición: Business Manager, Business Center, píxeles, Conversions API y Events API.

• Construir y mantener la conexión entre las plataformas y el CRM, y devolver las señales de calidad de lead para optimizar por cierre y no solo por volumen.

• Diseñar y probar formularios instantáneos, ángulos creativos y ganchos, sosteniendo una cadencia de 8 a 12 creativos nuevos al mes.

• Escribir guiones y briefs creativos para video vertical nativo.

• Entregar un reporte semanal con gasto, CPL, citas agendadas y costo por cita, junto con las decisiones que se derivan de esos números.

• Trabajar de la mano con el equipo comercial para verificar la calidad real de los leads.




Requisitos

• Mínimo 2 años administrando presupuesto propio en Meta Ads y al menos 1 año en TikTok Ads.

• Experiencia comprobable en campañas de generación de leads, no únicamente en e-commerce o alcance.

• Dominio de Meta Business Manager y TikTok Business Center a nivel administrador.

• Conocimiento práctico de píxel, Conversions API, eventos, UTMs y atribución.

• Capacidad de leer un reporte y explicar por qué subió el CPL: CPM, CTR o tasa de envío de formulario.

• Manejo de al menos un CRM y de herramientas de automatización.

• Criterio creativo: saber qué hace que un video funcione en TikTok y qué no.

• Disponibilidad para trabajo presencial en Azcapotzalco, Ciudad de México.




Deseable

• Experiencia en negocios de servicios con venta por llamada o cita.

• Edición básica de video vertical.

• Manejo de Looker Studio u hojas de cálculo avanzadas para reportería.

• Experiencia con Google Ads.




Ofrecemos

• Sueldo mensual: [definir rango].

• [Esquema de bonos por resultados, si aplica].

• [Prestaciones].

• Presupuesto de pauta real que administrar desde el primer mes.

• Autonomía sobre la estrategia y acceso directo a dirección, sin capas intermedias.




Proceso de selección

Al postular, incluye en tu mensaje tres datos: 1) el presupuesto mensual más alto que hayas administrado, 2) tu CPL promedio y en qué industria lo lograste, y 3) qué harías en tus primeros 30 días con una cuenta nueva. Las postulaciones que no incluyan esta información no avanzan.

description:
About the job

Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead
About Flowerburst

We are the fastest growing and most disruptive business in publishing since Amazon. 




Flowerburst starts movements — ideas that burst into life radiantly. Publishing is broken: more than 80 percent of Americans feel they have a book in them, and only about 1 percent ever publish it. After taking 2-3 years to go to market, nine out of ten traditionally published titles fail to turn a profit. Why? There are three middle men between the author and end customer, and there simply isn’t enough margin for any party to invest in marketing. 




Success on self-publishing platforms like Amazon KDP is even more elusive – they leave authors marketing blind and without cashflow: Amazon KDP doesn't show authors who their customers are and where they came from, and pay 60+ days after a sale is made. The result is centuries of gatekeeping in which the best ideas rarely reach the people who need them, dying on shelves in the back of bookstores, undiscovered. We are building the company that fixes this: an AI publishing platform fused with social, direct-to-consumer commerce. The AI platform allows anyone, anywhere to compile their idea in book form - helping the author exactly where they need it. Social commerce allows authors to place books in the heart of culture – social media feeds – to get discovered, even by audiences who typically don’t read books. Anyone, anywhere can write a book and get it to the masses. The end goal is a literary revolution.




The flywheel is already turning and validation has been immediate. In under 12 months since prototype launch, we’ve grown to $7.5M ARR (GMV run rate), and we are one of the top book sellers on social commerce platforms like TikTok Shop; we operate our own publishing imprints, and a creator/affiliate program of hundreds of active creators. Over the next quarter, we’re releasing our own titles (we publish at the speed of movements, not years), and within the next year, we’re opening up our platform so any author – regardless of station in life – can put their idea on paper and bring it to people who are eager to hear it.




The team is scrappy, ambitious, fast-moving, and highly entrepreneurial.




About the Role

We are hiring a Creator Partnerships & Affiliate Growth Lead to own and scale one of the most important parts of Flowerburst’s growth engine: our TikTok Shop affiliate and VIP Special Ops creator program.




This is not ordinary affiliate management.




Flowerburst has access to a large catalog of top-selling books and uses performance data to identify products with viral TikTok Shop potential before the broader market fully catches on. When we find those products, we bring them to selected creators with a compelling offer: higher commissions, product insights, performance analysis, content hooks, sample support, GMV Max support, and a real partnership designed to help them grow their GMV.




The goal is to help creators win. When creators consistently post around the right products, the upside can be substantial for both the creator and Flowerburst.




You will manage relationships with top TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators, convert them into active VIP partners, and help them produce more videos that sell books. You will be responsible for turning creator interest into posting commitments, repeat content, GMV growth, and long-term creator partnerships.




This is a creator-facing growth role for someone who is organized, persuasive, commercially minded, and excited to help build a repeatable creator revenue engine.




What You’ll Do

You will manage Flowerburst’s VIP creator pipeline from outreach to activation.




This includes identifying promising creators, sending personalized outreach, following up, tracking next steps, coordinating samples, sharing product briefs, asking for posting commitments, monitoring creator activity, and reporting what is working.




You will help build creator launch pods around new book releases and high-potential VIP products. For each campaign, you will help match the right creators with the right products, share content angles, track sample delivery and first posts, and encourage creators to post multiple videos rather than just one.




You will build relationships with creators so they see Flowerburst as one of their best affiliate partners. You will give them useful product insights, help them understand why certain books may resonate with their audiences, and make them feel like part of an insider program.




You will also help build the operating system behind the program: clean tracking, weekly reporting, repeatable follow-up workflows, creator briefs, and simple SOPs.




Responsibilities
Manage a pipeline of TikTok Shop affiliates and BookTok creators
Invite high-potential creators into Flowerburst’s VIP Special Ops Program
Send warm, persuasive, personalized outreach and follow-up messages
Clearly explain the creator opportunity and why selected products may help creators grow GMV
Track creator status, next steps, samples, posting commitments, and performance
Coordinate with internal operations on creator samples
Help creators understand which books to post and what angles may work
Build and manage creator launch pods for new book releases and VIP products
Ask creators for specific posting commitments
Track first post date, number of videos posted, repeat posting, and GMV
Re-engage creators who have sampled from Flowerburst in the past
Report weekly on creator pipeline, activity, and performance
Identify which creators, products, and content angles deserve more investment
Improve outreach, follow-up, campaign briefs, and creator management workflows




What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will learn Flowerburst’s products, creator program, and TikTok Shop affiliate workflow. You will understand the VIP Special Ops pitch deeply enough to explain it clearly to creators. You will clean up the creator tracker, follow up with warm creator leads, make sure every creator has a clear status and next action, help launch active creator pods, and establish weekly reporting.




You will also build a repeatable workflow for creator outreach, onboarding, follow-up, and campaign management. You will increase the number of VIP creators actively posting, track sample-to-post and post-to-GMV performance, help creators post multiple videos per campaign, own creator follow-up with minimal founder involvement, and create reusable creator briefs and campaign templates.




In your first 60 days, you will own the VIP creator program day-to-day, manage multiple creator launch pods, improve creator activation and repeat posting rates, and give leadership clear reporting on what is working.




In your first 90 days, you will help turn Flowerburst’s creator program into a predictable launch channel for new books and high-potential VIP products.




You Might Be a Fit If
You write excellent English
You communicate in a tone that is warm, casual, direct, and professional
You are highly organized and detail-oriented
You follow up consistently without needing reminders
You are comfortable managing many conversations at once
You have experience in creator partnerships, influencer marketing, affiliate marketing, account management, sales development, customer success, ecommerce, or partnerships

You can work independently and take ownership
You are comfortable asking people for commitments and following up when they do not deliver
You can understand performance data and translate it into simple, compelling creator-facing communication

Experience with Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center, affiliate platforms, or creator CRM tools




Location and Schedule

This is a full-time remote role.

We are equally interested in candidates based in South Africa, LATAM, and the Philippines.

You must be able to communicate with U.S.-based TikTok creators and affiliates during meaningful U.S. business-hour overlap, especially Eastern and Pacific afternoons.




Compensation

Expected base compensation:

$2,500–$3,500/month USD
Up to $4,000/month USD for an exceptional candidate




There is also significant performance bonus potential for measurable GMV growth.




This role has meaningful upside for the right person. If you help Flowerburst activate strong creators, increase repeat posting, and materially grow GMV from managed creator relationships, we want you to share in that success.




The bonus structure will be finalized after baseline performance and attribution are clear, but it will be tied to outcomes such as creator activation, videos posted, repeat posting, and incremental GMV from managed creators.




What We’re Looking For

We are not looking for a generic virtual assistant.




We are looking for someone who feels like a high-performing account manager, creator partnerships operator, or affiliate growth manager. You should be proactive, commercially minded, organized, and excellent in written communication.




The goal is not just to send messages. The goal is to turn creator relationships into videos, repeat posting, GMV, and long-term creator partnerships.




The right person should be excited about the opportunity Flowerburst can offer creators. We are bringing creators data-backed product opportunities, improved economics, performance support, and a real chance to grow their GMV.

title: Fleet Acquisition Supervisor
description:
About the job

En PartRunner conectamos a las empresas que mueven mercancía de gran volumen con la capacidad de transporte que lo hace posible. Nuestra red integra flotas PyME y transportistas independientes en distintos puntos de México, con unidades que van desde vehículos ligeros hasta carga pesada.




Hoy el reto es construir capacidad instalada en los mercados correctos, con un equipo que replique el método en varias plazas al mismo tiempo.

Por eso buscamos un/a Fleet Acquisition Supervisor que construya la capacidad de transporte para una de nuestras cuentas de mayor volumen: una operación de e-commerce a escala nacional, con estándares de servicio altos y crecimiento sostenido.

Vas a dirigir a un equipo de negociadores regionales, cerrar las cuentas de mayor peso y construir la capacidad antes de que la demanda la pida.




El desafío

Este no es un rol de gestión de proveedores ni de administración de equipo a distancia. Es comercial, con responsabilidad sobre la capacidad de toda la red.

Del otro lado hay una cuenta que no espera. Cuando la demanda sube, la capacidad tiene que estar. Tu trabajo es que el equipo la construya con anticipación, no con urgencia, y que lo que funciona en una plaza se vuelva método replicable en las demás.




Lo que harás

1. Liderazgo y Desarrollo del Equipo Comercial

Supervisar, coordinar y desarrollar al equipo de negociadores regionales.

Asignar territorios, metas y prioridades según el déficit de capacidad de cada mercado.

Realizar sesiones semanales de pipeline review: avance por etapa, calidad de prospección y riesgos de cierre.

Detectar brechas de desempeño e implementar planes de desarrollo con objetivos observables.

Ser el primer nivel de escalación en negociaciones complejas o condiciones fuera de estándar.




2. Estrategia de Cobertura y Crecimiento de Red

Traducir la demanda proyectada de la cuenta en objetivos concretos de adquisición: cuántas unidades, de qué tipo, en qué ciudad y para cuándo.

Anticipar picos estacionales y campañas, asegurando capacidad disponible antes de que se necesite.

Priorizar plazas y segmentos de flota según el déficit real de capacidad, no según facilidad de cierre.

Diseñar y estandarizar el método de prospección para que sea replicable por cualquier integrante del equipo.

Abrir nuevos canales de captación y medir su rendimiento contra los existentes.




3. Ejecución Comercial Directa

Gestionar personalmente la negociación con flotas de alto volumen y contrapartes estratégicas.

Mantener cuota individual en las cuentas de mayor impacto para el negocio.

Acompañar a los negociadores en cierres críticos y en campo cuando el tamaño de la operación lo amerite.




4. Economics de la Red

Negociar y sostener condiciones que equilibren competitividad para el transportista y rentabilidad para PartRunner.

Monitorear el costo de adquisición por unidad activa y el tiempo entre cierre y primer viaje.

Identificar en qué plazas se está pagando de más por capacidad y proponer ajustes.




5. Enfoque Analítico y Digital

Monitorear indicadores de adquisición, activación y retención por plaza, tipo de unidad y canal.

Detectar patrones de churn de transportistas antes de que impacten la capacidad disponible.

Identificar tareas manuales del proceso de afiliación y traducirlas en requerimientos accionables para producto y sistemas.

Asegurar la disciplina de registro en CRM del equipo completo: sin dato, la etapa no existe.




6. Reporteo y Mejora Continua

Generar y presentar reportes semanales y mensuales por mercado con KPIs clave: unidades afiliadas · % activación · tiempo a primer viaje · costo de adquisición · % retención a 90 días.

Reportar el estado de capacidad frente a los compromisos de servicio de la cuenta, con alertas tempranas cuando un mercado vaya corto.

Presentar hallazgos e iniciativas a dirección de forma clara y basada en datos.

Realizar análisis post-mortem de plazas que no alcanzaron objetivo y proponer correcciones concretas.




Lo que necesitamos de ti

Must Have

3+ años de experiencia en adquisición, ventas o desarrollo de proveedores.

3+ años en transporte, logística, paquetería o marketplaces digitales.

1+ año liderando equipos comerciales, con responsabilidad sobre la meta del equipo y no solo la propia.

Experiencia negociando con flotas o transportistas de alto volumen.

Manejo de CRM y disciplina de gestión de pipeline, propia y de equipo.

Dominio intermedio-avanzado de Excel / Google Sheets y experiencia elaborando reportes ejecutivos.

Residir en Guadalajara o zona metropolitana.

Disponibilidad para viaje foráneo eventual a las plazas del equipo.




Nice to Have

Experiencia abriendo plazas o mercados nuevos desde cero.

Experiencia previa en startups o entornos de alto crecimiento.

Experiencia en prospección digital de fletes.

Manejo de herramientas de BI (Power BI, Looker, Google Data Studio).




Competencias Clave

Tomas decisiones rápidas con criterio y datos.

Alto nivel de seguimiento y cierre: no dejas hilos sueltos, ni tuyos ni del equipo.

Te autogestionas: en remoto y sin supervisión presencial, sostienes tu ritmo y el de tu equipo.

Curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA, y las usas para hacer más con menos.




Nuestra oferta de valor

Sueldo base competitivo + esquema de bonos por desempeño + prestaciones de ley y superiores + esquema 100% remoto. 




¿Listo/a para el reto?

Envía tu CV a f.castillo@partrunner.com o postúlate directamente por este medio.







En PartRunner promovemos un entorno de trabajo inclusivo y libre de discriminación. Todas las decisiones de nuestros procesos se basan en competencias, experiencia y potencial, sin distinción de género, edad, origen, orientación, identidad o cualquier otra condición.

Por eso buscamos un/a Fleet Acquisition Specialist que viva en alguna de estas plazas y expanda nuestra red de transportistas desde ahí. Lo que harás

Construir y mantener tu propio pipeline en CRM, con seguimiento disciplinado por etapa.

2. Negociación y Cierre de Afiliaciones

description:
About the job

Reports to: Anna Sarelly, Founder & Creative Director

Location: Mexico City

Type: Full-time

Experience: 3+ years







ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is one of Mexico’s fastest-growing beauty brands, born at the intersection of beauty, culture, entertainment and community.




Founded by Anna Sarelly and Rémi Martini, SARELLY is building a new generation of beauty brand: culturally relevant, social-first and deeply connected to its community.

After becoming one of Mexico’s most exciting emerging beauty players, the brand is now entering its next chapter of growth, with major retail expansion across Mexico and the U.S.

Creativity is at the heart of everything we do—from product and packaging to campaigns, social content, retail experiences and entertainment. We are looking for someone who wants to help shape and protect a distinctive creative universe as SARELLY scales.







THE ROLE

SARELLY is looking for an Associate Art Director to ensure Anna Sarelly’s creative vision is consistently and flawlessly executed across every brand touchpoint. Reporting directly to Anna Sarelly, Founder & Creative Director, this person will work closely with her and with our Marketing and Creative teams, acting as the bridge between big-picture creative direction and day-to-day execution—translating campaign ideas into cohesive visual systems, guiding multidisciplinary teams, leading art direction, and ensuring everything we put into the world feels unmistakably SARELLY.




This is not a purely managerial role. We are looking for someone who can think, direct and make.

Someone with exceptional visual taste who can lead a shoot, ensure the vision is executed properly across different touchpoints, build moodboards, challenge layouts, guide designers, give meaningful feedback on social content, and step into execution when needed.

Most importantly, this role serves as the primary creative filter between Anna and the execution teams—protecting her time by determining what requires her input versus what can be independently resolved within established creative and brand standards.

Ultimately, your job is simple: Protect the creative vision from concept to execution.







WHAT YOU’LL DO

01 — Translate Creative Vision

Work directly with Anna to transform high-level campaign ideas, cultural insights and creative concepts into actionable visual direction.

You will help define and maintain consistency across:

Campaign visual systems
Art direction
Content pillars
Social expressions
Photography and video execution
Retail adaptations
Graphic design systems
Social media assets
Launch moments
Digital assets
Creator executions

You should be able to take a big idea and understand how it lives across an entire brand ecosystem—ensuring it remains visually coherent at every touchpoint.







02 — Lead Creative Execution

Own the execution of creative projects from briefing through final delivery.

Translate creative direction into clear, precise briefs for designers, photographers, videographers, editors, content creators, agencies, freelancers and brand creative production partners.

Ensure teams understand not only what they need to create, but why it matters to the overall vision.

Coordinate execution across multiple workstreams while maintaining consistency, quality and delivery timelines.







03 — Art Direct

Lead and support art direction across all brand outputs, including:

Campaign shoots
Social content shoots
Product photography
Video content
E-commerce visuals
Creator content
Brand activations
Retail experiences

You should feel comfortable making decisions around composition, lighting, styling, casting, props, sets, typography, motion and visual storytelling.

You will sometimes co-lead major campaigns with Anna and other times independently lead executions while maintaining full alignment with her vision.







04 — Own Creative Quality Control

Act as a guardian of the SARELLY visual universe.

Review creative output across teams and provide clear, actionable feedback before work reaches Anna.

This includes:

Social content
Reels / TikToks
Photography
Video edits
Graphic design
Campaign adaptations
Retail assets
Creator content
Digital assets
Brand presentations

Your responsibility is not simply to ask:

“Does this look good?”

It is to ask:

“Does this feel like SARELLY—and does it stay true to our creative vision?”

Act as the final creative checkpoint before work is escalated, ensuring Anna is only involved in decisions that genuinely require strategic creative direction.







05 — Lead Social & Content Execution

Partner closely with Social, Content, Growth and Market Pods to translate global campaign ideas into culturally relevant, platform-native executions.

Act as the primary creative interface between the Creative Studio and Growth teams, translating global creative direction into clear execution frameworks that allow local teams to execute autonomously while respecting SARELLY’s creative and brand guidelines.

The role provides creative direction and quality standards for social content but does not own the overall social media calendar, channel strategy or publishing cadence, which remain the responsibility of the relevant Social/Growth teams.

You will:

Refine visual consistency across social outputs
Improve execution of tone of voice, edits and formats
Identify opportunities for stronger visual storytelling
Maintain brand coherence in fast-moving content cycles
Ensure local market adaptations remain faithful to the global creative vision

Balance brand-building with the speed and spontaneity social requires.







06 — Strengthen the Creative Team Through Execution

Help raise the overall executional standard of the team.

Give clear, direct and constructive feedback focused on craft and consistency.

Mentor designers and content creatives in:

Layout
Composition
Visual hierarchy
Brand consistency
Execution quality

Create clarity when teams feel stuck and ensure the creative vision is understood and properly translated at every level.

Coordinate and prioritize work across Brand Design, Photo & Video, freelance creative resources and production partners, ensuring the right people are focused on the highest-impact work.

The goal is not for everything to depend on you.

The goal is to ensure the entire team executes at a higher standard.







07 — Own Creative Studio Operations

Own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the Creative Studio.

You will be responsible for:

Creative calendar management
Project prioritization
Creative briefs
Review processes
Resource coordination
Delivery planning
Cross-functional communication

Own creative prioritization and capacity planning across internal teams, freelancers and external partners.

When resources cannot support every request, proactively bring forward recommendations and proposed trade-offs—not just problems—for alignment with Anna.

Protect the quality of output while ensuring the Creative Studio operates efficiently at scale.







08 — Stay Hands-On

We are looking for a creative leader who still loves making things.

You should be comfortable working in:

Adobe Creative Suite
Moodboards
Presentations
Layouts
Visual references
Creative treatments
On-set problem solving

You do not need to execute every asset yourself.

But you must understand the craft deeply enough to elevate every piece of work.







THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You can walk into a room with designers, marketers, photographers, editors, producers, agencies and external partners and speak everyone’s language.

You understand that your role is to protect the brand, elevate execution and create clarity for the entire creative organization.

You have:

Exceptional visual taste
Strong art direction skills
A portfolio showing both concept understanding and execution excellence
Experience leading shoots and visual productions
Experience working with multidisciplinary creative teams
Strong project and creative workflow management skills
The ability to prioritize multiple creative initiatives simultaneously
Experience managing agencies, freelancers or external production partners
A strong understanding of social-first creative
High cultural awareness
Excellent communication and feedback skills
Strong organizational instincts
High attention to detail
The ability to move between thinking and making
Professional proficiency in English and Spanish

Experience in beauty, fashion, lifestyle or culturally driven brands is highly valued.

You can zoom out to understand the brand and zoom in to question a crop, a typeface, a transition or a layout decision.

Most importantly, you know how to take a creative vision, understand its intention, and make sure it is executed at the highest possible standard across every touchpoint—while enabling teams to move faster and more independently.







HOW WE’LL MEASURE SUCCESS

Within your first 6 months:

Creative consistency

Anna’s creative vision is clearly and consistently translated across campaign, social, retail and digital outputs.

Execution quality

The overall standard of visual execution across the team improves noticeably.

Creative autonomy

Day-to-day creative execution can move forward with minimal Creative Director intervention, with teams confidently operating within established creative standards.

Creative Studio effectiveness

The Creative Studio operates with clear priorities, efficient workflows and balanced resource allocation, resulting in fewer bottlenecks and stronger on-time delivery.

Team elevation

Designers and content creatives become more confident in executing the vision independently, while agencies and external partners receive clearer direction and require fewer revision rounds.

Creative Director leverage

Anna spends significantly more time on vision, concepting and innovation rather than execution oversight, creative triage and day-to-day decision making.







APPLICATION

A portfolio will requested to apply to this role. We are particularly interested in seeing examples of:

Art direction and campaign work
Photography and/or video productions
Social-first creative
Brand and visual identity execution
Projects where you translated a creative concept across multiple touchpoints
Your specific role and contribution to each project

description:
About the job

Operations & Product Support Coordinator

 Customer Support & Operations · Fintech / AI · Mexico · Remote, US hours




About the Company

My client is a US technology company building an AI platform for B2B loan servicing and legal collections. Commercial lenders, fintechs, and financial institutions use the platform to automate up to 90% of their servicing and legal workflows, from borrower communications all the way through UCC filing and enforcement.




The platform runs AI agents across voice, SMS, and email, connects directly to the client's loan management system, and layers in automated legal action with a network of attorneys. Compliance is built into the core, from FDCPA to state regulations, with full audit trails on every action. Customers report recovery rate improvements of up to 30%.




About the Role

This is a support-first seat at the center of a fast-moving fintech product. You will become the in-house expert on the platform, take care of the lenders who use it every day, and be the bridge between what customers need and what the product team builds.

Most of your week is customer facing: calls, questions, and requests from a portfolio of roughly 10 to 15 accounts. The rest is the work that keeps those customers happy behind the scenes: writing up issues as clear tickets, tracking them through to resolution, and closing the loop. You will also lend a hand to the marketing team when you have the bandwidth, which is a nice way to see more of how the business runs.

The core skill: answering "can the product do this for the customer?" accurately and quickly. That means learning the platform deeply, knowing its limits, and routing what it cannot do yet to the product team as a clear, well-written ticket.




What You'll Do

Own your accounts. Roughly 10 to 15 lenders, day to day, including scheduled calls. You are their person.
Handle support and product questions over calls, email, and chat, resolving what you can directly and escalating what you cannot.
Learn the platform inside and out. You will be trained on the internal software and become the person who knows what it can and cannot do. Expect a week or two to get there.
Write clear, well-structured tickets capturing the customer issue, the expected behavior, and how to reproduce it.
Track tickets end to end in Linear, following up until they are resolved and closing the loop with the customer.
Educate customers and build the relationship. Walk people through features, get them using more of the platform, and keep them confident in it.
Be the voice of the customer with product. Flag patterns and recurring requests, test new features, and feed real usage back into the roadmap.
Lend a hand to marketing. Most marketing runs through an AI tool, so this is light support when you have room: social posts, content coordination, the occasional campaign. Not the core of the job, but a real part of the week.
General operations support: internal coordination, documentation, and process work as the team scales.




What You Bring

2+ years in customer support, operations, customer success, or a similar coordination role, ideally at a software or technology company.
Fluent English (C1/C2), written and spoken. You will be on calls with US financial services customers. What matters most is communicating clearly and thinking well, not a perfect accent.
Strong written communication. A vague ticket costs engineering hours, so precision matters.
Technical curiosity. You do not need to code. You do need to genuinely enjoy learning how software works and being the person with the answer.
Organization under volume. Multiple customers, multiple open tickets, nothing dropped.
High agency and ownership. This is a pioneering seat on a small team. Nobody will hand you a checklist every morning.
Discretion. You will handle sensitive customer and borrower data in a regulated industry. Trustworthiness is not optional here.




One thing we screen for: you actually use AI

This team builds with AI and expects you to as well. We will ask you the same question they will: what is the coolest thing you have built or automated using AI tools?

It does not have to be work. A personal project, a workflow you automated, an assistant you wired up for yourself, all count. What we are listening for is that you have actually gone and made something, not that you have read about it.




Nice to Have

Experience with Linear, Jira, Notion, or similar ticketing and project tools. Linear is easy to pick up, so this is a head start rather than a requirement.
Familiarity with APIs and integrations, or comfort reading logs.
Background in fintech, lending, banking, financial services, or collections. Genuinely not required, curiosity about the space matters more.
Interest in financial markets or AI products.
Some marketing range: social content, copywriting, or campaign coordination. Helpful for the marketing support side of the role.

Location: Interlomas General Offices

Participate in the development and implementation of new ideas, techniques, procedures, services, or products under supervision.
Collaborate and network effectively within the team or immediate work environment to maximize work impact and personal learning.
Participate in learning opportunities and collaborate on change management initiatives for new processes under supervision.

Excel

Power BI

PowerPoint

Commercial attitude

Teamwork

Adaptability

Data analysis

You will experience business responsibilities from Day 1 – You work every single day on key projects from the beginning.
