description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you'll do

In this role, you will implement and manage User Policy operational processes that support responsible market growth and instill trust among users and partners. You will assess risks and opportunities, liaise with financial partners and merchants, and manage escalations while providing timely responses. As a User Policy Specialist at Stripe, you will apply and enforce the rules and requirements that determine which businesses can use our platform. This role is closely aligned with Stripe's mission, as it involves making key decisions about business eligibility to access our economic infrastructure.

Responsibilities


Assess and identify potential risks associated with business partnerships, making informed decisions that balance opportunity with compliance to protect Stripe's brand and reputation.
Investigate, action, and triage escalations across multiple channels, while providing accurate and timely responses to stakeholders.
Collaborate with various stakeholders, including business units, legal teams, and financial partners, to communicate User Policy requirements and ensure alignment with Stripe's mission and value proposition.
Utilize analytics to optimize strategies that can be enforced across Stripe's portfolio.
Develop and implement User Policy operational processes that ensure compliance with internal rules and external regulations, thereby enabling responsible business growth and market expansion for Stripe.
Identify gaps and areas for improvement within current User Policy frameworks, recommending enhancements to support sustainable business practices and progressive growth.
Participate in periodic business reviews to evaluate the impact of User Policy on Stripe's market performance and contribute to strategic discussions aimed at enhancing Stripe's growth and reputation.



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You possess experience in risk analysis, investigations, or risk operations
You have excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in diagnostic thinking and problem-solving, with experience using data to make assessments and judgments
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners



Preferred Qualifications


Risk experience in payments, e-commerce, or fintech mitigating digital and card-not-present risk
Experience in Trust and Safety related roles
Knowledge of risk schemes, risk prevention methods, and risk detection tools
Prior risk experience across multiple industries and verticals
Experience in a high-growth technology company
Experience working from a queue



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. description:
About the job

Why this role exists




Charles, our founder, spends most of his week talking with the owners of short-term rental property management companies. Five or six of those conversations get recorded every week, and almost nobody sees them. Your job is to change that. You'll take everything he says on camera and turn it into the newsletter, clips, and posts that make him the best-known voice in this industry. He hits record and reviews your drafts once a week. Everything in between belongs to you.

About HostGenius




HostGenius is a private membership network and business operating system for short-term rental property management companies. More than 70 member companies managing about 3,000 properties run on our platform. Charles scaled his own property management company to 160 listings before starting HostGenius, so when he talks about this business, operators listen. We're profitable and growing fast, and this role turns his daily conversations into a growth channel.

What success looks like




A year from now, thousands of US property managers read our weekly newsletter. Clips go up on Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube every week, and every word sounds like Charles wrote it himself. He spends under two hours a week on content once the cameras are off. The sales team uses proof clips you found. The ads team runs creative you handed them. When we host an industry event, you stretch one week of recording into three months of material.




What you will own

Turning raw recordings into published content. You pick the moments worth keeping, cut clips with Riverside's Magic Clips, and write the hooks and captions.
Final copy for the weekly newsletter, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. Our AI pipeline produces first drafts for you. You run it, check it, and edit everything until it sounds like Charles.
The publishing calendar. Everything ships on time every week without anyone chasing you.
The weekly review with Charles. One approval pass. You ship what he approves and rework what he flags.
A weekly scoreboard: what shipped, newsletter growth, engagement from actual property managers, and which clips went to the ads team.
Freelance editors, once long-form YouTube outgrows Magic Clips. They cut, you direct.




Not in scope: paid ads (our Growth Marketing Manager owns Meta), long-form video editing (we will outsource it), and inventing strategy from scratch. The system is already designed. Your job is to run it every week and keep making it better.




What we are looking for




Required:

3+ years running content production end to end for a company, founder, or creator, with published work you can show us
Written English at a native level. You'll be ghostwriting a Canadian founder, and if your copy needs a second edit before it ships, this isn't your role. Finalists complete a paid writing test in his voice.
Good instincts for short-form video. You can listen to an hour of conversation and know which 40 seconds will stop someone scrolling.
The discipline to run a publishing calendar for months without missing a date
At least 4 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time
You use AI tools daily for speed, and you catch what they get wrong




Nice to have:

Experience marketing to small business owners, or in real estate, hospitality, or short-term rentals
You've grown a newsletter on beehiiv, HubSpot, Kit, or similar
Podcast or webinar production, or familiarity with Riverside.fm
Enough design sense to make covers and carousels in Canva




Compensation

$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month as a full-time contractor plus up to a 30% annual bonus. This is a long-term role with upside as the media engine grows.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. Make sure your resume or profile links to 2 or 3 pieces of content you personally produced. We read every application that includes work samples and skip the ones that don't. Finalists complete a short paid writing test.

title: Representante de servicio al cliente
description:
About the job




Representante de servicio a cliente 

(IN HOUSE) 

(EXPERIENCIA EN EMPRESAS DE MANUFACTURA O TANGIBLES)







Objetivo del puesto




Garantizar una experiencia de servicio excepcional mediante la gestión integral de las necesidades, requerimientos y oportunidades de los clientes, asegurando respuestas oportunas, seguimiento efectivo y cumplimiento de los compromisos establecidos.




Actuar como enlace estratégico entre el cliente y las áreas internas, anticipando necesidades, resolviendo incidencias y generando acciones que fortalezcan la satisfacción, fidelización y relación comercial con los clientes.







Principales responsabilidades




Gestionar de manera integral la atención y servicio al cliente, asegurando respuestas oportunas, claras y orientadas a la solución.




Comprender las necesidades y expectativas de cada cliente, anticipándose a sus requerimientos y proponiendo alternativas que mejoren su experiencia de servicio.




Dar seguimiento puntual a pedidos, requerimientos, cotizaciones, entregas, incidencias y compromisos, asegurando el cumplimiento de los acuerdos establecidos.




Coordinar con las diferentes áreas internas las acciones necesarias para atender los requerimientos del cliente y garantizar una respuesta eficiente.




Gestionar y resolver incidencias y reclamaciones, identificando la causa raíz, estableciendo acciones correctivas y dando seguimiento hasta su cierre satisfactorio.




Mantener una comunicación proactiva con los clientes, informando oportunamente sobre avances, cambios, retrasos o cualquier situación que pueda impactar el servicio.




Dar seguimiento a indicadores de servicio, identificando tendencias, desviaciones y áreas de oportunidad para elevar el nivel de atención.




Analizar el comportamiento y necesidades de los clientes, detectando oportunidades de fortalecimiento de la relación comercial y posibles necesidades adicionales.




Mantener actualizada la información de clientes, pedidos, compromisos e incidencias, asegurando trazabilidad y disponibilidad de información para la toma de decisiones.




Participar activamente en la prevención de problemas, identificando riesgos en el servicio y escalando oportunamente aquellos casos que requieran intervención de otras áreas.




Construir relaciones de confianza con los clientes, convirtiéndose en un punto de contacto confiable y orientado a generar relaciones comerciales de largo plazo.







Se busca un profesional con alta orientación al cliente, pensamiento analítico, sentido de urgencia y capacidad para resolver problemas.




Debe demostrar:




Alta orientación al servicio y satisfacción del cliente.




Enfoque en resultados y cumplimiento de compromisos.




Excelente comunicación verbal y escrita.




Capacidad para escuchar, comprender necesidades y generar soluciones.




Pensamiento analítico y capacidad para identificar causas raíz.




Proactividad y anticipación de necesidades.




Capacidad para gestionar situaciones de presión y clientes exigentes.




Organización y seguimiento disciplinado.




Capacidad para coordinar múltiples requerimientos simultáneamente.




Habilidad para negociar y manejar conflictos.




Sentido de urgencia y capacidad de respuesta.




Trabajo colaborativo con diferentes áreas.




Capacidad para identificar oportunidades de mejora y proponer soluciones.




Orientación a la fidelización y construcción de relaciones de largo plazo.







Ofrecemos:




Sueldo Base.




Comisiones por retención y desarrollo de clientes.




Prestaciones superiores a la ley.




Plan de vida y carrera.

title: Closer de Ventas B2B High-Ticket — Tecnología HIFU | Remoto | $3,200–$6,400 USD/mes en inbound + 10% outbound
description:
About the job

¿Sabes conducir una videollamada comercial, descubrir la necesidad real de un negocio y convertir una oportunidad de alto valor en una venta?




En Ultrasonic ampliamos nuestro equipo comercial internacional. Buscamos un/a Closer de Ventas B2B High-Ticket con experiencia real en cierre consultivo para trabajar con clínicas estéticas, centros de belleza y spas médicos en España, México y Estados Unidos.

No vendemos cursos ni servicios abstractos. Comercializamos Ultrasonic 12D, una plataforma de tecnología HIFU para tratamientos médico-estéticos de alto valor, dentro de un modelo llave en mano que combina tecnología, formación para el cliente y marketing para impulsar la demanda.

Tu misión es clara: recibir oportunidades comerciales reales, entender el negocio del prospecto, presentar la solución, construir una propuesta a medida y convertir la conversación en una venta cobrada.


Lo que hace diferente esta posición

Recibirás leads reales procedentes de campañas de marketing activas. Ultrasonic invierte en captación digital, retargeting y generación de demanda. No empiezas con una lista fría sin contexto: trabajas oportunidades que ya han mostrado interés y que necesitan una conversación comercial profesional para avanzar.

Tendrás un equipo de Setters profesionales agendando reuniones calificadas para ti. El equipo de setting identifica necesidad, valida información clave, nutre al prospecto con los materiales necesarios y confirma la asistencia antes de transferirte la reunión. Tu foco está donde aporta más valor: diagnosticar, presentar, resolver objeciones y cerrar.

Tu trabajo es procesar y convertir oportunidades en venta. No buscamos a alguien que haga presentaciones genéricas o deje propuestas sin seguimiento. Buscamos un Closer que domine la conversación de negocio, demuestre el retorno de inversión con los números del propio cliente y lleve cada oportunidad a una decisión concreta.

Tendrás onboarding, academia y dirección comercial. Recibirás configuración de CRM y herramientas, acceso a la academia de producto, dossier comercial, casos reales, configurador de propuestas, scripts, roleplays y sesiones de coaching con Dirección Comercial. El acceso a reuniones reales llega cuando demuestras en roleplay que puedes ejecutar el método, no cuando simplemente han pasado unos días.


Un sistema de comisiones diseñado para premiar el cierre

Es una posición 100% a comisión, sin salario base y sin techo artificial de ingresos. La lógica es directa: cuanto mejor cierras, más te beneficia el sistema.

En operaciones inbound, las primeras cuatro ventas del mes generan una comisión del 5%. Al cerrar la quinta venta, la comisión sube al 8% y se recalcula de forma retroactiva sobre todas las ventas inbound de ese mes. Con un ticket medio de referencia de $8,000 USD, cuatro ventas representan $1,600 USD; cinco ventas activan $3,200 USD; siete ventas equivalen a $4,480 USD y diez ventas a $6,400 USD.

Si generas tus propias oportunidades mediante prospección outbound, cobras un 10% flat por cada operación cerrada. Con cinco ventas inbound y dos operaciones outbound, el escenario de referencia alcanza $4,800 USD en comisiones.

El detalle completo del sistema, los requisitos de validación, la atribución de ventas, los objetivos y las condiciones operativas se muestra en la web antes de que tomes ninguna decisión.


El perfil que buscamos

Buscamos una persona con al menos un año de experiencia demostrable en ventas B2B, high-ticket, tecnología, salud, estética o entornos consultivos. Debe saber conducir una videollamada profesional, escuchar antes de presentar, usar un CRM con disciplina y manejar objeciones sin necesidad de improvisar promesas imposibles.

Necesitas español nativo o nivel profesional, ordenador propio, conexión estable, cámara y disposición para grabar reuniones como parte del proceso de calidad y coaching. El inglés es un plus para oportunidades en Estados Unidos. La relación es mercantil, por lo que debes poder emitir factura como autónomo/a, freelance o empresa.

Valoramos especialmente a quien sabe vender retorno, no descuento. Si entiendes que una clínica no compra una máquina sino una nueva línea de facturación, vas a entender muy rápido la propuesta de Ultrasonic.


Proceso de selección

El proceso es directo: registro en la web, vídeo de presentación, vídeo pitch de producto, entrevista por videollamada con roleplay, propuesta de incorporación y onboarding.

¿Te interesa cerrar ventas de alto valor con producto real, campañas activas, reuniones calificadas y un sistema de comisiones que escala a tu favor?




Haz clic en “Solicitar empleo”. Accederás a la web con toda la información detallada del puesto, el modelo de comisiones, el proceso y el formulario de registro:

https://ventas.ultrasonic-pro.com

Hay oportunidades comerciales activas. Incorporación según proceso de selección.

About the job

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.





What you’ll be doing:


Field & Team Orchestration








Regional Field Operations Support: Serve as the central operational hub for our remote Field Marketing Managers across the Americas region. Oversee the complete lifecycle of regional event collateral and swag inventory, optimizing supply chains and workflows to guarantee seamless, friction-free daily operations.








Procurement & Legal Liaison: Drive the end-to-end procurement process. You will coordinate with Legal, Finance, and Procurement to shepherd contracts through approval, manage invoicing, and ensure vendors are paid on time.








Budget Tracking: Assist in developing event cost estimates and maintaining real-time budget accuracy across multiple regional activations.









Event Execution & Logistics








Customer Experience Ownership: Own the end-to-end logistics for customer-centric events (dinners, roundtables, workshops) in tight collaboration with Customer Marketing and Account Management teams.








Multi-Format Support: Provide logistical backbone for a diverse portfolio of events, including roundtables, industry trade shows, and co-sponsored partner events.









Data & Feedback Loops








AI-Driven Efficiency: Actively seek ways to use AI and automation (e.g., within Slack, SFDC, or Sheets) to streamline reporting, draft communications, and simplify repetitive administrative workflows.












We’re looking for:





2+ Years Experience: Proven track record in Event Coordination, Field Marketing, or a similar high-volume Ops role.








Tech-Forward Mindset: You don't just use tools; you optimize them. High proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs/Sheets) and Salesforce is required. Experience with JIRA and Slack as project management tools is preferred.








Service-Oriented EQ: You have a proactive mindset. You are friendly, professional, and capable of engaging with everyone from executives to warehouse vendors.








Async Mastery: You are comfortable working across time zones with high autonomy. You communicate clearly and directly, defaulting to "showing your work" so the team can stay aligned.








Remote-First: Ability to operate independently across global time zones.








On-Site Support: Willingness to travel up to 10% to provide hands-on support for key events.













Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role. 




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. 




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO




 




Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. 




 




JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.




 




Scam Notice:




Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.




 




All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"




 




 #BI-Remote




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

About the job

Descripción de la empresa EBC Financial Group es una empresa fundada en Londres que ofrece servicios financieros integrales, incluyendo brokerage, gestión de activos y servicios de inversión e inmigración. Contamos con presencia global en Londres, Tokio, Sídney, Singapur, Hong Kong y las Islas Caimán, lo que te permitirá trabajar con equipos y clientes internacionales. Nuestro equipo directivo suma décadas de experiencia en mercados financieros globales y sitúa la seguridad de los fondos de los clientes como máxima prioridad, operando bajo licencias de organismos reguladores como la FCA (Reino Unido), CIMA (Islas Caimán) y ASIC (Australia). Somos socio oficial de divisas del FC Barcelona y colaboramos con iniciativas de impacto junto a la UN Foundation, la Universidad de Oxford y otros aliados en salud global, economía, educación y sostenibilidad. Si te interesa el sector financiero regulado y orientado a la ética, EBC es un entorno dinámico para desarrollar tu carrera.

Descripción del puesto En el puesto de Customer Support en EBC Financial Group, serás la primera persona de contacto para las consultas y necesidades de clientes a nivel internacional. En tu día a día atenderás solicitudes vía correo electrónico, chat y teléfono, proporcionarás soporte técnico básico sobre plataformas de trading y servicios financieros, y ayudarás a resolver incidencias de forma rápida y clara. También te encargarás de hacer seguimiento de casos, registrar interacciones en las herramientas internas y colaborar con otros equipos para mejorar la satisfacción de clientes y la calidad del servicio. Este es un puesto de tiempo completo, presencial, ubicado en el área metropolitana de Ciudad de México.

Requisitos

Aptitudes sólidas en atención al cliente y Customer Support, con foco en la satisfacción y experiencia de la persona usuaria.
Aptitudes interpersonales para comunicarte de forma clara y empática, gestionar conflictos y crear relaciones de confianza con clientes de perfiles diversos.
Capacidad para proporcionar Technical Support, comprender procesos y productos financieros, y trasladar información técnica de forma sencilla.
Aptitudes analíticas para interpretar datos de servicio, detectar patrones en incidencias y proponer mejoras en procesos y herramientas.
Formación mínima en áreas relacionadas (administración, finanzas, economía o similares) y manejo fluido de herramientas digitales y ofimáticas.
Nivel alto de inglés hablado y escrito es un must; se valorará conocimiento de otros idiomas
Experiencia previa en FX y CFDs es un gran must 
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, orientación a resultados y disposición para aprender en un entorno regulado y dinámico.

About the job

READ THE FULL JOB POST CAREFULLY




We are seeking a Freelance Email Marketing Specialist to join our remote team on an hourly basis, with the potential to transition to a full-time, long-term position. If you're passionate about digital marketing and eager to grow in a supportive, flexible environment, read on to learn more about this opportunity.




The Opportunity

This role is ideal for a freelancer looking for consistent work with the goal of becoming a full-time member of our team. You'll start with an hourly contract and a project-based workload, with the goal of increasing your hours and responsibilities over time. For the right fit, this can quickly lead to a stable, full-time position with all the benefits of being an integral part of our company.




Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement email and SMS marketing strategies for clients.
Identify target audiences, create email lists and segments, and design effective campaigns.
Evaluate and optimize campaigns to improve delivery and open rates.
Ensure compliance with industry best practices.
Collaborate with clients and internal teams to execute and refine strategic plans.
Conduct client audits and create strategic documents like campaign calendars and automation plans.
Analyze data and adjust strategies to enhance performance.
Maintain timely communication with clients and the team, ensuring projects progress smoothly.
Conduct Zoom meetings with clients to review performance and provide insights.




Skills and Qualifications

Soft Skills:

Proficiency in spoken and written English.
Excellent interpersonal and leadership skills.
Detail-oriented (answer 1111 to this pre-screening question).
Proactive with strong problem-solving abilities.
Capable of multitasking and quick learning.

Hard Skills:

Background in digital marketing with a solid understanding of design principles.
Experience with email marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo, Mailchimp) for at least 1 year.
Ability to analyze metrics and digital trends to enhance engagement and uncover new opportunities.
Strong grasp of marketing messaging.

Preferable Skills:

Experience with SMS marketing.
Familiarity with project management tools like Slack and ClickUp.
Experience with GSuite and Figma.
Spanish language skills.




What We Offer

A fully remote and flexible work environment.
A clear path for career growth from an hourly contractor to a full-time employee.
Opportunities for professional development within the company.

Join us in delivering impactful marketing strategies and driving success for our clients as part of a dynamic and supportive team.




Application Process

Here’s an overview of our hiring process, with progression to each stage contingent upon approval:

Pre-screening Questions: Via LinkedIn application.
Pre-screening Video Interview: Record video responses to questions about yourself and your experience.
Personality Test: Evaluate key soft skills.
Team Interview: You'll meet with a senior team member.
Final Interview: Meet with our founder and CEO.




If you move past the initial stage, a team member will reach out to guide you through the next steps.




We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Business Development Analyst Jr. | B2B
description:
About the job

Sobre la posición:




En Castañón Abogados S.C., buscamos incorporar a un/a Business Development Analyst Jr. para apoyar el crecimiento comercial de la firma mediante la investigación de empresas, identificación de prospectos, prospección B2B y seguimiento de oportunidades.




Buscamos una persona proactiva, organizada, analítica y con facilidad para comunicarse y generar relaciones profesionales. Esta oportunidad está dirigida a recién egresados o perfiles con experiencia inicial que deseen desarrollar una carrera en Business Development, ventas consultivas y servicios profesionales.




La posición trabajará directamente con la Dirección de la firma y recibirá acompañamiento para conocer nuestros servicios, mercado objetivo, herramientas y procesos comerciales.




Lo que harás:




- Investigar empresas, sectores y mercados con potencial para convertirse en clientes.

- Apoyar en la creación y actualización de listas de cuentas objetivo.

- Identificar dueños, CEOs, CFOs, directores jurídicos y otros tomadores de decisión.

- Recopilar información relevante sobre empresas y prospectos antes de realizar un acercamiento.

- Apoyar en la ejecución de estrategias de prospección B2B.

- Utilizar LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, bases de datos y otras herramientas digitales para identificar prospectos.

- Buscar contactos, referencias y conexiones que faciliten el acercamiento con empresas y directivos.

- Identificar cámaras empresariales, asociaciones, consejos, eventos y espacios de networking.

- Apoyar en la generación y coordinación de reuniones comerciales.

- Preparar fichas e información previa sobre cada prospecto.

- Dar seguimiento a prospectos, reuniones, propuestas y actividades pendientes.

- Mantener actualizado el CRM y registrar cada interacción y siguiente acción.

- Apoyar en la elaboración de reportes comerciales.

- Colaborar con Dirección, las áreas jurídicas y Marketing en campañas dirigidas a empresas y cuentas objetivo.




Lo que buscamos:




- Licenciatura concluida o en etapa final en Administración, Negocios, Marketing, Economía, Finanzas, Derecho, Relaciones Internacionales o áreas afines.

- De 0 a 2 años de experiencia en desarrollo de negocios, ventas B2B, investigación comercial, atención a cuentas, consultoría, banca, fintech, tecnología o áreas similares.

- También consideraremos recién egresados con iniciativa, madurez profesional y capacidad de aprendizaje.

- Interés en desarrollar una carrera en Business Development y ventas consultivas B2B.

- Facilidad para investigar empresas, sectores y personas.

- Buena comunicación oral y escrita.

- Seguridad para interactuar profesionalmente con empresarios y directivos.

- Organización y disciplina para dar seguimiento a diferentes actividades.

- Iniciativa, curiosidad comercial y orientación a objetivos.

- Manejo profesional de LinkedIn y herramientas digitales.

- Buena presentación profesional.




Será un plus:




- Experiencia utilizando LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

- Conocimiento básico de algún CRM.

- Manejo de Excel o Google Sheets.

- Experiencia en prácticas profesionales, servicio social o proyectos relacionados con ventas, investigación o atención a clientes.

- Inglés intermedio o profesional.

- Interés en el sector empresarial y los servicios profesionales.




No es indispensable contar con experiencia previa en el sector legal.




Lo que ofrecemos:




- Capacitación y acompañamiento para desarrollarte en Business Development B2B.

- Trabajo directo con la Dirección de Castañón Abogados.

- Participación en la construcción y crecimiento del área de Desarrollo de Negocios.

- Exposición profesional a empresas, empresarios y directivos.

- Aprendizaje en prospección estratégica, networking y ventas consultivas.

- Oportunidad de aprendizaje y crecimiento profesional dentro de la firma.

- Esquema de bonos por cumplimiento de objetivos.

- Prestaciones de ley, incluido aguinaldo.

- Jornada presencial de lunes a viernes, de 09:00 a 19:00 horas, con dos horas de comida.

- Oficinas en Lomas de San Ángel Inn, Ciudad de México.




Importante:




Esta es una posición de desarrollo de negocios B2B. No está enfocada en community management, diseño gráfico, creación de contenido, publicidad digital, telemarketing o ventas masivas por volumen de llamadas.




Si te interesa investigar mercados, conectar con empresas, desarrollar relaciones profesionales y construir una carrera en Business Development, queremos conocerte.




Postúlate a través de LinkedIn y comparte tu CV actualizado.

You'll work at the intersection of brand utility and social culture, creating content that sits naturally alongside the creators, conversations, and trends your audience already follows. The most effective content for this portfolio doesn't feel like advertising it feels helpful, relevant, and worth sharing.

We're looking for someone culturally plugged in to Mexico's social landscape, creatively resourceful, and comfortable not only producing content end to end, but also being the face of the brand. Someone who can spot the opportunity, concept it quickly, produce it with care, and deliver it while it's still relevant.

Concept, shoot, edit, and produce social-first content for a leading household brand portfolio in Mexico across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and emerging formats — working across smartphone, DSLR, and lo-fi production setups to prioritise authenticity and cultural relevance over polish

Support shoots involving content creators, influencers, and real people, ensuring the production process is inclusive and representative of the diversity of Mexican families and communities
Experiment with new formats, techniques, and creative approaches sharing what works, and what doesn't, with the wider team
Use Gen AI tools to support content creation, from ideation and visual references to editing and copy exploration
Ensure all content meets platform specifications, brand guidelines, accessibility standards, and compliance requirements

WHAT YOU BRING

A portfolio of social content work with strong examples of platform-native content that generated genuine audience engagement — shares, saves, comments, conversation
Technical confidence across the full content creation process: concepting, shooting, and editing across smartphone and DSLR setups, with solid skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut, Canva, or equivalent
Fluency in Mexican social platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and emerging channels including a clear understanding of what performs, why, and how Mexican audiences discover and share content
A genuine feel for Mexican cultural relevance, with the ability to spot trending moments and conversations in the local market and turn them quickly into content ideas
Experience creating content for consumer brands, with an ability to communicate brand or product messages in a way that feels genuine and relatable not forced or overly commercial
A collaborative, proactive attitude comfortable pitching in across different content types and production needs, and able to deliver quality work on tight turnarounds

About the job

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible. 

You will improve value and service to your customers and improve supply chain efficiency. In addition, you will use internal and customer data to optimize plans and to support joint initiatives with strategic customers.

You will:


Be the single point of contact for your customer portfolio
Manage escalations for complaints and disputes, and handle and resolve issues to ensure maximum customer satisfaction
Help achieve business and commercial objectives by achieving customer service targets, supporting the improvement agenda (internal process and external customer) and developing collaborative relationships cross-functionally and with customers

Experience in CS&L and with customers
Experience in fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods company
Strong analytical and problem solving skills
SAP knowledge and expertise in MS Office
Customer orientation, strong influencing and communication skills
Strong focus on delivering productivities, service and KPIs
Team player, accountable, proactive thinking, flexibility



Enhance customer value and service quality while optimizing supply chain efficiency. You will leverage internal and customer data to optimize planning, support joint initiatives, and ensure flawless operational and logistical execution for deliveries and purchase orders.

Key Responsibilities


Primary Point of Contact & Relationship Management: Serve as the key contact for your assigned customer portfolio (including direct 1-on-1 collaboration between the internal commercial team and the customer’s supply/procurement team).
Supply KPI Monitoring: Continuously track essential metrics such as Fill Rate, On-Time In-Full , In-Stock levels, days of supply, and forecasts.
Issue Resolution & Dispute Management: Manage escalations regarding complaints or disputes, resolving incidents effectively to guarantee maximum customer satisfaction.
Data Analysis & Insights: Utilize customer data to monitor on-shelf availability, DC-to-store service levels, inventory levels, and promotional sales—driving internal and commercial decision-making to maximize service performance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & KPI Compliance: Partner with the Order Fulfillment team to report KPIs, conduct root-cause analyses, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.



Qualifications & Requirements


Relevant Experience: Proven track record in Customer Service & Logistics within the FMCG / CPG industry.
Account Management: Demonstrated ability in managing key accounts and driving specific supply metrics.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP and MS Office Suite.
Analytical & Communication Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, customer orientation, a proactive mindset, and excellent communication and influencing skills.
Results-Oriented: Proactive, collaborative team player with a firm commitment to delivering productivity, high service levels, and commercial targets.



No Relocation support available

Mondelez México has been in the country since 1927 and currently employs 6,000 wonderful people. Our diverse portfolio includes iconic and mouth-watering global brands such as Trident, Oreo, Philadelphia, and local jewels like Clorets and Bubbaloo. We are leaders in the making of cream cheese, powdered beverages and confections—in fact, we make seven out of every 10 chewing gums consumed by Mexicans. Our growth is supported by our cutting-edge manufacturing facilities, such as our Puebla Plant and Nuevo León HUB, which are the largest gums, candies and biscuits factories in the world in terms of volume. You can buy are products in 900,000 places in Mexico. We are also home to one of the 11 technology centers Mondelez International has worldwide, a specialized gum and candy facility that places us at the forefront of innovation and development in the country and drives our purpose to lead the future of snacking. We are pioneers in the country in work-life balance practices such as extended maternity leave, open spaces, remote work and flexible working hours.

description:
About the job

About the client

We’re a small, fast-moving Amazon advertising agency built by ex-Amazon employees. We’ve managed some of the biggest brands on the planet, but we’re not a corporate machine. We’re scrappy, strategic, and obsessed with performance.




We live in the details of Sponsored Ads, we experiment a lot, and we scale brands that actually matter. If you love the thrill of solving problems and having ownership over your work, this is your home.




We don’t believe in endless meetings or micromanagement. With that being said, this is not an easy job and we’re looking for someone that is excellent at what they do.




Responsibilities

You write weekly and monthly business reviews that explain why an account moved, not just that it moved, and every review ends with a written action plan: what we will do, by when, and what result we expect.
You build budget and media strategies. You can defend with data how much budget goes where, and you track performance against your own plan.
You optimize Sponsored Ads accounts against the client's goals: pulling spend back from underperforming products and targets, scaling spend into what's working, and backing every move with data.
At any point in the month, you know whether each of your accounts is pacing to budget and goal, and you flag pacing problems before the client notices them.
You manage your task load ranked by expected impact on the account. For any task on your list, you can state in one or two sentences why it matters and what business result it should produce.
You will work within our proprietary ads management software




What We’re Looking For

2+ years of hands-on experience running Amazon PPC campaigns across multiple brands.
Excel/Google Sheets skills and comfort working in bulk sheets for large scale edits and reporting.
Working fluency with PPC tools like Helium 10 and Data Dive to guide keyword and campaign decisions.
Clear, confident written and verbal English. You will communicate directly with the accounts you manage in writing and on calls.
Data-driven, curious, and proactive, you don't wait for instructions, you look for impact.
We work within Slack & Monday for communication, project and task management.




Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $2,000–$4,000 per month (based on experience and skill level)
Fully remote: work from anywhere
21 PTO days per year + US Holidays
Flexible hours: core collaboration window of 8–11 AM PST, with flexibility for the rest of your day

description:
About the job

Descripción de la empresa GREENFIELD AGRO es una empresa que ayuda a productores y marcas de alimentos y bebidas a vender y operar en nuevos mercados internacionales. Validamos el encaje producto-mercado, los canales de distribución y la estrategia de precios para asegurar el éxito comercial. Coordinamos muestras, requisitos regulatorios, órdenes de compra, producción, importaciones y distribución, asegurando que todo el proceso fluya sin problemas. Cuando surgen incidencias de calidad, inventario o entregas, trabajamos de cerca con proveedores y clientes hasta resolverlas. Operamos en México, Latinoamérica y Europa, con un foco especial en retail, distribución y proyectos de marca blanca.

También colaborarás con bodegas y productores para evaluar la calidad de los vinos, coordinar muestras y revisar fichas técnicas, asegurando que cada referencia cumpla los estándares de la empresa. Mantendrás una comunicación constante con los equipos de distribución y retail para optimizar el surtido y apoyar lanzamientos de nuevos productos. Este es un puesto de tiempo completo, presencial, ubicado en Ciudad de México, México.

Aptitudes en venta de vinos y desarrollo comercial, incluyendo Wine Sales y relación con clientes del sector HORECA y retail.
Conocimientos sólidos en Wine Education, capacidad para impartir formaciones, catas y asesoría técnica sobre vinos.
Formación o experiencia en Enología (Oenology), comprensión de procesos de elaboración (Winemaking) y trabajo con bodegas (Wineries).
Experiencia previa en el sector vinícola o bebidas alcohólicas, idealmente en puestos comerciales, de compras o de marketing de producto.
Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, organización y atención al detalle, así como buenas aptitudes de comunicación oral y escrita.

description:
About the job

Founding LinkedIn Outbound Campaign Strategist

Hey! We’re Scale Up, and our client is looking to hire a LinkedIn Lead Generation Specialist for a fast-growing AI startup building an AI-powered growth platform for LinkedIn outbound.

Type of Employment: Full-Time Contractor (Long-term)

Work Modality: 100% Remote

Work Schedule: Full-Time

Location: Global

About Our Client

Our client is a fast-growing AI startup building technology that helps companies identify the right prospects, start highly relevant conversations, and turn those conversations into qualified sales meetings.

They are looking for someone who is exceptional at LinkedIn outbound. This is not a role for someone who simply uploads prospect lists and creates standard sequences. They need someone who can understand a business, identify the strongest reasons to reach out, define the right audience, create messaging that generates genuine responses, and continuously improve campaigns based on real performance data.

You will have significant ownership, managing campaigns from initial research and strategy through launch, testing, and ongoing optimization.

What You’ll Own


Learn each client’s product, market, customers, positioning, and sales process. 
Identify the strongest ICPs, buyer segments, triggers, and campaign angles. 
Build highly targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and other data sources. 
Determine who to target, why they would care, and why the timing is relevant. 
Write connection requests, opening messages, follow-ups, and campaign variations. 
Build and launch LinkedIn outbound campaigns using the company’s platform. 
Monitor acceptance, reply, positive reply, meeting, attendance, and lead-quality rates. 
Identify where campaigns are underperforming and make the necessary adjustments. 
Run structured tests across audiences, offers, messaging, and CTAs. 
Review replies and conversations to understand what the market is actually saying. 
Pause weak campaigns quickly and scale the ones that work. 
Maintain clear campaign documentation covering tests, results, and learnings. 
Turn successful campaigns into repeatable playbooks for the broader team. 


What Exceptional Looks Like

You can look at a company and quickly answer:


Who is most likely to buy this? 
What signals suggest they may need it right now? 
Who should we exclude from the campaign? 
What would make the outreach feel specific without sounding automated? 
Is the problem the audience, offer, message, timing, or follow-up? 
What does the campaign data tell us to change next? 


You understand that great outbound is not about sending more messages. It is about creating the right conversation with the right person at the right time.

You May Be a Great Fit If


You have built and optimized successful B2B outbound campaigns. 
You are extremely strong in ICP research, segmentation, targeting, and outbound copywriting. 
You have deep hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator. 
You can write messages that are concise, casual, relevant, and genuinely human. 
You understand the difference between getting a reply and generating a qualified sales opportunity. 
You are comfortable working across multiple industries and quickly learning new markets. 
You use campaign data to make decisions rather than relying only on intuition. 
You can diagnose targeting and messaging problems and act on them quickly. 
You take full ownership and are comfortable working with minimal supervision. 
You can clearly explain why a campaign worked, why it failed, and what should happen next. 
You care deeply about the quality and business impact of your work. 


Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, Instantly, HeyReach, Expandi, Smartlead, Unipile, or similar outbound platforms is a plus, but results and strategic thinking matter more than the exact tool stack.

This Is Probably Not for You If


Your outbound strategy is mainly based on increasing volume. 
You rely heavily on generic templates with light personalization. 
You evaluate campaigns only through acceptance or overall reply rates. 
You need someone else to define the audience, angle, and offer. 
You launch campaigns and wait weeks before analyzing their performance. 
You cannot provide examples of campaigns you personally built and improved. 
Your messaging sounds like it was generated by a sales automation tool. 


How Success Will Be Measured

Your performance will be evaluated based on:


Quality and precision of targeting. 
Positive reply rate. 
Qualified meetings booked. 
Meeting attendance and lead quality. 
Speed and quality of campaign iteration. 
Client campaign performance over time. 
Strength of the insights and playbooks you produce. 


The focus is on qualified meetings, real sales opportunities, and revenue potential. Vanity metrics matter only when they help diagnose and improve campaign performance.

What Your First 90 Days Could Look Like

First 30 Days


Learn the product, customers, and existing campaign process. 
Audit current campaigns and identify the biggest performance opportunities. 
Take ownership of an initial group of campaigns. 
Establish a clear testing and reporting approach. 


By 60 Days


Independently research, build, launch, and optimize campaigns. 
Produce measurable improvements in targeting, messaging, or conversion rates. 
Turn early wins into repeatable campaign frameworks. 
Identify recurring process issues and propose improvements. 


By 90 Days


Own campaign strategy and execution with minimal oversight. 
Consistently generate qualified conversations through outbound campaigns. 
Raise the quality bar across the company’s campaigns. 
Help develop a world-class system for LinkedIn outbound. 


Why Join?


Work directly with the founder and have meaningful ownership from day one. 
Join a fast-growing startup where your work directly impacts customer results. 
Help shape both the campaign strategy and the AI-powered product behind it. 
Test strategies across different markets, offers, industries, and audiences. 
Play a key role in defining what world-class LinkedIn outbound looks like. 
Work remotely as part of an ambitious, highly autonomous team. 


Thanks!

About the job

E-Commerce Marketing Specialist (TikTok Shop focused)

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary: $1200 to $1800 USD/month based on experience + profit sharing bonuses based on performance.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a women-owned NYC eyewear brand, growing fast, building luxury sunglasses that solve real problems: floating sunnies, tangle-free aviators, foldable pocket frames, and mood-boosting lenses. We are a small team and a small business, not corporate at all, and it is a fun brand to be part of. We are close-knit and supportive, and everyone here wears many hats and jumps in wherever they are needed.




The Role

We are looking for a Marketing Specialist who can help make TikTok Shop a major growth engine for TopFoxx while supporting broader marketing, creative, influencer, and conversion initiatives.




This is not a traditional marketing manager role. You do not need prior TikTok Shop experience. You need to be a strong marketer who understands short-form content and learns platforms quickly. We are looking for someone who executes and brings results. You should be able to receive a problem like: "TikTok Shop isn't performing the way it should. Figure out what's happening."… and independently investigate the data, identify the problems, develop a strategy, start implementing solutions, monitor the results, and continue improving.




You will work across TikTok Shop, creators, influencer marketing, creative strategy, paid media, website conversion, and e-commerce marketing. You do not need to be the world's best expert in every area. But you need to be curious, capable, hands-on, and willing to figure things out.




What Success Looks Like

Grow TikTok Shop revenue and conversion while using creators, content, creative strategy, and broader marketing opportunities to drive measurable e-commerce growth.




You will be responsible for:

Understand → Identify → Strategize → Execute → Measure → Optimize → Scale




We want someone who can connect the dots between what customers see, what creators produce, how products are presented, and what ultimately makes someone buy.

Two numbers define this role. We get about 2,000 affiliate videos a month from roughly 650 creators, and only 1 to 2% of them drive any sales. Your job is to get us to 5,000 affiliates posting every month, and to take that 1 to 2% up to 5%. Volume alone would roughly triple this channel. Volume plus quality takes it about seven times where it is today.

And it has to be profitable. Every TikTok Shop sale carries a referral fee, affiliate commission, ad spend, discounts and shipping on top of product cost, so a campaign that looks like it is winning on reported ROI can still be losing us money. Growing revenue while margin disappears is not success here.




What You'll Oversee (Key Responsibilities)




1) TikTok Shop Growth (Primary Focus)

Understand the current state of our TikTok Shop and identify areas of opportunity.
Analyze GMV, sales, conversion, traffic, product performance, and creator-generated revenue.
Identify why products, content, or campaigns are underperforming.
Find opportunities to increase daily sales and overall GMV.
Develop and execute TikTok Shop growth strategies.
Test products, content, offers, campaigns, and creator strategies.
Follow TikTok Shop updates daily and be first to test them. New features are worth the most before the rest of the market catches on. 
Identify TikTok Shop features and opportunities TopFoxx is not currently utilizing.
Monitor performance and adjust strategies based on results.
Stay up to date, daily, on TikTok Shop updates, trends, tools, and best practices.
Build repeatable processes that make TikTok Shop growth more scalable.




2) Affiliate, Creator & Influencer Marketing 

Grow our affiliate base to 5,000+ creators posting every month, and lift the share of affiliate videos that actually drive sales from 1 to 2% up to 5%. Both numbers have to move together. More videos at the same quality is not the goal.
Build strong relationships with our top revenue-generating creators on TikTok Shop and win over the biggest GMV creators in our category. Keep a tracked written record of every conversation with each one, so the relationship lives in the company and not in one person's inbox.
Communicate directly with TikTok Shop creators and influencers.
Build relationships with high-potential creators.
Identify creators who have the ability to generate sales.
Identify which creators and content should be scaled.
Create clear creator briefs and content direction.
Give creators feedback on hooks, messaging, products, and content structure.
Help negotiate additional content or compensation when appropriate.
Develop creator campaigns around products, launches, promotions, and seasonal opportunities.
Identify opportunities for TikTok LIVE and other creator-led selling initiatives.
Connect creator performance back to GMV, conversion, and overall business results.




3) Creative Strategy

Review TikTok, Instagram, and paid creative.
Identify why certain videos capture attention and others do not.
Develop hooks, angles, concepts, and messaging.
Create content briefs for creators and internal teams.
Give actionable feedback on videos and creative.
Identify customer pain points that can become content opportunities.
Turn product benefits, reviews, objections, and customer questions into creative concepts.
Develop TikTok and Instagram content strategies.
Identify winning creator content that could be replicated or expanded.
Help determine which creative should be scaled.
Connect organic content, creator content, and paid advertising.
Build repeatable creative frameworks and testing processes.




4) Creative Execution

We want a marketer who can actually execute. You do not need to be an expert designer or professional video editor. However, you should have enough hands-on creative ability to make or modify content when necessary rather than being completely dependent on another person.




Experience with tools such as: Photoshop, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Canva, Other video or creative production tools is valuable.




You may:

Make simple creative edits.
Modify images or graphics.
Edit short-form video.
Create basic social content.
Build simple creative variations.
Add text, captions, hooks, or CTAs to content.
Prepare creator briefs and visual references.
Create basic marketing assets when needed.




5) Conversion & E-Commerce Optimization

Review product pages and landing pages.
Identify conversion friction and customer objections.
Evaluate whether advertising and product-page messaging are aligned.
Recommend improvements to product positioning and messaging.
Review product images, videos, headlines, descriptions, and calls to action.
Recommend creative improvements for website pages.
Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from content → product page → purchase.
Help develop conversion-focused landing page concepts.
Review Amazon product creative and content.
Evaluate TikTok Shop product presentation and identify opportunities to improve conversion.
Use customer questions, reviews, comments, and behavior to identify conversion opportunities.




6) Paid Media & Creative Support

Review existing paid advertisements.
Evaluate hooks, messaging, creative angles, and offers.
Identify opportunities to repurpose successful organic or creator content into paid ads.
Recommend creative concepts for Meta and TikTok.
Provide feedback on paid creative.
Help identify winning creative that should be scaled.
Connect paid media insights back to TikTok Shop and influencer strategies.
Help develop creative testing ideas.
Analyze creative performance and recommend improvements.




7) Data, KPIs & Performance

You will use data to make decisions, but this is not a purely analytical role.
You should be comfortable tracking and interpreting metrics such as: GMV, Revenue, Conversion rate, Orders, Traffic, Average order value, Creator-generated revenue, Creator posting frequency, Content performance, CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, Video retention, Engagement, Product-level conversion, 
The goal is always to connect the numbers to action.




8) Testing & Growth Initiatives

Test new TikTok Shop strategies.
Test creator approaches.
Test content angles and hooks.
Test offers and promotions.
Test product positioning.
Test creative formats.
Identify new platform opportunities.
Research competitors and market trends.
Look for new ways to increase conversion.
Stop strategies that are not producing results and quickly move toward better opportunities.

About the job

About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

A global digital transformation organization that helps leading enterprises reimagine how they create, manage, and deliver customer experiences by combining technology, creativity, AI, and engineering. Through multidisciplinary teams and hands-on execution, we partner with organizations to modernize workflows, scale content operations, accelerate innovation, and build solutions that drive measurable business impact.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Creative Technologist to join our team at the intersection of creative strategy, brand execution, and emerging AI technology.

This is a highly hands-on, enterprise-level, and client-facing role operating in an embedded lab environment alongside creative, brand, studio, and vendor teams. The Creative Technologist will lead the implementation, configuration, testing, and governance of AI-powered creative workflows and automation.

The role requires someone who can translate complex business and creative requirements into scalable, testable GenAI workflows, configure AI agents and pipelines, and work directly with senior stakeholders to drive adoption and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities


Translate creative and business team requests into scoped, testable GenAI workflow builds with clearly defined requirements and success criteria. 
Build, configure, test, and maintain GenAI workflows, feeds, agents, and automation pipelines for assigned categories and use cases. 
Configure prompts, model settings, workflow logic, and agent behaviors across multiple GenAI models. 
Design and maintain node-based workflows using visual logic builders and similar technologies. 
Document workflow builds, configurations, testing results, and learnings. 
Contribute to shared playbooks, documentation, and knowledge transfer across creative technology teams. 
Plan and execute structured testing across new categories and use cases against defined test plans, acceptance criteria, and KPIs. 
Build and maintain design system components, templates, and modular creative assets within GenAI workflows. 
Configure quality-control, validation, and scoring mechanisms for generated outputs in alignment with established governance standards. 
Monitor and optimize workflow efficiency, including model usage, credit/token consumption, output quality, and production performance. 
Facilitate discovery sessions and stakeholder alignment workshops to understand business needs and translate them into technical workflow requirements. 
Partner closely with creative, marketing, brand, studio, and technology stakeholders throughout the workflow lifecycle. 
Identify opportunities to improve automation, scalability, consistency, and creative production efficiency. 


Qualifications and Job Requirements


Hands-on experience building, configuring, or operating enterprise GenAI workflows, pipelines, agents, or automation systems. 
Hands-on experience with node-based, graph-based workflow editors, or visual logic builders, such as ComfyUI, n8n, Figma Weave, or similar tools. 
Experience configuring GenAI prompts, workflows, agents, and model selection across multiple GenAI models. 
Proven ability to translate business and creative requirements into structured, testable workflows with defined success criteria. 
Experience evaluating and optimizing AI-generated outputs against defined quality standards, acceptance criteria, or KPIs. 
Proven experience operating in a client-facing or senior stakeholder-facing role within an enterprise, corporate environment, agency, or consultancy. 
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience facilitating discovery sessions, requirements gathering, and stakeholder alignment workshops. 
Strong understanding of the creative and marketing production lifecycle, including creative briefs, asset production, review and approval processes, brand asset management, modular design systems, and content component production. 
Ability to collaborate effectively with creative, marketing, brand, studio, production, and technology teams. 
Experience working with AI in an enterprise or professional environment; candidates whose AI experience is strictly limited to personal, side-project, academic, or hobbyist use will not be considered. 
Based in Latin America (LATAM) with availability to work remotely. 
Advanced English proficiency, with strong verbal and written communication skills. 
Ability to work full-time hours aligned with US Central Time (CT). 


Nice to Have


Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, particularly Photoshop. 
Experience with Figma or similar design and prototyping tools. 
Experience with enterprise work management and creative operations platforms such as Adobe Workfront. 
Exposure to 3D asset pipelines, spatial design, CGI, or other emerging creative technologies that interface with GenAI workflows. 
Familiarity with data visualization, analytics dashboards, or performance tracking systems. 
Experience measuring workflow efficiency, credit/token consumption, output acceptance, or other AI production KPIs.

title: Sales and Leasing Specialist
description:
About the job

About the Role




We're looking for a high-energy, results-driven Sales and Leasing Specialist to serve as the

critical first point of contact for every prospective resident who shows interest in our properties.

This is a fast-paced, hybrid position where speed, warmth, and persistence directly translate to

occupancy success. Your mission is simple but vital: connect with every lead within one hour,

convert interest into scheduled property tours, and guide qualified prospects through the

application process to move-in.




This role is perfect for someone who thrives on call volume, loves the challenge of winning

people over, takes pride in flawless execution of a proven system, and has the organizational

discipline to manage multiple prospects through various stages of the leasing journey.




What You'll Do: 




Speed to Lead Execution

• Monitor the CRM continuously throughout your shift for incoming leads across all

properties

• Contact every new lead within 5 minutes via phone (primary) and follow-up

communication

• Make multiple contact attempts using strategic timing and persistence until you reach the

prospect




Tour Conversion & Sales

• Engage prospects with warmth and professionalism, building rapport quickly over the

phone

• Qualify leads, understand their needs and timeline, and match them to the right property

• Overcome objections and address concerns to move prospects toward booking a tour

• Schedule tours and confirm appointments, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks

• Follow up with prospects who haven't responded or are "thinking about it"




Application Management & Administrative Support

• Guide qualified prospects through the application process, ensuring they understand

requirements and timelines

• Proactively follow up with applicants to collect outstanding documents (pay stubs, IDs,

references, etc.)

• Review submitted applications for completeness and accuracy before routing for

approval

• Communicate application status updates to prospects, keeping them informed and

engaged throughout the process

• Coordinate with the property team to resolve application questions and move approved

applicants toward lease signing

• Maintain organized tracking of all prospects in the pipeline—from initial contact through

move-in




CRM Management & Documentation

• Log all call activity, prospect details, objections, and outcomes in the CRM accurately

and immediately

• Update lead status and next steps to ensure seamless handoff to the touring team and

property managers

• Track your own metrics: contact rate, conversion rate, tours booked, applications

submitted, and speed to lead performance




Accountability & Optimization

• Own your daily and weekly goals for calls made, contacts reached, tours booked, and

applications completed

• Identify patterns in objections, application drop-offs, or process bottlenecks and

proactively suggest improvements

• Maintain high energy and quality standards even during high-volume periods




What We're Looking For: 

Required Skills & Traits

• Exceptional Phone Presence – You sound confident, friendly, and genuine. People

want to talk to you even when they didn't plan to.

• Natural Sales Ability – You know how to listen, ask the right questions, create urgency,

and close without being pushy.

• Self-Starter Mentality – You don't need someone looking over your shoulder. You see a

lead, you call it. You see a problem, you solve it.

• Highly Organized & Detail-Oriented – You're tracking dozens of leads and applications

at different stages and nothing slips through the cracks. You thrive on systems, follow-

through, and keeping meticulous records.

• Strong Administrative Skills – You can manage paperwork, chase down missing

documents, and keep multiple applicants moving forward without dropping the ball. You

understand that administrative excellence is what turns tours into move-ins.

• Resilient & Consistent – Rejection doesn't faze you. You understand that 50 calls

might lead to 10 conversations and 3 tours, and you're energized by that reality, not

discouraged.

• Process-Driven – You understand that accurate CRM data and complete applications

aren't busywork—they're what allows the team to win.

• Comfortable with Repetition – You're calling leads and following up on applications all

day. If you need constant variety, this isn't the role for you. If you love perfecting a craft

through repetition, you'll excel here.

Preferred Experience

• 1-2+ years in inside sales, appointment setting, leasing, or customer service roles

(property management experience is a plus but not required)

• Experience working in a CRM system (Yardi, Knock, Rent Manager, Salesforce, or

similar)

• Proven track record of hitting or exceeding call/conversion metrics

• Experience managing application processes, collecting documents, or similar

administrative workflows

• Experience in a hybrid or virtual work environment




What Success Looks Like

Within 30 days, you're:

• Consistently contacting 90%+ of leads within 60 minutes

• Booking 15-20+ tours per week

• Maintaining accurate CRM records with zero missed follow-ups

• Successfully guiding applicants through document submission with minimal hand-

holding from managers




Within 90 days, you're:

• A trusted subject matter expert on objection handling and lead conversion

• Hitting or exceeding monthly tour-booking and application completion targets

• Proactively identifying bottlenecks in the lead-to-lease pipeline and suggesting process

improvements

• Managing a full pipeline of prospects from first contact through move-in with minimal

supervision




Work Environment

• Hybrid position – Work from home with reliable internet and a quiet workspace

• Core working hours required – Leads come in during business hours and evenings;

schedule flexibility within coverage windows

• High call volume – Expect to make 40-80+ calls per day depending on lead flow

• Metrics-driven culture – You'll be measured on activity (calls, contact rate) and outcomes

(tours booked, applications completed)




Why This Role Matters

You are the engine of our occupancy. Every tour booked is a potential resident, and every

resident means a thriving property. But tours alone don't fill units—your ability to shepherd

prospects through the application process and across the finish line is what turns interest into

signed leases. Your ability to move fast, connect authentically, stay organized, and close with

confidence directly impacts the success of our portfolio. If you love the thrill of high-volume

sales, take pride in flawless execution, and want to be a linchpin in a growing operation, this is

your role.
