description:
About the job

About Us

We are an entrepreneurial private investment platform acquiring and operating both real estate assets and privately held businesses.

Our real estate strategy focuses primarily on multifamily, industrial, and neighborhood retail properties. Our private equity strategy focuses on established, profitable operating companies across service businesses, healthcare, logistics, distribution, and other fragmented industries.

We move quickly, underwrite rigorously, and value professionals who combine analytical strength with practical judgment, intellectual curiosity, and an ownership mentality.

This is a fully remote position for a professional based in Colombia. The successful candidate must be able to collaborate closely with a U.S.-based investment team and maintain substantial overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

Please note: This is not an engineering, appraisal, brokerage, or purely asset-management position. Candidates must have direct transaction experience in private equity, investment banking, real estate investments, corporate development, or another investment-focused organization.




The Opportunity

We are seeking a hands-on Acquisition Associate to lead the evaluation and execution of both real estate and operating-company acquisitions.

The Vice President will work directly with senior leadership and take ownership of opportunities from initial screening through underwriting, due diligence, financing, Investment Committee presentation, closing, and post-acquisition planning.

This role is designed for a transaction-oriented professional who is comfortable building detailed financial models while also communicating with sellers, brokers, investment bankers, lenders, attorneys, accountants, property managers, and operating executives.

The successful candidate must be resourceful, highly organized, commercially minded, and capable of making clear investment recommendations—not simply completing assigned analyses.




Key ResponsibilitiesOpportunity Screening and Investment Judgment

Independently screen real estate and operating-company acquisition opportunities
Review offering memoranda, confidential information memoranda, broker packages, financial statements, tax returns, rent rolls, leases, and other transaction materials
Determine which opportunities warrant additional underwriting and senior-management attention
Identify key investment merits, risks, diligence requirements, and potential deal breakers
Prepare clear go, no-go, or pursue-with-conditions recommendations
Challenge assumptions presented by sellers, brokers, investment bankers, lenders, and third-party advisors
Evaluate opportunities based on downside protection, cash-flow durability, growth potential, financing risk, and risk-adjusted returns

Real Estate Underwriting and Valuation

Build, review, and maintain detailed Excel underwriting models
Prepare discounted cash-flow analyses, sensitivity analyses, scenario modeling, financing cases, and equity return waterfalls
Analyze rent rolls, leases, operating statements, trailing financials, budgets, real estate taxes, and capital-expenditure requirements
Evaluate market rents, occupancy, absorption, lease and sales comparables, cap rates, supply pipelines, zoning, and submarket drivers
Calculate and assess cash-on-cash returns, leveraged and unleveraged IRRs, MOIC, debt yield, DSCR, LTV, LTC, and ICR
Evaluate senior debt, mezzanine debt, preferred equity, joint-venture equity, and other capital structures
Review lease provisions, tenant reimbursements, renewal options, tenant improvements, leasing commissions, RUBS, and other property-specific considerations

Private Equity and Business-Acquisition Underwriting

Analyze privately held operating businesses across multiple industries
Build acquisition and leveraged-buyout models, including sources and uses, debt schedules, cash-flow projections, and investor returns
Analyze revenue, gross margin, adjusted EBITDA, SDE, owner add-backs, working capital, capital expenditures, and free cash flow
Evaluate customer concentration, supplier concentration, recurring revenue, employee dependency, cyclicality, and operational risks
Assess historical financial statements, tax returns, budgets, forecasts, and management adjustments
Normalize earnings and identify unsupported, nonrecurring, or questionable add-backs
Evaluate purchase-price structures, seller financing, rollover equity, conventional debt, and SBA financing when applicable
Assist with quality-of-earnings reviews and reconciliation of financial information across multiple sources
Research industries, competitors, market size, growth trends, fragmentation, regulatory considerations, and acquisition opportunities

Lead transaction processes from initial evaluation through closing
Coordinate financial, operational, commercial, legal, insurance, environmental, and property-level due diligence

The Market Development Representative (MDR) will generate new business through outbound calls and targeted emails to potential clients. This position spends roughly 80% of the time on the phone prospecting new clients. Market Development Reps will receive hands-on training with an emphasis on strategic selling and a focus on researching targeted accounts. Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

About the job

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We Also Offer


Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off
A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from


Role Overview

As a Specialist, Onboarding, you are a professional who thrives in ensuring a seamless and positive onboarding experience for our service professionals (our Pros) to our platform. You are responsible for coordinating and facilitating customer onboarding, while providing exceptional customer service and answering Pros' questions and concerns.

As the dedicated and primary point of contact during the most critical window post-enrollment, you take ownership of the Pro experience, guiding them through early adoption, building confidence, and ensuring they realize value quickly. You bring a proactive approach to addressing challenges, empathy, and problem-solving skills to help better our team and improve the lives of our Pros. You operate with an ownership mindset, acting as a continuation of the sales experience by reinforcing the value of HCP and ensuring Pros feel confident they made the right decision.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, hard working, and above all else focused on improving the lives of our Pros. Our success is their success.

What You Do Each Day


Own relationship during initial onboarding phase for new Pros including account activation and transition, adoption and product utilization, relationship building, and delivery of product and service value
Serve as the primary and dedicated resource for Pros during their early lifecycle, ensuring a smooth transition from sales through onboarding
Reinforce and “resell” the value of HCP, helping Pros build confidence in their decision and driving early product adoption
Effectively communicate client information, trends, and feedback across teams (i.e. Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Tech Support)

Identify opportunities for expansion, recommend areas for improvement, and proactively look for ways to better our Pros experience
Manage details, timelines, and action to drive efficiency
Improve our Pros opportunities by leveraging qualitative and quantitative analysis
Develop processes that distinguish our brand by exceeding customer expectations in support delivery
Eloquently troubleshoot technical issues, have deep product knowledge, and think outside the box for solutions


Qualifications


1-3+ years experience in full-time customer success, implementation or sales
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a related field
Proven success in developing relationships with new customers and exceeding success metrics
Ability to work the scheduled shifts: Monday - Friday 11am-8pm PST

A natural curiosity backed by action; you are multi-dimensional (volunteering, creative outlets, side projects, hobbies, athletics), with a proven ability to successfully start over, learn from scratch, and thrive in new environments

This role is open to candidates and the expected compensation range for this role is $25,450-$28,500 annual OTE (includes range of $19,750-$22,800 base plus variable bonus). The specific rate for the successful candidate will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. Housecall Pro is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth.

Founded in 2013, Housecall Pro helps home service professionals (Pros) streamline every aspect of their business. With easy-to-use tools for scheduling, dispatching, payments, and more, Housecall Pro enables Pros to save time, grow profitably, and provide best-in-class service.

Housecall Pro’s brand portfolio includes Business Coaching by Housecall Pro, a business coaching solution for home services businesses. Our brands are united by a singular mission to champion our Pros to success.

We support more than 50,000 businesses and have over 2,000 ambitious, mission-driven, genuinely fun-loving teammates across the globe. If you want to do work that impacts real people, supported by a team that will invest in you every step of the way, we’d love to hear from you.

Housecall Pro celebrates diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment. La colaboración consiste en impartir un seminario online dentro del área de especialidad de cada docente, articulando fundamentos teóricos, análisis clínico y herramientas de intervención. Buscamos una enseñanza rigurosa, actualizada y vinculada con los desafíos reales de la práctica profesional.




Áreas de especialización




Buscamos perfiles con formación y experiencia en modelos cognitivo-conductuales y contextuales —TCC, ACT o DBT—, Terapia Breve Centrada en Soluciones, intervención clínica en duelo o Terapia de Juego.




Responsabilidades

Revisar y validar el programa y los materiales proporcionados por IEDUC.
Proponer, en coordinación con el equipo académico, las adecuaciones que resulten pertinentes.
Impartir las sesiones virtuales conforme a los objetivos y la estructura del seminario.
Facilitar el análisis clínico, las actividades prácticas y la participación del grupo.




Perfil requerido




• Licenciatura en Psicología con título y cédula profesional.

• Formación especializada comprobable en el área de postulación.

• Experiencia clínica vigente y relacionada con el enfoque.

• Capacidad para comunicar contenidos clínicos de manera clara y estructurada.




Valoramos además:




Posgrado, certificaciones o entrenamientos en el enfoque; así como experiencia docente, capacitación, supervisión clínica o formación de profesionales de la salud mental. Estos elementos fortalecerán la candidatura, pero no es necesario reunirlos todos.




Características de la colaboración:




• Modalidad completamente online, con sesiones en vivo. Pueden postularse profesionales de cualquier estado de México.

• Colaboración profesional remunerada, temporal y por seminario.

• Periodo académico: septiembre a noviembre de 2026.

• IEDUC proporciona el programa y los contenidos temáticos del seminario. El docente deberá revisarlos, validarlos y acordar con el equipo académico las adecuaciones pertinentes, así como diseñar las actividades, ejercicios y recursos didácticos necesarios para favorecer la aplicación de los contenidos.

• El calendario, la carga académica, los alcances y los honorarios se compartirán antes de formalizar la colaboración, de acuerdo con el seminario asignado.




Postulación

Si tu formación y experiencia se relacionan con alguna de estas áreas, envíanos:

• CV actualizado.

• Área de especialización a la que deseas postularte.

• Breve descripción de tu experiencia clínica y docente.

• Disponibilidad durante el periodo señalado.




Postúlate directamente a través de LinkedIn o envía tu información a contacto@ieduc.com.mx

Asunto: Postulación docente | [Área de especialización]




En IEDUC buscamos profesionales que conozcan profundamente su disciplina y sepan convertir su experiencia clínica en una formación rigurosa, clara y significativa.

Remote — Latin America · Contract, part-time to start (~20 hrs/week) · 3+ years of experience




About Rad Hires

Rad Hires connects founder-led and growth-stage companies with vetted, AI-forward talent across Latin America. We handle sourcing, vetting, and process so our clients meet only candidates who are ready to contribute from day one.




About the company

Our client is a business consulting and services company that helps founder-led businesses turn strategic plans into executed work. They build project roadmaps and then embed execution teams inside their clients' operations — providing the structure, systems, and follow-through that fast-growing, founder-led organizations often lack on their own. The team works heavily with AI tools, including Claude, as part of how it operates day to day.




About the role

This is the company's first dedicated marketing hire. There is no internal marketing team today — marketing has been handled ad hoc by the founder and general admin support, which is why the newsletter hasn't launched yet and social posting has been inconsistent. The planning and content outline for the newsletter already exist; this person's job is to get it running and keep it running, along with the rest of the company's own marketing.

You'll also be the person who runs the company's marketing through Claude — orchestrating the AI agents and skills already built for the work, and acting as the human check to make sure what comes out of them is actually ready to ship.




What you'll do

Own the newsletter end to end: launch it from the existing plan and content outline, then run scheduling, writing, design, and sending, and use performance data to sharpen each send.
Protect and grow the brand voice across blog, case studies, social, and email content.
Keep the company website current and on message in Squarespace.

Re-establish a consistent social/LinkedIn presence, after a period of ad hoc, inconsistent posting.
Use Claude to orchestrate the marketing workflow across the different agents and skills already built, checking outputs before anything goes out.
Pull performance data from HubSpot and Google Analytics and use Claude to build and maintain a reporting dashboard (this doesn't exist yet — you'd be building it).
Track what's working and bring leadership a recommendation, not just numbers.




What we look for

3+ years of marketing experience (education and hands-on), generalist or coordinator level — a marketing-related degree is required.
Genuinely AI-forward: you already work with Claude (or similar tools) as your default way of working, not something you're picking up on the job.
A strong writer and editor with an eye for tone and design.
Familiarity with HubSpot and Squarespace; comfort with Google Workspace and basic analytics tools.
Comfortable building something from a plan rather than an established process — this role starts with direction, not a fully built system.




Signals we love

An initiator mindset — you push things to done instead of opening threads and letting them sit.
Detail-oriented — things stay current, accurate, and on time without needing reminders.
Comfortable in ambiguity — this client moves fast and doesn't always hand you a fully clear brief; you're expected to sense what's needed and bring a confident recommendation.




This role is not for you if

You need a fully defined process before you start. This is a build-it-yourself, first-marketing-hire role — the plan exists, but the execution system doesn't yet.

About the job

About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:


One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)


So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting


About the Role: 

We’ve rebuilt core consumer finance products from scratch, loans, credit cards, and car finance, delivering money to customers in minutes instead of days. We are now launching our credit card product in Mexico and building our founding local team.

Customer support is critical to our success. Many of our customers are entering the formal financial system for the first time, and the way we support them matters deeply.

We’re looking for a Customer Support Agent to help deliver an excellent, friendly, and trustworthy experience to our credit card customers in Mexico.

This is a hands-on role focused on answering customer questions, resolving issues, and guiding customers through our product and processes. You’ll be on the front lines of customer interaction, helping people understand their credit card, payments, balances, and next steps.

You don’t need to build tools or write code, but you do need to be empathetic, detail-oriented, reliable, and eager to learn. Many of the questions you handle will not yet be automated, and your work will directly help us improve our product and processes over time.

What You’ll Do

 Answer Customer Questions
Respond to customer inquiries via chat, email, and eventually phone.
Help customers understand their credit card, balances, due dates, payments, and app features.
Provide clear, friendly, and accurate answers using internal tools and knowledge bases.
Escalate complex or sensitive cases when needed.
 Resolve Issues with Care & Accuracy
Help customers troubleshoot common issues (payments, transactions, account access).
Follow defined processes to resolve issues correctly and safely.
Identify when something doesn’t look right and raise it to the appropriate team.
Always prioritise customer trust, clarity, and compliance.
 Learn the Product Deeply
Become an expert in our credit card product, app flows, and customer policies.
Stay up to date with changes to features, processes, and FAQs.
Use internal documentation and tools to provide consistent answers.
 Improve Support Quality Over Time
Flag recurring customer issues or unclear processes to your manager.

Contribute feedback from real customer conversations to Product and Operations.


Required

Strong written communication skills in Spanish (English is a plus).
High empathy and a genuine desire to help people.
Attention to detail and ability to follow processes carefully.
Comfort using digital tools (support platforms, internal dashboards, messaging tools).
Reliability, ownership, and professionalism.
Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-moving environment.

Previous experience in customer support, call centres, or service roles.
Experience supporting financial products (banking, credit cards, lending).

Working closely with Operations and Product teams by sharing customer feedback.
Helping ensure customers feel supported, informed, and respected.

Take a case from first contact through to actual resolution, including the backend or ops step that fixes it — not just the reply to the customer

Work alongside AI agents as part of your toolkit
Use AI assistants and internal agents to triage, draft, summarise, and pull data — and know when their output is wrong and shouldn't be shipped

Turn recurring problems into fewer problems

Write and maintain the runbooks, help articles, and macros the rest of the team uses
Reduce your own dependency on other teams: learn the internal tools, the SQL queries, and the ops scripts well enough to answer your own questions
Connect the dots across the business
Be the person who notices that a spike in one queue is caused by something three systems away
Bring the customer reality into product and risk decisions, and translate those decisions back into something a customer can understand in Spanish
Excellent written Spanish and working English (our tools, docs, and much of the team operate in English)
Genuine analytical curiosity: you like taking something apart to understand why it broke, and you follow the thread further than you were asked to

description:
About the job

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people
Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK
Profitable since 2017
Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs
Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




Join us if you want to

Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1
Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo
Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting




About The Role

Lendable is launching its credit card product in Mexico and building a founding

local team. We're looking for someone to own the day-to-day operation of that

product: the customer conversations, yes, but also the queues, the exceptions,

the data behind them, and the tooling that makes all of it faster next month

than it was this month.

This is not a scripted support seat. Our support stack is heavily instrumented

and increasingly AI-assisted, which means the routine answers are largely

handled what's left is the interesting part: cases that don't fit the script,

patterns nobody has noticed yet, and processes that still need a human to design

them. You'll spend part of your week talking to customers and part of it

figuring out why they had to contact us at all.

We're a small team in a market we're still learning. The person who does well

here is curious, comfortable being the one who doesn't wait to be told, and

happy to wear whichever hat the day needs.




What You'll Do

Own the daily operational queues, end to end
Run the recurring card-ops routines: blocked accounts, failed card deliveries, payments that need reconciling, applications stuck mid-flow
Take a case from first contact through to actual resolution, including the backend or ops step that fixes it — not just the reply to the customer
Keep queues clean and decisions auditable, and know which cases genuinely need another team versus which ones you can close yourself
Investigate, don't just respond
Dig into dashboards, internal tools, and customer records to work out what actually happened before deciding what to say
Reconstruct timelines across systems — application, card, transactions, payments and form a view on root cause
Spot irregularities early (fraud signals, broken flows, provider failures) and escalate with evidence and a hypothesis, not just a screenshot
Work alongside AI agents as part of your toolkit
Use AI assistants and internal agents to triage, draft, summarise, and pull data — and know when their output is wrong and shouldn't be shipped
Improve the prompts, macros, and knowledge sources those agents rely on when you see them getting things wrong or going stale
Help us decide which repetitive work should be automated next, and what needs to stay human
Turn recurring problems into fewer problems
Track what customers contact us about, quantify it, and bring the top patterns to Product, Risk, and Engineering with data attached
Write and maintain the runbooks, help articles, and macros the rest of the team uses
Reduce your own dependency on other teams: learn the internal tools, the SQL queries, and the ops scripts well enough to answer your own questions
Connect the dots across the business
Be the person who notices that a spike in one queue is caused by something three systems away
Bring the customer reality into product and risk decisions, and translate those decisions back into something a customer can understand in Spanish




What We're Looking For

Excellent written Spanish and working English (our tools, docs, and much of the team operate in English)
Genuine analytical curiosity: you like taking something apart to understand why it broke, and you follow the thread further than you were asked to
Comfort with data and tooling — spreadsheets, dashboards, internal admin panels — and no fear of a query, an API response, or a log file
Hands-on experience using AI tools in real work (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, n8n or similar): you've briefed an assistant on a task, iterated on the prompt, checked its output, and formed opinions about where it fails.
We're not looking for an AI specialist — we're looking for someone who already works this way
A bias toward figuring it out: you exhaust what you can do yourself before escalating, and when you do escalate you arrive with context
Care and precision with people's money and personal data, and the judgement to slow down on sensitive or emotional cases
Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities in an early-stage team




Nice to Have

Experience in fintech, banking, lending, or payments operations
Any hands-on technical foundation: basic SQL, scripting, Python notebooks, workflow automation tools, or having built something small yourself
Experience owning a support or ops process, not just working inside one
Background in a fast-growing startup or a founding-team environment




This role is probably not the right fit if

You're looking for a defined script and a fixed queue to work through
You'd rather hand a problem to another team than learn the system behind it
You prefer stable, unchanging processes, ours will change frequently




Life at Lendable

Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies
Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites
Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls
Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover
Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans
Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members
Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations




Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

Founded in 2009, CLO Virtual Fashion is creating a new ecosystem for digital fashion based on its unrivaled technology in 3D clothing simulation algorithms.




CLO Virtual Fashion provides all clothing-related services from concept to design, manufacturing, marketing, fitting, and styling based on 3D clothing simulation algorithms.




Along with costume design software CLO, Marvelous Designer, and Jinny, we are involved in the entire costume journey with platforms specialized in costume content such as CLO-SET and CONNECT to build an efficient and sustainable workflow. Additionally, our solution allows physical and digital garments to be tagged together to function within the CLO system.




CLO Virtual Fashion, which is leading the global digital fashion market, currently has a total of 13 offices in 11 countries around the world, including Asia, North America, Europe, and South America, and is gradually expanding based on numerous customers from around the world.




Position Overview




You will be trained to become an expert-level user of our software, CLO, but more importantly, will be responsible for all things involving education and user support.




You are the liaison between users and our software development team. You assist clients in translating & highlighting the flexibility and functionality of CLO into real solutions for their unique challenges. You bring your passion for knowledge with you, connecting and inspiring the people you educate.

Training Enterprise and Academic users

Presales Consultant – Retail POS & Unified Commerce

Location: Mexico City (Remote)

About the job

Remote | E-commerce | Inside Sales & Support | US Timezone (EST)




About the Opportunity

Our client is an e-commerce company specializing in home water filtration systems in the US market. They are expanding their remote international team and looking for an Inside Sales & Customer Success Specialist.

This is a hybrid role combining sales ownership with customer support execution. The role structure is approximately 70% Sales and 30% Customer Support. The ideal candidate should have a strong sales mindset, experience with inbound and outbound communication, and confidence in closing deals independently.




Why this role is unique:

High Ownership: Handle warm inbound leads and drive revenue without cold spamming.
Direct Impact: Build long-term customer relationships and directly influence customer lifetime value.
Uncapped Earnings: High commission percentages tied directly to clear sales targets.
Streamlined Processes: Low support volume, allowing you to focus heavily on sales and conversions.




What you will be doing:

Sales & Revenue Generation

Convert inbound inquiries into completed purchases through structured conversations.
Conduct sales discussions focused on closing and objection handling.
Handle consistent follow-ups, lead nurturing, and re-engagement of potential clients.
Execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities (upgrading systems and replacement filters).
Conduct targeted outbound outreach to warm leads.
Maintain accurate records, logging interactions and pricing negotiations in Zoho CRM.

Customer Support & Operations

Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and live chat with high responsiveness.
Process orders, refunds, replacements, and provide product consultations.
Coordinate with warehouse and fulfillment teams regarding shipping status and logistics issues.
Provide comprehensive pre-sale and post-sale support.

Operations & Reporting

Report daily on sales activity, conversion performance, and customer feedback.
Maintain proper CRM tagging, segmentation, and interaction logging.
Coordinate with internal CS, CRM, and marketing teams to optimize the sales funnel.




What company looking for:

3+ years of proven experience in sales, revenue generation, and deal closing.
Fluent American English (spoken and written) - this is a strict requirement with zero exceptions.
Solid experience working with CRMs (Zoho CRM is highly preferred).
High comfort level with both inbound and outbound sales calls.
Strong objection handling, pricing discussion, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work independently and consistently meet structured KPIs.

Nice to Have:

Experience in E-commerce (Shopify/Amazon ecosystems) or B2B sales.
Familiarity with logistics and fulfillment platforms such as ShipStation.
Experience with physical product sales (home improvement, appliances, etc.).




Products & Market context:

Products: Whole house water filtration systems, replacement filters, faucets, and components.
Target Market: Primarily B2C, with an expanding B2B segment (plumbers, installers, resellers).
Average Deal Sizes: $80–$300 for replacements/filters; $300–$600+ for full systems.
Repeat Customer LTV: $1,200+.




Location & Conditions

📍 Location: 100% Remote (Global, with a focus on LatAm, Europe).

🕒 Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST (Fixed schedule).

💼 Contract Type: Contractor.

About the job

Who We Are Is What We Do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

You’ll be the face and voice of Deel for our clients, both internally and externally. In this dynamic role, you’ll be responsible for onboarding clients and setting them up for durable relationships with Deel to enable long-term success. You will serve as our client’s trusted advisor by providing strategic guidance during the onboarding phase on operational and product-related issues. Simultaneously, you will be an internal advocate for clients with Deel by championing new products and capabilities to facilitate the expansion of each client’s business with Deel. You will facilitate on-time onboarding through project management of all stakeholders involved.

You are a passionate business builder at heart. You get energized by tackling complex, challenging, often ambiguous problems and driving real impact across a business. You are not afraid to get your hands dirty to deliver projects. You are a talented generalist at home, diving into data for insights, and confident in cross-functional project management with multiple stakeholders. Working with great people is a non-negotiable priority because you thrive in a highly collaborative, high-performance team. If that is you, join our team!

Responsibilities


Project Management: Plan, execute, and monitor the successful launch of our Global all-in-one Employee Management Platform Implementation for a diverse set of clients, ensuring timely completion .
Product Expertise: Become a Deel expert and a go-to resource for our customers and internal colleagues by deeply understanding our products/services, industry trends, and competitive landscape.
Communication & Presence: Communicate clearly, persuasively, and professionally with stakeholders, demonstrating confidence and credibility. Enable our customer base by understanding their use cases and aligning them with Deel’s best practices.

Team Contribution: Make meaningful contributions to team goals by collaborating closely with internal teams such as Customer Experience & R&D. Support team members for collective success and pitch in on developing/documenting implementation processes and best practices.

Experience: 3+ years in a customer onboarding role supporting a B2B SaaS product, particularly in HR, Payroll, and Finance domains.

About the job

Description

Amazon Mexico team is looking for a data driven, customer-obsessed, hands on and creative candidate to join our Vendor Hub Program team. As Account Manager, you'll work with selected vendors to help drive growth and help deliver a best-in-class customer experience on amazon.com.mx, while facilitating great business relationships with some of Amazon's highest visibility brands.

Key job responsibilities

You’ll be responsible for looking after a brand’s product portfolio, contributing to improvements in the user experience for customers and creating detailed monthly reports on performance. You’ll lead presentations and planning sessions with vendors and act as the main point of contact for them.

You will also provide support to drive category growth through detailed analysis of business inefficiencies and identifying solutions; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality product detail pages; and making recommendations for effective marketing campaigns.

To achieve success in this role, you will have strong analytical skills as well as relationship management and organizational skills. You will also be comfortable picking up new technologies. You'll be an analytics expert, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions, with the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You'll have strong communication skills and a proven track record of building positive working relationships.

Account Manager are fully involved in the following functions: online marketing, vendor management and in-stock management. Tasks associated with these functions include:


 Online marketing: improving product page data, developing marketing and merchandising plans, improving customer experience onsite, helping generating traffic and sales
 Vendor management: help growing selection of products to sell on Amazon, onboarding new vendors, identifying and resolving pricing issues
 In-stock management: tracking purchase orders, investigating late deliveries, resolving order rejections, working with vendors on PO automation.

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

 2+ years of sales or account management experience
 2+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
 Experience with Excel
 Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English


Preferred Qualifications

About the job

Marketing & Growth Lead




Construye la marca y el growth engine de AliVet: haz que los dueños de mascotas nos encuentren, confíen en nosotros, regresen y nos recomienden.




QUÉ ES ALIVET




AliVet está construyendo el mejor grupo de hospitales veterinarios de México. Integramos hospitales, elevamos su estándar médico y operativo y los convertimos en referentes de sus ciudades.




Estamos creciendo rápido y necesitamos construir una máquina de marketing que crezca con nosotros.




LO QUE ES TUYO




Marca & contenido




* Definir la narrativa y voz de AliVet.

* Liderar redes sociales, contenido y comunidad.

* Crear contenido desde los hospitales: médicos, pacientes, casos e historias.

Growth & adquisición




* SEO y Local SEO.

* Google Business Profiles y Google Reviews.

* Google Ads, Meta Ads y otros canales de adquisición.

Reputación & comunidad

* Construir una comunidad que interactúe, recomiende y regrese.

ERES TÚ SI




* Piensas como marketer y growth operator, no solamente como creador de contenido.

* Tienes buen ojo para contenido y sabes contar historias.

* Eres muy hands-on: propones, ejecutas, mides y optimizas.

* Te gusta trabajar con datos y herramientas de AI.

* Tienes sensibilidad real por los animales y por la experiencia del cliente.




TU OBJETIVO




Construir el sistema de marketing de AliVet y convertirlo en una fuente medible de crecimiento.




Mediremos tu éxito por:




* Nuevos clientes y CAC.

* Tráfico y leads generados.

* SEO y presencia local.

* Google Reviews y reputación.

* Repeat rate y reactivación.

* Crecimiento de comunidad.

ADÓNDE PUEDES LLEGAR

description:
About the job

About Us

Some companies are in the business of banking. Others are in the business of shoes. Or sports. Or soft drinks. At EF, we're in a different kind of business. One that's a little less tangible, and a lot more important. Because our business, what we make, makes everything else possible. We're in the business of understanding. Between people. Between cultures.

For over half a century we’ve been the leader in international educational programs and experiences designed to foster such understanding. Through language, cultural exchange, academic studies, and educational travel, we create the kinds of immersive experiences that challenge biases, open minds, and pave the way for a more understanding world.

You’ll find our offices and schools located in some of the world’s greatest cities, and filled with smart, driven people (over 50,000 of us) who push each other to be better every day. But it’s what we do together - building greater understanding, breaking down barriers, and creating a better world - that makes all the difference.

Founded in 1965 in Sweden, EF (Education First) is a global association of education companies that share a common mission of opening the world through education. EF has been recognized on Forbes 2025 and 2024 World’s Best Employers and 2024 Top Companies for Women lists, Fast Company’s 2025 Next Big Things In Tech, and was a 2024 App Store Award winner in Cultural Impact.

About The Team

EF English Live is powering the next generation of English language learning for millions of learners, worldwide. We’re reinventing education through a combination of real EF teachers and AI language learning technology with online English courses that simulates real-life scenarios. Join classes 24/7 from anywhere and progress faster with a method that works.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em português, espanhol e inglês

description:
About the job

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member's voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

About The Team

Stripe was built with simplicity in mind. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an independent business, startup, SMB, or enterprise, and our mission is to provide all Stripe users with the best support experience possible. Today, Stripe handles over 1 million support cases per year and processes millions of internal transactions. We'll achieve excellence by thinking of support in a novel, solution-oriented way and viewing operations as an integral enabler of all our growth.

Stripe has unique operational problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with as a result of "growing the GDP of the Internet." Stripes leverage understanding of our products, the financial industry and money movement, and our processes to support both internal and external users. Doing so requires us to invest significant resources into building this experience ourselves.

What you'll do

Stripe launched Stripe Delivery Centers—a new global team to design, implement, and grow Stripe operations for the next decade. We are looking for dynamic and curious people who have a passion for solving global user issues, building operations, driving process improvement, and playing a front-line role in building this new operational capability for Stripe and accelerating growth. If you like challenging, scaled problems and are an amazing teammate, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization
Be a part of building a brand new team and operational culture for Stripe
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems.
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving.
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations.
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes. You are an organized self-starter with a passion for finding solutions to our users' challenges.
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done.
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support.
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment.
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners.
You're willing to work a weekend shift pattern (either Sun-Thur (with Fri and Sat off) or Tue-Sat (with Sun and Mon off)). The SDC operates during daytime hours in 9-hour shifts (including 1-hour paid lunch break) scheduled to fall between the hours of 6am and 10pm.



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience in troubleshooting
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

🧮 We’re also unusually efficient. Net burn averaged about $14,600 a month in the first half of 2026, roughly 80% below typical for our stage, with a burn multiple of 0.83. Under 1 is top decile. That means new money goes to growth, not survival.

So that’s us. Feel free to learn more about us at: pilotplans.com/careers

The role. The goal. 🛣️

Here’s what we’re looking for from you:

It is very simple. We want someone to own group bookings end to end, and to win more of them. Retreats, conferences, weddings, sports teams, and larger friend and family trips keep finding us on their own, and we have never had anyone dedicated to them. That is what this role is.

Half the job is looking after the groups that come to us. The other half is going and finding more, through business development and marketing. It is some of the best business we get, and nobody owns it yet. You would.

What you’ll be doing and learning 🧑‍💻

Drumming Up New Business

Go and find group business rather than waiting for it to arrive
Build relationships with the kinds of organisations that travel in groups: companies, clubs, teams, event organisers, wedding planners
Work with marketing on campaigns, partnerships, and content aimed at group travel
Follow up with past groups and turn one trip into the next one
Bring us ideas for where group demand is hiding, then go and get it
Owning Group Requests
Respond quickly to group, retreat, and wedding block enquiries
Work out what the group actually needs: dates, size, budget, flexibility, and who makes the call
Put together options and quotes a group can decide from, not a wall of links
Follow up until they decide, without being pushy
Sourcing & Holding Inventory
Source rooms, rates, and holds with hotels and our distribution partners
Negotiate group rates and terms
Get confirmed options into Pilot so the group can plan around them
Keep track of what we are holding and when it expires
Booking & Vendor Operations
Place bookings, confirm them with the property, and keep good records
Get on the phone with hotels and partners when that is what resolves it
Sort out booking errors, availability problems, and special requests
Handle changes and cancellations all the way through to travel
Support During & After the Trip
Be reachable when a group is travelling and something goes wrong
Handle escalations calmly and with urgency
Make sure people feel informed and taken care of
Follow up afterwards and turn a good trip into repeat business
Making It a System
Build the templates, processes, and documentation so the next one is easier
Flag recurring problems to product and engineering
Keep an eye on how the pipeline is converting and what it is worth
Anything else as needed. We are a startup, so this is subject to change!




Treat everything above as a starting point, not a job spec carved in stone. It is not exhaustive, and it will change.




“Should I apply??!??!?” 🤯

First of all, obviously.

It’s easy, and you can do it here: https://forms.gle/D1HrBVbDteJqXwZYA

Second of all, as long as you think you have either the necessary skills, or the ability to learn them very quickly to do this role, you’re good. We care about your ability to execute, not your experience, though it certainly can be an indicator.

That said, the ideal candidate probably has these traits…

Core Traits and Working Style
Calm under pressure and emotionally steady, even when a group of 30 needs an answer tonight
Highly reliable, detail aware, and follows things through to completion
Acts with urgency and does not let issues linger
Comfortable working without perfect information and making good judgment calls
Polite, respectful, and empathetic with guests and partners, while still being firm when needed
Low ego. Focused on solving the problem, not defending themselves
Business Development and Marketing
Comfortable generating business, not just servicing it. Happy to go out and find the next group
Comfortable asking for the business without being pushy
Can negotiate rates and terms with a hotel and hold a position
Has ideas about where demand comes from, and is willing to test them
Motivated by closing and by margin, not just by clearing a queue
Communication and Execution
Very strong written communication. Clear, concise, and human
Comfortable getting on the phone with guests, hotels, and partners
Knows when async is enough and when a call resolves things faster
Able to explain issues and next steps clearly to non-technical people
Availability and Responsiveness
Genuinely available on an on-call basis, including some evenings and weekends when a group is travelling
Comfortable working Pacific time hours for North American groups
Comfortable with fast-moving environments and shifting priorities
Understands group travel is time sensitive and that dates expire
Experience and Background
Prior experience in group sales, hotel sales, events, travel agency work, hospitality, or customer support is strongly preferred
Experience dealing directly with customers or external partners is a plus
Travel or hospitality experience is helpful but not required
Based in or near Guadalajara, and able to be with us in person 1 to 3 times a week

If you meet even 50-70% of these you could be a great fit!

About the job

Comparte tu experiencia e impulsa a la próxima generación de emprendedores

¿Has construido una comunidad en redes sociales? ¿Has desarrollado estrategias digitales para marcas o proyectos? ¿Te apasiona compartir conocimiento y enseñar desde la experiencia?

En Liberu estamos desarrollando un programa de capacitación dirigido a emprendedores del sector de alimentos que buscan fortalecer su presencia en redes sociales, conectar con nuevos clientes y hacer crecer su negocio mediante estrategias digitales.

Para ello, buscamos especialistas con experiencia comprobada que deseen impartir workshops prácticos, dinámicos y basados en casos reales.







¿Qué tipo de perfiles buscamos?

Estamos en búsqueda de profesionales con experiencia comprobable en alguna de las siguientes áreas:

Social Media Management
Planeación Digital
Marketing Digital
Branding Digital
Creación de Contenido
Influencer Marketing
Community Management
Producción de Contenido

También invitamos a postularse a creadores de contenido que hayan desarrollado comunidades sólidas y deseen compartir su experiencia.







¿Qué buscamos en un speaker?

Más allá de la experiencia profesional, buscamos personas capaces de enseñar de forma clara, cercana y práctica.

Valoraremos especialmente perfiles que:

Disfruten compartir conocimiento.
Expliquen conceptos de manera sencilla.
Enseñen a partir de experiencias reales.
Tengan facilidad para hablar frente a grupos.
Inspiren a emprendedores y pequeños negocios.
Promuevan el aprendizaje mediante ejercicios y ejemplos prácticos.

Nuestro objetivo no es ofrecer clases teóricas, sino talleres que permitan a los participantes aplicar lo aprendido desde el primer día.







Programa de capacitación

El programa estará conformado por cuatro módulos, distribuidos durante dos semanas.

Cada speaker será seleccionado para impartir uno de los siguientes módulos.

Módulo 1Fundamentos de las Redes Sociales para Negocios

Temas de referencia:

Importancia de las redes sociales para un negocio.
Diferencias entre plataformas.
Errores comunes.
Casos de éxito.
Buenas prácticas.







Módulo 2Estrategia de Contenido para Negocios

Temas de referencia:

Definición de objetivos.
Conocimiento del cliente.
Planeación de contenido.
Calendario editorial.
Organización de publicaciones.







Módulo 3Creación de Contenido para Redes Sociales

Temas de referencia:

Desarrollo de ideas.
Grabación con celular.
Producción de contenido.
Comunicación frente a cámara.
Casos reales y aprendizajes.







Módulo 4Cómo convertir el contenido en resultados para el negocio

Temas de referencia:

Optimización del contenido.
Gestión de comunidad.
Mejores prácticas.
Planes de mejora.

Experiencia comprobable desarrollando estrategias digitales para marcas, empresas o proyectos.

Para todos los perfiles
Excelente capacidad de comunicación.
Disponibilidad para impartir sesiones de capacitación en línea.

Proceso de selección1. Recepción de postulaciones

Revisaremos la experiencia profesional, trayectoria y propuesta preliminar de cada candidato.

2. Entrevista con Liberu

Los perfiles preseleccionados participarán en una videollamada para conocer su experiencia, metodología de enseñanza y estilo de comunicación.

3. Desarrollo de la propuesta final

Los speakers seleccionados trabajarán junto con el equipo de Liberu para desarrollar y adaptar el contenido definitivo de su workshop, alineándolo con los objetivos del programa.

4. Selección final

Se confirmarán los especialistas que impartirán cada uno de los módulos del programa.

description:
About the job

Why this role exists




Charles, our founder, spends most of his week talking with the owners of short-term rental property management companies. Five or six of those conversations get recorded every week, and almost nobody sees them. Your job is to change that. You'll take everything he says on camera and turn it into the newsletter, clips, and posts that make him the best-known voice in this industry. He hits record and reviews your drafts once a week. Everything in between belongs to you.

About HostGenius




HostGenius is a private membership network and business operating system for short-term rental property management companies. More than 70 member companies managing about 3,000 properties run on our platform. Charles scaled his own property management company to 160 listings before starting HostGenius, so when he talks about this business, operators listen. We're profitable and growing fast, and this role turns his daily conversations into a growth channel.

What success looks like




A year from now, thousands of US property managers read our weekly newsletter. Clips go up on Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube every week, and every word sounds like Charles wrote it himself. He spends under two hours a week on content once the cameras are off. The sales team uses proof clips you found. The ads team runs creative you handed them. When we host an industry event, you stretch one week of recording into three months of material.




What you will own

Turning raw recordings into published content. You pick the moments worth keeping, cut clips with Riverside's Magic Clips, and write the hooks and captions.
Final copy for the weekly newsletter, LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube. Our AI pipeline produces first drafts for you. You run it, check it, and edit everything until it sounds like Charles.
The publishing calendar. Everything ships on time every week without anyone chasing you.
The weekly review with Charles. One approval pass. You ship what he approves and rework what he flags.
A weekly scoreboard: what shipped, newsletter growth, engagement from actual property managers, and which clips went to the ads team.
Freelance editors, once long-form YouTube outgrows Magic Clips. They cut, you direct.




Not in scope: paid ads (our Growth Marketing Manager owns Meta), long-form video editing (we will outsource it), and inventing strategy from scratch. The system is already designed. Your job is to run it every week and keep making it better.




What we are looking for




Required:

3+ years running content production end to end for a company, founder, or creator, with published work you can show us
Written English at a native level. You'll be ghostwriting a Canadian founder, and if your copy needs a second edit before it ships, this isn't your role. Finalists complete a paid writing test in his voice.
Good instincts for short-form video. You can listen to an hour of conversation and know which 40 seconds will stop someone scrolling.
The discipline to run a publishing calendar for months without missing a date
At least 4 hours of daily overlap with Pacific Time
You use AI tools daily for speed, and you catch what they get wrong




Nice to have:

Experience marketing to small business owners, or in real estate, hospitality, or short-term rentals
You've grown a newsletter on beehiiv, HubSpot, Kit, or similar
Podcast or webinar production, or familiarity with Riverside.fm
Enough design sense to make covers and carousels in Canva




Compensation

$2,500 to $3,500 USD per month as a full-time contractor plus up to a 30% annual bonus. This is a long-term role with upside as the media engine grows.




How to apply

Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions. Make sure your resume or profile links to 2 or 3 pieces of content you personally produced. We read every application that includes work samples and skip the ones that don't. Finalists complete a short paid writing test.

Position Title: Trade Marketing Associate Manager – Professional Beauty Mexico

Wella Company is one of the world’s leading beauty companies, comprised of a family of iconic brands such as Wella Professionals, Clairol, OPI, Nioxin and ghd. As innovators in the hair and nail industry, Wella Company empowers its people to delight consumers, inspire beauty professionals, engage communities, and deliver sustainable growth to its stakeholders.

For additional information about the Wella Company please visit www.wellacompany.com.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly driven, analytical, and execution-oriented Trade Marketing Associate Manager to join our Professional Beauty team in Mexico.

This role is responsible for developing and executing trade marketing strategies that accelerate sustainable growth, strengthen brand presence, and improve commercial performance across direct customers, distributors, and key professional beauty channels.

The Associate Manager will act as a key link between Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and other cross-functional teams, translating brand and commercial priorities into effective customer and channel plans. QUALIFICATIONS

About the job

About Parallel




At Parallel, we believe work is more than just a job—it shapes identity, purpose, and possibility. Our mission is to help people discover their life’s work while enabling organizations to build exceptional teams. We’re creating the next generation of hiring infrastructure, combining AI with thoughtful product design to help people and companies find their best match.




We’re looking for a Technical Product & Project Management Lead to join us on a client engagement, owning both the product strategy/discovery and the execution of a high-impact software project from ideation through delivery. This role sits at the intersection of product management, engineering, design, and client operations—ensuring we build the right features, solve the right user problems, and deliver projects on time and with high quality.




This engagement is expected to continue for the duration of the client project. High-performing team members will also be considered for future client engagements and full-time opportunities within Parallel as we continue to grow.




Role Overview




The Technical Product & Project Management Lead is responsible for driving the full product lifecycle—from user research, feature scoping, and requirements definition to sprint planning, development, QA, launch, and post-release evaluation. You will bridge customer and business needs with technical execution, translating ambiguous client problems into clear product roadmaps and actionable user stories while keeping engineering teams aligned and delivery on schedule.




This role is ideal for a hybrid Product & Project Manager who excels at strategic problem-solving, feature prioritization, cross-functional collaboration, and disciplined project execution in a fast-moving startup environment.




Responsibilities




Product Strategy & Discovery




Define feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specs derived from user research, client feedback, and market needs.
Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, user impact, and technical feasibility.
Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers to prototype, validate, and refine user flows and product interactions.
Establish success metrics (KPIs) for product features and analyze post-launch usage data to drive continuous feature iteration.




Execution & Delivery Management




Own the end-to-end delivery of product initiatives from roadmap planning through production release and post-launch optimization.
Create and maintain detailed project plans, roadmaps, release schedules, dependencies, and delivery milestones.
Lead Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
Proactively identify product/technical risks, unblock cross-functional dependencies, and drive rapid, informed decision-making.




Stakeholder Management & Operations




Serve as the central point of contact between client stakeholders, executive leadership, design, engineering, and operations teams.
Translate complex customer feedback and business needs into engineering roadmap priorities.
Oversee release management, quality assurance standards, user acceptance testing (UAT), and go-to-market readiness.
Continuously refine product management frameworks, documentation, and delivery processes across the team.




Requirements




3+ years of experience in product management, technical program management, or a hybrid product/project leadership role managing software products.
Proven track record of owning features/products end-to-end: defining user requirements, crafting PRDs (Product Requirement Documents), prioritizing backlogs, and shipping complex SaaS or AI applications.
Strong product sense & UX affinity: Ability to map out intuitive user flows, synthesize complex customer needs, and translate them into simple, powerful product solutions.
Technical & Agile fluency: Deep understanding of software development lifecycles, API integrations, cloud architecture concepts, and modern Agile frameworks.
Data-driven decision making: Experience setting product metrics, conducting quantitative/qualitative analysis, and prioritizing features using ROI framework models (e.g., RICE, MoSCoW).
Exceptional cross-functional leadership: Strong written and verbal communication skills to align engineering, product design, business stakeholders, and clients around a shared vision.
Tool proficiency: Hands-on experience with product and delivery management platforms (e.g., Linear, Jira, Notion, Figma, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Asana).
Startup mindset: Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-ownership environments with evolving priorities.




Nice to Have




Direct experience managing or launching SaaS, AI, or hiring/HR-tech products.
Background as a software engineer, technical writer, or computer science graduate.
Direct client-facing experience in consulting, agency, or enterprise software services environments.
Hands-on experience managing QA automation or complex software release pipelines.




Engagement & Benefits




Contract engagement for the duration of an active client project.
Opportunity to work directly with innovative startups and technology companies on meaningful products.

Competitive compensation.

About the job

Principal Function: The Order Fulfillment Specialist - Customer Success plays a critical role in efficiently receiving, reviewing, and processing all inbound customer purchase orders. This position ensures seamless coordination between customers, sales and internal teams, facilitates accurate order entry and timely fulfillment, and contributes to maintaining organized, compliant, and accurate internal processes.




Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Duties include, but are not limited to:




1. Customer Order Processing

Receive, review, and validate customer purchase orders to ensure accuracy of pricing, contractual terms, delivery requirements, and compliance with internal policies.
Request and coordinate product allocation, confirm material availability, and enter customer orders accurately into internal systems while monitoring order status through fulfillment.
Proactively track and resolve order delays or discrepancies, collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Supply Chain, Planning, Finance and Customer Success teams to align on delivery timelines and customer expectations.
Generate and distribute sales order confirmations to customers, ensuring clear communication of order details and fulfillment milestones.
Document, verify, and maintain records of any applicable third-party broker commissions associated with customer orders, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.

2. Customer Outbound Logistics

Plan, select, and execute all outbound customer shipments, balancing, cost efficiency, service reliability, and customer-specific delivery requirements.
Monitor shipment progress from dispatch through final delivery, providing timely, proactive updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with freight brokers, carriers, and warehouse partners to schedule shipments, resolve transit issues, mitigate delays, develop contingency plans to minimize customer impact.
Identify recurring logistics challenges and contribute to continuous improvement efforts aimed at enhancing delivery performance, visibility, and overall customer satisfaction.

3. Customer Support

Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and a solutions-oriented approach that reinforces thrust and long-term partnership.
Act as an extension of the Sales team by supporting customer requests, identifying upsell or follow-on order opportunities, and ensuring seamless handoffs between Sales and Operations.
Communicate extensively with customers, carriers, brokers, and internal teams via high-volume email and time-sensitive phone calls, responding promptly to inquiries, issues, and escalation needs related to active orders and shipments.
Prepare, retrieve, and distribute customer-requested documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates, and shipping records, ensuring accuracy and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

Carry out other duties to support departmental and organizational objectives.

title: Commercial Excellence Analyst
description:
About the job

Company Description 

Saya Biologics is a pioneering biopharmaceutical company in Latin America, focused on reducing the access gap to highly specialized biologic treatments. Through international strategic partnerships, we develop, register, commercialize, and distribute biologic and biosimilar medicines across the region. Our mission is to empower thousands of patients through accessible, innovative, and high-quality treatments. At Saya Biologics, you will have the opportunity to contribute to projects with a real impact on people’s lives and work in a collaborative and diverse environment driven by scientific and commercial excellence.







Role Description

As a Commercial Excellence Analyst, you will be responsible for measuring, analyzing, and tracking the performance of the sales force across Saya’s different business units. In your day-to-day work, you will build and maintain dashboards, reports, and commercial trackers to identify opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement in coverage, productivity, frequency, conversion, and commercial efficiency. You will also support commercial operations by tracking relationships with distributors, banks, insurers, hospitals, and other institutional stakeholders, ensuring that information, commitments, and next steps are clear and up to date. You will work closely with the Commercial, Finance, and Launch Excellence teams to standardize KPIs, prepare materials for internal reviews, organize key information, and contribute to a disciplined, agile, and well-documented commercial operation. 

This role is ideal for someone in the early stages of their career who wants to learn how the commercial engine of a growing biopharmaceutical company works, combining data analysis, operational coordination, and administrative support. 

This is a full-time position.







Requirements

• Strong analytical skills to work with commercial data, interpret trends, identify deviations, and generate actionable insights. 

• Commercial skills to understand sales operations, performance indicators, commercial productivity, and relationships with stakeholders such as distributors, hospitals, banks, and insurers. 

• Organizational skills to keep dashboards, reports, trackers, repositories, and commercial documentation up to date and well structured. 

• Communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, follow up on commitments, and present information clearly and in an organized manner.

• High attention to detail and a low margin of error when handling data, reports, and follow-up materials. 

• Proactivity to identify risks, opportunities, blockers, and improvements without waiting to be asked. 

• University degree in Business Administration, Business, Economics, Engineering, Data Analytics, Health Sciences, or related fields. 

• Recent graduate or up to 2 years of experience in internships, analytical, commercial, administrative roles, or related projects. 

• Solid command of Excel or Google Sheets; experience with BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau, CRM platforms such as Salesforce or Veeva, SAP, and Notion is desirable. 

• Advanced English level for reading and writing; bilingual Spanish-English profile is desirable. 

• Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate data cleaning, analysis, and report preparation, with human judgment and care for confidential information.
