title: Marketing Tech Ops - GHL Specialist
description:
About the job

GoHighLevel (GHL) Specialist — Remote, Mexico

Harvest Health Marketing, a division of Harvest Company, is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency that works exclusively with cash-pay chiropractic clinics. GoHighLevel is the backbone of everything we build for our clients — from lead capture to follow-up automation to appointment booking — and we need someone who knows the platform inside and out.

We are looking for an experienced GHL Specialist based in Mexico who can build complex automations, troubleshoot technical issues, create high-converting landing pages, set up SMS campaigns, manage A2P registration for client phone numbers, and configure accurate ad-platform tracking. This is a technical role that requires precision, problem-solving, and the ability to work closely with a U.S.-based team in real time.

About the Role

You will own the technical buildout and ongoing maintenance of GoHighLevel systems for our chiropractic clinic clients. Every client we onboard needs a fully functional GHL environment — pipelines, automations, landing pages, forms, calendars, SMS campaigns, email sequences, and conversion tracking — built correctly from the start and maintained as the business evolves.

You will work directly with our team to understand each client's workflow and translate that into a GHL build that runs without constant intervention. When things break — and sometimes they do — you will be the person who diagnoses and fixes it quickly.

This role requires daily availability during business hours for team meetings via Microsoft Teams. Strong communication is non-negotiable. If you cannot attend live meetings or communicate clearly in English, this role is not the right fit.

Required Skills & Experience

To be considered, you must meet all of the following:

• 3+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience — not familiarity, actual buildout and management experience

• Proven ability to build complex, multi-step automations including conditional logic, triggers, wait steps, and branching workflows

• Experience building and optimizing landing pages inside GHL — forms, funnels, and conversion-focused design

• Experience setting up SMS campaigns including drip sequences, appointment reminders, and lead follow-up automations

• Direct experience completing A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers — you understand the process, the requirements, and how to troubleshoot rejections

• Hands-on experience setting up Meta Conversions API (CAPI) — you can configure server-side event tracking for Meta/Facebook ads, including deduplication with the pixel and event matching for lead and purchase events

• Hands-on experience setting up offline conversion tracking for Google Ads — you can build and manage offline conversion imports so closed/won leads are matched back to the originating ad click

• In-depth understanding of UTM parameters and source tracking within GHL — you can set up and audit UTM tagging and traffic-source attribution so every lead can be traced back to the ad, campaign, and platform that generated it

• Strong troubleshooting ability — you can diagnose why an automation isn't firing, why a form isn't submitting, or why a message isn't delivering (or why a conversion isn't tracking) and fix it without hand-holding

• Excellent written and spoken English — you will attend daily meetings, communicate with team members, and document your builds clearly

• Fast, stable internet connection capable of supporting daily video calls via Microsoft Teams without interruption

• Availability to attend daily team meetings during U.S. business hours (schedule to be confirmed)

Applications without demonstrated GHL experience will not be reviewed. Be prepared to walk through a build you have completed.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with GHL sub-account setup and white-label agency environments

• Familiarity with Zapier or Make (Integromat) for third-party integrations

• Experience integrating GHL with Meta Lead Ads or Google Ads for automatic lead ingestion

• Background working with U.S.-based digital marketing agencies or healthcare-adjacent businesses

• Understanding of HIPAA-conscious communication practices for medical or healthcare clients




Responsibilities

• Build and configure GHL sub-accounts for new clients including pipelines, stages, tags, and custom fields

• Design and build complex automations for lead follow-up, appointment booking, no-show re-engagement, and nurture sequences

• Build landing pages, opt-in forms, and funnels optimized for patient lead generation

• Set up and manage SMS and email campaigns including A/B testing and performance monitoring

• Complete A2P 10DLC registration for client phone numbers and manage compliance requirements

• Set up and maintain Meta Conversions API integrations and Google Ads offline conversion imports for client accounts

• Implement and audit UTM parameters and source/attribution tracking in GHL so lead and conversion data ties back to the correct ad campaign

• Troubleshoot automation failures, integration issues, tracking discrepancies, and platform errors quickly and thoroughly

• Document all builds clearly so the team understands what was built and why

• Attend daily team meetings via Microsoft Teams and communicate progress, blockers, and completed work

• Maintain and update existing client GHL environments as strategies evolve




Compensation

• Fixed monthly rate — based on experience and scope of work

• Compensation discussed after skills assessment and initial interview

• Long-term contract with potential for rate increases as the relationship and workload grow




Who Thrives in This Role

• You are technically precise — you build things correctly the first time and test before handing off

• You communicate proactively — you flag issues before they become problems and ask questions before going in the wrong direction

• You take ownership of your builds — if something isn't working, you don't wait to be asked, you fix it

• You are reliable and present — daily meetings aren't optional and your availability during U.S. hours is consistent

• You learn fast — GHL updates frequently and you stay current without being asked

If you are looking for a role where you work independently without communication or live collaboration, this is not the right fit. We operate as a team and expect you to be a present, communicative part of it.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The global ABP Team acts as a critical platform that enables and improves efficiencies and effectiveness across Stripe by providing high-value, high-impact administrative support to leadership. The global ABP Team is a recognized and valued team that is integral to how Stripe operates. A crucial part of the global ABP Team is our Administrative Coordinator team—a centralized group of highly motivated and skilled individuals who offer core administrative support to Stripe leaders.

What you’ll do

As the Administrative Coordinator program and team grow, you'll find ways to successfully build processes and systems for scale, manage hiring practices that maintain the Stripe talent bar, and manage individual contributors across multiple regions. Additionally, you'll build relationships with key stakeholders and leaders across the organization that enable and support the work of the Administrative Coordinators and the larger global ABP Team. You'll report to and partner closely with the ABP Program Manager and support operational efforts, programming, and processes for the global ABP Program, including operating cadence, rhythm of business, and documentation.

Responsibilities


Manage and lead a team of Administrative Coordinators
Maintain an understanding of team workload and bandwidth
Develop and maintain adherence to the scope of the program and ensure individuals are set up for success
Maintain an understanding of team and individual performance and quality of support
Develop and maintain program documentation and guidelines
Provide regular and frequent feedback and coaching to individual team members
Address program escalations, feedback, and concerns
Develop strong executive, peer, and stakeholder relationships, maintaining effective communication channels and influencing without authority
Manage the headcount and capacity planning process in partnership with the ABP Program Manager
Manage the onboarding and training (and associated logistics) for new Administrative Coordinators
Serve as an expert on Stripe- and ABP-related policies and guidelines (e.g., travel and expenses) and enforce with the team—provide guidance and expectations around administrative best practices, tools, and processes
Identify and solve large-scale, ambiguous, and complex problems with company- and org-wide impact and drive org-wide strategic improvements
Drive key changes to programs to achieve future-state objectives, including processes, documentation, measurement, etc.
Draft and distribute comms across the ABP Team and to key stakeholders
Ideate and implement process improvements for the global ABP Program
Drive efficiency through simplification, automation, and continuous improvement of systems, processes, and ways of working
Contribute to strategic planning and roadmapping for the global ABP Program
Support existing tools, processes, templates, playbooks, and knowledge management efforts
Exhibit excellent judgment on sensitive and cross-functional issues, building collaboration between leaders, sub-teams, and the larger organization



Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Experience managing stakeholders and influencing critical client relationships
Experience in headcount planning and hiring practices
Experience in project and program management
Experience as an Administrative or Executive Assistant or deep knowledge of the administrative support role



Preferred Qualifications


Experience managing or leading individuals or a small team
Experience in managing global programs
Experience mentoring, growing, and developing individual contributors
Experience managing bandwidth and balancing workloads of multiple individuals



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

title: Remediation Complaint Analyst
description:
About the job

Workstream: Post-Market Quality Assurance (PMQA) Remediation

Role: Remediation Complaint Analyst

Role Summary

The Remediation Complaint Analyst is part of the PMQA remediation team and supports the retrospective review of historical complaints. This includes assessment of complaints against the criteria prescribed by the applicable retrospective review protocol, documentation of results and escalation of issues identified.

Responsibilities

Perform retrospective review and assessment of intake and complaint records per applicable retrospective review protocols.

Assess complaints to confirm the applicable complaint failure mode has been assigned, and escalate where the event relates to a potential adverse event.

Confirm that complaint investigations are best in class and aligned with requirements.

Confirm that complaints have been closed in a timely manner.

Provide input to the post-market surveillance organization on information gathered from complaint investigations.

Document results in accordance with the applicable retrospective review protocol.

Escalate to remediation clinical specialists or product quality engineers for correction as required.

Support the retrospective review and process remediation team as needed.

Communicate issues to the respective retrospective review lead.

Complete all assigned work in a timely manner.

Support FDA CAPA and intermediate controls as required.

Complete assigned training prior to performing assigned job responsibilities.

Participate in team meetings.

Support team leads and project managers with communication and reports needed for other forums.

Support the PMQA organization and remediation efforts as needed to ensure compliance to regulations and standards.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher preferred, or an associate degree with five or more years of cradle-to-grave complaint handling experience.

Experience working in a medical device or pharmaceutical regulated environment.

Expertise in 21 CFR 820, 21 CFR 803, ISO 13485 and EU MDR.

Experience reviewing and assessing large quantities of complaints as part of a remediation project.

Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel and Teams, Agile, Salesforce or similar applications used in a medical device or pharmaceutical environment.

High level of attention to detail, with the ability to organize and manage multiple tasks.

Ability to spot consistent issues and escalate them to management, and to request feedback when unsure what action to take.

Good listening and communication skills, with the ability to stay on task and maintain timeline commitments.

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of regulations impacting radiological devices and other global regulations.

Reporting Structure

Reports to: PMQA Leadership



Desired Skills and Experience

ISO 13485, Complaint Handling

title: Sourcing Specialist
description:
About the job

Sourcing Specialist – Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) 

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in human resources? A Sourcing Specialist who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Sourcing Specialist, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. Americas Delivery Mexico (ADMX) leverages scale and talent to provide high quality, cost effective service to our clients.




ADMX is a member of the Global Delivery Network which has presence across the world with Delivery centers in the United States, Romania, India, Spain, China, and the Philippines. ADMX is in Queretaro, Mexico. We provide consulting services to help our clients achieve a higher level of service in operational efficiency and business value. We are a team of professionals passionate about serving clients with distinction and learning, and we are driven by our purpose: Making an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and society.




The team

Talent team offers HR solutions by tapping into the different aspects of HR policies, to ensure every

professional’s engagement with the organization is meaningful. As part of the Talent Acquisition team, you will work with our business leaders to develop, implement and execute successful recruiting programs and effective reporting and analytics.




Key Roles and Responsibilities 

As a Talent Acquisition Research team, you will collaborate with stakeholders in the Sourcing /

Recruiting / Business groups to research, develop and deliver intelligence thereby enabling the

success of the company and our clients. You may work in any of our businesses involving Consulting.




The Researcher will deliver comprehensive research and on-demand intelligence for a variety of

market and functional specific requests in the Recruitment context. He/she will serve as expert on

direct sourcing strategies, tools, methodologies and practices.

• Partner with aligned stakeholders to create and implement sourcing strategies for active and

future requisitions

• Focus on target companies and industries to identify talent for various recruiting needs

• Administer reactive talent sourcing while driving towards a more proactive talent

• Pursue every available outlet (deep web, databases, networking, internet, job boards, in-house

channels) to find the intelligence/information that is requested

• Execute various types of research requests like talent mapping, market data intelligence,

compensation analysis, name generation etc.

• Recommend tools, channels, and best practices for talent attraction

• Develop holistic talent identification and research strategies to solve the business talent needs

• identify emerging recruiting platforms to optimize sourcing, pipelining and customer

experience

• Research candidates contact information including phone numbers and emails




Qualifications 

Required: 

• Completion of course of study/Egresado in any pertinent field or industry.

• +3 years of experience in research at an IT or consulting firm, or in recruitment within a

corporate environment, including passive candidate identification, market mapping, and

talent pool creation and maintenance.

• Excellent verbal/written communication skills

• Strong analytical and logical reasoning abilities

• Experience in a global company preferred. Strong understanding of a global talent attraction

landscape with emphasis on the MX geography

• Ability to learn market and competitive changes quickly, best-in-class search process, including

candidate research and outreach techniques

• Strong knowledge of recruiting-based websites, applicant tracking systems and creative

sourcing techniques. Candidate identification via Boolean/internet searching.

• Experience creating search strategies, mapping markets and gleaning industry insights

• Hands-on research, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal skills




Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Mexico at the time of hire; limited sponsorship may be available for this role based on business needs and applicable law.




Preferred 

• Experience with some ERP with the Talent acquisition

• Ability to identify candidates for respective industry/service lines, paper screen candidates,

and propose candidates to the recruiter/business




Our people and culture 

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ideas and perspectives and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our client most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.




Professional development 

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there’s always room to learn. We offer

opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through

mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our

professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.




Accommodations 

We are committed to providing equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for people with

disabilities. To request a reasonable accommodation, contact our Talent Relations team at

USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com




All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color,

religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran

status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law

About the job

About Us

Fractal Power is a vertically integrated power company built for the modern grid. We own and operate across the entire stack, combining utility-scale energy storage infrastructure with algorithmic trading and dispatch to deliver power precisely where and when it’s needed most. 




We are backed by the world’s leading infrastructure and deeptech investors, including Riot, Definition, and Worldbuild.




Why Join Us?

Demand for power is growing at the fastest rate since WWII yet supply is stranded behind worsening transmission and interconnection bottlenecks. The new economy requires a new model of power delivery, one that’s vertically integrated, algorithmically operated, and co-located with demand. 




We solve the last-mile infrastructure problem by vertically integrating across the entire value chain of American power - from greenfield development, to algorithmic optimization, dispatch, and power trading across a fleet of distributed resources - allowing us to deliver power where and when it's needed most on the grid. We have the ambition, the team, and the zeal to create the next great power company and we are looking for fanatical people to join us.




Role Overview

You will own the end-to-end delivery of Fractal’s distribution-connected, utility-scale battery energy storage projects in ERCOT, from greenfield site through interconnection, construction, energization, and commercial operation.




You are the single accountable owner for every project assigned to you. You will build and defend the integrated project schedule, manage all pre-NTP development operations, administer the EPC contract, and drive the critical path across land, interconnection, permitting, procurement, engineering, construction, and commissioning. You will hold the project EPC contractor and every other party to their commitments, and you will have broad authority to pull in any resource in the company to keep projects moving.




You will be measured on whether projects reach commercial operation on schedule and on budget. You will operate with extraordinary agency, ownership, and expectations.




Key Responsibilities

Own the schedule, budget, and commercial operation date for every project assigned to you, from site control and interconnection application through energization, commissioning, and COD.

About the job

💸 USD 38,000 to USD 50,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working!

🎬 Working with globally recognizable brands in US TV and entertainment

✨ An account-management role combining client leadership, creative judgment, and AI-first ways of working

💻 A high-end, fast computer and all the latest software and AI tools you'll need

🕘 Pacific Time working hours, generally 9:00am–5:30pm PT




Who We Are 




At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.




Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.




Embracing Future-Facing Technology 




Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!




About The Role 




We are hiring an Account Manager to grow client confidence, satisfaction, and account value. Our client portfolio includes some of the biggest names in global entertainment, including well-known animation brands, so this role will particularly suit someone who is excited by fandoms and understands why audiences care deeply about particular characters, stories, and worlds. You will combine relationship ownership, commercial awareness, and creative confidence to turn each client's vision into strong social work.




Creative confidence is central. You will not make every asset, but you must translate the client's vision, know what works and what does not on social, and review copy, design, and video with specific feedback the team can act on.

This is not a message-passing role. You will represent the client internally, engage with the quality and value of the work, bring structure to ambiguity, challenge weak scope, and make sure clients know what happens next.




Storm is an AI-native agency. AI tools and agentic workflows are central to how our teams work, and we hire people who want to work that way from day one.

We're not talking about using AI as a search box or an autocomplete. The person we're looking for treats AI as a capable pair of hands. They delegate whole pieces of work, not just questions. They review what comes back with a sharp, critical eye. And they keep refining how they brief and direct it, so the quality compounds. If you read that and thought "that's just how I work now," this role is built for you.




You'll learn your assigned account deeply: its strategy, services, relationships, commercial context, and the standard the work must meet. From there, you'll use Storm's AI and collaborative tools as part of how you plan, prepare, communicate, coordinate delivery, and follow through. The role remains account management at its core: building trusted relationships, exercising strong judgement, protecting the quality and value of the work, and helping accounts grow.







RESPONSIBILITIES 




What can you expect? 

Own client confidence and satisfaction, using AI tools and agentic workflows as your default way of working, not an afterthought. Build trusted relationships and communicate before clients need to follow up.
Understand each client's strategy, stakeholders, services, commercial context, audience, creative vision, preferences, and pressure points well enough to represent the account internally and anticipate needs.
Turn the client's creative vision into action across briefs, content calendars, campaigns, and deliverables. Review creative assets critically and give clear feedback that protects the intent while improving the work.
Work out what the client is asking for, what they may really need, and what matters strategically. Turn ambiguity into clear direction, context, owners, dependencies, decisions, and next steps.
Keep delivery coordinated across services, teams, timelines, blockers, and dependencies. Use agents and reusable workflows for preparation, action tracking, planning, research, reporting, and follow-up.
Bring strong account judgment to ambiguous work. Balance the relationship, delivery reality, commercial context, capacity, risk, and long-term account health. Diagnose issues first, then escalate with evidence, options, and a recommendation.
Protect the quality and value of Storm's creative, operational, strategic, and technical services. Challenge work that is weak, off-strategy, unsuitable for the platform, or unlikely to create the intended value, and help get it to the right standard.
Make account health and commitments visible. Surface sentiment, risks, opportunities, scope pressure, decisions, approvals, and follow-ups early, with records that people and agents can pick up and use.
Connect clients with Storm's wider expertise so they experience the depth and connected value of the team.
Spot and develop opportunities from client needs, service gaps, relationship signals, campaign moments, or operational problems, bringing enough evidence and context for the right people to act.
Improve how each account runs through better communication rhythms, reporting, documentation, approved AI workflows, and blocker framing. Coach teammates to bring evidence, what they have tried, options, and a specific ask.
Stay current in account management, social platforms, creative work, and the services around the role. Apply feedback and keep improving the quality, speed, judgment, and reliability of your work.
Keep improving how the work gets done: encode your best methods into reusable skills and workflows that agents and teammates can pick up and run, and teach what works so the whole team levels up with you.




Your Expertise 

Evidence that you can own client relationships, stakeholder communication, account delivery, or complex operational conversations.
Strong creative and social judgment. You can translate a client's vision into briefs, recognize platform-native ideas, explain why an asset works or does not, and give constructive feedback across copy, design, and video.
Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools and agents in real work, studies, or personal projects: research, meeting preparation, context management, drafting, analysis, action tracking, QA, or workflow improvement, not just quick questions or meeting note summaries.
The judgment to review AI output against client strategy, service quality, commercial context, facts, commitments, and brand standards. You never treat it as finished work.
A systems thinker: you see repeatable account work as a workflow to design and improve, not a list of tasks to grind through.
High agency and ownership. You step beyond the immediate brief, drive improvements to completion, and know when to escalate early.
Commercial awareness and the ability to recognize scope pressure, service gaps, account risk, and useful growth opportunities.
Operational, strategic, and technical curiosity. You understand the work around the creative, ask sharper questions, challenge weak assumptions, and explain tradeoffs plainly.
Comfort with collaborative systems such as Airtable, Monday.com, Notion, Asana, spreadsheets, Slack, Teams, or similar tools, plus an appetite to improve them.
Clear written and spoken communication. You make messy situations feel calm and practical and work well asynchronously.
Attention to detail held at speed: names, dates, decisions, dependencies, status, and promises stay accurate.
Enthusiasm for how quickly AI-enabled knowledge work is evolving, with an instinct for what improves client work and what is just noise.




What It's Like To Work Here




Modern Tools & A Real AI Stack

You will have modern hardware, approved AI tools, collaboration systems, and support from our AI Operations team. We expect you to use that stack seriously in real work.




Your Methods Can Become How The Team Works

We actively encourage people to bring forward better ways of working. When a method you develop proves itself, you won't just use it quietly: you'll encode it as a skill others can run, teach it to the team, and watch it become the new standard, with your name on it.




Team-Based

You will work with an international team of 175+ people across account management, strategy, creative, production, operations, AI, and technology. The best client experience makes that expertise feel connected.




Remote-First & Pacific-Time Aligned

This role is fully remote, but it works Pacific Time hours, generally 9:00am–5:30 pm PT.

Apply through our careers site. Any work you want to show us? It's optional but would be a bonus! Anything you think might be relevant.




Answer a short set of self-recorded video questions.

About the job

Google SEO & AI Specialist

Remote — LATAM | Independent Contractor | Mid-Level

Compensation: Competitive, based on experience




Rose Harper Law is scaling its digital presence across four office markets in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania and search is changing faster than most firms can keep up with. We need someone who lives at the intersection of traditional SEO and the new world of AI-driven search (think AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity) to make sure our firm shows up, wins trust, and converts when injured people go looking for help.




About Rose Harper Law




Rose Harper Law, LLC is a bilingual (English/Spanish) personal injury plaintiff firm licensed in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania, with offices in Parsippany NJ, Hawthorne NY, Allentown PA, and Hazleton PA. We're a fast-growing, faith-driven, community-rooted practice, and our marketing engine including a distributed LATAM content and social team is a core part of how we reach and serve the communities we work in.




About the Role




Twelve months from now, this role will have measurably grown organic visibility across all our markets and made sure Rose Harper Law is showing up accurately and favorably in AI-generated search answers, not just traditional blue links. You'll work closely with our Digital Content Coordinator and LATAM content/social team, applying both classic SEO discipline and emerging AI/answer-engine optimization (AEO/GEO) practice to a fast-moving, multi-market content operation.




What You'll Do




• Own on-page and technical SEO across roseharperlaw.com and its 13-market city landing pages — audits, on-page fixes, internal linking, schema, and site health.

• Apply AEO/GEO strategies to improve how the firm is represented in AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search surfaces.

• Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis to identify content gaps and new ranking opportunities across our practice areas and markets.

• Manage and optimize Google Business Profile pages across all four office locations — listings, posts, Q&A, reviews, and local search performance.

• Build and execute a backlink strategy: identify link opportunities, run outreach, and track domain authority and referring-domain growth over time.

• Develop and lead outreach for publication and media relationships — guest posts, local press, and legal directories that build authority and referral traffic.

• Coordinate SEO priorities with our social media team so content, keywords, and publishing calendars are aligned across channels rather than working in silos.

• Partner with our content team to brief, edit, and structure blog posts, YouTube companion content, and landing pages for both traditional and AI search.

• Track rankings, organic traffic, and Domain Rating growth, and report on what's working in plain language leadership can act on.

• Stay ahead of algorithm and AI-search developments and translate them into practical changes to our content and technical setup.




What We're Looking For




Required:




• 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, agency or in-house.

• Experience applying AEO/GEO strategies or otherwise optimizing content for AI-powered search results.

• Strong working knowledge of on-page, technical, and local SEO fundamentals.

• Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.

• Track record running backlink/outreach campaigns and building relationships with publications, directories, or media contacts.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; Spanish fluency is a strong plus given our bilingual client base.

• Comfortable working independently, managing your own workload, and meeting deadlines across a distributed team.

• A portfolio or case studies showing measurable organic growth or AI-search visibility gains (required to apply — see How to Apply below).




Preferred (nice to have):




• Experience in legal, professional services, or another regulated/compliance-sensitive industry.

• Familiarity with WordPress or a similar CMS.




Compensation




Competitive, based on experience. This is an independent contractor position open to candidates residing in Latin America.




How to Apply

Send the following to info@roseharperlaw.com and mcevallos@roseharperlaw.com:

• Your resume.

• A portfolio or case study demonstrating measurable SEO or AI-search results you've driven (required).

• A short written analysis of roseharperlaw.com's current SEO/AI-search visibility, along with a proposed 3-month action plan for how you'd approach the role — we want to see how you think, not a polished agency pitch.

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

Partner closely with Program Manager & Category Lead to identify new methods and processes to increase efficiency and quality. 
Work visibly & transparently in Microsoft Teams and other office 365 tools.

Fluent English

High degree of ownership, initiative, and intellectual curiosity. 
Attention to detail. 


Nice to have


Experience in quantitative consumer research, designs/ systems 
Working knowledge of sensory, statistical analysis programs or programming languages –Javascript, R, python, programming language basic.

title: SEO Manager (Digital Marketing Agency, EST Hours)
description:
About the job

SEO Manager (Digital Marketing Agency, EST Hours)




Pressure Washing Marketing Pros | Remote | Full-time, 9 AM to 5 PM EST




SNAPSHOT: $4,000 to $7,000 USD/month, depending on experience. Fully remote. 9 AM to 5 PM EST, hard requirement. You lead three SEO specialists, carry 10 to 15 of our hardest accounts yourself, and own SEO decisions day to day. Path to Head of SEO.




The apply link is at the bottom. Read the whole post first. We’ll know if you didn’t.




READ THIS FIRST




This role has two halves and you have to be good at both. You lead the SEO team, and you also run your own accounts. Most people can only do one of those.




Most SEO people who want to lead can no longer do the work. Most SEO people who can do the work do not want to lead. We have hired both. Neither one worked.




So if you want to work quietly on your own accounts and not manage anyone, this is not it. Close the tab. No hard feelings, those are good roles and we have hired them.




If you are strong at local SEO, you want to lead a team without giving up the hands-on work, and you want to grow into running a whole department, keep reading.




WHO WE ARE




We’re a digital marketing agency that works exclusively with exterior cleaning businesses (pressure washing, soft washing, window cleaning). We’re at $1.2M in revenue, 150 active clients, and client retention sits at 98 to 99%. Our clients love us, our results are real, and we built that by being obsessively good at one niche.




The SEO function here is not a startup. A team of specialists already executes consistently across 100+ local accounts, backed by a dedicated web and development team that handles the build work, and a client success team that owns the client relationships. The systems, the workflows, and the AI are already built in-house.




What the department does not have is a leader. Right now the founder approves every strategy, catches the problems, and makes the decisions. This role exists to change that.




THE ONE HARD REQUIREMENT




3+ years of hands-on local SEO at an agency, including at least one year with SEO people reporting to you.




Local. Read that again. Local or multi-location SEO for service businesses.




If your background is ecommerce, national, enterprise, or SaaS SEO, this is not a fit and we will not move forward. That is not a judgment on your skill. Enterprise and ecommerce SEO are genuinely hard. They are also a different job. Our world is Google Business Profiles, local pack rankings, service area and city pages, silo structure, citations, and keeping reviews coming in, across 100+ small local businesses in a single niche. A strong enterprise SEO would be starting over here, and would be bored inside a month.




We will not bend on the management year either. Leading three independent SEO specialists is a different skill from being the best specialist in the room. You need to have already had to look at someone else’s audit, decide it is not good enough, and tell them directly. If you have informally mentored people but have never been responsible for someone else’s work, this role will expose that fast.




THE SEAT, HONESTLY




You report directly to the founder. Three SEO specialists report to you. You are the final call on SEO decisions day to day.




You own your team’s standards and their output. You set the priorities, you give the feedback, you decide when work is not good enough, and you have those conversations yourself. The founder signs off on pay and hiring decisions, and he relies on your assessment of your team to make them.




You also carry your own book: 10 to 15 of our hardest accounts, hands-on. Our biggest clients, the accounts at risk, and the ones that just signed. That is on purpose. Your authority here is earned by doing the work, not handed to you with the title, and your specialists will know the difference inside a week.




Roughly how the week breaks down:




• 40% your own book of 10 to 15 accounts

• 25% reviewing the specialists’ work

• 20% leading the team: priorities, coaching, standups, hard conversations

• 10% digging into problems and recoveries across the full 100+ account book

• 5% client calls and strategy on our largest accounts




We are not promising you the Head of SEO role. We are telling you it is genuinely available to the right person, that it means owning the whole function across a larger book and a larger team as we grow, and that we would much rather promote into it than hire it from outside.




WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO




• Own SEO delivery across a 100+ account book. If work is late, wrong, or about to slip, you know before anyone tells you.




• Lead three SEO specialists: priorities, standards, coaching, and direct feedback when the work is not good enough.




• Run your own book of 10 to 15 of our hardest accounts, hands-on.




• Check the specialists’ work before it goes out: audits, on-page changes, content briefs and silos, Google Business Profiles, citations, internal linking.




• Figure out why rankings and local pack positions drop, and own the fix rather than the explanation.




• Approve monthly account strategies and make sure every account has a strategy and a report in the system on time.




• Look at the web team’s work for anything that will hurt SEO. They check their own build. You catch what will cost rankings.




• Work with our Ops and Delivery Manager on anything that crosses between teams, and talk to Client Success directly when an SEO account is in trouble. They hear it from you, not through a middleman.




• Keep the SEO processes and SOPs accurate and useful, and improve them once the system is yours. Documented and actually followed, not written once and forgotten.




• Get on client calls for our largest accounts and the ones in trouble, to defend the strategy and reset expectations. Roughly 10 to 15% of your time.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR




• 3+ years of hands-on local SEO at an agency, with at least one year managing SEO people. Non-negotiable, see above.




• Able to work 9 AM to 5 PM EST, Monday through Friday. Hard requirement.




• Real depth across on-page, off-page, technical, and local: Google Business Profiles, local packs, service area and city pages, silos, schema, internal linking, citations.




• Strong at figuring out what went wrong. Given an account that dropped, you come back with a real explanation of why, then prove it or rule it out. Not a guess, and not a generic checklist.




• You think in systems. When something goes wrong twice, you fix the process instead of the symptom, and you write it down so the next person does not have to work it out again.




• Vocal and proactive. You raise problems early, you propose the fix instead of waiting to be told, you say the uncomfortable thing in the meeting, and you push back on the founder when you think he is wrong. If you avoid conflict, this role will be miserable for you.




• Able to lead people who are used to being left alone. SEO specialists are independent by nature. You have to earn their respect with your work first, then actually direct them.




• Fluent in Ahrefs, Google Search Console, and Google Analytics.




• Strong with AI. We use it throughout the agency and expect you to use it to work faster and cleaner, not to think for you. Hands-on experience with Claude is a plus.




• Excellent written and spoken English. A lot of this job is written, and you are in front of our biggest clients some of the time.




• Comfortable in ClickUp, Slack, Loom, and Google Drive.




WHO WILL NOT SUCCEED HERE




Being honest because it saves us both time:




• The manager who can no longer do the work. You run good meetings and a clean board and you cannot audit a site yourself. We already know how that ends.




• The specialist who will not lead. You are excellent working on your own, and you go quiet when a decision or a hard conversation is yours to handle. That is half of this job.




• Ecommerce, national, or enterprise SEO backgrounds. See above.




• People who show up and start rewriting the system in week two.




• People whose strongest skill is interview polish or AI-assisted writing rather than live thinking.




• People who get defensive or go quiet when challenged directly. You will be challenged directly here, often.




• People who need a checklist for every task and reassurance every day.




If any of that is you, this role will make you miserable and you will not last. Please apply elsewhere. We genuinely wish you well.




TOOLS YOU’LL WORK WITH




• Ahrefs

• Google Search Console, Analytics, and Tag Manager

• Claude and our internal AI workflows

• ClickUp

• Slack and Loom

• Google Drive, Sheets, and Docs




COMPENSATION AND TERMS




• Pay: $4,000 to $7,000 USD/month, depending on experience and your ability to lead at a senior level without a long ramp-up period. The top of the range is for someone who can take over the department quickly. Your pay is based on the work you show us, not on what you ask for.




• Hours: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM EST. Hard requirement. This is a leadership seat, which means being available when your team, the other departments, and our clients are. 




• Location: Fully remote. We hire globally if you can reliably work 9 AM to 5 PM EST. 




• Tools and systems: We provide the tools, the automation, and our internal AI workflows.




• Path to more: Head of SEO as we scale, with the pay and ownership that comes with it.




HOW TO APPLY




We have a structured process, and it is built to reward people who can actually do the work rather than people who interview well.




We will not consider:




• AI-generated applications. We can tell, and we won’t move forward.

• Incomplete applications.




Apply only through this link:




https://hiring.pressurewashingmarketingpros.com/hiring/seo-manager/job-post-6643

description:
About the job

Remote SaaS Sales Representative — BowerBird.io


Location: Remote — Mexico (or other South American countries)




Please note: You must have C2 or native-speaker-level written and spoken English. Please do not apply unless your English is at this level.




About BowerBird




BowerBird is an Australian online platform that connects architecture and design professionals with journalists so they can get their work published.




We are a fully remote, global team that values excellent work, direct feedback and daily improvement. We work with architects, designers and media professionals around the world, including people from many of the largest and most respected design publications.


About the role




We are looking for an experienced Sales Closer to help architects and designers decide whether BowerBird is right for them.




Your main responsibility will be conducting pre-booked sales meetings via Zoom with prospects who have already expressed an interest in BowerBird.




You will uncover what each prospect wants to achieve, understand what is preventing them from achieving it and show how BowerBird could support their business goals. You will present the platform, recommend the right plan, discuss pricing, handle concerns and ask directly for the sale.




You will also regularly call inbound leads who have engaged with BowerBird but have not yet booked a meeting. These are not random cold calls: they are people who have already shown an interest in what we do. Your job will be to understand why they became interested, determine whether there is a genuine opportunity and book an appropriate sales meeting.




Phone calls are part of this position, alongside email and other follow-up methods. You should be comfortable picking up the phone when it is the most effective way to start a conversation or move a lead forward.


What you will do




Conduct pre-booked sales meetings with architects, interior designers and other design professionals.
Call inbound leads and convert suitable prospects into booked meetings.
Research prospects before each meeting.
Use needs-based discovery to understand each prospect’s business goals and challenges.
Connect BowerBird’s features to specific outcomes rather than delivering a generic demonstration.
Recommend the most suitable subscription plan.
Discuss price confidently and ask directly for the sale.
Explore the real issue when a prospect hesitates.
Agree on clear decision dates and next steps.
Follow up actively by phone and email.
Keep accurate prospect notes, tasks and records.
Review your sales meetings and apply regular coaching.
Work towards individual sales targets.

About you




You will have:




C2 or native-speaker-level written and spoken English;
proven sales experience with personal responsibility for closing;
experience conducting sales meetings by phone or video;
confidence calling inbound leads;
experience using discovery questions to understand customer needs;
the ability to translate product features into commercial value;
confidence discussing price, handling objections and asking for a decision;
strong follow-up and organisational habits;
the ability to work independently in a fully remote environment;
a genuine interest in architecture, design, media or related creative industries;
the ability to work as an independent contractor while meeting the requirements of your local authorities.




Experience in SaaS, subscription sales, consultative sales, architecture, design, media or public relations will be highly regarded.




Because our prospects are based around the world, your English must be clear, natural and easy for international clients to understand. An accent is not a problem. Clear international communication is essential.


Our skateboarding culture




We like to skateboard. Not literally—that could end badly.




“Skateboarding” is how we describe daily improvement. Within the sales team, this means reviewing meetings, receiving specific coaching and applying one useful change at a time.




You will receive regular coaching and support, but you must genuinely enjoy being coached. We are looking for someone who can receive direct feedback, understand it and change their approach quickly.




This role will not suit someone who avoids phone calls, dislikes direct sales targets or does not want their sales meetings reviewed and coached.


What we offer




A fully remote position.
Pre-booked meetings with prospects who have already expressed interest.
Inbound leads rather than random cold-call lists.
A base payment plus attractive, uncapped commission.
Daily coaching and practical sales support.
The opportunity to work with architects, designers and media professionals worldwide.
A supportive global team.
BowerBird’s Grown-up Leave Program—our version of unlimited leave.
The opportunity to contribute to an Australian technology company working across architecture, design, media and AI.

How to apply




Please follow the link to apply, submit your CV, LinkedIn profile and a thoughtful response, explaining why you want to join BowerBird and why this role suits you.




Your response should help us understand who you are, how you sell and why BowerBird interests you. Generic cover letters or summaries of our website will not help us assess your fit.




Before reaching the interview stage, we recommend exploring BowerBird and listening to at least one episode of the BowerBird Architecture Podcast.




If you are an experienced salesperson who enjoys discovery, closing, phone calls, coaching and continuous improvement, we would like to hear from you.

title: Ejecutivo de Prospección y Ventas
description:
About the job




Prospección digital, generación de leads y desarrollo comercial para proyectos hoteleros y desarrollos inmobiliarios.

En ACERDOORS suministramos e instalamos puertas técnicas y contrafuego para proyectos hoteleros, desarrollos inmobiliarios y edificios corporativos.

Buscamos un(a) Ejecutivo de Prospección y Ventas cazador(a), responsable de generar oportunidades comerciales: identificar clientes potenciales, contactarlos, agendar reuniones y alimentar el pipeline de ventas.

Es un puesto 100% comercial. Trabaja de la mano con el Gerente Comercial y se apoya en el contenido que produce el área de Contenido y Redes, pero su foco es prospectar y abrir oportunidades, no crear contenido.

Objetivo del puesto

Generar de manera constante leads calificados y reuniones comerciales mediante prospección digital (Social Selling) y seguimiento disciplinado en el CRM, para alimentar el pipeline de ventas de ACERDOORS.

Principales responsabilidades

Prospección

• Identificar empresas, desarrolladores, despachos de arquitectura y tomadores de decisión.

• Contactar prospectos por LinkedIn, WhatsApp, correo y llamada usando estrategias de Social Selling.

• Dar seguimiento a las conversaciones hasta agendar reuniones comerciales.

• Generar leads calificados para el Gerente Comercial.

Administración del pipeline (CRM)

• Registrar y administrar el pipeline de prospección en el CRM.

• Mantener actualizada la base de datos de clientes potenciales.

• Programar y ejecutar seguimientos de forma disciplinada.

• Elaborar reportes semanales de actividad y resultados (leads, citas y avance).

Desarrollo comercial

• Acompañar al Gerente Comercial en reuniones cuando se requiera.

• Colaborar con el área de Contenido para contar con material y mensajes de prospección efectivos.

• Alcanzar y superar las metas mensuales de prospección.

Perfil

Persona proactiva, persistente y orientada a resultados, cómoda buscando y contactando clientes todos los días, motivada por un esquema de comisiones.

Formación

Mercadotecnia, Comunicación, Administración, Negocios o afín. (Título no indispensable si existe experiencia comprobable.)

Experiencia

• 1 a 3 años en prospección, ventas B2B, desarrollo de negocios o Social Selling.

• Experiencia contactando prospectos y agendando citas por canales digitales.

• Deseable experiencia en construcción, arquitectura, industria o inmobiliario.

Conocimientos indispensables

Prospección comercial

Contacto y seguimiento de prospectos por LinkedIn, WhatsApp y correo, y agendado de citas.

CRM

Experiencia administrando el pipeline en HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce o similar.

Conocimientos deseables

LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads y manejo de indicadores y metas.

Habilidades

• Excelente comunicación.

• Facilidad para relacionarse.

• Persistencia comercial.

• Organización y disciplina de seguimiento.

• Orientación a resultados.

Inglés

Deseable nivel de lectura y conversación entre 40% y 70%.

Ofrecemos

• Sueldo base de $10,000 a $12,000 MXN según experiencia.

• Esquema de comisiones sin tope, siendo el principal componente del ingreso (ver Esquema de comisiones).

• Periodo de prueba de 3 (tres) meses; durante este periodo el pago se realiza fuera de nómina.

• Capacitación continua, herramientas de trabajo y acceso a CRM.

• Prestaciones de ley y contratación permanente.

Esquema de comisiones

Adicionalmente al salario base, se reconocerá una comisión sobre el precio de venta de los proyectos, excluyendo instalación y fletes, conforme a los siguientes parámetros:

• 2% (dos por ciento) sobre el precio de venta neto (sin instalación ni fletes) de todos los proyectos que el colaborador prospecte, genere y traiga directamente a la empresa.

• 1% (uno por ciento) sobre el precio de venta neto (sin instalación ni fletes) en proyectos asignados por la empresa al colaborador.

• Comisiones sin tope: a mayor prospección efectiva, mayor ingreso.

Modalidad

• Presencial. Lunes a viernes de 9:00 a 18:00 hrs.

• Con disponibilidad ocasional para reuniones y visitas comerciales.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
About the job

Sales Development Representative (SDR) 

Remote 




About the Company

Hirably is a fast-growing company in the SaaS and embedded payments space, serving the buy-here-pay-here (BHPH) auto industry. 

We help dealers run and collect on their own loan books, and we're profitable and growing quickly. We're hiring an SDR to help us break further into the largest dealers in the market. 




Compensation 

$25,000 MXN net per month, plus uncapped monthly variable tied to the MRR generated from deals you assist in closing. 

Fully remote. 




About the Role

You'll be Hirably's next Sales Development Representative, focused on our largest dealer prospects: BHPH operators running 500+ active loans. You'll report directly to our VP of Revenue, who owns Sales and Marketing and runs weekly 1:1s with this role. You'll have direct access to executive coaching from day one. 




These are family-owned businesses with lean teams, big loan books, and a different relationship with cash flow and collections than a typical SMB. Breaking into this segment takes disciplined, high-volume outbound work, and that's what this role is built around. 




You'll partner directly with our senior account executives, generate qualified demos, hand off opportunities cleanly, and shorten the time from cold outreach to closed-won revenue. You're joining a growing sales team, inheriting a sales engine that already converts well and a CRM operation we're actively tightening in real time. You'll be one of the people putting that discipline into the daily motion, booking qualified meetings, and helping AEs close. 




This is an earlier-stage role for us, with real room to grow. The opportunity to move into a closing seat or hybrid role that blends prospecting with running smaller deals is real, and we'll invest in developing people who earn it. 




Responsibilities 

● Run a high volume of outbound cadences across phone, email, and LinkedIn against a defined portfolio of BHPH dealers running 500+ active loans. 

● Qualify against our ICP before booking demos. A demo that shouldn't have been booked costs the team more than the time it took to book it. 

● Book qualified demos with confirmed dates and pre-demo discovery logged in HubSpot. Maintain a strong show rate through multi-channel confirmation (reminder call/text, day-of confirmation, cell number capture at scheduling). 

● Log everything: activity, calls, demo recordings, and loss reasons. If it isn't in HubSpot, we have no way to know it happened. 

● Support post-demo nurture and multi-threading on live deals, and contribute to competitive intel and loss reason capture. 




Qualifications 

● You can point to real evidence of cold outreach and resilience, whether that's directly carrying an outbound sales quota or something like canvassing, fundraising, telemarketing, or door-to-door sales. 

● You genuinely enjoy making dials and you're phone-first by default. ● You're disciplined in a CRM (HubSpot preferred). 

● You're coachable, and comfortable working through deals one at a time in a weekly 1:1 with our VP of Revenue. 

● You track your own numbers and own them, good weeks and bad ones. The scoreboard doesn't scare you. 

● You write tight and get real energy from picking up the phone. 

● Based in or willing to work Eastern or Central US hours. 

● English Level Required: C1/C2 Preferred Skills 

● BHPH, subprime auto, or auto retail experience. This is a real advantage, but direct industry experience isn't required — genuine curiosity about how dealers run their loan books is. 

● Experience selling to family-owned or owner-operated SMBs. 

● Comfort with longer sales cycles (60-120 days) and multi-threading across 2-4 stakeholders

description:
About the job

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.




About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We're looking for an Operations Risk Manager to continue improving our risk management framework and governance structures. You'll use data to track daily risk exposures and support reporting to internal and external stakeholders.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.




What you’ll be doing

Working with the first line of defence to identify, assess, document, and regularly review risks of all types
Coaching the business to design and implement controls
Supporting the development and implementation of operational risk policies, procedures, key indicators, and appetite statement
Developing techniques for quantification of operational risk and resilience, including stress testing and impact tolerances
Taking ownership of the risk incident management process, ensuring recording of risk events, and managing incident reports
Monitoring operational risk against limits and thresholds, producing respective reports to management and other relevant stakeholders
Developing and maintaining risk tools and systems
Monitoring KRI breaches and working with risk owners/group risk team to resolve them within a set timeline
Conducting presentations and workshops on risk identification and mitigation




What you'll need

3+ years of experience in operational risk management within banking or financial services
An understanding of core operational risk concepts
Experience working with local regulators in Mexico
Previous examples of practically interpreting and organising complex matters
To be curious and never accepting of assumptions, with a desire to fully understand how things work
To be organised and have a methodological approach




Nice to have

Experience with operational risk stress testing and quantification







Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

description:
About the job

About Sezzle: 

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated Merchant Risk Analyst who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

Sezzle currently partners with over 20,000 active merchants to offer their customers the ability to split orders into 4 interest-free payments over 6 weeks. As a Merchant Risk Analyst, you will be responsible for ensuring that none of our merchant partners are exhibiting behaviors that could negatively impact Sezzle or our customers. This means constantly monitoring all of our current merchant partners, as well as declining unsuitable merchants at the time of application. Essentially, it is your job to set and maintain a certain level of excellence for the merchants that Sezzle chooses to partner itself with and offer its services to. Analysts will also make recommendations to our management on how to improve and scale our processes.

We are looking for a teammate who can work full-time Tuesday through Saturday between 9:00 am - 5:30 pm - Central Time. This will be a salaried, contractor position. 

What You'll Do: 


Actively analyze merchant applications by evaluating risk scores, products, and policies 
Investigate high-risk merchant account activity to minimize loss from fraud and reputational risks 
Communicate and coordinate processes between teams to refine the merchant approval process
Write and execute queries in MySQL to analyze merchant information and performance metrics 
Analyze merchant reputational risk based on customer NPS reviews
Work as a mediator between the Merchant Success and Support teams to resolve merchant risk-related issues and provide guidance on overall risk tolerance and policy 
Improve current merchant fraud detection framework to find fraud more effectively 
Perform extensive analysis on ways the merchant approval process can be streamlined and automated and challenge the status quo by working collaboratively, as well as independently, on projects focused on improving methods, policies, and internal tools. 


What We Look For: 


Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution 
Minimum 1 year of experience in risk management, fraud or financial crime prevention operations 
Experienced in analyzing data and comfortable making impactful decisions in a fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environment
Work experience with MYSQL, PostgreSQL 
Attention to detail and ability to multitask 
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills 
Strong business judgment and communication skills 
Ability to self-start and work with minimal supervision after training 
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.


Preferred Qualifications


2+ years of experience in real-world analytical experience in merchant/business fraud and credit risk management, fraud or financial crime prevention operations in e-commerce, banking, fintech or financial institutions is a plus 
Ideal candidate will be available to start within two weeks following an offer


About You: 


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 


What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome: 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The compensation range for the role is $1,800 - $2,000 USD GROSS monthly as a contractor. Our ranges are very broad to accommodate all types of candidates and encourage growth. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

description:
About the job

Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) will make outbound calls to potential clients who have expressed interest in learning more about Docusign or appear to be strong potential customers based upon our general market focus. The SDR qualifies prospective customers through targeted questions about their business strategy then leveraging this information to align and sell Docusign's product offerings. This position spends roughly 80% of the time on the phone prospecting new clients. Sales Development Reps will receive hands-on training with an emphasis on strategic selling and a focus on researching targeted accounts. This position is a great way for individuals to gain in depth experience in a rapidly growing SaaS company.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, SDR.

Responsibility


Make outbound calls to prospects who have expressed interest in learning more about Docusign
Make outbound calls to prospects who are deemed to reside in one of Docusign's core vertical markets
Share information about Docusign and ask questions about the prospect's business intentions
Discern propensity to buy and forward good potential leads to the Sales Account Executives to pursue
Schedule appointments between prospects and Account Executives
Record prospect information in CRM database

Hybrid: Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic


BS/BA degree or equivalent work experience


Preferred


Prior experience working in sales
Ability to form strong business relationships
Excellent verbal and written communication skills


Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

Accommodation

title: Analista de Customer Success - Mexico
description:
About the job

🚀 Somos Inceptia

Cambiamos la manera en que las empresas interactúan con sus clientes usando Inteligencia Artificial conversacional — bots de voz y chat que gestionan cobranzas, ventas y atención al cliente a escala.




🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

Analista de Customer Success — Perfil Técnico

📍 Noroeste de México — Hermosillo, Culiacán o Tijuana · Home office, con residencia en la región




🧙 Acerca del rol

Serás el puente entre nuestros clientes y la plataforma de Inceptia. Tu día a día combina soporte técnico-funcional, optimización de bots y acompañamiento en integraciones, con foco en que cada cliente saque el máximo valor de sus campañas.




No es un rol de soporte reactivo tipo call center: buscamos a alguien que identifique proactivamente oportunidades de mejora, proponga cambios en los flujos conversacionales y se involucre en la implementación junto al equipo de desarrollo.




🙌 Por qué unirte a Inceptia?

• Somos una empresa de Tecnología de IA. Trabajás con modelos de IA conversacional de punta.

• Contrato formal, en nómina y con prestaciones de ley (IMSS, aguinaldo, vacaciones).

• Esquema 100% home office: no necesitás mudarte ni viajar, solo vivir en la región.

• Aprendizaje constante en un producto de IA que está creciendo mes a mes en México y Centroamérica.




📌 Responsabilidades

• Gestionar la configuración y el lanzamiento de campañas de bots de voz y chat para clientes.

• Brindar soporte técnico y funcional ante consultas e incidentes sobre la plataforma.

• Diseñar, modificar y optimizar prompts conversacionales para mejorar el rendimiento de los bots.

• Acompañar a clientes en la integración vía API: explicar el funcionamiento del endpoint, validar payloads, identificar errores de carga y coordinar con desarrollo cuando corresponda.

• Realizar auditorías periódicas de bots para detectar problemas y oportunidades de mejora en flujos, tasas de contacto y resolución.

• Coordinar con el equipo de desarrollo la implementación de cambios en configuraciones de bots y telefonía.

• Documentar configuraciones, procesos y guías de integración para clientes y uso interno.

• Capacitar a usuarios clave de los clientes en el uso de la plataforma.

• Analizar datos de gestión (contactabilidad, estados, resultados) para generar insights y reportes ejecutivos.




✅ Lo indispensable

• Formación técnica: estudiante avanzado (desde 3er año) o egresado de Sistemas, Ingeniería, Informática o afín.

• Perfil analítico y resolutivo: cómodo leyendo documentación técnica, probando cosas y resolviendo problemas sin esperar todo resuelto.

About the job

Customer Retention Specialist

Remote – LATAM

About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here—decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

The Role

As a Customer Retention Specialist, you'll play a key role in helping patients stay engaged with their health journey. You'll proactively connect with patients who may be at risk of canceling or pausing their subscription, provide support during retention conversations, and help them understand the value of continuing their treatment.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow a career in Customer Success, Retention, or Healthcare Operations. You'll receive training on our products, systems, and best practices while developing valuable communication and relationship-building skills.

What You'll Do

Proactively reach out to patients who may be at risk of canceling or disengaging.
Handle inbound cancellation and pause requests with empathy and professionalism.
