description:
About the job

Hey there — yeah, you!




HomeHop is a fast-growing short-term rental management company (think Airbnb & VRBO), and we're on the hunt for a friendly, quick-thinking individual to be the voice our guests hear when they reach out. We started with a handful of properties and now manage 120+ short-term rentals across the Midwest USA… and we're still just getting started!




If you love solving problems, thrive when things move fast, and get a little thrill from checking things off a list — keep reading.




What you'll actually be doing

You'll be our guest's go-to person. Someone messages asking where to park, how the hot tub works, or whether they can check in early? You've got them — warm, fast, and helpful every time. Guest messaging is a big part of this role… but it's not the whole role.




Because we're a startup, no two shifts look the same. One minute you're smoothing over a booking question, the next you're helping the team knock out a random task that keeps the whole machine running. We wear a lot of hats around here, and we're looking for someone who's happy to grab one and jump in.




A taste of the day-to-day:

Chatting with guests across Airbnb, VRBO, and our direct booking channels — keeping it prompt, professional, and genuinely friendly
Handling reservations, questions, and the occasional "help, I locked myself out" moment
Coordinating with cleaning and maintenance crews to keep stays running smoothly
Jumping in on all kinds of team tasks and projects as we grow — flexibility is the name of the game
Keeping notes and records tidy so nothing slips through the cracks
Using critical thinking when problems with guests arise




The schedule:

Friday, Saturday & Sunday, 1:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST — these are our busiest hours and your time to shine
You'll need to work on American holidays (guests travel most when everyone else is off)
5 days of PTO to start




You'll fit right in if you…

Write like a real, warm human — clear, kind, and typo-free
Stay cool under pressure and can juggle a few things at once
Are tech-savvy and comfortable bouncing between apps and platforms
Have experience with short-term rentals or Airbnb (a big plus!)
Are based in Mexico and ready to work fully remote
Actually like helping people




Why HomeHop?

We're a small, scrappy, supportive team that believes work should be fun — not a corporate snooze-fest. We move fast, we back each other up, we celebrate wins, and there's real room to grow as we do!




Ready to hop in?

Hit apply and tell us a little about yourself. We can't wait to meet you!!

The Role

You're a full-stack marketer who's deep in Meta and Google ads but understands how everything connects. You can write killer ad copy, optimize a landing page, fix a broken funnel, and explain strategy on a client call.

You'll manage paid advertising for 30-40 medical spa clients and drive the strategy for your portfolio with the support of an Account Manager.

Build and optimize Meta and Google campaigns daily
Write ad copy that converts

Partner with Account Manager on client strategy
Join client calls when performance needs strategic intervention
Spot upsell opportunities

❌ Media buyers who optimize in a vacuum

❌ Specialists who can't see the bigger picture

About the job

Company Description Click Seguridad Jurídica, SAPI DE CV, SOFOM ENR is a fiduciary institution registered with the Comisión Nacional para la Protección y Defensa de los Usuarios de Servicios Financieros (CONDUSEF). The organization is formed by professionals with extensive experience in fiduciary and financial services. It focuses on providing fiduciary services that help guarantee payment obligations and credits. The company offers comprehensive advisory support for the implementation and establishment of trusts, with personalized attention and tailored solutions. Its mission is to protect clients’ security and interests in every engagement.

Role Description The Compliance Officer is a full-time, on-site role based in Mexico City, Mexico. This position is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing compliance programs to ensure adherence to applicable financial, fiduciary, and consumer protection regulations. Day-to-day tasks include monitoring regulatory changes, conducting compliance risk assessments, reviewing and approving internal policies and procedures, and performing periodic audits of operations and documentation. The Compliance Officer will investigate and address potential compliance issues, prepare reports for senior management, and coordinate with legal and operational teams to remediate findings. The role also involves training employees on regulatory requirements, promoting a culture of ethical conduct, and serving as a key point of contact for regulatory inquiries and inspections.

Qualifications

Strong expertise in compliance management, with demonstrated experience in developing, implementing, and monitoring Compliance Management frameworks.
In-depth knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements applicable to financial services, including SOFOME, local financial regulations, consumer protection standards, trusts, and trustees.
Excellent analytical skills to assess compliance risks, interpret complex regulations, and translate them into practical controls and procedures.
Clear and effective communication skills to prepare reports, deliver training, and collaborate with cross-functional teams and regulatory bodies.
Solid understanding of finance, including fiduciary structures, credit operations, and risk management in financial institutions.
Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field; advanced certifications in compliance or risk management are an advantage.
Proven experience in a compliance, risk, or regulatory role within financial services or fiduciary institutions.
High level of integrity, attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
Proficiency in relevant office and compliance tools; familiarity with Spanish-language regulations and documentation is highly beneficial.

description:
About the job

Overview

About the Role & Team

IDC, a global leader in technology market intelligence, is seeking a market researcher to join our team. This role requires a mix of analytical abilities, attention to detail, proficiency in research methodologies, alongside excellent communication skills to convey complex information effectively.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in interpreting data, staying abreast of IT market trends and events, supporting their team with in-depth research, and working collaboratively to meet research objectives.

The market researcher will play a crucial role in supporting the authorship and delivery of IDC’s market intelligence products and services in a rapidly evolving information technology landscape. The role will focus on utilizing the latest market research methodologies and tools to uncover relevant data from internal and external data sources and synthesizing into market research content assets.

What You’ll Do


 Support IDC’s market research agenda by conducting in-depth primary and secondary research into IT markets and their impact on industries, namely energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing. 
 Have in-depth knowledge/experience and understanding in energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing business operations, either through working in these industries or executing consulting/research engagements 
 Track, monitor, and identify IT industry developments to identify and report on market shifts, patterns, and anomalies. 
 Collaborate with internal subject matter expert analysts to achieve research goals and produce deliverables efficiently. 
 Participate in ongoing professional development and contribute to team knowledge sharing. 
 Synthesize raw data into information and meaningful insights and deliver tailored content components and assets that address key business requirements. 
 Contribute to the creation of written research studies and presentations summarizing findings for internal and external stakeholders 


What You Bring


Bachelor’s degree required; (business, economics, management information systems, technology marketing, product management or related field).
2-3 years of experience in market research, consulting, or analysis, ideally in the information technology sector, with knowledge in the energy/resources/oil and gas/manufacturing domain, with a flair toward writing research content.
Previous experience in roles such as market intelligence or competitive intelligence is preferred.
Outstanding written and strong verbal communication skills.
Proven ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with and across teams globally.
Experience with office productivity tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Some experience with any AI tools such as MS CoPilot, Google Gemini, Perplexity, ChatGPT, or other similar tools.
A strong interest in the IT market, including, but not limited in topics such as AI and data management, cloud platforms, security, enterprise applications, enterprise infrastructure, devices, networking, telecommunications, application development, and services.
Understanding and interest in the application of information technology to industry use cases.
Flexibility to work both independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced, global environment.
Professional fluency in English.
Hybrid job, 2 times per week at the office.


Preferred Attributes


Experience working with or for technology vendors, IT distributors, or in a market research/consulting firm.
Experience working in or analyzing emerging markets within the technology sector.
Knowledge of business models, go-to-market strategies, and technology adoption patterns in enterprise IT.
Intellectual curiosity, willingness to learn new marker research methods and tools, analytical mindset, and a collaborative, supportive approach to teamwork.


Why This Role Stands Out

At IDC, your work helps shape how the world understands technology and where it goes next. You collaborate with curious, high-caliber colleagues who value rigor, integrity, and shared success. As the premier global provider of trusted technology intelligence, IDC equips business and technology leaders with the evidence they need to make confident decisions. Our insights inform strategy, investment, and innovation across industries and regions.

Recognized by IIAR as Analyst Firm of the Year for five consecutive years, IDC sets the standard for credibility and impact. With more than 1,000 analysts worldwide and a truly global perspective, we combine deep expertise with practical relevance. Here, your ideas matter, your voice is heard, and your contributions provide the insights leaders rely on every day. It is meaningful work, backed by a culture that supports growth, collaboration, and long-term career development with a globally respected brand.

Equal Opportunity Employer

IDC is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons. Employment eligibility verification required. We participate in E-Verify.

About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious.

You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

Como Especialista de Engagement, serás la pieza clave para diseñar, ejecutar y medir nuestras estrategias de marketing de retención. Tu misión principal será incrementar la frecuencia de compra y el valor anual (LTV) de nuestros clientes utilizando nuestros canales propios (Sitio Web + App) y de contacto directo (Email Marketing y WhatsApp).




Tus principales retos y funciones:




Planeación y Automatización: Coordinarás la planeación, diseño y programación de campañas personalizadas mediante herramientas de marketing automation, asegurando una comunicación segmentada y ad hoc a los objetivos de negocio.




Segmentación Avanzada de Audiencias: Administrarás bases de datos integrando las necesidades comerciales del día a día (stock disponible, lanzamientos de temporada, control de merma) para garantizar mensajes altamente relevantes que impulsen las ventas regionales.




Estrategia y Coordinación de Contenidos: Organizarás la producción anticipada de contenidos y copies alineados al calendario comercial. Supervisión Técnica de Flujos: Monitorearás la configuración técnica y ejecución impecable de campañas automatizadas críticas (correos de bienvenida, carritos abandonados, reactivación, flujos de tráfico continuo).




Análisis de Datos y Herramientas: Explotarás plataformas clave como CleverTap, Gupshup, Google Sheets y Tableau para la ejecución, monitoreo profundo y medición de impacto de cada campaña.




Optimización y A/B Testing: Consolidarás las estrategias de comunicación priorizando KPIs de interacción y conversión mediante el análisis constante, ejecución de pruebas A/B y adopción proactiva de nuevas herramientas.




Requisitos Clave




Formación: Licenciatura concluida en Marketing, Comercio/Negocios Internacionales, Administración, Ingeniería Industrial Administrador (IIA), Ingeniería Industrial y de Sistemas (IIS) o carreras afines.




Experiencia: Experiencia previa comprobable en puestos similares orientados a CRM, Retención o Marketing Automation.




Conocimientos Técnicos Indispensables:




Experiencia sólida en el manejo de plataformas de CRM.




Ejecución avanzada de campañas personalizadas de Email Marketing y WhatsApp.




Capacidad comprobada en el Análisis de resultados de campañas de marketing y propuestas de mejora continua basadas en datos.

Habilidad para la creación de contenidos y copies enfocados a marketing.

description:
About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

TopFoxx | Remote | Full-Time

 

Location: Remote (must work U.S. East Coast hours).

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Hours are flexible. We care about performance, not clocks.

Salary: $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.

Language: Perfect written and spoken English is required (this is non-negotiable), along with a deep understanding of U.S. culture, slang, and social media behavior.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned fashion startup reinventing the sunglasses industry with solution-oriented designs and bold branding. Since 2016, we have grown from a bootstrapped e-commerce brand into a global business serving hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by an engaged community of influencers and creators.

We are not here to follow trends. We create them. Our sunglasses are tangle-free, floatable, foldable, shatter-resistant, and sustainably made, and we are just getting started.

We are a small, lean, founder-led team of fewer than ten people, with only about three of us on marketing. That means there is nowhere to hide and no one to pass the work to. Everyone wears multiple hats, owns real outcomes, and what you build genuinely moves the company. We do not do slow. We move fast, we pivot often, and we only hire A-players who treat the business like their own.




The Role

You will be the main one. This is the person who owns influencer and affiliate marketing end to end at TopFoxx. You are not waiting for a manual or a list of tasks. You are expected to bring the strategy, bring the ideas, and then execute them yourself, fast.

This space changes daily. New creators, new trends, new platform rules. You have to move quickly, test constantly, double down on what converts, and cut what does not. We are not looking for someone who only posts and reports. We are looking for a real executor who is proactive, creative, and obsessed with one thing above all: profitable, converting partnerships.

This is a big opportunity, and we want to be honest with you: it is also real work. We already have a large base of affiliates and creators, but your job is to grow it, activate it, and make it far more profitable. This is not a coast-along role. You will be building, pushing, and problem-solving every single day. For the right person, that is exactly the appeal.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct path into leading the influencer marketing function as it scales.




Why This Is Worth It

Here is the honest pitch. This is not a maintenance job and it is not busywork. Influencer and affiliate marketing is one of the biggest growth levers we have, and we believe this channel can become a multi-million dollar engine for TopFoxx. We are looking for the person who can build that.

We reward outcomes, not hours. If you can show us you can grow this and drive real, profitable revenue, you grow with it. That means a clear path into leadership and compensation that reflects the results you create. The ceiling here is high for someone who actually delivers, and you will be able to point to a business you helped build, not just tasks you completed.

If you want to be a small piece of a big machine, this is not it. If you want real ownership, real upside, and to look back in a year knowing you built something that matters, keep reading.




1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Program (Your Primary Focus)

This is the heart of the role and where most of your time and energy goes. The big one is affiliate. Your job is to make sure the affiliates are converting, the program is profitable, and the numbers in TikTok Shop Seller Center are strong and trending up.

Own TikTok Shop Seller Center day to day. Live in the dashboards, know your numbers cold, and make sure performance is healthy across GMV, conversion, and orders.
Make the affiliate program profitable. Track and grow GMV, revenue per creator, sample-to-sales ROI, and commission costs. Protect margin. Every dollar of product and commission has to earn its return.
Build and manage a pipeline of hundreds to thousands of active TikTok Shop affiliates, and keep them actually posting and selling, not just signing up.
Recruit high-converting creators and live sellers who know how to talk about product and drive sales, not just collect free samples.
Go live and sell yourself. You will host TikTok Lives, get on camera, and sell the glasses directly. Then you bring affiliates on, show them how it is done, and coach them to do the same.
Coordinate TikTok Live schedules with strong sellers, secure Spark Ads permissions, and optimize listings and content angles for maximum GMV.
Watch performance weekly. Scale top converters aggressively, and cut low performers fast.
Keep the data honest. No padded numbers, no inflated reporting. Decisions are only as good as the data behind them.




2. Instagram Influencers

Instagram is the second pillar. Here we work on gifting and affiliate only, so your skill is finding the right people and getting them to convert without a paid budget.

Source Instagram influencers who can actually sell, creators who understand product and know how to drive their audience to buy, not just post a pretty photo.
Run gifting-only and affiliate-only collaborations, and move creators from one gift to repeat posting to consistent affiliate sales.
Rebuild our existing relationships. We have lists of past and dormant influencers. A big part of this role is reigniting those relationships and turning old contacts back into active, converting partners.
Build genuine, consistent relationships so TopFoxx stays top of mind, through thoughtful, regular touchpoints across Instagram and DMs.




3. LTK, Affiliate Platforms & Onboarding Calls

The third pillar is affiliate-driven platforms like LTK, and just as important, getting on calls with creators. This role is not behind a screen all day. You have to be outgoing and genuinely good at talking to people.

Recruit and activate creators on LTK and other affiliate networks (Amazon, affiliate links) who are still actively driving commission-based sales.
Run weekly onboarding calls. You will be on calls regularly, onboarding new influencers, walking them through the program, and getting them excited and set up to post.
Get on calls and close collabs. Be confident and persuasive, build rapport quickly, and convince creators to say yes to working with us, often with gifting only.
Understand creator psychology and motivate influencers to post consistently through relationship, community value, and a clear win for them.




4. Strategy, Reporting & Full Influencer Marketing Scope

Because you own this function, you also handle everything a strong e-commerce influencer marketing lead would handle. Study what bigger e-commerce brands do, then adapt the best of it to a lean, fast-moving team.

Build the strategy. Bring a clear point of view on where influencer and affiliate marketing is going and how TopFoxx wins, then put it into action.
Plan and execute campaigns tied to product launches, holidays, seasonal moments, and major sales events (BFCM, summer, new drops).
Manage content calendars, gifting coordination, sample sends, and follow-ups so nothing slips.
Build weekly performance reports that connect activity to revenue, and use them to decide what to scale and what to kill.
Create simple SOPs, trackers, and playbooks as you go, so the program is repeatable and scalable as the team grows.
Collaborate with the creative, marketing, and product teams to keep messaging aligned, and step in on urgent launch-related projects when needed.
Stay ahead of trends, new creators, and new affiliate opportunities before competitors do.
Help with wider marketing as needed. With a team this small, marketing is just three people and everyone pitches in. From time to time things will come up across other marketing areas and departments that need a hand. We need someone proactive and solution-oriented who brings energy, jumps in, and helps build this with us rather than sitting idle.




Who You Are

Proactive: You see the gap and fill it. You bring the plan, you do not wait to be told.
A real executor: You move fast, ship daily, and adapt as things change hour to hour.
Analytical and profit-obsessed: You can read a Seller Center dashboard, understand ROI and margin, and turn data into decisions.
Persuasive and outgoing: You love talking to creators, you are comfortable on camera and on calls, and you can sell the partnership and the product.
Relationship-driven: You are a natural connector who builds loyalty and keeps partners coming back.
Organized under pressure: You can juggle hundreds of moving pieces without dropping the ball.




Required Experience & Skills

2+ years in influencer or affiliate marketing, preferably in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce / DTC.
Expert, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center mechanics and affiliate programs.
Proven track record of generating real sales through gifting-only or zero-budget strategies.
Comfort with LTK, Amazon, and other affiliate platforms.
Comfortable on camera and hosting TikTok Lives to sell product directly.
Perfect written and spoken English, and a strong understanding of U.S. culture and digital trends. This is genuinely important.
KPI-driven, highly organized, and able to build simple systems and SOPs as you scale.




What You Get

Salary of $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.
A fully remote role on a fast-moving global team.
Real ownership of the influencer and affiliate function, with a path into leadership as it scales.
PTO including vacation, holidays, sick, personal, and mental health days.
Free TopFoxx products and partner brand perks.

About the job

Hello! 👋🏽

At Factorial we're looking for a new Onboarding Specialist for the LATAM Market to help us boost the company to the next level. 🦄

Ready to be part of the challenge?🚀

The Role 📜

As an Onboarding Specialist, you will play a critical role in shaping the first experience our customers have with Factorial. This is not just implementation — this is where customers decide to fully adopt and believe in our product.

You will be responsible for leading end-to-end onboarding processes, ensuring customers successfully implement Factorial and adapt it to their internal HR and operational workflows.

⚠️ Note: This is not an HR onboarding role — it is a consultative, client-facing role that is part of our post-sales process.

One of your biggest challenges will be to deeply understand each client’s processes, identify gaps, and translate their needs into a scalable and effective setup within Factorial — making them feel confident they made the right decision.

What will you be doing:


Own and lead the onboarding journey for new LATAM customers from kickoff to full activation
Design and execute a tailored onboarding roadmap for each client, aligning timelines, milestones, and success criteria
Guide clients through implementation via video calls and email, ensuring adoption of key features and workflows
Bring a consultative approach, helping clients translate their HR processes into Factorial in a scalable and efficient way
Act as the main point of contact during onboarding, ensuring alignment, visibility, and momentum at every stage
Identify risks, blockers, and opportunities early, coordinating with internal teams (Product, Support, Sales) to resolve them
Collect and structure customer feedback, turning insights into actionable improvements for Product and CX
Drive a best-in-class onboarding experience, ensuring clients feel supported, confident, and excited about using Factorial.


Your Profile 🧐 


Strong ownership & problem-solving mindset: You take full responsibility for your clients’ onboarding success. You proactively identify challenges, align stakeholders, and ensure solutions are implemented — making the client feel you’ve got their back at all times.
Consultative & analytical thinking: You are able to deeply understand client processes and translate them into structured, scalable solutions within the platform.
Customer-centric mindset: You know this is a critical moment in the customer journey, and you focus on delivering an experience that builds trust, engagement, and long-term retention.
Fast learner & product-driven: You quickly become an expert in the product, stay up to date with new features, and feel empowered to ask questions and challenge the status quo to improve how we work.
Cross-functional collaboration: You are comfortable working with multiple teams to unblock issues, ensuring visibility and progress for your clients.

title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
About the job

Acerca de Emeritus

En Emeritus creemos que los líderes construyen del mundo un lugar mejor. Nuestra misión es democratizar el acceso a educación de clase mundial, colaborando con las mejores escuelas de negocio del planeta — MIT Sloan, Columbia Business School, Tuck School of Business, entre otras. Ofrecemos cursos, certificados y maestrías en inglés, español, mandarín y portugués, impactando a más de 300,000 estudiantes en +100 países.




Acerca del Puesto

El Marketing Automation Specialist será el arquitecto de los flujos de comunicación digital que guían a los prospectos desde el primer intento de contacto hasta la inscripción en programas de Emeritus. Esta persona será responsable de diseñar, implementar y optimizar journeys automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud, gestionar campañas multicanal (email y WhatsApp), y medir el impacto de cada acción con KPIs claros.

El rol requiere una mentalidad analítica y orientada a resultados: entender el origen y comportamiento de los prospectos, explorar patrones de interacción, detectar oportunidades de mejora y colaborar con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para maximizar la tasa de inscripción.




Funciones Principales

1. Diseño e Implementación de Flujos Automatizados

• Mapear y comprender las fuentes de prospectos (paid media, orgánico, referidos, alianzas) y sus comportamientos para diseñar customer journeys relevantes.

• Diseñar, construir y lanzar flujos automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio) alineados a cada etapa del funnel.

• Definir lógicas de segmentación, personalización y ramificaciones basadas en comportamiento (aperturas, clics, formularios, tiempo en el funnel).

• Proponer y desarrollar nuevas automatizaciones para mejorar la conversión y la eficiencia operativa del equipo.

• Coordinar con redactores y diseñadores para solicitar los copies y materiales necesarios para cada flujo.




2. Gestión de Campañas y Envíos

About the job

Role highlights


Customer Excellence Specialist
Location: Mexico, Chile, or Colombia
Department: Customer Excellence
Reports to: Senior Customer Excellence Manager
Employment type: Permanent
Workplace model: Remote
Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)


Why this role matters

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you’ll be the vital link between ICEYE’s SAR satellite capabilities and our customers across the LATAM region — ensuring every order, from submission to final delivery, runs smoothly and every customer interaction leaves a lasting impression.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world’s largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your Day-to-day Responsibilities

Regular Customer Excellence Responsibilities

Order Management


Oversee the entire order process, from submission to the delivery of the final product.
Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.


Satellite Resource Planning


Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.
Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.


Customer Interaction


Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer-related issues.
Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.


Process Improvement


Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.
Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.


Product Knowledge


Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.


Account Management Responsibilities

Governmental and Commercial Contracts:


Serve as the point of contact for governmental contracts and commercial clients.
Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results to customers.


Relationship Building


Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, serving as a key contact for order-related queries.


Training And Progress Monitoring


Coordinate and conduct service training for both internal and external customers.
Monitor order progress closely, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.


Reporting


Satisfy internal and external reporting needs by providing accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).


What We’re Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Remote Sensing, Aerospace, or a related field.
Proven experience in a customer excellence, account management, or customer-facing operations role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills,Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Availability for shift work (no night shifts required).


Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)


Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.


Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

description:
About the job

Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Job Details

Role: Performance Strategist (Demand Gen)

Department: Performance

Job Location: Remote (Mexico)

Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)

Total Compensation: $510,000 - $612,000 MXN + Benefits

New Hire Starting Pay: $510,000 - $587,000 MXN + Benefits

Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America's most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn't, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we've built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they're proud of - together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Strategist, you'll ensure Thrive operates at peak performance by establishing efficient processes, implementing best practices, and fostering growth within your team in both technical and strategic areas. Your mission will be to develop and execute project growth initiatives, lead a high-performing team, and uphold our company philosophy. You'll focus on setting your team up for success by enhancing the systems used to build, maintain, and grow client relationships through continuous improvement of philosophies, programs, policies, and processes.

Working Within Our Values:

At Thrive, we value teamwork and a "no politics" culture. This means that no matter your title, everyone is committed to contributing in whatever way is needed to ensure project success. Your role involves both high-level, strategic leadership and rolling up your sleeves for hands-on execution when required.

Your focus of responsibilities will be: 


Domain: Recognized as an emerging leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges, elevate team skills, and drive program growth by enabling teams to excel in their projects and careers.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across mid-sized projects. You're responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.
Client: Organizing and leading high-impact client relationship drivers, such as client onboards and business reviews, and using the latest and most cutting-edge methods and tools available to achieve successful outcomes.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with small to mid-sized clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we're addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.
People: Elevating people you work directly and indirectly with to bring best-in-class solutions to projects through their thinking and execution. Supporting the development of team members to grow company performance expertise.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a manager level, you address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are an expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.
Company: Lead a culture of project excellence in the Performance department by guiding daily interactions, developing initiatives, and aligning individual efforts with organizational goals. Monitor team workflow, use business intelligence tools to optimize people and project allocation.
Example: You lead team-level conversations and support initiatives that keep Thrive on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We're committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you'll familiarize yourself with Thrive's tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you'll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer term account initiatives. You'll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you'll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. 


Qualifications


You have executed, planned and maintained multi-channel, full funnel performance marketing accounts of $200k+ USD media spend per month at a consistently positive ROI for the client across multiple platforms at a time (e.g., Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, Display, Programmatic Platforms, TikTok, Twitter, Spotify and others).
You have experience directly collaborating with and delegating to junior team members as a senior account manager. You have contributed to the development of multiple team members by leading training and providing strategic guidance and project leadership to the point of developing others to the next stage of seniority / role level.
You have advanced analytical skills and are experienced in using visualization tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or similar platforms to pull, sort, analyze and draw insight from ad platforms, analytics, and / or business intelligence tools.
You've managed performance media across a range of business verticals and sizes (ecommerce, demand gen, etc), and have been responsible for pacing, forecasting and reporting the impact of performance media on overarching business goals.
You have successfully managed client and / or key stakeholder relationships (ranging in seniority) via weekly touchpoint meetings, quarterly business presentations and asynchronous communication channels (Slack, email, Asana, etc). You've resolved difficult stakeholder situations, keeping priorities organized and objectives aligned and have consistently received buy-in on strategic proposals or deliverables.
You have effectively communicated with clients on marketing concepts such as incrementality, KPI selection, attribution and business economics and have incorporated marketing measurement considerations into your strategic approaches.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

Nuestra misión es simplificar la operación de los centros educativos, reduciendo su carga administrativa y mejorando la comunicación con padres de familia, para que directores y maestros puedan enfocarse en lo más importante: la educación de los niños.




➡️ ¿Te apasiona esta visión?

¡Genial! Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo y creemos que esta oportunidad puede ser lo que estás buscando. Únete a una empresa 100% mexicana con presencia local y un producto diseñado para las necesidades de miles de centros en Latinoamérica.




➡️ Descripción del puesto

Como Customer Success Specialist, tu misión será asegurar que los centros educativos tengan la mejor experiencia posible con nuestra plataforma. Serás responsable de gestionar una cartera de centros educativos, asegurando su correcta incorporación, adopción y crecimiento dentro de la plataforma Aldea.

Este no es un rol únicamente reactivo: buscamos a alguien que gestione de forma proactiva la relación con sus clientes, identifique riesgos de churn y detecte oportunidades de expansión.

Tu principal objetivo será maximizar la retención, el uso de la plataforma y el crecimiento de tus cuentas.




Responsabilidades:

Realizar onboarding de nuevos clientes mediante videollamadas.
Gestionar cartera de clientes, construyendo relaciones a largo plazo.
Dar seguimiento continuo para asegurar adopción y uso activo de la plataforma.
Mantener comunicación constante con clientes (llamadas, correo, mensajes).
Detectar riesgos de churn y actuar de forma oportuna.
Identificar oportunidades de expansión (upsell y cross-sell).
Atender y canalizar incidencias al equipo de Soporte.
Analizar métricas de uso, retención y satisfacción (NPS).
Recopilar feedback de clientes y compartirlo con Producto y Desarrollo.
Dar seguimiento al proceso de alta con proveedores de pago.




Competencias y cualificaciones deseadas

1 - 3 años años de experiencia en Customer Success, Account Management o roles similares de atención/fidelizacion de clientes.
Experiencia gestionando cartera de clientes (no solo atención reactiva).
Experiencia en SaaS o tecnología (deseable).
Fuerte orientación al cliente y a resultados.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
Capacidad analítica y comodidad trabajando con métricas.
Organización y manejo de múltiples cuentas y tareas.
Experiencia con CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive o similares).
Inglés intermedio-avanzado.
Paciencia, empatía, proactividad y orientación al cliente.




Medición de resultados

Retención de clientes.
Nivel de adopción y uso de la plataforma.
NPS y satisfacción del cliente.
Expansión de cuentas (upsell/cross-sell).




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Esquema híbrido: 4 días presencial y 1 remoto.
Sueldo mensual bruto: $22,000 - $25,000 (Acorde a experiencia).
Impacto directo en el sector educativo.
Crecimiento profesional en una startup en expansión.
Equipo dinámico y cultura enfocada en resultados.

We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of — together.

The Opportunity

This is a build-and-grow moment. We're expanding our performance practice around lead generation, and the work comes with a portfolio most marketers only get to admire from the outside — think category-defining B2B software and technology brands, the kind of companies whose products you already use and whose growth story is still being written. You won't just be running campaigns for them; you'll be the strategic partner helping them figure out how demand generation compounds into pipeline, market share, and durable growth. That means owning the questions that actually move a business: how do we reach the right buyers earlier, turn intent into qualified pipeline, and build a lead engine that scales as they do? The tactical craft matters — funnel design, lead quality, CPL and lead-to-opportunity performance — but here it's in service of something bigger: shaping how some of the most ambitious brands in tech grow. If your best work has been measured in ROAS, purchases, or app installs, this likely isn't your fit. But if you think about demand gen as a growth strategy, not just a channel, let's chat.

The Role

Joining the Performance department (performance marketing) as our Performance Manager, you'll be responsible for driving project excellence in Performance Programs by implementing growth strategies, solving complex problems, and fostering team development to ensure that Thrive remains an industry leader in performance marketing. You'll oversee the success of some of our highest priority brands and partnerships, ranging from household names through to brands that are in early growth stages. You'll also be a key contributor to product innovation and project growth initiatives, working amongst a collaborative team to continuously improve our product and service.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:


Domain: Recognized as a leader in performance marketing at Thrive, you solve client challenges with innovative solutions, advocate for team member career growth, and contribute to agency-wide thought leadership in your area of expertise.
Example: You'll lead teams in the research, media planning and strategic roadmaps across some of our largest brands. You are responsible for mobilizing internal teams and working alongside them from inception through to hands-on, ongoing execution execution and optimization, while reporting to stakeholders on key performance indicators.


Client: Improve and redefine client success standards at Thrive by championing exceptional client service. Solve client and project issues with performance marketing solutions and provide advice on workflow and resource management.
Example: You lead strategic conversations with some of our largest clients 1:1, proactively engaging in and consistently monitoring client sentiment to ensure we’re addressing any challenges and opportunities. You provide constructive feedback to team members and work in partnership with the senior operational team to address any resourcing, performance or economic shifts.


People: Enhance the Performance department’s expertise by mentoring and managing team members, and contributing to their development through upskilling, training content, workshops, and other company resources.
Example: You either manage team members directly or work closely with them in a mentor and advocate capacity. Operating at a senior-manager level, you develop other leaders & address any role performance challenges proactively and appropriately. You set team members up for success to continuously elevate their roles on projects, are expert at giving feedback and approach difficult conversations with confidence and care.


Company: Make significant contributions to people and projects within the Performance department by solving complex problems, coordinating support, and aligning with stakeholders. Use performance marketing expertise to enhance organizational initiatives and support company goals.
Example: You lead company-level conversations and initiatives that keep us on the leading edge of performance marketing. You get buy-in, work through change management, and successfully collaborate with cross-functional support as needed.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:


In your first 30 days you’ll familiarize yourself with Thrive’s tools and processes and begin onboarding to projects and teams across your department, identifying performance opportunities and building relationships.
In your first 60 days you’ll be playing an active role across projects, collaborating with teams on day-to-day and longer-term account initiatives. You’ll begin developing processes and strategies to improve team and project success and sharing key insights with others.
In your first 90 days you’ll be stepping into account leadership opportunities, providing support across project planning, strategy, client partnerships and team skills development. You’ll begin collaborating with senior stakeholders across the company, leveraging your experience to provide valuable feedback and move initiatives forward. 


Qualifications


You've planned and executed multi-channel, full-funnel performance marketing campaigns with media spends exceeding $500k USD per month, delivering consistently positive ROI across multiple platforms (e.g., Meta, Search, YouTube, Programmatic, TikTok).
You’ve mobilized and led teams of 5-10, providing direct management, training, and strategic guidance to develop junior team members into management roles.
You’ve built and customized dashboards using tools like Google Sheets, Excel, Looker or Tableau to streamline reporting, analyze performance data, and focus on key business objectives and KPIs.
You’ve developed or improved internal initiatives or processes that have been adopted company-wide, elevating performance standards across the organization.
You’ve driven performance media strategy across diverse business verticals, having successfully led pacing, forecasting, and reporting with business objectives, and effectively communicated these strategies to senior stakeholders, including C-Suite executives.
You’ve successfully managed client relationships with multiple stakeholders, delivering strategic recommendations, resolving complex situations, and gaining buy-in through clear and effective communication across meetings and digital channels.


Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

About the job

Introduction

Job Title: Marketing & Creative Coordinator
Schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week | Monday–Friday, aligned with Pacific Time
Location: Remote - Latin America




Overview

Bring great design to life and help shape a brand people remember.

Join a high-performing, design-driven real estate team with decades of experience representing premium properties in one of the world's most iconic cities. Known for its relationship-first approach, attention to detail, and elevated marketing standards, the team believes that every piece of creative work should be intentional, polished, and memorable.

This role goes far beyond creating graphics. You'll play a key role in maintaining the visual identity of the brand across print, digital, social media, email, and web. Working closely with the team, you'll help bring every property to market with a thoughtful, editorial approach while ensuring every touchpoint reflects a consistent and high-quality brand experience. This is a non-client-facing, English-only role where creativity, independence, and strong design instincts are highly valued.




Key Responsibilities

Design high-quality listing collateral, including brochures, flyers, postcards, signage, and digital marketing assets.
Manage the company's social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube, including content planning, scheduling, engagement, and growth.
Create polished, repeatable marketing campaign templates that ensure consistency and scalability across listings.
Maintain brand consistency across listing presentations, email marketing, print materials, and open house collateral.
Lead website updates and ongoing content maintenance.
Build and manage email marketing campaigns.
Independently identify creative challenges and develop thoughtful, effective solutions with minimal supervision.




Must-Have Requirements

Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator (Canva-only experience is not sufficient).
A portfolio demonstrating real brand and campaign design work, showcasing both execution and creative thinking.
Strong understanding of social media platforms, content formats, trends, and audience engagement.
Excellent visual design skills with the ability to produce polished, professional marketing materials.
Video editing experience.
Ability to work independently with minimal oversight while consistently delivering high-quality work.




Nice-to-Have Requirements

Experience with campaign strategy or content planning beyond graphic design.
Previous experience in real estate or luxury/lifestyle brands.
Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools.




Why Join Us

If you're passionate about thoughtful design and enjoy creating marketing that stands out for all the right reasons, this is an opportunity to make a real impact. You'll join a collaborative, design-focused team that values creativity, high standards, and attention to detail while giving you the autonomy to own your work.

Every project is an opportunity to elevate a premium brand, build a cohesive visual identity, and contribute to meaningful marketing that reflects quality over quantity. If you're looking for a role where your creative judgment is trusted and your work truly shapes how a brand is experienced, we'd love to hear from you.

Inglés B2-C1, indispensable.

description:
About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across voice, email, and enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z and Base10 with over $60M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments - where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist, your mission is to connect the dots between user needs, data insights, and product capabilities to help our customers unlock value. You’ll dive deep into our customer operations, partner directly with end users and decision-makers, and shape how HappyRobot’s technology is applied to their most critical challenges.

At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You Will Do


Partnering with customers to understand their workflows, goals, and pain points—often embedding directly with their teams.
Collaborating with Forward Deployment Engineers to scope, prototype, and deliver solutions powered by HappyRobot’s platform.
Identifying and interpreting key datasets that drive customer decision-making, and working to integrate them into robust, scalable pipelines.
Designing and refining user workflows that solve meaningful problems and scale across teams and functions.
Leading training and onboarding sessions, ensuring new users are set up for success and our tools have lasting impact.
Presenting findings and strategy to stakeholders at all levels—from frontline operators to executives.
Driving customer expansion by scoping new use cases and shaping how we grow our footprint within organizations.


Why join us?


Opportunity to work at a high-growth AI startup, backed by top investors.
Rapidly growing and backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, and Base10.
Ownership & Autonomy - Take full ownership of projects and ship fast.
Comprehensive Benefits - Healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Top-Tier Compensation - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.
Work With the Best - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Travel Designer
description:
About the job

About the Role

As a Travel Designer, you are responsible for transforming each member's travel dreams, preferences, and aspirations into exceptional, tailor-made journeys that feel effortless, thoughtful, and deeply personal.

Working within a Pod that operates as a business unit, you will combine curiosity, creativity, commercial awareness, and outstanding communication skills to design experiences that delight members while contributing to the Pod's commercial success.

You will report directly to the Experience Manager, who provides your day-to-day leadership, sets priorities, and supports your performance and professional growth.

You will partner closely with the Travel Design Lead, who is responsible for establishing travel design standards, coaching the team, and ensuring every itinerary and proposal consistently meets the quality standards.

You will also collaborate closely with the Destination Team, leveraging their expertise to create exceptional journeys while contributing your own insights and feedback to continuously improve destination knowledge, experiences, and recommendations.

Together, you will collaborate across the Pod to deliver the level of personalization, attention to detail, commercial impact, and service excellence.

 




Your Areas of Ownership




Member Understanding

● Collaborate closely with the Experience Manager to develop a deep understanding of each member's travel style, preferences, priorities, and aspirations.

● Demonstrate curiosity by asking the right questions and proactively seeking the context needed to design highly personalized journeys.

● Translate member profiles and insights into thoughtful recommendations that accurately reflect each member's needs, preferences, and expectations.

● Apply empathy, active listening, and exceptional attention to detail to ensure every itinerary feels personal, relevant, and carefully crafted.

● Demonstrate sound judgment by delivering recommendations that are accurate, relevant, and fully aligned with the member's needs, budget, preferences, and expectations.

 

Travel Design Excellence

● Design highly personalized journeys that combine creativity, attention to detail, and operational feasibility.

● Craft itineraries that reflect each member's lifestyle, interests, and travel aspirations.

● Work closely with the Destinations team to combine destination expertise with member insights, creating thoughtfully curated journeys that feel authentic, personalized, and truly exceptional.

● Deliver proposals that feel unique, thoughtful, and tailored to every member.

● Balance inspiration with practicality while maintaining Essentialist's standards of quality and luxury.

● Partner with the Travel Design Lead to continuously elevate the quality, creativity, and consistency of every itinerary and proposal.

● Continuously expand your destination knowledge and seek inspiration to create unforgettable travel experiences.

 

Commercial Impact

● Contribute to revenue growth by identifying opportunities to enrich every itinerary with meaningful experiences and additional services.

● Support trip conversion through timely responses, thoughtful recommendations, and compelling travel proposals.

● Balance creativity with commercial awareness, ensuring recommendations deliver value for both the member and the business.

● Recognize opportunities to surprise and delight members while strengthening long-term loyalty.

 




Destination Collaboration 

● Build strong relationships with the Destination Team to continuously deepen your destination knowledge.

● Partner closely with Destination Specialists to ensure every itinerary reflects local expertise, operational feasibility, and the highest quality standards.

● Share feedback on destinations, suppliers, and experiences to help continuously improve recommendations and travel content.

● Proactively identify gaps, inconsistencies, or opportunities for improvement and collaborate with the Destination Team to strengthen future itineraries.

● Contribute to building and evolving destination's knowledge by sharing learnings and insights from your member interactions.

 

Operational Excellence

● Respond promptly to member requests and internal priorities, maintaining speed without compromising quality.

● Manage multiple trips simultaneously while consistently meeting turnaround expectations and service standards.

● Translate member needs into clear, structured, and actionable plans for the Operations team.

● Build accurate, complete, and operationally feasible itineraries by working closely with the Destination Team and leveraging their expertise.

● Maintain exceptional attention to detail across every stage of the travel design process, ensuring every proposal meets the quality standards.

 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

● Partner closely with your Experience Manager, Operations Executives, Travel Design Lead, and Destination Team to deliver exceptional member experiences.

● Collaborate with the Destination Team to ensure every itinerary reflects local expertise, operational feasibility, and the highest quality standards.

● Proactively share feedback, identify gaps, and suggest improvements to destination content, supplier recommendations, and travel experiences, helping continuously strengthen the destination knowledge.

● Maintain clear, proactive, and accurate communication with the Operations Executives, ensuring all information is transferred seamlessly to enable flawless trip execution.

● Collaborate openly across the Pod, embrace feedback, continuously develop your travel expertise, and contribute to raising the team's standards.

 

Qualifications / Requirements

● Proven experience in luxury travel, bespoke travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, concierge services, or premium hospitality is required.

● Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

● Exceptional curiosity and a genuine passion for travel, destinations, and cultures.

● Excellent attention to detail with the ability to interpret complex requests accurately.

● Strong commercial awareness and the ability to naturally identify opportunities to enhance both the member experience and business results.

● Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

● Excellent judgment, problem-solving skills, and decision-making ability.

● Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively within a cross-functional Pod structure.

● Comfortable adopting new tools, technology, and AI solutions that enhance efficiency, collaboration, and the overall member experience.

 

What Great Looks Like

Success as a Travel Designer means creating journeys that feel deeply personal, effortless, and unforgettable.

You will:

● Consistently design exceptional, highly personalized travel experiences.

● Develop a deep understanding of every member's preferences and travel aspirations.

● Respond quickly while maintaining outstanding quality and attention to detail.

● Deliver recommendations that are thoughtful, accurate, and commercially impactful.

● Build trusted partnerships within your Pod to ensure seamless execution.

● Continuously expand your travel knowledge and inspire members with exceptional ideas.

● Contribute to long-term member loyalty by creating experiences members can't wait to repeat.
