title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
About the job

About the Role

VIAS is looking for a Growth Marketing Specialist to help drive pipeline growth across key Business Units by turning strategy into high-impact execution.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional marketing role for someone who can translate technical solutions into compelling campaigns, content, and digital experiences that generate demand. You will work across multiple channels and initiatives, including email, social media, landing pages, webinars, events, outbound support, and performance tracking.

You will also be expected to use AI tools confidently and practically to improve the speed, quality, and scale of marketing execution. We are looking for a marketer who combines strong execution skills with commercial thinking, digital fluency, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across different parts of the business.




Role Objective

Drive pipeline growth by translating technical solutions into high-performing marketing programs across assigned Business Units. This role connects strategy to execution across campaigns, content, events, digital channels, and reporting, ensuring marketing initiatives are aligned to revenue goals and delivered effectively.




Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation and Campaign Execution

Execute marketing campaigns across assigned Business Units, ensuring strategy is translated into coordinated, multi-channel execution. Support campaign planning, manage timelines, and ensure campaigns launch on time with consistent messaging across all channels.

Help deploy and optimize campaigns across email marketing, social media, web and landing pages, outbound sequences, webinars, and event follow-up. Coordinate with internal stakeholders from each Business Unit to align priorities, messaging, launches, and deadlines.




Content Development and Channel Adaptation

Create, adapt, and repurpose content for different formats and channels, ensuring technical solutions are communicated clearly and effectively to the right audiences.

Develop content for email campaigns, LinkedIn and other social channels, landing pages, website content, webinars, and outbound support. Adapt messaging appropriately for each channel while maintaining consistency with campaign objectives and brand positioning.

Work with external design and video partners to brief, coordinate, and deliver campaign assets.




Webinar, Event, and Content Series Support

Support the planning and execution of strategic marketing initiatives such as webinars, industry events, customer events, podcast episodes, and technical content series.

Coordinate timelines, materials, logistics, follow-up communications, and content distribution to ensure these initiatives contribute to lead generation and pipeline development. Help connect each initiative to the wider campaign flow, including promotion, registration, follow-up, nurturing, and post-event repurposing.




Podcast and Repurposed Content Execution

Support the production and promotion of podcast episodes and technical content series, including scheduling, content preparation, and post-launch distribution.




Turn long-form content into a consistent stream of campaign assets, including social posts, email content, blog content, landing page copy, and outbound support messaging, maximizing content value across channels.




CRM, Attribution, and Performance Support

Support the accuracy and effectiveness of campaign tracking and marketing reporting by helping maintain clean data and strong attribution practices across CRM and campaign platforms.




Help maintain CRM data accuracy in Zoho, ensure correct campaign attribution, support lead tracking and reporting, and build simple dashboards or reporting views to monitor campaign performance. Analyze results and identify opportunities to improve messaging, targeting, conversion rates, and overall campaign effectiveness.




Lead Scoring, Segmentation, and Intent Data Support

Support the refinement of lead scoring and segmentation practices by working with Marketing and Sales to improve lead quality and campaign relevance.

Help align MQL criteria with Sales, analyze engagement behavior, and use tools to improve targeting, sequencing, and prioritization based on intent and engagement.




AI-Enabled Marketing Execution

Use AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of marketing execution across content creation, campaign ideation, research, segmentation, reporting, and workflow efficiency.




Apply AI to repurpose technical content, support message testing, accelerate research and summarization, improve campaign productivity, and identify opportunities for smarter automation across the marketing function. Use good judgment to ensure outputs remain accurate, relevant, and aligned with brand and business goals.




What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means consistently turning strategy into execution across multiple Business Units, keeping campaigns and content moving, and helping Marketing contribute more effectively to pipeline growth.

A strong performer in this role will launch campaigns on time, deliver high-quality content across channels, improve the connection between campaigns, events, and follow-up, contribute to better reporting and attribution discipline, and use AI to increase productivity without compromising quality.




KPIs

Performance in this role will be measured through a combination of business impact and execution quality, including pipeline contribution, campaign delivery, content output, conversion performance, event and webinar contribution, and CRM/reporting accuracy.

Key measures include marketing-sourced pipeline, marketing-influenced pipeline, campaign launch timeliness, number of campaigns executed across assigned Business Units, content pieces delivered per campaign, social media consistency aligned to campaign activity, lead-to-MQL conversion, MQL-to-SQL conversion, landing page conversion rates, leads generated from webinars and events, post-event follow-up performance, attribution accuracy, and reporting completeness.




Required Experience and Skills

We are looking for a marketer with a strong mix of execution, content development, campaign coordination, commercial thinking, and digital fluency.

You should bring experience in B2B marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or campaign execution. You should be comfortable creating and adapting content across email, social, web, and event-related formats, and confident managing campaigns from planning through launch and follow-up.




You should also have experience working across multiple stakeholders and priorities, familiarity with CRM and campaign reporting tools, and strong organizational skills with close attention to detail. An analytical mindset is important, along with the ability to interpret campaign results and identify improvement opportunities.

Practical experience using AI tools to improve marketing execution, content production, research, segmentation, and performance analysis is required.

Experience with platforms such as Mailchimp, Zoho, LinkedIn, IA for lead generation and ZoomInfo will be a strong advantage.




Preferred Background

Experience in technical, engineering, industrial, software, or solutions-based B2B environments would be highly valued. Experience supporting webinars, events, podcasts, or technical content series is also a plus.

About the job

About Us

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. We help our members invest in those companies 12 to 18 months before they go public, deal-by-deal, with full discretion.

We are not a fund. We are a club. No blind pools, no lock-ups, no marketing dressed up as deal flow. Every member chooses what they back, and we handle everything else - sourcing, diligence, SPV formation, legal, reporting, and the live community that makes the whole thing run.

What You Will Do:

The CRM Coordinator is the operational backbone of our member and prospect pipeline. You will own the integrity and performance of our CRM - ensuring every contact, deal stage, and communication touchpoint is accurate, timed, and purposeful.

This is not a data-entry role. We need someone who understands why the data matters, takes ownership of process breakdowns before anyone else notices them, and continuously improves how we track and engage our community. You will work closely with the Director of Community & Operations to ensure no relationship falls through the cracks.

Surface insights to leadership in a clear, concise format - no noise, just signal

2+ years of hands-on CRM or revenue operations experience, with HubSpot as a hard requirement

About the job

About United Credit




United Credit helps healthcare providers grow their practices by making patient financing simple.




Unlike single-lender financing companies, United Credit gives providers access to multiple financing options through one application, helping more patients get approved while allowing providers to offer financing that fits a wider range of credit profiles. Our merchant partners rely on us not just for financing, but for responsive service, industry expertise, and a true partnership focused on helping their businesses grow.




We’re a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company where ideas become action quickly. We value accountability, collaboration, and people who take ownership of their work. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and making a measurable impact every day, you’ll fit right in.




Position Summary




The Business Development Manager is responsible for driving growth within an assigned portfolio of healthcare providers. Through consultative account management, strategic business reviews, staff training, performance analysis, and relationship development, the BDM helps providers increase financing utilization, improve patient conversion, and maximize the value of their partnership with United Credit. Reporting to the Sales Manager, this role is about growing and protecting an existing book of business, not new-account hunting.




Essential Responsibilities




● Conduct business reviews with assigned merchants using Salesforce dashboards and portfolio analytics to identify growth opportunities.

● Identify underperforming accounts and develop action plans to increase funded volume and merchant activation.

● Train providers and office staff on financing best practices, patient conversation scripts, and program utilization.

● Increase merchant activation and application utilization across the assigned territory.

● Analyze funding trends within the portfolio and recommend strategies to improve loan volume and share of wallet.

● Establish and maintain executive relationships with owners, providers, office managers, and practice administrators.

● Educate merchants on UC programs, benefits, rates, and compliance requirements to ensure a high level of program knowledge.

● Protect merchant retention by proactively identifying competitive threats and addressing provider concerns before they become churn risk.

● Collaborate with Enrollment Specialists to ensure a smooth merchant handoff after activation.

● Partner with Operations to resolve merchant issues quickly and maintain a high standard of merchant satisfaction.

● Introduce program changes and enhancements to assigned accounts, including new lender additions, pricing tiers, or platform features.

● Maintain working knowledge of the patient and healthcare financing industry, including competitor offerings (Cherry, CareCredit, Proceed Finance, HFD, Alphaeon, and similar providers), so you can speak credibly to how United Credit compares.

● Represent the company at industry trade shows and meetings, as needed.

● Perform other duties as assigned.




Performance Metrics (KPIs)

● Monthly funded loan volume within assigned portfolio

● Active merchant percentage

● Merchant utilization rate (applications per active merchant)

● Merchant retention and reactivation

● Share of wallet within assigned accounts

● Business reviews completed

● Training sessions conducted

● Salesforce activity completion




What Success Looks Like

● You build trusted relationships with healthcare providers.

● You move quickly and follow through on commitments.

● You solve problems rather than waiting for direction.

● You use data to prioritize your day and identify growth opportunities within your portfolio.

● You consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

● You contribute ideas that improve the merchant experience.




Required Skills

● 2+ years of account management, portfolio management, or relationship management experience required; experience in healthcare sales, patient financing, medical sales, or practice development is a strong plus.

● Excellent phone and communication skills (50+ calls per day, 2+ hours of talk time daily).

● Consultative selling and solution-selling skills, with the ability to build and execute account growth plans rather than simply respond to requests.

● Ability to handle provider communications in a friendly, professional, and timely manner across phone, email, and text.

● Ability to be both a team player in a collaborative environment and an independent contributor.

● Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and adapt as the competitive landscape shifts.

● Strong time management and territory management skills.

● Expert use of computers and typing, with knowledge of Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.

● Fluent, professional-level written and verbal English skills.

● Work experience utilizing Salesforce or a comparable CRM, including dashboards and portfolio analytics.

● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field, preferred.




Work Location & Hours

● Fully remote position open to international candidates, with preference for Mexico-based candidates.

● Full-time.

Essential Responsibilities




● Own the entire enrollment pipeline from initial outreach through underwriting approval.

● Work consumer-sourced leads where a patient has inquired about financing through United Credit but their provider is not yet enrolled: proactively contact the provider by phone and email, let them know a patient is actively seeking financing, and pitch enrollment in the United Credit platform.

● Create urgency around provider onboarding to reduce enrollment cycle time.

● Set qualified appointments for Business Development Managers, confirm attendance, and position calls as valuable (training, growth, increased approvals).

● Collaborate closely with Business Development Managers to ensure a seamless transition after activation.

● Contact assigned accounts to reintroduce United Credit, highlight program improvements, and encourage submission of new applications.

● Live Conversations: 8-12 per day

● Appointments Set: 2-4 daily, 10-20 per week

● Enrollment-to-activation conversion rate

● You move quickly and follow through on commitments.

● You solve problems rather than waiting for direction.

● You use data to prioritize your day and keep your pipeline moving.

● You consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

● You contribute ideas that improve the merchant experience.




Required Skills

● Strong phone presence with the ability to drive high call volume and meaningful talk time.

● Consultative, relationship-driven sales approach rather than a transactional one; comfort with solution selling.

● Excellent follow-up discipline and a sense of urgency, given how quickly providers can choose a competing financing option.

● Ability to manage and prioritize a multi-account sales pipeline independently.

● Comfort working in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with documentation.

● Coachable, consistent, and self-motivated, even on slow days.

● Healthcare sales, medical sales, or patient financing experience is a strong plus.

About Sarelly




Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand—we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.

As we expand into the U.S., we're investing in a new capability: an AI-powered Consumer Intelligence Hub that continuously transforms consumer signals into better business decisions.

We're looking for someone to lead that capability.

You won't spend your time commissioning surveys and writing research reports.

Instead, you'll build and own Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence function, working at the intersection of consumer understanding, AI and business strategy.

Your mission is simple: Turn consumer signals into better business decisions.

Working alongside an external AI Intelligence Architect and the executive team, you'll help build one of the first AI-native Consumer Intelligence capabilities in beauty.

Build Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Framework

Define how raw consumer data should be categorized and tagged.

Our Client:




Our client has built an AI-powered operating system that runs the entire sales engagement layer for automotive dealerships, and it's already proven at scale, having worked over a million leads and booked more than 100,000 appointments.




They're changing the way sales works in automotive. The old model, broken manual follow-up loops, reps buried in busywork, is being replaced by a closed-loop system that handles the grind, so sales reps can focus on what they do best: selling and closing. Dealerships grow. The category is moving fast, and this team is right at the centre of it.




This is a pivotal moment. The company is transitioning from build mode to scale mode, and the category around AI-driven automotive sales infrastructure is exploding. If you want to join a team that's already delivering real results and help take it to the next level, the timing couldn't be better.




In This Role, You’ll:




Be the hands-on content creator behind the company’s organic social presence. Your day-to-day is the full content creation loop: editing footage, writing copy, publishing across platforms, engaging the community, and learning from the data to make the next piece better. You’ll also contribute to the editorial direction alongside the Director of Media.




What You'll Be Doing




Content Creation (~75%)

Editing raw footage into scroll-stopping short-form social media content, this is the bulk of the role
Writing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs that stop the scroll and drive action
Appearing on camera when needed as part of content
Publishing on cadence across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Facebook, and X
In-platform engagement and community building: comments, DMs, replies, relationships
Daily co-concepting with the Director of Media

Performance & Reporting (~25%)

Translating what’s working (and what isn’t) into better content in the next cycle
Contributing to the editorial calendar and content direction based on performance insights

Non-negotiable: you have hands-on experience editing short-form video for social media and have grown a real account organically (B2B, founder-led, or a company brand). You can show the content you’ve made, explain the editing choices, and prove the growth was driven by your work. This is the core of what we’re hiring for.




The rest:

Video editing proficiency: you can take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging short-form content
Comfort on camera: you’re willing to appear in content when the role calls for it
Copywriting ability for hooks, captions, scripts, and CTAs
Platform-native knowledge: current on formats, sounds, and what performs where

Experience with organic growth strategy or content attribution

About the job

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.






About the Role


JumpCloud is building an AI-first GTM engine designed to scale pipeline generation through automation, intelligent workflows, and operational leverage. This role will focus on the next evolution of outbound execution by combining AI, automation, data orchestration, and modern GTM tooling to build scalable outbound systems that improve efficiency, personalization, and pipeline generation.




This is a hands-on builder role focused on deploying production-ready workflows, not just experimenting with AI tools. You will partner closely with Marketing, Sales Development, and Operations leadership to create agentic outbound programs that connect data, AI, sequencing, enrichment, and engagement systems into a unified outbound motion.




You will help operationalize how modern outbound gets built at scale.







What You'll Be Doing:


Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity.







Core Objectives:Build Agentic Outbound Systems



Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration






Operationalize AI at Scale





Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools






Improve Outbound Efficiency





Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability






Accelerate Pipeline Generation





Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration






Ship Fast and Iterate





Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact







We're Looking For:


A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals.




Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity.







Required Qualifications:


GTM Systems & Operations








Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms.








Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms.








Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management.








In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency.









AI & Automation








Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation.








Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems.








Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes.








Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus.









Builder Mentality








Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration.








Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly.








Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale.









Cross-Functional Collaboration








Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly.








Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.









Operating Style








Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action.








Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve.








Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact.


















Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role. 




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. 




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

Wellbeing activities

Become an Emmie




 




Emma is transforming the world of sleep - and we want the highest-performing people to help us pull it off. We want you. But only if you're willing to go all in. Only if you're willing to question, disrupt, innovate, and create from the ground up.

About the job

About Skift

Skift is the leading business intelligence and media company in travel, delivering news, research, and global events that power smarter decisions across the industry. We convene senior leaders and innovators who rely on Skift for clarity, insight, and meaningful connection in a fast-moving global market.




Why This Role Matters

Reporting to the Ad Operations Manager, the Campaigns Operations Coordinator plays a key role in the day-to-day administration and execution of Skift’s advertising and sponsorship campaigns.

By working closely with Sales and Creative teams, this role ensures campaigns are set up accurately, launched on time, and tracked with care. Your attention to detail and organized approach directly supports campaign delivery and advertiser satisfaction.




The Opportunity

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and organized professional with experience in digital campaign administration and ad operations support.

This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with ad platforms and internal systems, communicates clearly across teams, and takes pride in keeping campaigns running smoothly from setup through completion.




Some of What You’ll Do

Campaign Setup & Administration

Support the end-to-end setup and trafficking of direct-sold digital campaigns in Google Ad Manager
Enter and maintain line items, targeting parameters, creative uploads, and placements accurately
Conduct pre-launch quality checks to ensure campaigns are configured correctly before going live

Campaign Monitoring & Reporting

Track daily pacing and flag delivery issues or discrepancies to the appropriate team members
Pull and organize campaign performance data to support regular reporting
Maintain accurate records of campaign status, delivery, and changes throughout the flight

Technical & Operational Support

Assist with implementation and QA of third-party tags, pixels, and UTM parameters
Follow and uphold naming conventions and reporting hygiene across all campaigns
Support newsletter sponsorship deployment (HubSpot preferred) and podcast ad operations
Help coordinate retargeting campaign setup under the guidance of senior team members

Cross-Team Coordination

Communicate with Sales and Creative teams to gather campaign assets and resolve setup questions
Support delivery data verification for billing and invoicing purposes
Escalate technical issues or platform discrepancies to the appropriate internal contacts




What You’ll Bring

2–3 years of experience in ad operations, campaign coordination, or digital media administration
Working knowledge of Google Ad Manager (required)
Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as targeting, pacing, impressions, and creative specs
Experience with third-party tag implementation and tracking pixels is a plus
Strong organizational skills and high attention to detail
Clear communicator who can follow processes and flag issues proactively
Able to manage multiple tasks and campaigns simultaneously in a remote work environment




Success Metrics

Accurate and timely campaign setup with minimal errors
Campaigns launched on schedule with all assets and tracking in place
Consistent and organized campaign records and reporting hygiene
Proactive communication with team members when issues or gaps are identified
Reliable support for delivery data and invoicing alignment




What We Offer

Opportunity to grow within a respected and innovative media company
Exposure to the intersection of media, events, and travel intelligence
Collaborative, supportive, and remote-friendly work environment




How We Work

Skift is a remote-first, globally distributed company. We value clarity, accountability, and strong documentation to stay aligned across time zones.




How To Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter sharing why you’re interested and how your experience aligns with Skift.

Skift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of travelers around the world.

If selected, a Skift team member will reach out to schedule next steps.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across voice, email, and enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z and Base10 with over $60M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. About The Role

At HappyRobot, our partners are a core growth engine — but only if we're rigorous about which opportunities we chase and disciplined about setting partners up to win.

We're looking for a Partnerships Strategy & Enablement Lead to build the system that turns raw partner-sourced opportunities into a prioritized, well-scoped pipeline, and to build the enablement that lets partners qualify, sell, and deploy on their own.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of strategy, commercial structuring, and partner operations. You'll be the person who decides what's worth pursuing, builds the case for it, and makes sure it actually gets delivered.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it's not "your job." If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don't wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for "just fine." We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it's a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody's watching.

We are "majos"

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. "Majo" is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We're building something ambitious, and it's easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We're running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; 'exceptional performance is the passing grade.' Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that's how we win.

First-Principles Thinking 

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don't copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It's how we build what others think is impossible.

description:
About the job

Junior Strategist 

Remote · Reports to Pod Leader/YouTube Strategist

Knwn Local 

Apply now: https://righteous-chestnut-b59.notion.site/dbf353fd5db582eca4790187f228454a?pvs=105




About Knwn Local: We build organic content brands for real estate agents. YouTube channels, email newsletters, social content. Full service, done for you. We work with 100+ agents across North America and we are scaling fast. Our clients close $10M to $1B+ in sales a year and many of them call their channel the best marketing investment they have ever made. We are scaling from 100 clients toward 300, then 1,000+, and the team has grown past 65 people on the way there.




Role: The Jr. Strategist exists because a Pod Leader cannot run 15+ channels alone. The ideas have to be found, the briefs have to be built, and the scripts and thumbnails have to be reviewed before anything reaches a client. That is this role.




You work directly under a Pod Leader who owns the client relationship, leads the strategy calls, and has final say on everything. Your job is to own the work that makes their job possible. The stronger your briefs, the sharper your reviews, and the more you understand each client, the better the pod performs.




This is also a team role. You are working alongside writers, editors, and designers who are all building toward the same goal. How the content performs is tied to what you bring.




Responsibilities

Handle ideation for 15+ channels. Research ideas, find outliers, write title options, build the thumbnail concept and direction, write the logline, and complete the video outline.
Review every script before it reaches a client. Check the hook, the CTAs, and the conclusion. If something is off, fix it or flag it clearly.
Review every thumbnail before it is finalized. Evaluate the concept, the strategy, and whether it earns the click. If the direction is wrong, say why.
Be on every client call with your Pod Leader. Take real-time notes, add ideas into Notion as the conversation happens, and have a clean action item list ready when the call ends.
Show up to team meetings knowing your numbers and ready to contribute.




Results

60%+ of all ideas for your team are created by you
90%+ of ideas you create are approved by the Pod Leader on the first pass
90%+ of scripts reviewed before they reach a client
90%+ of thumbnails reviewed before they ship
Brief quality improves consistently over time, tracked through Pod Leader feedback




Requirements

Built and managed content across multiple channels or clients simultaneously, where the details were yours to get right
Developed a repeatable ideation process using data, not just gut feel -- can walk through how they find outlier ideas and what makes them confident in one
Reviewed creative work (scripts, thumbnails, or similar) before it reached an audience and caught problems others missed
Worked inside a team-based production environment where missing a deadline affected other people downstream
Can demonstrate a real understanding of YouTube: how videos get traction, what makes a hook land, and how a video generates a lead




Who This Is For: This role is genuinely creative. You are coming up with ideas for 15+ channels every month and those ideas have to keep working for each client over time. You are not just generating volume. You are staying curious about what is performing, watching what other channels are doing, and bringing back ideas that are actually good.




You also have to be organized. There is a lot of independent work here and none of it waits for someone to remind you. You are tracking briefs, reviews, and deadlines across multiple clients at once.




If you like doing deep research, get genuinely excited about finding a concept you know is going to work, and can keep that level of attention across a full client load, this role will feel like a good fit.




It's not for you if you need a lot of direction to get started, want to be making final decisions right now, or do not want to work closely as part of a team.




Schedule: Monday through Friday, core hours aligned with 8am to 5pm Eastern. Some client calls may require flexibility within that window. (Some hours are flexible based on timezone)




Location: Fully remote. Open to candidates internationally




Compensation: $36,000 to $42,000 base salary depending on experience. Reviewed annually. Compensation grows with performance. We are building a performance model where hitting your numbers and continuing to take on more gets rewarded directly. All positions start with a 30 to 90 day paid trial.




Our Core Values

Relentless Curiosity - Learning never stops. You enjoy growth personally and professionally.
Kind Candor - Honest feedback both internally and externally is a gift we gladly receive.
Extreme Ownership - Be the type of person people can always count on, both internally and externally.
Operational Excellence - Be the person who spots what is broken and makes it better.




How to Apply: 

Apply here: https://righteous-chestnut-b59.notion.site/dbf353fd5db582eca4790187f228454a?pvs=105




Pay $36K to 42K USD a year

About the job




We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Junior Event Coordinator to support the planning and execution of client-facing and internal events. This role will work closely with the Event Planner to coordinate logistics, manage vendors, and ensure seamless event delivery from planning through post-event follow-up.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about events, detail-oriented, and eager to gain hands-on experience in high-impact, professional environments. This position supports the execution of high-profile, premium events, requiring strong attention to detail, professionalism, and a polished approach to client experience.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Event Planning & Coordination

Support end-to-end execution of events (in-person and virtual), including seminars, client meetings, and regional events
Assist in creating and managing detailed event timelines, checklists, and trackers
Coordinate logistics such as venue setup, catering, AV, transportation, and materials

Vendor & Supplier Management

Liaise with vendors (venues, catering, AV, printing, transportation) to confirm services and timelines
Track contracts, invoices, and payment follow-ups
Ensure all deliverables meet quality and brand standards

Operational Support

Maintain attendee registration lists and track confirmations
Support the preparation of event materials (agendas, name badges, signage, presentations)
Assist in managing on-site execution, including registration desk and attendee experience

Administrative & Reporting

Track event budgets and expenses in coordination with the Event Planner
Organize documentation (invoices, contracts, post-event reports)
Support post-event reporting, including attendance, feedback, and key metrics

Communication & Coordination

Coordinate with internal stakeholders (sales teams, marketing, leadership) to ensure alignment
Assist in drafting logistics emails and communications to attendees and vendors
Proactively follow up on action items to keep projects on track

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Event Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Experience supporting premium, luxury, or high-end events is highly preferred
2 years of experience in event coordination, hospitality, or administrative roles
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Excellent communication skills in English and Spanish 
Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)




Professional Presence

Excellent personal presentation and professional demeanor are required, particularly when interacting with clients, senior stakeholders, and during on-site event execution.

Preferred Skills

Experience supporting corporate or client-facing events
Familiarity with budget tracking and expense management
Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to anticipate needs
Team player with a proactive and flexible attitude




Working Style

Highly detail-oriented and execution-focused
Comfortable with hands-on support during events (including occasional travel if needed)
Ability to work independently while staying aligned with the Event Planner

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

At DiDi, we are building something special, and we want the world to know it. We believe in creativity, connection, and the power of a killer digital strategy. We’re looking for a creative, internet-obsessed, and driven Social Media Intern to join our Regional Social Media Marketing team.

If you live on TikTok, know exactly why a specific audio is trending, and understand how community drives brand loyalty, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

In this role, you'll be...

As our Social Media Intern, you won't just be fetching coffee or scheduling boring posts. You will be in the driver’s seat of our community presence, helping us scale our hyper-local footprints and collaborating with incredible creators. You will work closely with our core marketing team and external agency partners to turn big ideas into viral realities.

Key Responsibilities


Community Management: Be the voice of our brand. You’ll engage with our followers, spark conversations, and turn casual scrollers into brand evangelists.
Influencer Marketing Management: Source, approve and review local and macro-influencers. You'll manage the outreach pipeline and ensure creators deliver content that hits the mark in partnership with our influencer agency. 
City-Based Campaigns: You will assist in brainstorming and executing hyper-targeted, city-specific campaigns to build local buzz and offline-to-online engagement.
Agency Coordination: Act as a bridge between our internal team and our paid media agency. You'll help coordinate our boosting/paid social efforts to ensure our top-performing organic content gets the budget it deserves.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Unapologetic Passion: You genuinely love social media and influencer culture. You understand the nuances of different platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) and what makes content shareable.
A Creative Mindset: You can spot trends before they hit the mainstream and know how to adapt them to a brand voice.
Organization Skills: Juggling multiple influencers and city campaigns requires a sharp eye for detail and great time management.
Analytical Curiosity: Note: While basic knowledge of social analytics is a massive plus to help us track our social media impact, it is not mandatory. We are more than happy to teach you the ropes if you bring the data-curious mindset!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

About The Job

Are you passionate about transforming customer data into meaningful consumer experiences? As a Product Owner – CRM & Customer Data, you will lead the strategy and evolution of critical marketing technology products that power customer engagement, personalization, identity management, and data activation across digital channels.

In this role, you will own the roadmap, backlog, and value realization of CRM, Customer Data Platform (CDP), and Identity Management capabilities. Working at the intersection of business, data, and technology, you will help create seamless, trusted, and personalized consumer experiences while enabling scalable growth through first-party data.

You will partner with cross-functional stakeholders across marketing, digital, analytics, technology, privacy, and customer engagement teams to ensure data-driven capabilities deliver measurable business impact.

About You What You’ll Do


Define and execute the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for CRM, Identity Management, and CDP platforms. 
Prioritize features, enhancements, and user stories that maximize business value and customer outcomes. 
Drive consumer data unification, segmentation, profile orchestration, and activation initiatives. 
Collaborate with technical and business teams to deliver scalable, compliant, and high-quality digital solutions. 
Establish and monitor key product and data quality metrics, including profile accuracy, match rates, completeness, and activation readiness. 
Support customer lifecycle, retention, and personalization use cases through trusted first-party data strategies. 


About You

You are a customer-focused product professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and turning data capabilities into tangible business outcomes. You combine strategic thinking with strong execution skills and can effectively navigate cross-functional environments where business, technology, and privacy considerations intersect.

Must-Have Qualifications


Experience leading digital products as a Product Owner, Product Manager, Sr. Product Analyst, Martech Product Owner, or similar role. 
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, backlog management, prioritization, and user story development. 
Hands-on experience with Customer Data Platforms, particularly Treasure Data CDP or similar solutions. 
Solid understanding of CRM ecosystems, consumer engagement programs, customer lifecycle management, and personalization strategies. 
Knowledge of identity management concepts, including profile unification, identifiers, account linking, and recognition models. 
Familiarity with customer data architectures, event-driven data models, and digital activation ecosystems. 
Experience working with tools such as Jira and Confluence. 


Nice-to-Have Qualifications


Understanding of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, or Tag Commander. 
Exposure to Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe DAM, Salsify, or related digital experience platforms. 
Knowledge of APIs, data integrations, governance frameworks, and access management principles. 
Experience working within first-party data, consent-aware marketing, and privacy-conscious digital environments. 
Portuguese language skills. 


What Makes You Successful


Strong business acumen and customer-centric mindset. 
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills. 
Ability to balance technical, commercial, and compliance considerations. 
Analytical thinking with a focus on measurable outcomes. 
Comfortable working in dynamic, cross-functional, and fast-paced environments. 
Proactive, structured, and accountable approach to product ownership. 


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Marketing, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.

About Us

At Danone Mexico, we work with a deep conviction people's health and the health of the planet are connected. Under our global vision One Planet. One Health., we build a healthier future through food and beverages that are part of the daily lives of millions of families worldwide.

In Mexico, with more than 15,000 employees, 35 plants, and over 100 distribution centers across the country, we are a diverse and highly committed community driving iconic brands such as Danone, Activia, Oikos, Danonino, Bonafont, and Silk. Every person who joins us brings a key piece to continue evolving and innovating.

At Danone, you will find an environment where you can grow with purpose and be authentic. We value what each person contributes, and it is this combination of experiences, talents, and perspectives that strengthens our culture and drives us to achieve extraordinary results. Here, you will have the freedom to propose, create, and bring ideas to life that generate real impact.

We foster your development through continuous feedback, clear objectives, agile methodologies, and learning tools designed to accelerate your professional growth. We want you to move forward with confidence and find a path that inspires you. Your well-being is also fundamental to us. That’s why we offer flexible benefits, comprehensive health programs covering physical, emotional, and financial well-being, support platforms, exclusive discounts, and benefits above the legal requirements—supporting you at every stage of your life.

We are proudly a B Corp certified company, reflecting our commitment to responsible practices, conscious decisions, and a positive impact on people, communities, and the planet.

If you are looking for a place where you can contribute, grow, and be part of a community driven by purpose, we invite you to explore our opportunities and discover for yourself everything you can build at Danone. Your next big professional step could start here.

description:
About the job

Descripción de la empresa

Sobre Syngenta 

Syngenta es un líder mundial en innovación agrícola con presencia en más de 90 países. Nos enfocamos en desarrollar tecnologías y prácticas agrícolas que empoderen a los agricultores para alimentar a la población mundial mientras preservan nuestro planeta. Nuestros descubrimientos científicos ofrecen mejores beneficios para los agricultores y la sociedad a una escala sin precedentes. Guiados por nuestras Prioridades de Sostenibilidad, desarrollamos nuevas tecnologías y soluciones que ayudan a los agricultores a cultivar plantas más saludables en suelos más sanos con un mayor rendimiento. Syngenta Crop Protection tiene su sede en Basilea, Suiza; Syngenta Seeds en Estados Unidos. Lee nuestras historias y síguenos en LinkedIn, Instagram & X.

Descripción del empleo

En Syngenta, nuestro objetivo es construir el equipo más colaborativo y confiable en agricultura, proporcionando semillas de alta calidad y soluciones innovadoras de protección de cultivos que mejoren el éxito de los agricultores. Para apoyar esta misión, el equipo de Crop Protection de Syngenta busca un Crop Marketing Lead – Mesoamérica con base en México. Este rol lidera la estrategia de marketing regional, traduciendo la visión comercial en planes concretos de go-to-market, precios y activaciones, con un equipo de 13 personas a cargo en México y CAC.

Responsabilidades 


Diseñar y ejecutar planes de marketing para CP en Mesoamérica: precios, go-to-market y activaciones.
Conducir el desarrollo del equipo (13 personas en MX y CAC): exigencia, claridad de objetivos e impacto.
Asumir la responsabilidad del P&L del área, desafiando planes de acción con base en resultados concretos.
Construir relaciones sólidas con distribuidores y ventas, con presencia activa en territorio.
Liderar la planificación estacional de campañas coordinando equipos locales y regionales.
Trabajar con BI para identificar oportunidades y riesgos del mercado agrícola y traducirlos en ajustes tácticos.

Experiencia comercial con foco en ventas o canales de distribución en el sector agro, con vivencia directa en campo y con distribuidores.

Más allá de solamente creer en el poder de la diversidad, Syngenta promueve una cultura inclusiva que abraza las diferencias en todas sus formas. About the job

About You:

Are you interested in launching or growing your career in digital marketing? The WITHIN team is expanding, and we’re looking for a Digital Media Buyer Trainee to support our efforts across multiple marketing channels. This role offers an opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop expertise in key areas of digital marketing, including Paid Social, Paid Search, Programmatic, Email Marketing, Affiliate Marketing, Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Influencer Marketing, and Retail Media.

As part of a fast-growing company, you’ll collaborate with internal teams and clients to drive performance-driven marketing strategies. This role is perfect for individuals who are analytical, creative, and eager to learn in a dynamic, deadline-driven environment.

What You’ll Learn:

This role will expose you to various marketing channels, helping you develop a strong foundation in performance marketing. Depending on the projects you work on, you may gain experience and training in:

Paid Social: Learn how to create and manage paid social campaigns on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn, focusing on targeting, budgeting, and performance analysis to drive engagement and conversions.
Paid Search: Understand how to create and optimize paid search campaigns on platforms like Google Ads and Bing, including keyword research, ad copywriting, and bidding strategies to maximize return on investment (ROI).
Programmatic: Gain insight into programmatic advertising, including working with demand-side platforms (DSPs) to buy display, video, and native ads at scale, optimizing for reach, engagement, and conversions.
Email Marketing: Learn how to craft compelling email campaigns, segment audiences, and optimize performance through testing and automation.
Affiliate Marketing: Understand how brands collaborate with partners to drive traffic and conversions through commission-based strategies.
Search Engine Optimization (SEO): Gain insights into optimizing website content and structure to improve search engine rankings and organic visibility.
Influencer Marketing: Explore how brands collaborate with influencers to build awareness, drive engagement, and generate conversions.
Retail Media: Discover how brands advertise on e-commerce platforms (e.g., Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, etc.) to increase product visibility and sales.




Some duties will include and are definitely not limited to:

Work with a diverse portfolio of clients to support their marketing efforts.
Communicate with clients via email and meetings, ensuring alignment on strategy and performance goals.
Collaborate with multiple internal teams to design and execute marketing strategies.
Produce meaningful marketing KPI dashboards and deliver performance reports with actionable insights.
Support A/B testing, consumer research, and data-driven decision-making to enhance campaign performance.
Assist in implementing best practices and proprietary technology to optimize marketing strategies.
Provide creative and copy recommendations.




Qualifications and Experience:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Interest in pursuing a career in performance-driven digital marketing.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel (e.g., conditional statements, pivot tables, VLOOKUPs).
Full professional proficiency (written and spoken) in English.

Our interview process includes, but is not limited to, the following:

Cognitive Aptitude and Typing Test
Logic assessment on Basic data analytics & problem-solving assessment

2-Month Paid Development & Probation Program

This role begins with a 2-month program designed to provide hands-on training and professional working experience, as well as serve as the standard employment probationary period. During this probationary period, you will be closely supervised by our staff and continuously assessed by to determine if you are competent and trustworthy enough to be a full Digital Media Buyer for WITHIN. Upon successful completion of this program, you will be staffed on a team to begin working on client accounts on an independent full-time basis immediately!

Note: Employment types may vary by country due to local labor laws, HR will clarify before employees start.




We offer a competitive salary and benefits based on ability level, including:

Base salary - 25k MXN
Unlimited vacation policy
Health insurance coverage
Food stipend
Internet/phone stipend
Dog friendly office
Professional Development Program
This is a fully in-office role based in Mexico City, Mexico. Candidates must be available to work on-site five days a week.
This is an entry level position. Training and development will be provided.

Note. Please submit your resume in English.

WITHIN is the world's first Performance Branding company, partnering with some of the biggest brands in the world to drive business growth through innovative marketing strategies. With a full suite of offerings including media, creative, SEO, Lifecycle, Retail Media, Affiliate and Influencer, we’re able to work with our brand partners in an integrated fashion, allowing us to align marketing strategies back to core business objectives. Document API interactions, endpoint behaviors, authentication requirements, and service dependencies.
Assist in defining API contracts, request/response structures, and integration error-handling models.

Work with development teams using Copado AI Agents to generate integration plans and development recommendations.
Validate AI-generated integration designs to ensure they align with business requirements and system architecture.
Provide oversight and business context to guide AI-assisted solution development.

Support backlog refinement and prioritization for integration initiatives.
Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria defining integration behaviors and system interactions.
Collaborate with development teams operating within Copado DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment processes.

Support integration testing and validation activities.
Develop test scenarios to ensure data integrity, system behavior, and error handling across integrated platforms.
Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders.

Maintain integration documentation including:

Data flow diagrams
API documentation
Integration runbooks
Support change management and communication related to integration deployments.







Qualifications




Experience working as a Business Analyst supporting enterprise system integrations
Strong understanding of API-based integration patterns and data mapping
Experience documenting integration requirements, system interactions, and interface specifications
Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams
Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies




Required Skills




Experience with Salesforce platform integrations
Experience with Microsoft Azure integration services
Familiarity with:

Azure Functions
Azure Logic Apps
Azure Service Bus
Experience working within Copado DevOps or CI/CD environments
Exposure to AI-assisted development tools such as Copado AI Agents
Salesforce certification, such as Salesforce Business Analyst or Administrator




Preferred Skills




Success in this role is defined by the ability to clearly define integration requirements, support scalable system interactions, and collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable integrations across Salesforce and enterprise platforms.

Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.

Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.

Familiarity with managing internal plant-to-plant supplier relationships within a global manufacturing organization.
Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.
Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles (kanban, PFEP, pull systems, standard work).
Experience with foreign supplier coordination, import logistics, or customs compliance basics.

About the job

Company Description

Do you want beneficial technologies being shaped by your ideas? Whether in the areas of mobility solutions, consumer goods, industrial technology or energy and building technology - with us, you will have the change to improve quality of life all across the globe. Welcome to Bosch!

Job Description

The Supply Chain Planner — Customer & Procurement manages material flow across the North American supply chain on behalf of Bosch customers, plant operations, and internal logistics. Depending on business needs and team structure, this role may be assigned to one or both of the following tracks: Passthrough (Customer) Planning or Procurement (Raw Material) Planning. Planners are expected to develop competency in both areas over time, enabling organizational flexibility as business requirements evolve.

Assignment Note: Individual planners will be designated to a primary track based on team structure and business need. This JD covers both tracks to support role mobility and cross-training across the planning organization.

Track A: Customer & Passthrough Planning

Procure finished goods from global Bosch supplying plants → Manage warehouse inbound → Fulfill OEM/Tier 1 customer demand

A1. Inbound Planning & Procurement from Bosch Supplying Plants


Generate and manage purchase orders and delivery schedules to global Bosch supplying plants based on customer demand and inventory targets.
Maintain 24+ months of rolling demand visibility in SAP and/or Kinaxis Maestro to support long-range capacity planning at supplying plants.
Coordinate with supplying plants on allocation priorities, capacity constraints, shortages, engineering changes, and EOP transitions.
Monitor inbound order confirmations and proactively escalate mismatches between confirmed and required quantities.
Maintain planning master data: lead times, MOQs, lot sizes, safety stock levels, and MRP controller assignments.


A2. Warehouse Coordination (Summerville, SC & Laredo, TX)


Coordinate inbound receipts, inventory positioning, and stock availability across North American warehouse locations.
Monitor and resolve blocked stock, MRP exceptions, and inventory discrepancies with warehouse operations teams.
Manage goods-in-transit (GIT) visibility and ensure timely clearance of open inbound deliveries.
Support warehouse operations through accurate ASN transmission, delivery scheduling, and outbound shipment prioritization.
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory in partnership with warehouse teams; develop disposition strategies.


A3. Customer Management & Order Fulfillment


Manage customer-facing planning for OEM and Tier 1 accounts across automotive, powersports, and commercial vehicle segments.
Process and validate customer EDI releases; ensure accurate system intake and timely order fulfillment.
Transmit and validate Advance Shipping Notifications (ASNs) through customer portals per customer-specific requirements.
Schedule outbound shipments and monitor deliveries through final customer destination.
Proactively communicate supply risks to customers with recovery timelines and viable alternatives.
Support shortage escalations with structured root cause analysis and corrective action documentation.


Track B: Procurement & Raw Material Planning

Translate production demand into supplier orders → Ensure uninterrupted material supply → Protect manufacturing continuity

B1. MRP-Driven Procurement Planning


Execute and manage MRP runs in SAP to generate planned orders and purchase requisitions based on production demand.
Convert MRP requirements into purchase orders or scheduling agreements aligned with supplier lead times and production schedules.
Maintain planning master data: MRP type, lot sizes, lead times, safety stock, reorder points, and MRP controller assignments.
Monitor and action MRP exception messages (expedite, defer, cancel) to keep supply plans aligned with evolving demand.
Maintain data governance standards in SAP for assigned material portfolio, including parameter integrity and proper controller assignment.


B2. Supplier Coordination & Order Management


Manage purchase orders and scheduling agreements with external suppliers, ensuring on-time delivery to plant locations.
Communicate demand requirements, changes, and escalations to suppliers in a clear and timely manner.
Monitor supplier delivery performance and proactively address shortages, late deliveries, and quality holds.
Coordinate with Purchasing and Supplier Quality on corrective actions, capacity constraints, and alternate source qualification.
Support new supplier onboarding and system configuration in ERP.


B3. Production Supply & Shortage Management


Monitor stock levels at point-of-use and receiving locations to ensure uninterrupted production supply.
Manage critical shortage situations with structured recovery plans communicated to plant operations and management.
Participate in shortage review meetings with structured updates on open issues and resolution timelines.
Coordinate expedited shipments when necessary; ensure premium freight is justified, approved, and documented.
Track goods-in-transit and ensure timely customs clearance for imported materials.


Applies to Both Tracks

Inventory Management & Optimization


Maintain inventory levels (DIO) in alignment with working capital and service level objectives.
Perform ABC/XYZ material classification and define inventory strategies based on criticality, demand volatility, and margin.
Identify excess, slow-moving, and obsolete inventory; recommend and execute disposition strategies.
Support safety stock reviews and planning parameter optimization on a defined cadence.
Manage inventory risk through product lifecycle transitions: new launches, engineering changes, and end-of-production.


Performance Monitoring & Reporting


Monitor and report KPIs relevant to assigned track: OTIF, backlog, premium freight, fill rate, supplier OTD, and DIO.
Analyze forecast vs. actual deviations to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
Prepare structured input for weekly shortage reviews, monthly business reviews (MBR), and customer/plant scorecards.
Develop root cause analysis and corrective action documentation for supply disruptions and service failures.
Use SAP, Kinaxis Maestro, and Power BI to maintain real-time planning and performance visibility.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement


Collaborate with Sales, Finance, Quality, and Purchasing to align supply plans with business priorities.
Manage premium freight requests through the iStar approval process; ensure spend is justified, documented, and minimized.
Contribute demand and supply input to the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process.
Identify and drive continuous improvement opportunities across planning processes, system usage, and cross-functional workflows.


Qualifications

Required - All Planners


Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field.
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in supply chain planning, materials management, or procurement within a manufacturing or distribution environment.
Hands-on SAP ERP experience at the transaction level (planning, purchasing, or inventory management context).
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis, reporting, and planning scenario modeling (pivot tables, XLOOKUP, etc.).
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable planning decisions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; ability to communicate professionally during escalation situations.
Results-oriented with strong ownership mindset, urgency, and attention to detail.
Flexible worker, operates well working both independently and in a team environment.


Preferred - Track A (Passthrough / Customer Planning)


Automotive OEM or Tier 1 customer experience (e.g., BMW, DTNA, Toyota, Ford, Harley-Davidson, BRP, Polaris).
Experience managing EDI releases, ASN transmission, and customer portal compliance.
Familiarity with managing internal plant-to-plant supplier relationships within a global manufacturing organization.
Experience with premium freight management and cost-reduction disciplines.


Preferred - Track B (Procurement / Raw Material Planning)


Working knowledge of MRP logic, BOM structures, and production planning fundamentals.
Experience with external supplier coordination and scheduling agreement management.
