title: PPC Specialist (Lead Generation, Home Services)
description:
About the job

About company

We are a fast-growing performance agency focused on lead generation for home-services brands. We value ethics, clarity, and measurable outcomes. The team invests in learning and avoids siloed hand-offs so people can own results end to end.




The role

Run PPC for a portfolio of home-services clients and be accountable for outcomes from onboarding through scale. The job blends in-platform execution with tagging, analytics, and client communication. You will work alongside teammates in data and client services rather than sitting in a narrow channel lane.




What you’ll do

• Plan, build, launch, and optimize Google Ads and Microsoft Ads for lead generation

• Join client calls, translate data into decisions, set expectations, and build trust

• Own measurement quality with Google Tag Manager, including data layer checks and debugging

• Use GA4, CRM-based attribution views, Looker Studio, and CallRail to assess performance and recommend changes

• Maintain hygiene, budgets, and a steady test plan; use scripts where helpful

• Collaborate with the existing account team during onboarding and share context with peers




What you’ll bring

• 3-4 or more years in PPC for lead generation, with solid home-services experience

• Strong English for a client-facing role; accents are welcome

• Hands-on strength in Google Ads or Microsoft Ads plus GTM, GA4, Sheets, Looker Studio, and basic CallRail usage

• Comfort reading closed-loop data and making decisions from CRM-sourced revenue

• Clear thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to move between strategy and execution

• Ability to align most working hours to the Central time U.S. day; typical weeks average 40 to 50 hours




Nice to have

• Experience with Google Ads scripts or simple automation

• Zapier or similar workflow tools

• Familiarity with Google Ads API concepts and partnering with data engineers

• Landing page tools such as WordPress, Unbounce, or Leadpages




Interview process

• Initial interview

• Paid audit task

• Follow-up interview to review your work

• Decision




Start date

As soon as possible, with respect for notice periods.




Schedule: Align most of your day to the U.S. Central work window; plan to overlap broadly between 7:00 a.m. and 7:00 p.m. CT

description:
About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

TopFoxx | Remote | Full-Time

 

Location: Remote (must work U.S. East Coast hours).

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Hours are flexible. We care about performance, not clocks.

Salary: $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.

Language: Perfect written and spoken English is required (this is non-negotiable), along with a deep understanding of U.S. culture, slang, and social media behavior.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned fashion startup reinventing the sunglasses industry with solution-oriented designs and bold branding. Since 2016, we have grown from a bootstrapped e-commerce brand into a global business serving hundreds of thousands of customers, backed by an engaged community of influencers and creators.

We are not here to follow trends. We create them. Our sunglasses are tangle-free, floatable, foldable, shatter-resistant, and sustainably made, and we are just getting started.

We are a small, lean, founder-led team of fewer than ten people, with only about three of us on marketing. That means there is nowhere to hide and no one to pass the work to. Everyone wears multiple hats, owns real outcomes, and what you build genuinely moves the company. We do not do slow. We move fast, we pivot often, and we only hire A-players who treat the business like their own.




The Role

You will be the main one. This is the person who owns influencer and affiliate marketing end to end at TopFoxx. You are not waiting for a manual or a list of tasks. You are expected to bring the strategy, bring the ideas, and then execute them yourself, fast.

This space changes daily. New creators, new trends, new platform rules. You have to move quickly, test constantly, double down on what converts, and cut what does not. We are not looking for someone who only posts and reports. We are looking for a real executor who is proactive, creative, and obsessed with one thing above all: profitable, converting partnerships.

This is a big opportunity, and we want to be honest with you: it is also real work. We already have a large base of affiliates and creators, but your job is to grow it, activate it, and make it far more profitable. This is not a coast-along role. You will be building, pushing, and problem-solving every single day. For the right person, that is exactly the appeal.

This is a high-ownership role with a direct path into leading the influencer marketing function as it scales.




Why This Is Worth It

Here is the honest pitch. This is not a maintenance job and it is not busywork. Influencer and affiliate marketing is one of the biggest growth levers we have, and we believe this channel can become a multi-million dollar engine for TopFoxx. We are looking for the person who can build that.

We reward outcomes, not hours. If you can show us you can grow this and drive real, profitable revenue, you grow with it. That means a clear path into leadership and compensation that reflects the results you create. The ceiling here is high for someone who actually delivers, and you will be able to point to a business you helped build, not just tasks you completed.

If you want to be a small piece of a big machine, this is not it. If you want real ownership, real upside, and to look back in a year knowing you built something that matters, keep reading.




1. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Program (Your Primary Focus)

This is the heart of the role and where most of your time and energy goes. The big one is affiliate. Your job is to make sure the affiliates are converting, the program is profitable, and the numbers in TikTok Shop Seller Center are strong and trending up.

Own TikTok Shop Seller Center day to day. Live in the dashboards, know your numbers cold, and make sure performance is healthy across GMV, conversion, and orders.
Make the affiliate program profitable. Track and grow GMV, revenue per creator, sample-to-sales ROI, and commission costs. Protect margin. Every dollar of product and commission has to earn its return.
Build and manage a pipeline of hundreds to thousands of active TikTok Shop affiliates, and keep them actually posting and selling, not just signing up.
Recruit high-converting creators and live sellers who know how to talk about product and drive sales, not just collect free samples.
Go live and sell yourself. You will host TikTok Lives, get on camera, and sell the glasses directly. Then you bring affiliates on, show them how it is done, and coach them to do the same.
Coordinate TikTok Live schedules with strong sellers, secure Spark Ads permissions, and optimize listings and content angles for maximum GMV.
Watch performance weekly. Scale top converters aggressively, and cut low performers fast.
Keep the data honest. No padded numbers, no inflated reporting. Decisions are only as good as the data behind them.




2. Instagram Influencers

Instagram is the second pillar. Here we work on gifting and affiliate only, so your skill is finding the right people and getting them to convert without a paid budget.

Source Instagram influencers who can actually sell, creators who understand product and know how to drive their audience to buy, not just post a pretty photo.
Run gifting-only and affiliate-only collaborations, and move creators from one gift to repeat posting to consistent affiliate sales.
Rebuild our existing relationships. We have lists of past and dormant influencers. A big part of this role is reigniting those relationships and turning old contacts back into active, converting partners.
Build genuine, consistent relationships so TopFoxx stays top of mind, through thoughtful, regular touchpoints across Instagram and DMs.




3. LTK, Affiliate Platforms & Onboarding Calls

The third pillar is affiliate-driven platforms like LTK, and just as important, getting on calls with creators. This role is not behind a screen all day. You have to be outgoing and genuinely good at talking to people.

Recruit and activate creators on LTK and other affiliate networks (Amazon, affiliate links) who are still actively driving commission-based sales.
Run weekly onboarding calls. You will be on calls regularly, onboarding new influencers, walking them through the program, and getting them excited and set up to post.
Get on calls and close collabs. Be confident and persuasive, build rapport quickly, and convince creators to say yes to working with us, often with gifting only.
Understand creator psychology and motivate influencers to post consistently through relationship, community value, and a clear win for them.




4. Strategy, Reporting & Full Influencer Marketing Scope

Because you own this function, you also handle everything a strong e-commerce influencer marketing lead would handle. Study what bigger e-commerce brands do, then adapt the best of it to a lean, fast-moving team.

Build the strategy. Bring a clear point of view on where influencer and affiliate marketing is going and how TopFoxx wins, then put it into action.
Plan and execute campaigns tied to product launches, holidays, seasonal moments, and major sales events (BFCM, summer, new drops).
Manage content calendars, gifting coordination, sample sends, and follow-ups so nothing slips.
Build weekly performance reports that connect activity to revenue, and use them to decide what to scale and what to kill.
Create simple SOPs, trackers, and playbooks as you go, so the program is repeatable and scalable as the team grows.
Collaborate with the creative, marketing, and product teams to keep messaging aligned, and step in on urgent launch-related projects when needed.
Stay ahead of trends, new creators, and new affiliate opportunities before competitors do.
Help with wider marketing as needed. With a team this small, marketing is just three people and everyone pitches in. From time to time things will come up across other marketing areas and departments that need a hand. We need someone proactive and solution-oriented who brings energy, jumps in, and helps build this with us rather than sitting idle.




Who You Are

Proactive: You see the gap and fill it. You bring the plan, you do not wait to be told.
A real executor: You move fast, ship daily, and adapt as things change hour to hour.
Analytical and profit-obsessed: You can read a Seller Center dashboard, understand ROI and margin, and turn data into decisions.
Persuasive and outgoing: You love talking to creators, you are comfortable on camera and on calls, and you can sell the partnership and the product.
Relationship-driven: You are a natural connector who builds loyalty and keeps partners coming back.
Organized under pressure: You can juggle hundreds of moving pieces without dropping the ball.




Required Experience & Skills

2+ years in influencer or affiliate marketing, preferably in fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or e-commerce / DTC.
Expert, hands-on knowledge of TikTok Shop Seller Center mechanics and affiliate programs.
Proven track record of generating real sales through gifting-only or zero-budget strategies.
Comfort with LTK, Amazon, and other affiliate platforms.
Comfortable on camera and hosting TikTok Lives to sell product directly.
Perfect written and spoken English, and a strong understanding of U.S. culture and digital trends. This is genuinely important.
KPI-driven, highly organized, and able to build simple systems and SOPs as you scale.




What You Get

Salary of $1,500 to $2,000 per month based on experience, plus performance bonuses tied to affiliate revenue and profitability.
A fully remote role on a fast-moving global team.
Real ownership of the influencer and affiliate function, with a path into leadership as it scales.
PTO including vacation, holidays, sick, personal, and mental health days.
Free TopFoxx products and partner brand perks.

About the job

This position is 100% remote for Mexico, Columbia, Venezuela and Guatemala, Argentina, Honduras, DR, Brazil applicants. Not a US based post. The hours are 10am-7pm MST and includes one Saturday a month from 8-5 MST.

About Us

The Savings Group (TSG), the parent company of RateGenius, AUTOPAY and Tresl, is the most diversified consumer marketplace for automotive finance, refinance, and protection plans. Through a network of more than 180 lenders across all 50 states, TSG provides consumers more choices for their origination and refinanced auto loans, while also delivering loan volume growth to its lender network and partners through a proprietary, web-based platform.

Why Work at The Savings Group?

Working at TSG is more than your standard J-O-B. That's because we work with some of the most amazing goal-oriented and driven people in fintech and still embody the spirit of a startup! Not only have we worked together to perfect the way we serve our customers, but we've built a pretty awesome culture in the process. Our people come from all kinds of backgrounds to create something exciting and new: A BETTER WAY TO DO CAR LOANS. We offer steady growth, a strong and supportive leadership team, and in-depth training and tools to ensure your success.

Summary

The Customer Success Representative Level I ensures that customers receive wonderful customer service in all aspects when taking care of the customers. This includes any and all customers that are calling in to inquire regarding potential vehicle purchases, refinances or questions regarding open applications and so forth. Customer Success maintains all overflow through TSG phone systems and is the start of the TSG journey for all our customers throughout all of its brands. Customer Success Representatives Level I are required to answer all phone calls received, respond to customer inquiries, complete customer applications either over the phone or via text/email, and send emails to the correct corresponding departments as needed to resolve customer complaints. This includes internal transfers as well as maintaining Legal and Compliance concerns when completing applications as well.

About the job

HireLatam is a premier recruitment agency that places top Latin American talent in independent contractor roles in US companies. With a proven track record and a commitment to excellence, we're your trusted partner in the pursuit of career success. Our extensive network, personalized approach, and supportive guidance ensure that you're in the best hands to find your next job opportunity.

 

Job Title: Remote Customer Experience Lead - Cleaning Services (100% Work From Home) 

 

Location: Remote from Latin America

 

Position Type: Full Time

 

Salary: $1,700 USD/month + incentives/bonus compensation

 

Schedule: Monday-Friday, 7:30 A.M to 4:30 P.M, Central Day Time (CDT).

 

 

Position Overview:

 

Our Client provides premium, recurring residential cleaning and specialty home services to high-end homeowners throughout the United States. Operating with professionally trained field employees, advanced tracking software, and an unwavering commitment to operational excellence, they have built a reputation for delivering a luxury-tier customer experience. They are scaling quickly and are focused on establishing a robust, high-performance customer support ecosystem.

 

The Role

 

Our Client is seeking a high-caliber Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator who serves as the primary point of contact for customers and prospective customers. This role is responsible for front-line customer communication, customer scheduling, lead follow-up, quoting, sales support, and timely, professional communication throughout the customer relationship.

This position reports to the Customer Experience Leader and works closely with the Operations team. Customer Service owns the customer relationship and communication, while Operations owns service delivery, scheduling strategy, quality, and field execution.

The Customer Experience Leader provides coaching, process guidance, and support for escalated customer situations, complex sales opportunities, and SOP ownership.

The ideal candidate enjoys helping people, solving problems, staying organized, and following through. They communicate proactively, work well inside structured systems, and take pride in making sure customers know what is happening and what to expect.

Document, verify, and maintain records of any applicable third-party broker commissions associated with customer orders, ensuring accuracy and audit readiness.

2. Customer Outbound Logistics

Monitor shipment progress from dispatch through final delivery, providing timely, proactive updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Coordinate closely with freight brokers, carriers, and warehouse partners to schedule shipments, resolve transit issues, mitigate delays, develop contingency plans to minimize customer impact.

About the job

EL EQUIPO

El equipo de Universe forma parte del ecosistema de Ticketmaster y está enfocado en ofrecer soluciones innovadoras de venta de boletos para eventos de admisión general, complementadas con estrategias de marketing digital que impulsan el alcance, engagement y conversión de nuestros clientes.




DESCRIPCIÓN DEL CARGO

Buscamos un Ejecutivo/a de Servicios Digitales para Universe, nuestra plataforma enfocada en eventos de admisión general, que combine la venta de boletos con soluciones estratégicas de marketing digital. Esta posición será responsable de asesorar a clientes (promotores, venues y organizadores) para maximizar el desempeño de sus eventos a través de herramientas digitales y acompañamiento consultivo.




Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar en un puesto que combina tecnología y marketing digital impactando directamente en la venta de boletos y en la experiencia de nuestros clientes.







LO QUE HARÁS

Asesorar a clientes sobre el uso las soluciones de marketing digital de para maximizar la venta de boletos.
Ejecutar reuniones consultivas con organizadores e inmuebles para entender sus necesidades y proponer estrategias digitales.

LO QUE NECESITAS SABER (o HABILIDADES TÉCNICAS)

Te adaptas a entornos dinámicos y de rápido crecimiento.
Actúas con ética y responsabilidad en todas tus interacciones.




VIDA EN TICKETMASTER

Nos enorgullece formar parte de Live Nation Entertainment, la empresa de entretenimiento en vivo más grande del mundo. Nuestra visión en Ticketmaster es conectar a las personas alrededor del mundo con los eventos en vivo que aman.

Como el mercado de boletos más grande del mundo y el proveedor global líder de herramientas y servicios para la industria del entretenimiento en vivo, estamos en una posición única para cumplir con esa visión.

Lo hacemos todo con una pasión intensa por el entretenimiento en vivo y una cultura inspiradora y diversa, impulsada por líderes accesibles, gerentes atentos y equipos entusiastas. Si te apasiona el entretenimiento en vivo como a nosotros, y deseas trabajar en una empresa dedicada a ayudar a millones de fanáticos a vivir esa experiencia, queremos saber de ti.

Nuestra labor se guía por nuestros valores:

Fiabilidad: Entendemos que los fanáticos y clientes dependen de nosotros para hacer posible sus experiencias en eventos en vivo, y nosotros dependemos los unos de los otros para lograrlo.
Trabajo en equipo: Creemos que el logro individual es insignificante en comparación con el éxito que se puede lograr en equipo.
Integridad: Estamos comprometidos con los más altos estándares morales y éticos en nombre de los innumerables socios y partes interesadas que representamos.
Sentido de pertenencia: Estamos comprometidos a construir una cultura en la que todas las personas puedan ser su yo auténtico, tengan voz igualitaria y oportunidades para prosperar.







OPORTUNIDADES IGUALES

Estamos apasionados y comprometidos con nuestra gente, y vamos más allá de la retórica sobre diversidad e inclusión. Trabajarás en un entorno inclusivo y se te alentará a ser tú mismo en el trabajo. Haremos todo lo posible para ayudarte a equilibrar exitosamente tu vida laboral y personal. Como negocio en crecimiento, fomentaremos que desarrolles tanto tus aspiraciones profesionales como personales, disfrutes de nuevas experiencias y aprendas de las personas talentosas con las que trabajarás. Nos importa el talento, y alentamos las postulaciones de personas sin importar su género, raza, orientación sexual, religión, edad, estado de discapacidad o responsabilidades familiares.




PRÁCTICAS DE CONTRATACIÓN

La descripción del puesto anterior ha sido diseñada para indicar la naturaleza general y el nivel del trabajo realizado por los empleados dentro de esta clasificación. No está destinada a contener ni a interpretarse como un inventario exhaustivo de todas las funciones, responsabilidades y cualificaciones requeridas para los empleados asignados a este puesto.

Las políticas de contratación de Ticketmaster están diseñadas para incorporar a las personas más calificadas disponibles de manera oportuna y eficiente. Ticketmaster puede utilizar todos los medios disponibles, incluyendo la promoción interna, referencias de empleados, publicidad externa, agencias de empleo, reclutamiento por internet, ferias de empleo, reclutamiento universitario y head hunters. Ticketmaster puede utilizar herramientas de inteligencia artificial (IA) para apoyar la preselección y evaluación de candidaturas. Todas las decisiones de contratación se toman con revisión humana.

title: Spanish Language Expert - Remote
skills: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Spanish, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field.
Native or near-native Spanish proficiency with strong reading and writing skills.
Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English.
3+ years of professional experience in Spanish writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows.
Strong understanding of Spanish grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, accents, tone, register, formal/informal usage, and cultural context.

Comfortable handling Latin American Spanish and/or European Spanish, including vocabulary, voseo/tuteo/ustedeo usage, localization expectations, and audience adaptation. Candidates should specify which variant(s) they can support.

Ability to evaluate Spanish content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, incorrect register, missing accents, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology.

Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems.
Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation.

Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed.
Documentation: Create and maintain Spanish project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials.

Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Spanish-specific style requirements.
Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Spanish language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve.
Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Spanish-language projects.

You're wired for correctness: You also can't comfortably walk away from something that's half-finished or quietly broken. You notice when an output is subtly wrong, thin, or off-voice.
You learn by doing: You don't wait for perfect documentation; you take a stab, and when you get stuck you come back with a precise account of what you don't understand.
You teach yourself the frontier: You already poke at new tools, features, and techniques on your own time to see how far you can push them because learning is fun for you.

You want to own outcomes: You're the person who can see the fix and is frustrated by not having the authority to deliver. You want the accountability — not the title, the responsibility — and you understand that owning something means defining what success looks like and being measured against it.

You can understand what people actually need: Requests arrive messy and underspecified. You're good at translating "the client said X" into "here's what actually needs to happen," and triaging across tools and teams to make it real.
You do not need a finance background or a degree: You do need to be smart, curious, easy to work with, and genuinely interested in the problem.
Evals and traces — how we can measure whether an AI system is actually doing its job, and how we follow what it did, step by step.
GraphRAG / Hybrid RAG — how systems retrieve the right memory and context.
Auto-research loops — e.g. Andrej Karpathy's framing, or "Codex goals" and "Claude dreaming" as different takes on the same core idea.
You don't need to understand how it works. The bar is simpler and harder: can you grasp the value, and picture how you'd operate and wield these in practice?
description:
About the job

About Our Client:

Our Client builds institutional memory for investment firms and family offices. The judgment, decisions, and conversations that make a firm what it is mostly live in people's heads — and disappear when those people move on. We change that, working on top of the tools each firm already uses to turn how they operate into something the team can use, allocators can see, and the next generation can inherit.




The Role

This is a frontline operations role for an AI-native consulting practice. The founder owns each client engagement and sets the architecture. You keep the systems running and the clients well-served.

As AI lets very small teams deliver work that used to require very large ones, someone has to make sure the prompts, knowledge bases, capture routines, and recurring deliverables behind that actually work as intended.




What you'll do:

Frontline support: Be the first point of contact for client teams. Take in requests, respond, escalate to the founder when needed.
Diagnose the problem: Most requests won't come with clear specs. Figure out what the client actually needs and what the response should look like.
Update the tooling: Once you know the right response, go into Notion, Linear, Slack, Google Workspace, Claude, Fireflies, etc. and make it real. The work is configuration and curation.
Turn messy material into useful artifacts: Transcripts, email threads, scattered documents — read them, find the structure, produce a summary, decision log, brief, or procedure.
Steward the knowledge base: Keep each client's institutional memory layer organized, current, and trustworthy. Catch staleness, gaps, and drift before they compound.
Monitor quality: Review AI-assisted outputs on a regular cadence. Fix wrong-voiced or thin output and feed corrections back into the templates.
Document the system: Write the procedures and reference materials that let a client's team operate on their own.
Onboard new clients: Stand up tooling, ingest context, build initial structures, get routines running. Each onboarding makes the next one faster.




Who you are: 

AI operations didn't exist as a job a couple of years ago so we care more about how you're wired than what's on your résumé.

You're wired for correctness: You also can't comfortably walk away from something that's half-finished or quietly broken. You notice when an output is subtly wrong, thin, or off-voice.
You learn by doing: You don't wait for perfect documentation; you take a stab, and when you get stuck you come back with a precise account of what you don't understand.
You teach yourself the frontier: You already poke at new tools, features, and techniques on your own time to see how far you can push them because learning is fun for you.
You want to own outcomes: You're the person who can see the fix and is frustrated by not having the authority to deliver. You want the accountability — not the title, the responsibility — and you understand that owning something means defining what success looks like and being measured against it.
You can understand what people actually need: Requests arrive messy and underspecified. You're good at translating "the client said X" into "here's what actually needs to happen," and triaging across tools and teams to make it real.
You do not need a finance background or a degree: You do need to be smart, curious, easy to work with, and genuinely interested in the problem.




A Litmus Test (Read Before you apply):

This role is about operating and wielding advanced AI systems — not building them. You will not be asked to code or to derive any math. But you do need enough conceptual fluency to know what these systems are doing and when they're going wrong.

Before you apply, spend an afternoon — call it four hours — getting the gist of three things (YouTube is fine):




Evals and traces — how we can measure whether an AI system is actually doing its job, and how we follow what it did, step by step.
GraphRAG / Hybrid RAG — how systems retrieve the right memory and context.
Auto-research loops — e.g. Andrej Karpathy's framing, or "Codex goals" and "Claude dreaming" as different takes on the same core idea.
You don't need to understand how it works. The bar is simpler and harder: can you grasp the value, and picture how you'd operate and wield these in practice?




If, after an afternoon, you can honestly say, "I don’t know the inner workings, but I understand its purpose and how to use it," you’ll do great here. If it still feels unclear, a genuine effort, this might not be the right fit and that’s completely okay.

About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have


Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Renewals, Customer Success, Inside Sales, Sales Operations, or Contract Management (preferred).
Experience working with CRM tools such as Salesforce for opportunity management, forecasting, and reporting.
Experience supporting North America–based customers.


What We Offer

Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
Employee Assistance Program
Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a Solutions Consultant to be part of our Professional Services team to deploy cloud products and services for our customers. This person must be a hands-on, self-starter who loves solving innovative problems in a fast-paced, agile environment. The ideal candidate will have the insight to connect a specific business problem and Snowflake’s solution and communicate that connection and vision to various technical and executive audiences.

The person we’re looking for shares our passion for reinventing the data platform and thrives in a dynamic environment. That means having the flexibility and willingness to jump in and get it done to make Snowflake and our customers successful. It means keeping up to date on the ever-evolving data and analytics technologies, and working collaboratively with a broad range of people inside and outside the company to be an authoritative resource for Snowflake and its customers.

AS A SOLUTIONS CONSULTANT AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

As a Data Scientist / MLOps Consultant within Snowflake Professional Services, you will design and deliver machine learning and AI solutions for customers across a range of industries. This role focuses on helping customers implement scalable, production-ready solutions, including custom machine learning models, platform migrations, dashboards, GenAI applications, agents, and MLOps pipelines. Proficiency in SQL.

description:
About the job

Job Description

Sales Development Representative (SDR) – NetSuite

Resumen del Rol

El Sales Development Representative (SDR) es responsable de identificar, prospectar y desarrollar cuentas alineadas con el Perfil de Cliente Ideal (ICP) de NetSuite, generando conversaciones de valor que permitan identificar desafíos, iniciativas estratégicas y posibles oportunidades de transformación de negocio.

Como primer punto de contacto con potenciales clientes, el SDR ejecuta estrategias multicanal de prospección, diseña planes de contacto efectivos y agenda reuniones calificadas con tomadores de decisión. Su principal objetivo es generar Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) de alta calidad mediante un entendimiento profundo de los retos y necesidades del cliente, facilitando una transición exitosa al equipo de ventas para la posterior calificación de oportunidades.

Dependiendo de la función asignada, el SDR puede desempeñarse en modelos Inbound, donde su foco será recibir marketing qualified leads, calificarlos y desarrollar la cuenta con agilidad ("Farmer"), o Outbound, con un enfoque proactivo de apertura de mercado y generación de nuevas conversaciones ("Hunter").

Perfil curioso, con ganas de potenciar sus habilidades con nuevas herramientas de tecnología ( Inteligencia artificial). Preferible nivel de inglés conversacional.

Perfil del Candidato

Experiencia


 Preferible experiencia en prospección comercial, generación de demanda, desarrollo de negocios o ventas consultivas, preferentemente en tecnología, software o soluciones SaaS. 
 Preferible experiencia en prospección outbound y/o gestión de leads inbound. 
 Familiaridad con herramientas CRM y plataformas de prospección digital. 



Competencias Clave


 Mentalidad Hunter para roles Outbound y Farmer para roles Inbound. 
 Excelente capacidad de investigación y mapeo de cuentas. 
 Habilidades de descubrimiento y escucha activa. 
 Comunicación efectiva y capacidad para generar confianza con ejecutivos y tomadores de decisión. 
 Disciplina, organización y consistencia en la ejecución diaria. 
 Orientación a resultados y cumplimiento de métricas. 
 Curiosidad intelectual y aprendizaje continuo. 
 Capacidad para adoptar y aprovechar herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial en su proceso comercial. 



Indicadores de Desempeño (KPIs)


 Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) generados. 
 Oportunidades creadas a partir de SQLs transferidos. 
 Reuniones calificadas agendadas. 
 Conversión de prospectos a SQL. 
 Conversión de SQL a oportunidad. 
 Cumplimiento de actividades de prospección y planes de contacto. 
 Calidad de la información y documentación registrada en CRM. 



Lo que distingue a un SDR exitoso en NetSuite

Un SDR exitoso no se limita a generar reuniones; comprende profundamente el negocio del prospecto, identifica y documenta sus principales desafíos y construye el contexto necesario para que el equipo de ventas pueda desarrollar una conversación consultiva y convertir esa necesidad en una oportunidad real de negocio.

Responsabilidades Principales


 Identificar y prospectar organizaciones que cumplan con el Perfil de Cliente Ideal (ICP) de NetSuite. 
 Investigar cuentas, industrias y contactos clave para desarrollar estrategias efectivas de acercamiento.

About the job

Responsibilities

Team Introduction

CapCut, a ByteDance product, is a leading all-in-one video editing platform empowering creators worldwide. We’re expanding our vibrant LATAM community and seeking a talented specialist to drive content excellence and creator growth in this dynamic region.

CapCut Template is a feature that allows users to create videos quickly and easily by applying pre-designed editing formats. Users simply insert their own media to generate a customized final video.

These Templates Serve Different Types Of Users


 Content creators who professionally use social platforms and rely on templates to scale production and engage with trends.
 Professional videomakers, editors, and small businesses looking for practical, high-quality solutions for promotion and communication.
 Casual social media users who want to participate in trends or create fun videos without needing editing skills.



As a Content & Creator Operations Specialist, you will fuel CapCut’s growth in LATAM by scaling high-quality content, nurturing creators, and enhancing our content ecosystem. You’ll bridge data-driven insights, cultural trends, and creator empowerment to boost user engagement and platform revenue.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

 Build distinguishing advantages through strategic creator partnerships.

 Deep familiarity with LATAM social media and cultural trends; strong content sensitivity: ability to identify viral trends and emerging creators.
 Knowledge of short-video platforms and/or AI tools; basic video editing skills.

CapCut is an all-in-one video editing app that empowers creators to express themselves and transform videos into creative masterpieces. description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues 
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization 
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


* Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

¡TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Becario en Mercadotecnia para el área de Sports Marketing Connections

Ubicación: Ciudad de México (Santa Fe)

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español. TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, lo que impulsa su contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio.

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU. Nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente.

Dirigido a estudiantes que desean cumplir con sus prácticas profesionales o servicio social en un entorno corporativo, esta experiencia representa una excelente oportunidad para aplicar tus conocimientos en la práctica.

Esta experiencia formativa no contempla compensación económica, pero brinda acceso a procesos reales y acompañamiento profesional por parte de un equipo altamente capacitado.

¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo dinámico!

Acerca del puesto y equipo

Formarás parte del equipo de Sports Marketing Connections, encargado de diseñar flyers comunicando la transmisión de diferentes Shows Deportivos y Eventos Deportivos asi como dar seguimiento a campañas activas de los clientes confirmados. Este equipo trabaja de la mano con el equipo de ventas Televisaunivision y áreas internas para desarrollar propuestas creativas y asegurar la correcta ejecución de proyectos especiales.

Sobre ti

Como Becario en Sports Marketing Connections, apoyarás en la elaboración de comunicados internos para dar a conocer la información de transmisión de diferentes Shows y Eventos en vivo. Tendrás la oportunidad de aprender sobre procesos comerciales, seguimiento de campañas y elaboración de materiales gráficos de acuerdo a la campaña activa y comunicación de cada uno de los clientes.

Tu Día a Día Incluirá


Crear comunicados internos. 
Aportar ideas creativas para el desarrollo de campañas de clientes dentro de Shows y Eventos Deportivos.
Apoyar en el seguimiento de materiales gráficos de los clientes, de la mano de los editores. 
Buscar y recopilar testigos de las campañas.
Realizar búsqueda de “Patrocinadores Oficiales” de los diferentes torneos deportivos y equipos. 
Apoyar en el segumiento de la comercialización para eventos deportivos.


Tu deberías de tener


Estudiante de últimos semestres de Licenciatura en Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Publicidad o Diseño.
Manejo de paquetería Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) y app para edición de comunicados.
Actitud proactiva, disposición para aprender y buenas habilidades de comunicación.
Interés en desarrollar tu carrera profesional en el área deportiva.
Conocimiento de los diferentes deportes como LigaMX (Varonil / Femenil), La Liga, Box, NFL, F1, etc.
Disponibilidad para realizar tu servicio social o prácticas profesionales de manera presencial en Santa Fe.


Lo Que Te Ofrecemos

Experiencia práctica en una empresa líder en medios y entretenimiento

Experiencia práctica en procesos reales de adquisición de talento.

Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo y profesional

Oportunidad de desarrollo y aprendizaje continuo

Nuestro compromiso con la inclusión

TelevisaUnivision es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados serán considerados para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, nacionalidad, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

Univision es un empleador que ofrece equidad e igualdad de oportunidades. Todos los solicitantes calificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de sexo, identidad de género, orientación sexual, raza, color, religión, origen nacional, discapacidad, estado de veterano protegido, edad o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.

description:
About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive AdOps (individual contributor) who will:


Project manage creative specification requirements and digital asset delivery; coordinating timelines and leading communications with our agency partners. 
Responsible for accuracy and upkeep of our creative spec library making updates in accordance with industry specifications and/or publisher requirements. 
Lead the creation of campaign creative specs and asset tracker ensuring alignment with media plans. 
Maintain a high-quality standard for the Ad Operations department by overseeing Quality assurance of creative. Responsible for receipt, organisation, and QA of assets upon receipt and before launch, providing consultation when necessary. 
Monitor creative delivery to ensure time targets are met, including checking assets and providing troubleshooting support for trafficking issues related to creative, publisher implementation, and escalation to third-party vendors when necessary. 
Regularly meet with internal teams, external client partners and clients to provide updates on deliverables. 
Continually evaluate workflows and processes in order to streamline cross team functions while keeping us organised and efficient. 
Help to continually identify and implement opportunities for improvement within team processes, supporting systems and communication channels. 


Skills And Experience


BA degree from an accredited educational institution or equivalent experience 
2+ years experience in a project-based position in digital advertising (CM360 Knowldge is a plus) 
Preferable experience in advertising operations with demonstrable knowledge of ad serving 
Excellent English communication, problem solving, analytical skills and extreme attention to detail 
Well-developed organisational and project management skills, to ensure you can keep on top of your own and others workload and Experience working in a deadline-driven environment. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. 

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. 

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy ) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted. 

Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

Jr. Content Designer role is a specialist position focused on print, digital, or motion content materials design. A successful candidate must have a proficient understanding and functional capability with software used to create graphics and designs from scratch, as well as the ability to edit and manipulate creative assets. They will be responsible for developing and producing production ready graphics.

Additionally, the Jr. Brand Content Designer must be able to follow creative processes and produce various materials with full consistency. The Jr. Content Designer is also responsible for supporting the creative versioning of existing assets within our brand portfolio to meet customer and consumer needs.

Your Impact

As Jr. Content Designer your functions would consist of:


 Participate in brainstorming and concept development in a supporting role

 Use editorial skills to create compelling and mesmerizing visual presentations for internal Marketing use

 Deliver simple print artworks when needed.

 Be detail oriented, with an ability to prioritize, multitask, and stay organized while responding to quick requests.
 Learning and apply feedback to improve designs.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?

 Strong creative portfolio, available online or as a PDF.
 Proficiency in English.
 Basic knowledge of print design.
 Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, Blender and After Affects is considered a plus.
 1 year experience working with creative teams in agency or in-house agency environments is a plus.
 Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with a willingness to learn and develop new design skills.


If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs. 
Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning. 
Development programs according to Leadership skills.

Learning experiences with internal and external providers. 
We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others.

A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle.

About the job

Description

We are seeking a leader with procurement experience to strategically source Auxiliary equipment and services for fulfillment operations within CAPEX Equipment category. The person in this role will coordinate with several teams across Amazon and will interact with suppliers to satisfy organizational requirements. The position will work and partner with multiple teams to develop and execute robust category sourcing strategies, deliver savings, improve supply chain resilience and productivity across the category. The ideal candidate is a self-starter, and a creative, critical thinker with an strong motivation to learn. You must be an effective communicator and be able to work independently and as a leader of peers to generate high-quality work product in a collaborative, creative, ever-changing, and sometimes ambiguous environment.

Key job responsibilities


 Establish multi year category sourcing strategies, lead cross-functional strategic sourcing teams, negotiate with suppliers and execute contracts to optimize Amazon’s competitive position
 Drive appropriate relationships with category suppliers, with a principal objective of achieving the optimal solution and cost of ownership that meets the business’ goals supported by a culture of continuous improvement with performance benchmarks in use
 Manage category suppliers to proactively identify, monitor and optimize opportunities
 Act as a market intelligence provider regarding categories; anticipate strategic opportunities and keep key stakeholders informed
 Drive category suppliers in Supplier Relationship Management activities to mitigate risk, improve performance and add value to Amazon
 Identify, achieve and report on savings and value targets for category sourcing activities
 Align with internal customers and understand the business application of the category


Key Performance Indicators


 Earn the trust of key stakeholders to drive alignment with the business
 Create a robust category strategy in conjunction with internal customers to ensure there is a comprehensive, unified approach for the category.
 Achieve yearly cost saving or value targets appropriate to the category aligned with annual budget processes.
 Define and report on key metrics that measure effectiveness of supply and cost savings
 Champion AI workflows and procurement standards

As a CAPEX Equipment procurement leader at Amazon, you'll be at the forefront of driving value and innovation across our Customer Fulfillment network. You'll be constantly balancing short-term operational needs with long-term strategic goals, always with an eye on how your decisions impact Amazon's ability to delight customers.In this role, you're not just managing spend – you're shaping the future of e-commerce fulfillment. Your work will have a tangible impact on Amazon's bottom line and will play a crucial role in our mission to be Earth's most customer-centric company.

About The Team

We're seeking leaders to join our Global Procurement Operations (GPO) CAPEX Equipment Category Team where strategic thinking meets operational excellence to power Amazon's fulfillment network. As part of our diverse procurement team, you'll help manage critical categories that keep our vast logistics operations running efficiently.

What Makes Our Team Special


 Collaborative culture where innovative ideas thrive
 Data-driven decision making approach
 Opportunity to make significant impact on global operations
 Supporting one of the world's largest logistics networks


As we continue growing, we need leaders who can help raise the bar in category sourcing, procurement excellence and drive our fulfillment network forward with passion and purpose.

Basic Qualifications


 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
 2+ years of relevant strategic sourcing and category management in indirect categories such as professional services, support or maintenance spend, supply chain, forecasting, manufacturing, sourcing/procurement, or vendor management experience
 Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
 Bachelor's degree
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English
 1+ years of experience to detail/write/simplify prompts and have ability to leverage Amazon internal AI tools, flows and bots


Preferred Qualifications


 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience

 Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

description:
About the job

Description

Our Finance Operations team has built a transformational platform that replaced disconnected systems and streamlined financial processes. We're expanding our Mexico-based team and looking for finance professionals with strong technical aptitude, people who understand accounting and procurement fundamentals and can leverage automation tools and AI to do the work better, faster, and at scale.

Key job responsibilities

Why This Role Matters

You'll Join a Small Mexico-based Team Providing Americas Coverage For a Platform That Manages Substantial Marketing Spend Globally. Your Work Directly Enables


 Business teams to focus on content and marketing strategy instead of administrative tasks
 Finance leadership to make data-driven decisions with real-time visibility
 Accounting to close books faster with unprecedented accuracy
 Senior leadership to trust financial data for strategic planning
 You'll be the person who understands both the finance process and the technology that powers it ensuring purchase orders flow correctly, budgets reconcile, and the systems behind it work.


What You'll Do

Support Finance Operations with Technical Expertise. You'll manage purchase order workflows, budget tracking, vendor setup, and spend reconciliation, but you'll do it with a technical lens. You understand how the systems behind these processes connect, where they break, and how to fix or improve them. You'll be the bridge between "what finance needs" and "how the platform delivers it."

A day in the life

Day-to-day, This Means


 Managing purchase orders with accuracy and speed
 Tracking budgets and providing real-time spend visibility to business teams
 Reconciling financial data across systems and flagging discrepancies
 Ensuring compliance with procurement policies and accounting standards
 Supporting month-end close activities and accrual processes
 Being the go-to person when something in the workflow isn't working right


You'll experiment with and implement AI tools to classify transactions, flag anomalies, draft communications, and assist with reconciliation.

You'll stay current on emerging AI capabilities and identify where they can reduce toil in your day-to-day work.

You'll conduct monthly business reviews with marketing and industry teams across the Americas and partner with Finance, Accounting, Legal, and Global Procurement to resolve complex issues.

What Success Looks Like

Accuracy & Compliance: Transactions processed correctly, on time, with proper controls

Responsiveness: Business teams get fast, knowledgeable support on finance queries

Automation Impact: You measurably reduce manual work through workflows you build and maintain

Technical Reliability: The automations you build are well-documented, don't break silently, and fit cohesively into the team's broader platform strategy

Collaboration: Trusted partnerships across time zones and functions

About The Team

Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications


 1+ years of finance experience
 Knowledge of standard software including Excel, Access, Oracle, Essbase, SQL and VBA skills
 Bachelor's degree or above in accounting, information systems, finance, or equivalent
 Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English
 Demonstrated experience building automated workflows using any automation platform (make.com, Zapier, Power Automate, or similar)


Preferred Qualifications


 Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish
 Experience in modeling complex business scenarios
 Knowledge of accounting principles, processes, and entries
 Experience with monday.com (board configuration, automations, integrations)
 Experience with AI tools for productivity or data processing
 Fluent in Portuguese (written and verbal)

description:
About the job

Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

As Renewals Specialist you will manage a focused portfolio of customer accounts to ensure the renewal of support contracts. You will create high renewal rates by engaging customers and channel partners, communicating contract value, and removing friction from the renewal process.

As Renewals Specialist you will work through remote engagement (telephone, email, Gainsight, and CRM workflows) and partners with Customer Success, Sales, Channel, and Operations and Support teams. You will use Salesforce data and processes to manage renewals, forecast risk, and support we are recurring revenue and retention goals for North America–based customers

Your Responsibilities


You will manage a defined portfolio of accounts with a primary focus on renewing support contracts on time and in full.
You will engage customers and channel partners ahead of contract expiration to create seamless renewal outcomes. Sending notifications of renewal expiration to customers.
You will communicate contract coverage, renewal options, timelines, and the value of continued support services.
You will ensure renewals, working toward renewal rate, churn, and forecasting Indicators set by leadership.
You will use Salesforce to manage renewal opportunities, track progress, maintain accurate contract data, receive and send customer quotes, and support forecasting activities.
You will partner with Partner Success Managers to align renewal strategies with channel partners.
You will collaborate with Sales, Channel teams, Contracts, and Operations on pricing, terms, documentation, and renewal execution.
You will provide first-line support for renewal-related inquiries, including contract scope, pricing questions, and renewal logistics.
You will identify renewal risk early and escalate to ensure leadership visibility and proactive mitigation.
You will follow established Salesforce and renewal processes to ensure data quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
You will support our revenue retention and growth strategy by reducing renewal friction and improving the customer experience.


The Essentials - You Will Have


Bachelor's degree.


The Preferred - You Might Also Have

Generous Vacation

Proactivity and motivation.

Prioritization and working within the setting of “Context not Control”, with strong time management skills, and being able to work on multiple projects at the same time.
Being able to make informed decisions aligned with project needs

description:
About the job

Who We Are

GrowthAssistant connects top marketing and operations talent with fast-growing companies that depend on great execution to scale. Founded in 2021 and named by Forbes as one of the best startups to work at, we're a permanently remote team that runs on integrity, proactive candor, and a bias toward action — and we prioritize the human experience in everything we do. We hire for skill and for heart, and we invest in our people for the long haul.




The Opportunity

We are looking for a detail-oriented Lifecycle Marketing Specialist to join a high-growth brand and take ownership of end-to-end email campaign operations. In this role, you won't just be executing tasks; you’ll be a key driver of the lifecycle process—managing the content calendar, drafting creative briefs, and collaborating with brand and design teams to bring campaigns to life.




Operating primarily within Iterable, you will build, QA, and deploy sophisticated automated journeys and weekly campaigns designed to drive lead conversion, member engagement, and reactivation. If you are a proactive marketer who balances technical execution with strong project management and a data-driven mindset, we want to meet you.




What Your Day-to-Day Will Look Like

Campaign Operations: Build, QA, and deploy 3-4 weekly email campaigns in Iterable, focusing on audience segmentation, triggered sends, and automated journeys.
Calendar & Project Management: Manage the email content calendar using Jira to ensure all campaigns, briefs, and stakeholder approvals remain on schedule.
Creative Collaboration: Write creative briefs and partner with designers and copywriters to ensure all assets align with email marketing best practices.
Technical Execution: Build and edit templates using Stripo and use basic HTML to troubleshoot formatting issues within Iterable.
Performance Optimization: Conduct A/B testing and pull performance data to report on open rates, CTR, and conversion metrics, providing actionable recommendations for strategy.
Database Health: Maintain strict list hygiene, segmentation accuracy, and deliverability standards while ensuring full privacy compliance.
Process Growth: Assist in building new automated workflows and triggered campaigns from the ground up as the lifecycle program scales.




What You Bring

Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in lifecycle, CRM, or email marketing, preferably within a high-growth startup environment.
Platform Expertise: Strong experience with Iterable (preferred) or Braze. Proficiency in HubSpot or Klaviyo will be considered if you have deep automation and journey-building experience.
Strategic Mindset: A deep understanding of segmentation logic, customer lifecycle stages, and triggered campaign operations.
Content Coordination: Proven ability to manage creative briefs and coordinate timelines across internal brand and creative teams.
Technical Skills: Experience with email builders (Stripo, Taxi, or Stensul) and basic HTML for template editing.
Data Literacy: Ability to interpret email metrics and translate data into performance-improving strategies.
Communication: Excellent communication skills regarding timelines, blockers, and creative feedback.
Logistics: Ability to work US business hours and maintain high QA standards in a fast-paced environment.




Bonus Points if:

You have direct experience in healthcare, wellness, or membership-based brands.
You are an expert-level user of Stripo and Iterable.
You have familiarity with Power BI, SQL, or advanced reporting workflows.
You have experience providing creative feedback based on engagement data.
You have exposure to SMS or omnichannel strategy (a future need for this role).




What We Offer

At GrowthAssistant, you aren't just joining a company; you're joining a movement to redefine how the world’s best brands scale. We believe that the right talent, placed in the right role, changes everything - and that starts with how we take care of you.




We support your life inside and outside of work with a comprehensive benefits package:

Fully Remote: 100% Remote work environment, never fight traffic again
Health Coverage: HMO or Healthcare Stipend (depending on location) after 90 days of service
Time to Recharge: 7 Paid Holidays and up to 6 PTO days per year
Family First: Parental leave after 1 year of service




We offer additional incentives for go-getters and proven performers!

$25 monthly perfect attendance bonus
Performance bonus
Anniversary bonus ($100 at 1 year; $200 at 2 years)
Earn a $300 referral bonus for each candidate you refer who is successfully hired, and $500 when you help us identify and close a new opportunity with your client




Your Application Roadmap

You’ve applied, now let’s get to work. Here’s the play-by-play:

Step 1 Resume Screening: Our hiring team reviews your experience to see how your unique skills align with our high-growth roles.
Step 2 Recruiter Interview: If we believe we have a great client match, we’ll reach out to schedule a human-to-human chat to discuss your career goals, experience, and what makes you tick.
Step 3 Online Assessment: This is your chance to shine! You’ll complete a role-specific test, a personality assessment, and your official GA Profile Form so we can represent you.
Step 4 Match Interview: You’ll meet with one of our Senior Leaders for a deep-dive validation to ensure we’re matching you with the right opportunity. This is your moment to bring your A-game and really shine - it’s the final step for many of our roles!




Depending on the client, there are sometimes 2 additional steps:

Step 5 15-min Prep Call: We’ve got your back. Before the final round, your Recruiter will hop on a quick call to coach you, share insider tips, and ensure you’re 100% ready.
Step 6 Client Interview: You’ll meet the client to discuss how you’ll help them scale and succeed. Bring your metrics and be on your A-game - this is your last chance to make a great first impression!




Join our 100% remote global team today, and grow with GrowthAssistant!




GrowthAssistant is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.
