About the job

Please note this job advertisement is only available in Spanish. To view the job, select ‘Español - ES’ from the language selector in the page menu.

El BDM suele desplegarse para aportar valor a clientes con necesidades más complejas, p. ej., clientes P&A, W, PCS, PE, y se asigna a un equipo de Premier Relationship Managers (RMs). Aunque los RMs son responsables del proceso integral de asesoramiento y ventas con los clientes, el BDM les ayuda a comprender mejor a los clientes, a reunirse con ellos junto con los RMs cuando sea necesario, a formular recomendaciones adecuadas y a ayudar a los clientes a entender el valor y los riesgos de las soluciones disponibles.

En ocasiones, el BDM también puede impartir formación de producto para apoyar y ejecutar lanzamientos de nuevos productos, y liderar eventos de educación para clientes para ayudarles a adquirir un mejor conocimiento de los mercados financieros y de las soluciones financieras. El BDM también debe seguir el proceso de ventas basado en necesidades, ofreciendo a los clientes una experiencia patrimonial significativa y consistente y, en última instancia, una experiencia sobresaliente.

Responsabilidades principales


Fortalecer la imagen de HSBC como proveedor líder de soluciones patrimoniales, proporcionando a los clientes acceso a experiencia técnica avanzada en productos.
Apoyar a los RMs para aumentar la confianza de más clientes en las capacidades de HSBC y mejorar la efectividad y la calidad de las necesidades cubiertas para los clientes objetivo.
Asistir a los RMs y ayudar a cerrar ventas, profundizando y haciendo crecer las relaciones con los clientes mediante la identificación y el descubrimiento de necesidades, la identificación de soluciones patrimoniales relevantes y el análisis técnico, y apoyando a los RMs en la presentación y explicación de la(s) solución(es) al cliente.
Realizar revisiones de cartera con los RMs, evaluar la idoneidad de los productos y el impacto de cambios de mercado y regulatorios en los productos mantenidos por los clientes, según corresponda; identificar oportunidades y gestionar riesgos.
Acompañar a los RMs en 3 a 5 reuniones diarias con clientes y aportar asesoramiento e información basada en conocimiento técnico, actuando como segundo punto de contacto para los RMs en productos y soluciones específicas.


Conocimientos y experiencia


Mínimo de un año de experiencia laboral como especialista de producto o asesor/a financiero/a.
Sólidas habilidades de atención al cliente, con capacidad para ofrecer una experiencia destacada y soluciones basadas en necesidades.
Conocimiento profundo de soluciones y productos financieros complejos específicos, incluyendo conocimiento de mercados financieros, dinámicas socioeconómicas y requisitos regulatorios relevantes para los productos.
Amplia visión del mercado externo sobre condiciones de mercado, nuevas soluciones de producto y comprensión de la actividad actual de los mercados financieros.
Capacidad y experiencia demostradas para identificar correctamente las necesidades del cliente.
Habilidades sólidas para gestionar un proceso de ventas consultivo.
Sólida comprensión de los estándares globales de prevención de blanqueo de capitales (AML).
Trabajo en equipo y habilidades de colaboración.
Conocimiento de regulaciones de cumplimiento locales y del Grupo.
Especialización en una o más categorías de producto, p. ej.: Productos Estructurados/FX/Inversiones/Planificación Financiera/Jubilación/Protección/Hipotecas, etc.


Ofrecemos.

Contratación directa por parte del Banco.

Sueldo base, bono trimestral por desempeño, aguinaldo, prima vacacional, seguro de vida, seguro de gastos médicos mayores, créditos, descuentos en los productos del Banco, participación activa en programas de sustentabilidad/ responsabilidad social, descuentos en más de 9,000 establecimientos y un plan de carrera acorde a tus aspiraciones.

“En HSBC esperamos que nuestra gente se trate con dignidad y respeto, creando una cultura incluyente que promueva igualdad de oportunidades. Nuestros valores definen quiénes somos como organización y lo que nos distingue, valoramos la diferencia, avanzamos juntos, nos hacemos responsables de nuestras acciones, usamos el buen juicio, hacemos lo correcto y hacemos que las cosas sucedan”.

“En HSBC nos encontramos orientados a garantizar la igualdad de género y capacitación constante hacia nuestros empleados, así como a la protección de sus derechos laborarles y sociales”.

“En HSBC ofrecemos a nuestros colegas un mayor número de días para que puedan disfrutar al máximo su boda, cuidar al nuevo integrante de la familia, o vivir el duelo por la pérdida de algún familiar”.

Nuestro paquete de permisos con goce de sueldo está a la vanguardia en México.

Ahora tienes una razón más para ser HSBC y vivir con orgullo una cultura de bienestar integral, balance y auto cuidado”.

“¡Queremos que formes parte de nuestro equipo! ¡Descubre cómo es trabajar con nosotros!"

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grow dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs of external users and internal Stripe teams.

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

As an analyst on the Payments Health Operations team, you will be charged with monitoring and maintaining payments performance for Stripe’s largest users. This will include triaging, investigating, and responding to detected regressions in authentication and cost rates; providing in-depth analysis of performance degradations; answering queries from our product support and technical account management teams; and engaging with users and other teams at Stripe to help ensure our users are maximizing their acceptance rates while minimizing their costs and fraud.

You will work at the core of Stripe's platform, ensuring the reliability of our payments stack and the health of the broader ecosystem. Technical Operations roles in Payments are a dynamic and key component of Stripe's success. Focused on financial partner integrations and funds-flow expansion, we sit at the intersection of product/platform engineers and financial partners, connecting them to ensure that everyone thrives and nothing is lost in translation.

Responsibilities


Monitor authorization rates and performance for large users, responding to alerts of degradation, triaging and investigating the cause, and communicating your findings to the account team, banking partners, and card networks.
Analyze cost checkers to ensure our cost models' accuracy.
Respond to performance inquiries from technical account managers, product support teams, and other internal Stripe teams.
Interface with Stripe’s financial partners across the world to communicate operational breakages and help drive resolutions.
Provide fast, accurate responses to complex support inquiries from partners.
Partner with internal and external teams to validate the accuracy of Stripe’s financial data.
Introduce data and process efficiencies to meet the scale and speed of Stripe.
Identify and automate inefficient operational processes to reduce manual workloads.



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


Have at least 1 year of experience in a technical role, with experience writing SQL queries to query relational databases.
Have experience navigating the nuanced complexity of financial systems and solving large-scale, technical challenges.
Have strong analytical skills to investigate, prioritize, and identify the root cause of issues.
Have experience managing communications and workflows with technical and non-technical teams across internal and external stakeholders.
Are comfortable operating independently and thrive in a fast-paced environment to deliver results, with an ability to establish priorities and reliably execute against time-sensitive deadlines.
Have experience identifying and triaging technical issues.
Possess a demonstrated track record of process improvement and proactive problem-solving.
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.



Preferred Qualifications


Payments expertise (working with financial partners, optimizing processing errors, managing payment costs).
Experience operating in a high-growth technology company.
Python or Scala knowledge.



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

description:
About the job

Great companies don’t grow because they post more content. They grow because the right people notice them.




Every day, potential clients are scrolling, searching, and deciding who they trust.




The challenge isn't getting attention—it's turning attention into conversations, opportunities, and growth.




That's why we're looking for a Marketing & Growth Coordinator who can help us expand our reach, strengthen our brand presence, and create meaningful connections with future clients.




This is a hands-on, execution-focused role that combines content creation, audience growth, outbound marketing, prospect engagement, and first-touch client communication. You'll play a direct role in helping us generate inbound and outbound opportunities while supporting the growth of our business pipeline.




If you're someone who enjoys turning ideas into action, creating engaging content, building relationships, and helping businesses grow, we'd love to meet you.




What You'll Do

Drive Marketing & Growth Initiatives

Develop and execute marketing initiatives designed to attract new clients and increase company visibility.
Support pipeline growth through outbound campaigns, targeted outreach, and brand awareness efforts.
Identify and engage industries, markets, and niches aligned with company growth goals.
Help generate inbound business opportunities through consistent and strategic marketing efforts.
Contribute directly to company growth by creating opportunities that lead to new client conversations.




Build and Grow Our Social Presence

Manage and maintain company social media platforms, including LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant channels.
Create and publish high-quality content that showcases company activity, hiring successes, operational updates, and client outcomes.
Develop a consistent flow of written, visual, and video-based content.
Monitor engagement, interact with audiences when needed, and maintain an active online presence.
Help strengthen brand awareness and position the company as a trusted partner in the marketplace.




Execute Outbound & Inbound Marketing Efforts

Launch and manage outbound email and messaging campaigns tied to hiring activity, target industries, and company initiatives.
Build, organize, and maintain prospect outreach lists.
Handle inbound marketing inquiries and serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients.
Conduct first-touch discovery calls with potential clients.
Communicate professionally and confidently with U.S.-based business owners and decision-makers.




Create Content That Supports Growth

Develop marketing materials, including presentations, one-pagers, branded collateral, and other business development assets.
Coordinate simple video editing and content formatting.
Support company branding initiatives and ensure consistency across all platforms and materials.
Assist with branded materials, promotional items, and company marketing assets when needed.
Help tell the company's story through content that attracts, engages, and converts prospects.




Collaborate Across the Organization

Work closely with leadership and internal teams to align marketing efforts with company goals and priorities.
Gather updates, success stories, wins, and content from internal departments.
Support company-wide growth initiatives through consistent execution and follow-through.
Help ensure marketing efforts remain aligned with business objectives and growth targets.




What You Bring

Proven experience in marketing, social media management, outbound marketing, lead generation, or related fields.
Demonstrated success growing audiences, increasing engagement, generating leads, or supporting business development efforts.
Ability to showcase previous campaigns, audience growth results, content performance, or measurable marketing outcomes.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Confidence speaking with U.S.-based business owners and decision-makers.
Experience handling inbound inquiries and conducting initial prospect conversations.
Experience creating content across multiple platforms and formats.
Familiarity with social media management and outbound email marketing.
Basic video editing and content formatting skills are preferred.
Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and execute independently.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where initiative and follow-through matter.




Why This Role Matters

Every marketing campaign, social post, outreach message, and prospect conversation creates an opportunity for growth.

In this role, you'll help shape how our company is seen, how new clients discover us, and how opportunities enter our pipeline. Your work will directly contribute to brand visibility, lead generation, client engagement, and long-term business growth.




If you're excited about combining marketing, content creation, outreach, and relationship-building into a role where your work creates measurable impact, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Associate Managing Consultant, Advisors & Consulting Services, Marketing

ADVISORS & CONSULTING SERVICES

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. Our Advisors & Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard’s rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.

The Advisors & Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy & Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Marketing consultants lead the strategy development and implementation of campaigns and engagements for clients. They use customer data to provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, evaluating campaign results and adapting the approach to optimize marketing performance.

Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. At Pacvue and Helium 10, great careers don’t just happen — they’re built. Here, you’ll rise as an industry leader, push the boundaries of innovation, own your journey, and thrive as part of an inclusive global community that’s redefining the future of commerce.

About the Role:

Pacvue is seeking an experienced Office Manager to own the full operational and technical footprint of our fast-growing Mexico City location. This role is the operational backbone of the office — leading everything from facilities and IT coordination to employee experience programs and executive meeting logistics. The Office Manager operates with a high degree of independence, exercises sound judgment on day-to-day decisions, and is accountable for outcomes across the full site. Additionally, this role will take on broader administrative responsibilities that support the business at large.

Responsibilities:

Event & Meeting Management


Lead end-to-end planning and execution of all office events and meetings, including customer and partner engagements, board meetings, and executive offsites — independently managing logistics, agendas, materials, and stakeholder coordination. 


Office Operations


Own the day-to-day operational health of the office — including employee access, seating, tech setup, supply ordering, and maintaining a well-organized work environment and kitchen. 
Anticipate operational needs proactively and resolve issues independently, escalating only when the situation exceeds site-level authority. 


Employee Experience


Design and curate in-office programming — including team gatherings, happy hours, and community or volunteering events — with ownership over planning, execution, and continuous improvement based on employee feedback. 


Special Projects


Lead cross-functional special projects from scoping through delivery — including company swag programs managed in partnership with Marketing — making independent judgment calls on priorities, trade-offs, timelines, costing, and fulfillment. 


IT Coordination & On-Site Support


Serve as the primary on-site owner of IT operations, managing the full hardware lifecycle including shipping, receiving, inventory tracking, and asset management for employee devices, monitors, peripherals, and accessories. 
Independently handle IT setup and installation tasks — including monitor configuration, shared-use device setup, and workstation peripherals — for new and existing employees. 
Own routine maintenance and proactive health checks for shared-use IT equipment such as conferencing systems and cabling, resolving issues within scope and escalating only when remote ITSD support is required. 
Act as the authoritative on-site liaison between the Mexico City office and the ITSD for all non-standard IT issues, including local network disruptions and facility-level connectivity concerns. 
Independently assess, triage, and resolve IT security and access-related incidents in accordance with company protocols; escalate only when issues exceed site-level resolution capacity. 
Proactively identify and communicate recurring or environmental IT issues — including ISP outages, physical security concerns, and hardware trends — to the ITSD to support remote troubleshooting and long-term resolution. 


Skills & Qualifications:


Proven expertise managing the full operational and technical footprint of a corporate office, including facilities, IT coordination, and employee experience programs. 
Demonstrated ability to lead complex special projects independently — with strong judgment on scope, budget, trade-offs, and delivery. 
Takes initiative and drives outcomes without waiting for direction; highly organized and customer-focused. 
Expert-level calendar management across international and US time zones; comfortable navigating complex executive schedules. 
Exercises sound, independent judgment and executes with precision. 
Deep familiarity with workplace technology systems and IT hardware lifecycle management; able to evaluate and implement new tools with minimal ramp-up. Our team uses Outlook, Zoom, and Slack. 
Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to align stakeholders across functions. 


Benefits:


Private Medical Insurance 
Grocery Coupons 
Telework 
Christmas Bonus (15 Days) 


Pacvue is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

description:
About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Marketing Associate 

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Marketing Associate , you won't just be watching from the sidelines; you will be hands-on from day one, collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate complex technical innovations into compelling market value.

Location: This role will be based remote globally

What Your Day Will Look Like


GTM Support: Contribute to go-to-market planning and execution. 
Storytelling: Draft and edit compelling messaging and positioning that highlights business value for diverse target audiences. 
Campaign Coordination: Assist in developing campaign plans and content dissemination strategies to ensure our message reaches the right people. 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other demand generation and digital teams to help optimize marketing funnels and track campaign performance. 
Event & Social Support: Work with the wider marketing team to coordinate webinars, events, and social media promotions. 



What We Are Looking For In You


Tech Curiosity: A genuine passion for technology and a desire to learn about open source. 
Analytical Thinking: An ability to break down complex issues and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations. 
Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships within a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; you enjoy storytelling and creating impactful content. 
Proactive Mindset: A self-starter who can prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines in a dynamic setting. 
Foundational Knowledge: A basic understanding of marketing principles or go-to-market strategies (via your degree, internships, or personal projects). 
Growth Mindset: Someone who is eager to learn, open to feedback, and not afraid to take on new challenges. 



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.


Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

Inspired by their own experiences, they came up with a simple but brilliant idea: why not allow travellers to buy data plans for any destination from their home country?

Our passion for providing easy and convenient connectivity to travellers around the world drives everything we do.

We love our work and we do it with pride. Stay connected wherever you go.

About the job

Description

The Consumer Marketing Coordinator will support the execution and operational management of consumer marketing strategies for MAC Cosmetics, ensuring strong alignment between strategy, execution, performance tracking and daily operations. This role is key to the successful implementation of consumer-facing initiatives across social, influencer marketing, CRM, content, PR activations, digital platforms and omnichannel consumer touchpoints.

The role will be responsible for coordinating and executing core consumer marketing processes, supporting campaign development, product launches, always-on brand strategies, and seasonal activations, ensuring consistency with global and regional frameworks while adapting them to local market needs.

This position requires a highly analytical and strategic operational profile, capable of supporting decision-making through data, performance analysis, market insights, and consumer behavior understanding. A key responsibility is the strategic identification, analysis and evaluation of influencer and talent profiles, based on metrics, performance KPIs, audience relevance, brand fit, content quality, business objectives and consumer segmentation, supporting the development of effective influencer and creator strategies.

The Consumer Marketing Coordinator will play a critical role in the execution of influencer marketing, content ecosystems and creator programs, including coordination, briefing, follow-up, content development, approvals, performance tracking, reporting and operational management of collaborations, campaigns and always-on initiatives.

This role will provide direct strategic and operational support to the Consumer Marketing Manager, assisting in planning, execution, coordination, reporting, performance tracking, and day-to-day operational management of the Consumer Marketing area. Coordination and execution of social media strategies, content calendars and social cadence
Support in influencer strategy development, talent selection, performance analysis and reporting

CRM, digital and omnichannel campaign alignment
KPI tracking, reporting, market and competitor analysis
Operational execution, process management and follow-up
Cross-functional coordination with Digital, CRM, PR, E-commerce, Agencies, Corporate and Regional teams

The role contributes to brand growth by strengthening consumer acquisition, engagement, conversion and retention strategies, ensuring disciplined execution, operational excellence and performance-driven decision-making across all consumer marketing initiatives.

This is a cross-functional, execution-driven, analytical and strategically supportive role, essential for scaling the Consumer Marketing function and enabling high-impact brand activation.

High attention to detail – you catch the missing link in the message and the task that was marked done but wasn't.

description:
About the job

Overview

CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

Responsibilities

The Opportunity

Jr. Content Designer role is a specialist position focused on print, digital, or motion content materials design. A successful candidate must have a proficient understanding and functional capability with software used to create graphics and designs from scratch, as well as the ability to edit and manipulate creative assets. They will be responsible for developing and producing production ready graphics.

Additionally, the Jr. Brand Content Designer must be able to follow creative processes and produce various materials with full consistency. The Jr. Content Designer is also responsible for supporting the creative versioning of existing assets within our brand portfolio to meet customer and consumer needs.

Your Impact

As Jr. Content Designer your functions would consist of:


 Participate in brainstorming and concept development in a supporting role
 Design low complexity projects from scratch.
 Use editorial skills to create compelling and mesmerizing visual presentations for internal Marketing use
 Assist in creating design materials (graphics, assets, photo retouching, mockups, etc.)
 Execute design adaptations based on existing Key Visuals or Brand Guidelines to create Digital Ads, POS or other touchpoints.
 Deliver simple print artworks when needed.
 Act as a brand guardian by following brand guidelines closely.
 Be detail oriented, with an ability to prioritize, multitask, and stay organized while responding to quick requests.
 Learning and apply feedback to improve designs.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For?


 Bachelor’s degree in a directly related field (Advertising, Graphic Design, Visual Arts, etc.).
 Strong creative portfolio, available online or as a PDF.
 Proficiency in English.
 Basic knowledge of print design.
 Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign, Blender and After Affects is considered a plus.
 1 year experience working with creative teams in agency or in-house agency environments is a plus.
 Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with a willingness to learn and develop new design skills.


If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us:


Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs. 
Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning. 
Development programs according to Leadership skills. 
Specialized training according to the role. 
Learning experiences with internal and external providers. 
We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others. 
Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life. 
A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle. 
And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others. 


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

description:
About the job

About us:

At Near, we help top talent in Latin America find remote roles with US companies. Our mission is to create better lives by fostering a remote work culture that transcends borders.




About the role

We're revitalizing our outbound sales strategy and need someone hungry, resourceful, and AI-savvy to own this critical function. You'll implement proven projects already designed by our marketing/sales team, then have the freedom to optimize and develop new approaches as you demonstrate success.

This is a unique opportunity for a smart, driven individual who is curious and self-taught on AI to make a significant impact working directly with our founding team. We value execution and results over years of experience.




What You'll Do

Implement and execute two established outbound projects, ensuring consistent delivery and optimization.
Build and maintain systematic processes that deliver predictable results.
Prepare and manage cold outreach campaigns, including writing and refining email sequences - using AI to draft, test, and iterate faster
Measure and continuously improve outreach campaign performance to drive sales pipeline growth.
Leverage AI tools to research prospects, personalize outreach at scale, and automate repetitive tasks.
Identify new opportunities, tools, and approaches to enhance our outreach processes - with a strong eye toward AI-native solutions.
Collaborate closely with marketing to optimize strategy and nurture cold leads into marketing and sales-qualified opportunities.
Provide accurate performance reporting to the C-level management team.
Work directly with the founding team on all outbound initiatives.




Who You Are

A fast learner who works autonomously.
Naturally curious about AI - you've explored tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity on your own and find ways to apply them to real work.
Strong follow-through.
Proficient with Excel/Google Sheets.
Detail-oriented with a talent for building and maintaining efficient systems.
Results-driven with a bias toward action and continuous improvement.
Hungry to make an impact in a fast-paced startup environment.
Tech-savvy and eager to learn new tools.
Someone who thinks quickly, identifies issues proactively, and implements solutions.




Tech Stack & Tools

You'll become proficient with a range of modern sales and AI tools, including:

AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and similar) for research, copywriting, and workflow automation.
Google Sheets for data management and analysis.
Email sequencing tools for campaign management.
Domain management platforms.
Apollo, Amplemarket, and other sales enablement technologies.
Various automation and outreach optimization tools.




Your Growth Path

You'll start fully focused on executing existing outbound processes and campaigns.
As you demonstrate success, you'll gradually take ownership of the entire outbound system.
Over time, you'll transition into a more strategic role, developing and implementing your own outbound initiatives.




What's In It For You

Become a key revenue-generating team member in a fast-growing company.
Work directly with founders to shape and execute sales strategy.
Significant room for growth and advancement as you demonstrate results.
Develop valuable technical skills with modern sales, AI, and marketing tools.
Freedom to test new ideas, tactics, and approaches with leadership support.
Join a team of high performers with high standards who value initiative and fresh thinking.

description:
About the job

The Producer Roaster Forum (PRF) is a trade show and forum event that connects coffee producers and roasters, held once a year in coffee-producing countries. These events facilitate direct interactions, networking, and knowledge sharing, promoting innovation and strengthening the global coffee supply chain.




In addition to PRF, we organize the Global Coffee Awards across Europe, Latin America, Asia and more. As our designer, you will have the unique opportunity to shape the distinct visual identities and sub-brands for all of these international events throughout the year.




PRF is seeking a talented Brand & Visual Designer (Graphic Designer) to join our team. The ideal candidate will bring 3+ years of digital design experience, a proven track record of collaborating in a team environment, and a passion for flexing their creative muscles.




This is a permanent, full-time, fully remote role. You'll be joining a diverse, remote-first team currently spanning across Central and South America.




Because each of our events demands a completely new brand and visual refresh, we are looking for a designer who loves to innovate rather than replicate. You should be someone who embraces change, welcomes the challenge of frequent rebranding, and constantly seeks to push the creative envelope with fresh, forward-thinking designs.




PRF is the most important coffee event held in producing countries. As part of this team, you will report to our Marketing Manager, who will manage your workload, which includes:




Develop digital designs that help to achieve marketing and strategic goals for our brand.
Create new graphics in accordance with the existing brand guidelines.
Create, develop, and manage digital design solutions for a variety of uses, including social media, websites, graphics, newsletters, etc.
Liaise with the team on regular calls and team meetings to understand the range of projects and turn their descriptions into striking, aesthetic design assets.
Alter existing assets to be suitable across a range of platforms and formats.
Make necessary improvements to existing graphics/designs.
Ensure all designs follow the company’s brand guidelines and visual identity. Maintain consistent visual elements across all platforms and materials.
Be detail-oriented and organized in your day-to-day work.
Bring creativity to team brainstorming sessions.




ESSENTIAL:

A minimum of 3 years of experience with digital design.
A minimum of 3 years of experience using Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, AfterEffects, and tools such as Sketch or similar.
Experience with Figma or similar.
Bilingual - Spanish/English.
Ability to autonomously ideate, design, and create content for print.
Good understanding of social media (and visuals/graphics performing well across these platforms).
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage time effectively.
Collaborative skills.
Contribute effectively within an organizational structure.
Ability to perform as part of a small team.
An interest in the specialty coffee sector.
Willingness to travel to coffee farms and participate in events.




DESIRABLE:

Klaviyo
Website UI/UX design
Understanding of HTML

Our client is a boutique digital marketing agency that prioritizes substance over fluff, maintaining a close, high-impact relationship with a limited roster of premium clients across music, entertainment, media, and tech.

This role is structured in phases: initially, your primary focus will be performing meticulous quality checks and reporting across paid marketing, email, and SMS campaigns. Within a month, you will transition into independently planning, setting up, and launching ad campaigns across multiple platforms. If you are an incredibly organized stickler for detail who loves a fast-paced environment, this role is for you.




Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance: Quality check campaign execution by the advertising team, catching errors in setup, targeting, copy, creative, event dates, locations, and more.
Communications & Tracking: Monitor and respond to pertinent email communications between clients and external teams.
Campaign Execution: Build, launch, and manage end-to-end paid ad campaigns without assistance across Meta and TikTok (and ideally Google).
Strategy & Reporting: Create strategic and budget recommendations for campaigns and develop regular reports with actionable insights for clients.
Project Management: Ensure meeting action items are carefully noted, assigned, and tracked in ClickUp to ensure timely execution.




Must-Have Qualifications

Experience: 3+ years of experience building and managing ad campaigns, with deep expertise in the nuances of the Meta ads platform at a micro level, alongside experience in TikTok and Google Ads.
Project Management Tools: Proficiency using in-depth project management platforms such as ClickUp, Asana, or similar software.
Extreme Attention to Detail: Absolute zero-tolerance for typos, inaccurate information, or mismatched event details (such as dates, venues, or lineups).
Communication Skills: Proactive internal and external communication skills with fluent English proficiency.
Team Fit: Experience working closely with a small, fast-paced team while remaining highly organized with your own tasks, priorities, and calendar.




Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience working with ticketed live events, a passion for music, or strong taste in the space.
Hands-on technical experience with tracking pixels (generation, installation, conversion events, and custom audience creation).
Proficiency with Google Analytics to monitor client traffic trends.
Experience drafting and executing email or SMS marketing campaigns using platforms like Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Laylo, Hive, or Community.
Foundational SEO optimization skills across client web domains.




Why Work With Us?

Join a boutique, fast-paced team where your work directly moves the needle for high-quality clients.
Escape the corporate fluff—we focus on meaningful campaigns, proactive insights, and real results that keep clients partnering with us for years.
Opportunity to rapidly expand your operational responsibilities from quality control into full campaign ownership.

description:
About the job

Job Type: Internship




Job Location: Mexico (Remote)




Compensation: Commission-Based (no fixed stipend)




Company Description

Axentra OS is an innovative platform created to eliminate inefficiencies in Shopify stores by automating complexities and streamlining operations. It offers an all-in-one operating system that integrates 33 applications (more are being added) such as logins, customer accounts, order management, exchanges, returns, refunds, reviews, referrals, subscriptions, CRM, engagement tools, revenue generation, analytics, and more. Designed for operational control and scalable growth, Axentra OS provides seamless workflows and refined customer experiences. It helps merchants overcome the fragmentation in e-commerce with beautiful, intuitive interfaces and merchant-centric solutions.




More about us here — https://www.axentraos.com

and here — https://apps.shopify.com/axentra-customer-command-centre




With us, you’ll learn the fundamentals of how modern commerce moves. You’ll connect with founders, marketers, and decision-makers building the next generation of e-commerce brands. You’ll see how conversations turn into strategy, and how technology becomes the edge that defines success.




What you will do

Establish Partnerships with Web Development agencies or freelancers focused on the Shopify platform: The primary focus of this role is to reach out to Shopify merchants and agencies in Mexico via cold calling to establish partnerships between our company and them.




Requirements

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related fields.

• You may be a Shopify Developer looking to partner with a leading tech company.

• Excellent communication skills for engaging diverse audiences.

• Strong passion for digital marketing, social media marketing, web development, SEO and eagerness to learn within a startup environment.

• Familiarity with social media platforms, particularly LinkedIn, Facebook, Reddit, and Instagram.

• Proactive mindset, ability to take initiative, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Team collaboration skills coupled with independence and self-motivation.

About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a BC (Business Campaign) Campaign Strategy Intern at DiDi, you will support the design, execution, and performance analysis of marketing and activation campaigns that drive driver and rider acquisition, retention, and platform engagement across multiple regions. Your work will directly contribute to measurable increases in user activation rates, cost-per-acquisition improvement, and campaign ROI while helping the campaign strategy team scale targeted programs across DiDi’s large, multi-product ecosystem.

In this role, you'll be...


Analyze campaign performance data and generate weekly dashboards and insights that identify trends, anomalies, and optimization opportunities, contributing to a 10–20% improvement in campaign KPIs.
Support the planning and execution of cross-channel acquisition and retention campaigns (in-app, push, SMS, paid social), coordinating with product, operations, and creative teams to ensure timely launches and consistent messaging.

Develop A/B test plans and track results for creative, channel mix, and incentive structures, documenting learnings and recommending scalable changes to reduce CPA and increase LTV.
Prepare concise business-facing reports and presentation decks that translate campaign findings into actionable recommendations for regional managers and senior stakeholders.
Monitor campaign budget spend and pacing, flagging risks and proposing reallocation strategies to maximize ROI while ensuring compliance with local market guidelines.
Assist in local market research and competitive benchmarking to adapt global campaign frameworks to regional behaviors and regulatory constraints, ensuring relevance and compliance.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Last years of bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred.
Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using Excel, SQL, or analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Looker, Tableau) to manipulate datasets and derive actionable insights.
Proactive, collaborative attitude with experience working in cross-functional teams and the adaptability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
Attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership, able to manage campaign tracking, budget pacing, and documentation for multiple regional pilots concurrently.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

description:
About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Graduate Partner Marketing Manager

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Graduate Partner Marketing Manager, you aren’t just running campaigns; you are architecting the strategic relationships that drive our business forward. You will collaborate with the titans of tech:


Public cloud: AWS, Google, Microsoft, Oracle.
Silicon: NVIDIA, Intel, Arm, Qualcomm, AMD.
Global hardware: Dell, HP, Lenovo.



Early careers & growth

We are specifically looking for recent graduates who are serious about their success and ready to make a global impact. At Canonical, we prioritize talent and potential over years of experience; we will teach you the technical and commercial nuances of the open-source world through our structured career journey program. You will gain experience working with top tier talent and with multiple enterprise technologies. If you have the drive and a high standard for excellence, we provide the platform for you to become a world-class marketing leader.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas region and will report to the Partner Marketing Team Manager.

Your impact


Architect joint success: Build high-velocity go-to-market plans with global partners, moving from initial messaging to full-scale pipeline generation.
Launch at scale: Lead integrated campaigns, industry announcements, and product launches that reach everyone from developers to C-suite decision-makers.
Creative packaging: Translate cutting-edge tech in the open-source world into educational and marketing content that resonates.
Ecosystem evolution: Shape and scale our partner programs to keep pace with an ever-expanding network of hardware vendors, software vendors, and channel resellers.



What We’re Looking For


The marketing basics: You understand how marketing works (especially within enterprises) and have familiarity with common marketing platforms, social media, and business technology.
The relationship builder: You can navigate complex and dynamic organizations and build lasting rapport.
The analytical thinker: You obsess over value and use data to decide which experiments to scale and which to iterate.
The self-starter: You thrive in a fast-paced, remote environment and aren't afraid to "roll up your sleeves" to get a project across the finish line.



What We Offer You

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.


Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Parental Leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events



About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
About the job

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity, and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues 
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience 
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features 
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate 
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from the ground up and make a real impact on the future of the organization 
Be a part of building a brand-new team and operational culture for Stripe 
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user-first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
You have prior experience in customer service or internal and external user-facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you're an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and the ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross-team collaboration and support
You prioritize well and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you'll receive a weekday off. The SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support 
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives 



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

About the job

Role: E-commerce Simulation Expert (Remote)
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Payout: $40 - $50/hour




Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking an E-commerce Simulation Expert to work on a contract basis. The role focuses on building and refining synthetic e-commerce environments that train and evaluate advanced AI models. Your expertise in real-world commerce will directly shape how AI systems learn, reason, and perform across critical domains. This work supports the development of reliable AI agents and contributes to the evolution of human-in-the-loop AI training.




Key Responsibilities:

• Design and construct synthetic digital stores with realistic product assortments, logical category structures, and authentic pricing models to reflect real-world e-commerce complexity.

• Generate, structure, and maintain comprehensive product catalogs ensuring high data quality, logical consistency, and alignment with market standards.

• Develop diverse shopping scenarios and user prompts that simulate varied consumer intents, preferences, and challenging edge cases to stress-test AI behavior.

• Create evaluation rubrics and conduct rigorous quality assurance to ensure generated data and simulations meet domain-specific accuracy and realism requirements.

• Collaborate with AI teams to refine prompt engineering and scenario design for continuous improvement of AI training datasets.




Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Demonstrated experience in e-commerce operations, including product data management, catalog structuring, or retail systems with a focus on data integrity and real-world relevance.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to design complex, logically consistent product hierarchies and pricing logic.

• Familiarity with AI/LLM prompting and evaluation principles, or ability to quickly learn how to structure inputs that generate high-quality training data for AI systems.

• Background in scenario design and user behavior modeling, preferably in retail, consumer goods, or related domains.

• Attention to detail and a quality assurance mindset to maintain high standards in synthetic data generation and simulation environments.

• Self-directed work style with ability to manage multiple asynchronous tasks and deliver consistent, high-quality output under defined deadlines.




More About the Opportunity:

This role offers the chance to contribute directly to the development of frontier AI systems by leveraging real-world e-commerce expertise. You will work within a global network supporting AI research, with exposure to cutting-edge reinforcement learning environments and agent-based AI training. The position is ideal for professionals seeking meaningful impact through applied domain knowledge in a rapidly evolving field.




Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.

What Makes Us Unique 

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024 – but we're just getting started. 




How You'll Make an Impact: 

As a Customer Support Coach, you will be the voice of and advocate for our customers, providing exceptional support. By resolving questions and troubleshooting issues across multiple channels, you’ll ensure a seamless experience for our hotel partners. Your contributions will strengthen client relationships, promote software adoption, and shape the future of our platform by sharing valuable feedback. You'll also play a key role in creating training materials, updating support resources, and staying ahead of system updates, making a lasting impact on our customers and team.




Our Customer Support Team:

Join a dynamic, fully remote team of over 60 global Customer Support professionals united by our goal of delivering exceptional customer experiences across live chat, email, and phone. We pride ourselves on our supportive, diverse, and collaborative culture, where continuous learning, growth, and innovation drive everything we do. Be part of a team that values connection, celebrates success, and always strives to exceed expectations!




What you Bring to the Team:

Assist and support our existing customers (hotel properties) daily in the use of our software
Resolve customers' inquiries via phone, email, chat, or any other media that Cloudbeds uses to help customers
Troubleshoot and make outbound calls for escalated issues
Foster strong customer relationships with empathy to drive loyalty, retention, and increased software adoption.
Gather customers' feedback and requirements for future releases of the software
Use training materials and attend company-wide online training sessions to keep up-to-date with the latest system updates




What Sets You Up for Success: 

1+ years of hospitality experience in hotels, hostels, BNBs, or similar with Front Desk, Night Auditor, Revenue Manager, General Manager, or similar roles
Previous experience in customer service or similar is a plus
Native or Fluent in English and Spanish, Portuguese is a plus.
Excellent communication skills and a positive attitude
Excellent problem-solving skills and emotional intelligence
Great levels of learning agility

Excellent internet/wifi connection

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. 




Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. title: Growth & Strategy Specialist - México

Representar las necesidades y oportunidades del mercado mexicano ante el equipo global de Innovamat para influir en la hoja de ruta de producto.
Trabajar con RevOps en la construcción y gestión del pipeline en Salesforce, garantizando calidad del dato y precisión en el forecasting.
Colaborar con el equipo global de Growth para trasladar y adaptar al contexto mexicano las best practices y experimentos que funcionan en otros mercados.

Liderazgo de equipos: experiencia construyendo y desarrollando equipos en entornos de alta ambigüedad y crecimiento acelerado.

Propósito: interés y pasión genuina por transformar la educación y la enseñanza de las matemáticas en México.

Impacto directo y medible: cada nuevo colegio incorporado representa cientos de niños y niñas aprendiendo matemáticas de manera diferente.
Equipo y respaldo global: acceso al conocimiento, herramientas y experiencia de un equipo global líder en EdTech, presente en más de 10 países.
Línea de carrera en LATAM: posibilidad de liderar el crecimiento regional conforme Innovamat escala en América Latina.
Cultura Innovamat: ambiente horizontal, dinámico y de alto rendimiento, donde se premia la iniciativa, la autonomía y el debate constructivo.
Flexibilidad: esquema de trabajo híbrido desde Ciudad de México, con balance saludable entre vida profesional y personal.

description:
About the job

Brainlabs is the media agency built to answer one question: what's actually driving profit? Founded in 2012 by Daniel Gilbert, we were built by engineers before we were a media agency. Today, 1,000+ Brainlabbers across five continents use our proprietary agents, built on 32 media tools and over 2,500 logged experiments, to help brands connect every channel they plan and buy to one thing: the bottom line.

The role

Brands live and die by their product pages. A great product with poor content gets buried. A well-optimized listing with clear titles, strong keywords, and accurate attributes climbs. This role

owns that gap.

As a Content Optimization and Catalogue Management Specialist, you'll be responsible for how our clients products show up, get found, and convert on Amazon and Mercado Libre. That means writing and refining listings, managing catalogue health, and building the kind of organic visibility that doesn't disappear the moment ad spend drops.

You'll work directly with client teams and internal strategists to keep catalogues clean, content sharp, and rankings moving in the right direction.

What will you do?

Your day-to-day breaks into two connected areas.

Content Optimization

Content optimization is where you drive organic performance. You'll conduct keyword research, write and update product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend attributes. You'll audit existing content against platform best practices and identify gaps before they become ranking problems. You'll test copy variations and track what actually moves the needle.

Catalogue Management

Catalogue management is where you keep the operation running. You'll handle the publication and maintenance of product listings, manage bulk uploads and flat files, resolve listing errors

and suppressed ASINs or items, and keep content synchronized across multiple accounts and categories. When something breaks, you figure out why and fix it.

Beyond those two pillars, you'll monitor organic ranking performance, report on content health metrics, and bring recommendations that are grounded in data, not guesswork.

What are we looking for?

Experience

Around three years working in content optimization and/or catalogue management on Amazon and/or Mercado Libre. You understand how these platforms rank organic results and you've

influenced those rankings for real brands.

Platform Fluency

You know Seller Central and Vendor Central. You've worked with Mercado Libre item publication flows. Flat files, bulk uploads, listing errors, and suppressed items are familiar

territory, not new concepts.

Keyword and SEO Fundamentals

You know how to research, prioritize, and place keywords in a way that platforms reward. You understand the difference between what drives impressions and what drives conversions.

Analytical Mindset

You read performance data and draw conclusions from it. If organic rankings drop, you have a process for diagnosing why. If a content change works, you can explain what it did and why it helped.

Attention to Detail

Catalogue work is unforgiving. A wrong attribute, a missing image, a misformatted file: these things cause real problems. You catch errors before they ship.

English Proficiency

You're comfortable reading, writing, and communicating professionally in English. You'll work with international teams and documentation.

Nice to Have


Experience with tools like Helium 10, Data Dive, or Jungle Scout.
Familiarity with Amazon's A+ Content and Brand Store modules.
Experience across multiple categories or markets.



What happens next?

We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.

Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!

Please note that we will never ask you to transfer cash or make any other payment to us in order to apply for a role or to work for Brainlabs. Any such asks are fraudulent and should be reported to the appropriate authorities in your area.
